No. {NUM}
{STRBUF}   x{NUM}
entries.translation:
号码{NUM}
{STRBUF}　　×{NUM}

entries.english:
Wild #MON
Battles: {NUM} Time Status
entries.translation:
与野生宝可梦战斗的
次数：{NUM}次 计数器的状态

entries.english:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MON there are in the
world. Three years ago,
PROF.OAK said that there were 150
different kinds.
entries.translation:
世界上到底有
多少种宝可梦呢。 大木博士
3年前的报告中是说总共有150种……

entries.english:
The COLOSSEUM--
upstairs at any #MON CENTER--is
for link battles. Battle records are
posted on the wall, so I can't
afford to lose.
entries.translation:
在宝可梦中心
2楼的竞技场可以进行连接对战。 墙上可以看到自己的成绩，
所以不能输太惨啊。

entries.english:
A higher level
#MON doesn'talways win. After all, it may
have a type dis-advantage. I don't think
there is a single #MON that is
the toughest.
entries.translation:
因为有属性相克，
不论等级多高， 绝对强大的宝可梦
也是几乎不存在的。

entries.english:
This is SLOWPOKE
WELL!
entries.translation: 这里是呆呆兽之井！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF10Text
entries.english:
I'm good!
You can't win.
entries.translation:
我很强哦！
你绝对赢不了我！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF11Text
entries.english:
Are you treating
this seriously?
entries.translation:
我要和你对战，
你能认真对待吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingF12Text
entries.english:
Ahahah! I'll take
it easy on you!
entries.translation:
啊哈哈！
我手下留情就是了！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF13Text
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER is a
tough place!
entries.translation:
这个对战塔里面，
净是一些高手哦。

entries.label: _BTGreetingF14Text
entries.english:
I want to see your
style in action!
entries.translation:
让我看看
你的品味！！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF15Text
entries.english:
OK, here goes!
I have momentum!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻，我要上了！
谁也没法阻止我！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF1Text
entries.english:
OK, I'm not
fooling around!
entries.translation:
那我要来真的了！
来对战吧。

entries.label: _BTGreetingF2Text
entries.english:
Look! My #MON
are really cute!
entries.translation:
快看，快看！
这是我可爱的宝可梦。

entries.label: _BTGreetingF3Text
entries.english:
Let's get our
battle started!
entries.translation:
来吧……
开始对战呀！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF4Text
entries.english:
Are we going to
battle? Let's!
entries.translation:
还是要对战吗？
嘻嘻，我要上了！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF5Text
entries.english:
Oh, you have some
rare #MON.
entries.translation:
哎呀，你使用的宝可梦
很稀有呢。

entries.label: _BTGreetingF6Text
entries.english:
Want to hear about
my cute #MON?
entries.translation:
你就这么想听我
炫耀自己的宝可梦吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingF7Text
entries.english:
Battle? Sure!
Right now!
entries.translation:
对战吗？
那就开始吧！！

entries.label: _BTGreetingF8Text
entries.english:
Please let me win!
Please?
entries.translation:
拜托，让我赢吧！
不可以吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingF9Text
entries.english:
Well, can we
begin?
entries.translation: 准备好了吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingM10Text
entries.english:
Hah!
Let's get rolling!
entries.translation:
呼——！！
来对战啊！！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM12Text
entries.english:
You want to be a
leader? Let me battle you,
then!
entries.translation:
你的目标是关主？
让我来做你的对手吧。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM13Text
entries.english:
Today, I'm going
to whomp you.
entries.translation:
今天，
我要轻松地战胜你。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM14Text
entries.english:
I bet you can't
beat me!
entries.translation:
战胜我，
能做得到吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingM15Text
entries.english:
I'll show you a
real battle!
entries.translation:
没错！
这就是对战啊。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM16Text
entries.english:
Let's go!
No holds barred!
entries.translation:
那就开始对战吧！
不要手下留情啊！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM17Text
entries.english:
My #MON skills
are phenomenal!
entries.translation:
我使用宝可梦的技法
无人能敌！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM18Text
entries.english:
Who are you?
I don't know you…
entries.translation:
你是谁？
不认识你啊……

entries.label: _BTGreetingM19Text
entries.english:
Um… Are you that…
um…person?
entries.translation:
你是
那个人吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingM1Text
entries.english:
Hello, glad to
meet you! I do hope we have
a good battle.
entries.translation:
你好，初次见面！
请多关照。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM20Text
entries.english:
I heard that
you're hot!
entries.translation:
听说你
真的很行呢——！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM21Text
entries.english:
I'm scared about
what might happen. My #MON are way
too strong.
entries.translation:
绝了，真是绝了！
我的宝可梦可能太强了。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM22Text
entries.english:
Hey, there!
I'll take you on!
entries.translation:
喂！
你的对手是我！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM23Text
entries.english:
I wonder if I can
battle properly…
entries.translation:
要对战啊……
我赢得了吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingM24Text
entries.english:
Wrrooar!
I won't lose!
entries.translation:
喔——！
我可不会输啊！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM25Text
entries.english:
Sorry, but I'm
going to win.
entries.translation:
你的对手是我。
很抱歉，我赢定了。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM2Text
entries.english:
Work, work, work…
I'm always busy!
entries.translation:
一天到晚都在忙工作，
真是忙得不得了。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM3Text
entries.english:
Brace yourself for
my all-out attack!
entries.translation:
我真的要拿出真本事了！
做好心理准备吧！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM4Text
entries.english:
Heh, your #MON
look pretty cool.
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿，
你的宝可梦很带感啊。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM5Text
entries.english:
#MON every day!
I love battling!
entries.translation:
宝可梦，每一天！！
玩对战，乐无边！！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM6Text
entries.english:
Hi, there! Let's
keep this clean!
entries.translation:
呀，请多关照！
来一场爽快的对战吧！

entries.label: _BTGreetingM7Text
entries.english:
Do you want to see
my battle level?
entries.translation:
你也想看
我的等级吗？

entries.label: _BTGreetingM8Text
entries.english:
Hey, let's battle.
I'm your opponent.
entries.translation:
嘿，来对战吧！
我当你的对手。

entries.label: _BTGreetingM9Text
entries.english:
I'm your
opponent. Get ready to be
hammered.
entries.translation:
你的对手是我，
做好心理准备。

entries.label: _BTLossF10Text
entries.english:
Giving up? You're
pretty weak!
entries.translation:
这么快就投降了？
你也太弱了吧？

entries.label: _BTLossF11Text
entries.english:
Oh, sorry! Looks
like I won!
entries.translation:
哎呀，抱歉！
是我赢了。

entries.label: _BTLossF12Text
entries.english:
Oops, sorry! But
I'm happy too!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻，抱歉啦！
有点开心呢。

entries.label: _BTLossF13Text
entries.english:
You might have a
hard time.
entries.translation:
以你的等级
到这里挺不容易的吧？

entries.label: _BTLossF14Text
entries.english:
Every battle is a
drama!
entries.translation:
对战？
那是一种浪漫！

entries.label: _BTLossF15Text
entries.english:
See, I rolled
right over you!
entries.translation:
你看，你无法阻止我吧？
我真帅啊！

entries.label: _BTLossF1Text
entries.english:
Yay! Too easy!
Like, no way!
entries.translation:
太好了，真是太开心了，
轻松取胜，绰绰有余！

entries.label: _BTLossF2Text
entries.english:
Aren't they really
adorable?
entries.translation:
大家都非常非常可爱，
对吧？

entries.label: _BTLossF3Text
entries.english:
Was I too strong
for you?
entries.translation:
我是不是
太强了呀？

entries.label: _BTLossF4Text
entries.english:
Oh, you're too
weak. Shame.
entries.translation:
哎呀，也太弱了吧。
你不行呢！

entries.label: _BTLossF5Text
entries.english:
May I have one of
your #MON?
entries.translation:
那个宝可梦
给我算了？

entries.label: _BTLossF6Text
entries.english:
What do you think
about my cuties?
entries.translation:
我可爱的宝可梦
怎么样啊？

entries.label: _BTLossF7Text
entries.english:
Oh, I love it!
Battling is wild!
entries.translation:
我真的好喜欢
好喜欢对战！！

entries.label: _BTLossF8Text
entries.english:
Wow, thank you!
You're so nice!
entries.translation:
呀～～谢谢！
你真温柔呢。

entries.label: _BTLossF9Text
entries.english:
Well, I beg your
pardon…
entries.translation: 嘻嘻嘻……失礼了。

entries.label: _BTLossM10Text
entries.english:
Wahahaha! Didn't
break a sweat!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈哈！
赢得很轻松啊。

entries.label: _BTLossM12Text
entries.english:
You need another
ten years of training to get
better, I'd say.
entries.translation:
还差十年呢，
你学得不够勤奋！

entries.label: _BTLossM13Text
entries.english:
I knew I'd win.
I'm so great!
entries.translation:
果然是我赢了，
我真厉害啊。

entries.label: _BTLossM14Text
entries.english:
Those #MON
aren't enough!
entries.translation:
那种宝可梦
还差了点！

entries.label: _BTLossM15Text
entries.english:
This battle…
I'm bored!
entries.translation:
这种对战……
太无聊了啊！！

entries.label: _BTLossM16Text
entries.english:
Sorry! I wanted
the win more!
entries.translation:
呀，抱歉！！
你的气势差了点吧？

entries.label: _BTLossM17Text
entries.english:
You've got a long
way to go. Well, keep trying!
Best of luck!
entries.translation:
你还差得远呢。
回去好好练习吧。

entries.label: _BTLossM18Text
entries.english:
I must've imagined
that. There seems to be
no one here…
entries.translation:
是我的错觉吗，
这里好像没人啊。

entries.label: _BTLossM19Text
entries.english:
It doesn't appear
to be you…
entries.translation:
你应该……
不是我说的那个人。

entries.label: _BTLossM1Text
entries.english:
Thank you! A most
enjoyable battle!
entries.translation:
真的非常感谢。
这是场开心的对战。

entries.label: _BTLossM20Text
entries.english:
Not bad. I was
just a bit better.
entries.translation:
其实
不太行吧！？

entries.label: _BTLossM21Text
entries.english:
See? My #MON
were too strong.
entries.translation:
对吧？
它们真的很强吧？

entries.label: _BTLossM22Text
entries.english:
Don't you have a
better strategy?
entries.translation:
你就拿不出什么
更好的战术吗！？

entries.label: _BTLossM23Text
entries.english:
Um… Sorry…
I think I won.
entries.translation:
那个……抱歉，
看起来是我赢了。

entries.label: _BTLossM24Text
entries.english:
Wrrooar! I knew
I was a genius!
entries.translation:
喔——！
我果然是天才啊！

entries.label: _BTLossM25Text
entries.english:
Yeah! My #MON
rule!
entries.translation:
赢了！
我的宝可梦真酷！

entries.label: _BTLossM2Text
entries.english:
But, I work hard
in battle too!
entries.translation:
但是在对战中
我也没放水哦！

entries.label: _BTLossM3Text
entries.english:
What a cakewalk!
You're too easy!
entries.translation:
轻松获胜，
你也太弱了吧。

entries.label: _BTLossM4Text
entries.english:
Hey, hey, no way!
You won't win!
entries.translation:
嘿，嘿！！
就这样还想赢啊！

entries.label: _BTLossM5Text
entries.english:
I'm on top of my
game, but not you!
entries.translation:
我很淡定，哟！
你很震惊，哟！

entries.label: _BTLossM6Text
entries.english:
Whoops, sorry for
that wipeout!
entries.translation:
哎哟，抱歉抱歉！
别放在心上哦！

entries.label: _BTLossM7Text
entries.english:
Hehehe, I know
your level now!
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿……
我看到你的等级了！

entries.label: _BTLossM8Text
entries.english:
Wow, you're not
serious about it!
entries.translation:
你一点也不
上心呢！！

entries.label: _BTLossM9Text
entries.english:
Hahah! That was a
pushover!
entries.translation:
哈，哈，哈！
赢得太轻松了。

entries.label: _BTWinF10Text
entries.english:
I won't accept
this… No way!
entries.translation:
我不承认……
我绝对不承认！

entries.label: _BTWinF11Text
entries.english:
Oh, how nasty!
You were serious!
entries.translation:
哎呀，真过分！
你认真的吗？

entries.label: _BTWinF12Text
entries.english:
Oh, oh, I lost!
Thanks. Bye!
entries.translation:
哎——输了？
还是要谢谢你。

entries.label: _BTWinF13Text
entries.english:
Ooh, you might
make a run here!
entries.translation:
真棒！
你一定可以的！

entries.label: _BTWinF14Text
entries.english:
Oh… Want to trade
something?
entries.translation:
啊，啊—— 
要不要和我交换？

entries.label: _BTWinF15Text
entries.english:
No! This did not
happen!
entries.translation:
生气！！讨厌！
我绝对不承认！

entries.label: _BTWinF1Text
entries.english:
No!
Like, no way!
entries.translation:
不——！？
我想大叫：不甘心啊——！

entries.label: _BTWinF2Text
entries.english:
I'm sorry, it's
all my fault!
entries.translation:
抱歉，各位！
是我的技术太差了。

entries.label: _BTWinF3Text
entries.english:
Ooh, you're in a
different class.
entries.translation:
你真强呀……
我赢不了呀……

entries.label: _BTWinF4Text
entries.english:
Wow! Are you quite
satisfied?
entries.translation:
哇，真厉害啊！！
你满意了吧？

entries.label: _BTWinF5Text
entries.english:
…I want one of
your #MON.
entries.translation:
………我还是
很想要那个宝可梦……

entries.label: _BTWinF6Text
entries.english:
Oh! My! You're a
dreadful trainer!
entries.translation:
真是的！！
你是不是太过分了！

entries.label: _BTWinF7Text
entries.english:
Oh, how rude! Wait
till next time!
entries.translation:
啊，真失礼啊！
真想说：下次再找你算账！

entries.label: _BTWinF8Text
entries.english:
You're mean!
I hate meanies!
entries.translation:
我真的很讨厌
你这种坏心眼的人。

entries.label: _BTWinF9Text
entries.english:
Sob… That's not
fair!
entries.translation: 呜呜呜，太不公平了。

entries.label: _BTWinM10Text
entries.english:
Tough! I'm no
match for you!
entries.translation:
太强了……！
我赢不了你啊。

entries.label: _BTWinM12Text
entries.english:
You're incredibly
talented. No one can touch
you now!
entries.translation:
你具有优秀的才能。
比任何人都优秀！

entries.label: _BTWinM13Text
entries.english:
Uh? My plans are
out of whack…
entries.translation:
哎呀？
和预想的不一样啊。

entries.label: _BTWinM14Text
entries.english:
I want your
#MON. Please?
entries.translation:
我想要那只宝可梦。
………你不愿意吗？

entries.label: _BTWinM15Text
entries.english:
…I won't turn tail
in battle!
entries.translation:
………我才不会
逃走啊！！

entries.label: _BTWinM16Text
entries.english:
Wahah! Congrats!
I can't do better!
entries.translation:
哈哈哈，恭喜！
我可赢不了你啊！

entries.label: _BTWinM17Text
entries.english:
Aww… Don't lose
after beating me.
entries.translation:
啊……接下来
一路高歌猛进吧！

entries.label: _BTWinM18Text
entries.english:
Who am I?
I don't know…
entries.translation:
你问我是谁？
我不知道……

entries.label: _BTWinM19Text
entries.english:
Then you really
are the legendary…
entries.translation:
哦哦！！
你就是传说中的……？

entries.label: _BTWinM1Text
entries.english:
Thank you. You are
formidable.
entries.translation:
真的非常感谢。
你很强呢。

entries.label: _BTWinM20Text
entries.english:
Eh, you're not
that special.
entries.translation:
哎呀，
也不过如此嘛。

entries.label: _BTWinM21Text
entries.english:
Graa! My #MON
were total wimps!
entries.translation:
生气！！
我的宝可梦弱得一批！

entries.label: _BTWinM22Text
entries.english:
You've got decent
style!
entries.translation:
哦哦！
你的直觉不错啊。

entries.label: _BTWinM23Text
entries.english:
I guess I'm not
good enough yet…
entries.translation:
我技术太差了吗？
我还不行吗？

entries.label: _BTWinM24Text
entries.english:
Arrooh! I hate it
when I lose!
entries.translation:
喔——！
我输了，不甘心啊……

entries.label: _BTWinM25Text
entries.english:
Oh, close! I lost
by just a bit!
entries.translation:
嗯，可惜了！
就差一点点啊。

entries.label: _BTWinM2Text
entries.english:
I'm too busy to be
battling!
entries.translation:
工作太忙了，
根本没空对战啊。

entries.label: _BTWinM3Text
entries.english:
I won't lose next
time, all right?
entries.translation:
下次我可不会输了！
走着瞧吧。

entries.label: _BTWinM4Text
entries.english:
You serious?
This is brutal!
entries.translation:
噫，讲真！？
这真是绝了！

entries.label: _BTWinM5Text
entries.english:
I don't care that
I lost, really!
entries.translation:
对战算什么 ………
后悔算什么 ………

entries.label: _BTWinM6Text
entries.english:
Whoops! Come on,
let me win one!
entries.translation:
啊哈哈，可恶！
让我赢一次吧！

entries.label: _BTWinM7Text
entries.english:
Ouch… I'm just too
weak…
entries.translation:
呜呜……
我还是太弱了。

entries.label: _BTWinM8Text
entries.english:
…Urgh… Nothing
positive here…

entries.label: _BTWinM9Text
entries.english:
No way! There has
to be a mistake!
entries.translation:
骗人的吧！
怎么会这样！

entries.label: AlanAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english: Yup, it's {STRBUF}! Is that {PLAYER}?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}！ 哎呀，{PLAYER}？

entries.label: AlanAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yup, it's {STRBUF}! Is that {PLAYER}?
Good evening!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}！ 呀，{PLAYER}，晚上好！

entries.label: AlanAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yup, it's {STRBUF}! Is this {PLAYER}?
Good morning!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}！ {PLAYER}呀？早上好！

entries.label: AlanGenericText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, are you
raising your#MON properly? I read in a book
that you should raise any #MON
you catch withlove and care.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，
你还在培育宝可梦吧？ 我以前在书上读到过，
一定要好好照顾自己捕捉到的宝可梦！

entries.label: AlanGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hello! It's me,
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，是我呀，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AlanGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hello! It's me,
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，是我呀，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AlanGreetText
entries.english:
Hello! It's me,
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，是我呀，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AlanBattleRematchText
entries.english:
I've studied quite
a bit since then, and I've gotten a
lot better! I'm hanging out on
{STRBUF}. Can you come down
for a battle?
entries.translation:
从那以后我拼命学习，
总算是变强了！ 我现在在{STRBUF}，
来和我对战吧！

entries.label: AlanComePickUpGiftText
entries.english:
I have to do my
homework, so can you come get your
gift right away? I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
你快点来拿啊！
我还要回去写作业呢！ 我在{STRBUF}等着你！

entries.label: AlanDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
By the way, we
knocked out a wild {STRBUF} just
the other day. Studying up in
advance worked!
entries.translation:
说起来，我之前
打倒了{STRBUF}哦！ 复习完全起作用了！

entries.label: AlanFoundItemText
entries.english:
Hehehe, I picked
up something nice! You can have it!
Why don't you come to {STRBUF}
and pick it up?
entries.translation:
嘿嘿，
刚刚捡到好东西了！ 我就给你好了！
你要来{STRBUF}拿吗？

entries.label: AlanGettingStrongerText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
getting stronger, exactly as I
calculated!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}啊，
最近越来越强了！和我预想的一样！

entries.label: AlanHangUpText
entries.english: See you later!
entries.translation: 那就再见了！

entries.label: AlanHaventPickedUpAnythingText
entries.english:
I haven't picked
up anything yet. I'll call you if I
find something.
entries.translation:
呃……
我还没发现遗失物…… 找到了马上联系你！

entries.label: AlanLostAMonText
entries.english:
By the way, a wild
{STRBUF} escapedon me yesterday. A computational
error on my part…
entries.translation:
说起来，我昨天
放跑了{STRBUF}。 这可真是出乎预料。

entries.label: AlanReminderText
entries.english:
If we don't battle
soon, I'll forgetmy strategy! I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
再不快点来和我对战的话，
我就要忘记自己的战术了！ 我在{STRBUF}等着你！

entries.label: AlanAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Reading textbooks
is worthwhileevery so often. When I'm reading
and walking, Ihave to look down. So I notice items
on the ground. Next time I find
something, I'llgive it to you. May I have your
phone number?
entries.translation:
但是，偶尔读读课本
也会发生好事哦。 比方说，有时候边走路
边低头读课本，会发现别人掉的好东西！ 对了，下次再捡到东西，
我可以送给你哦！告诉我你的电话号码吧？

entries.label: AlanAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
If I find some-
thing, it's yours. So may I have your
phone number?
entries.translation:
如果找到东西就送你，
告诉我你的电话号码吧？

entries.label: AlanGiftText
entries.english:
This, this! This
is yours! Ta-da!
entries.translation:
就是这个！送你了！
锵！

entries.label: AlanNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll call you as
soon as I find something. You can
count on it!
entries.translation:
发现好东西的话，
就打电话给你，敬请期待！

entries.label: AlanNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh… I thought it
would be a good break to call you
when I'm studying…
entries.translation:
哎，要是能用电话来
转换学习的心情，我也会很高兴的啊。

entries.label: AlanPackFullText
entries.english:
Whoops! You can't carry
any more items! I'll hold it until
next time.
entries.translation:
嗯，遗憾！
你拿不下更多了…… 下次再给你吧！

entries.label: AlanPhoneFullText
entries.english:
There's no room
for my number.
entries.translation:
哎呀？你都电话存满了，
没法再添加我的号码了。

entries.label: AlanRematchText
entries.english:
I waited around
for you! I'm thoroughly
prepared today!
entries.translation:
在等着你呢！
这次好好预习了！

entries.label: AnthonyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yeah, {STRBUF} the
HIKER here. Ah, {PLAYER},
right?
entries.translation: 喂，我是登山男{STRBUF}！ 哦！{PLAYER}呀！

entries.label: AnthonyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yeah, {STRBUF} the
HIKER here. Ah, {PLAYER}, isn't
it?
entries.translation: 喂，我是登山男{STRBUF}！ 哦！{PLAYER}啊！

entries.label: AnthonyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yeah, {STRBUF} the
HIKER here. Ah, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂，我是登山男{STRBUF}！ 哦！{PLAYER}！

entries.label: AnthonyGenericText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
as feisty as ever? My {STRBUF} and
me--we have energy to burn. We hike
up mountains every day to work out
all our energy.
entries.translation:
宝可梦都挺好吧？ 我和{STRBUF}
每天都在登山，现在精神得不得了，而我不会对此感到苦恼！

entries.label: AnthonyGreetDayText
entries.translation: 哟，{PLAYER}啊——！ 我是登山男{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AnthonyGreetNiteText
entries.translation: {PLAYER}！没吓到吧！ 我是登山男{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AnthonyGreetText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}? This is {STRBUF}
the HIKER!
entries.translation: 哟，{PLAYER}啊！ 我是登山男{STRBUF}！

entries.label: AnthonyBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Come on--let's
battle right now! {STRBUF} is
where I am. Come on down if
you feel up to it!
entries.translation:
马上来场宝可梦对战吧！ 我在{STRBUF}，
有干劲的时候就过来吧！

entries.label: AnthonyDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Lately, I've been
running across wild {STRBUF}
quite often. They're easily
taken care of.
entries.translation:
还有，我最近总能遇见
{STRBUF}哦！最后当然是轻松搞定啦。

entries.label: AnthonyHangUpText
entries.english:
All right then!
Be good!
entries.translation: 那你也保重吧！

entries.label: AnthonyHurryText
entries.english:
Hello? What? Where
is DUNSPARCE? DARK CAVE! Hurry! I know I've said
it before, but DUNSPARCE don't
appear when there are strong #MON
around.
entries.translation:
喂喂！
啊，你问土龙弟弟在哪？ 黑暗洞穴啊！赶紧去吧！ 我以前也说过好几次，
土龙弟弟好像不愿意待在有强大宝可梦的地方。

entries.label: AnthonyLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I was
battling this {STRBUF} the
other day… It took off when I
got distracted bya passing BEAUTY. Learn from my
mistake--always stay focused on
the job at hand!
entries.translation:
哦，对了。我最近和
{STRBUF}对战的时候，视线一不小心就被路过的大姐姐吸引，它就乘机逃掉了！ 你也要认真一点啊！

entries.label: AnthonyMonAteSomeBerriesText
entries.english:
The other day, I
was watching my {STRBUF} eat
some BERRIES. It looked like it
was enjoying its meal, so I decided
to try some. I'm not sure if
people should eat that stuff, but it
was delicious!
entries.translation:
最近我的{STRBUF}
吃了一些树果。看它吃得这么香，我就跟着一起吃了！不知道人吃了会怎么样…… 不过是真的好吃。

entries.label: AnthonyReminderText
entries.english:
Hello! You haven't
forgotten about our battle, have
you? {STRBUF}!
I'm waiting!
entries.translation:
喂喂——！
你没忘记吧！ 说好了要和我对战哦！
我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: AnthonySwarmText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! It's
mind-blowing! I took a hike in
{STRBUF}yesterday, see? Well, there were
tons of {STRBUF} around! You have
to see it! I get this feeling
that {STRBUF} may be timid.
I didn't see any where there are
strong #MON.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！你信吗！ 我昨天外出的时候，
走到了{STRBUF}…… 然后你猜怎么着！
那到处都是{STRBUF}！不去看就亏大发了！ 不过……{STRBUF}
该不会是胆小鬼吧……？不然它们为什么出现在没有强大宝可梦的地方呢？

entries.label: AnthonyWasntPayingAttentionText
entries.english:
Rare #MON? Hey, sorry! I was
too focused on my hike, so I wasn't
paying attention.
entries.translation:
稀有的宝可梦？ 抱歉！我一心想着登山，
就没怎么注意这个……

entries.label: AnthonyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
By the way, I'm a
HIKER, so I often go to mountains
and caves. I occasionally see
rare #MON. I could call you
the next time Isee one. Feel like swapping
phone numbers?
entries.translation:
话说回来！ 因为我是登山男，所以
经常会去高山或洞穴， 时不时就会
遇见稀有的宝可梦哦！ 如果遇见了的话，
下次我可以打电话联系你哦！ 要交换电话号码吗？

entries.label: AnthonyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I could call you
when I see somerare #MON. Feel like swapping
phone numbers?
entries.translation:
我遇见稀有宝可梦的话，
可以联系你哦！ 要交换电话号码吗？

entries.label: AnthonyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Be patient. I'll
find some rare#MON for you!
entries.translation:
在发现稀有宝可梦之前，
我会一直守在这里的！

entries.label: AnthonyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
You're cold. I may
as well head tothe mountains…
entries.translation:
居然这么绝情，
我真想找座山钻进去……

entries.label: AnthonyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone's full. It can't register
my phone number.
entries.translation:
喂喂，电话已存满了。
没法再添加了。

entries.label: AnthonyRematchText
entries.english:
All righty, then! My #MON and I
are raring to go!
entries.translation:
好，快点来对战吧！ 我也和宝可梦
全都精力充沛——！

entries.label: ArnieAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello, you
got {STRBUF}. …Huh, {PLAYER}? Yo!
entries.translation: 喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。 ……{PLAYER}吗，嗨！

entries.label: ArnieAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello, you
got {STRBUF}. …Huh, {PLAYER}? Yo!
entries.translation: 喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。 ……{PLAYER}吗，嗨！

entries.label: ArnieAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello.
This is {STRBUF}. …Huh, {PLAYER}? Yo!
entries.translation: 喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。 ……{PLAYER}吗，嗨！

entries.label: ArnieGenericText
entries.english:
I bet your #MON
are a lot strongerthan before.
entries.translation:
你和你的宝可梦
都强了不少呢。

entries.label: ArnieGreetDayText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello?
{STRBUF} calling. Where are you now,
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation:
喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。
{PLAYER}在哪呢？

entries.label: ArnieGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello?
{STRBUF} calling. Are you awake now,
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation:
喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。
{PLAYER}没睡吧？

entries.label: ArnieGreetText
entries.english:
Yeah, hello?
{STRBUF} calling. What are you up
to, {PLAYER}?
entries.translation:
喂喂——我是{STRBUF}。
{PLAYER}在干嘛呢？

entries.label: ArnieBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Hey, let's battle
our #MON! I won't lose to
you battling or in the Bug-Catching
Contest! I'll be here on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
哎，和我来场对战吧！ 不管是对战还是捕虫大赛，
我都不会输！ 我在{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ArnieDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Changing the topic
here, I saw this {STRBUF} for the
first time. It was easy to
beat, actually.
entries.translation:
话说回来，
我之前看到{STRBUF}，虽然是第一次进行对战，结果却赢得意外轻松！

entries.label: ArnieHangUpText
entries.english:
Let's talk again,
huh?
entries.translation: 那下次再聊！

entries.label: ArnieHaventSeenRareMonText
entries.english:
I haven't had any
luck seeing rare#MON lately… But I know they're
out there!
entries.translation:
我最近怎么也找不到
稀有的宝可梦…… 但我相信一定能找到！

entries.label: ArnieHurryText
entries.english:
Hello? Are you
coming or what? You're missing out
on seeing YANMA! Get down to ROUTE
35 right now!
entries.translation:
喂喂——！你不来吗？ 不看蜻蜻蜓就太亏了！
35号道路，快来！

entries.label: ArnieLostAMonText
entries.english:
I was wondering,
do you happen tohave {STRBUF}? I can't seem to
catch one. What is its weakness, I
wonder.
entries.translation:
哎，你有没有
{STRBUF}啊？ 我怎么也捉不到，
它有什么弱点啊？

entries.label: ArnieMonIsSoCuteText
entries.english:
I'm always with my
{STRBUF}! It's so cute!
I just love it!
entries.translation:
我永远都和
{STRBUF}在一起！它真是又强又可爱啊！

entries.label: ArnieReminderText
entries.english:
Hey, where are you
now? Let's battle. I'll
be waiting for youon {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
喂喂？现在在哪啊？ 快来和我对战吧！
我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: ArnieSwarmText
entries.english:
Boy, am I glad I
caught you! A whole bunch of
{STRBUF} have appeared around
{STRBUF}! You have to see
this!

entries.label: ArnieAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Do you get the
feeling that there are more rare
#MON around? I'm positive there
are, so I look allthe time. If I find one, I
want to share the good news with
everyone I know. I know! Give me
your phone number.
entries.translation:
话说回来，你不觉得
这附近应该有更稀有的宝可梦吗？ 我认为一定是有的，
所以一直都在寻找。 等我发现了，一定会
开心地昭告天下——！ 对了！把你的电话号码也
告诉我吧！

entries.label: ArnieAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I want to let
people know if Isee rare #MON. Please give me
your phone number!
entries.translation:
发现稀有的宝可梦的话
我就想让别人知道——！ 快告诉我电话号码！

entries.label: ArnieNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
If I spot any
awesome #MON, I'll be sure to
give you a call!
entries.translation:
如果发现了特别的宝可梦，
一定会给你打电话的！

entries.label: ArnieNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Aww! I want to
tell someone aboutmy discoveries!
entries.translation:
怎么这样啊——！
我真的想让别人知道啊—！

entries.label: ArniePhoneFullText
entries.translation:
你的电话没空位了啊，
如果有空位一定要加我！

entries.label: ArnieRematchText
entries.english:
It's my turn to
win now! I've turned over a
new leaf!
entries.translation: 这次轮到我赢了——！ 和上次可不一样了哦！

entries.label: BethAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，你好！

entries.label: BethAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh, {PLAYER}.
Good evening.
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，晚上好！

entries.label: BethAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh, {PLAYER}.
Good morning.
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，早上好！

entries.label: BethGenericText
entries.english:
Are you the kind
of person who goes to #MON CENTERS
often? I go every day.
Watching out for the health of your
#MON is a basic part of being a
#MON trainer.
entries.translation:
喂，你是不是那种
经常去宝可梦中心的人？ 我的话，每天都去哦。 宝可梦的健康管理是
宝可梦训练家的必备知识。

entries.label: BethGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, hi!
This is {STRBUF}. Do you have some
time?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，你好。
我是{STRBUF}，你有空吗？

entries.label: BethGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}.
Good evening. This is {STRBUF}. I hope you were
awake.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，早上好。
我是{STRBUF}，还没睡吧？

entries.label: BethGreetText
entries.english:
Good morning,
{PLAYER}! This is {STRBUF}.
Were you sleeping?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，早上好。
我是{STRBUF}，还在睡吗？

entries.label: BethBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Do you want to
battle? I'm goingto win this time! I'll be waiting
for you around {STRBUF}.
Look for me, OK?
entries.translation:
喂，要和我对战嘛？
这次肯定是我赢！ 我在{STRBUF}，
你经过的话，就来找我吧。

entries.label: BethDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh, have you ever
seen a {STRBUF}before? I just battled
one… It was much faster
than I expected. I was a little
shocked. I still won, of
course.
entries.translation:
还有啊，
你见过{STRBUF}吗？ 我之前和它对战了……
没想到它速度这么快，我有点被吓到了。 不过我赢了就是了。

entries.label: BethExhilaratingRideText
entries.english:
Do you remember my
sweet {STRBUF}? {STRBUF} runs
very fast. It's exhilarating
to ride on its back when it
really gets going.
entries.translation:
喂，你还记得
我的小{STRBUF}吗？ 说起小{STRBUF}啊，
跑得也太快了吧！ 我骑着它飞驰的时候，
感觉超级棒！

entries.label: BethHangUpText
entries.english: OK, bye-bye!
entries.translation: 那就拜拜咯！

entries.label: BethLetsBattleAgainSometimeText
entries.english:
Let's battle again
sometime!
entries.translation:
下次有机会，
再来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: BethLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh, I just saw a
wild {STRBUF}. I was trying to
catch it when I noticed that I was
all out of #BALLS. If you don't check
your items, you may run out at the
worst time. I hope you learn
from my mistake.
entries.translation:
还有啊，
之前遇见了{STRBUF}，就在我要捕捉它的时候…… 精灵球正好用完了。 所以说要经常检查道具，
不然关键时刻就会出事。你也要注意啊。

entries.label: BethReminderText
entries.english:
Um… {PLAYER}?
What's wrong? Did you forget our
deal? {STRBUF}. That's where I'm
waiting.
entries.translation:
哎？{PLAYER}，怎么了？
你忘记我们的约定了？ 我在{STRBUF}等着你呢。

entries.label: BethAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
It's been a while
since I lost… You're very good
at battling. We should battle
again sometime. By challenging a
tough trainer like you, I think I can
get better too. So how about it? Would you give me
your phone number?
entries.translation:
久违的失败……
你很精通宝可梦对战呢。 哪天再来场宝可梦对战吧。 我觉得，只要不断地和
你这样强大的训练家进行对战，我也能变强！ 所以你愿不愿意……
把电话号码告诉我？

entries.label: BethAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
By challenging a
tough trainer like you, I think I can
get better too. So how about it? Would you give me
your phone number?
entries.translation:
我觉得，只要不断地和
你这样强大的训练家进行对战，我也能变强！ 所以你愿不愿意……
把电话号码告诉我？

entries.label: BethNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Let's battle again
sometime!
entries.translation:
下次我再找你
进行宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: BethNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
That's too bad… Let me know if you
change your mind.
entries.translation:
这样啊……遗憾……
等你想法变了再来找我吧。

entries.label: BethPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh no. Your phone
is out of memory.
entries.translation:
喂，你已经
存满电话号码了啊！

entries.label: BethRematchText
entries.english:
You sure kept me
waiting! Let's go!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
马上开始宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh! Good day,
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 嗨，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，你好呀。

entries.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh! Good evening,
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 嗨，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，晚上好。

entries.label: BeverlyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. Oh! Good morning,
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 嗨，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，早上好。

entries.label: BeverlyGenericText
entries.english:
Keeping your
#MON happy? My {STRBUF} is
healthy. It eats alot every day.
entries.translation:
你的小宝可梦还好吗？ 我的小{STRBUF}呀，
今天也很有精神，它吃了好多东西呢。

entries.label: BeverlyGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}.
This is {STRBUF}. How are you doing?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，你好。
我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: BeverlyGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}.
This is {STRBUF}. Were you awake?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，晚上好。
我是{STRBUF}，还没睡吧？

entries.label: BeverlyGreetText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}.
Good morning. This is {STRBUF}.
Were you asleep?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，早上好。
我是{STRBUF}，你醒了吧？

entries.label: BeverlyComePickUpText
entries.english:
Pardon?
Oh, the NUGGET? There's no need to
hurry. Come see me in {STRBUF}
when you can.
entries.translation:
哎？是说金珠吗？ 那就不用太着急了，
我就在{STRBUF}，有空就来找我吧。

entries.label: BeverlyDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
I happened to come
across a wildSNUBBULL recently. My SNUBBULL, I
assure you, was far cuter than the
wild one.
entries.translation:
还有就是……
之前我居然遇见了野生的布鲁…… 虽然大家都是布鲁，
但是我的小布鲁不知道比它们可爱多少倍！

entries.label: BeverlyFoundItemText
entries.english:
My husband got
some NUGGETS. If you'd like, you
could have one as thanks for helping
me out. I'll be at
{STRBUF}. Please come see me
when you can.
entries.translation:
那个，我家老公
带回了一些金珠…… 要是你愿意，
我就送你一个当作平时关照我的谢礼。 我在{STRBUF}，
有空就来找我吧。

entries.label: BeverlyHangUpText
entries.english:
You can expect a
call from me.
entries.translation: 那下次再打给你吧。

entries.label: BeverlyLetsChatAboutMonAgainText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
in prime form? Let's chat about
#MON again.
entries.translation:
小宝可梦都还好吧？
我们下次再继续聊一些宝可梦的话题吧。

entries.label: BeverlyLostAMonText
entries.english:
I happened to see
a wild MARILL the other day.
Or so I thought. A closer look
showed it was {STRBUF}. I was
quite miffed.
entries.translation:
还有就是……
之前我居然遇见了野生的玛力露…… 仔细一看是{STRBUF}，
我大失所望。

entries.label: BeverlyMadeMonEvenCuterText
entries.english:
I fancied up my
{STRBUF} and made it even cuter
than before!
entries.translation:
我的小{STRBUF}
打扮了一下，变得更可爱了！

entries.label: BeverlyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Your MARILL is so
cute and adorable! You love #MON
just like I do! Want to trade
phone numbers? Let's chat! It'll
be so much fun!
entries.translation:
你那只玛力露……
真可爱啊，太棒了！你也很喜欢宝可梦吧…… 对了！要不，
把你的号码告诉我吧？ 有空陪我聊聊天呗，
我觉得一定会很有趣！

entries.label: BeverlyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Your MARILL is so
cute and adorable! We should chat, it
will be fun. Can I have your
phone number?
entries.translation:
你那只玛力露……
真可爱啊，太棒了！ 对了！要不，
有空陪我聊聊天呗，把你的号码告诉我吧？

entries.label: BeverlyGiftText
entries.english:
Oh? {PLAYER}? 
I waited here for you. I brought you
a little gift.
entries.translation:
哎呀？{PLAYER}，
我一直都等着你呢。这个就交给你了。

entries.label: BeverlyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
To be honest, I
want a MARILL. But I make do with
my cute SNUBBULL.
entries.translation:
其实我一直都想
拥有玛力露……但是小布鲁也很可爱，所以我还是忍得住的。

entries.label: BeverlyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh… That's
disappointing… Goodbye, MARILL…
entries.translation:
这样吗……好遗憾……
再见，小玛力露……

entries.label: BeverlyPackFullText
entries.english:
Oh?
You have no room. Please come back
for it later.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
好像拿不下更多了呢。那就下次再来吧。

entries.label: BeverlyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh? Your phone's
memory is full.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
你好像存满号码了！

entries.label: BikeShopPhoneCallerText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
Our BICYCLE sales have gone through
the roof! We owe it all to
your advertising by riding around
on our BICYCLE. As our way of say-
ing thanks, please keep that BICYCLE.
Thanks again!
entries.translation:
呀，{PLAYER}！
最近自行车很畅销！ 这还是多亏了你经常
骑自行车给我们做宣传。 说是礼物也不太合适吧，
反正借给你的自行车现在已经归你了！ 真的太感谢你了。

entries.label: BillPhoneDayGreetingText
entries.english:
Good day! This is the #-
MON STORAGE SYSTEM ADMINISTRATION
SERVICE.
entries.translation:
您好！ 这里是宝可梦寄放中心
管理服务！

entries.label: BillPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Thanks for
waiting! {PLAYER}, your BOX
is full! You'll have to
switch BOXES if you want to catch
more #MON.
entries.translation:
不好意思，久等了！ {PLAYER}使用的盒子
完全满了！ 去整理整理吧，
不然就不能寄放宝可梦了！

entries.label: BillPhoneGenericText
entries.english:
Who's calling? {PLAYER}, is it?
Hang on a sec… ……
……
entries.translation:
您该怎么称呼？ 啊，{PLAYER}吗？
请稍等一下！ …… …… …… …… ……
…… …… …… ……

entries.label: BillPhoneMornGreetingText
entries.english:
Good morning! This is the #-
MON STORAGE SYSTEM ADMINISTRATION
SERVICE.
entries.translation:
早上好！ 这里是宝可梦寄放中心
管理服务！

entries.label: BillPhoneNearlyFullText
entries.english:
Thanks for
waiting! {PLAYER}, your BOX
has room for only{STRBUF} more #MON. Maybe you should
switch your BOX.
entries.translation:
不好意思，久等了！ {PLAYER}使用的盒子
只剩{STRBUF}个空位了。 这段时间
最好去整理一下吧？

entries.label: BillPhoneNewlyFullText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}?
It's me, BILL! Thanks for using
my STORAGE SYSTEM. That last #MON
you sent filledyour BOX up. You'll have to
switch BOXES if you want to catch
more #MON. Bye now!
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}？ 我是正辉！
感谢您经常用我的系统。 算上刚刚传送的宝可梦，
盒子里正好放满了！ 快去整理整理盒子吧，
不然就不能寄放宝可梦了！ 那就拜拜了！

entries.label: BillPhoneNiteGreetingText
entries.english:
Good evening! This is the #-
MON STORAGE SYSTEM ADMINISTRATION
SERVICE.
entries.translation:
这么晚真是辛苦了！ 这里是宝可梦寄放中心
管理服务！

entries.label: BillPhoneNotFullText
entries.english:
Thanks for
waiting! {PLAYER}, your BOX
has room for {STRBUF}more #MON. Get out there and
fill it up!
entries.translation:
不好意思，久等了！ {PLAYER}使用的盒子
还有{STRBUF}个空位。 请多寄放一些宝可梦！

entries.label: BrentAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes? {STRBUF} here… Ah, {PLAYER}. What
can I do for you?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，{PLAYER}，怎么了？

entries.label: BrentAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes? {STRBUF} here… Ah, {PLAYER}. What
can I do for you?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，{PLAYER}，怎么了？

entries.label: BrentAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes? {STRBUF} here… Ah, {PLAYER}. What
can I do for you?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，{PLAYER}，怎么了？

entries.label: BrentGenericText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I saw you
coming out of a #MON CENTER the
other day. You heal your
#MON regularly, don't you?
I'm impressed. Heh, my {STRBUF}
is so tough, it doesn't need to go
to #MON CENTERSoften. Heheh!
entries.translation:
话说回来，
我上次好像看到你从宝可梦中心出来。 看到你勤快地回复宝可梦，
我也很感动呢。 我的{STRBUF}很强，
很少去宝可梦中心呢，嘿嘿嘿。

entries.label: BrentGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hiya, {PLAYER}, how
are you doing? Hey, it's me,
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，还好吗？ 是我啊，是我，{STRBUF}。

entries.label: BrentGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hiya, {PLAYER}, how
are you doing? Hey, it's me,
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，还好吗？ 是我啊，是我，{STRBUF}。

entries.label: BrentGreetText
entries.english:
Hiya, {PLAYER}. How
are you doing? Hey! It's me,
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，还好吗？ 是我啊，是我，{STRBUF}。

entries.label: BrentAbraGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
ABRA was the first #MON that BILL
ostensibly caught.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉捕捉到的第一只宝可梦是凯西。

entries.label: BrentBattleRematchText
entries.english:
You've got time
like usual, right? Feel like having a
battle? It'll be a chance
to see my rare #MON. It'll be
worth your time! You know where--
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
你还是像以前那样闲吧？
要不，来和我对战吧？ 而且你还有机会
见到我身边的稀有宝可梦，这场对战肯定很有意义…… 我在{STRBUF}，
你要是愿意就来找我吧。

entries.label: BrentBattlingGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
Evidently, BILL isn't very good at
battling.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉不是很擅长宝可梦对战。

entries.label: BrentDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I took
down this wild {STRBUF}.
It wasn't rare enough to bother
catching.
entries.translation:
啊，还有……我之前
打倒了{STRBUF}哦。 虽然它算不上是
值得捕捉的稀有宝可梦。

entries.label: BrentFatherGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL's father is supposed to be a
great #MANIAC.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉的爸爸其实也是超级宝可梦狂热迷。

entries.label: BrentFlowerShopGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL appears to like the lady at
the FLOWER SHOP.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉其实很喜欢花店里的大姐姐。

entries.label: BrentGoldenrodGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL's originallyfrom GOLDENROD.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉的老家是满金市。

entries.label: BrentGrandpaGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
Apparently BILL's grandpa isn't a
#MANIAC.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉的爷爷不是宝可梦狂热迷。

entries.label: BrentHangUpText
entries.english: So that's it then.
entries.translation: ……那就说到这里了。

entries.label: BrentKimonoGirlGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL's mother is said to have been
a KIMONO GIRL.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉的妈妈以前是和服女孩。

entries.label: BrentLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I saw a
rare #MON aboutan hour ago. It was my first
sighting. But I didn't have any
# BALLS… Would BILL laugh
at my mistakes?
entries.translation:
啊，还有……
大约在1小时之前，我看到了稀有的宝可梦。 我还是第一次看到……
可是我身边没有精灵球，没法进行捕捉…… 我怎么会犯这种错呢，
这下要被正辉笑话了……

entries.label: BrentMilkGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL supposedly hates milk and
can't drink it.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉很讨厌牛奶，完全不愿意喝。

entries.label: BrentRareTradeText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I got an
extremely rare #MON in a trade
a while back. Do you want to
know what it is? Hehe, I'm keeping
it a secret!
entries.translation:
说起来，
我之前交换到了超级稀有的宝可梦哦！想知道是什么宝可梦吗？ 嘿嘿嘿，
我还是保密吧！

entries.label: BrentReminderText
entries.english:
You want to see my
rare #MON. Hurry over to
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
难道你不想看稀有宝可梦？
我在{STRBUF}等着你，快过来啊。

entries.label: BrentRoute25GossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL evidently lives on ROUTE 25
in KANTO.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉一直住在关都地区的25号道路。

entries.label: BrentSisterGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know…?
BILL's younger sister apparently
can't wink.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？
据说正辉的妹妹不知道怎么眨单眼。

entries.label: BrentSorryImTooBusyText
entries.english:
You wanted to hear
about BILL? Sorry, but I'm too
busy for you. I'll call when I
have time.
entries.translation:
你说想和我聊正辉？ 抱歉……我现在很忙。
等我有空再打给你，请你耐心等一会儿吧。

entries.label: BrentAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
By the way, you're
a #MANIAC… I can tell.
Yes, you are. But your knowledge
is shallow still! Do you know BILL?
He's an incredible #MANIAC.
I revere him. I'll teach you all
I know about BILL, so leave me your
phone number.
entries.translation:
说起来，你是
宝可梦狂热迷吧…… 不用说我也知道！ 但是还远远不够呢！ 那个厉害的宝可梦狂热迷
——正辉，你听说过吧？是我憧憬的宝可梦狂热迷。 我会告诉你
正辉的各种趣闻。把你的号码告诉我吧。

entries.label: BrentAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I'll teach you all
I know about BILL, so leave me your
phone number.
entries.translation:
我会告诉你
正辉的各种趣闻。把你的号码告诉我吧。

entries.label: BrentNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
BILL--he's more
than amazing! To be a #MANIAC
like him someday… That's my dream.
entries.translation:
正辉真的很厉害！ 我总有一天也会成为
他那样的宝可梦狂热迷！

entries.label: BrentNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
You're going to
regret it… And I won't care…
entries.translation: 以后别后悔啊……

entries.label: BrentPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Huh? Your phone
list's full. A #MANIAC has
to be more tidy!
entries.translation:
什么啊？
你的电话已经存满了。狂热迷必须精于整理。

entries.label: BrentRematchText
entries.english:
I've been waiting. Look, check out my
#MON!
entries.translation:
我等很久了……
来看看我的宝可梦吧！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneBenAndFernText
entries.english:
Did you know…? BEN and FERN talk
on the phone for hours about what
#MON music they should play on
different days ofthe week. One time, FERN's
rapping style kind of rubbed off on
BEN weirdly. So we ended up
enduring BEN's silly, chilly, a
willy-nilly jive-talking shtick fora while. Let's chat again!
entries.translation:
那个，
听说浩史和靖史两个人为了决定播放哪个宝可梦的音乐、周几播出，会开很久的电话会议。 不过，每次到了最后，
浩史都会莫名其妙地用靖史的说话腔调 大声地宣布：
“就决定是这首歌啦！”然后腔调就变不回来了。 就说到这吧，下次再聊！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneCompanyVacationText
entries.english:
Guess what? All of
us from the RADIO TOWER are going on
a company vacation to the RADIO TOWER
in LAVENDER. We're wasting our
vacation on a trip to another RADIO
TOWER? I'd much rather go
to the beach! {PLAYER}, I hope
you have enough fun for both of us
on your journey! Bye-bye!
entries.translation:
那个，
我们满金电台决定下次休息的时候集体去紫苑电台玩！ 不过难得有天休息，
去紫苑电台就感觉自己非常亏…… 啊——真想去海边啊！ {PLAYER}，好好旅行吧！
就当是帮我玩了！ 那就拜拜咯！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneCoopedUpInRadioTowerAnswerText
entries.english:
Is it sunny
outside today? When you're cooped
up in the RADIO TOWER as much as I
am, you lose touch with the outside.
It can be boring. Please call again!
entries.translation:
那个……
外面现在是晴天吗？ 我一直待在电台里，
已经完全感受不到天气了。真无聊啊！ 那就这样吧，下次再聊！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneDayAnswerText
entries.english:
Hi, this is BUENA…
Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}! Do you tune into
BUENA's show?
entries.translation:
您好，我是葵妍！ 啊，{PLAYER}！
你平时会听我的节目吧？

entries.label: BuenaPhoneDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}!
Hi, it's BUENA! I needed someone
to chat with!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！我是葵妍！
你来陪我说说话吧！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneFavoriteSlotMachineAnswerText
entries.english:
I'm thinking of
going to the GAME CORNER tomorrow.
It's been a while. You see, I have my
favorite machine… It pays out a lot,
I kid you not! Huh? Nuh-uh, it's
my secret! You have to find
it yourself! Catch you later!
entries.translation:
我打算明天去游戏城
好好玩两把，我已经很久没去了！ 其实那边有一台
我特别喜欢的老虎机…… 出代币的概率特别大！ 哎？我当然不能说啦！
这种东西要靠自己找嘛！ 那就这样吧，下次见！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneGoingShoppingText
entries.english:
I'm going shopping
with MARY and LILYsoon. It'll be great if
GOLDENROD DEPT. STORE has a sale
on when we go… {PLAYER}, maybe we
can hook up too! Catch you later!
entries.translation:
那个，我和莉莉丝、小胡桃
约好下次有机会的话3个人一起去购物！ 要是满金百货店到时候
有打折活动就更好了…… 要是能遇见{PLAYER}
就更好了！再见啦！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneGotAColdText
entries.english:
…Cough, cough! Uhm sorry uh got
uh code dite now. Buh uma pro so uh
hav to cover id ub so no un notice
while uhm on air. Uh fidz muh voice
now. I'll catch you on
the fly. This hasbeen BUENA!
entries.translation:
……嗯哼、咳、咳！ 抱歉……
我现在港冒了…… 但是我是装业的，
在节布里一定要装没病，不能让光众抗出来…… 那、那我就把声英变回来。 ……下次再聊！
我是你的搭档……葵妍！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneLuckyNumberShowText
entries.english:
Tell me, {PLAYER}.
Have you ever won a prize on the
LUCKY NUMBER SHOW? REED moans that
he's never won, so he vows to keep
the show on theair till he does. Let's chat again!
entries.translation:
那个，{PLAYER}，
你有没有中过幸运号码？ 节目主播阿植本人
其实从来没有中过奖。听他说，在中奖之前他会一直坚持做节目！ 那就这样了，下次再聊！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneMidnightAnswerText
entries.english:
This is BUENA.
I can't come to the phone right
now. If you want to
chat, tune into BUENA's PASSWORD
on the radio and give me a call
after midnight!
entries.translation:
您好，我是葵妍。 我暂时无法接听电话。 如果想与我交流，
请在晚上0点之前收听葵妍的密语。不见不散。

entries.label: BuenaPhoneMidnightText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}!
Hi, it's BUENA! I'm just on my
break.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！我是葵妍！
我现在是休息时间哦！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneMorningAnswerText
entries.english:
Hi, this is BUENA… Oh! Good morning,
{PLAYER}! I'm kind of foggy
in the morning…
entries.translation:
您好，我是葵妍…… 啊，{PLAYER}，早上好！
我早上很难起来呢！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneMorningText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}!
Hi, it's BUENA! I got up early, so
I decided to call!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！我是葵妍！
一大早就想到给你打电话！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneNiteAnswerText
entries.english:
Hi, this is BUENA…
Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}! I just got off
work.  Let me tell you,
I'm exhausted!
entries.translation:
您好……我是葵妍…… 哎呀！{PLAYER}！
我的工作结束了！好累啊！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}!
Hi, it's BUENA! I couldn't sleep,
so I called you.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！我是葵妍！
我睡不着，想找你聊天。

entries.label: BuenaPhonePikachuFanClubText
entries.english:
I'm elated that
more people are taking part in my
PASSWORD show. But when PIKACHU
was the password, it was uh… whew…
overwhelming. FAN CLUB people
came in out in droves, shouting
'PIKACHU!' over and over. I mean,
they were loud. Anyone tuning in
around then must have been shocked
by the racket! Anyway, back to
work for me! Let's chat again!
entries.translation:
那个……
最近来回答密语的人多了不少，我很高兴啊。 如果哪天的密语
正好就是“皮卡丘”，那就厉害了…… 发烧友俱乐部的成员
会一个接一个地过来， 大声喊着： “皮卡丘小可爱！” “皮卡丘小可爱！” 在广播里听到这些声音，
肯定会吓一跳吧？ 啊，我要回去工作了！
那就下次再联系吧！

entries.label: BuenaPhonePokegearAnswerText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}. You
use your #GEAR to listen to the
radio, right? I heard that you
can even display town maps with
#GEAR. I have a bad sense
of direction, so #GEAR would be
handy… Anyway, thanks for
calling! Later!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}平时都在
用宝可装置听广播吧？ 我听说现在的宝可装置
连地图都能看了？ 我有严重的路痴症状，
所以特别想要宝可装置！ 感谢来电！再见吧！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneProfessorOakText
entries.english:
Yesterday, PROF.
OAK was in the studio to tape his
show. So I went over and
introduced myself. Get this--he tunes
in to my program! Oh! Here comes
PROF.OAK again! I'm going to chat
him up again! Catch you later!
entries.translation:
昨天大木博士
过来录制节目的时候，我和他聊了一会儿。没想到就连大木博士也一直在收听我主持的节目！ 啊……！大木博士来了！
今天也要和他谈天说地！ 那就先这样了！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneRadioCardQuestionsText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}.
You won that RADIO CARD by beating
the quiz at the reception desk,
didn't you? Guess what? I made
up the questions! …Were they too
easy for you? Well, let's chat
again!

entries.label: BuenaPhoneRadioTowerDirectorText
entries.english:
Guess what?
The RADIO TOWER's DIRECTOR is a big
fan of TV! A while ago, a
fashion show on TV said that black
suits were in. Now all he wears
are black suits. But it's a secret
that our DIRECTOR is a TV fan, so if
you see him, don't you dare mention
it! Oh! The DIRECTOR
will be here soon! Later! Tune into
my show!
entries.translation:
那个……
我们电台的局长啊，其实很爱看电视。 之前有一次他在看电视， 突然就说： “原来现在流行黑西装！”
从那以后，他就只穿黑西装了！ 不过，
喜欢看电视是局长的秘密，千万不能当面提起啊。 哎呀，
局长差不多要来了。 再见！要好好听广播哦！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneReceptionistText
entries.english:
You know the
receptionist atthe RADIO TOWER? 'Welcome,' is all
she ever says. But she's really
the chattiest person at the
RADIO TOWER. So she must be
holding back. Isn't that fun to
know? Catch you later!
entries.translation:
那个，你有没有发现
电台接待处的小姐姐 好像就只会说： “欢迎光临！” 不过呢，
她其实是全电台第一话痨！ 只要她张口说话，
就会连着说好几个小时。所以平时只好忍着。 你现在是不是觉得
和她打招呼很有意思？ 那就再见了！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneRocketText
entries.english:
Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}! You are how? Aiyee! This isn't
the time for me to be cracking silly
gag greetings! The RADIO TOWER is
in deep trouble! {PLAYER}, you'd
better be careful!
entries.translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}！
你还好吧？ 啊，我怎么和你
悠闲地问候起来了！ 电台里出大事了！ {PLAYER}，
你也要多加小心啊！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneStarterPokemonText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, what was
the first #MONyou ever caught? …Oh, really? I've seen lots of
#MON around, but I've never
caught one. I should give it a
try sometime. Did you know that
the first #MON MARY caught was a
DROWZEE? Isn't that so out
of character? But MARY's DROWZEE
kept making her fall asleep on the
job, so she traded with a fan for a
MEOWTH. Let's chat about
#MON again! Bye-bye!
entries.translation:
那个，{PLAYER}
第一个捕捉到的宝可梦是哪只？ ……哎，这样吗！ 我也遇见过
不计其数的宝可梦，但是还没有捕捉过！下次想挑战一下呢！ 小胡桃第一个捕捉到的
宝可梦其实是催眠貘哦。 真让人意外呢！ 不过小胡桃担心
自己被催眠貘催眠，那样会妨碍工作。所以就和她的粉丝交换，换成了小喵喵！ 下次继续聊宝可梦吧！
拜拜！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneStressedFromWorkText
entries.english:
You know, last
night… I was so stressed
out from work, I ate a ton of junk
food! MARY and I have
this deal aboutlosing weight… This won't do… Huh? What's the
weight? This has to be a
total secret! MARY weighs… Aiyee! M-MARY! Uh… Um… I… Sorry,
wrong number!
entries.translation:
那个，昨天晚上啊…… 工作结束之后，
我实在是太疲劳了，于是就吃了一大堆零食！ 但我在和小胡桃比减肥，
这样子可不行啊…… 嗯？你问我多重？ 我当然不会说啊！
不过小胡桃的体重是…… 啊……！小胡桃！
呃，那个，这个，抱歉，打错电话了！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneWentOutWithBenText
entries.english:
The other day, I
went out to eat with DJ BEN!
Isn't it great? Not only that, he
said the music on my program is
cool! Oh, wow! Like,
what should I do? …Oops, I have to
get ready for my show! I'll catch
you later!
entries.translation:
前一阵子，
我和靖史主播一起去吃了顿饭！ 这本来就很值得开心了，
他还夸奖我的节目，说节目伴奏非常酷！ 呀！我都不知如何是好了！ ……啊，我也差不多该
回去准备工作了！再见！

entries.label: BuenaPhoneWhenDoYouRelaxText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, tell me. When do you relax
the most? For me, it has to
be in the studio right after my
show, enjoying a nice cup of tea.
It's so pleasant that it gradually
makes me drowsy… …… …… …… …… …… ……Zzz Oops, I drifted
off just thinking about it! How, uh…
embarrassing! Please forget this
happened! Later!
entries.translation:
那个，{PLAYER}，
你在什么时候最安心？ 我的话是节目结束后，
悠闲地坐在录音棚里喝着红茶的那一刻！ 这种时候心里特别舒服，
就很容易犯困…… …… …… …… …… …… ……呼呼 糟糕！只是想想就犯困了！
真难为情啊！ 快忘了刚刚的事！再见！

entries.label: ChadAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Hi, {PLAYER}, good
day!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 呀，{PLAYER}，你好！

entries.label: ChadAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Hi, {PLAYER}, good
evening!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 呀，{PLAYER}，晚上好！

entries.label: ChadAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 呀，{PLAYER}，早上好！

entries.label: ChadGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? You know PROF.OAK,
so of course your#MON are fine! My #MON are
doing well too. But then, I am
trying to become a #MON professor,
so that shouldn'tbe a big surprise.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦们都还好吧？
啊，我差点忘了！ 你可是大木博士的朋友，
怎么可能不好呢，哈哈哈。 我的宝可梦都挺好的！
毕竟我要成为宝可梦博士， 这点事是肯定要做到的。

entries.label: ChadGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}, good
day! It's {STRBUF}.
How are you?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，你好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: ChadGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}, good
evening! It's {STRBUF}.
How are you?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，晚上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: ChadGreetText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}, good
morning! It's {STRBUF}.
How are you?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: ChadBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Want to battle?
I have to battle every so often to
avoid rusting out. I'll be on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
那个，和我对战吧？
偶尔要来场宝可梦对战嘛，不然感觉会生疏的。 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来找我吧。

entries.label: ChadBlueGossipText
entries.english:
Do you know BLUE? He's PROF.OAK's
grandson and a former #MON
LEAGUE CHAMPION! He's one super
#MON trainer!
entries.translation:
你认不认识青绿？ 他是大木博士的孙子，
曾经还当过宝可梦冠军！堪称顶尖宝可梦训练家！

entries.label: ChadDaisyGossipText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK has a
granddaughternamed DAISY. When she's around,
even the most ferocious #MON
calm right down.
entries.translation:
大木博士有一个孙女，
名字叫奈奈美…… 听说只要她在场，
不论是多凶暴的宝可梦也会变得老老实实的！

entries.label: ChadDaisyTeaGossipText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK has a
granddaughternamed DAISY. She has tea every
day for an hour from three in the
afternoon. I wish I could
join her for tea and chat about
PROF.OAK.
entries.translation:
大木博士有一个孙女，
名字叫奈奈美…… 每天3点到4点之间的
1小时是她的喝茶时间！ 真希望我也能和她
一起喝一次茶，再一起聊聊大木博士……

entries.label: ChadDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh yes, I managed
to knock out a wild {STRBUF} a
while back. Well, considering
all the studying I do every day, it
was inevitable.
entries.translation:
对了，
之前我好不容易打倒了{STRBUF}哦。 毕竟我每天都在学习嘛，
这也是理所当然的结果。

entries.label: ChadGoingToStudyHardText
entries.english:
I'm going to study
hard so PROF.OAK will make me his
assistant!
entries.translation:
我要努力学习，
那样等我长大了就能当大木博士的助手了！

entries.label: ChadHangUpText
entries.english: See you later!
entries.translation: 那就再见啦！

entries.label: ChadKurtGossipText
entries.english:
Do you know KURT,
the BALL creator? He and PROF.OAK go
back a long way. I guess great
people attract oneanother!
entries.translation:
说起制球工匠钢铁先生， 据说他和大木博士
很久以前就是朋友了！ 厉害的人的身边，
也都是厉害的人！

entries.label: ChadLeagueGossipText
entries.english:
#MON LEAGUE is
the great gather-ing place for all trainers who wish
to become CHAMP. PROF.OAK acts as
an advisor to the #MON LEAGUE's
headquarters. He really is a
great man.
entries.translation:
所有想成为宝可梦冠军的
宝可梦训练家心中的圣地——宝可梦联盟！！ 听说大木博士
给宝可梦联盟的总部提过很多建议！ 他真是了不起的人啊！

entries.label: ChadLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yes, I came
close to catching a wild {STRBUF},
but it got away. For the longest
time, I've been wanting to observe
{STRBUF}. Rats…
entries.translation:
对了，
之前我差点就能捉到{STRBUF}了…… 我一直都很想观察
{STRBUF}来着，真是太可惜了……

entries.label: ChadObservingWildText
entries.english:
I recently began
observing wild{STRBUF}. I've been learning
all sorts of new things through my
observations. I wish I could
become a #MON researcher like
PROF.OAK soon.
entries.translation:
我最近开始观察
{STRBUF}了…… 只要仔细地观察它们，
就可以发现很多以前没有注意到的细节！ 我想快点变成像大木博士
那样的宝可梦博士啊。

entries.label: ChadPokemonTalkGossipText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK is a popularradio show, right? Did you know that
he was going to turn down the show
at first? But MARY's energy
and persistencewore him down. So we have MARY to
thank for it!
entries.translation:
说起深受喜爱的广播节目
大木博士的宝可梦讲座， 听说大木博士一开始
其实是打算拒绝的！ 胡桃小姐亲自登门拜访，
还是感动到了大木博士，最后终于答应了！ 我们要感谢胡桃小姐啊！

entries.label: ChadProfElmGossipText
entries.english:
Everyone's talking
about PROF.ELM. He used to be an
assistant to thegreat PROF.OAK! That is so cool!
I envy him!
entries.translation:
说起著名的空木博士， 据说他以前担任过
大木博士的助手！ 啊！太厉害了，让人羡慕！

entries.label: ChadProfOakTrainerGossipText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK used to
be a trainer along time ago. But rather than
battling, he found #MON themselves
to be interesting. So he abandoned
his training to focus on becoming
a researcher.
entries.translation:
听说大木博士
过去也是宝可梦训练家。 不过他渐渐地发现
比起宝可梦对战，他对宝可梦本身更感兴趣。 所以就不当训练家了，
走上了宝可梦研究之路。

entries.label: ChadProfOakTravelingGossipText
entries.english:
Did you know?
PROF.OAK traveled all over the world
when he was young. While traveling,
he must've learned about #MON
naturally. I envy him…
I'd like to travel and learn about
things too…
entries.translation:
那个，你知道吗？
听说大木博士年轻的时候曾经环游世界。 在旅途中，能自然而然地
学到很多宝可梦的知识。 真是令人羡慕啊……
我也想游览很多地方，学习各种知识……

entries.label: ChadProfOaksDreamGossipText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK's dream
is to compile a comprehensive
#DEX. I envy you for
taking part inthat project…
entries.translation:
大木博士有一个梦想，
那就是完成图鉴收集，打造出完美宝可梦图鉴！ 而他居然找你帮忙，
太厉害了，让人羡慕……

entries.label: ChadReminderText
entries.english:
Do you remember
about our battle? The place is
{STRBUF}. Hurry over--I'm
waiting.
entries.translation:
哎，
还记得对战的约定吧？ 地点是{STRBUF}。
快来啊，我在等你呢。

entries.label: ChadAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Huh? Is that thing
a #DEX? Haveyou met PROF.OAK? Huh? You have? 
That's way cool! I have a dream of
becoming a #MON researcher like
PROF.OAK. May I please have
your phone number? We should chat
about PROF.OAK. I'm sure it will
be loads of fun!
entries.translation:
那个？你带着的那个
该不会是宝可梦图鉴吧？你见过大木博士吗？ 哎！见过啊！
厉、厉害！好厉害！ 我的梦想就是
成为大木博士那样的宝可梦博士。 那个，我有个请求……
能不能把号码告诉我？ 我们可以一起讨论
关于大木博士的话题呢！想来一定很有趣吧。

entries.label: ChadAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
May I please have
your phone number? We should chat
about PROF.OAK. I'm sure it will
be loads of fun!
entries.translation:
能不能把号码告诉我？ 我们可以一起讨论
关于大木博士的话题呢！想来一定很有趣吧。

entries.label: ChadNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
You must listen to
PROF.OAK'S #MONTALK, right?
entries.translation:
大木博士的宝可梦讲座！
你当然也在听吧？！

entries.label: ChadNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh… I wish I had a
chance to meetPROF.OAK…
entries.translation:
这样吗……真遗憾啊……
好想见到大木博士啊……

entries.label: ChadPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone list is
completely full!
entries.translation:
哎？你的电话存满了，
无法再添加了。

entries.label: ChadRematchText
entries.english:
I've been waiting!
Let's battle now!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
那就开始对战吧！

entries.label: DanaAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} on the
line. I know!
It's {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 原来是{PLAYER}呀！

entries.label: DanaAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} on the
line. {PLAYER}?
What's up?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}？怎么了！

entries.label: DanaAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} on the
line. Hey! It's {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 嗨，{PLAYER}呀！

entries.label: DanaGenericText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF} is
so full of energy, it's a little
scary. How are your
#MON doing?
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}
现在好得不得了！ 你的宝可梦呢？

entries.label: DanaGreetDayText
entries.english:
Uh, {PLAYER}? It's me!
It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
啊，{PLAYER}？
是我是我！{STRBUF}啊！

entries.label: DanaGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Uh, {PLAYER}? It's me!
It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
啊，{PLAYER}？
是我是我！{STRBUF}啊！

entries.label: DanaGreetText
entries.english:
Uh, {PLAYER}? It's me!
It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
啊，{PLAYER}？
是我是我！{STRBUF}啊！

entries.label: DanaBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Right now, I'm on
{STRBUF}. If you're close
by, let's battle! I'll be waiting
for you!
entries.translation:
那个，我现在
在{STRBUF}！ 如果你到了附近，
那就再来和我对战吧！我等着你哦！

entries.label: DanaCanYouWaitABitLongerText
entries.english:
Oh! You wanted a
gift, right? I got one, but I
want to keep this. Can you wait a bit
longer?
entries.translation:
啊，你问礼物在那里？
唔……虽然拿是拿到了，但是我想留着自己用。 你再耐心等等吧！

entries.label: DanaComePickUpText
entries.english:
Hello? If you don't come
get your present soon, I'll give it
to someone else. I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
喂喂——！？ 你要再不过来拿，
我就要送给别人咯！ 我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: DanaDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
It took only an
instant to KO awild {STRBUF}. It must be because
you gave me some battling tips last
time.
entries.translation:
喂，听我说，听我说！
之前我一瞬间就打倒了{STRBUF}哦！ 这或许是因为我从你那
学到了一些对战诀窍吧？

entries.label: DanaFoundItemText
entries.english:
You know what?
I got a good gift! As I promised,
it's yours! I'm sure you'd
like it. Come get it! I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
那个，我得到好东西了！
那就按之前说好的，我把它送你吧！ 嘿嘿，敬请期待！
快来{STRBUF}取货吧！

entries.label: DanaHangUpText
entries.english: See you!
entries.translation: 拜了！

entries.label: DanaLostAMonText
entries.english:
You know what?
A wild {STRBUF} got away from me
again. It was so close!
Really, just a little bit more,
and I would've…
entries.translation:
那个，我最近又让
{STRBUF}跑掉了！真是太可惜了！真的就差一点了！

entries.label: DanaReminderText
entries.english:
Hi! You haven't
forgotten about your promise to
battle me? I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
不是约好了宝可梦对战嘛？
你不会忘了吧！ 我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: DanaTakingPhotosText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF} is
getting prettier! I've been taking
photos galore!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}
最近越来越可爱了！好想拼命给它拍照啊！

entries.label: DanaAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
You're really good
at #MON! Boys give me items
after battles, but sometimes they
give me too much. Next time, I can
share some if you want. Let me get
your phone number.
entries.translation:
话说你很懂宝可梦啊！ ……有些男孩子在对战后
可能会送我道具，偶尔会有多余的！ 下次收到可以分给你！
所以把号码告诉我吧！

entries.label: DanaAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I'll share my
gifts with you. Let me get your
phone number.
entries.translation:
我会把礼物分给你的！ 你愿不愿意
把电话号码告诉我？

entries.label: DanaGiftText
entries.english:
Hi! Are you here
for your gift? This should really
make your day!
entries.translation:
啊，你是来拿礼物的吧？ 这个东西呢——
应该会让你开心的！给！

entries.label: DanaNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Next time a boy
gives me something after a battle,
I'll share some! Does that make me
bad?
entries.translation:
下次有男孩子在对战后
送我东西，我就分给你。 难道，我是个坏女人？

entries.label: DanaNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Aww, you don't
want anything? But it's all for
free…
entries.translation:
哎，不需要吗——？
难得我愿意分享……

entries.label: DanaPackFullText
entries.english:
Where are you
going to put this? I'll keep it, so
come get it later!
entries.translation:
看你背包这么满，
肯定放不下了！ 我先存着，你记得过来！

entries.label: DanaPhoneFullText
entries.english:
But your phone's
out of memory!
entries.translation:
哎，电话已经存满了，
不能再添加了！

entries.label: DanaRematchText
entries.english:
You're really
late! I'm eager to get
going!
entries.translation:
太迟了，真是的！ 我都已经做好了
充分的精神准备！

entries.label: DerekAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}? Good day pika,
what's up pika?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}吗？ 你好皮卡，有事吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}? Good evening pika,
what's up pika?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}吗？ 晚上好，有事吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}? Good morning pika.
What's up pika?
entries.translation: 呀，{PLAYER}吗？ 早上好，有事吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekGenericText
entries.english:
You have to hear
this! My lovable {STRBUF} looked
at me and grinned! It must be because
our hearts beattogether as one!
entries.translation:
你听我说，
我的小{STRBUF}，总是笑眯眯地看着我！ 所谓的“心有灵犀”
说的就是这种情况吧？

entries.label: DerekGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} pika, good
pika day! It's {STRBUF}, how
pika are you?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，你好皮卡！ 我是{STRBUF}，还好吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} pika, good
evening! It's {STRBUF}. Were
you pika awake?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，晚上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，醒着吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} pika, good
morning! It's {STRBUF}, how
pika are you?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，还好吗皮卡？

entries.label: DerekBugCatchingContestText
entries.english:
Did you remember?
The Bug-CatchingContest is today. You're going to
go, aren't you? I think I'll
participate with PIKACHU to show
off its cuteness.
entries.translation:
你还记得吗？
今天有捕虫大赛哦！ 你肯定会去参赛吧？ 我要用我的小皮卡丘参赛！
我一定要好好展示一下它那可爱的外形！

entries.label: DerekCheekPinchingText
entries.english:
Listen to this.
My {STRBUF} grins happily when
I pinch its cheek. But it never grins
for anyone else. I must be special.
entries.translation:
请听我说，
我的小{STRBUF}啊，只要我轻轻戳它的脸颊，它就会露出灿烂的笑容！ 如果换成别人戳它，
他就不会笑……或许我是特 别 的人吧！

entries.label: DerekComePickUpText
entries.english:
What's wrong? I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}. Come pick this up
anytime.
entries.translation:
怎么了啊？
我在{STRBUF}，你随时都能来取哦。

entries.label: DerekDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and recently,
my PIKACHU beat awild {STRBUF}! A wild {STRBUF},
I tell you! Don't you think
that's astounding? My PIKACHU is
awesome! My PIKACHU is the
greatest!
entries.translation:
啊！还有一件事，
我之前用皮卡丘打倒了{STRBUF}！ 那可是{STRBUF}啊！ 你不觉得很厉害吗！ 我家皮卡丘最强！ 我家皮卡丘最棒！

entries.label: DerekFoundItemText
entries.english:
I'd like you to
have a NUGGET. My PIKACHU just
loves it. I'm certain your
PIKACHU will loveit too!
entries.translation:
我把金珠给你吧！ 我家的小皮卡丘
超级喜欢金珠哦。 所以我觉得你的小皮卡丘
肯定也会喜欢的。

entries.label: DerekHangUpText
entries.english:
Well, let's talk
again!
entries.translation: 那再见了。

entries.label: DerekLetsGetTogetherText
entries.english:
How is your
PIKACHU doing? Let's get together
and brag about ourPIKACHU!
entries.translation:
小皮卡丘还好吗？ 下次就来好好比一下
谁更会炫耀小皮卡丘！

entries.label: DerekLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and I saw a
wild {STRBUF} alittle while ago. But it wasn't very
cute, so I left it…
#MON have to be cute. They're no
good otherwise.
entries.translation:
啊！还有一件事，
我之前遇见了{STRBUF}…… 我觉得它不太可爱，
就无视了…… 宝可梦必须可爱，
不然就没意义了嘛！

entries.label: DerekAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Oh, wow! PIKACHU!
It's so soft andfurry! How cute! Let's be friends!
PIKACHU-lovers arenever bad people! Let's chat about
PIKACHU! Can I get your
phone number?
entries.translation:
哇——是皮卡丘——！
软软的，蓬蓬的，真可爱— 哎！你和我交朋友吧！
喜欢皮卡丘的人一定不是坏人！ 跟我一起畅谈
皮卡丘的话题吧！ 怎么样？
告诉我你的电话号码吧？

entries.label: DerekAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Let's chat about
PIKACHU! Can I get your
phone number?
entries.translation:
跟我一起畅谈
皮卡丘的话题吧！ 怎么样？
告诉我你的电话号码吧？

entries.label: DerekGiftText
entries.english:
I've been looking
for you! Here, seethis? This is it! I'm certain your
PIKACHU will lovemy gift too!
entries.translation:
等着你呢。
你看！就是这个！ 好了，你拿去吧！
小皮卡丘也会很高兴的。

entries.label: DerekNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
PIKACHU is the
one! If anything comes up, I'll
give you a jingle.
entries.translation:
果然还是皮卡丘最棒！
有事会打电话给你的！

entries.label: DerekNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
You… I bet you don't
even like PIKACHU…
entries.translation:
原来你……
不喜欢皮卡丘吗……

entries.label: DerekPackFullText
entries.english:
Uh-oh, too bad.
You don't have any room. Be sure to
get it later.
entries.translation:
哎呀？真遗憾啊。
似乎拿不下更多东西了。请下次再来拿吧。

entries.label: DerekPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Wait a sec! Your
phone list's full!
entries.translation:
喂，喂！
你的电话已满了！

entries.label: ElmPhoneAssistantText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? Did you see my
assistant? He's at the #MON CENTER
in VIOLET CITY.
entries.translation:
呀，{PLAYER}。 你能不能去见见我助手？
他在桔梗市宝可梦中心。

entries.label: ElmPhoneCheckingTheEggText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? We're checking the
EGG now. It does appear to be a
#MON EGG.
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 我正在研究那个蛋，
好像确实是宝可梦的蛋。

entries.label: ElmPhoneDisasterText
entries.english:
H-hello? {PLAYER}?
It's a disaster! Uh, um, it's just
terrible! What should I do?
It… Oh, no… Please get back
here now!
entries.translation:
喂、喂喂，{PLAYER}？ 出、出大事了！！
呃，那个，就是…… 怎么办啊……
反正就是出大事了！你赶紧回来吧！！

entries.label: ElmPhoneDiscoveredHatchTimeText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? I just made a new
discovery. The time it takes
for an EGG to hatch depends on
the #MON.
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 如果宝可梦种类不同，
孵化蛋所需要的时间似乎也会改变。

entries.label: ElmPhoneDiscoveredPokerusText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? I discovered an
odd thing. Apparently there's
something called #RUS that in-
fects #MON. Yes, it's like a
virus, so it'scalled #RUS. It multiplies fast
and infects other #MON too. But
that's all. It doesn't seem to
do anything, and it goes away over
time. I guess it's
nothing to worryabout. Bye!
entries.translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！？ 最近的研究表明：
有种叫宝可病毒的东西会感染到宝可梦身上。 因为很像感染人的病毒，
所以才命名为宝可病毒。 话说回来，
宝可病毒会不断增殖传染给其他同行宝可梦。不过好像也就这样了。 只要过一段时间，
它们就会自然消退。 就说到这里吧，加油！

entries.label: ElmPhoneEggAssistantText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? We
discovered some- thing about the
EGG! My assistant is at
the #MON CENTER in VIOLET CITY. 
Could you talk tohim?
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}！
之前那个宝可梦蛋我已经研究出一点成果了！ 我的助手现在应该
到桔梗宝可梦中心了，你去问问他吧！

entries.label: ElmPhoneEggHatchedText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}?
How is the EGG? What? It hatched?
Wow! What kind of#MON is it? Please come show
me now!
entries.translation:
呀，{PLAYER}。
蛋怎么样了？ 哎，孵出宝可梦了！
是、是什么样的宝可梦？你快带回来给我看看！

entries.label: ElmPhoneGiftText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? I have something
here for you. Could you swing by
my LAB? See you later!

entries.label: ElmPhoneGotAholdOfSomethingNeatText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}?
How's it going? I got ahold of
something neat. Swing by my LAB
and pick it up! See you later!
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}，
最近还好吧？ 那个，
我弄到了一个好东西，你想要的话就过来拿吧！ 再见！

entries.label: ElmPhoneHealYourMonText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? Try not to overdo
it. Be sure to heal
your #MON ifthey are hurt.
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 别太勉强了啊。
宝可梦受伤的时候，一定要让它们好好休息啊。

entries.label: ElmPhoneHowIsTheEggText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? How's the EGG? Has
anything changed? If anything hap-
pens, please call.
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 那个蛋现在怎么样了？
有没有发生变化？ 如果发生了什么变化，
一定要打电话告诉我啊。

entries.label: ElmPhoneInvestigatingEggMovesText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? It's still a
mystery what kinds of moves hatched
#MON have. We're investigat-
ing that now.
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 孵出来的宝可梦
所能学会的招式的招式中或许藏有什么秘密！我现在正在研究这一点。

entries.label: ElmPhonePokemonStolenText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? I'm very
upset now. We had a #MON
stolen from here. How could anyone
do that?
entries.translation:
啊，{PLAYER}…… 宝可梦被偷了……
到底是怎么回事啊……

entries.label: ElmPhoneRadioTowerRocketTakeoverText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, how are
things going? I called because
something weird is happening with the
radio broadcasts. They were talking
about TEAM ROCKET. {PLAYER}, do you
know anythingabout it? Maybe TEAM ROCKET
has returned. No, that just can't
be true. Sorry to bug you.
Take care!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
最近怎么样啊？ 我总觉得最近的
广播节目不太对劲。所以就想给你打电话。 每次打开广播，
好像都会听到：“火箭队……” {PLAYER}
你知道这是怎么回事吗？ 难不成，
那个火箭队复活了？不会吧…… 打扰你非常抱歉，
你也小心一点吧！

entries.label: ElmPhoneSawMrPokemonText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}? Did you meet MR.
#MON? Great!Come back safely!
entries.translation:
喂喂，{PLAYER}吗？ 见到宝可梦爷爷了吗？
见到了的话就回来吧，路上要小心呀。

entries.label: ErinAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
Yahoo!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}—— 啊，{PLAYER}，呀呵！

entries.label: ErinAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}—— 啊，{PLAYER}，你好啊！

entries.label: ErinAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}—— 啊，{PLAYER}，早上好！

entries.label: ErinGenericText
entries.english:
Are you raising
your #MON? Hey, {STRBUF}'s
{STRBUF} islooking good!
entries.translation:
还在培育宝可梦吧？ {STRBUF}的{STRBUF}啊，
状况非常好哦！

entries.label: ErinGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Working hard?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！很辛苦吧！

entries.label: ErinGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Were you up?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！没睡吧！

entries.label: ErinGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Good morning!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！早上好！

entries.label: ErinBattleRematchText
entries.english:
I'm ERIN. Want to
battle me again? I won't lose this
time! I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
那个，你要不要
再和惠美对战啊？我这次可不会输了！ 我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: ErinComeBattleText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}!
Come battle ERIN! I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
啊，{PLAYER}！
快来和惠美对战吧！ 我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: ErinDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
And, and…
I just battled andbeat {STRBUF}! I've raised my
#MON properly!
entries.translation:
还有还有， 我刚刚正好打败了
{STRBUF}！ 我的培育方式果然很出色！

entries.label: ErinHangUpText
entries.english: See you. Bye-bye!
entries.translation: 就这样了，拜拜——！

entries.label: ErinLostAMonText
entries.translation:
不过啊，不过啊， 我又让{STRBUF}跑了……
真是好讨厌的感觉！

entries.label: ErinMonIsMuchStrongerText
entries.english:
{STRBUF}'s {STRBUF}
is much strongerthan before!
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}的{STRBUF}啊，
变得比之前更强了！

entries.label: ErinWorkingHardText
entries.english:
I'm working hard
to raise my#MON! Come back for
another battle!
entries.translation:
我现在正在
努力培育宝可梦！ 有机会再和我对战吧！

entries.label: ErinAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
It really made me
angry to lose. I'll have to train
much harder… Here's my number.
I'm ERIN--don't forget! Want to
battle me again?
entries.translation:
结果还是输了，
真不甘心啊！我必须更更更努力…… 喂，告诉我你的电话号码。
下次再和我对战吧！

entries.label: ErinAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I want to battle
with you again. Do you want to
exchange numbers?
entries.translation:
希望你能再陪我对战——！
要添加电话号码吗？

entries.label: ErinNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll remember to
call when I wantto battle again!
entries.translation:
等我想对战的时候，
一定会打电话给你的！

entries.label: ErinNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh… I'm sad…
If you do want to battle, come see
ERIN--that's me!
entries.translation:
诶？好难过啊！
算了，等你有兴致了再来找我吧！

entries.label: ErinPackFullText
entries.english:
That's too bad!
You have no room… I'll give it to
you another time.
entries.translation:
啊——尴尬！
你拿不下更多东西了…… 下次再给你吧！

entries.label: ErinPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh no. Your phone
is all filled up.
entries.translation:
你好像存满号码了，
不能再继续添加啦！

entries.label: ErinRematchGiftText
entries.english:
Aww… I lost again! I wonder how many
times that is… Thanks for coming!
Here's a present!
entries.translation:
啊——又输了！
这都是第几次了…… 但还是谢谢你了！
这是礼物！

entries.label: ErinRematchText
entries.english:
Yay! I waited!
Let's start now!
entries.translation:
哇——！等了好久——！
那就赶紧来对战吧——！

entries.label: GavenAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF} speaking… Hi, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！你好！

entries.label: GavenAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF} speaking… Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good evening!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！晚上好！

entries.label: GavenAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF} speaking… Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！早啊！

entries.label: GavenGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? My {STRBUF}'s
doing as great asever. Let's keep at it
and become #MONCHAMPS!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦都还好吧？ 我的{STRBUF}啊，
依然状态绝佳！ 既然都想成为宝可梦冠军，
接下来的日子里，我们一起努力吧！

entries.label: GavenGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}! It's me, {STRBUF}.
How are you doing?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，你好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: GavenGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, good
evening! It's me, {STRBUF}.
How are you doing?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: GavenGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, good
morning! It's me, {STRBUF}.
How are you doing?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: GavenBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Let's battle! I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}. Give me a shout
when you're close.
entries.translation:
来场宝可梦对战吧！ 我在{STRBUF}等你，
你到了附近就来找我吧。

entries.label: GavenDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and I managed
to barely defeat {STRBUF} the
other day. I've never seen a
{STRBUF} getthat strong… You shouldn't let
your guard down, even against a
#MON you'reused to seeing.
entries.translation:
还有啊……
之前我好不容易才打倒了{STRBUF}。 这么强的{STRBUF}
我还是头一次见到…… 即使是常见的宝可梦，
你也不能掉以轻心啊。

entries.label: GavenHangUpNotThursdayText
entries.english:
I obsess over how
to beat you.
entries.translation:
我现在满脑子都在想：
怎么才能赢你……

entries.label: GavenHangUpText
entries.english:
OK, I'll talk to
you soon!
entries.translation: 那就再见啦。

entries.label: GavenLostAMonText
entries.english:
And a while back,
I tried to catch awild {STRBUF}. But it managed to
elude me. One wrong decision
could mean total failure… You ought
to be careful too.
entries.translation:
还有啊……
之前我差点儿就能捉到{STRBUF}了…… 最后还是让它逃了。 正所谓：
一招不慎，满盘皆输……你也要小心啊。

entries.label: GavenMonGreaterThanImaginedText
GavenReminderText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, why
aren't you here? I'll take you down
with {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，还没来吗？ 我在{STRBUF}，
这次一定会打败你的！

entries.label: GavenAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Wow, you're tough.
I haven't battled that seriously in
a long time. Could I get your
phone number? I'd like to battle
again when I heal {STRBUF} and the
rest of my team.
entries.translation:
你好强啊，
我好久没有动真格了。 喂，把你的电话号码
告诉给我吧？ 等{STRBUF}回复了，
我会再找你对战的！

entries.label: GavenAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Could I get your
phone number? I'd like to battle
again when I heal {STRBUF} and the
rest of my team.
entries.translation:
喂，把你的电话号码
告诉给我吧？ 等{STRBUF}回复了，
我会再找你对战的！

entries.label: GavenNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
How should I beat
you? I'm tormented by those thoughts
all the time…
entries.translation:
怎么才能赢你呢……
我整天都在思考这个问题。

entries.label: GavenNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
OK… I understand…
But if you change your mind, give me
a shout anytime.
entries.translation:
原来如此……我懂了。
等你想法改变了，随时可以来找我！

entries.label: GavenPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone's
memory is full. You can't register
my number.
entries.translation:
喂，你电话已经存满了……
不能再添加号码了！

entries.label: GavenRematchText
entries.english:
Hi! I've been
waiting for you! This time, I'm
going to win!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
这次我肯定能赢！

entries.label: GinaAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}!
Hi, how are you?
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}！你好！

entries.label: GinaAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}!
Good evening!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}！晚上好！

entries.label: GinaAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}！早上好！

entries.label: GinaGenericText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
still tough? I train every day
with {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦还是很强吧？ 我和{STRBUF}
每天都在特训哦！

entries.label: GinaGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? It's {STRBUF}. Is
this a bad time?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}？
我是{STRBUF}，没打扰你吧！

entries.label: GinaGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? It's {STRBUF}.
Got time to chat?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}？
我是{STRBUF}，有空吗？

entries.label: GinaGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? It's {STRBUF}.
Good morning!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}？
我是{STRBUF}，早上好！

entries.label: GinaBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Would you be my
practice partneragain sometime? I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}. …Could you take it
a little easier onme next time?
entries.translation:
喂喂，
你再来当我的练习搭档吧？ 我在{STRBUF}，
这次……你要手下留情啊！

entries.label: GinaComePickUpText
entries.english:
I'm getting really
impatient, waiting to give you my
present! Hurry over to
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
一想到能把这个送给你，
我就激动得不得了…… 快来{STRBUF}吧！

entries.label: GinaDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
We battled a wild
{STRBUF} and managed to drop it
in a close match. We're getting into
the groove!
entries.translation:
还有，听我说！
之前好不容易打倒了{STRBUF}哦！最近的状态越来越好了！

entries.label: GinaFoundItemText
entries.english:
I picked up some-
thing nice today. I want you to have
it, so I called! You will come for
it, won't you? {STRBUF} is
where I am.
entries.translation:
我今天捡到好东西了，
我想分点给你，所以就打了这通电话！ 你会来拿吧？
我在{STRBUF}哦！

entries.label: GinaGettingInSyncWithMonText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF} and
I are getting more in sync with each
other.
entries.translation:
