我和{STRBUF}
最近真的是越来越情投意合了！

entries.label: GinaHangUpText
entries.english:
Bye! Let's chat
again!
entries.translation: 那下次再聊吧。

entries.label: GinaHaventFoundAnythingYetText
entries.english:
Sorry, I haven't
found anything useful yet…
I promise, if I find anything, you
can have it!
entries.translation:
抱歉啊，
最近没发现什么好道具…… 等我找到了一定分给你！

entries.label: GinaLostAMonText
entries.english:
But, you know? I still haven't
caught {STRBUF}. It's getting past
frustrating…
entries.translation:
不过啊， 不过我还是没
捉到{STRBUF}啊……我已经要受不了了。

entries.label: GinaReminderText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}!
How soon can I expect to see you
for our battle? Don't forget,
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}！
快来和我对战吧！ 我在{STRBUF}哦！

entries.label: GinaRocketTakeoverRumorText
entries.english:
Have you heard
about TEAM ROCKET? They've taken over
the RADIO TOWER inGOLDENROD. Are the people
inside safe?
entries.translation:
你能听我说吗？ 我听说满金电台
被火箭队占领了！ 里面人没事吧？

entries.label: GinaAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Whenever I see a
strong trainer, I want to be their
cheerleader. When I'm on my
walk, I sometimespick up items. If I get anything,
you can have it! Want to give me
your number? I'll call as soon
as I get anything.
entries.translation:
一看到强大的训练家，
我就想为他们助威呢。 在附近散步的话，
有时会找到道具。哪天有发现的话，我就送给你吧！ 你愿意把电话号码
告诉我吗？等我有发现就打给你。

entries.label: GinaAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
If I find an item,
you can have it! Want to give me
your number?
entries.translation:
找到了道具就送给你！ 可以告诉我
你的电话号码吗？

entries.label: GinaGiftText
entries.english:
So you're finally
here! I think this will
make you happy.
entries.translation:
终于来了呢！ 我觉得你会开心地
收下这个，对吧？

entries.label: GinaNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll call as soon
as I get anything!
entries.translation:
等我找到的时候，
就给你打电话！

entries.label: GinaNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Is that so? Well,
I'll still berooting for you!
entries.translation:
是吗？但是，
我还是会为你助威的。

entries.label: GinaPackFullText
entries.english:
Your PACK looks
completely full. I'll have to hold
on to this.
entries.translation:
哎呀，你的行李
好像已满呀。 没办法，我先保管着吧。

entries.label: GinaPhoneFullText
entries.english:
But your phone is
all filled up!
entries.translation:
哎呀，你的电话存满了，
不能再添加呢！

entries.label: GinaRematchText
entries.english:
I've been waiting! I've gotten a bit
better at this!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
我比过去强了一些呢！

entries.label: HueyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yeah, this is
{STRBUF}. Huh? What's up
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}！ 怎么了，{PLAYER}？

entries.label: HueyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yeah, this is
{STRBUF}. Huh? What's up
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}！ 怎么了，{PLAYER}？

entries.label: HueyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yeah, this is
{STRBUF}. Huh? What's up,
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}！ 怎么了，{PLAYER}？

entries.label: HueyGreetDayText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}! You
free right now? It's me, {STRBUF}!
How's it going?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，你有空吗？ 我是{STRBUF}啊！近来可好？

entries.label: HueyGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
Were you asleep? It's me, {STRBUF}!
How's it going?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，还没睡吧？ 我是{STRBUF}啊！近来可好？

entries.label: HueyGreetText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
You awake? It's me, {STRBUF}!
How's it going?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，起来了吧？ 我是{STRBUF}啊！近来可好？

entries.label: HueyBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Hey, I challenge
you to a battle! It won't be like
last time! {STRBUF}'s
where I'm waiting for you. Hustle
over here pronto!
entries.translation:
喂，来对战吧！
我和上次可不一样了！ 我在{STRBUF}，
赶紧来吧！不见不散！

entries.label: HueyHangUpText
entries.english: See ya!
entries.translation: 再见了！

entries.label: HueyReminderText
entries.english:
Hey, you'd better
not have forgottenabout our battle! {STRBUF}! Hustle over quick!
I'm waiting!
entries.translation:
嘿！说好的对战，
你不会忘了吧！ 我在{STRBUF}！
赶紧来吧！不见不散！

entries.label: HueyWeHaveToBattleAgainSometimeText
entries.english:
We have to battle
again sometime. You can bet I'm
going to keep challenging you
till I win.
entries.translation:
再来对战吧！
在战胜你之前，我会不断地发起挑战！

entries.label: HueyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Cool! That's the
first time I'velost in a while! Hey, give me your
phone number. You'd be fun to
battle, so I'll call you when I
get stronger!
entries.translation:
你还挺能干！
好久没输过了！ 对了！
把你的号码告诉我吧！ 我觉得我能和你
再战三百回合，等我变强了就给你打电话！

entries.label: HueyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Hey, give me your
phone number. You'd be fun to
battle, so I'll call you when I
get stronger!
entries.translation:
把你的号码告诉我吧！ 我觉得我能和你
再战三百回合，等我变强了就给你打电话！

entries.label: HueyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Hey, let's battle
again!
entries.translation: 再来一场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: HueyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Looks like you're
a wimp…
entries.translation: 看来你是个胆小鬼啊……

entries.label: HueyPackFullText
entries.english:
Oh… Your PACK's
full. I'll give itto you later.
entries.translation:
什么啊……
你的背包已满了。没办法，下次吧。

entries.label: HueyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Hey! Your phone's
already full!
entries.translation:
喂！
添加的电话已满了！

entries.label: HueyRematchGiftText
entries.english:
Man! You're as
tough as ever! I've battled you
over and over, but {PLAYER}, I haven't
won once. I bought tons of
items to toughen up my #MON, but
to no avail… Items alone aren't
the answer. That must be what
it is… Here, take this,
{PLAYER}. I won't be needing
it anymore…
entries.translation:
可——恶！
你怎么还是这么强…… 和{PLAYER}
对战过这么多次，我一次也没赢过啊…… 我明明买了一堆药，
拼命锻炼了……凭什么啊？ 药不是万能的……
或许就是这个道理…… {PLAYER}！拿去！
我已经用不着这个了！

entries.label: HueyRematchText
entries.english:
Hey! I'm tired of
waiting for you!
entries.translation: 慢死了！等得我好着急！

entries.label: IrwinAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello? {STRBUF}
here… Wow, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 喔——{PLAYER}！！

entries.label: IrwinAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello? {STRBUF}
here… Yippee, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 咻——{PLAYER}！！

entries.label: IrwinAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello? {STRBUF}
here… Hey, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 哇——{PLAYER}！！

entries.label: IrwinGreetDayText
entries.english:
Uh, hello,
{PLAYER}? It's your buddy
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂、喂喂，{PLAYER}？ 我是你的挚友，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: IrwinGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Uh, hello,
{PLAYER}? It's your sidekick
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂、喂喂，{PLAYER}？ 我是你的伙伴，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: IrwinGreetText
entries.english:
Uh, hello.
{PLAYER}? It's your pal,
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation: 喂、喂喂，{PLAYER}？ 我是你的朋友，{STRBUF}！

entries.label: IrwinCalledRightAwayText
entries.english:
Hehe, I called
right away! I think we can be
good friends!
entries.translation:
嘿嘿，马上打电话找你了！ 我感觉我们以后
关系会变得非常好！

entries.label: IrwinEliteFourGossipText
entries.english:
Yesterday, I went
out to NEW BARK TOWN.  There was a
lady who looked a lot like you,
{PLAYER}. What? That lady
was your mom? Aww, I should've
introduced myself! I bet your mom's
really proud of all that you've
accomplished. Heh, put it this
way. I'd be proud if I were your
mom, believe me!
entries.translation:
昨天我出门的时候
走到了若叶镇， 看到了一个女人，
长得很像{PLAYER}。 哎！是你妈妈啊？ 嗨！早知道是这样，
我就应该和她打招呼……！ 话说回来，
如果你妈妈知道你的事迹，她肯定会非常自豪的！ 我都有点羡慕了，
我要是你妈妈该多好！

entries.label: IrwinFogBadgeGossipText
entries.english:
I saw, I heard! You beat MORTY of
ECRUTEAK GYM! Th-that's just
incredible! I actually went to
the GYM's entrance to cheer you on.
Did you know that? But everyone was
floating, and there were ghosts
all over! So I chickened out and
took off for home…
entries.translation:
我看到了，我听说了！ 你打败了缘朱道馆的松叶！
太、太了不起了！ 我本来想给你打气，
所以我就走进了道馆的门口。 结果看到里面的人都飘着，
用的还都是幽灵属性，太吓人了，就跑回来了……

entries.label: IrwinGoodMatchText
entries.english:
I'm so glad you
called! I was just about
to call you too! I guess we must be
a good match!
entries.translation:
你给我打电话，我很高兴！ 现在我正好也想
给你打电话来着，我们真合得来啊！

entries.label: IrwinHangUpText
entries.english:
I hate having to
hang up on you! Call you later!
entries.translation: 我真不舍得挂断电话！ 就说到这，再见……！

entries.label: IrwinJasmineReturnedGossipText
entries.english:
Hey, I heard about
you! You saved that
#MON at the LIGHTHOUSE, didn't
you? {PLAYER}, I wish
you'd come see me when I'm sick in
bed with a cold!
entries.translation:
我听说了、听说了！ 前不久你帮助了
灯塔里的宝可梦！ 要是我感冒的时候，
{PLAYER}也能来看我，我就太高兴了！

entries.label: IrwinMarshBadgeGossipText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, I heard! You're kicking up
a mighty ruckus over in KANTO!
What a glorious rampage it must
be! You so rock!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，我听说了！ 你在关都也有很多
英勇事迹！这简直就是天神下凡、天女散花、天魔乱舞！ 咻～～我迷上你了！

entries.label: IrwinMtSilverGossipText
entries.english:
I hear rumors
about you all overthe place. It just makes me
sigh, {PLAYER}. How did you get so
strong? Go for the world
championship now! I'll always be
cheering you on!
entries.translation:
我在很多地方
听到过你的传闻！ 哎……我不由得叹息！
{PLAYER}！ 为什么你会这么强？ 你的目标是世界第一吧！
从今往后，我会一直给你加油的！

entries.label: IrwinPlainBadgeGossipText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, I heard! You defeated that
WHITNEY? It makes me proud
to be your friend!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，我听说了！ 你战胜了小茜，对吧？ 能成为你的朋友，
我真是太荣幸了！

entries.label: IrwinRadioTowerGossipText
entries.english:
I heard, I heard,
I heard! About your heroic
liberation of the RADIO TOWER! You
rock so hard!
entries.translation:
我听说了……听说听说了！ 你在电台里的神勇表现！
你也太帅了吧！太帅了！

entries.label: IrwinRisingBadgeGossipText
entries.english:
I saw, I saw! I saw you go into
the DRAGON'S DEN! I'm certain you
passed! Aww, no need to be modest!
You can't fail!
entries.translation:
看到你啦！
看到你进龙穴啦！ 你肯定通过考验了吧！
别害羞啊！毕竟是你啊！

entries.label: IrwinRocketHideoutGossipText
entries.english:
I heard, I heard,
I heard! You smashed TEAM
ROCKET's hideout! You're like a
movie hero, even! But um… What was
TEAM ROCKET?
entries.translation:
我听说了，听说听说了！ 你居然能摧毁火箭队基地，
这简直就是电影里的男主角啊！ 说起来，火箭队是什么？

entries.label: IrwinRocketTakeoverRumorText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, have you
heard? GOLDENROD's RADIO
TOWER has been taken over by TEAM
ROCKET! …Um… What's TEAM
ROCKET?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，知道吗？ 我听说满金电台
被火箭队占领了！ 说起来，火箭队是什么？

entries.label: IrwinSnorlaxGossipText
entries.english:
I saw, I saw! You waking up
SNORLAX! I was watching you
from afar, so I couldn't tell what
you did exactly. Did you play a
flute to wake it? Wow! That's like
magic!
entries.translation:
我看到了，看到啦！ 你唤醒了卡比兽！ 不过我当时站在远处，
没看清发生了什么。你是不是吹了什么笛子啊？ 了不起！你一定是魔法师！

entries.label: IrwinSoMuchToChatAboutText
entries.english:
How are you? What are you
doing? Where are you? How many BADGES do
you have now? How much money
have you saved? How's your mom? Have you got lots
of #MON? Is it going to be
sunny tomorrow? Arrgh, there's so
much I want to chat about! This
is going nowhere!
entries.translation:
你还好吧？ 在干嘛呢？ 现在在哪？ 赢了几个徽章？ 带着多少零花钱？ 你妈妈过得还好吧？ 宝可梦收集了多少啊？ 明天会是晴天吗？ 哎呀，我光顾着问了，
根本没在聊天啊！

entries.label: IrwinTrainPassGossipText
entries.english:
I heard, I heard! You got a MAGNET
TRAIN PASS! When I saw you
departing on the ship, I felt sad
that I wouldn't be able to see you
for a while. But since you have
that PASS, you can zip back anytime!
That's reassuring! What? You can FLY
back anytime? What do you mean
by FLY?
entries.translation:
我听说了，听说啦！ 你是不是
拿到定期月票啦？ 上了船以后，
就暂时不能见面了。想想就有些伤心…… 但有定期月票就省心了！ 哎，你说用飞翔就能过来？
“飞翔”是什么？

entries.label: IrwinVermilionCityGossipText
entries.english:
I saw, I saw,
I saw! You striding onto
a ship, {PLAYER}! I can't get over
how good you look with the sea as
your backdrop!
entries.translation:
我看到了！看到看到了！ {PLAYER}帅气地
乘上了高速船！ 不过你确实
很有大海的感觉！

entries.label: IrwinYourEscapadesRockText
entries.english:
Hearing about your
escapades rocks my soul!
It sure does!
entries.translation:
听了你的英雄事迹，
今天依然为你着迷！

entries.label: IrwinAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
You're the best
I've ever battled! Huh? You're the
one who saved allthe SLOWPOKE? Well, no wonder I
couldn't beat you! Would it be OK to
get your number? I don't want to
miss anything youdo from now on!
entries.translation:
我第一次遇到
像你这么强的对手！ ……哎？什么，你就是
那个救助呆呆兽的人？ 哇！和你这样的人交手，
赢得了才怪呢！ 那，如果可以的话，
……能告诉我你的号码吗？ 我今后可不想错过
你的精彩事迹！

entries.label: IrwinAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
You will tell me
your phone number?
entries.translation:
哎！你要把电话号码
告诉我吗？

entries.label: IrwinNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Wow! Gee, thanks!
Now I can call you anytime, whether
anything's up or not. You know,
just to chat!
entries.translation:
哇——谢谢！
我今后会鼓起干劲的。 有什么事的话，
我就打电话给你。 就算没有什么事，
我也会打给你的！

entries.label: IrwinNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh, but…
I'm not dangerous! I just want to
call and chat about everything
and nothing!
entries.translation:
怎，怎么会……！
我可不是什么怪人啊！ 我只是希望有事的时候
能给你打电话， 就算没有什么事，
也能打给你，仅此而已！

entries.label: IrwinPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone list is
already full… You must be really
popular…
entries.translation:
那个……你的电话存满了，
无法继续添加啊…… 你一定，很受欢迎吧……

entries.label: JackAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello. This is
{STRBUF}… How's it going,
{PLAYER}?
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}，你好啊！

entries.label: JackAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello. This is
{STRBUF}… Good evening,
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}，晚上好！

entries.label: JackAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello. This is
{STRBUF}… Good morning,
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}，早上好！

entries.label: JackGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? My {STRBUF} is
so curious, it's a problem. Maybe
it's like me…
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦还好吧？ 我的{STRBUF}
和我一样好奇心旺盛，真让人拿它没办法。

entries.label: JackGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, howdy! It's me, {STRBUF}.
Isn't it nice out?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，你好！ 我是{STRBUF}，天气不错！

entries.label: JackGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, good
evening! It's me, {STRBUF}.
Got a minute?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，晚上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，你有空吗？

entries.label: JackGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, good
morning! It's me, {STRBUF}.
How are you doing?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早啊！ 我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: JackBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Do you want to
battle? I'll show you how to battle
logically. I'll be in
{STRBUF}. Give me a shout if
you're nearby.
entries.translation:
喂，要来场宝可梦对战吗？
就让你好好看看我用智慧制定出来的战术。 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近，就来找我吧。

entries.label: JackDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
The other day, I
easily defeated a{STRBUF}. I think swapping
tips with you isstarting to help.
entries.translation:
对了，
我在前几天轻松地打倒了{STRBUF}！ 这也是多亏了你
总是和我交换情报吧？

entries.label: JackEarthquakeTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If your opponent
uses DIG, your EARTHQUAKE becomes
more powerful.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 趁对方使用挖洞的时候
使出地震的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackGustTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If your opponent
is FLYing, your GUST becomes much
more powerful.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 趁对方使出飞翔的时候
使出起风的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackHangUpText
entries.english: See you later!
entries.translation: 那就下次见了！

entries.label: JackHeardSomeGreatTipsText
entries.english:
My friend heard
some great tips. He's going to let
me in on some. When he tells me,
I'll call rightaway and tell you.
entries.translation:
我的朋友说他自己
掌握了惊人的消息。 他说以后再告诉我。
等我知道的时候，一定会马上告诉你。

entries.label: JackIntelligenceKeepsRisingText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
intelligence keeps rising. It might
be smarter thanyours!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}
现在变得更聪明了！可能比你的宝可梦还聪明。

entries.label: JackLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and listen.
I missed catching a {STRBUF} by
just a tiny bit. If I'd been a bit
more informed, I'm sure I would've
caught it…
entries.translation:
然后，听我说！
之前{STRBUF}跑走了，我差点就能捉到它了…… 如果我的知识再丰富一点，
当时一定可以成功的……

entries.label: JackMagnitudeTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If your opponent
uses DIG, your MAGNITUDE becomes
more powerful.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 趁对方使用挖洞的时候
使出震级的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackRainDanceTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? When it's raining,
fire-type moves become much weaker
than usual.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 下雨的时候，
火属性的招式威力会比平时弱。

entries.label: JackReminderText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}! Do you remember
your promise? We have to battle
soon! I'll be at
{STRBUF}.

entries.label: JackRolloutTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If you use DEFENSE
CURL, ROLLOUT's power goes way up
past normal.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 使用变圆之后
再使出滚动的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackSandstormTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? The rock, ground
and steel types can't be hurt by
SANDSTORM.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 岩石、地面、钢3种属性
即使处于沙暴之中也不会受到伤害哦。

entries.label: JackSolarbeamTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If the sunlight is
harsh, SOLARBEAM doesn't need to be
charged up.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 日照很强的时候，
日光束不需要吸收光。

entries.label: JackStompTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If the opponent
uses MINIMIZE, your STOMP becomes
more powerful.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 趁对方使用变小的时候
使出踩踏的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackSunnyDayTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If the sunlight is
harsh, water-type moves become much
weaker.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 日照很强的时候，
水属性的招式威力会比平时弱。

entries.label: JackThunderTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know? When it's raining,
THUNDER is sure tostrike.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 下雨的时候，
打雷必定能击中。

entries.label: JackTwisterTriviaText
entries.english:
Did you know…? If your opponent
is FLYing, your TWISTER becomes
more powerful.
entries.translation:
你知道吗？ 趁对方使出飞翔的时候
使出龙卷风的话，威力会比平时更强。

entries.label: JackAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Your knowledge is
impressive! I like that! Want to trade
battle tips? I'll phone if I
get good info. Would you tell me
your number?
entries.translation:
说起来，
你真是学识渊博呢。嗯，我很喜欢！ 为了在宝可梦对战中取胜，
我们来交换情报吧。 有新发现就给你打电话，
告诉我你的电话号码呗？

entries.label: JackAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Want to trade
battle tips? I'll phone if I
get good info. Would you tell me
your number?
entries.translation:
为了在宝可梦对战中取胜，
我们来交换情报吧。 有新发现就给你打电话，
告诉我你的电话号码呗？

entries.label: JackNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll call you if I
hear anything!
entries.translation:
得到新消息的话，
我会立刻给你打电话！

entries.label: JackNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh, OK. Too bad… Well, if you ever
want my number,come see me, OK?
entries.translation:
真是遗憾啊……
等你想添加号码的时候，再来和我说一声吧。

entries.label: JackPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh?
Your phone's full. It can't register
my number.
entries.translation:
喂，你的电话存满了，
无法再添加号码了！

entries.label: JackRematchText
entries.english:
Hi, I was waiting
for you to show! Let's get started
right away!
entries.translation:
哎呀，等死我了！
那就立刻开始吧。

entries.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} here! Oh, {PLAYER}? You
doing well?
entries.translation: 嗨！我是{STRBUF}， {PLAYER}！还好吧？

entries.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} here! Oh, {PLAYER}? You
doing well?
entries.translation: 嗨！我是{STRBUF}， {PLAYER}！还好吧？

entries.label: JoeyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hi, {STRBUF} here! Oh, {PLAYER}? You
doing well?
entries.translation: 嗨！我是{STRBUF}， {PLAYER}！还好吧？

entries.label: JoeyGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? My {STRBUF}'s
raring to go, justlike always. It's the only one
I have. I'm going to become a great
trainer with it!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦也还好吧？
我的{STRBUF}还是和以前一样充满干劲！ 毕竟我的身边只有它，
所以我想和它一起成长，成为成熟的宝可梦训练家！

entries.label: JoeyGreetDayText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}! How's
it going? This is {STRBUF}.
Got a minute?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！你好吗？
我是{STRBUF}，现在有空？

entries.label: JoeyGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing? This is {STRBUF},
got a minute?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！你好吗？
我是{STRBUF}，现在有空？

entries.label: JoeyGreetText
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing? This is {STRBUF},
got a minute?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！你好吗？
我是{STRBUF}，现在有空？

entries.label: JoeyBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Let's get together
and battle! I promise things
will be different! {STRBUF}'s
where I'll be. Give me a shout
when you come.
entries.translation:
和我来场宝可梦对战吧！
这次肯定不会像上次那样。 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来找我吧。

entries.label: JoeyDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I took
down a {STRBUF} in the wild the
other day. It was a cakewalk.
Well, I guess it can't be helped,
us being so tough.
entries.translation:
啊，还有一件事！
我之前打倒了{STRBUF}！ 不过一点成就感都没有。
这也没办法，谁让我们这么强啊！

entries.label: JoeyDevisingStrategiesText
entries.english:
I'm checking out
{STRBUF}'s moves and devising some
strategies. When I come up
with a good one,let's battle!
entries.translation:
我在研究{STRBUF}的
招式，以便制定战术！ 等我想出好战术，
我们就对战吧！

entries.label: JoeyHangUpText
entries.english: All right. Later!
entries.translation: 下次见！

entries.label: JoeyLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I saw a
wild {STRBUF}! I thought about
going for it, but I decided to work
with my one-and- only right to the
extreme end.
entries.translation:
啊，还有一件事！
之前看到{STRBUF}了！ 虽然我很想捕捉……
但我坚持只用1只宝可梦，所以就放弃了。

entries.label: JoeyMonLookingSharperText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
looking sharperthan before! I doubt there's a
#MON as cool as this guy in your
party!

entries.label: JoeyReminderText
entries.english:
What's keeping
you, {PLAYER}! Let's get down and
battle already! I'm waiting on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
好慢啊，{PLAYER}！ 快来和我对战啊！
我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: JoeyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Listen, can I get
your phone number? I'll ring you for
some battles. I'm a rookie too, 
so I think it'd bea good motivator.
entries.translation:
哎，如果你愿意，
那就把号码告诉我吧！ 要进行宝可对战的话，
我会给你打电话的。 大家都是初学者，
这也是不错的刺激！

entries.label: JoeyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Can I get your
phone number? I don't want to
lose against you! We have to battle
again, OK?
entries.translation:
那就把号码告诉我吧！ 我不是很想输给你！
下次再进行宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: JoeyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll ring you
whenever I get theurge to battle!
entries.translation:
要进行宝可梦对战的话，
我会立刻打电话给你的！

entries.label: JoeyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh, all right… But I won't lose
to you again!
entries.translation:
明白了……但是……
我不会再输给你了！

entries.label: JoeyPackFullText
entries.english:
Hey, wait! Your
PACK is stuffed! Well, we'll leave
it till next time.
entries.translation:
切，什么啊。
你的背包都塞满了啊！那就下次再来吧。

entries.label: JoeyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Huh, what? Your
phone's full.
entries.translation:
可，你的电话
添加的号码已满了吗！

entries.label: JoeyRematchGiftText
entries.english:
And yet another
loss… No doubt about
it--you're tough. Being beaten this
often actuallyfeels good now! Here, take this. 
Use it to get even tougher. That will
toughen me up too!
entries.translation:
又输了……
你真的很强！ 明明输了这么多次，
反而觉得心情还不错！ 对了！这个给你！
用这个来变得更强吧！我也会变得更强的！

entries.label: JoeyRematchText
entries.english:
I've been waiting!
Let's battle now!
entries.translation:
我在等着！
那么开始对战吧！

entries.label: JoseAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}? Hi!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}？你好啊！

entries.label: JoseAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}?
Good evening!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}？晚上好！

entries.label: JoseAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, {PLAYER}?
Good morning!
entries.translation: 你好，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}？早上好！

entries.label: JoseGenericText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
still cooking? My {STRBUF} has
too much energy. Once it takes off,
it won't come backfor a while.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦还好吧？ 我的{STRBUF}啊，
精力太旺盛了，让人头疼！ 只要把它放出来，
它就迟迟不愿意回来。

entries.label: JoseGreetDayText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}? Tweet! Yeah, it's
me, {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
啊，是{PLAYER}？
嘟——！我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: JoseGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}? Tweet! Yeah, it's
me, {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
啊，是{PLAYER}？
嘟——！我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: JoseGreetText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}? Tweet! Yeah, it's
me, {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
啊，是{PLAYER}？
嘟——！我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: JoseBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Want to battle
again? For some reason,
my FARFETCH'D is all worked up and
raring to go. {STRBUF}'s
where I'm at. Keep an eye out
for me, OK?
entries.translation:
要再来场宝可梦对战吗？
因为我的大葱鸭现在非常有干劲…… 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来找我吧。

entries.label: JoseComePickUpText
entries.english:
What's wrong? Don't you want
this gift? Catch up to me on
{STRBUF}, and I'll let you
have it.
entries.translation:
怎么了？难道你不要？
我在{STRBUF}，你到了附近就来拿吧。

entries.label: JoseDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
A while ago, my
FARFETCH'D KO'dthis {STRBUF}. You should have
seen FARFETCH'D wield that stick.
Amazing stuff!
entries.translation:
还有啊，
之前我都大葱鸭打倒了{STRBUF}…… 真想让你看到大葱鸭
挥舞植物茎部的样子！

entries.label: JoseFoundItemText
entries.english:
My FARFETCH'D had
something prettyin its beak. Like I promised,
you can have it. Catch up to me on
{STRBUF}, and I'll let you
have it.
entries.translation:
我的大葱鸭之前
叼回来了很漂亮的东西。 按照约定，就把它送你了。 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来拿吧。

entries.label: JoseHangUpText
entries.english: Be seeing you!
entries.translation: 那就再见啦！

entries.label: JoseHaventGottenItemYetText
entries.english:
I haven't gotten
what I promisedyou yet. I'll call you as
soon as I get it, so could you wait
a little longer?
entries.translation:
我现在还没有弄到
之前说好要送你的东西， 等我弄到手了就联系你，
你耐心等等吧。

entries.label: JoseLostAMonText
entries.english:
I ran into a wild
{STRBUF}… I was trying to
catch it, but it took off faster
than I thought it would. It was a
bit disappointing.
entries.translation:
还有，我之前
遇见了{STRBUF}…… 它快得超乎想象。
就要成功捕捉的时候，它一下子就不见了。你也觉得很遗憾吧？

entries.label: JoseMonsStickHasADeliciousAromaText
entries.english:
Hey listen, my
{STRBUF}'s stick has this really
delicious aroma. That aroma gets my
appetite going!
entries.translation:
你听我说！
我的{STRBUF}啊，拿着的茎部会发出香味。 我一闻到这个香味，
肚子就马上饿了！

entries.label: JoseReminderText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, could you
hurry over? FARFETCH'D is
agitated. If you don't come
soon, it might smack me with its
stick! {STRBUF}! Please come as
soon as you can!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
能快点过来嘛？ 我的大葱鸭很不耐烦啊……
要是你再不过来，它就要用茎部打我了！ 我在{STRBUF}哦！
希望你尽量快点！

entries.label: JoseAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
If my {STRBUF}
sees anything pretty, it goes
and gets it. Do you like pretty
things? I could share if
it gets some more. What's your phone
number? I'll call. Don't expect a
whole lot, OK?
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}啊，
只要发现漂亮的东西，不管是什么都会叼回来…… 你喜欢漂亮的东西嘛？ 要是它下次再叼东西回来，
我也分你一点吧？ 要是告诉我你的号码，
我就能打电话通知你哦。也不用太期待就是了。

entries.label: JoseAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Do you like pretty
things? I could share if
FARFETCH'D goesand gets more. What's your phone
number? I'll call.
entries.translation:
你喜欢漂亮的东西嘛？ 要是大葱鸭叼了东西回来，
我也分你一点吧？ 要是告诉我你的号码，
我就能打电话通知你哦。

entries.label: JoseGiftText
entries.english:
Kept me waiting!
Look, this is it! See? Isn't it some
kind of pretty?
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
你看，就是这个！ 超级漂亮，对吧？

entries.label: JoseNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll call you as
soon as I getsomething pretty.
entries.translation:
要是获得了什么漂亮东西，
我会用电话通知你的。

entries.label: JoseNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
You sure? Well,
tell me if youchange your mind.
entries.translation:
这样吗？
等你改变想法了，随时都可以来找我哦。

entries.label: JosePackFullText
entries.english:
Huh? You don't
have anywhere to put this. Better
come back for it.
entries.translation:
那个？
你好像拿不动更多东西了。下次再来吧。

entries.label: JosePhoneFullText
entries.english:
Huh? Your phone
list is full.
entries.translation:
嗯？你已经存满号码了，
不能再添加了！

entries.label: JoseRematchText
entries.english:
Tweet! Tweeeet! Kept me waiting!
Go, FARFETCH'D!
entries.translation:
哔——，哔稀——！ 等着你呢！
上吧，大葱鸭！

entries.label: KenjiAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} here… {PLAYER}! Beautiful
weather, hey?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！美好的天气！

entries.label: KenjiAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} here… {PLAYER}! Beautiful
moonlight, hey?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！美好的月夜！

entries.label: KenjiAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} here… {PLAYER}! Beautiful
morning, hey?
entries.translation: 我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}！美好的早晨！

entries.label: KenjiGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}呀！
我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: KenjiGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}呀！
我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: KenjiGreetText
entries.english:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}呀！
我是{STRBUF}！

entries.label: KenjiCallMeBackAnotherTimeText
entries.english:
I'm in training
now. I apologize, but call me back
another time. Oooooaaarrrgh!
entries.translation:
我正在修行呢，
之后再打给你！嘿呀——！

entries.label: KenjiHangUpMorningText
entries.english:
I plan to take a
lunch break, so come see me then!
Ayiiiyah!
entries.translation:
我打算今天白天休息，
到时候你尽管来玩吧！喝啊——！

entries.label: KenjiHangUpNightText
entries.english:
I rested up over
my lunch break. Now it's time to
resume training! Oooryaah!
entries.translation:
白天我已经休息够了，
现在又继续修行了！嘿啊——！嘿啊——！

entries.label: KenjiHangUpText
entries.english:
Anyway, we'll chat
again!
entries.translation:
再见，
下次再聊吧！

entries.label: KenjiIllHaveTimeToChatTomorrowText
entries.english:
I apologize, but I
don't have time to chat while I am in
training! I'll have time to
chat tomorrow! Yiiihah!
entries.translation:
抱歉，我正在修炼，
腾不出手来打电话。 明天我就有空了，
到时候再联系！喝！

entries.label: KenjiRemainDedicatedText
entries.english:
Are you still on
your journey? I remain dedicated
to my training. Oooooaaarrrgh!
entries.translation:
还在继续旅行吧？ 我也在继续修行！
喝呀——！

entries.label: KenjiTakingABreakText
entries.english:
I'm taking a break
on ROUTE 45! Why not drop by if
you are free?
entries.translation:
我现在正在休息，
地点是45号道路！ 你有空就过来吧！

entries.label: KenjiAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Our battle was
remarkable! I wish for some-
thing to rememberyou by! Perhaps your phone
number will do? My training makes
it impossible tochat much, but…
entries.translation:
……说起来，这场对战
真的很精彩呢！ 我希望能有什么东西
让我把你记在心里！ 你能把你的电话号码
告诉我吗？ 我总是在修行，
也没机会聊天呢……

entries.label: KenjiAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
My training makes
chatting tough, but will you take
down my number?
entries.translation:
我正在修行之中，
也没什么机会聊天……你还愿意添加我的号码吗？

entries.label: KenjiGiftText
entries.english:
I wish to thank
you, {PLAYER}! I've been training
all alone… I was happy that
you cared to call… I want you to have
this!
entries.translation:
今天，我想
感谢{PLAYER}！ ……你总是给我打电话，
让我这种孤身修行的人，感到非常开心…… 请收下这个！

entries.label: KenjiNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I must train
harder to becomethe mightiest!
entries.translation:
我要变得更强！
修行！修行！

entries.label: KenjiNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
If you decide you
want my number,come see me.
entries.translation:
等你想添加的时候，
再过来找我吧！

entries.label: KenjiPackFullText
entries.english:
Your strength will
not let you carry another thing!
I will hold this till you lighten
your PACK!
entries.translation:
再增加的行李的话，
恐怕你会吃不消！ 等你减轻行李了再来吧。
我先好好存着！

entries.label: KenjiPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone appears
to be full. Come back later!
entries.translation:
你的电话好像已满了，
过会儿再来吧！

entries.label: LizAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，你好——

entries.label: LizAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，晚上好——

entries.label: LizAnswerPhoneText
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，早上好——

entries.label: LizGenericText
entries.english:
I had some time,
so I called you. So anyway, how are
your #MON? Me, I take my
{STRBUF} to the #MON CENTER in
VIOLET every day, so it's doing just
fantastic! I'm friends with
the receptionist!
entries.translation:
我现在挺闲的，
就想到给你打电话了。 喂喂！
你的宝可梦还好吧？ 我每天都要
把我的{STRBUF}带去桔梗市宝可梦中心，他马上就会充满活力！ 它现在和前台的大姐姐们
关系变得相当好了。

entries.label: LizGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}.
This is {STRBUF}. How are things
going for you?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，你好——
我是{STRBUF}，近来可好？

entries.label: LizGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Good evening,
{PLAYER}. This is {STRBUF}.
Are you awake?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，晚上好——
我是{STRBUF}，还没睡吧？

entries.label: LizGreetText
entries.english:
Good morning,
{PLAYER}. This is {STRBUF}.
Were you sleeping?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，早上好——
我是{STRBUF}，起来了吧？

entries.label: LizBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Hi! Do you have
some free time? I've got all sorts
of time. If you're free, would you
like to battle? I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}. Let me know when
you get here!
entries.translation:
哎，你有空吗？ 我现在闲的发慌啊。
如果你也有空的话，不如陪我对战吧？ 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来找我吧！

entries.label: LizBeautifulTrainerGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! I saw a beautiful
{STRBUF}! I wish I could
become a beautiful{STRBUF} too.
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 我之前遇见了
特别漂亮的{STRBUF}！ 我将来也想变得和那个
{STRBUF}一样漂亮啊！

entries.label: LizBugCatchingContestGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! Have you ever
taken part in a Bug-Catching
Contest at theNATIONAL PARK? I did once, but
all I could catchwas a CATERPIE. But guess what! I won with that
CATERPIE. Isn'tthat great?
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 你有没有参加过
自然公园的捕虫大赛？ 其实我以前也
参加过那么一次…… 不过我参赛的那次
只捉到了绿毛虫。 可我居然靠着绿毛虫
拿下了第一名！这可以吹一辈子啊！

entries.label: LizDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
And, and! Um… We beat a wild
{STRBUF} with just one hit a
little while ago. We felt sorry for
it, though.
entries.translation:
还有还有！ 我之前只用一击就
打倒了{STRBUF}……它是不是太可怜了？

entries.label: LizEarlGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! Do you know EARL,
the teacher who runs the #MON
ACADEMY in VIOLET? I saw him doing
pirouettes while he was running. It
was wildly funny!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 桔梗市宝可梦补习班的
初始老师，你见过吗？ 那个人总是转着圈圈
在城里跑来跑去。超级有趣啊！

entries.label: LizFalknerGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! Don't you think
FALKNER of VIOLET GYM is cool and
handsome? But they say his
dad, who's out training on the
road, is even more cool and handsome
than FALKNER. I wish I could
meet him!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 知道桔梗道馆的阿速吧？
他是不是又酷又帅？ 不过我听说，
阿速那个外出旅行的爸爸比他更酷、也比他更帅。真想见一次啊！

entries.label: LizFawningOverMonText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! My {STRBUF}…
it… so pretty… and… giggle… so
awesome… yes… but… very much… eeek!
And… lovely… Just ravishing…
Oh, too much! …Hug it… sleeping…
That's right… pretty… sigh… So
nice… Cute… …Oops! Look at the
time! I chattedtoo long! I'm sorry I took
so much of your time!
I love chatting!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 我的{STRBUF}啊……
……超级……啊…………太可爱了……而且……哎嘿…………嘿嘿……真是的……强过头…………然后…………就是这样……不过……非常…………呀——！ …………抱紧了……
就算在睡…………是吧？……………………太漂亮……！……真是的………………哎呀？啊，都这个点了啊！我们好像聊太久了呢。 占你这么长时间，很抱歉。
谁让我这么喜欢电话呢！

entries.label: LizForgotGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! Uh… Um… Whoops! I forgot what I
was going to say!
entries.translation: 喂，听我说听我说！ 呃，那个……就是……？ 啊哈哈，我忘了啊！

entries.label: LizHangUpText
entries.english:
OK, I'll call you
later!
entries.translation: 那下次再聊吧！

entries.label: LizLostAMonText
entries.english:
And, and! Uh… We just saw a
really gorgeous{STRBUF}. But I was on the
phone, so it got away. It made us
really angry!
entries.translation:
还有还有！ 我之前遇见了
特别漂亮的{STRBUF}…… 可我当时正在打电话，
错过了它……好后悔！

entries.label: LizMonAlwaysWantsToNuzzleText
entries.english:
Oh, you have to
hear this. My {STRBUF} is
so adorable! It always wants to
nuzzle me!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 我的{STRBUF}啊，
动不动就蹭我脸，这也太可爱了吧！

entries.label: LizMooMooMilkGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! Do you know about
MOOMOO MILK? You can buy it at
MOOMOO FARM. It's supposed to
be good for health and beauty.
I really want to try some. I bet
it's delicious!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 你知道吗？哞哞牧场
会出售哞哞鲜奶。 大家都说哞哞鲜奶
喝了以后养颜又健康，我也好想喝啊！ 肯定很好喝啊！

entries.label: LizReminderText
entries.english:
I've got too much
time on my hands! Let's battle right
away! I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}!

entries.label: LizRuinsOfAlphGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! I was listening to
the radio in the RUINS OF ALPH when
an odd broadcast suddenly cut it on
the regular show. I wonder what it
was. So strange!
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 我之前在阿露福遗迹
打开了广播…… 只听见广播里面
在播放奇怪的节目！这是怎么回事？真奇怪啊！

entries.label: LizSalonGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! There's a #MON
SALON in GOLDENROD that's run by two
brothers. The older brother
is good, but the younger one really
isn't. But sometimes the
younger one does a better job than
his brother. Every time I go, I
have a hard time trying to decide
whom I should use…
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 在满金市的某处
有一对美发兄弟…… 哥哥手艺非常好，
弟弟就差了点。 不过有的时候，
弟弟剪出来的效果可能比哥哥更好。 我每次都不知道找谁，
纠结死了啊！

entries.label: LizSurfPikachuGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! I collect #MON
plush dolls. But I can't seem
to get a hold of a SURF PIKACHU DOLL.
None of my friends have it. It must
be totally rare! You could really
brag about it ifyou had one.
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 我不是一直都在收集
宝可梦布偶吗…… 但是，怎么也弄不到
冲浪皮卡丘布偶。 我的小伙伴也都没有，
它肯定非常稀有吧！有了它该多自豪啊！

entries.label: LizWhitneyGossipText
entries.english:
Listen, listen! GOLDENROD GYM's
WHITNEY began battling only a
little while ago! But the #MON
LEAGUE chose heras a GYM LEADER! I bet she must be
totally talented.
entries.translation:
喂，听我说听我说！ 据说满金道馆的小茜
前一阵子才开始玩宝可梦对战！ 不过毕竟是宝可梦联盟总部
钦定的道馆馆主，她一定有优秀的才能啊！

entries.label: LizWrongNumberText
entries.english:
Hi, TANIA. How are
you? This is LIZ. I'm fine, but I'm
bored silly! Huh… Wrong number?
Oops! Sorry!
entries.translation:
小柔，你好嘛？我是香织。
我倒是很好，就是有点闲！ 哎，打错了？ ……
啊哈哈，抱歉抱歉。

entries.label: LizAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Oh? You're on a
big journey to seethe sights? Neat! Let's be friends!
Can I have yourphone number? I want to hear
about everythingyou've seen!
entries.translation:
哎！你在旅行吗？
可以看到各种东西吧…… 喂，不如把你的号码
告诉我吧～？ 我们交个朋友吧！
真希望你能通过电话把各种见闻告诉我啊～

entries.label: LizAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Let's be friends!
Can I have yourphone number? I want to hear
about everythingyou've seen!
entries.translation:
喂，不如把你的电话号码
告诉我吧～？ 我们交个朋友吧！
真希望你能通过电话把各种见闻告诉我啊～

entries.label: LizNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll telephone you
if I hear anythinginteresting.
entries.translation:
我如果听说了有趣的事情，
也会马上给你打电话哦！

entries.label: LizNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Aww… You won't be
my friend?
entries.translation:
哎——怎么能这样——
你不想和我交朋友吗——！

entries.label: LizPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Wait! Your phone
list is filled up!
entries.translation:
等一下！
你已经存满号码了！

entries.label: LizRematchText
entries.english:
You're late! Let's
get started now!
entries.translation:
好——慢！
马上开始对战吧！

entries.label: MomCheckBalanceText
entries.english:
By the way, you've
saved up ${STRBUF}. Do you want to
keep on saving?
entries.translation:
说起来，你存的钱已经
攒到了{STRBUF}元，还要继续存钱吗？

entries.label: MomDeterminedText
entries.english:
That sounds really
tough. But, {PLAYER}, I
know you're really determined. You'll
be OK, right?
entries.translation:
嗯……你也挺不容易。 不过，{PLAYER}
毕竟是个勤奋的人，别太勉强自己啊。

entries.label: MomImportantToSaveText
entries.english:
It's important to
save your money.
entries.translation:
好好存钱
是非常有必要的！

entries.label: MomOKIllSaveText
entries.english:
OK. I'll save your
money.
entries.translation: 那我就帮你存钱吧。

entries.label: MomOtherAreaText
entries.english:
Wow, you're in
{STRBUF}? Good luck on your
#MON quest!
entries.translation:
你现在在{STRBUF}吗？
是在努力收集宝可梦吧！

entries.label: MomPhoneCherrygroveText
entries.english:
You're visiting
{STRBUF}? How about coming
home for a bit?
entries.translation:
哎呀，你在{STRBUF}吗？
离若叶镇很近嘛，有空要来看看我啊。

entries.label: MomPhoneGenericAreaText
entries.english:
Really, you're in
{STRBUF}? I've never gone
there. That's kindof neat, {PLAYER}.
entries.translation:
哦，你在{STRBUF}吗？
妈妈还没去过呢。 {PLAYER}真厉害呀！

entries.label: MomPhoneGreetingText
entries.english:
Hello? Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
Working hard?
entries.translation:
喂喂，喂喂…… 啊！是{PLAYER}吗！
你还在继续努力吧？

entries.label: MomPhoneHangUpText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, keep it
up! I'm rootingfor you, baby!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！加油！
妈妈会给你鼓气的！

entries.label: MomPhoneLandmarkText
entries.english:
Oh, so you're in
{STRBUF}… Isn't that where
{STRBUF} is? Did you go
take a look?
entries.translation:
啊，你在{STRBUF}吗…… 我记得……
那附近好像有{STRBUF}，你要去看看吗？

entries.label: MomPhoneLectureText
entries.english:
Hello? …… {PLAYER}?
I heard from PROF. ELM that you went
on a long trip. I wish you would
have told me… What about money?
Should I save it?
entries.translation:
喂喂，喂喂…… ……{PLAYER}？
妈妈听空木博士说你要出去旅行…… 你应该先和我说一声啊…… 那钱的方面怎么办？
要妈妈帮你存钱吗？

entries.label: MomPhoneNewBarkText
entries.english:
What? You're in
{STRBUF}? Come see your MOM
sometime!
entries.translation:
什么，你在{STRBUF}啊？
有空要来看看我啊。

entries.label: MomPhoneNoGymQuestText
entries.english:
Hello? Hi, {PLAYER}! If
you're done with your errand come
on home, dear.
entries.translation:
喂喂，喂喂…… 哎呀，{PLAYER}，
事情办完了就回来吧，别光顾着玩呀。

entries.label: MomPhoneNoPokedexText
entries.english:
Hello? Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
You're on a big mission for PROF.
ELM? Be good!
entries.translation:
喂喂，喂喂…… 哎呀，{PLAYER}，
我听说空木博士委托你办什么事情？加油啊！

entries.label: MomPhoneNoPokemonText
entries.english:
Hello? Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
Wasn't PROF.ELMwaiting for you?
entries.translation:
喂喂，喂喂…… 哎呀，{PLAYER}，
空木博士是不是找你有事啊？

entries.label: MomPhoneWontSaveMoneyText
entries.english:
OK. I won't save
your money.
entries.translation: 那就不存了吧。

entries.label: MomYoureNotSavingText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER},
you're not saving any money. Would
you like to save?
entries.translation:
对了，{PLAYER}
还没开始存钱呢，要存吗？

entries.label: MomYouveSavedText
entries.english:
By the way, you've
saved up ${STRBUF}. Want to start
saving again?
entries.translation:
对了，你已经在妈妈这儿
存了${STRBUF}。 要重新开始存钱吗？

entries.label: ParryAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yup, yup!
It's {STRBUF}! Hah, and here's
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 这不是{PLAYER}嘛！

entries.label: ParryAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yup, yup!
It's {STRBUF}! Hah, and here's
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 这不是{PLAYER}嘛！

entries.label: ParryAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yup, yup!
It's {STRBUF}! Hah, and here's
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 这不是{PLAYER}嘛！

entries.label: ParryGenericText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
looking good? My {STRBUF} and
me--we're looking mighty dandy!
Hahahah!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦还好吧？ 叔叔我和叔叔的{STRBUF}
都很健康！哈哈哈！

entries.label: ParryGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, it's
{STRBUF}! Have you had a
proper lunch?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！午饭吃了吗！

entries.label: ParryGreetNiteText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, it's
{STRBUF}! Have you had a
proper dinner?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！晚饭吃了吗！

entries.label: ParryGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, it's
{STRBUF}! Have you had a
proper breakfast?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我是{STRBUF}！早饭吃了吗！

entries.label: ParryBattleRematchText
entries.english:
You're thinking
you'd like to battle me. Am I
right or what? Yep! We'll meet on
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
你现在是不是很想
和叔叔我对战啊？你说想？那是必须的！ 就在{STRBUF}碰头吧！

entries.label: ParryBattleWithMeText
entries.english:
You'll battle with
me again, right?
entries.translation:
你再和叔叔我
来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: ParryDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Yeah, we KO'd a
wild {STRBUF}! That was OK, but I
wanted to get it…
entries.translation:
叔叔我最近打倒了
{STRBUF}！其实我本来是想捕捉的……

entries.label: ParryHangUpText
entries.english:
OK, give me a call
again!
entries.translation: 下次再打给你吧！

entries.label: ParryHaventYouGottenToText
entries.english:
Haven't you gotten
to {STRBUF}? Waiting here isn't
bad, but I'd surelike to battle!
entries.translation:
你还没有到
{STRBUF}吗？ 虽然等你也没什么，
但是叔叔我更想和你对战！

entries.label: ParryLostAMonText
entries.english:
And yesterday, we
spotted a wild {STRBUF}.
We were debating whether to catch
it or beat it. When along came
another guy who caught it!
How about that!
entries.translation:
另外，叔叔我昨天遇见了
{STRBUF}。犹豫了好久，不知道该捕捉还是该打倒。 这时有个人正好路过，
结果就被他给捉走了！

entries.label: ParryNothingCanMatchText
entries.english:
Nothing can match
my {STRBUF} now.
entries.translation:
叔叔我的{STRBUF}
已经打遍附近无敌手！

entries.label: ParryAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Sheesh, the way
you attacked! That was something! We
should meet again! How about giving
me your number?
entries.translation:
哎呀——说起来，
你的攻势挺精彩啊！有空再陪叔叔对战吧！ 告诉我你的电话号码吧！

entries.label: ParryAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
So you want to
register my phone number for a re-
match, huh?
entries.translation:
哦！你想添加叔叔的
电话号码了吗！肯定还想和我对战吧？

entries.label: ParryNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I'll call you
whenever I feellike battling!
entries.translation:
等我想对战的时候，
我的电话就会轰过去哦！

entries.label: ParryNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
No? That's fine. A definite no is
easy to take! I'll be right here
when you're readyfor a rematch.
entries.translation:
就算被果断拒绝，
心情也还是很好！ 但是，想陪叔叔对战的话，
随时可以过来哦！

entries.label: ParryPackFullText
entries.english:
Your PACK looks
stuffed full! You can't have
this now.
entries.translation:
哦！看起来
你的行李已经满了！ 我暂时帮你保管吧！

entries.label: ParryPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh? There's no
room to registermy phone number.
entries.translation:
那个？你的电话没空位
留给叔叔的号码啊。

entries.label: ParryRematchGiftText
entries.english:
Well, you're
special all right. If only I'd begun
#MON when I wasa tad younger… I want you to work
and succeed for the both of us.
So take this, OK?
entries.translation:
你真的很强啊——！ 如果我再早点
开始宝可梦的话…… 好的！你也要连我的份
一起加油啊。带上这个吧！

entries.label: ParryRematchText
entries.english:
Hey, here comes
the kid! Let's go! Ready for my usual
no-brainer, all-out offense?
entries.translation:
哦，来了啊！那就对战吧！
叔叔我这次也会毫不犹豫地发起猛攻哦！

entries.label: RalphAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes? Ah, {PLAYER}. You're courteous
enough to state your name when you
call on the phone.
entries.translation:
喂……{PLAYER}吗？ 在电话里也能自报姓名，
你真的很有礼貌呢！

entries.label: RalphAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes? Ah, {PLAYER}. You're courteous
enough to state your name when you
call on the phone.
entries.translation:
喂……{PLAYER}吗？ 在电话里也能自报姓名，
你真的很有礼貌呢！

entries.label: RalphAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes? Ah, {PLAYER}. You're courteous
enough to state your name when you
call on the phone.
entries.translation:
喂……{PLAYER}吗？ 在电话里也能自报姓名，
你真的很有礼貌呢！

entries.label: RalphGenericText
entries.english:
Are you taking
good care of your #MON? You have
to be good to yourpartners!
entries.translation:
你很关爱宝可梦吧？
同伴当然是要好好关爱啦。

entries.label: RalphGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hiya, it's Uncle
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}大叔。

entries.label: RalphGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hiya, it's Uncle
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}大叔。

entries.label: RalphGreetText
entries.english:
Hiya, it's Uncle
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}大叔。

entries.label: RalphBattleRematchText
entries.english:
What do you say to
a battle with me? Good, you're going
to do it! For a kid, you're
quite agreeable. {STRBUF} is
the spot!
entries.translation:
怎么样，
都过这么久了，再和叔叔来场对战吧？ ……你愿意吗！ 真是懂事的孩子啊！
好，我在{STRBUF}等你！

entries.label: RalphDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
I just beat a wild
{STRBUF}. I told my kid, but
he scoffed that he could do the same
thing easily. Boy, has he gotten
cocky…
entries.translation:
对了，前不久
我打倒了{STRBUF}！我得意地告诉孩子，他却说自己也做得到…… 唉，初生牛犊不怕虎……

entries.label: RalphHangUpText
entries.english:
You call your mom
sometimes too!
entries.translation:
再见了。
你也要常常联系妈妈啊！

entries.label: RalphHurryText
entries.english:
Hey, what's the
matter with you? Aren't you coming
over to fish forQWILFISH? I'm on ROUTE 32,
so hurry up!
entries.translation:
喂喂！别愣着啊？ 快来钓千针鱼啊！
地点是32号道路！

entries.label: RalphItemText
entries.english:
Listen, I… Yowch! Uh, sorry! See,
{STRBUF} are biting like there
is no tomorrow over here on
{STRBUF}! Aiyee! Ouch!
One jabbed me! Heh, they're some
kind of feisty! {PLAYER}, you have
to see this rare sight! Get ready
to fish!
entries.translation:
其实啊……好痛！ 啊，不，抱歉抱歉！
哎呀，我在{STRBUF}钓到好多{STRBUF}了！ 哇，痛痛痛！居然扎我！
哈哈，真有活力啊！{PLAYER}！它们很稀有！你也去钓吧！

entries.label: RalphLostAMonText
entries.english:
Yesterday a wild
{STRBUF} slipped away from me, in
front of my kid. I was feeling down
about it until he shared his #
BALLS with me. Hahah, that sure
made my day!
entries.translation:
还有，我昨天在孩子眼前
放跑了{STRBUF}，就在我感到沮丧的时候，孩子把精灵球分给我了！ 哈哈，我真的很开心呢。

entries.label: RalphNeglectingKidsText
entries.english:
I've been spending
more time with my {STRBUF} than I
have with my kids. That's a bit sad,
actually.
entries.translation:
最近陪{STRBUF}的时间，
比陪孩子的时间还多！还真是让人挺难过的。

entries.label: RalphNoItemText
entries.english:
Yeah, I know. You're looking for
rare #MON. Recently, all I've
been catching areMAGIKARP, though…
entries.translation:
你问有没有稀有宝可梦？
唔……最近只能钓到鲤鱼王……

entries.label: RalphReminderText
entries.english:
So where are you?
I'm waiting for you to show up on
{STRBUF}. You shouldn't make
your elders wait!
entries.translation:
喂喂，你在哪呢？
快来{STRBUF}对战啊！ 不要让年纪比你大的人
等太久啊。

entries.label: RalphAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Don't young people
fish anymore? I've seen rare
#MON while I'vebeen fishing… You young people
like that, right? Want to trade
phone numbers? I'll let you know
if I see anything.
entries.translation:
最近的年轻人
都不怎么垂钓了吧？ 不过叔叔垂钓的时候，
时不时就会碰到稀有的宝可梦…… 这么一来，年轻人也会
对垂钓产生兴趣吧？ 要交换电话号码吗？
碰到好东西会跟你讲的。

entries.label: RalphAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Hm? So you do want
me to phone if Isee rare #MON?
entries.translation:
嗯？你其实很希望
从我的电话中听见稀有宝可梦的事情吧？

entries.label: RalphNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Yep, phone if I
see rare #MON. Don't worry, I
won't forget!
entries.translation:
出现了稀罕宝可梦的话，
我会记得给你打电话的！

entries.label: RalphNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh…
My own kids won't even give me their
phone numbers… Is that how young
people are today?
entries.translation:
这样啊…… 算了，我家孩子也
跟我说他不愿意把号码告诉爸爸……最近的小朋友都这样呢。

entries.label: RalphPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone's
memory is full. It seems that
young people allhave #GEAR.
entries.translation:
你的电话好像存满了。 最近的年轻人
都有宝可装置呢……

entries.label: RalphRematchText
entries.english:
Hey, kid! No losing for me
this day!
entries.translation:
哦，总算来了，年轻人！
大叔我今天不会输的！

entries.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, hi, {PLAYER},
what's up?
entries.translation:
你好，我是{STRBUF}……
{PLAYER}啊！有事吗？

entries.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, hi, {PLAYER},
what's up?
entries.translation:
你好，我是{STRBUF}……
{PLAYER}啊！有事吗？

entries.label: ReenaAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}.
What's up?
entries.translation:
你好，我是{STRBUF}……
{PLAYER}啊！有事吗？

entries.label: ReenaGenericText
entries.english:
Hey, how are your
#MON doing? What? Great?
I see… What? My #MON? Of course they're
doing great! What kind of a question
is that?
entries.translation:
喂，你的宝可梦们
最近还不错吧？非常不错？这样啊…… 你问我的宝可梦？ 它们当然很好啦！
别问这些废话嘛！

entries.label: ReenaGreetDayText
entries.english:
You're slow! Hurry
up and answer! It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
别再慢吞吞地接电话了！
是我，是我啊！{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ReenaGreetNiteText
entries.english:
You're slow! Hurry
up and answer! It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
别再慢吞吞地接电话了！
是我，是我啊！{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ReenaGreetText
entries.english:
You're slow! Hurry
up and answer! It's me, {STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
别再慢吞吞地接电话了！
是我，是我啊！{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ReenaBattleRematchText
entries.english:
We are going to
battle! The place shall be
{STRBUF}! Don't make me
wait! Got it?
entries.translation:
来和我对战吧！ 地点是{STRBUF}！
赶紧来！就这么说定了！

entries.label: ReenaDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Have I ever faced
a wild {STRBUF}? You need to ask? {STRBUF} I've
beaten on numerousoccasions!
entries.translation:
呃……你问我有没有与
{STRBUF}对战过？ 这还用问吗！ 我都不知道打败过多少
{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ReenaForwardText
entries.english:
Don't be too proud
just because you happened to beat
me…  It was a fluke!
entries.translation:
不过是赢我一两次而已，
你可别太得意了……你只是 侥 幸 而已！

entries.label: ReenaHangUpText
entries.english: Fine, you may go.
entries.translation: 那你要快点来哦！

entries.label: ReenaHurryText
entries.english:
What are you
doing? I told you that
the place was {STRBUF}!
Don't try to run!
entries.translation:
你在干嘛啊！
地方是{STRBUF}！可别逃掉了啊！

entries.label: ReenaLostAMonText
entries.english:
Have I ever failed
to catch a wild#MON? You need to ask? I would never fail
to catch a wild {STRBUF}…
Oh! Never mind!
entries.translation:
呃……你问我捕捉的时候，
有没有失败过？ 这还用问吗！ 我怎么可能捉不到
{STRBUF}嘛，啊……

entries.label: ReenaMonsIsAPerfectMatchText
entries.english:
Listen, dear… Do you recall my
{STRBUF}? Yes, exactly. That
lovely {STRBUF}. Wouldn't you agree
it's a perfectmatch for me?
entries.translation:
那个……
你还记不记得我的{STRBUF}啊？ 就是美丽的{STRBUF}！
它和我简直是天作之合！

entries.label: ReenaAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Not bad…
It's something to beat me, even by
an unlikely fluke… I like you! Give
me your number! You can be my
practice partner!
entries.translation:
挺能干的嘛……
虽然是 侥 幸 ，但赢了就是赢了…… 我看好你！
把电话号码告诉我吧！ 你就做我的
练习搭档吧！

entries.label: ReenaAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
Give me your phone
number! You are going to
be my practicepartner!
entries.translation:
告诉我电话号码！ 你就成为我的
练习搭档了！

entries.label: ReenaNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Don't be too proud
about beating me! It was a fluke!
entries.translation:
虽说战胜了我，
你可别得意忘形啊……那只是 侥 幸 而已！

entries.label: ReenaNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
I don't believe
it! You're goingto regret this!
entries.translation:
不敢相信！
你可不要后悔啊！

entries.label: ReenaPhoneFullText
entries.english:
What? Your phone
list has no room!
entries.translation:
什么嘛！
你已经存满号码了啊！

entries.label: ReenaRematchText
entries.english:
What took you?
Start right away!
entries.translation:
太慢了！
快点开始对战吧！

entries.label: TiffanyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF}. Oh, {PLAYER}.
Hello.
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 啊，{PLAYER}，你好。

entries.label: TiffanyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF}. Oh, {PLAYER}, good
evening.
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 啊，{PLAYER}，晚上好。

entries.label: TiffanyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF}. Oh, {PLAYER}.
Good morning.
entries.translation: 喂，我是{STRBUF}。 啊，{PLAYER}，早上好。

entries.label: TiffanyGenericText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
doing well? I hope you take
them to a #MONCENTER every day. Don't push them
too hard. My {STRBUF} is
cute and lively precisely because
I take it to a #MON CENTER
every day.

entries.label: TiffanyGreetDayText
entries.english: Is this {PLAYER}? Hi, it's {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
是{PLAYER}吗？
你好，我是{STRBUF}。

entries.label: TiffanyGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Is this {PLAYER}? Good evening. This
is {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
是{PLAYER}吗？
晚上好，我是{STRBUF}。

entries.label: TiffanyGreetText
entries.english:
Is this {PLAYER}? Good morning. This
is {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
是{PLAYER}吗？
早上好，我是{STRBUF}。

entries.label: TiffanyAsleepText
entries.english:
What's wrong?
Can't you visit? CLEFAIRY got tired
and fell asleep. I'm not sure if I
can wake it up… Please hurry to
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
怎么还没有来啊？ 我的小皮皮等不下去了，
现在都已经睡着了。对战前醒得过来吗…… 我在{STRBUF}，
快来吧，等着你呢！

entries.label: TiffanyBattleRematchText
entries.english:
I know this might
surprise you, but would you like to
battle? I'll be waiting
with CLEFAIRY on{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
可能有点唐突……
要和我对战吗？ 我和我的小皮皮一起
在{STRBUF}等你。

entries.label: TiffanyDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and we had to
battle a wild {STRBUF} a while
ago… My CLEFAIRY came
close to fainting! Isn't that awful? I hate those nasty
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
还有就是，
我之前和{STRBUF}对战了…… 我的小皮皮差点就要
陷入濒死状态了！ 它很过分吧？
我超级讨厌{STRBUF}！

entries.label: TiffanyFoundItemText
entries.english:
I bought some PINK
BOWS at GOLDENROD DEPT.STORE for my
CLEFAIRY. I got too many, so
I'll give you one! Come collect it on
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
我之前在满金百货店
买到了粉红丝带，我觉得很适合小皮皮…… 可是我好像买多了，
也分你一条吧。 我在{STRBUF}等你，
你要是愿意就来拿吧。

entries.label: TiffanyHangUpText
entries.english: Bye-bye!
entries.translation: 那就拜拜咯！

entries.label: TiffanyHurryText
entries.english:
What's wrong?
Can't you visit? I'm sure this will
look good on yourCLEFAIRY. Please hurry to
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
怎么还没有来啊？ 我觉得它一定也非常适合
你的小皮皮哦。 我在{STRBUF}，
快来吧，等着你呢！

entries.label: TiffanyItsAwfulText
entries.english:
{STRBUF}! It's awful.
My CLEFAIRY… Huh? {PLAYER}? Oh, sorry! I was
in a hurry, and I… I have to go!
Bye-bye!
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}！不得了了！
我的小皮皮……啊，{PLAYER}！？ 抱、抱歉，
我一着急就容易出错。 抱歉了，那就这样，拜拜！

entries.label: TiffanyLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh, and we had to
battle a wild {STRBUF} a while
ago… My CLEFAIRY got
frightened, so we ran away as fast
as we could! I just can't help
feeling protectiveof my CLEFAIRY.
entries.translation:
还有就是，
我之前和{STRBUF}对战了…… 我的小皮皮太害怕了，
所以我马上就跑走了！ 不知道为什么，我就是
忍不住想保护小皮皮。

entries.label: TiffanyMonIsAdorableText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
adorable, don't you think so?
I always sleep with it--it's so
fluffy and warm!

entries.label: TiffanyNoItemText
entries.english:
I love dressing up
my CLEFAIRY!
entries.translation:
我最喜欢去
打扮我的小皮皮！

entries.label: TiffanyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Hi! You like
CLEFAIRY too? They're so very
cute, aren't they? I think we can be
good friends! I want to know
your phone number! Let's talk about
CLEFAIRY!
entries.translation:
哎，你也喜欢皮皮吗？ 皮皮真是太可爱了。 我们应该很合得来吧！
愿意和我交个朋友吗？如果愿意，就把你的电话号码告诉我吧！ 一起讨论皮皮吧！

entries.label: TiffanyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I want to know
your phone number! Let's talk about
CLEFAIRY!
entries.translation:
如果愿意，就把你的
电话号码告诉我吧！ 一起讨论皮皮吧！

entries.label: TiffanyGiftText
entries.english:
You took a long
time. See this? Isn't it cute?
It's a PINK BOW.
entries.translation:
呀，你好慢啊。
你看，就是这个……可爱的粉红丝带！

entries.label: TiffanyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Isn't my CLEFAIRY
super-adorable?
entries.translation:
喂，我的小皮皮
是不是超级可爱？

entries.label: TiffanyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Aww… Oh well.
Look for me if you want to talk about
CLEFAIRY.
entries.translation:
哎，好遗憾……
等你想聊皮皮的时候再来找我吧！

entries.label: TiffanyPackFullText
entries.english:
Uh-oh. Your PACK
is crammed full.
entries.translation: 哎呀？背包放不下了！

entries.label: TiffanyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Oh? Your phone
registry is full.
entries.translation:
哎呀？你的
电话已经存满了啊？

entries.label: TiffanyRematchText
entries.english:
There you are! CLEFAIRY, I want
you to try hard!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！
小皮皮！加油吧！

entries.label: ToddAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. This must be
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 喂、我是{STRBUF}—— 你是{PLAYER}嘛！

entries.label: ToddAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. Ah, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂、我是{STRBUF}—— 啊，是{PLAYER}啊！

entries.label: ToddAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. Hey, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂、我是{STRBUF}—— 你是{PLAYER}吧！

entries.label: ToddGenericText
entries.english:
How do you raise
your #MON? I do all sorts
of things, like leaving them in
DAY-CARE and toughening them up
with items.
entries.translation:
你是用什么方式
培育宝可梦的呢？ 我要么寄放到培育屋去，
要么用道具强化它们。

entries.label: ToddGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. {PLAYER}, what are
you doing?
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，你怎么样？

entries.label: ToddGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. {PLAYER}, sorry to
call you so late.
entries.translation:
喂喂，我是{STRBUF}。 {PLAYER}，抱歉，
这么晚给你打电话……

entries.label: ToddGreetText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}. {PLAYER}, right?
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}。 是{PLAYER}吗？

entries.label: ToddBattleRematchText
entries.english:
You must be a lot
better now, huh? How about showing
me your technique in a real battle
with me? I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
你现在强了不少吧？ 那就展示一下你的身手！
我在{STRBUF}，来和我对战吧？

entries.label: ToddDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
And, you know? Now we can KO
{STRBUF} easily. I should challenge
the GOLDENROD GYM.
entries.translation:
然后啊，
它已经强到可以轻松地打倒{STRBUF}了！ 我也试着去
挑战满金道馆好了？

entries.label: ToddDepartmentStoreBargainSaleText
entries.english:
This is it--the
one we've all beenwaiting for! GOLDENROD DEPT.
STORE's bargainsale is on now! Want it cheap?
Want it lots? Don't miss this
GOLDENROD chance! Huh? I sound like
a huckster? Well, yeah. I was
mimicking them… Anyway, you've got
to get there assoon as you can!
entries.translation:
久 等 了 ！ 满金百货店
终于开始打折了！ 早买早赚，多买多赚！
机不可失，时不再来！ 啊？你说我像超市的托？ 我是在学店里的售货员啦！
别说这个了，你快去啊！

entries.label: ToddHangUpText
entries.english: See you later!
entries.translation: 那就再见咯！

entries.label: ToddHaveYouGoneToDepartmentStoreText
entries.english:
Haven't you gone
to GOLDENROD DEPT. STORE? I've scoped
it out already! They had some real
bargains. You should get
there quickly.
entries.translation:
满金百货店去了吗？
我老早就逛完了！ 现在可是多买多赚呢，
你也快点去吧！

entries.label: ToddLookingForwardToBattleText
entries.english:
Where are you? Let's have our
battle soon! I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
喂喂，你怎么了？ 快来和我对战吧！
我在{STRBUF}等着你！

entries.label: ToddLooksCuteLikeMeText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF} is
looking more and more like me. It's
getting cuter!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}啊，
变得超级可爱了，真是越来越像我啊！

entries.label: ToddLostAMonText
entries.english:
And, you know?
We just failed to beat {STRBUF} by
a tiny margin. I'm guessing my
#MON's levels aren't high enough
yet…
entries.translation:
还有啊，
之前差点就能打倒{STRBUF}了。 培育的时间还是太短了吧。

entries.label: ToddSavingUpForBargainSaleText
entries.english:
I'm saving up for
the next bargain sale. When's the
next one?
entries.translation:
为了下次的打折，
我正在努力存钱！真希望马上就是下次！

entries.label: ToddAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
From here, I can
see GOLDENROD's DEPT.STORE. They
have bargain sales up on the rooftop
every so often. Could I get your
phone number? I'll call you when
they have a sale.
entries.translation:
对了，干脆趁机去
满金百货店看看吧。 好像有的时候
顶楼会进行打折。 喂，能告诉我电话号码吗？
下次打折的时候，我就可以联系你了。

entries.label: ToddAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
If you give me
your number, I'll call you when they
have a sale.
entries.translation:
打折的时候我会通知你的，
能把你的号码告诉我吗？

entries.label: ToddNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
I check GOLDENROD
DEPT.STORE every day, so I know
when there's asale.
entries.translation:
我每天都会去
逛逛满金百货店，有打折我马上就会知道！

entries.label: ToddNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Anyway… If you're short on
money, take downmy number. I'll call you when
there's a sale.
entries.translation:
还是算了。 那等你手头紧的时候，
再来要我的号码吧。

entries.label: ToddPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone doesn't
have enough memoryfor more numbers.
entries.translation:
但，你的电话已经存满了，
没法再添加了。

entries.label: ToddRematchText
entries.english:
I waited for you!
I even cut back my shopping to raise
my #MON better!
entries.translation:
等着你呢！ 我强忍购物欲望，
就是为了这一天！

entries.label: ToddSaleText
entries.english:
Shopping under the
sky! It feels so nice
up on a rooftop.
entries.translation:
在蓝天之下购物！
屋顶真令人心情舒畅～

entries.label: TullyAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… That voice…
{PLAYER}, right?
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 这声音是{PLAYER}吧！

entries.label: TullyAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… This must be
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 哦，是{PLAYER}呢！

entries.label: TullyAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, this is
{STRBUF}… Oh, Good morning,
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 哦，早上好，{PLAYER}！

entries.label: TullyGenericText
entries.english:
How's your trip
coming along? I can't complain
about my fishing!
entries.translation: 你的旅行，一切顺利吧？ 我的垂钓太让人满意了！

entries.label: TullyGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hello!
{STRBUF} here… What a perfect day
for fishing!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 今天也很适合去垂钓！

entries.label: TullyGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Hello!
{STRBUF} here… It's a great night
for fishing!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 今晚很适合夜间垂钓！

entries.label: TullyGreetText
entries.english:
Hello!
{STRBUF} here… Good morning! The
weather's great!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 早上好，天气不错呀！

entries.label: TullyBattleRematchText
entries.english:
We should get a
battle going! I'll be fishing on
{STRBUF}. Swing by if you
have the time.
entries.translation:
我们也应该再来一场
宝可梦对战了吧！ 我在{STRBUF}垂钓，
有空就尽管来找我吧。

entries.label: TullyDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I KO'd a
wild {STRBUF}. It was huge, like
this big even. Heh, I guess you
can't tell overthe phone…
entries.translation:
说起来，我之前打倒了
{STRBUF}哦。好家伙，它大概这么大吧！ ……电话里好像说不清啊。

entries.label: TullyForwardText
entries.english:
Yup, TULLY here… {PLAYER}? What?
You're lost? Our battle will be
on {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
喂，我是禾念。啥？
{PLAYER}？你迷路了？ 说好的宝可梦对战，
约在了{STRBUF}！

entries.label: TullyFoundItemText
entries.english:
I picked up a good
little thing atthe water's edge. Like I promised,
it's yours. I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
我在水边捡到了好东西。 之前不是说好了要送你吗？
我在{STRBUF}等你。

entries.label: TullyHangUpText
entries.english:
Well, I'll be
seeing you.
entries.translation: 那就下次见。

entries.label: TullyHurryText
entries.english:
I've got something
good for you. Hustle over to
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
我有好东西要给你，
你赶紧来{STRBUF}看看吧！

entries.label: TullyLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, I lost a
wild {STRBUF}. It was huge, like
this big even. Heh, I guess you
can't tell overthe phone…
entries.translation:
说起来，我之前让
{STRBUF}逃走了……好家伙，它大概这么大吧！ ……电话里好像说不清啊。

entries.label: TullyMonHasGrownText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF} has
grown again. It was only about
so big when I caught it, but now
it's way bigger.

entries.label: TullyNoItemText
entries.english:
Have I found
anything good? Nope, not yet. It's like fishing,
you need patience.
entries.translation:
你问我有没有捡到好东西？
目前还没有。 这和垂钓是一样的道理，
耐心等待才能有成果！

entries.label: TullyAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
Hey, you're trying
to be the ultimate trainer too? Then
we're comrades! If I find any more
items by the water, I'll give
you some. Just give me your
phone number.
entries.translation:
你也想成为最强训练家？
我们的目标是一样的！那我们就是伙伴了！ 好！如果我在水边
捡到什么好东西，我也分给你吧！ 怎么样？要不要告诉我
你的电话号码呢？

entries.label: TullyAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
If I find any more
items by the water, I'll give
you some. Just give me your
phone number.
entries.translation:
在水边捡到东西的话，
我会分给你的！ 你愿不愿意告诉我
你的电话号码呢？

entries.label: TullyGiftText
entries.english:
Hey, there you
are! Here's a gift, as
promised!
entries.translation:
哦，你来了吗！ 按照约定，这个
就送给你了！

entries.label: TullyNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
You'll be hearing
from me if I findsomething good.
entries.translation:
找到好东西的话，
我会立刻打电话的！

entries.label: TullyNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Is that so? Then
I'll just have touse them myself.
entries.translation:
这样啊？那就算了，
我还是自己用吧……

entries.label: TullyPackFullText
entries.english:
Your PACK's full? Come back later--
that'll do it.
entries.translation:
行李已经放了吗……
下次再来拿吧。

entries.label: TullyPhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone list is
all filled up. Come back if you
make room for me.
entries.translation:
你的电话已经存满了，
腾出空位以后再来。

entries.label: TullyRematchText
entries.english:
I've been doing
more than just fishing since we
last met. You're in for a
big surprise!
entries.translation:
这段时间我可不只是
呆在这里钓鱼哦！ 你会吓一跳的！

entries.label: UnknownGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? My #MON are a
bit too energetic. {STRBUF},
especially. Every time it
spots a trainer,it has to battle. It gets to be a
bit much for me!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦们，
也很有精神吧？ 我的宝可梦太有精神了，
让人不知该如何是好！ 尤其是{STRBUF}，
它只要看到训练家就会向他发起挑战。 每次都要跟着倒霉！

entries.label: UnknownTougherThanEverText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
looking tougherthan ever. It looks even
tougher than me!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}
现在变得更加可靠了！ 简直比我还强！

entries.label: UnusedPhoneText
entries.english: Good morning.
entries.translation: 早上好。

entries.label: VanceAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Yes, hello?
{STRBUF} here! Hi, {PLAYER}! Are your bird
#MON flying?
entries.translation:
喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 啊，你好，{PLAYER}！
你的鸟宝可梦能飞吗？

entries.label: VanceAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Yes, hello?
{STRBUF} here! Evening, {PLAYER}!
Are you letting your bird #MON
see some action?
entries.translation:
喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 啊，晚上好，{PLAYER}！
你的鸟宝可梦很活跃吧？

entries.label: VanceAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Yes, hello?
{STRBUF} here! Morning, {PLAYER}! Are you using bird
#MON?
entries.translation:
喂喂！我是{STRBUF}！ 啊，早上好，{PLAYER}！
你也用鸟宝可梦吧？

entries.label: VanceGenericText
entries.english:
Are you and your
#MON fine? My {STRBUF}
looks like it will get tough enough
to face and beat the legendary bird
#MON!
entries.translation:
你和宝可梦都还好吧？ 我感觉我的{STRBUF}
现在已经不会输给传说的鸟宝可梦了！

entries.label: VanceGreetDayText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Remember me?
entries.translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！ 我，{STRBUF}！还记得吧！

entries.label: VanceGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Good evening,
{PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Are you free now?
entries.translation: 晚上好，{PLAYER}！ 我，{STRBUF}！你有空吗？

entries.label: VanceGreetText
entries.english:
Good morning,
{PLAYER}! It's {STRBUF}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 早上好，{PLAYER}！ 我，{STRBUF}！早上好——！

entries.label: VanceBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Right now, I'm on
{STRBUF}. You know, where I
first met you? Want to battle?
I'll wait here.
entries.translation:
现在在{STRBUF}！
就是第一次见到你的地方！ 喂，再来和我对战吧？
我会在这里等你的！

entries.label: VanceDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
We can easily beat
{STRBUF}! …Huh? You too?
Isn't that great?
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}之流，
我们能轻松搞定！ 呃……你说你也办得到？
那不挺好嘛！

entries.label: VanceHangUpText
entries.english: OK, bye for now!
entries.translation: 就这么说了！再见。

entries.label: VanceHurryHurryText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}!
Hurry, hurry! {STRBUF}!
FLY over now!

entries.label: VanceLookingForwardText
entries.english:
I'll be looking
forward to ournext battle!
entries.translation: 真期待下次和你对战啊！

entries.label: VanceLostAMonText
entries.english:
But get this, a
wild {STRBUF} just barely eluded
us. I wanted to FLY
after it…
entries.translation:
不过我之前放跑了
{STRBUF}，好可惜啊。 我都想飞过去追它了。

entries.label: VanceMonHasBecomeTougherText
entries.english:
My {STRBUF}'s
become tougher. We've achieved
liftoff!
entries.translation:
我的{STRBUF}啊，
现在变得非常强了，简直就是势不可挡！

entries.label: VanceAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
You know, you are
really strong. But I don't want
to just slink off… I know! Could I
get your number? Let's meet up for
more battles!
entries.translation:
你还真是很强啊！ 就这么输了很不甘心…… 对了！你能不能把号码
告诉我！下次再战！

entries.label: VanceAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
I want to battle
tough trainers asoften as I can! Could I get your
number? Let's meet up for
more battles!
entries.translation:
遇见强大的训练家，
就想多对战几次——！ 你能不能把号码
告诉我！下次再战！

entries.label: VanceNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
Don't forget to
come see me when Ichallenge you!
entries.translation:
以后如果接到我的电话，
一定要来找我对战哦！

entries.label: VanceNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
A bird-user friend
isn't a bad thingto have, I think… Won't you
reconsider?
entries.translation:
有个养鸟人当朋友
不是挺好的嘛…… 再考虑考虑？

entries.label: VancePackFullText
entries.english:
Oh, too bad. You
don't have room. I'll give it to
you next time!
entries.translation:
嗯，很遗憾！
你拿不动更多东西了…… 下次再来吧！

entries.label: VancePhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone's out
of memory. Deletea number for me!
entries.translation:
你的电话存满了啊，
无法再添加了！

entries.label: VanceRematchGiftText
entries.english:
You are really,
really strong! Thanks for taking
me on so often--I learned a whole
lot from you. I know! This will
do as my thanks!
entries.translation:
你真的很强啊——！ 你陪我对战这么多次，
我也学到了不少呢…… 对了！为了表示感谢，
这个就送你了！

entries.label: VanceRematchText
entries.english:
Am I happy to see
you! I won't lose!
entries.translation:
你总算来了啊！
好——！我可不会输！

entries.label: WadeAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}吗！你好！

entries.label: WadeAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. Oh, hi, {PLAYER}!
Good evening!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}吗！晚上好！

entries.label: WadeAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello? This is
{STRBUF} speaking. Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… {PLAYER}吗！早上好！

entries.label: WadeGenericText
entries.english:
How are your
#MON doing? My #MON have
too much energy to burn. It gets to
be a problem. Of all my #MON,
{STRBUF} is thehardest to handle. Working with it is
exhausting.
entries.translation:
宝可梦都还好吧？ 我的宝可梦太有精神了，
让人不知该如何是好！ 尤其是{STRBUF}，
它好像特别有精力，我每次陪它玩，都要被累个半死。

entries.label: WadeGreetDayText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, howdy! It's me, {STRBUF}.
Isn't it nice out?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，天气真好！

entries.label: WadeGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Good evening,
{PLAYER}! It's me, {STRBUF}.
Were you awake?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，晚上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，你还醒着吗？

entries.label: WadeGreetText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, good
morning! It's me, {STRBUF}.
Isn't it nice out?
entries.translation: {PLAYER}，早上好！ 我是{STRBUF}，天气真好！

entries.label: WadeAreYourMonGrowingText
entries.english:
Are your #MON
growing? My #MON are
growing a bit too quickly for me.
It's overwhelming! {STRBUF}'s grow-
ing especially quickly. I think
it'll get tough.
entries.translation:
宝可梦有成长了吗？ 我感觉我的宝可梦们
成长速度快过头了！ 尤其是{STRBUF}，
他的成长速度特别快。我觉得它现在已经很强了！

entries.label: WadeBattleRematchText
entries.english:
Do you feel like a
#MON battle? It won't be like
last time! {STRBUF}'s
where I'll be. Let me know when
you get there.
entries.translation:
来场宝可梦对战吧？
这次肯定不会像上次那样。 我在{STRBUF}，
你到了附近就来找我吧。

entries.label: WadeBugCatchingContestText
entries.english:
The Bug-Catching
Contest is at the NATIONAL PARK
today. Are you going,
{PLAYER}? I'm trying to make
up my mind.
entries.translation:
今天是自然公园
举办捕虫大赛的日子哦。{PLAYER}，你去吗？ 我还没决定去不去。

entries.label: WadeComeQuickText
entries.english:
How come you're
not here yet? {STRBUF} is
where I am. Please get here as
soon as you can!
entries.translation:
你怎么还不来？ 我在{STRBUF}，
赶紧过来吧！

entries.label: WadeDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, we KO'd a
wild {STRBUF} with one hit a
while back. It went down so
easily, I felt a little sorry for
the poor thing.
entries.translation:
还有……
我之前一击就打倒了{STRBUF}…… 赢得太过轻松，
反而觉得对方很可怜……

entries.label: WadeFoundItemText
entries.english:
I found all kinds
of BERRIES. If you want, I'll share
some with you. I'll be waiting on
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
那个，
我找到了很多树果，也分点给你吧。 我现在在{STRBUF}。

entries.label: WadeHangUpText
entries.english: See you later!
entries.translation: 那就再见了！

entries.label: WadeLostAMonText
entries.english:
Oh yeah, a wild
{STRBUF} got away from me at
the last second. I know it's a
common #MON… But it does annoy
me that it got away when I almost
had it.
entries.translation:
还有，我上次差点就
捉到{STRBUF}了，但还是让它跑了…… 虽然是很常见的宝可梦…… 但是捕捉失败
让人很不甘心啊……

entries.label: WadeNoBerriesText
entries.english:
Huh? BERRIES? Sorry, I haven't
found any yet. I'll call you if I
find any. Will youplease wait?
entries.translation:
啊，树果？ 抱歉，我还没找到。
等我找到一定会联系你，你尽管等着吧！

entries.label: WadeQuickBattleText
entries.english:
Let's battle
already! {STRBUF} is
where I am. Please get here as
soon as you can!
entries.translation:
快和我对战！ 我在{STRBUF}，
赶紧过来吧！

entries.label: WadeAskNumber1Text
entries.english:
You're awesome!
I like you! I look for #MON
here every day. When I'm in the
grass, I find allkinds of BERRIES. If you'd like,
I'll share some. Could I get your
phone number?
entries.translation:
好厉害啊，你！
嗯，我看好你！ 其实我每天都在这里
寻找宝可梦。每次钻进草丛里都会捡到各种树果…… 如果你愿意的话，
我也能分给你一些！把你的号码告诉我吧！

entries.label: WadeAskNumber2Text
entries.english:
When I'm in the
grass, I find allkinds of BERRIES. If you'd like,
I'll share some. Could I get your
phone number?
entries.translation:
每次钻进草丛里
都会捡到各种树果…… 如果你愿意的话，
我也能分给你一些！把你的号码告诉我吧！

entries.label: WadeGiftText
entries.english:
Good to see you!
See? This is what I found.
It's for you!
entries.translation:
来得正好！
看，我找到这个了…… 给你了！

entries.label: WadeNumberAcceptedText
entries.english:
You'll hear from
me as soon as I find anything that
you might like.
entries.translation:
一有发现就会给你打电话，
至于成果嘛，敬请期待！

entries.label: WadeNumberDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh well. Don't be
shy if you want toget my number.
entries.translation:
是吗，真是遗憾啊……
算了，等你想添加的时候，再来和找我吧！

entries.label: WadePackFullText
entries.english:
Oops, your PACK's
full. Too bad. You should come
back for it later.
entries.translation:
嗯，真遗憾！
你好像拿不动更多了， 下次再来吧。

entries.label: WadePhoneFullText
entries.english:
Your phone list
has no room for mynumber.
entries.translation:
喂，你的电话已存满了，
无法再继续添加了！

entries.label: WadeRematchText
entries.english:
I was waiting for
you. Let's battle!
entries.translation:
在等着你哦！
那就来对战吧！

entries.label: WiltonAnswerPhoneDayText
entries.english:
Hello, you have
reached {STRBUF}… Ah, {PLAYER}, is
it?
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，{PLAYER}呀。

entries.label: WiltonAnswerPhoneNiteText
entries.english:
Hello, you have
reached {STRBUF}… Ah, if it isn't
{PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，这不是{PLAYER}吗。

entries.label: WiltonAnswerPhoneText
entries.english:
Hello, you have
reached {STRBUF}… Ah, {PLAYER}.
entries.translation: 喂喂，我是{STRBUF}…… 啊，{PLAYER}。

entries.label: WiltonGenericText
entries.english:
Have your #MON
grown any? My {STRBUF} has
grown quite a bit.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦成长了不少吧？ 我的{STRBUF}
现在变得非常大了。

entries.label: WiltonGreetDayText
entries.english: Ah, it's {STRBUF}… Can you talk now?
entries.translation: 啊，我是{STRBUF}…… 现在可以通话吧？

entries.label: WiltonGreetNiteText
entries.english:
Ah, it's {STRBUF}… Sorry for calling
so late.
entries.translation: 啊，我是{STRBUF}…… 这么晚真不好意思。

entries.label: WiltonGreetText
entries.english:
Ah, it's {STRBUF}… Have you got a
moment?
entries.translation: 啊，我是{STRBUF}…… 你有空吧？

entries.label: WiltonBattleRematchText
entries.english:
I'm fishing on
{STRBUF}, but nothing's
biting today. Help me while my
time away, comeover for a battle.
entries.translation:
我在{STRBUF}，
现在正在垂钓，可是怎么也不上钩…… 你过来和我对战吧？
我可不是为了消遣啊。

entries.label: WiltonDefeatedMonText
entries.english:
We beat a wild
{STRBUF}… You know, I have
more fun fishing than beating wild
