是寄放在培育屋奶奶那的
{STRBUF}。

entries.label: _LeftWithDayCareManText
entries.english:
It's {STRBUF}
that was left withthe DAY-CARE MAN.
entries.translation:
是寄放在培育屋爷爷那的
{STRBUF}。

entries.label: _LuckyNumberMatchPCText
entries.english:
Congratulations! We have a match
with the ID number of {STRBUF} in
your PC BOX.
entries.translation:
恭喜恭喜！寄放在
电脑里的小{STRBUF}的 ID号码完全
一致。

entries.label: _LuckyNumberMatchPartyText
entries.english:
Congratulations! We have a match
with the ID number of {STRBUF} in
your party.
entries.translation:
恭喜恭喜！你
带着的小{STRBUF}的 ID号码完全
一致。

entries.label: _MagikarpGuruMeasureText
entries.english:
Let me measure
that MAGIKARP. …Hm, it measures
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
那么，让我来测量一下
你的鲤鱼王的尺寸吧。 …嗯，{STRBUF}厘米！

entries.label: _MailAlreadyHoldingItemText
entries.english:
It's already hold-
ing an item.
entries.translation:
已经携带了其他道具，
无法再携带邮件了。

entries.label: _MailAskSendToPCText
entries.english:
Send the removed
MAIL to your PC?
entries.translation:
要将取出的邮件
传送到电脑吗？

entries.label: _MailClearedPutAwayText
entries.english:
The cleared MAIL
was put away.
entries.translation:
将清除了内容的邮件
放进背包里了。

entries.label: _MailDetachedText
entries.english:
MAIL detached from
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
从{STRBUF}那取出了
邮件！

entries.label: _MailEggText
entries.english:
An EGG can't hold
any MAIL.
entries.translation: 无法让蛋携带！

entries.label: _MailLoseMessageText
entries.english:
The MAIL will lose
its message. OK?
entries.translation:
取出邮件的话，
信息将会消失，可以吗？

entries.label: _MailMessageLostText
entries.english:
The MAIL's message
will be lost. OK?
entries.translation:
文本即将被清除，
可以吗？

entries.label: _MailMovedFromBoxText
entries.english:
The MAIL was moved
from the MAILBOX.
entries.translation: 从盒子里移除了邮件。

entries.label: _MailNoSpaceText
entries.english:
There's no space
for removing MAIL.
entries.translation:
道具已满，
邮件无法取出！

entries.label: _MailPackFullText
entries.english: The PACK is full.
entries.translation:
背包已满，
无法收纳邮件！

entries.label: _MailSentToPCText
entries.english:
The MAIL was sent
to your PC.
entries.translation:
已将邮件
传送到电脑里。

entries.label: _MailboxFullText
entries.english:
Your PC's MAILBOX
is full.
entries.translation:
电脑的邮箱
已满！

entries.label: _MayPassWhirlpoolText
entries.english:
It's a vicious
whirlpool! A #MON may be
able to pass it.
entries.translation:
有激烈的漩涡！ ……用宝可梦的招式
或许就能穿过去吧？

entries.label: _MayRegisterItemText
entries.english:
An item in your
PACK may be registered for use
on SELECT Button.
entries.translation:
放进背包的道具
可添加在快捷键。

entries.label: _MaySmashText
entries.english:
Maybe a #MON
can break this.
entries.translation:
有块坚硬的岩石……
或许能用宝可梦招式破坏？

entries.label: _MemoryGameDarnText
entries.english: Darn…
entries.translation: 真可惜……

entries.label: _MemoryGameYeahText
entries.english: , yeah!
entries.translation: 不客气了！

entries.label: _MonNumberText
entries.english: #MON number?
entries.translation: 宝可梦号码？

entries.label: _MoveBoulderText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} can
move boulders.
entries.translation:
多亏了{STRBUF}的怪
力，现在可以推动石块了！

entries.label: _MoveNameText
entries.english: {STRBUF}
entries.translation: 使出了{STRBUF}

entries.label: _MysteryGiftCanceledText
entries.english:
The link has been
cancelled.
entries.translation: 连接已中止。

entries.english:
Communication
error.
entries.translation: 连接错误。

entries.english:
Sorry--only five
GIFTS a day.
entries.translation:
神秘礼物
1天只能接收5次！

entries.label: _MysteryGiftOneADayText
entries.english:
Sorry. One GIFT
a day per person.
entries.translation:
来自同一个人的神秘礼物
1天只能接收1次！

entries.label: _MysteryGiftSentHomeText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} sent
{STRBUF}to {STRBUF}'s home.
entries.translation:
从{STRBUF}那
送来了{STRBUF}到{STRBUF}的家！

entries.label: _MysteryGiftSentText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} sent
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
从{STRBUF}那
送来了{STRBUF}！

entries.english:
The link has been
cancelled.
entries.translation: 连接已中止。

entries.label: _NameCardLinkCommErrorText
entries.english:
Communication
error.
entries.translation: 连接错误。

{STRBUF}'s CARD was
listed as no.{NUM}.

{STRBUF}的名片

The CARD was not
registered.
entries.translation:
名片没有经过
注册。

entries.label: _NameCardReceivedCardText
entries.english:
Received
{STRBUF}'s CARD.
entries.translation:
从{STRBUF}那
收到了名片！

entries.label: _NameRaterBetterNameText
entries.english:
Hm… {STRBUF}…
That's a fairlydecent name. But, how about a
slightly betternickname? Want me to give it
a better name?
entries.translation:
唔，{STRBUF}啊……
这个昵称真是大吉大利！ ……但是呢，
我还能帮你想出 更吉利的名字哦，
怎么样？

entries.label: _NameRaterComeAgainText
entries.english:
OK, then. Come
again sometime.
entries.translation:
是吗。
好吧，下次再来。

entries.label: _NameRaterEggText
entries.english:
Whoa… That's just
an EGG.
entries.translation:
喂喂……
那只是颗蛋啊！

entries.label: _NameRaterFinishedText
entries.english:
That's a better
name than before! Well done!
entries.translation:
这个名字
可比之前那个吉利多了。

entries.label: _NameRaterHelloText
entries.english:
Hello, hello! I'm
the NAME RATER. I rate the names
of #MON. Would you like me
to rate names?
entries.translation:
你好，你好！
我是姓名鉴定师，就是占卜姓名的人。 我来给你算算宝可梦的
昵称吉利不吉利。

entries.label: _NameRaterNamedText
entries.english:
All right. This
#MON is nownamed {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
好！从现在开始，
这只宝可梦就叫{STRBUF}！

entries.label: _NameRaterPerfectNameText
entries.translation:
嗯，{STRBUF}吗？
非常棒的昵称！无可挑剔！ 以后也要好好爱护
{STRBUF}哦！

entries.label: _NameRaterSameNameText
entries.english:
It might look the
same as before, but this new name
is much better! Well done!
entries.translation:
虽然和之前的名字差不多，
但肯定是这个更吉利！太好了！

entries.label: _NameRaterWhatNameText
entries.english:
All right. What
name should wegive it, then?
entries.translation:
是吗。那么，
要决定用哪个昵称呢？

entries.label: _NameRaterWhichMonText
entries.english:
Which #MON's
nickname should Irate for you?
entries.translation:
你希望我
算哪只宝可梦的昵称？

entries.label: _NoPhotoText
entries.english:
Oh, no picture?
Come again, OK?
entries.translation:
什么……不拍了？
欢迎下次再来！

entries.label: _NoPromptText
entries.english: No
entries.translation: 没有

entries.label: _NoRoomTMHMText
entries.english:
You have no room
for any more{STRBUF}S.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}已经
拿不下了！

entries.label: _OKComeBackText
entries.english:
OK!
Come back!
entries.translation:
很好！
回来！

entries.label: _OakPCText1
entries.english:
Want to get your
#DEX rated?
entries.translation:
要获取当前的
宝可梦图鉴的评价吗？

entries.label: _OakPCText2
entries.english:
Current #DEX
completion level:
entries.translation:
现在的
宝可梦图鉴完成度为……

entries.label: _OakPCText3
entries.english:
{STRBUF} #MON seen
{STRBUF} #MON owned PROF.OAK's
Rating:
entries.translation:
发现的宝可梦：{STRBUF}种！
捉到的宝可梦：{STRBUF}种！ 大木博士的评价为……
…… …… ……

entries.label: _OakPCText4
entries.english:
The link to PROF.
OAK's PC closed.
entries.translation:
……大木博士的电脑的
连接已结束！

entries.label: _OakRating01
entries.english:
Look for #MON
in grassy areas!
entries.translation:
你应该去各地的草丛走走，
多捕捉一些宝可梦！

entries.label: _OakRating02
entries.english:
Good. I see you
understand how touse # BALLS.
entries.translation:
嗯！使用精灵球的技术
日渐娴熟了呢！

entries.label: _OakRating03
entries.english:
You're getting
good at this. But you have a
long way to go.
entries.translation:
差不多适应了吧。
但是前方的路还很长呢！

entries.label: _OakRating04
entries.english:
You need to fill
up the #DEX. Catch different
kinds of #MON!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦图鉴
还有很多地方没填满！多捕捉几种宝可梦吧！

entries.label: _OakRating05
entries.english:
You're trying--I
can see that. Your #DEX is
coming together.
entries.translation:
嗯，你很努力嘛！
宝可梦图鉴已经初具规模了！

entries.label: _OakRating06
entries.english:
To evolve, some
#MON grow, others use the
effects of STONES.
entries.translation:
有的要靠培育来进化，
有的要靠石头的影响进化，宝可梦的进化方式有很多！

entries.label: _OakRating07
entries.english:
Have you gotten a
fishing ROD? You can catch #MON
by fishing.
entries.translation:
你拿到钓竿了吗？
你可以试试到处垂钓，一定能找到更多宝可梦！

entries.label: _OakRating08
entries.english:
Excellent! You
seem to like col-lecting things!
entries.translation:
很精彩！
难道收集就是你的兴趣爱好吗？

entries.label: _OakRating09
entries.english:
Some #MON only
appear during certain times of
the day.
entries.translation:
据说有些宝可梦
只在特定的时间带活动！

entries.label: _OakRating10
entries.english:
Your #DEX is
filling up. Keepup the good work!
entries.translation:
页面不断地增加呢！
保持势头，继续加油吧！

entries.label: _OakRating11
entries.english:
I'm impressed.
You're evolving #MON, not just
catching them.
entries.translation:
哇！令人佩服！
你抓了很多宝可梦，也进化了很多宝可梦！

entries.label: _OakRating12
entries.english:
Have you met KURT?
His custom BALLSshould help.
entries.translation:
见过钢铁先生吗？
如果能得到他制作的球，想必收集也会变得更顺利！

entries.label: _OakRating13
entries.english:
Wow. You've found
more #MON than the last #DEX
research project.
entries.translation:
哦！回过神来，
已经比上次调查发现的宝可梦还要多了。

entries.label: _OakRating14
entries.english:
Are you trading
your #MON? It's tough to do
this alone!
entries.translation:
朋友进行过交换吗？
有些事一个人是办不到的。

entries.label: _OakRating15
entries.english:
Wow! You've hit
200! Your #DEXis looking great!
entries.translation:
天哪！超过200种了！
这会是一份出色的图鉴！我很期待啊！

entries.label: _OakRating16
entries.english:
You've found so
many #MON! You've really
helped my studies!
entries.translation:
发现这么多了啊……
这次的宝可梦研究全是你的功劳！

entries.label: _OakRating17
entries.english:
Magnificent! You
could become a #MON professor
right now!
entries.translation:
我都找不到词形容你了！
你有宝可梦博士的潜质！

entries.label: _OakRating18
entries.english:
Your #DEX is
amazing! You're ready to turn
professional!
entries.translation:
能把图鉴收集到这个程度，
完全可以称得上是专家！

entries.label: _OakRating19
entries.english:
Whoa! A perfect
#DEX! I've dreamt about this!
Congratulations!
entries.translation:
啊，我梦寐以求
完美的图鉴终于完成了！……衷心祝贺！

entries.label: _OakText1
entries.english:
Hello! Sorry to
keep you waiting! Welcome to the
world of #MON! My name is OAK. People call me the
#MON PROF.
entries.translation:
哎呀，久等了！ 欢迎来到
精灵宝可梦的世界！ 我叫大木， 大家都亲切地称我为
宝可梦博士。

entries.label: _OakText2
entries.english:
This world is in-
habited by crea-tures that we call#MON.
entries.translation:
精灵宝可梦，简称宝可梦。 在这个世界里，
到处都生活着一种叫做精灵宝可梦的生物！

entries.label: _OakText4
entries.english:
People and #MON
live together by supporting each
other. Some people play
with #MON, somebattle with them.
entries.translation:
人们与宝可梦愉快地玩耍，
或者一同战斗…………互帮互助，共同生活。

entries.label: _OakText5
entries.english:
But we don't know
everything about#MON yet. There are still
many mysteries tosolve. That's why I study
#MON every day.
entries.translation:
但是，我们并没有了解
宝可梦的一切。 宝可梦身上还有很多
秘密等待我们解决！ 为了弄清这些谜团，
我每天都要进行宝可梦的相关研究！

entries.label: _OakThisIsntTheTimeText
entries.english:
OAK: {PLAYER}!
This isn't thetime to use that!
entries.translation:
大木博士说过……
{PLAYER}！这种东西是要看场合来用的啊！

You can't deposit
your last #MON!

你可能会有麻烦啊？

You can't take any
more #MON.

甭想带走更多，

You gotta have

没宝可梦的家伙

寄放了

Withdrew {NUM}
{STRBUF}(S).

取出了
{NUM}个{STRBUF}。

{STRBUF}
fainted!

useable #MON! {PLAYER} whited

{PLAYER}的手上

PROF.OAK's PC

连接到大木博士的电脑！ 呼叫了

Bzzzzt! You must

{PLAYER} turned on
the PC.

{PLAYER}打开了
电脑的开关！

噢！

entries.translation:
返回最后到访过的
宝可梦中心。

entries.label: _ThatsEnoughComeBackText
entries.english:
that's
enough! Come back!
entries.translation:
好了！
回来！

entries.label: _ThrewAwayText
entries.english:
Threw away
{STRBUF}(S).
entries.translation:

现在记录的所有名片、所有密码都会消失。 名片文件夹被删除后，
将会无法复原。 要删除名片文件夹吗？

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderAskOpenOldText
entries.english:
There is an older
CARD FOLDER from aprevious journey. Do you want to
open it?
entries.translation:
之前冒险的时候
留下了一份名片文件夹。 要打开吗？

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderDeleteAreYouSureText
entries.english:
Are you sure you
want to delete it?
entries.translation:
确定要
进行删除吗？

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderDeletedText
entries.english:
The CARD FOLDER
has been deleted.
entries.translation: 名片文件夹已删除！

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderFinishRegisteringCardsText
entries.english:
Finish registering
CARDS?
entries.translation:
要结束
添加名片吗？

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro1Text
entries.english:
The CARD FOLDER
stores your and your friends'
CARDS. A CARD contains
information like the person's name,
phone number andprofile.
entries.translation:
名片文件夹
可以用来存放你以及你朋友的名片。 名片是
写着名字、电话号码或自我介绍的卡片。

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro2Text
entries.english:
This is your CARD. Once you've
entered your phone number, you can
trade CARDS withyour friends.
entries.translation:
这就是你的名片！ 输入电话号码后，
你就能与朋友们交换名片了。

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro3Text
entries.english:
If you have your
friend's CARD, you can use it to make
a call from a mobile phone on
the 2nd floor of a#MON CENTER.
entries.translation:
拥有朋友的名片后，
就能在宝可梦中心的2楼使用移动连接。可以从名片中选择您想拨出的号码。

entries.label: _MobileCardFolderIntro4Text
entries.english:
To safely store
your collection of CARDS, you must
set a PASSCODE foryour CARD FOLDER.
entries.translation:
那么，为了保护
你或朋友们的的名片，给名片文件夹制定一组密码吧。

entries.label: _MobileOnlyThreeMonMayEnterText
entries.english:
Only three #MON
may enter.
entries.translation:
能参加的宝可梦
最多不超过3只！

entries.label: _MobilePickThreeMonForBattleText
entries.english:
Pick three #MON
for battle.
entries.translation:
请选择3只
宝可梦参加！

entries.label: _MobileStadiumEntryText
entries.english:
Data for use in
the MOBILE STADIUM of the N64 #MON
STADIUM 2 can beread here. Read the data?
entries.translation:
这里可以读取
Nintendo 64 专用软件《宝可梦竞技场 金银》中的“移动竞技场”所需要使用的数据。 要读取数据吗？

entries.label: _MobileStadiumSuccessText
entries.english:
Data transfer is
complete. We hope you enjoy
MOBILE STADIUM battles in the N64
#MON STADIUM 2.
entries.translation:
数据读取完成。 期待您能体验
《宝可梦竞技场 金银》中的“移动竞技场”！

entries.label: _MobileUseTheseThreeMonText
entries.english:
{STRBUF},
{STRBUF} and{STRBUF}. Use these three?
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}、
{STRBUF}、{STRBUF}，这3只可以吗？

entries.label: _MomLostGearBookletText
entries.english:
I lost the in-
struction bookletfor the #GEAR. Come back again in
a while.
entries.translation:
啊，糟糕！
宝可装置的说明书不见了！ 你过一会儿再回来吧。

entries.label: _MoveAskForgetText
entries.english:
Which move should
be forgotten?
entries.translation:
请选择要忘
记的招式！

entries.label: _MoveCantForgetHMText
entries.english:
HM moves can't be
forgotten now.
entries.translation:
这是非常重要的招式，
无法忘记！

entries.label: _MoveForgotText
entries.english:
Poof! {STRBUF} forgot
{STRBUF}. And…
entries.translation:
空！ {STRBUF}把使用
{STRBUF}的方法忘得干干净净了！ 于是……！

entries.label: _MoveKnowsOneText
entries.english:
That #MON knows
only one move.
entries.translation:
这只宝可梦仅学习了
一个招式哟。

entries.label: _MoveMonWOMailSaveText
entries.english:
Each time you move
a #MON, datawill be saved. OK?
entries.translation:
如果使用此机能，
每次移动宝可梦的时候，都会写入记录。 可以吗？

entries.label: _NeedAtLeastThreeMonText
entries.english:
You need at least
three #MON.
entries.translation:
请带上至少3只
宝可梦！

entries.label: _NewDexDataText
entries.english:
{STRBUF}'s data
was newly added tothe #DEX.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}的资料被
添加到宝可梦图鉴里了！

entries.label: _NoCyclingText
entries.english:
Cycling isn't
allowed here.
entries.translation: 这里不能骑自行车。

entries.label: _NothingToSellText
entries.english:
You don't have
anything to sell.
entries.translation:
你明明
没带任何道具啊！

entries.label: _OakText6
entries.english:
Now, what did you
say your name was?
entries.translation:
说起来……
我也该知道你叫什么名字了吧！

entries.label: _OakText7
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, are you
ready? Your very own
#MON story isabout to unfold. You'll face fun
times and toughchallenges. A world of dreams
and adventures with #MON
awaits! Let's go! I'll be seeing you
later!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
准备好了吗？ 属于你的故事
马上就要开始了！ 或许还有很多开心或者
痛苦的事情在等着你！ 向着梦想与冒险！
向着精灵宝可梦的世界！Let's go! 我们待会儿见！

entries.label: _ObjectEventText
entries.english: Object event
entries.translation: 对象事件

entries.label: _OnlyThreeMonMayBeEnteredText
entries.english:
Only three #MON
may be entered.
entries.translation:
请选3只
宝可梦参加！

{STRBUF}'s PP
is maxed out.

entries.translation: 招式点数回复了！

entries.label: _PPsIncreasedText
entries.english:
{STRBUF}'s PP
increased.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}的
招式点数增加了！

entries.label: _PasswordAskEnterText
entries.english:
Please enter the
password.
entries.translation: 请输入密码。

entries.english: Reset the clock?
entries.translation: 要再次设置时钟吗？

entries.label: _PasswordAskResetText
entries.english:
Password OK.
Select CONTINUE &reset settings.
entries.translation:
密码正确。
请选择“继续游戏”，再次设置时钟。

entries.label: _PasswordWrongText
entries.english: Wrong password!
entries.translation: 密码错误！

entries.english:
All right.
See you around.
entries.translation:
这样吗？
那就下次再会。

entries.label: _PharmacyFinalPriceText
entries.english:
{NUM} {STRBUF}(S)
will cost ${NUM}.
entries.translation:
是{STRBUF}啊。{NUM}个
一共要{NUM}元。

entries.label: _PharmacyHowManyText
entries.english: How many?
entries.translation: 要买多少？

entries.label: _PharmacyIntroText
entries.english:
What's up? Need
some medicine?
entries.translation:
嗯？有什么事吗？
要买药吗？

entries.label: _PharmacyNoMoneyText
entries.english:
Huh? That's not
enough money.
entries.translation: 嗯？你的钱不够。

entries.label: _PharmacyPackFullText
entries.english:
You don't have any
more space.
entries.translation: 行李已满了呀。

entries.label: _PharmacyThanksText
entries.english: Thanks much!
entries.translation: 谢谢惠顾！

entries.label: _PhoneClickText
entries.english: Click!
entries.translation: 哔！

entries.label: _PhoneJustTalkToThemText
entries.english:
Just go talk to
that person!
entries.translation:
大家靠这么近，
直接面谈不是更好吗！

entries.label: _PhoneOutOfAreaText
entries.english:
That number is out
of the area.
entries.translation:
……无法连接！
好像不在服务区……

entries.label: _PhoneThankYouText
entries.english: Thank you!
entries.translation: 谢谢！

entries.label: _PhoneWrongNumberText
entries.english:
Huh? Sorry, wrong
number!
entries.translation:
哎呀？
对不起，打错了……

entries.label: _PickThreeMonForMobileBattleText
entries.english:
Pick three #MON
for battle.
entries.translation:
请选择3只
要出战的宝可梦！

entries.label: _PlayedFluteText
entries.english:
Played the #
FLUTE. Now, that's a
catchy tune!
entries.translation:
吹奏了宝可梦之笛！ 嗯——！
真是美妙的音色！

entries.label: _PleaseTryAgainTomorrowText
entries.english:
There is less than
1 min. left today! Please try again
tomorrow.
entries.translation:
今天剩余的时间
不到1分钟！ 请明天再来。

entries.label: _PocketIsFullText
entries.english:
The {STRBUF}
is full…
entries.translation:
真可惜！
{STRBUF}已满……

entries.label: _PokegearAskDeleteText
entries.english:
Delete this stored
phone number?
entries.translation: 真的要删除吗？

entries.label: _PokegearAskWhoCallText
entries.english:
Whom do you want
to call?
entries.translation:
想要
打电话给谁？

entries.label: _PokegearPressButtonText
entries.english:
Press any button
to exit.
entries.translation:
按下按键
结束宝可装置。

entries.label: _PutItemInPocketText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} put the
{STRBUF} inthe {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}将{STRBUF}
放进{STRBUF}了！

entries.english:
{PLAYER} put the
{STRBUF} inthe {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}将
{STRBUF}放进{STRBUF}了！

entries.label: _RaiseThePPOfWhichMoveText
entries.english:
Raise the PP of
which move?
entries.translation:
增加哪个招
式的点数？

entries.label: _ReceivedItemText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
{STRBUF}！

entries.label: _RepelUsedEarlierIsStillInEffectText
entries.english:
The REPEL used
earlier is stillin effect.
entries.translation:
之前使用的喷雾
效果还留着！

entries.label: _RestoreThePPOfWhichMoveText
entries.english:
Restore the PP of
which move?
entries.translation:
要回复
哪个招式？

entries.label: _SaveFileCorruptedText
entries.english:
The save file is
corrupted!
entries.translation:
记录的内容
已损坏！！

entries.label: _SavedTheGameText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} saved
the game.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
完好地写下了记录！

entries.label: _SavingDontTurnOffThePowerText
entries.english:
SAVING… DON'T TURN
OFF THE POWER.
entries.translation:
正在写入记录……
请勿切断电源。

entries.label: _SeerCantTellAThingText
entries.english:
Whaaaat? I can't
tell a thing! How could I not
know of this?
entries.translation:
竟然！
完全看不透！ 竟然有我不明白的事……

entries.label: _SeerDoNothingText
entries.english:
Fufufu! I saw that
you'd do nothing!
entries.translation:
哼哼哼，
什么也不做我照样能看穿！

entries.label: _SeerEggText
entries.english:
Hey! That's an EGG! You can't say that
you've met it yet…
entries.translation:
什么啊！ 那不是蛋吗！ 这根本就
还没有相遇啊……

entries.label: _SeerImpressedText
entries.english:
Incidentally… I'm impressed by
your dedication. It's been a long
time since I've seen a #MON as
mighty as this{STRBUF}. I'm sure that
seeing {STRBUF} in battle would
excite anyone.
entries.translation:
怎么说呢…………… 居然能培育成这个水平！
好久没见过宝可梦能像{STRBUF}一样强了。 {STRBUF}战斗时，
在周围旁观的人们也一定会跟着兴奋起来！

entries.label: _SeerMightyText
entries.english:
Incidentally… It certainly has
grown mighty! This {STRBUF}
must have come through numerous
#MON battles. It looks brimming
with confidence.

entries.label: _SeerMoreCareText
entries.english:
Incidentally… It would be wise
to raise your #MON with a
little more care.
entries.translation:
怎么说呢… 我劝你还是
多用点心思去培育宝可梦。

entries.label: _SeerMoreConfidentText
entries.english:
Incidentally… It seems to have
grown a little. {STRBUF} seems
to be becomingmore confident.
entries.translation:
怎么说呢…… 经过一些培育之后，
这只{STRBUF}好像变得更自信了。

entries.label: _SeerMuchStrengthText
entries.english:
Incidentally… {STRBUF} has
grown. It's gainedmuch strength.
entries.translation:
怎么说呢……… 这只{STRBUF}
经过良好的培育之后，力量也增强了不少。

entries.label: _SeerNameLocationText
entries.english:
Hm… I see you met
{STRBUF} here:{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
嗯……
这只{STRBUF}是在{STRBUF}遇到的！

entries.label: _SeerNoLocationText
entries.english:
What!? Incredible! I don't understand
how, but it is incredible!
You are special. I can't tell where
you met it, but itwas at level {STRBUF}. Am I good or what?
entries.translation:
这、这太厉害了！！ 不明觉厉啊！
你很了不得啊。 虽然说不出相遇地点……
但相遇时的等级是{STRBUF}！！ 我也很能了不得吧？

entries.label: _SeerSeeAllText
entries.english:
I see all.
I know all… Certainly, I know
of your #MON!
entries.translation:
我什么都能看穿…… 你的宝可梦
当然也能看穿！

entries.label: _SeerTimeLevelText
entries.english:
The time was
{STRBUF}! Its level was {STRBUF}! Am I good or what?
entries.translation:
然后……
相遇的时间是在{STRBUF}！ 当时的等级是{STRBUF}！ 怎么样，全都看穿了吧。

entries.label: _SeerTradeText
_SentTrophyHomeText
entries.english:
There was a trophy
inside! {STRBUF} sent the
trophy home.
entries.translation:
从里面出现了奖杯！
{STRBUF}将奖杯 送到了家里。

entries.label: _SlotsBetHowManyCoinsText
entries.english:
Bet how many
coins?
entries.translation:
要赌几枚
代币？

entries.english: Darn!
entries.translation: 没中。

entries.label: _SlotsLinedUpText
entries.english:
lined up!
Won {STRBUF} coins!
entries.translation:
齐了！
赢得{STRBUF}枚代币！

entries.label: _SlotsNotEnoughCoinsText
entries.english:
Not enough
coins.
entries.translation: 代币不足！

entries.label: _SlotsPlayAgainText
entries.english: Play again?
entries.translation: 要再玩1次吗？

entries.label: _SlotsRanOutOfCoinsText
entries.english:
Darn… Ran out of
coins…
entries.translation:
代币
没有了……

entries.label: _SlotsStartText
entries.english: Start!
entries.translation: 开始！

entries.label: _SpaceSpaceColonText

时
分

Stop learning
{STRBUF}?
entries.translation:
那么，要放弃学习
{STRBUF}吗？

entries.english:
Huh? {STRBUF}
stopped evolving!
entries.translation:
什么……？{STRBUF}
的变化停止了！

entries.label: _TheMonMustAllBeDifferentKindsText
entries.english:
The {STRBUF} #MON
must all bedifferent kinds.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}只宝可梦
必须全部是不同的种类！

entries.label: _TheMonMustNotHoldTheSameItemsText
entries.english:
The {STRBUF} #MON
must not hold thesame items.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}只宝可梦
携带的道具必须全部都是不同的道具！

entries.label: _TimeAskOkayText
entries.english:
,
is that OK?
entries.translation: 没错吧？

entries.label: _TimesetAskAdjustDSTText
entries.english:
Do you want to
adjust your clock for Daylight
Saving Time?
entries.translation: 要调整时钟吗？

entries.label: _TimesetAskDSTText
entries.english:
Do you want to
switch to DaylightSaving Time?
entries.translation:
那么，
要改成夏令时吗？

entries.label: _TimesetAskNotDSTText
entries.english:
Is Daylight Saving
Time over?
entries.translation:
那么，
夏令时结束了吗？

entries.label: _TimesetDSTText
entries.english:
I set the clock
forward by onehour.
entries.translation:
已经把时钟
往前调了1小时。

entries.label: _TimesetNotDSTText
entries.english:
I put the clock
back one hour.
entries.translation:
已经把时钟
往回调了1小时。

entries.label: _TryAgainUsingSameSettingsText
entries.english:
Try again using
the same settings?
entries.translation:
用现在的设置
重试一次吗？

entries.label: _WantAQuickMobileBattleText
entries.translation:
今天剩余的时间
只剩下{NUM}分钟了！ 要赶紧对战吗？

entries.label: _WantToRushThroughAMobileBattleText
entries.english:
There is only
1 min. left today! Want to rush
through a battle?
entries.translation:
今天剩余的时间
只剩下1分钟了！ 要迅速对战吗？

entries.english:
The window save
area was exceeded.
entries.translation:
窗口存放区域
溢出。

entries.english:
No windows avail-
able for popping.
entries.translation:
没有
可出栈的窗口！

entries.english:
Today's remaining
time is {NUM} min. Would you like to
battle?
entries.translation:
今天剩余的时间
还有{NUM}分钟。 要对战吗？

entries.english:
Would you like to
save the game?
entries.translation:
要保存目前为止的
冒险记录吗？

entries.english:
You can't take an
EGG!
entries.translation: 蛋是不能带的！

entries.label: BugContestPrizeNoRoomText
entries.english:
Oh? Your PACK is
full. We'll keep this
for you today, so come back when you
make room for it.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
行李好像已满呢…… 既然今天放不下了，
我们先帮你保存，整理完行李再来吧。

entries.label: CoinVendor_Buy500CoinsText
entries.english:
Thank you! Here
are 500 coins.
entries.translation:
好！感谢购买！
500枚代币，拿好！

entries.label: CoinVendor_Buy50CoinsText
entries.english:
Thank you!
Here are 50 coins.
entries.translation:
好！感谢购买！
50枚代币，拿好！

entries.label: CoinVendor_CancelText
entries.english:
No coins for you?
Come again!
entries.translation:
……不要吗！
那就下次再来吧！

entries.label: CoinVendor_CoinCaseFullText
entries.english:
Whoops! Your COIN
CASE is full.
entries.translation:
呀……！
代币盒已满！

entries.label: CoinVendor_IntroText
entries.english:
Do you need some
game coins? It costs $1000 for
50 coins. Do youwant some?
entries.translation:
需要游戏用的代币吗？ 50枚只需1000元！
要买代币吗？

entries.label: CoinVendor_NoCoinCaseText
entries.english:
Do you need game
coins? Oh, you don't have
a COIN CASE foryour coins.
entries.translation:
需要游戏用的代币吗？ 哎呀？你没有
盛放代币的代币盒啊！

entries.label: CoinVendor_NotEnoughMoneyText
entries.english:
You don't have
enough money.
entries.translation: 你的钱不够啊！

entries.label: CoinVendor_WelcomeText
entries.english:
Welcome to the
GAME CORNER.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
这里是游戏城哦！

entries.label: ContestResults_ConsolationPrizeText
entries.english:
Everyone else gets
a BERRY as a con-solation prize!
entries.translation:
作为安慰奖，
我们将会把树果发给没有获得名次的选手。

entries.label: ContestResults_DidNotWinText
entries.english:
We hope you do
better next time.
entries.translation:
下次比赛
要加把劲哦。

entries.label: ContestResults_JoinUsNextTimeText
entries.english:
Please join us for
the next Contest!
entries.translation:
下次的大赛
也要再接再厉哦。

entries.label: ContestResults_PartyFullText
entries.english:
Your party's full,
so the #MON was sent to your BOX
in BILL's PC.
entries.translation:
队伍已满，
我们会传送到盒子里。

entries.label: ContestResults_PlayerWonAPrizeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, the No.{STRBUF}
finisher, wins{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
第{STRBUF}名：{PLAYER}
奖品是{STRBUF}。

entries.label: ContestResults_ReadyToJudgeText
entries.english:
We will now judge
the #MON you'vecaught. ……
…… We have chosen the
winners! Are you ready for
this?
entries.translation:
接下来要审查
各位捉到的宝可梦！ …… …… ……
…… …… …… 发表结果——！！
锵锵——锵！！

entries.label: ContestResults_ReturnPartyText
entries.english:
We'll return the
#MON we kept for you.
Here you go!
entries.translation:
寄放的宝可梦将会
返还给您。

entries.label: DifficultBookshelfText
entries.english:
It's full of
difficult books.
entries.translation: 摆满了很复杂的书！

HOME PAGE… It hasn't been

……嗯，内容没有变。

What is this? Oh, it's an
incense burner!
entries.translation:
是佛坛……
嗯，是香火的味道……

entries.translation: 是城镇地图！

entries.english:

#MON GRAPH…
entries.translation:
陈列着宝可梦的杂志！ ……宝可梦之友
……宝可梦手册……宝可梦画报

友好商店

merchandise!

种类齐全！

entries.label: NurseAskHealText
entries.english:
We can heal your
#MON to perfecthealth. Shall we heal your
#MON?
entries.translation:
这里将会为您
回复宝可梦的体力！ 要让你的宝可梦，
休息一下吗？

entries.label: NurseDayText
entries.english:
Hello!
Welcome to our#MON CENTER.
entries.translation:
你好！
这里是宝可梦中心！

entries.label: NurseGoodbyeText

We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
欢迎
下次再来！

entries.label: NurseMornText
entries.english:
Good morning!
Welcome to our#MON CENTER.
entries.translation:
早上好！
这里是宝可梦中心！

entries.label: NurseNiteText
entries.english:
Good evening!
You're out late. Welcome to our
#MON CENTER.
entries.translation:
坚持到这么晚，辛苦了！
这里是宝可梦中心！

entries.label: NursePokerusText
entries.english:
Your #MON
appear to be infected by tiny
life forms. Your #MON are
healthy and seemto be fine. But we can't tell
you anything more at a #MON
CENTER.
entries.translation:
您交给我们的宝可梦
身上似乎附着着微小生命体。 宝可梦很健康。
虽说没有什么大碍，但是在宝可梦中心无法得知更多的情况。

entries.label: NurseReturnPokemonText
entries.english:
Thank you for
waiting. Your #MON are
fully healed.
entries.translation:
久等了！ 交给我的宝可梦
全都变得精力充沛了哦！

entries.label: NurseSeeYouAgainTextUnused
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
欢迎
下次再来！

entries.label: NurseTakePokemonText
entries.english:
OK, may I see your
#MON?
entries.translation:
那么，
就交给我吧！

entries.label: PictureBookshelfText
entries.english:
A whole collection
of #MON picturebooks!
entries.translation: 放着一整套宝可梦绘本！

entries.label: PokeComNurseDayText
entries.english:
Hello! This is the #-
MON COMMUNICATION CENTER--or the
#COM CENTER.
entries.translation:
你好！ 欢迎光临
宝可梦对话中心！

entries.label: PokeComNurseMornText
entries.english:
Good morning! This is the #-
MON COMMUNICATION CENTER--or the
#COM CENTER.
entries.translation:
早上好！ 欢迎光临
宝可梦对话中心！

entries.label: PokeComNurseNiteText
entries.english:
Good to see you
working so late. This is the #-
MON COMMUNICATION CENTER--or the
#COM CENTER.
entries.translation:
坚持到这么晚，辛苦了！ 欢迎来到
宝可梦对话中心！

entries.label: PokeComNursePokerusText
entries.english:
Your #MON
appear to be infected by tiny
life forms. Your #MON are
healthy and seemto be fine. But we can't tell
you anything more.
entries.translation:
您交给我们的宝可梦
身上似乎附着着微小生命体。 宝可梦很健康。
虽说没有什么大碍，但是我们无法得知更多的情况。

#MON CENTER
entries.translation:
回复宝可梦的体力！
宝可梦中心

entries.translation:
这里是宝可梦广播！
随时欢迎点播！

{PLAYER}
得到了{STRBUF}！

entries.label: RegisteredNumber2Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} registered
{STRBUF}'s number.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}添加了
{STRBUF}的电话号码！

entries.label: RockSmashTextUnused
entries.english:
Maybe a #MON
can break this.
entries.translation:
这块岩石好像很坚硬……
或许可以用招式推动？

entries.label: StrengthTextUnused
entries.english:
A #MON may be
able to move this.
entries.translation:
有块大石头……
或许可以用招式推动？

entries.label: TVText
entries.english: It's a TV.
entries.translation: 有台电视！

entries.label: TeamRocketOathText
entries.english:
TEAM ROCKET OATH Steal #MON for
profit! Exploit #MON
for profit! All #MON exist
for the glory ofTEAM ROCKET!
entries.translation:
火箭队心得： 抢夺宝可梦，发财不是梦！
使唤宝可梦，实现发财梦！ 所有宝可梦都是
为了火箭队而生！

entries.label: TrashCanText
entries.english:
There's nothing in
here…
entries.translation: 里面是空的……

entries.label: WindowText
entries.english:
My reflection!
Lookin' good!
entries.translation:
窗户玻璃闪闪发亮！
里面映出了自己的脸！

entries.label: UnusedGotSweetHoneyText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
SWEET HONEY.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}获得了
甜甜蜜。

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyAfterText1
entries.english:
My little brother
takes SWEET HONEY and goes somewhere
with it. I wonder what he's
up to?
entries.translation:
我弟弟只要得到甜甜蜜，
就会往外面跑，每天都是这样？ 他到底是去干什么了？

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyAfterText2
entries.english:
Did you put SWEET
HONEY on a tree? What happened to
it?
entries.translation:
你在树上涂过甜甜蜜吗？
涂了以后会怎么样呢？

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyAfterText3
entries.english:
Did you put SWEET
HONEY on a tree? It takes about a
day for #MON tobe drawn to it.
entries.translation:
你在树上涂过甜甜蜜吗？
只要再过一天左右，就能用香气吸引到宝可梦。

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyBagFullText
entries.english:
I want to give you
some SWEET HONEY, but you have no
room for it.
entries.translation:
啊，
我是很想给你甜甜蜜，但是你已经拿不下了。

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyButterfreeText
entries.english: BUTTERFREE: Freeh!
entries.translation: 巴大蝶：大蝶！

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyGiveText
entries.english:
Here you go! Have
some SWEET HONEY!
entries.translation:
好的！
请好好收下甜甜蜜哦！

entries.label: UnusedSweetHoneyText
entries.english:
My #MON is an
expert at collect-ing SWEET HONEY. I'll share some
with you.
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
非常擅长收集甜甜蜜。 你要是愿意，
我也给你一些吧。

entries.label: AzaleaGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo, challenger! BUGSY's young, but
his knowledge of bug #MON is for
real. It's going to be
tough without myadvice. Let's see… Bug
#MON don't likefire. Flying-type moves
are super-effec-tive too.
entries.translation:
嗨，
挑战者！ 虽然阿笔年纪不大，
但是虫宝可梦的相关知识不会输给大人！ 没有提示，心里没底吧？
好嘞，那就交给我吧！ 没错！
虫宝可梦讨厌火！ 飞行属性的招式
也是效果绝佳！

entries.label: AzaleaGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Well done! That
was a great clash of talented young
trainers. With people like
you, the future of#MON is bright!
entries.translation:
太厉害了吧！
年轻训练家之间的激烈对战…… 宝可梦世界的未来
充满光明！

entries.label: BugCatcherAlAfterBattleText
entries.english:
They're so cool,
but most girls don't like bug
#MON. I don't know why…
entries.translation:
明明长得这么酷，
怎么会有这么多女孩子讨厌虫宝可梦啊，真是莫名其妙。

entries.label: BugCatcherAlBeatenText
entries.english:
You proved how
tough you are…
entries.translation: 反而是我明白了你有多强！

entries.label: BugCatcherAlSeenText
entries.english:
Bug #MON are
cool and tough! I'll prove it to
you!
entries.translation:
我要让你知道
帅气又强大的虫宝可梦到底有多迷人！

entries.label: BugCatcherBennyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
#MON become
stronger if theyevolve. Really!
entries.translation:
宝可梦进化以后
是真的会变强哦！

entries.label: BugCatcherBennyBeatenText
entries.english:
Just evolving
isn't enough!
entries.translation: 只是进化还不行吗……

entries.label: BugCatcherBennySeenText
entries.english:
Bug #MON evolve
young. So they get stronger that much
faster.
entries.translation:
虫宝可梦进化得特别快！
知道吗？这就意味着它们变强的速度会更快！

entries.label: BugCatcherJoshAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I guess I should
teach them bettermoves…
entries.translation:
不学点更强的招式
就赢不了呢……

entries.label: BugCatcherJoshBeatenText
entries.english: Urrgggh!
entries.translation: 呜呜呜……

entries.label: BugCatcherJoshSeenText
entries.english:
You saved all the
SLOWPOKE? Whew,you're mighty! But my grown-up
#MON are prettytough too!
entries.translation:
你说你拯救了呆呆兽？
那可真有你的。 不过我培养的宝可梦
也很强哦！

entries.label: BugsyText_BugMonsAreDeep
entries.english:
Bug #MON are
deep. There are many mysteries to
be explored. Study your favor-
ites thoroughly.
entries.translation:
虫宝可梦非常深奥，
仍然还有很多东西需要不断地进行研究。 你也试着钻研钻研
自己喜欢的宝可梦吧？

entries.label: BugsyText_FuryCutterSpeech
entries.english:
TM49 contains
FURY CUTTER. If you don't miss,
it gets strongerevery turn. The longer your
battle goes, thebetter it gets. Isn't that great?
I discovered it!
entries.translation:
招式学习器49里面
含有“连斩”哦！ 只要没有打偏，
威力就会变得越来越大！ 战斗拖得越久，
形势就会越有利！ 怎么样，很厉害吧！？
这可是我的发现哦！

entries.label: BugsyText_HiveBadgeSpeech
entries.english:
Do you know the
benefits of HIVE-BADGE? If you have it,
#MON up to L30 will obey you,
even traded ones. #MON that know
CUT will be able to use it outside
of battle too. Here, I also want
you to have this.
entries.translation:
你知道昆虫徽章的
特殊效果吗？ 只要带上昆虫徽章，
就算是别人送的宝可梦，只要等级在30以内都会乖乖听话哦！ 还有，学会了居合斩的
宝可梦也可以在对战外使用那个招式了哦！ 另外，这个也拿去吧！

entries.label: BugsyText_INeverLose
entries.english:
I'm BUGSY!
I never lose when it comes to bug
#MON. My research is
going to make me the authority on
bug #MON! Let me demonstrate
what I've learnedfrom my studies.
entries.translation:
我是阿笔！
虫宝可梦的相关知识，我不会输给任何人！ 毕竟我将来打算
靠虫宝可梦的研究去成为伟大的博士！ 所以，我就让你见识见识
我的研究成果吧。

entries.label: BugsyText_ResearchIncomplete
entries.english:
Whoa, amazing!
You're an experton #MON! My research isn't
complete yet. OK, you win. Take
this BADGE.
entries.translation:
哇，好强！
你很懂宝可梦啊！ 啊啊——
我的研究还差得远呢！ 嗯！我知道了。
这个徽章拿去吧！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedHiveBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
HIVEBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿笔那里
得到了昆虫徽章！

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
AMY: You're
really strong!
entries.translation: 久美：好强——好厉害——

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay1BeatenText
entries.english:
AMY & MAY: Oh,
double goodness!
entries.translation: 久美和留美：哎哟哟——

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay1SeenText
entries.english:
AMY: Hi! Are you
challenging theLEADER? No way!
entries.translation:
久美：哎！
你是来挑战馆主的吗？那种事情别想别想——

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
MAY: Our bug #-
MON lost! Oh, whata shame.
entries.translation:
留美：虫宝可梦输掉了，
好难过啊——

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay2BeatenText
entries.english:
AMY & MAY: Oh,
double goodness!
entries.translation: 久美和留美：哎哟哟——

entries.label: TwinsAmyandmay2SeenText
entries.english:
MAY: You want to
see the LEADER?We come first!
entries.translation:
留美：哎！你是来
挑战馆主的吗？那就赶快开战吧——

entries.label: AzaleaMartBugCatcherText
entries.english:
A GREAT BALL is
better for catch-ing #MON than a# BALL. But KURT's might
be better some-times.
entries.translation:
使用超级球的话，
会比精灵球更容易捕捉到宝可梦。 但是在一些特殊情况下，
钢铁先生的球才是首选哦。

entries.label: AzaleaMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
There's no GREAT
BALL here. # BALLS will have
to do. I wish KURT would
make me some ofhis custom BALLS.
entries.translation:
呃……没有超级球吗，
只能用精灵球将就了。 真想使用
钢铁先生制作的球哪。

entries.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FFishingGuruText
entries.english:
BILL's PC can
store up to 20#MON per BOX.
entries.translation:
使用正辉的电脑，
1个盒子最多可以寄放20只宝可梦哦。

entries.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
Do your #MON
know HM moves? Those moves can
be used even if your #MON has
fainted.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦有没有学会
被称为秘传的招式吗？ 当宝可梦处于濒死状态，
虽然没有精力出战，但是秘传招式还是能用的。

entries.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FPokefanFText
entries.english:
Do you know about
APRICORNS? Crack one open,
hollow it out and fit it with a
special device. Then you can catch
#MON with it. Before # BALLS
were invented, everyone used
APRICORNS.
entries.translation:
你知道球果吗？ 割开球状树果，
去掉里面的果肉，再装进特殊的装置中。 接着就可以拿来
捕捉宝可梦了！ 在精灵球问世之前，
人们一直是都用球果来捕捉宝可梦的哦。

entries.label: AzaleaPokecenter1FUnusedText
entries.english:
This BILL guy
created the system for storing
#MON in a PC. BILL's PC can
store up to 20#MON per BOX.
entries.translation:
将捕捉到的宝可梦
寄放进电脑的系统好像是叫正辉的人创建的。 使用正辉的电脑，
1个盒子最多可以寄放20只宝可梦哦。

entries.label: AzaleaGymSignText
entries.english:
AZALEA TOWN
#MON GYMLEADER: BUGSY The Walking
Bug #MONEncyclopedia
entries.translation:
桧皮镇宝可梦道馆
馆主：阿笔会走路的虫宝可梦大百科

entries.label: AzaleaTownGrampsTextAfter
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE have
returned. Knowing them, they
could've just been goofing off some-
where.
entries.translation:
呆呆兽都回来了。
嗯，毕竟是悠哉的呆呆兽，之前肯定是到哪悠哉去了。

entries.label: AzaleaTownGrampsTextBefore
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE have
disappeared fromtown… I heard their
TAILS are beingsold somewhere.
entries.translation:
镇子里的呆呆兽不见了…… 我好像听说某些地方
正在出售呆呆兽的尾巴……

entries.label: AzaleaTownIlexForestSignText
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST Enter through the
gate.
entries.translation: 穿过门口就是栎树林。

entries.label: AzaleaTownKurtText1
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST is
restless! What is going on?
entries.translation:
栎树林里还挺吵闹的！
发生什么了！

entries.label: AzaleaTownKurtText2
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, here's
your GS BALL back!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
我要把GS球还给你！

entries.label: AzaleaTownKurtText3
entries.english:
Could you go see
why ILEX FOREST isso restless?
entries.translation:
你能帮忙去查查
栎树林吵闹的原因吗？

entries.label: AzaleaTownRivalAfterText
entries.english:
I hate the weak. #MON, trainers.
It doesn't matterwho or what. I'm going to be
strong and wipeout the weak. That goes for TEAM
ROCKET too. They act big and
tough in a group. But get them
alone, and they'reweak. I hate them all. You stay out of my
way. A weakling like you is only a
distraction.
entries.translation:
…… 弱小的家伙
真是太讨厌了。 宝可梦也好，
训练家也罢…… 那些弱小的家伙，
我要全部击溃。所以我才想变强…… 火箭队也是一样。 明明一个比一个没用，
还凑在一起嚣张得要死。我绝对不会放过他们。 …… 你不要来妨碍我，
看到弱者在旁边晃荡，真的非常不舒服呢。

entries.label: AzaleaTownRivalBeforeText
entries.english:
…Tell me some-
thing. Is it true that
TEAM ROCKET hasreturned? What? You beat
them? Hah! Quitlying. You're not joking?
Then let's see howgood you are.
entries.translation:
…… 我有话要问你。 …… 我听说火箭队复活了，
这是真的吗？ 什么，你打败了他们？
别胡扯了。 …… 居然是真的？
那就让我看看你的实力吧！

entries.label: AzaleaTownRivalLossText
entries.english:
…Humph! I knew
you were lying.
entries.translation:
…… 哼！
我就知道你在胡扯。

entries.label: AzaleaTownRivalWinText
entries.english:
… Humph! Useless
#MON! Listen, you. You
only won because my #MON were
weak.
entries.translation:
…… 哼！
这些宝可梦真没用。 …… 你要清楚，你能赢
是因为我的宝可梦太弱了。

entries.label: AzaleaTownRocket1Text
entries.english:
It's unsafe to go
in there, so I'mstanding guard. Aren't I a good
Samaritan?
entries.translation:
这里面很危险，
所以我站在这里看着，以免有人误闯进来。 切，莫非我是个好人？

entries.label: AzaleaTownRocket2Text
entries.english:
Do you know about
SLOWPOKETAIL? Iheard it's tasty! Aren't you glad I
told you that?
entries.translation:
你知道呆呆兽的尾巴吗？
有传闻说那东西超好吃哦。 我怎么连这种好事都讲了，
切，莫非我是个好人？

entries.label: AzaleaTownSignText
entries.english:
AZALEA TOWN
Where People and #MON Live in
Happy Harmony
entries.translation:
这里是桧皮镇。
宝可梦与人和谐共生的小镇。

entries.label: AzaleaTownSlowpokeText1
entries.english: SLOWPOKE: … …… …… ……

entries.label: AzaleaTownSlowpokeText2
entries.english: …… ……Yawn?

entries.label: AzaleaTownTeacherText
entries.english:
Did you come to
get KURT to makesome BALLS? A lot of people do
just that.
entries.translation:
你也是来找钢铁先生
制作精灵球的吗？好多人都是这样。

entries.label: AzaleaTownYoungsterText
entries.english:
Cut through AZALEA
and you'll be inILEX FOREST. But these skinny
trees make it impossible to get
through. The CHARCOAL MAN's
#MON can CUTdown trees.
entries.translation:
穿过桧皮的城镇后
就是栎树林。 但是，途中有小树挡路，
难以继续前进。 木炭工匠的宝可梦
应该学会了能砍树的招式。

entries.label: CharcoalKilnSignText
entries.english: CHARCOAL KILN
entries.translation: 这里是木炭工匠的家。

entries.label: KurtsHouseSignText
entries.english: KURT'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 这里是钢铁先生的家

entries.label: SlowpokeWellSignText
entries.english:
SLOWPOKE WELL Also known as the
RAINMAKER WELL. Locals believe
that a SLOWPOKE'syawn summons rain. Records show that
a SLOWPOKE's yawn ended a drought
400 years ago.
entries.translation:
呆呆兽之井
别名：求雨之井 这个地区的人们相信，
每当呆呆兽打哈欠时，天上就会下雨。 实际上在400年前，
因为呆呆兽的哈欠，帮人们解决了一场大旱灾。这件事写进了当时的记录。

entries.label: WoosterText
entries.english: WOOSTER: Gugyoo…
entries.translation: 水鱼： ……咕啾

entries.label: Text_AMonLevelExceeds
entries.english:
One or more of
your #MON'slevels exceeds {NUM}.
entries.translation:
您的同行宝可梦之中
有等级超过{NUM}的宝可梦。

entries.label: Text_AskRegisterRecord_Mobile
entries.english:
Would you like to
register your record with the
CENTER?
entries.translation:
要将本次成绩
登录至中心吗？

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerBugCatcher
entries.english:
I'm trying to see
how far I can go using just bug
#MON. Don't let there be
any fire #MON…
entries.translation:
我想试试看
只用虫宝可梦能撑多久！ 千万别碰到火宝可梦啊！

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerCooltrainerF
entries.english:
There are lots of
BATTLE ROOMS, but I'm going to win
them all!
entries.translation:
管它有多少对战房间，
我要全部获胜！

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerGranny
entries.english:
It's a grueling
task, not being able to use items
in battle. Making your
#MON hold items is the key to
winning battles.
entries.translation:
在战斗中
禁止使用道具，这个规矩也太严格了…… 所以携带的道具
就成了胜负的关键！

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_1
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER is a
facility made for#MON battles. Countless #MON
trainers gather from all over to
hold battles in specially designed
BATTLE ROOMS. There are many
BATTLE ROOMS inthe BATTLE TOWER. Each ROOM holds
seven trainers. If you defeat the
seven in a ROOM, and you have a
good record, you could become the
ROOM's LEADER. All LEADERS will
be recorded in the HONOR ROLL for
posterity. You may challenge
in up to five BATTLE ROOMS each
day. However, you may
battle only once a day in any given
ROOM. To interrupt a
session, you must SAVE. If not, you
won't be able to resume your ROOM
challenge.
entries.translation:
对战塔是用来进行
宝可梦对战的设施。 来自全国的许多宝可梦
训练家都聚集于此。 他们将会在专门用于
对战的对战房间展开战斗。 对战塔内准备了很多
这样的对战房间。 每个对战房间里
都有7名训练家， 完全战胜7名训练家
并取得好成绩的人，将会成为房间首领。 我们会记录新关主的名字，
并记录在历代关主一览中。 1天总共能挑战5次，
而同一个房间，1天仅能挑战1次。 另外，请注意：
如果挑战中途想要退出，必须先写入记录，否则将会无法继续挑战。

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_2
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER is a
facility made for#MON battles. Countless #MON
trainers gather from all over to
hold battles in specially designed
BATTLE ROOMS. There are many
BATTLE ROOMS inthe BATTLE TOWER. Each ROOM holds
seven trainers. Beat them all, and
win a prize. To interrupt a
session, you must SAVE. If not, you
won't be able to resume your ROOM
challenge.
entries.translation:
对战塔是用来进行
宝可梦对战的设施。 来自全国的许多宝可梦
训练家都聚集于此。 他们将会在专门用于
对战的对战房间展开战斗。 对战塔内准备了很多
这样的对战房间。 每个对战房间里
都有7位训练家， 完全战胜7位训练家之后，
我们将会送上精美奖品。 另外，请注意：
如果挑战中途想要退出，必须先写入记录，否则将会无法继续挑战。

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerRules
entries.english:
Three #MON may
enter battles. All three must be
different. The items they
hold must also bedifferent. Certain #MON
may also have level restrictions
placed on them.
entries.translation:
最多有3只宝可梦能参加。
其中不能出现相同宝可梦。 每只宝可梦携带的道具中
也不能出现相同物品。 某些宝可梦参加之后，
可能会出现等级限制。

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerWelcomesYou
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER
welcomes you! I could show you
to a BATTLE ROOM.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临对战塔！ 接下来我将带您
前往对战房间。

entries.label: Text_BattleTowerYoungster
entries.english:
Destroyed by the
first opponent in no time at all…
I'm no good…
entries.translation:
居然被第一个对手
瞬间击败……不行啊，我……

entries.label: Text_BattleTower_LeftWithoutSaving
entries.english:
Excuse me!
You didn't SAVE before exiting
the BATTLE ROOM. I'm awfully sorry,
but your challenge will be declared
invalid.
entries.translation:
这位客人！ 上一次结束时
并没有完好地写下记录。 我们要很遗憾地通知您：
您的挑战将被视为无效。

entries.label: Text_BeatenAllTheTrainers_Mobile
entries.english:
Congratulations! You've beaten all
the trainers! Your feat may be
worth registering, {PLAYER}. With your
results, you may be chosen as a
ROOM LEADER.
entries.translation:
恭喜你！
顺利战胜了关主！ 由于{PLAYER}
战胜了关主， 成绩登录之后，将有机会
成为对战房间的新关主！

entries.label: Text_CancelYourBattleRoomChallenge
entries.english:
Cancel your BATTLE
ROOM challenge?
entries.translation:
您要取消
挑战对战房间吗？

entries.label: Text_CantBeRegistered
entries.english:
Your record from
the previous BATTLE ROOM can't
be registered. OK?
entries.translation:
上次在对战房间中的
挑战成绩无法登录至中心，这样也可以吗？

entries.label: Text_CantBeRegistered_PreviousRecordDeleted
entries.english:
Your record from
the previous BATTLE ROOM can't
be registered. Also, the existing
record will bedeleted. OK?
entries.translation:
上次在对战房间中的
挑战成绩无法登录至中心。 现有的成绩也将被删除，
这样也可以吗？

entries.label: Text_CheckTheLeaderHonorRoll
entries.english:
Check the LEADER
HONOR ROLL?
entries.translation:
这是历代关主一览，
要观看吗？

entries.label: Text_CongratulationsYouveBeatenAllTheTrainers
entries.english:
Congratulations! You've beaten all
the trainers! For that, you get
this great prize!
entries.translation:
恭喜你！
顺利战胜了关主！ 由于您战胜了关主，
我们将会送给你奖品！

entries.label: Text_FiveDayBattleLimit_Mobile
entries.english:
You may enter only
five BATTLE ROOMS
each day. Please come back
tomorrow.
entries.translation:
对战房间每天
最多只能挑战5次！ 请等到明天之后再过来。

entries.label: Text_MayNotEnterABattleRoomUnderL70
entries.english:
{STRBUF} may not
enter a BATTLEROOM under L70. This BATTLE ROOM
is for L{NUM}.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}最少也要
参加等级70的对战房间。本房间限制等级{NUM}。

entries.label: Text_NextUpOpponentNo
entries.english:
Next up, opponent
no.{STRBUF}. Ready?
entries.translation:
接下来是第{STRBUF}个对手，
准备好了吗？

entries.label: Text_PlayerGotFive
entries.english:
{PLAYER} got five
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
5个{STRBUF}！

entries.label: Text_PleaseConfirmOnThisMonitor
entries.english:
Please confirm on
this monitor.
entries.translation:
请您确认
这个显示器上的画面。

entries.label: Text_PleaseStepThisWay
entries.english:
Please step this
way.
entries.translation: 请来这边。

entries.label: Text_ReadBattleTowerRules
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER rules
are written here. Read the rules?
entries.translation:
写着对战塔的规则，
要读一下规则吗？

entries.label: Text_ReceivedAListOfLeadersOnTheHonorRoll
entries.english:
Received a list of
LEADERS on theHONOR ROLL.
entries.translation:
接收到了
历代关主一览。

entries.label: Text_RegisterRecordOnFile_Mobile
entries.english:
We have your
previous record on file. Would you
like to registerit at the CENTER?
entries.translation:
这位客人，
我们这有您上次的成绩。 要将成绩
登录至中心吗？

entries.label: Text_RegisterRecordTimedOut_Mobile
entries.english:
Sorry, but it's
not possible to register your most
recent record at the CENTER because
too much time has elapsed since the
start of yourchallenge.
entries.translation:
这位客人，非常抱歉！
由于挑战开始之后 经过的时间太长，
您上一次的挑战成绩无法登录至中心！

entries.label: Text_RightThisWayToYourBattleRoom
entries.english:
Right this way to
your BATTLE ROOM.
entries.translation:
那么，我将带您
前往对战房间。

entries.label: Text_SaveAndEndTheSession
entries.english:
SAVE and end the
session?
entries.translation:
写入记录并结束，
可以吗？

entries.label: Text_SaveBeforeConnecting_Mobile
entries.english:
Your session will
be SAVED before connecting with
the CENTER.
entries.translation:
在联系中心之前
将会写入记录。

entries.label: Text_SaveBeforeEnteringBattleRoom
entries.english:
Before entering
the BATTLE ROOM, your progress will
be saved.
entries.translation:
在挑战对战塔之前，
将会写入记录。

entries.label: Text_SaveBeforeReentry
entries.english:
Your record will
be SAVED before you go back into
the previous ROOM.
entries.translation:
挑战上一个房间之前
将会写入记录。

entries.label: Text_ThankYou
entries.english: Thank you!
entries.translation: 您辛苦了！

entries.label: Text_ThanksForVisiting
entries.english:
Thanks for
visiting!
entries.translation: 辛苦您了！

entries.label: Text_TooMuchTimeElapsedNoRegister
entries.english:
Sorry, but it's
not possible to register your
current record at the CENTER because
too much time has elapsed since the
start of yourchallenge.
entries.translation:
这位客人，非常抱歉！
由于挑战开始之后 经过的时间太长，
您刚刚的挑战成绩无法登录至中心！

entries.label: Text_WantToGoIntoABattleRoom
entries.english:
Want to go into a
BATTLE ROOM?
entries.translation:
要挑战
对战房间吗？

entries.label: Text_WeHopeToServeYouAgain
entries.english:
We hope to serve
you again.
entries.translation:
我们衷心
期待您下次光临。

entries.label: Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
entries.translation:
好了，让你久等了。
那么我将带您去对战房间。

entries.label: Text_WouldYouLikeToHearAboutTheBattleTower
entries.english:
Would you like to
hear about theBATTLE TOWER?
entries.translation:
需要听一下
对战塔的说明吗？

entries.label: Text_YourMonWillBeHealedToFullHealth
entries.english:
Your #MON will
be healed to fullhealth.
entries.translation:
我来为您
回复宝可梦的体力。

entries.label: Text_YourPackIsStuffedFull
entries.english:
Oops, your PACK is
stuffed full. Please make room
and come back.
entries.translation:
……哎呀，道具满了呢。
请先整理一下道具，之后再过来吧。

entries.label: Text_YourRegistrationIsComplete
entries.english:
Your registration
is complete. Please come again!
entries.translation:
登录完成，
期待您下次光临。

entries.label: Text_ReturnedAfterSave_Mobile
entries.english:
You'll be returned
after you SAVE.
entries.translation: 保存后再回来吧。

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText
entries.english:
You can use only
three #MON. It's so hard to
decide which three should go into
battle…
entries.translation:
最多只能使用
三只宝可梦。选谁参加对战非常重要哦！嗯，我要好好想想……

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText_NotYetOpen
entries.english:
What on earth do
they do here? If the name says
anything, I guess it must be for
#MON battles.
entries.translation:
这里是干什么的啊？ 既然叫做对战塔，
那这里肯定会进行很多宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideSailorText
entries.english:
Hehehe, I snuck
out from work. I can't bail out
until I've won! I have to win it
all. That I must!
entries.translation:
哎嘿嘿，
我还是翘掉工作溜到这里来了。 在我战胜全员之前，
决不能放弃！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideSailorText_Mobile
entries.english:
Ehehehe…
I sneaked out ofwork to come here. I'm never giving
up until I becomea LEADER!
entries.translation:
哎嘿嘿，
我还是翘掉工作溜到这里来了。 在我成为关主之前，
决不能放弃！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideSignText
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER Take the Ultimate
Trainer Challenge!
entries.translation:
这里是对战塔
目标是最强训练家！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideSignText_NotYetOpen
entries.english: BATTLE TOWER
entries.translation: 这里是对战塔

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideText_DoorsClosed
entries.english:
The BATTLE TOWER's
doors are closed…
entries.translation:
对战塔的入口
紧闭着……

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideText_DoorsOpen
entries.english: It's open!
entries.translation: 开门了！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText
entries.english:
Wow, the BATTLE
TOWER is huge! There must be many
kinds of #MONin there!
entries.translation:
对战塔太大了吧！ 这里一定有
很多宝可梦！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText_Mobile
entries.english:
Wow, the BATTLE
TOWER is huge! Since there are a
whole bunch of trainers inside,
there must also be a wide variety of
#MON.
entries.translation:
对战塔太大了吧！ 里面有很多训练家
在不停地进行对战。也就是说，这里也聚集了各种各样的宝可梦吧！

entries.label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText_NotYetOpen
entries.english:
Wow, the BATTLE
TOWER is huge! My neck is tired from
looking up at it.
entries.translation:
对战塔太大了吧！
看了这么久，脖子都酸了！

entries.label: BillsBrotherText
entries.english:
My grandpa is at 
my brother BILL'son CERULEAN CAPE.
entries.translation:
我爷爷
去小正辉在华蓝海角的那个房子里玩了。

entries.label: BillsBrothersHouseYoungsterText
entries.english:
I saw these weird,
slow #MON onCYCLING ROAD.
entries.translation:
我之前在自行车道
看见了一种奇怪的宝可梦慢悠悠地走来走去！

entries.label: BillEeveeMayEvolveText
entries.english:
BILL: PROF.ELM
claims EEVEE may evolve in new and
unknown ways.
entries.translation:
正辉：伊布身上发现了
新的进化可能性，空木博士之前好像发表过。

entries.label: BillImCountingOnYouText
entries.english:
BILL: I knew you'd
come through! Way to go! You're
the real deal! OK, I'm counting
on you. Take good care of
it!
entries.translation:
正辉：您瞧瞧您，
哎呀……可真仗义，不愧是干大事儿的！ 那就仰仗您了，
要好好疼爱它哦！

entries.label: BillNoEeveeText
entries.english:
Oh… Now what to
do?
entries.translation: 这样啊……

entries.label: BillPartyFullText
entries.english:
Whoa, wait. You
can't carry anymore #MON.
entries.translation:
这可不行啊，
不能带更多的宝可梦了。

entries.label: BillPopWontWorkText
entries.english:
BILL: My pop, he
won't work. All he does is goof off
all day long. He's getting to be
a real headache…
entries.translation:
正辉：我爸不爱工作，
整天游手好闲，真让人没辙。

entries.label: BillTakeThisEeveeText
entries.english:
BILL: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Do us a favor andtake this EEVEE. It came over when
I was adjustingthe TIME CAPSULE. Someone has to
take care of it, but I don't like
being outside. Can I count on you
to play with it,{PLAYER}?
entries.translation:
正辉：哎哟，{PLAYER}，
正好有事儿想拜托您，我刚取出来一只伊布。 这小家伙儿是我调整
时光胶囊的时候别人突然送来的。 必须得有人照料它才行，
偏偏我又爱在家闷着，{PLAYER}，您带它玩儿吧。

entries.label: BillsMomText_AfterEcruteak
entries.english:
My husband was
once known as a #MANIAC.
BILL must have taken after his
father.
entries.translation:
我老公以前被人叫做
宝可梦狂热迷，正辉还真像他老爸呢……

entries.label: BillsMomText_BeforeEcruteak
entries.english:
Oh, you collect
#MON? My sonBILL is an expert. He just got called
to the #MON CENTER in ECRUTEAK
CITY. My husband went
off to the GAME CORNER without
being called…
entries.translation:
哎呀，你在收集宝可梦啊。
我的儿子也很懂宝可梦哦。 他叫做正辉，
现在在缘朱市的宝可梦中心有点事情。 我老公去了游戏城，
虽然没人叫他去……

entries.label: BillsSisterPhoneFullText
entries.english:
You can't record
any more numbers.
entries.translation:
啊！
不能再添加更多号码了。

entries.label: BillsSisterRefusedNumberText
entries.english:
My brother made
the PC #MONstorage system. I was going to
give you BILL'snumber…
entries.translation:
在电脑里
寄放宝可梦的系统就是由我哥哥制作出来的哦。 我本来想把
正辉哥哥的电话号码告诉你的……

entries.label: BillsSisterStorageSystemText
entries.english:
My big brother
BILL made the PC #MON storage
system.
entries.translation:
在电脑里
寄放宝可梦的系统就是由正辉哥哥制作出来的哦。

entries.label: BillsSisterUsefulNumberText
entries.english:
Are you a trainer? I've got a useful
phone number foryou.
entries.translation:
你是宝可梦训练家？ 那我告诉你一个
很棒的电话号码吧？

entries.label: ReceivedEeveeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
EEVEE!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}获得了
伊布！

entries.label: RecordedBillsNumberText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} recorded
BILL's number.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}添加了
正辉的电话号码！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaAskToSeeMonText
entries.english:
If you have that
#MON, may I seeit, please?
entries.translation:
您要是带了那只宝可梦，
请一定让我看看……

entries.label: BillsGrandpaComeAgainText
entries.english:
Come visit again
sometime.
entries.translation: 下次再来玩。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaExcitedToSeeText
entries.english:
You will show me?
How good of you!
entries.translation:
哦哦，要给我看吗！
太谢谢了！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaGrowlitheText
entries.english:
BILL told me about
a #MON that is very loyal to its
trainer. It's supposed to
ROAR well.
entries.translation:
正辉跟我说过：
有一种宝可梦擅长吼叫，对初始训练家十分忠诚。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaIntroText
entries.english:
Hm? You know BILL?
He's my grandson. He's in JOHTO. He
does something with PCs, so I'm
house-sitting.
entries.translation:
哦？
您认识正辉吗？那可是我亲孙子！ 他在城都
研究那个……电脑来着。就让我来看家了！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaLickitungText
entries.english:
My grandson BILL
told me about a #MON that has a
long tongue.
entries.translation:
我孙子正辉提到过：
有这样一种宝可梦，它总是用长舌头舔东西。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaOddishText
entries.english:
Ah, my grandson
mentioned a round, green #MON that
has leaves growingon its head.
entries.translation:
对了，我孙子说过：
有这样一种宝可梦，身子圆圆的，头上还长了绿色的叶子。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaPichuText
entries.english:
Do you know that
hugely popular#MON? The #MON that
has a yellow bodyand red cheeks. I would love to
see what it looks like before it
evolves.
entries.translation:
不是有一种宝可梦
特别受欢迎吗？ 哎呀！就是那个黄身体，
红脸颊的宝可梦呀！ 我就特别想看看
它进化之前的样子！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaShownAllThePokemonText
entries.english:
Thanks for showing
me so many cute#MON. I really enjoyed
myself. I'm glad I've lived such a
long life.
entries.translation:
您让我见识了很多
可爱的宝可梦呢。太谢谢了！ 我真是太开心了！
很庆幸自己活了这么久！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaShownPokemonText
entries.english:
Ah, so that is
{STRBUF}? Isn't it cute!
That's so kind ofyou.
entries.translation:
哦哦，这就是{STRBUF}呀！
真是可爱的宝可梦！ 感谢您特意带来给我看。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaStaryuText
entries.english:
Do you know of a
sea #MON that has a red sphere
in its body? You know, the one
that's shaped likea star? I heard that it
appears at night. I would surely
like to see it.
entries.translation:
好像有这样的海生宝可梦：
身上有红珠子，身体是星形的。 一到夜晚就会出现。
我真想亲眼看看它！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaTokenOfAppreciationText
entries.english:
Thanks! This is a token of
my appreciation.
entries.translation: 太谢谢了！ 这个就给你当谢礼吧！

entries.label: BillsGrandpaVulpixText
entries.english:
I heard about a
cute #MON thathas six tails. I would love to
hug a cute #MONlike that.
entries.translation:
听说有种可爱的宝可梦
长了6根尾巴。 我也好想抱抱
这样的宝可梦啊——。

entries.label: BillsGrandpaWrongPokemonText
entries.english:
Hm? That's not the
#MON that I wastold about.
entries.translation:
嗯…… 这好像不是我
说的那只宝可梦吧……

entries.label: BillsGrandpaYouDontHaveItTextText
entries.english:
You don't have it?
That's too bad…
entries.translation:
您没带吗？
真遗憾哪……

entries.label: BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead
entries.english:
Arooo! Voices in
my head! Huh? I'm listening
to my radio!
entries.translation:
哇——
信号很强烈啊！ 嗯？
我在听广播呢！

entries.label: BlackBeltText_WeirdRadio
entries.english:
My radio's busted?
Lately, I only getthis weird signal.
entries.translation:
我的收音机坏了吗？
最近怎么只能听见奇怪的节目啊？

entries.label: BlackthornCitySignText
entries.english:
BLACKTHORN CITY A Quiet Mountain
Retreat
entries.translation:
这里是烟墨市。
坐落在山间的静谧城市。

entries.label: BlackthornCityTrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS A #MON holding
a MIRACLEBERRY will cure itself
of any statusproblem.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 如果携带了奇迹果，
不论什么特殊状态都能恢复！

entries.label: BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text
entries.english:
Are you going to
make your #MONforget some moves?
entries.translation:
哎呀，你也想
让宝可梦忘记招式吗？

entries.label: BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text
entries.english:
Wow, you came
through the ICEPATH? You must be a real
hotshot trainer!
entries.translation:
哎！
你居然穿过了冰雪小径！ 想必你一定是
实力非凡的训练家吧！！

entries.label: BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText
entries.english:
If CLAIR allows
it, her grand-father--our MASTER--will also. You may enter.
entries.translation:
要是您得到了
小椿大人的许可， 身为她爷爷的长老大人
一定也会许可您的。 那就请进吧。

entries.label: BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText
entries.english:
No. Only chosen
trainers may train here.
Please leave.
entries.translation:
只有被选中的训练家
才允许在这里修行。您请回吧。

entries.label: BlackthornGymSignText
entries.english:
BLACKTHORN CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: CLAIR The Blessed User
of Dragon #MON
entries.translation:
烟墨市宝可梦道馆
馆主：小椿神圣的龙宝可梦使者！

entries.label: BlackthornYoungsterText
entries.english:
Dragon masters all
come from the cityof BLACKTHORN.
entries.translation:
被称为龙使者的
宝可梦训练家全都来自烟墨市哦。

entries.label: DragonDensSignText
entries.english:
DRAGON'S DEN
AHEAD
entries.translation: 前方是龙穴

entries.label: MeetSantosText
entries.english:
SANTOS: … It's Saturday… I'm SANTOS of
Saturday…
entries.translation: 星祺六：…… …… …… 我是星期六的星祺六……

entries.label: MoveDeletersHouseSignText
entries.english:
MOVE DELETER'S
HOUSE
entries.translation: 啥都能忘记？爷爷的家

entries.label: SantosGaveGiftText
entries.english:
SANTOS: … SPELL TAG… Ghost-type moves
get stronger… It will frighten
you…
entries.translation:
星祺六：…… …… …… 诅咒之符…… 幽灵属性招式会变强，
强到吓你一跳……

entries.label: SantosGivesGiftText
entries.english: You can have this…
entries.translation: 这个给你……

entries.label: SantosNotSaturdayText
entries.english:
SANTOS: Today's
not Saturday…
entries.translation:
星祺六：今天
不是星期六啊………… …… …… …… ……

entries.label: SantosSaturdayText
entries.english:
SANTOS: … See you again on
another Saturday… I won't have any
more gifts…
entries.translation:
星祺六：…… …… …… 到了下个星期六
再见吧…… 不过到时候没东西给你……

entries.label: Text_ClairIsBeaten
entries.english:
You defeated
CLAIR? That's amazing! I've never heard
of her losing to anyone other than
LANCE.
entries.translation:
你居然战胜了小椿吗！
太厉害了吧…… 居然输给了阿渡之外的人，
这还是第一次看到！

entries.label: Text_ClairIsIn
entries.english:
CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, is waitingfor you. However, it would
be impossible for a run-of-the-mill
trainer to win.
entries.translation:
道馆馆主小椿大人
正在等着你呢。 不过一般水准的训练家
是不可能赢过她的。

entries.label: Text_ClairIsOut
entries.english:
I am sorry. CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, entered the DRAGON'S DEN
behind the GYM. I have no idea
when our LEADERwill return.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉。 道馆馆主小椿大人
去了道馆后面的龙穴办点事情。 不知道什么时候回来……

entries.label: BlackthornDragonSpeechHouseDratiniText
entries.english: DRATINI: Draa!
entries.translation: 迷你龙：龙——

entries.label: BlackthornDragonSpeechHouseGrannyText
entries.english:
A clan of trainers
who can freely command dragons
live right here inBLACKTHORN. As a result, there
are many legends about dragons in
this town.
entries.translation:
有一个族群
可以自由地操纵龙，他们就住在烟墨市。 可能就是因为这个，
这里流传着很多与龙相关的传说。

entries.label: BlackthornGymClairText_BagFull
entries.english:
What is this? You
don't have room?
entries.translation:
真是的！
你应该好好整理才对啊！

entries.label: BlackthornGymClairText_DescribeTM24
entries.english:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH. No, it doesn't
have anything todo with my breath. If you don't want
it, you don't haveto take it.
entries.translation:
这里面是——
龙息。 ……不是那个最辣辣椒！
如果你不需要，我也不会强迫你的。

entries.label: BlackthornGymClairText_League
entries.english:
What's the matter? Aren't you headed
to the #MONLEAGUE? Don't you know
where it is? From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN. Then SURF east.
The route there isvery tough. Don't you dare
lose at the #-MON LEAGUE! If you do, I'll
feel even worse about having lost
to you! Give it every-
thing you've got.
entries.translation:
你愣着干什么？
该去宝可梦联盟了吧？ 知道该往哪走吗？ 如果从这里出发……
那就先去若叶镇吧！ 然后就用冲浪
一直朝着东方前进，就能到达宝可梦联盟了。但是，这段路可不平坦。 还有啊……
我不许你输给宝可梦联盟！ 要不然，
我这个手下败将情何以堪！ ……加油啊！

entries.label: BlackthornGymClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting
entries.english:
You've kept me
waiting! Here! Take this!
entries.translation:
太慢了！
赶紧拿完走人！

entries.label: BlackthornGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! It's been a long
journey, but we are almost done!
Count on me! CLAIR uses the
mythical and sac-red dragon-type#MON. You can't damage
them very easily. But you know,
they're supposed to be weak against
ice-type moves.
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！ 你终于来到这里了。
只差一点了！我会为你提供帮助的！ 小椿用宝可梦是
传说中的生物——神圣的龙宝可梦！ 太慢太柔弱的攻击
是无法伤到它们的！ ……不过，
我听说它们害怕冰属性的招式！

entries.label: BlackthornGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
You were great to
beat CLAIR! All that's left is
the #MON LEAGUEchallenge. You're on the way
to becoming the#MON CHAMPION!
entries.translation:
居然战胜了小椿，
你真了不得！ 接下来是挑战宝可梦联盟！
目标是宝可梦冠军！对吧？

entries.label: BlackthornGymText_ReceivedTM24
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM24.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小椿那里
得到了招式学习器24！

entries.label: ClairIntroText
entries.english:
I am CLAIR. The world's best
dragon master. I can hold my own
against even the #MON LEAGUE's
ELITE FOUR. Do you still want
to take me on? …Fine.
Let's do it! As a GYM LEADER,
I will use my full power against any
opponent!
entries.translation:
我叫小椿！ 是世界第一
龙使者。 即使是面对
联盟里的四天王，凭我的实力也不会输！既然如此，你还要挑战吗？ ……好吧，我明白了。
那就开始吧！ 作为训练家，
我会全力应战的！

entries.label: ClairText_GoToDragonsDen
entries.english:
I won't admit
this. I may have lost,
but you're still not ready for the
#MON LEAGUE. I know. You should
take the dragonuser challenge. Behind this GYM is
a place calledDRAGON'S DEN. There is a small
shrine at its center.
Go there. If you can prove
that you've lost your lazy ideals,
I will recognize you as a trainer
worthy of a GYMBADGE!
entries.translation:
我不承认。 虽然输家说这种话不合适，
可是以你现在的心态根本就没有资格挑战宝可梦联盟。 ……对了！ 在这个宝可梦道馆后面
有一个洞穴，人们称之为龙穴。 龙穴中心处有个祠堂，
你去那里吧。 如果你能在那里
改掉现在天真的想法， 那我就承认你是
配得上道馆徽章的训练家！

entries.label: ClairText_TooMuchToExpect
entries.english:
What's the matter? Is it too much to
expect of you?
entries.translation: 怎么？ 你果然办不到吧？

entries.label: ClairWinText
entries.english:
I lost? I don't believe
it. There must besome mistake…
entries.translation:
我居然输了…… 不敢相信！
一定是哪里弄错了……

entries.label: CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Dragons are weak
against dragon-type moves.
entries.translation:
没错，龙应付不了
龙属性的招式。

entries.label: CooltrainerfLolaBeatenText
entries.english: Way to go!
entries.translation: 还挺有两下的！

entries.label: CooltrainerfLolaSeenText
entries.english:
Dragons are sacred
#MON. They are full of
life energy. If you're not
serious, you won't be able to beat
them.
entries.translation:
龙是神圣的生物，
是充满生命力的宝可梦。不要想随便获胜！

entries.label: CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I know my short-
comings now. Thanks for showing
me!
entries.translation:
我体会到了自己的不成熟。
这也是多亏了你，非常感谢！

entries.label: CooltrainermMikeBeatenText
entries.english: That's odd.
entries.translation: 不对劲啊。

entries.label: CooltrainermMikeSeenText
entries.english:
My chance of
losing? Not evenone percent!
entries.translation:
我输给你的可能性
连百分之一都没有！

entries.label: CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText
entries.english:
LANCE told you
that he'd like to see you again?
Not a chance!
entries.translation:
哎！阿渡大人
居然和你说“再会”？这……这不可能啊！

entries.label: CooltrainermPaulBeatenText
entries.english:
My dragon #MON
lost?
entries.translation: 我的龙居然会输！

entries.label: CooltrainermPaulSeenText
entries.english:
Your first battle
against dragons? I'll show you how
tough they are!
entries.translation:
让你好好感受第一个
与你交战的龙使者有多强！

entries.label: BlackthornGym2FBoulderFellText
entries.english:
The boulder fell
through!
entries.translation: 石块掉下去了！

entries.label: CooltrainerfFranAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Uh-oh… CLAIR is
going to be mad…
entries.translation:
怎么办啊，
要挨小椿大人批评了……

entries.label: CooltrainerfFranBeatenText
entries.english: Awww… I lost…
entries.translation: 嗷……我输了！

entries.label: CooltrainerfFranSeenText
entries.english:
I can't allow a
nameless trainerpast me! CLAIR would be
livid if I did!
entries.translation:
我怎么可能
放你这种无名之辈过去！要不然…… 小椿大人会生气的！

entries.label: CooltrainermCodyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Members of our
dragon-user clan can use dragon
#MON only after our MASTER allows
it.
entries.translation:
我们龙使者一族
获得长老大人的许可之后，才可以使用龙属性的宝可梦。

entries.label: CooltrainermCodyBeatenText
entries.english:
Rats! If only I
had a dragon!
entries.translation: 可恶！要是我有龙就好了！

entries.label: CooltrainermCodySeenText
entries.english:
It's not as if we
all use dragon-type #MON.
entries.translation:
并不是道馆里的所有人
都用龙属性宝可梦！

entries.label: BlackthornMartBlackBeltText
entries.english:
MAX REPEL keeps
weak #MON awayfrom you. It's the longest
lasting of theREPEL sprays.
entries.translation:
黄金喷雾可以
驱逐弱小的宝可梦。 在各种喷雾之中，
黄金喷雾的效果最持久！

entries.label: BlackthornMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
You can't buy MAX
REVIVE, but it fully restores a
fainted #MON. Beware--it won't
restore PP, the POWER POINTS
needed for moves.
entries.translation:
使用活力块之后，
濒死的宝可梦就会复活。不过友好商店里没得卖！ 另外，你要注意：
它并不能回复招式点数！

entries.label: BlackthornPokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
Deep inside far-
off INDIGO PLATEAU is the #MON
LEAGUE. I hear the best
trainers gather there from around
the country.
entries.translation:
据说宝可梦联盟在
遥远的石英高原的深处。 全国各地优秀的训练家
都会聚集在那里。

entries.label: BlackthornPokecenter1FTwinText
entries.english:
There was this
move I just had to teach my #-
MON. So I got the MOVE
DELETER to make itforget an HM move.
entries.translation:
我非常想让宝可梦
学会一个新招式，于是就拜托遗忘爷爷让宝可梦忘了秘传招式！

entries.label: DaisyAllDoneText
entries.english:
DAISY: There you
go! All done. See? Doesn't it
look nice? It's such a cute
#MON.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：好了！
现在清爽多了！ 哦呵呵，
真是可爱的宝可梦呀！

entries.label: DaisyAlreadyGroomedText
entries.english:
DAISY: I always
have tea around this time. Come
join me.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：我每天
都会在这个点喝茶哦。欢迎下次再来！

entries.label: DaisyAlrightText
entries.english:
DAISY: OK, I'll
get it lookingnice in no time.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：那么，
我要开始梳毛了！

entries.label: DaisyCantGroomEggText
entries.english:
DAISY: Oh, sorry.
I honestly can'tgroom an EGG.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：哦呵呵！
我没法给蛋梳毛呀。

entries.label: DaisyHelloText
entries.english:
DAISY: Hi! My kid
brother is the GYM LEADER in VIRIDIAN
CITY. But he goes out
of town so often, it causes problems
for the trainers.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：我弟弟是
常青市的道馆馆主。 但是他常常不在道馆，
好像给大家添了不少麻烦。

entries.label: DaisyOfferGroomingText
entries.english:
DAISY: Hi! Good
timing. I'm aboutto have some tea. Would you like to
join me? Oh, your #MON
are a bit dirty. Would you like me
to groom one?
entries.translation:
奈奈美：欢迎光临。
你来得正好呀！现在正是喝茶时间。 哎呀？你的宝可梦
好像有点脏啊！我来给它们梳毛吧？

entries.label: DaisyRefusedText
entries.english:
DAISY: You don't
want to have one groomed? OK, we'll
just have tea.
entries.translation:
奈奈美：不要梳毛吗？
那还是喝茶吧。

entries.label: DaisyWhichMonText
entries.english:
DAISY: Which one
should I groom?
entries.translation: 奈奈美：要选哪只宝可梦？

entries.label: GroomedMonLooksContentText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} looks
content.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}
好像非常享受！

entries.label: BrunoScript_BrunoBeatenText
entries.english:
Why? How could we
lose?
entries.translation:
这是怎么了！
……我们竟然输了！

entries.label: BrunoScript_BrunoBeforeText
entries.english:
I am BRUNO of the
ELITE FOUR. I always train to
the extreme be-cause I believe inour potential. That is how we
became strong. Can you withstand
our power? Hm? I see no fear
in you. You look determined. Per-
fect for battle! Ready, {PLAYER}?
You will bow down to our overwhelm-
ing power! Hoo hah!
entries.translation:
我是四天王希巴！ 我相信潜藏在
我们体内的可能性，所以在不断地追求极限。 你有自信能战胜
如此强大的我们吗？ 哦，你那毫无惧色的
表情非常不错。这才是战斗时该有的姿态。 你叫{PLAYER}吧？
来吧！看看你能不能承受住我们的神力！ 哼——！哈——！

entries.label: BrunoScript_BrunoDefeatText
entries.english:
Having lost, I
have no right tosay anything… Go face your next
challenge!
entries.translation:
败军之将，
何以言勇！向下一个房间前进吧！

entries.label: BurnedTower1FEusineIntroText
entries.english:
EUSINE: My name's
EUSINE. I'm on the trail
of a #MON namedSUICUNE. And you are…? {PLAYER}? Glad to
meet you! I heard rumors
that SUICUNE is in this BURNED TOWER,
so I came to look. But where exactly
could it be?
entries.translation:
水京：我叫做水京，
为了找到叫水君的宝可梦，正在进行旅行。 你是……？ {PLAYER}吗，你好啊！ 我听别人说
水君在烧焦塔出现，所以马上赶过来了…… 它到底藏在哪里呢……？

entries.label: BurnedTower1FEusineText
entries.english:
EUSINE: I heard
that SUICUNE is in this BURNED TOWER,
so I came to look. But where exactly
could it be?
entries.translation:
水京：我听别人说
水君在烧焦塔出现，所以马上赶过来了…… 它到底藏在哪里呢……？

entries.label: BurnedTower1FMortyText
entries.english:
MORTY: ECRUTEAK's
GYM LEADER has to study what are
said to be the legendary #MON
--SUICUNE, ENTEIand RAIKOU. EUSINE is here, so
I've decided to investigate the
TOWER with him.
entries.translation:
松叶：作为缘朱道馆馆主，
我必须好好研究 被称为传说的宝可梦的
水君、炎帝、雷公的各种相关知识。 既然水京兄也在，
我觉得我们可以一起调查这座塔。

entries.label: BurnedTowerRival_AfterText1
entries.english:
…Aw, whatever. You would never be
able to catch a legendary #MON
anyway.
entries.translation:
……切，算了。 反正你这样的人
根本就不可能捉到传说的宝可梦！

entries.label: BurnedTowerRival_AfterText2
entries.english:
Humph! What are you doing
falling into a hole? Some genius
you are! Serves you right!
entries.translation:
哼！ 还真找个洞钻进去了，
丢人现眼！ 真是活该！

entries.label: BurnedTowerRival_BeforeText
entries.english:
…… …… …… …Oh, it's you. I came looking for
some legendary #MON that they
say roosts here. But there's
nothing here! Nothing after all
the trouble of coming to this
dump? No way! It's all your
fault!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… ……怎么又是你。 据说传说的宝可梦
在这个地方休眠，所以就想来找找看。但是连根毛也没看到！ 难得本大爷愿意
大驾光临这种破地方，居然被耍了！ 这全都是你的错！

entries.label: BurnedTowerRival_LossText
entries.english:
…Humph! This is why I hate
battling wimps. It's just a waste
of my time.
entries.translation:
……哼！ 所以我才讨厌
和废物进行对战！根本就是浪费时间！

entries.label: BurnedTowerRival_WinText
entries.english:
…Humph! This is why I hate
battling wimps. There's no
challenge in it.
entries.translation:
……哼！ 所以我才讨厌
和废物进行对战！一不小心就玩过头了。

entries.label: BurnedTowerB1FEusineText
entries.english:
EUSINE: I dug a
hole here, too… I was shocked! SUICUNE raced by
like a blur, right in front of my
eyes! For ten years I
chased SUICUNE, and I finally got
to see it. I'm all choked up! {PLAYER}, I owe
this all to you! Thank you! I heard that the
legendary #MON of ECRUTEAK test
chosen humans by allowing them to
get close. I'm going to track
SUICUNE. {PLAYER}, let's
meet again! Farewell!
entries.translation:
水京：我挖了个洞
跟着你下来了……… 我的天呐！ 水君以惊人的气势
跑到我面前了！ 我寻访水君有10年了，
今天总算见到一面！ 真是百感交集！ 这也多亏了{PLAYER}，
谢谢你！ 有消息说：
缘朱市传说中的宝可梦会靠近自己认可的训练家， 并且会向他发起考验！ 我要去追赶水君了。 那么就告辞了！
{PLAYER}，下次再见！

entries.label: ChefText_Eatathon
entries.english:
Hi! We're holding an
eatathon contest. We can't serve you
right now. Sorry.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！ 很不巧，
本店正在举行大胃王比赛！真是抱歉！

entries.label: EatathonContestPosterText
entries.english:
Eatathon Contest!
No time limit! A battle without
end! The biggest muncher gets it
all for free!
entries.translation:
大胃王大赛！
无限的时间！无尽的战斗！第一名不收任何餐费！

entries.label: Fisher1Text_Concentration
entries.english:
Don't talk to me! You'll break my
concentration!
entries.translation:
别和我说话啊！
我无法集中啊！

entries.label: Fisher1Text_Snarfle
entries.english: …Snarfle, chew…
entries.translation: 我嚼我嚼……！

entries.label: Fisher2Text_GulpChew
entries.english: …Gulp… Chew…
entries.translation: 我吃我吃……！

entries.label: Fisher2Text_Quantity
entries.english:
I take quantity
over quality! I'm happy when I'm
full!
entries.translation:
饭好不好吃不重要！
只要分量管饱就满足了！

entries.label: Fisher3Text_GoldenrodIsBest
entries.english:
The food is good
here, but GOLDEN-ROD has the bestfood anywhere.
entries.translation:
这里味道很不错，
但还是满金的食物更胜一筹！

entries.label: Fisher3Text_MunchMunch
entries.english: Munch, munch…
entries.translation: 我吞我吞……！

entries.label: FoundLeftoversText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} found
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}找到了
{STRBUF}！

entries.label: NoRoomForLeftoversText
entries.english:
But {PLAYER} can't
hold another item…
entries.translation:
但是，{PLAYER}
已经带不走更多道具！

entries.label: TeacherText_CrunchCrunch
entries.english: Crunch… Crunch…
entries.translation: 我咽我咽……！

entries.label: TeacherText_KeepEating
entries.english: Crunch… Crunch… I can keep eating!
entries.translation: 我咽我咽……！ 我还能继续吃！

entries.label: TeacherText_MoreChef
entries.english: More, CHEF!
entries.translation: 再来一碗！老板！

entries.label: TeacherText_NoCoinCase
entries.english:
Nobody here will
give you a COIN CASE. You should
look in JOHTO.
entries.translation:
这家店里以前
有人专门送代币盒，想找他，就去城都吧。

entries.label: CeladonCityDeptStoreSignText
entries.english:
Find What You
Need at CELADONDEPT.STORE!
entries.translation:
必能邂逅您梦寐以求的商品
玉虹百货公司

entries.label: CeladonCityFisherText
entries.english:
This POLIWRATH is
my partner. I wonder if it'll
ever evolve into afrog #MON.
entries.translation:
这只蚊香泳士
就是我的搭档！ 这家伙总有一天
也会变成蛙宝可梦吧？

entries.label: CeladonCityGameCornerSignText
entries.english:
The Playground for
Everybody--CELADONGAME CORNER
entries.translation:
大人和小孩的休闲乐园
玉虹游戏城

entries.label: CeladonCityGramps1Text
entries.english:
GRIMER have been
appearing lately. See that pond out
in front of the house? GRIMER live
there now. Where did they
come from? This isa serious problem…
entries.translation:
最近出现了
很多臭泥。 你看，我家门前的池子里
也出现臭泥了！ 它们到底是从哪来的啊？
真伤脑筋……

entries.label: CeladonCityGramps2Text
entries.english:
Nihihi! This GYM
is great! Only girls are allowed
here!
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿！
这个道馆好的很哇！道馆里头美女多哇！

entries.label: CeladonCityLassText
entries.english:
Looking at the
ground while I was walking made me
dizzy.
entries.translation:
……我一边走，
一边看路上的花纹，眼睛都看花了！

entries.label: CeladonCityLassText_Mobile
entries.english:
I love being
surrounded by tallbuildings! Isn't it true that
GOLDENROD #MON CENTER was made
much, much bigger? That is so neat!
I wish we had a place like that in
KANTO…
entries.translation:
我就特别喜欢
到处都是大房子的城市！ 满金市的宝可梦中心
现在是不是变得超级大了？ 真好啊，真希望
关都也有这样的地方。

entries.label: CeladonCityMansionSignText
entries.english: CELADON MANSION
entries.translation: 玉虹大厦

entries.label: CeladonCityPoliwrathText
entries.english: POLIWRATH: Croak!
entries.translation: 蚊香泳士：呱～呱呱～～！

entries.label: CeladonCitySignText
entries.english:
CELADON CITY The City of
Rainbow Dreams
entries.translation:
这里是玉虹市。
玉虹即是梦幻的彩虹之色。

entries.label: CeladonCityTeacher1Text
entries.english:
I lost at the slot
machines again… We girls also play
the slots now. You should check
them out too.
entries.translation:
啊！
玩老虎机又输了！ 最近连女孩子都
沉迷于老虎机哦！你也去玩玩看吧？

entries.label: CeladonCityTeacher2Text
entries.english:
CELADON DEPT.STORE
has the biggest and best selection
of merchandise. If you can't get
it there, you can't get it any-
where. Gee… I sound like
a sales clerk.
entries.translation:
玉虹百货公司商品齐全，
是最好的百货公司！你想要的东西应有尽有！ ……我怎么
变得跟推销员似的！

entries.label: CeladonCityTrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS GUARD SPEC.
protects #MON against SPECIAL
attacks such asfire and water. Get your items at
CELADON DEPT.STORE!
entries.translation:
……有用的公告牌！ 在战斗中使用能力防守
可以保护我方宝可梦， 防止其受到火、水、电等
特殊攻击的影响！ 购买道具，
请认准玉虹百货公司！

entries.label: CeladonCityYoungster1Text
entries.english:
Want to know a
secret? CELADON MANSION
has a hidden backdoor.
entries.translation:
我告诉你一个秘密！ 玉虹大厦里面
其实有一个秘密后门！

entries.label: CeladonCityYoungster2Text
entries.english:
They're holding an
eating contest atthe restaurant. Just watching them
go at it makes mefeel bloated…
entries.translation:
那边那个食堂
正在举行大胃王比赛……光是看着就饱了……！

entries.label: CeladonGymSignText
entries.english:
CELADON CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: ERIKA The Nature-Loving
Princess
entries.translation:
玉虹市宝可梦道馆
馆主：莉佳热爱自然的大小姐！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore1FDirectoryText
entries.english:
1F: SERVICE
COUNTER 2F: TRAINER'S
MARKET 3F: TM SHOP 4F: WISEMAN GIFTS 5F: DRUG STORE 6F: ROOFTOP
SQUARE
entries.translation:
1楼 …… 服务柜台
2楼 …… 训练家专卖店3楼 …… 招式学习器专卖4楼 …… 聪明人礼品店5楼 …… 药品店6楼 …… 休息广场

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
This DEPT.STORE is
part of the same chain as the one
in GOLDENROD CITY. They were both
renovated at thesame time.
entries.translation:
这家百货公司
好像和姐妹公司——满金百货店一起进行过改装哦。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore1FReceptionistText
entries.english:
Hello! Welcome to
CELADON DEPT.STORE! The directory is
on the wall.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
玉虹百货公司！ 各楼层指南
请参看右边的指示牌。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore1FTeacherText
entries.english:
This is my first
time here. It's so big… I'm afraid I'll
get lost.
entries.translation:
我还是第一次来……
这里真是太大了，我都晕了！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore2FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Top Grade Items
for Trainers! 2F: TRAINER'S
MARKET
entries.translation:
训练家必备物品应有尽有！
2楼 …… 训练家专卖店

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore2FPokefanMText
entries.english:
I just recently
became a trainer. My son encouraged
me to do it. I'm impressed by
the selection ofconvenient items.
entries.translation:
我都这把年纪了，
还是被儿子带着成为了训练家…… 我还收集了一大堆
方便的道具哦。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore2FYoungsterText
entries.english:
My dad's having a
hard time learning the names of items
