and how they are supposed to be
used…
entries.translation:
我爸这个人啊，
怎么也记不住道具的名称和作用。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore3FDirectoryText
entries.english:
3F: TM SHOP Make Your #MON
Stronger!
entries.translation:
3楼 …… 招式学习器专卖
让你的宝可梦变强！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid1Text
entries.english:
Uh-oh! I traded my
#MON without removing the UP-
GRADE from it.
entries.translation:
哎呀！
一不小心就交换出了携带升级数据的宝可梦！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid2Text
entries.english:
Yeah! I'm finally
getting a PORYGON! I'm no good at the
slots, so I could never get enough
coins… …Huh? The traded PORYGON
turned into a dif-ferent #MON!
entries.translation:
太好了！
总算得到多边兽了！ 我玩不来老虎机，
代币一直都攒不够…… ……啊？ 被传送过来的多边兽
变成别的宝可梦了！？

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore3FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
The TM SHOP sells
some rare moves.
entries.translation:
招式学习器专卖正在
出售稀有的招式学习器哦。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore3FYoungsterText
entries.english:
I can't decide
which #MON I should use this TM
on…
entries.translation:
要让哪个宝可梦
记住招式学习器呢……啊，好头疼……

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore4FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Express Yourself
With Gifts! 4F: WISEMAN GIFTS
entries.translation:
4楼 …… 诚心诚意送礼！
聪明人礼品店！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore4FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
I'm here to buy
SURF MAIL to sendto my girlfriend.
entries.translation:
我要给女朋友写信，
所以来买冲浪邮件！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore4FYoungsterText
entries.english:
This is the only
place where you can buy LOVELY
MAIL.
entries.translation:
可爱邮件
只能在这里买到哦！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore5FDirectoryText
entries.english: 5F: DRUG STORE
entries.translation: 5楼 …… 药品店

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore5FGentlemanText
entries.english:
I want to buy some
items that raise #MON stats, but
I don't haveenough money…
entries.translation:
虽然我很想买提升
宝可梦能力的道具……唔……钱不够啊！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore5FSailorText
entries.english:
I want PP UP, so I
can raise the PP of moves. But you
can't buy it…
entries.translation:
我想买增加招式点数
最大值的PP提升剂，但听说那是不在商店出售的道具！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore5FTeacherText
entries.english:
Using items on
them makes #-MON happy. They hate certain
items, though…
entries.translation:
如果给宝可梦使用道具，
它会很高兴的！不过也有让宝可梦讨厌的道具……

entries.label: CeladonClangText
entries.english:
Clang! {STRBUF}
popped out.
entries.translation: 哐当！ {STRBUF}已滑落至取物口！

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore6FDirectoryText
entries.english:
6F: ROOFTOP SQUARE
VENDING MACHINES
entries.translation:
6楼 …… 休息广场
……自动贩卖机

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore6FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
A vending machine
with a prize rou-lette… You never see
those anymore.
entries.translation:
带有抽奖功能的
自动贩卖机……最近都找不到了呢。

entries.label: CeladonDeptStore6FYoungsterText
entries.english:
Aww! There's no
games here! I wanted to play…
entries.translation:
喂——喂——！
这里没有游戏呀——！我想玩游戏呀——！

entries.label: CeladonVendingNoMoneyText
entries.english:
Oops, not enough
money…
entries.translation: 钱不够！

entries.label: CeladonVendingNoSpaceText
entries.english:
There's no more
room for stuff…
entries.translation: 已经拿不下了！

entries.label: CeladonVendingText
entries.english:
A vending machine!
Here's the menu.
entries.translation:
是自动贩卖机！
想要的饮料是 …… ……

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherFullCoinCaseText
entries.english:
Hey, your COIN
CASE is full, kid. You must be riding
a winning streaktoo.
entries.translation:
哎呀！
你的代币盒完全满了！看啦你也很走运嘛！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherNoCoinCaseText
entries.english:
Hey, you don't
have a COIN CASE. How am I supposed
to give you anycoins, kid?
entries.translation:
哎呀！
你没带代币盒哦！那我怎么分给你代币啊？

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherText1
entries.english:
Gahahaha! The coins just
keep popping out! Hm? What, kid? You
want to play? I'll share my luck
with you!
entries.translation:
噶、哈、哈！
源源不断地出代币！笑得停不下来！ ……哦！什么？
你也想玩游戏？ 好吧，
我就把好运分给你！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerFisherText2
entries.english:
Gahahaha! It makes me feel
good to do nice things for other
people!
entries.translation:
噶、哈、哈！ 帮助别人
是快乐之本！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerFishingGuruText
entries.english:
I think this slot
machine will payout… The odds vary
among machines.
entries.translation:
我有种预感，
这台一定能出代币…… 好像有的老虎机出的多，
而有的老虎机不出代币。

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerGrampsText
entries.english:
Hmmm… The odds are
surely better for PIKACHU's line,
but… What to do?
entries.translation:
唔……从概率上来说，
皮卡丘那列更好吧……唉，好烦啊……！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerLighterText
entries.english:
There's a lighter
here.
entries.translation: 放着一个打火机！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerPokefanMText
entries.english:
The slot machines
are all state ofthe art.
entries.translation:
这边的老虎机
全都是最新型号！啊，这也太有乐趣了吧！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerPoster1Text
entries.english:
Hey! Underneath this
poster… There's nothing!
entries.translation: 啊！ 在海报的后面…… 什么也没有发现！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerPoster2Text
entries.english:
Hey! Underneath this
poster… There's nothing!
entries.translation: 啊！ 在海报的后面…… 什么也没有发现！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome! You may exchange
your coins for fabulous prizes
next door.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！ 您可以在隔壁的交换处，
把游戏中积攒的代币兑换成精美奖品！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerSodaCanText
entries.english:
A can of soda… Someone must be
coming back… Huh? It's empty!
entries.translation:
放着一罐果汁。
这里被别人占了吧……哎呀……？里面是空的！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerTeacherText
entries.english:
It's this machine
I want. It cleaned me out
yesterday, so it should pay out
today.
entries.translation:
对了，就是这台！ 昨天没有出过
一枚代币，今天一定会出！

entries.label: CeladonGymGuideText
entries.english:
Hey! CHAMP in
making! Are you playing
the slots too? I'm trying to get
enough coins for aprize #MON. But I don't have
enough coins yet…
entries.translation:
哎呀！
未来的冠军！你也来玩老虎机？ 我很想兑换
奖品宝可梦啊……但代币就是不够。

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoomGentlemanText
entries.english:
I wanted PORYGON,
but I was short by100 coins…
entries.translation:
我好想要多边兽啊……
但是代币还差100枚……！

entries.label: CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoomPharmacistText
entries.english:
Whew… I've got to stay
calm and cool… I can't lose my
cool, or I'll loseall my money…
entries.translation:
呼呜呜呜…… 我要小心一点，
不能大脑发热啊…… 要是花光了所有钱
那就真的完了……

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_AskWhichPrizeText
entries.english:
Which prize would
you like?
entries.translation: 要哪个呢？

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_ComeAgainText
entries.english:
Oh. Please come
back with coins!
entries.translation:
啊，这样吗。
请多积攒一些代币再来！

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_ConfirmPurchaseText
entries.english:
OK, so you wanted
a {STRBUF}?
entries.translation: {STRBUF}，可以吗？

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_HereYouGoText
entries.english: Here you go!
entries.translation: 给，请收下！

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_NoCoinCaseText
entries.english:
Oh? You don't have
a COIN CASE.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
您没有代币盒哦。

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_NotEnoughCoinsText
entries.english:
You don't have
enough coins.
entries.translation: 您的代币不够哦。

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_NotEnoughRoomText
entries.english:
You have no room
for it.
entries.translation: 已经拿不下了。

entries.label: CeladonPrizeRoom_PrizeVendorIntroText
entries.english:
Welcome! We exchange your
coins for fabulousprizes!
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！ 在这里，
可以用游戏中积攒的代币兑换成您心仪的奖品！

entries.label: BeautyJuliaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
How do I go about
becoming ladylikelike ERIKA?
entries.translation:
我要怎么样才能变得
像莉佳一样温柔贤惠？

entries.label: BeautyJuliaBeatenText
entries.english: How annoying!
entries.translation: 讨厌，真是的！

entries.label: BeautyJuliaSeenText
entries.english:
Were you looking
at these flowersor at me?
entries.translation:
哎呀？你看入迷了吗？
是在看我还是在看花？

entries.label: ErikaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
ERIKA: Losing
leaves a bitteraftertaste… But knowing that
there are strong trainers spurs me
to do better…
entries.translation:
莉佳：输了
可真叫人不甘心呢…… 但是知道世上还有强者，
也可以激励自己呢。

entries.label: ErikaBeatenText
entries.english:
ERIKA: Oh!
I concede defeat… You are remarkably
strong… I shall give you
RAINBOWBADGE…
entries.translation:
莉佳：……！
是我输了。 你真的很强呢…… 我要把这个彩虹徽章
送给你。

entries.label: ErikaBeforeBattleText
entries.english:
ERIKA: Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?
It's so pleasant… …I'm afraid I may
doze off… My name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER ofCELADON GYM. …Oh? All the way
from JOHTO, yousay? How nice… Oh. I'm sorry, I
didn't realize that you wished to
challenge me. Very well, but I
shall not lose.
entries.translation:
莉佳：你好……
天气真好呢。……好像随时都会感到昏昏欲睡呢…… 我是
玉虹道馆的莉佳。 …… …… 是这样啊！
你从城都远道而来吗。 ……呃，
你是要申请对战吗？ 是吗……
我可是不会输的。

entries.label: ErikaExplainTMText
entries.english:
ERIKA: That was a
delightful match. I felt inspired.
Please, I wish youto have this TM. It is GIGA DRAIN. It is a wonderful
move that drains half the damage it
inflicts to healyour #MON. Please use it if
it pleases you…
entries.translation:
莉佳：真是场精彩的对战。
我深受感动，这个招式学习机就送你了。 里面是终极吸取。
这个优秀的招式能把向对方造成的伤害中的一半转化为宝可梦的营养。 如果可以，
我希望你能用上它。

entries.label: LassMichelleAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I just got care-
less, that's all!
entries.translation: 我只是一时大意！

entries.label: LassMichelleBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, bleah!
entries.translation: 啊啊，不甘心！

entries.label: LassMichelleSeenText
entries.english:
Do you think a
girls-only GYMis rare?
entries.translation:
哎呀，你在干嘛？
难道你从来没见过只有女生的道馆吗？

entries.label: PicnickerTanyaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Oh, look at all
your BADGES. No wonder I couldn't
win!
entries.translation:
哎——你有这么多徽章啊。
这怎么可能赢得了啊！

entries.label: PicnickerTanyaBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, that's it?
entries.translation: 哎——骗人的吧？

entries.label: PicnickerTanyaSeenText
entries.english:
Oh, a battle?
That's kind ofscary, but OK!
entries.translation:
哎——要进行宝可梦对战？
虽然有点刺激，但我愿意。

entries.label: PlayerReceivedRainbowBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
RAINBOWBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
得到了彩虹徽章！

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
ERIKA will get you
back for us!
entries.translation:
人家要让莉佳姐姐
帮人家报仇！

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe1BeatenText
entries.english: Oh… We lost…
entries.translation: 人家输了啦……

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenText
entries.english:
We'll show you
#MON moves thatERIKA taught us!
entries.translation:
人家要给你展示一下
小莉佳传授的宝可梦招式！

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
ERIKA is much,
much stronger!
entries.translation:
莉佳姐姐
比人家强得多！

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe2BeatenText
entries.english: We couldn't win…
entries.translation: 人家赢不了啊……

entries.label: TwinsJoAndZoe2SeenText
entries.english:
We're going to
protect ERIKA!
entries.translation:
莉佳姐姐
会保护我们的！

entries.label: CeladonMansion1FClefairyText
entries.english:
CLEFAIRY: Clef
cleff!
entries.translation: 皮皮：皮～皮皮～～！

entries.label: CeladonMansion1FMeowthText
entries.english: MEOWTH: Meow!
entries.translation: 喵喵：喵～～呜！

entries.label: CeladonMansion1FNidoranFText
entries.english:
NIDORAN: Kya
kyaoo!
entries.translation: 尼多兰：啾～啾唔～！

entries.label: CeladonMansionManagerText
entries.english:
My dear #MON
keep me company, so I don't ever
feel lonely. MEOWTH even brings
money home.
entries.translation:
只要身边有宝可梦陪伴，
即使是独居生活……也不会感到孤寂…… 我家的喵喵啊……
有时候会捡到钱呢。

entries.label: CeladonMansionManagersSuiteSignText
entries.english:
CELADON MANSION
MANAGER'S SUITE
entries.translation:
玉虹大厦
…… 管理员室

entries.label: CeladonMansion2FComputerText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} turned on
the PC. … Someone was in the
middle of compos-ing an e-mail. …I hope you'll
come visit KANTO. I think you'll be
surprised at how much things have
changed here. You'll also see
many #MON that aren't native to
JOHTO. To the PRODUCER …
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
按下了电脑开关！ …… …… …… 好像有一封邮件
正写到一半！ …… …… …… 好久不见，
我很希望你能来关都！ 看到这边的变化，
你应该会吓一跳吧！ 这里还有很多城都
看不到的宝可梦。 ……致制作人 …… …… ……

entries.label: CeladonMansion2FMeetingRoomSignText
entries.english:
GAME FREAK
MEETING ROOM
entries.translation:
GAME FREAK
会客室

entries.label: CeladonMansion3FDevRoomSignText
entries.english:
GAME FREAK
DEVELOPMENT ROOM
entries.translation: GAME FREAK 开发室

entries.label: CeladonMansion3FDrawingText
entries.english:
It's a detailed
drawing of apretty girl.
entries.translation:
有张漂亮的画。
……是充满魅力的女孩子！

entries.label: CeladonMansion3FGameProgramText
entries.english:
It's the game
program. Messing with it could put
a bug in the game!
entries.translation:
是游戏的程序！
要是修改了这个游戏可能会出错吧。

entries.label: CeladonMansion3FReferenceMaterialText
entries.english:
It's crammed with
reference materi-als. There's evena # DOLL.
entries.translation:
摆满了各种资料。
……还有皮皮玩偶！

entries.label: GameFreakCharacterDesignerText
entries.english:
Aren't the TWINS
adorable? JASMINE's pretty
too. Oh, I love them!
entries.translation: 双胞胎很可爱吧！ 阿蜜也是，唔……！ 他们真可爱啊！

entries.label: GameFreakGameDesignerAfterDiplomaText
entries.english:
The GRAPHIC ARTIST
will print out aDIPLOMA for you. You should go show
it off.
entries.translation:
我们会
让插画师把奖状打印出来送给你！拿去给大家看看吧！

entries.label: GameFreakGameDesignerCompletedPokedexText
entries.english:
Wow! Excellent!
You completed your#DEX! Congratulations!
entries.translation:
哇，了不起！
你终于填满了图鉴的所有页面！ 恭喜你！

entries.label: GameFreakGameDesignerText
entries.english:
Is that right? I'm the GAME
DESIGNER! Filling up your
#DEX is tough,but don't give up!
entries.translation:
是吗！ 我是游戏设计师。 你要收集所有宝可梦吗？
这件事很不容易哦，加油！

entries.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistErrorText
entries.english:
Something's wrong.
I'll have to can-cel printing.
entries.translation:
好像那里出问题了。
打印将被取消！

entries.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistPrintDiplomaText
entries.english:
I'm the GRAPHIC
ARTIST. Oh, you completed
your #DEX? Want me to print
out your DIPLOMA?
entries.translation:
我是个插画师！ 哦，你完成图鉴了！
作为纪念，我把奖状打印给你吧？

entries.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistRefusedText
entries.english:
Give me a shout if
you want yourDIPLOMA printed.
entries.translation:
等你想打印的时候，
尽管来找我吧！

entries.label: GameFreakGraphicArtistText
entries.english:
I'm the GRAPHIC
ARTIST. I drew you!
entries.translation:
我是个插画师！
你就是我画出来的！

entries.label: GameFreakProgrammerText
entries.english:
Who, me? I'm the
PROGRAMMER. Play the slot
machines!
entries.translation:
我吗？我是程序员哦！
去玩老虎机吧！

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofFisherText
entries.english:
High places--I do
love them so! I'd say the only
thing that loves heights as much as
me is smoke!
entries.translation:
我特别喜欢高处！ 恐怕只有我和青烟
才会如此喜欢高处！

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofGraffitiText
entries.english:
There's graffiti
on the wall… {PLAYER} added a
moustache!
entries.translation: 墙上画了涂鸦…… {PLAYER}加上了胡子！

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistCurseText
entries.english:
TM03 is CURSE. It's a terrifying
move that slowly whittles down the
victim's HP.
entries.translation:
招式学习器03是诅咒！
这个招式可以一点一点地削减对方的体力，真的很可怕呢！

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistIntroText
entries.english:
Let me recount a
terrifying tale…
entries.translation:
你要不要听听
我珍藏的恐怖故事……

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistNotNightText
entries.english:
Then again, it's
not as scary while it's still light
outside. Come back after
sunset, OK?
entries.translation:
……哎哟！
这大白天的，就算讲了也没意思！ 等太阳下山了再来吧！

entries.label: CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistStoryText
entries.english:
Once upon a time,
there was a little boy who was given
a new BICYCLE… He wanted to try
it right away… He was having so
much fun that he didn't notice the
sun had set… While riding home
in the pitch-black night, the bike
suddenly slowed! The pedals became
heavy! When he stopped
pedaling, the bike began slipping
backwards! It was as if the
bike were cursed and trying to drag
him into oblivion! … … SHRIEEEEK! The boy had been
riding uphill onCYCLING ROAD! …
Ba-dum ba-dum! For listening so
patiently, you maytake this--TM03!
entries.translation:
话说有个男孩收到了
一辆神秘的自行车…… 男孩非常高兴，
当场就骑车转了几圈…… 其实这时天已经黑了，
四周伸手不见五指……可他太高兴，没意识到…… 突然，自行车的车速
一下子就变慢了！车蹬变得十分沉重！他没踩车蹬，可自行车却在向后滑！ 难道这是被诅咒的自行车，
要把男孩拖向地狱吗…… …… …… …… …… …… …… 呀————！！ 原来是因为
他身处自行车道的斜坡！ …… …… ……
我说完了，谢谢…… 你居然能听到最后，
我要送你招式学习器03！

entries.label: CeladonEusineText1
entries.english:
EUSINE: Hi! I'm back visiting
my hometown. It's been quite a
while.
entries.translation:
水京：哟！ 我已经好久没有
回到自己老家了。

entries.label: CeladonPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
ERIKA is a master
of grass #MON. She'll make you
pay if you don'twatch yourself.
entries.translation:
莉佳小姐
是草宝可梦的行家！ 你要是小看她，
会吃苦头的！

entries.label: CeladonPokecenter1FPharmacistText
entries.english:
TEAM ROCKET's
hideout is in the basement of the
GAME CORNER. Oh, wait. That was
three years ago.
entries.translation:
游戏城的地下
有火箭队的基地…… 哎呀！
这是三年以前的过时情报！

entries.label: EusineLeavesCeladonText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, have you
heard? There have been
fresh rumors of a rainbow-colored
#MON appearingat TIN TOWER. I've just had my
party healed, so now I'm headed to
ECRUTEAK. I'll be seeing
you, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，知道吗？ 我也是刚刚才知道的。
据说在铃铛塔上出现了虹色的宝可梦。 我接下来
也想去一趟缘朱市， 所以就先过来
回复了宝可梦的体力。 我先行一步，{PLAYER}！

entries.label: NoBeastsText
entries.english:
Oh, by the way,
{PLAYER}. Have you caught
the legendary #MON RAIKOU and
ENTEI? ……………… Okay… If you catch even
one, I hope thatyou'll inform me. I'm counting on
you, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
说起来，{PLAYER}，
你有没有捉到 传说的宝可梦
雷公和炎帝？ …………… 这样啊…… 你要是捉到了，
一定要和我说一声。 拜托你了，{PLAYER}！

entries.label: CeruleanBikeShopSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… The BIKE SHOP has
moved to GOLDENRODCITY in JOHTO…
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ ……奇迹自行车店
现在已经搬到城都地区满金市……

entries.label: CeruleanCapeSignText
entries.english:
CERULEAN CAPE
AHEAD
entries.translation: 前方是华蓝海角

entries.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerFText1
entries.english:
My SLOWBRO and I
make an awesomecombination!
entries.translation:
我和呆壳兽
是无敌的组合！

entries.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerFText2
entries.english:
SLOWBRO, show me
your CONFUSION!
entries.translation:
来吧，呆壳兽，
快用念力！

entries.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText1
entries.english:
KANTO's POWER
PLANT? It's near the end
of ROUTE 9, the road that heads
east from here. I think there was
an accident ofsome sort there.
entries.translation:
如果想去关都发电厂…… 沿着9号道路往东，
就在道路尽头附近。 但我听说那里出事了……

entries.label: CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText2
entries.english:
You're collecting
every single kindof #MON? That must be quite
a challenge, butit sounds fun too.
entries.translation:
喔——！
你正在收集所有宝可梦？ 这虽然不太轻松，
但很有意义啊。

entries.label: CeruleanCityFisherRocketTipText
entries.english:
I saw this shady
guy go off towardCERULEAN's CAPE.
entries.translation:
有个超级可疑的人
往华蓝海角那边跑了！

entries.label: CeruleanCityFisherText
entries.english:
I'm a huge fan of
CERULEAN GYM'sMISTY.
entries.translation:
华蓝道馆的馆主是小霞！
我是她的粉丝！

entries.label: CeruleanCitySignText
entries.english:
CERULEAN CITY A Mysterious Blue
Aura Surrounds It
entries.translation:
这里是华蓝市。
华蓝即是神秘的水蓝之色。

entries.label: CeruleanCitySlowbroText
entries.english: SLOWBRO: Yarah?
entries.translation: 呆壳兽：呆～？

entries.label: CeruleanCitySuperNerdText
entries.english:
The CAPE in the
north is a good place for dates.
Girls like it!
entries.translation:
往北有个海角，
那可是女生们最爱的约会胜地哦！

entries.label: CeruleanCityYoungsterText1
entries.english:
There used to be a
cave here that had horribly powerful
#MON in it.
entries.translation:
这边曾经有个洞窟，
里面栖息着极强的宝可梦！

entries.label: CeruleanCityYoungsterText2
entries.english:
Ayuh? My ITEMFINDER is
responding…
entries.translation:
哎呀……？ 我的探宝器
怎么一直都有反应……？

entries.label: CeruleanGymSignText
entries.english:
CERULEAN CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: MISTY The Tomboyish
Mermaid
entries.translation:
华蓝市宝可梦道馆
馆主：小霞俏皮的美人鱼。

entries.label: CeruleanLockedDoorText
entries.english: It's locked…
entries.translation: ……锁得紧紧的！

entries.label: CeruleanPoliceSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… Stamp out thievery
and make the city a friendlier, more
cheerful place! CERULEAN POLICE
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ 这里是和谐正能量的城市，
请停止盗窃行为。……华蓝市警署留

entries.label: CeruleanGymGruntBigMistakeText
entries.english:
Oh no! You seen
me already! I makebig mistake!
entries.translation:
……Oh no！
我已经被you发现了！Big my mistake！

entries.label: CeruleanGymGruntByeText
entries.english:
Hey, you! Forget
you see me, okay? You see, hear,
know nothing, okay?
Bye, kid! Nothing! Bye-bye a go-go!
entries.translation:
Hey you！
Forget这件事情！You什么都没看见、没听见、没了解！ Bye kid！
Long goodbye！！

entries.label: CeruleanGymGruntIntroText
entries.english:
Oops! I so sorry!
You not hurt,okay? I very busy.
No time for talk-ing with you. Notgood for me ifseen by somebody.
entries.translation:
Oh！Sorry！
You没有受伤吧？我very busy！没有闲工夫和you进行talking！万一被人发现，那就大事不妙了！

entries.label: CeruleanGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! Since MISTY was
away, I went out for some fun too.
He-he-he.
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！ 因为之前小霞她们都不在，
所以我也跑出去玩了！哇哈哈哈哈！

entries.label: CeruleanGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Hoo, you showed me
how tough you are. As always, that
was one heck of agreat battle!
entries.translation:
你果然很强呢！
真是一场精彩的对战！

entries.label: CeruleanGymNote1Text
entries.english:
Sorry, I'll be out
for a while.MISTY, GYM LEADER
entries.translation:
抱歉，我要出去一会儿。
……道馆馆主小霞留

entries.label: CeruleanGymNote2Text
entries.english:
Since MISTY's out,
we'll be away too.GYM TRAINERS
entries.translation:
因为小霞不在，
我们也出去玩了。……道馆训练家留

entries.label: MistyFightDoneText
entries.english:
MISTY: Are there
many strong train-ers in JOHTO? Likeyou, I mean. I'm going to
travel one day, so I can battle some
skilled trainers.
entries.translation:
小霞：城都难道
有很多强大的训练家？我是说像你这样的。 我以后也要出去旅行，
去挑战强大的训练家！

entries.label: MistyIntroText
entries.english:
MISTY: I was ex-
pecting you, youpest! You may have a
lot of JOHTO GYM BADGES, but you'd
better not take metoo lightly. My water-type
#MON are tough!
entries.translation:
小霞：你来了啊！
电灯泡！ 虽然你好像带着
很多城都的徽章，但别把我看扁了！ 我的水属性宝可梦
非常强哦！

entries.label: MistyWinLossText
entries.english:
MISTY: You really
are good… I'll admit that
you are skilled… Here you go. It's
CASCADEBADGE.
entries.translation:
小霞：还挺厉害…… 我要老老实实地
认可你的实力…… 这个，拿着。
是蓝色徽章哦！

entries.label: ReceivedCascadeBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
CASCADEBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小霞那里
得到了蓝色徽章！

entries.label: SwimmerfBrianaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Don't be too smug
about beating me. MISTY will destroy
you if you getcomplacent.
entries.translation:
虽然你打败了我，
但还不是安心的时候！小霞非常强哦！

entries.label: SwimmerfBrianaBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, you calmly
disposed of me…
entries.translation:
居然完全没被我吓到……
你也太冷静了吧……！

entries.label: SwimmerfBrianaSeenText
entries.english:
Don't let my ele-
gant swimming un-nerve you.
entries.translation:
看到我如此优美的泳姿，
你可别目瞪口呆！

entries.label: SwimmerfDianaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'll be swimming
quietly.
entries.translation: 我要安静地游泳。

entries.label: SwimmerfDianaBeatenText
entries.english:
I give up! You're
the winner!
entries.translation:
我投降！
是我输了！

entries.label: SwimmerfDianaSeenText
entries.english:
Sorry about being
away. Let's get onwith it!
entries.translation:
抱歉，之前溜出去了！
那就赶紧开始对战吧！

entries.label: SwimmermParkerAfterBattleText
entries.english:
MISTY has gotten
much better in thepast few years. Don't let your
guard down, oryou'll be crushed!
entries.translation:
最近几年，
小霞长进了不少哦！你可别大意了！会 吃 苦 头 的！

entries.label: SwimmermParkerBeatenText
entries.english: This can't be…
entries.translation: 这怎么可能……

entries.label: SwimmermParkerSeenText
entries.english:
Glub… I'm first! Come
and get me!
entries.translation:
哇噗！ 你要先赢过我！
尽管来吧！

entries.label: CeruleanGymBadgeSpeechHousePokefanMText
entries.english:
Are you collecting
KANTO GYM BADGES?
entries.translation: 你在收集关都的道馆徽章？

entries.label: CeruleanMart_CooltrainerFText
entries.english:
MISTY is about the
only person in town who can beat
the trainers atCERULEAN's CAPE.
entries.translation:
能够战胜华蓝海角
那帮训练家的人，恐怕整个城市也只有一个道馆馆主小霞！

entries.label: CeruleanMart_CooltrainerMText
entries.english:
You'll run into
many trainers on the way to CERU-
LEAN's CAPE. They want to see
how they stack up against other
trainers.
entries.translation:
去华蓝海角的路上
有很多训练家。 他们会测试一下
过路训练家的实力哦。

entries.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FGymGuideText
entries.english:
The MAGNET TRAIN
travels at over 340 mph. It goes
between KANTO and JOHTO in almost no
time at all. It really makes
JOHTO accessible.
entries.translation:
磁浮列车时速550公里！
往返于关都和城都只是一瞬间的事情！ 有了它，
去城都就方便多了！

entries.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
For battles, I'd
much rather use #MON I've been
raising, even if they're weaker
than some newlycaught #MON.
entries.translation:
对战的时候啊，
即使弱得不像话，比起新捉到的宝可梦，还是更想用自己培育起来的宝可梦！

entries.label: CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText_Mobile
entries.english:
Do you battle by
mobile phone? If time runs out
during a battle, waiting to see who
won is reallynerve wracking.
entries.translation:
试过手机对战吗？ 比赛中途结束，
获胜者还没公布的时候真的非常让人紧张呢！

entries.label: CeruleanDiglettText
entries.english: DIGLETT: Dug dug.
entries.translation: 地鼠：地地鼠

entries.label: CeruleanPoliceStationFishingGuruText
entries.english:
I heard that some
shady character isskulking about. I won't stand for
it if he turns outto be a thief.
entries.translation:
我听说有个可疑的人
在四处溜达！ 如果那是小偷，
我一定要给他一点颜色！

entries.label: CeruleanPoliceStationPokefanFText
entries.english:
We were held up by
robbers before.
entries.translation:
几年前
有个小偷闯进来过。

entries.label: CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseGrampsText
entries.english: Ah… I'm so happy…
entries.translation:
啊……
我真是太幸福了——

entries.label: CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseGrannyText
entries.english:
My husband lives
happily with #-MON he got throughtrades.
entries.translation:
我家的老头子啊， 以前和很多人交换过。
现在和宝可梦们过着幸福的生活。

entries.label: CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseRhydonText
entries.english:
KANGASKHAN: Garu
garuu.
entries.translation: 袋兽：袋袋，袋袋！

entries.label: CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseZubatText
entries.english: ZUBAT: Zuba zubaa.
entries.translation: 超音蝠：超音，超音～！

entries.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText1
entries.english:
Where have all the
SLOWPOKE gone? Are they out play-
ing somewhere?
entries.translation:
为什么呆呆兽都消失了，
是跑出去玩了吗？

entries.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText2
entries.english:
I'm sorry--I for-
got to thank you. This is CHARCOAL
that I made. Fire-type #MON
would be happy tohold that.
entries.translation:
说起来，
我还要向你道谢呀。 这是我烧制的木炭。
让火属性的宝可梦携带，它一定会很开心的！

entries.label: CharcoalKilnApprenticeText3
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE came
back, and you evenfound FARFETCH'D. You're the cool-
est, man!
entries.translation:
呆呆兽也回来了，
大葱鸭也找到了，你也太酷了吧！

entries.label: CharcoalKilnBossText1
entries.english:
All the SLOWPOKE
have disappearedfrom the town. The forest's pro-
tector may beangry with us… It may be a bad
omen. We shouldstay in.
entries.translation:
镇上的呆呆兽都不见了， 唔，会不会是
森林之神生气了……？ 反正不是什么好兆头，
现在最好不要贸然行动。

entries.label: CharcoalKilnBossText2
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE have
returned… But my APPRENTICE
hasn't come backfrom ILEX FOREST. Where in the world
is that lazy guy?
entries.translation:
呆呆兽都回来了……  倒是那个来实习的小鬼
去了栎树林就没回来了。他要玩到什么时候去啊…… 真是的！
拿他一点办法也没有！

entries.label: CharcoalKilnBossText3
entries.english:
You chased off
TEAM ROCKET and went to ILEX
FOREST alone? That takes guts!
I like that. Cometrain with us.
entries.translation:
不仅驱逐了火箭队，
还能勇敢地走进栎树林。 你的气魄令人佩服！
怎么样！和我们一起修行吧？

entries.label: FarfetchdText
entries.english: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!
entries.translation: 大葱鸭：呱——

entries.label: CherrygroveCitySignText
entries.english:
CHERRYGROVE CITY The City of Cute,
Fragrant Flowers
entries.translation:
这里是吉花市
可爱花朵香气飘逸的城市

entries.label: CherrygroveRivalText_Seen
entries.english:
…… …… …… You got a #MON
at the LAB. What a waste.
A wimp like you. …… …… …… Don't you get what
I'm saying? Well, I too, have
a good #MON. I'll show you
what I mean!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 你在研究所里
得到了宝可梦啊。给你这么弱的人真浪费。 …… …… …… 什么啊，
你听不懂我在说什么吗？ …… 那就没办法了。
我也拿到了不错的宝可梦，我来好好教教你吧！

entries.label: CherrygroveRivalText_YouLost
entries.english:
…… …… …… My name's ???. I'm going to be
the world's great-est #MONtrainer.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 我的名字是???。 将会成为世界最强
宝可梦训练家的男人！

entries.label: CherrygroveRivalText_YouWon
entries.english:
…… …… …… My name's ???. I'm going to be
the world's great-est #MONtrainer.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 我的名字是???。 将会成为世界最强
宝可梦训练家的男人！

entries.label: CherrygroveTeacherText_HaveMapCard
entries.english:
When you're with
#MON, goinganywhere is fun.
entries.translation:
有宝可梦同行的话，
去哪里都很开心呢。

entries.label: CherrygroveTeacherText_NoMapCard
entries.english:
Did you talk to
the old man by the#MON CENTER? He'll put a MAP of
JOHTO on your#GEAR.
entries.translation:
你有没有向宝可梦中心
旁边的那个爷爷问话？ 他可以为你身上的
宝可装置增加城都地区地图功能哦！

entries.label: CherrygroveYoungsterText_HavePokedex
entries.english:
I battled the
trainers on theroad. My #MON lost.
They're a mess! I must take them to
a #MON CENTER.
entries.translation:
我和站在路边的训练家
勇敢地大战了一场…… 但是我的宝可梦打输了，
都累得精疲力尽……必须要去宝可梦中心了……

entries.label: CherrygroveYoungsterText_NoPokedex
entries.english:
MR.#MON's house
is still fartherup ahead.
entries.translation:
宝可梦爷爷的家
还要再往前走一段距离。

entries.label: GotMapCardText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}'s #GEAR
now has a MAP!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}可以用
宝可装置查看城镇地图了！

entries.label: GuideGentGiftText
entries.english:
Here… It's my house!
Thanks for yourcompany. Let me give you a
small gift.
entries.translation:
这里是…… 我的家！
感谢你愿意陪我。 这个是谢礼哦！

entries.label: GuideGentIntroText
entries.english:
You're a rookie
trainer, aren'tyou? I can tell! That's OK! Every-
one is a rookieat some point! If you'd like, I
can teach you afew things.
entries.translation:
你还是新人训练家吧？
被我说中了吧！ 很好很好，
靡不有初嘛。 要不要让我
指点一下啊？

entries.label: GuideGentMartText
entries.english:
This is a #MON
MART. They sell BALLS
for catching wild #MON and other
useful items.
entries.translation:
这里是友好商店！
捕捉宝可梦的球等等物品都要在这里购买哦！

entries.label: GuideGentNoText
entries.english:
Oh… It's something
I enjoy doing… Fine. Come see me
when you like.
entries.translation:
这样啊……
我还挺期待的……你心情好的时候尽管来吧。

entries.label: GuideGentPokecenterText
entries.english:
This is a #MON
CENTER. They heal your #MON in no
time at all. You'll be relying
on them a lot, so you better learn
about them.
entries.translation:
这里是宝可梦中心！
把受伤的宝可梦寄放在这，一瞬间就能治好！ 接下来你应该会
经常来这里，一定要好好记住哦！

entries.label: GuideGentPokegearText
entries.english:
#GEAR becomes
more useful as youadd CARDS. I wish you luck on
your journey!
entries.translation:
给宝可装置
装上各种好用的扩展卡它就会变得越来越好用！ 那么，加油吧！

entries.label: GuideGentRoute30Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 30 is out
this way. Trainers will be
battling their prized #MON
there.
entries.translation:
这前面是30号道路！
大家都在磨练着自己引以为豪的宝可梦！

entries.label: GuideGentSeaText
entries.english:
This is the sea,
as you can see. Some #MON are
found only inwater.
entries.translation:
这里如你所见，是一片海。 有的宝可梦
只会出现在水中！

entries.label: GuideGentTourText1
entries.english:
OK, then!
Follow me!
entries.translation: 好，我给你带路！

entries.label: GuideGentsHouseSignText
entries.english: GUIDE GENT'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 这里是向导爷爷的家

entries.label: MysticWaterGuyTextAfter
entries.english:
Back to fishing
for me, then.
entries.translation: 那么，我要继续垂钓了。

entries.label: MysticWaterGuyTextBefore
entries.english:
A #MON I caught
had an item. I think it's
MYSTIC WATER. I don't need it,
so do you want it?
entries.translation:
之前钓上来的宝可梦
身上携带者道具哦。 好像叫神秘水滴什么的。
我只要钓宝可梦就够了，你要的话就给你吧。

entries.label: RivalCherrygroveLossText
entries.english:
Humph. That was a
waste of time.
entries.translation:
…… 哼！
真是浪费时间。

entries.label: RivalCherrygroveWinText
entries.english:
Humph. Are you
happy you won?
entries.translation:
…… 哼！
赢了很开心吗？

entries.label: CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseLassText
entries.english:
#MON change? I would be shocked
if one did that!
entries.translation:
宝可梦的外形会变吗？ 如果是突然产生变化，
那我一定会吓一跳呢！

entries.label: CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseYoungsterText
entries.english:
#MON gain expe-
rience in battle and change their
form.
entries.translation:
宝可梦啊，
一直战斗积累经验之后外形也会发生变化哦！

entries.label: CherrygroveGymSpeechHouseBugCatcherText
entries.english:
When I get older,
I'm going to be aGYM LEADER! I make my #MON
battle with my friend's to make
them tougher!
entries.translation:
等我长大了，
我要努力成为道馆馆主！ 为此我要和朋友进行
宝可梦对战来磨练自己！

entries.label: CherrygroveGymSpeechHousePokefanMText
entries.english:
You're trying to
see how good you are as a #MON
trainer? You better visit
the #MON GYMS all over JOHTO and
collect BADGES.
entries.translation:
作为一个宝可梦训练家，
你想要检测自己的实力吧？ 那么你可以
去收集城都地区各地的道馆徽章！

entries.label: CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
They're fresh out
of # BALLS! When will they get
more of them?
entries.translation:
据说精灵球售罄了！
要什么时候才有货啊！

entries.label: CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText_PokeBallsInStock
entries.english:
# BALLS are in
stock! Now I cancatch #MON!
entries.translation:
可以买精灵球了！
这下就能捕捉宝可梦了！

entries.label: CherrygroveMartYoungsterText
entries.english:
When I was walking
in the grass, a bug #MON poi-
soned my #MON! I just kept going,
but then my#MON fainted. You should keep an
ANTIDOTE with you.
entries.translation:
在草丛里走的时候，
中了虫宝可梦的毒！ 然后走着走着，
宝可梦就倒下了！ 还是带点解毒药比较好。

entries.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FFisherText
entries.english:
It's great. I can
store any number of #MON, and
it's all free.
entries.translation:
不管寄放多少宝可梦
都不用交钱，好开心啊。

entries.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
That PC is free
for any trainerto use.
entries.translation:
放在那里的电脑，
只要是宝可梦训练家就可以随意使用！

entries.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText
entries.english:
The COMMUNICATION
CENTER upstairswas just built. But they're still
finishing it up.
entries.translation:
2楼的连接俱乐部是
前不久才建好的。 不过，我听说
目前还在进行调整。

entries.label: CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText_CommCenterOpen
entries.english:
The COMMUNICATION
CENTER upstairswas just built. I traded #MON
there already!
entries.translation:
2楼的连接俱乐部是
前不久才建好的。 我老早就去体验了
宝可梦交换！

entries.label: ChucksWifeBeatChuckText
entries.english:
But you can't use
FLY without thiscity's GYM BADGE. If you beat the
GYM LEADER here,come see me. I'll have a nice
gift for you.
entries.translation:
没有道馆徽章就没有意义。
等你战胜了这个城市的道馆馆主以后再来吧。会给你好东西的。

entries.label: ChucksWifeChubbyText
entries.english:
My husband lost to
you, so he needsto train harder. That's good, since
he was getting alittle chubby.
entries.translation:
呵呵呵，我家的丈夫啊，
输给你以后一直在特训。 这也挺好的，
他的肚子最近太松胯了。

entries.label: ChucksWifeEasierToFlyText
entries.english:
You crossed the
sea to get here? That must have
been hard. It would be much
easier if your #MON knew how
to FLY…
entries.translation:
你渡过了那片海？
那可真是很辛苦啊。 要是有学会飞翔的宝可梦，
你就轻松多了……

entries.label: ChucksWifeFlySpeechText
entries.english:
Teach FLY to your
#MON. You will be able
to FLY instantly to anywhere you 
have visited.
entries.translation:
让宝可梦记住飞翔的话，
就可以一瞬间到达之前去过的地方哦。

entries.label: ChucksWifeGiveHMText
entries.english:
That's CIANWOOD's
GYM BADGE! Then you should
take this HM.
entries.translation:
这是湛蓝的道馆徽章！ 那这个招式学习器
就送给你了，拿去。

entries.label: CianwoodCityLassText
entries.english:
CHUCK, the GYM
LEADER, spars with his fighting #-
MON.
entries.translation:
道馆馆主阿四先生
为了锻炼格斗宝可梦，会亲自和它们对抗。

entries.label: CianwoodCityPokefanMText
entries.english:
Boulders to the
north of town canbe crushed. They may be hiding
something. Your #MON could
use ROCK SMASH tobreak them.
entries.translation:
城镇北方的岩石被打碎后，
可能会出现各种东西。 想破坏岩石的话，
让宝可梦使出碎岩就行了。

entries.label: CianwoodCitySignText
entries.english:
CIANWOOD CITY A Port Surrounded
by Rough Seas
entries.translation:
这里是湛蓝市。
浪涛环绕的海滨城市。

entries.label: CianwoodCityUnusedText
entries.english:
There are several
islands betweenhere and OLIVINE. A mythical sea
creature supposed-ly lives there.
entries.translation:
这里与浅葱之间的海域
不是有几座小岛吗。 有传闻说
海神住在那些岛屿之中。

entries.label: CianwoodCityYoungsterText
entries.english:
If you use FLY,
you can get back to OLIVINE in-
stantly.
entries.translation:
只要使用飞翔，
就能立刻到达浅葱市！

entries.label: CianwoodGymSignText
entries.english:
CIANWOOD CITY
#MON GYM LEADER: CHUCK His Roaring Fists
Do the Talking
entries.translation:
湛蓝市宝可梦道馆
馆主：阿四以猛拳诉说一切的男人

entries.label: CianwoodPharmacySignText
entries.english:
500 Years of
Tradition CIANWOOD CITY
PHARMACY We Await Your
Medicinal Queries
entries.translation:
500年老字号
湛蓝药店期待您前来问药

entries.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioSignText
entries.english:
CIANWOOD CITY
PHOTO STUDIO Take a Snapshot as
a Keepsake!
entries.translation:
湛蓝照相大叔
请拍1张旅行纪念照吧。

entries.label: CianwoodPokeSeerSignText
entries.english:
THE # SEER
AHEAD
entries.translation:
前方是
天眼通之家

entries.label: EusineAfterText
entries.english:
You're amazing,
{PLAYER}! No wonder #MON
gravitate to you. I get it now. I'm going to keep
searching forSUICUNE. I'm sure we'll see
each other again. See you around!
entries.translation:
你真厉害，{PLAYER}！ 难怪宝可梦都被你吸引…… 原来如此。 我会继续寻找水君的。 我们还会再次见面吧。
再会！

entries.label: EusineBeatenText
entries.english:
I hate to admit
it, but you win.
entries.translation: 不甘心啊……我输了！

entries.label: EusineSuicuneText
entries.english:
EUSINE: Yo,
{PLAYER}. Wasn't that
SUICUNE just now? I only caught a
quick glimpse, but I thought I saw
SUICUNE running onthe waves. SUICUNE is beau-
tiful and grand. And it races
through towns and roads at simply
awesome speeds. It's wonderful… I want to see
SUICUNE up close… I've decided. I'll battle you as
a trainer to earnSUICUNE's respect! Come on, {PLAYER}.
Let's battle now!
entries.translation:
水京：哟，{PLAYER}。 刚才那个……
是水君吧？ 虽然只是匆匆一瞥，
但我好像看到水君在海面上飞驰…… 水君真是美丽而飒爽。 它以惊人的速度穿梭在
城镇或道路之间。 真是太迷人了。 我好想站在更近的距离
仔细观察水君啊…… 好吧！ 只要和你这种训练家对战，
我也能得到水君的认可吧。 那就马上对战吧！
上吧，{PLAYER}！

entries.label: BlackbeltLaoAfterText
entries.english:
Fighting #MON
are afraid of psy-chics…
entries.translation:
格斗宝可梦
其实害怕超能力。

entries.label: BlackbeltLaoBeatenText
entries.english: That's shocking!
entries.translation: 震惊！

entries.label: BlackbeltLaoSeenText
entries.english:
We martial artists
fear nothing!
entries.translation:
我们格斗家，
从来都是无所畏惧！

entries.label: BlackbeltLungAfterText
entries.english:
My #MON lost…
My… my pride isshattered…
entries.translation:
引以为豪的宝可梦输了，
我的自信被击碎了……

entries.label: BlackbeltLungBeatenText
entries.english: I got shattered!
entries.translation: 我、我被击碎了……

entries.label: BlackbeltLungSeenText
entries.english:
My raging fists
will shatter your#MON!
entries.translation:
我这对强有力的拳头，
一定会击碎你的宝可梦！

entries.label: BlackbeltNobAfterText
entries.english:
I lost! 
I'm speechless!
entries.translation: 身为败者，无话可说！

entries.label: BlackbeltNobSeenText
entries.english:
Words are useless.
Let your fists dothe talking!
entries.translation:
身无长物！
无需多言，以拳会友！

entries.label: BlackbeltYoshiAfterText
entries.english:
You seem to have a
strong bond withyour #MON too!
entries.translation:
你和宝可梦之间
也有一条强韧的纽带！

entries.label: BlackbeltYoshiBeatenText
entries.english: This isn't real!
entries.translation: 真的吗——！？

entries.label: BlackbeltYoshiSeenText
entries.english:
My #MON and I
are bound togeth-er by friendship. Our bond will
never be broken!
entries.translation:
维系我和宝可梦的纽带
是我们之间的炙热友谊！任谁也无法打破它！

entries.label: ChuckAfterText
entries.english:
WAHAHAH! I enjoyed
battling you! But a loss is a
loss! From now on, I'm
going to train 24hours a day!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈！
我非常开心！ 不过输了就是输了，
明天开始24小时特训！

entries.label: ChuckExplainBadgeText
entries.english:
STORMBADGE makes
all #MON up to L70 obey, even
traded ones. It also lets your
#MON use FLY when you're not in
a battle. Here, take this
too!
entries.translation:
有了打击徽章，
就算是别人送的宝可梦，等级低于70就会听你话。 你也能让宝可梦飞翔了！ 啊，正好，
把这个也拿去吧！

entries.label: ChuckExplainTMText
entries.english:
That is DYNAMIC-
PUNCH. It doesn't always
hit, but when it does, it causes
confusion!
entries.translation:
招式学习器01里面是
爆裂拳！！ 虽然中不中是五五开，
但只要成功击中，就能让对方尝到必定陷入混乱的一击！

entries.label: ChuckIntroText1
entries.english:
WAHAHAH! So you've come
this far! Let me tell you,
I'm tough! My #MON will
crush stones andshatter bones! Watch this!
entries.translation:
不错！
你居然能到这里！先说一句，我非常强！ 我锻炼出的宝可梦
既能粉碎岩石，也能让对手粉身碎骨！ 你瞧好了！

entries.label: ChuckIntroText2
entries.english:
CHUCK: Urggh!
… Oooarrgh!

entries.label: ChuckIntroText3
entries.english:
There! Scared now,
are you? What?
It has nothing to do with #MON?
That's true! Come on. We shall
do battle!
entries.translation:
怎么样！怕了吧！ 什么？你问宝可梦在哪？
我给忘了！那就开始对战吧！

entries.label: ChuckLossText
entries.english:
Wha? Huh?
I lost? How about that!
You're worthy ofSTORMBADGE!
entries.translation:
哎哟？
我怎么输了…… 这可真难为情啊！
很好！你配得上打击徽章！

entries.label: GetStormBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
STORMBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿四那里
得到了打击徽章！

entries.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseLassText
entries.english:
I heard that you
can only see it if you have a SILVER
WING. It must have the
same scent as thecreature.
entries.translation:
据说，如果带了银色之羽，
就可以见到它。 或许是因为
它能闻出自己的气味吧。

entries.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTeacherText
entries.english:
You came from
OLIVINE? Do you remember
the four islandsalong the way? I heard that a 
mythical sea crea-ture is hiding inthem.
entries.translation:
你从浅葱市过来的？
途中有4座小岛对吧？听说里面住着海神呢。

entries.label: CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTwinText
entries.english:
I've heard that
the whirlpools around the islands
are caused by thesea creature. You might need a
special move toget past them.
entries.translation:
有一个说法是
岛屿周围的漩涡其实是海神造成的。 如果没学会特殊的招式，
就无法渡过漩涡。

entries.label: PharmacistDescribeSecretpotionText
entries.english:
My SECRETPOTION is
a tad too strong. I only offer it in
an emergency.
entries.translation:
我家的秘传之药
药性有点猛，要没事儿可千万不能吃。

entries.label: PharmacistGiveSecretpotionText
entries.english:
Your #MON ap-
pear to be fine. Is something wor- 
rying you? … The LIGHTHOUSE
#MON is introuble? I got it! This ought to do
the trick.
entries.translation:
您的宝可梦
看起来没受重伤，那是有其他病痛吗？ …… …… …… 嗨，
原来是灯塔的宝可梦啊。 那好说！
您得用这副药，拿好了，您。

entries.label: ReceivedSecretpotionText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
SECRETPOTION.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
得到了秘传之药！

entries.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_No
entries.english:
Oh, that's too
bad. I thought it would be a great
memento…
entries.translation:
这样啊，有点遗憾呢。
这会是旅行的美好回忆啊。

entries.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_Question
entries.english:
You have magnifi-
cent #MON withyou. How about a photo
for a souvenir?
entries.translation:
你身边的宝可梦不错啊，
怎么样，要不要给宝可梦拍1张纪念照？

entries.label: CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_Yes
entries.english: OK! Big smile now!
entries.translation: 好，准备好了吗。

entries.label: CianwoodGymGuideText
entries.english:
The #MON GYM
trainers here aremacho bullies. If I stick around,
they might comeafter me. Here's some ad-
vice: the GYM LEADER uses the
fighting-type. So you should
confound him withpsychic #MON. Wipe out his #-
MON before they can use their
physical strength. And those boulders
in the middle ofthe GYM? If you don't move
them correctly, you won't reach
the GYM LEADER. If you get stuck,
go outside.
entries.translation:
这儿的宝可梦道馆里面
净是一些莽汉！ 要是站在他们旁边，
我可能也要被打飞。 我要给你一点建议：
道馆馆主使用的是格斗属性宝可梦！ 所以，你应该用
超能力宝可梦迷惑它们！趁着对方还没发力，先发制人！ 还有……
道馆中央有几块巨岩！ 如果不能把它们挪开，
就没机会见到道馆馆主！ 前方没路就先转身离开，
这点也很重要。

entries.label: CianwoodGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! You won!
I could tell bylooking at you!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！赢了吧？
你的表情说明了一切！

entries.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FLassText
entries.english:
Did you meet the
#MANIAC? He's always brag-
ging about hisrare #MON.
entries.translation:
你见过这里的狂热迷吗？ 他好像有稀有的宝可梦，
总是在那里显摆。

entries.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
I love showing off
the #MON that I've raised.
Don't you? I'm going to get
into a bunch of battles, and show
off my #MON!
entries.translation:
自己培育出来的宝可梦，
当然很想展示给别人看！ 我要在超多的对战中，
向大家展示我的宝可梦！

entries.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText1
entries.english:
Don't you get the
urge to show off your #MON to
friends? I wish I could
show the #MON I raised to my pal
in VIOLET.
entries.translation:
说起自己的宝可梦，
那当然是要给别人炫耀啦！ 我真想
让桔梗市的朋友看到我培育出来的宝可梦……

entries.label: CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText2
entries.english:
I've been battling
my pal in VIOLET using a MOBILE
ADAPTER link. I'm down 5-7
against him. I'vegotta crank it up!
entries.translation:
我最近用移动适配器
和身处桔梗市的朋友进行了连接对战。 目前5胜7败！
好戏这才开始呢！

entries.label: CinnabarIslandBlueText
entries.english:
Who are you? Well, it's plain
to see that you'rea trainer… My name's BLUE. I was once the
CHAMPION, although it was for only a
short time… That meddling RED
did me in… Anyway, what do
you want? You want to challenge me or
something? …I hate to say
it, but I'm not in the mood for a
battle now. Take a good look
around you… A volcano erupts,
and just like that, a whole town
disappears. We can go on win-
ning and losing in #MON. But if
nature so much as twitches, we can
lose in a second. … That's the way it
is… But, anyway, I'm
still a trainer. If I see a strong
opponent, it makesme want to battle. If you want to
battle me, come tothe VIRIDIAN GYM. I'll take you on
then.
entries.translation:
你哪位？
是宝可梦训练家吧，这点倒是一目了然…… 我的名字是青绿！
曾经当过冠军的男人！虽然没当太久……都怪赤红那个混蛋，就知道给我碍事……！ 说起来，你来干嘛的？
难道想和我对战？ ……不好意思，
我现在没那个心情。 你看看这里的惨况…… 只是一场小型火山爆发，
就让整个城市蒸发了。 不论宝可梦对战
是输还是赢，大自然随便哆嗦一下，就能让我们一败涂地…… …… …… ……
…… …… ……算了，我毕竟也是训练家。要是遇见强者，当然也会技痒。 你要是想找我对战，
那就来常青道馆吧。到时候自然会和你交手的。

entries.label: CinnabarIslandGymSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… CINNABAR GYM has
relocated to SEA-FOAM ISLANDS. BLAINE
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张纸条！ 红莲镇的道馆
搬到双子岛去了……夏伯

entries.label: CinnabarIslandSignText
entries.english:
CINNABAR ISLAND The Fiery Town of
Burning Desire
entries.translation:
这里是红莲镇。
红莲即是热情的鲜红之色。

entries.label: CinnabarPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
CINNABAR GYM's
BLAINE apparently lives alone in the
SEAFOAM ISLANDScave…
entries.translation:
红莲道馆的夏伯
现在好像独自待在双子岛的洞窟里……

entries.label: CinnabarPokecenter1FFisherText
entries.english:
It's been a year
since the volcanoerupted.
entries.translation:
这里的火山爆发之后
已经过去一年了。

entries.label: .FriendReadyText
entries.english:
Your friend is
ready.
entries.translation: 对方完全准备好了！

entries.label: CopycatsHouse1FBlisseyText
entries.english: BLISSEY: Bliisii!
entries.translation: 幸福蛋：幸～福～！

entries.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText
entries.english:
My daughter is so
self-centered… She only has a few
friends.
entries.translation:
我家闺女啊，
真的是从小给惯坏了……朋友也没几个。

entries.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
She recently lost
the # DOLL that a boy gave her
three years ago. Ever since then,
she's gotten evenbetter at mimicry…
entries.translation:
她把皮皮玩偶弄丢了，
那是一个男孩三年前送的。 从那以后，
她就沉浸在模仿练习中……

entries.label: CopycatsHouse1FPokefanMText
entries.english:
My daughter likes
to mimic people. Her mimicry has
earned her the nickname COPYCAT
around here.
entries.translation:
我女儿喜欢模仿这一点
真的让我非常头疼……！ 因为她没事就去捉弄别人，
周围的人都叫她“模仿少女”！

entries.label: CopycatText_ExplainPass
entries.english:
COPYCAT: That's
the PASS for theMAGNET TRAIN. The rail company
man gave me that when they tore
down our old housefor the STATION.
entries.translation:
模仿少女：想乘磁浮列车
就要用定期月票！ 之前住的家被改建成
磁浮列车车站的时候，铁路公司的人就把这个送给我了。

entries.label: CopycatText_Female_1
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Hi. You
must like #MON. {PLAYER}: No, not
me. I asked you. {PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：你好啊！
你说你喜欢宝可梦？ {PLAYER}：不是说我
我是在问你啊！ {PLAYER}：……什么呀！
你真是个奇怪的女孩子！

entries.label: CopycatText_Female_2
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Hi. Did
you really loseyour # DOLL? {PLAYER}: You'll
really give me a rail PASS if I
find it for you? {PLAYER}: Sure,
I'll look for it! You think you lost
it when you werein VERMILION?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：喂喂！
听说你弄丢了皮皮玩偶，这是真的吗？ {PLAYER}：找到的话，
你会送我定期月票？ {PLAYER}：那么，
我就帮你找回来吧！ 好像是当初
去枯叶市的时候不见的吧？

entries.label: CopycatText_Female_3
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Thank you
for the rail PASS! {PLAYER}: …Pardon? {PLAYER}: Is it
really that fun to copy what I say
and do?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：谢谢你
送我定期月票！ {PLAYER}：……干～嘛？ {PLAYER}：模仿我
有那么愉快嘛？

entries.label: CopycatText_GiveDoll
entries.english:
COPYCAT: Yay!
That's my CLEFAIRY# DOLL! See the tear where
the right leg is sewn on? That's
proof!
entries.translation:
模仿少女：哇——！
我的皮皮玩偶！它的右腿有道伤痕！这就是证据！

entries.label: CopycatText_GivePass
entries.english:
OK. Here's the
MAGNET TRAIN PASSlike I promised!
entries.translation:
之前说好的，拿去！
这是定期月票哦！

entries.label: CopycatText_ItsAScream
entries.english:
COPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!
entries.translation:
模仿少女：嗯……！
非～常愉快哦！

entries.label: CopycatText_Male_1
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Hi! Do
you like #MON? {PLAYER}: Uh, no, I
just asked you. {PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：呀，你好啊！
你喜欢宝可梦嘛？ {PLAYER}：不是说我
我是在问你啊！ {PLAYER}：……算了，
你这人真奇怪！

entries.label: CopycatText_Male_2
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
I heard that you lost your favorite
# DOLL. {PLAYER}: If I find
it, you'll give mea rail PASS? {PLAYER}: I'll go
find it for you. You think you lost
it when you wentto VERMILION CITY?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：呀，你好啊！
你弄丢了皮皮玩偶，一定很难过吧！ {PLAYER}：找到的话，
你会送我定期月票？ {PLAYER}：那么，
我就帮你去找吧！ 好像是当初
去枯叶市的时候不见的！

entries.label: CopycatText_Male_3
entries.english:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks a lot forthe rail PASS! {PLAYER}: Pardon? {PLAYER}: Is it
that fun to mimicmy every move?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}：呀！
谢谢你送我定期月票！ {PLAYER}：……干～嘛？ {PLAYER}：模仿别人
有那么愉快吗？

entries.label: CopycatText_QuickMimicking
entries.english:
COPYCAT: Hmm?
Quit mimicking? But that's my
favorite hobby!
entries.translation:
模仿少女：……干嘛？
你叫我不要随便模仿别人？ 可惜我的兴趣爱好
就是模仿别人呀！

entries.label: CopycatText_Worried
entries.english:
COPYCAT: Pardon? I shouldn't decide
what you shoulddo? But I'm really
worried… What ifsomeone finds it?
entries.translation:
模仿少女：……干嘛？
你叫我不要自作主张？ 可是我真的很难过啊……
大概被别人捡走了吧……？

entries.label: CopycatsDodrioText1
entries.english: DODRIO: Gii giii!
entries.translation: 嘟嘟利：叽～叽～！

entries.label: CopycatsDodrioText2
entries.english:
MIRROR, MIRROR ON
THE WALL, WHO'S THE FAIREST ONE OF
ALL?
entries.translation:
……魔镜啊魔镜！
告诉我这个世界上最美丽的女孩是谁？

entries.label: CopycatsHouse2FDollText
entries.english:
This is a rare
#MON! Huh? It's only a doll…
entries.translation:
这是稀有的宝可梦！？
……哎呀？只是布偶。

entries.label: DanceTheaterCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
That man's always
with his RHYDON. Says he wants a
#MON that canSURF and dance. Is he trying to
make a synchro-nized swimming#MON?
entries.translation:
那边的大叔，
总是和钻角犀兽在一起！ 他希望学会冲浪的宝可梦
也能学会跳舞！ 他可能是打算让宝可梦
进行花样游泳吧……

entries.label: DanceTheaterFancyPanelText
entries.english:
It's a fancy panel
that's decoratedwith flowers.
entries.translation:
这个屏风看起来很贵，
上面画着各种季节的花！

entries.label: DanceTheaterGrannyText
entries.english:
The KIMONO GIRLS
are so beautiful… But they have to
go through rigor-ous training. And they have to
learn to follow customs before ap-
pearing in public. But if you love
something, any-thing is possible.
entries.translation:
和服女孩真漂亮…… 但是想要出来表演的话，
必须经过严格的训练，还要遵守很多规矩！ 不过喜爱的力量是无敌的。

entries.label: KimonoGirlKuniAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I trained a lot,
so I thought I was a capable trainer.
I guess I'm not.
entries.translation:
每天都在努力练习，
还以为自己已经娴熟了。看来奴家还差得远呢。

entries.label: KimonoGirlKuniBeatenText
entries.english:
You're stronger
than you look.
entries.translation:
真是抱歉，
奴家刚刚以貌取人了。

entries.label: KimonoGirlKuniSeenText
entries.english:
Oh, you're a cute
trainer. Would youlike to battle?
entries.translation:
哎呀，有位可爱的训练家。
是来找奴家对战的吗？

entries.label: KimonoGirlMikiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I can keep dancing
because there are people who enjoy
what I do. My #MON keep my
spirits up too.
entries.translation:
有宝可梦陪在身边，
还有这么多人欣赏奴家的舞蹈，奴家一定会继续努力的。

entries.label: KimonoGirlMikiBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, you're good
at #MON too.
entries.translation:
嗯……
你的宝可梦也很强呢。

entries.label: KimonoGirlMikiSeenText
entries.english:
Do you like my
dancing? I'm goodat #MON too.
entries.translation:
您看奴家这舞如何？
奴家的宝可梦也很强哦。

entries.label: KimonoGirlNaokoAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I enjoyed that
bout. I would liketo see you again.
entries.translation:
感谢您愿意陪奴家对战。
欢迎下次再来。

entries.label: KimonoGirlNaokoBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, you are very
strong.
entries.translation: 真厉害啊！

entries.label: KimonoGirlNaokoSeenText
entries.english:
You have lovely
#MON. May I seethem in battle?
entries.translation:
您的宝可梦好很不错呀，
能让奴家好好瞧瞧吗？

entries.label: KimonoGirlSayoAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Rhythm is impor-
tant for both dancing and #-
MON.
entries.translation:
跳舞也好，宝可梦也好，
节奏感很重要。

entries.label: KimonoGirlSayoBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, so close!
I almost had you.
entries.translation:
真是可惜呢。
奴家差点儿就能赢了。

entries.label: KimonoGirlSayoSeenText
entries.english:
I always dance
with my #MON. Of course, I also
train them.
entries.translation:
奴家和珍爱的宝可梦们
总是在一起跳舞。当然，也会抽空培育它们。

entries.label: KimonoGirlZukiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I put a different
flower in my bar-rette every month.
entries.translation:
说起奴家戴的头花儿，
每月都会换上不同的花哦。

entries.label: KimonoGirlZukiBeatenText
entries.english:
I don't have any
#MON left…
entries.translation:
奴家好像没有
可以拿来战斗的宝可梦了。

entries.label: KimonoGirlZukiSeenText
entries.english:
Isn't my barrette
pretty? Oh. A #MON
battle?
entries.translation:
奴家的头花儿很漂亮吧？
呀，您是来对战的？

entries.label: RhydonText
entries.english:
RHYDON: Gugooh
gugogooh!
entries.translation: 钻角犀兽：咕嗷，咕嗷嗷！

entries.label: SurfGuyElegantKimonoGirlsText
entries.english:
I wish my #MON
were as elegant asthe KIMONO GIRLS…
entries.translation:
真希望我的宝可梦也能
像她们一样高贵优雅。

entries.label: SurfGuyLadGiftText
entries.english:
Lad! If you can
defeat all the KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
entries.translation:
小兄弟！
如果能战胜所有和服女孩，我就送你好东西！

entries.label: SurfGuyLassieGiftText
entries.english:
Lassie, if you can
defeat all the KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
entries.translation:
小姑娘！
如果能战胜所有和服女孩，我就送你好东西！

entries.label: SurfGuyLikeADanceText
entries.english:
The way you bat-
tled, it was likewatching a dance. It was a rare
treat to see! I want you to have
this. Don't worry--take it!
entries.translation:
我刚刚看到了，
你的宝可梦战斗的姿态简直就像跳舞一样优美！ 真是大饱眼福！ 这算我的一点心意，
你尽管收下就是了！

entries.label: SurfGuyNeverLeftAScratchText
entries.english:
Not only are the
KIMONO GIRLS great dancers, they're
also skilled at#MON. I always challenge
them, but I've never even left a
scratch…
entries.translation:
这些和服女孩舞跳得好，
宝可梦也用得溜！ 我总是会挑战她们，
但是完全打不过……

entries.label: SurfGuySurfExplanationText
entries.english:
That's SURF. It's a move that
lets #MON swimacross water.
entries.translation:
这是叫做冲浪的招式。
有了它就能在水面上悠游自如！

entries.label: DarkCaveBlackthornEntrancePharmacistText1
entries.english:
Whoa! You startled
me there! I had my BLACK-
GLASSES on, so I didn't notice you
at all. What am I doing
here? Hey, don't you
worry about it. I'll give you a
pair of BLACK-GLASSES, so forgetyou saw me, OK?
entries.translation:
呜哇！吓了一跳！ 因为我戴着黑色眼镜
完全没注意到你！ 你问我来这里做什么？ 哎呀，怎么说呢……
我把黑色眼镜给你，你就别管我了。

entries.label: DarkCaveBlackthornEntrancePharmacistText2
entries.english:
BLACKGLASSES ups
the power of dark-type moves.
entries.translation:
黑色眼镜……
让宝可梦携带后，能提升恶属性招式的攻击力。

entries.label: DayCareManText_GiveOddEgg
entries.english:
I'm the DAY-CARE
MAN. Do you know about
EGGS? I was raising
#MON with mywife, you see. We were shocked to
find an EGG! How incredible is
that? Well, wouldn't you
like this EGG? Then fine, this is
yours to keep!
entries.translation:
我是培育屋爷爷。
想要了解蛋吗？ 我和奶奶培育宝可梦时
………你猜怎么着！ 竟然出现了蛋！
这可太神奇了。 怎么样？
你是为了蛋才过来的吧？ 呵呵呵，
那就把这个给你吧。

entries.label: DayCareText_ComeAgain
entries.english: Come again.
entries.translation: 请下次再来哟。

entries.label: DayCareText_DescribeOddEgg
entries.english:
I found that when
I was caring for someone's #MON
before. But the trainer
didn't want the EGG, so I'd kept
it around.
entries.translation:
我们之前保管
别人寄放宝可梦时突然发现了这个…… 寄放的训练家
说不需要，我就先自己收下了。

entries.label: DayCareText_GotOddEgg
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
ODD EGG!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从培育屋爷爷那
得到了谜之蛋！

entries.label: DayCareText_PartyFull
entries.english:
You've no room for
this.
entries.translation:
哎呀，
你好像带不了更多了。

entries.label: Text_DayCareManTalksAboutEggTicket
entries.english:
I'm the DAY-CARE
MAN. There's something
new in GOLDENROD called the TRADE
CORNER. I was given an EGG
TICKET that can be traded in for a
ODD EGG. But since we run a
DAY-CARE, we don't need it. You may
as well have it.
entries.translation:
我是培育屋爷爷。
我听说在满金市新建成的交换角落中，有机会获得谜之蛋。 我得到了叫做
“蛋兑换券”的东西…… 我自己有培育屋，
也用不着这东西。 就送给你好了。

entries.label: Text_GrampsLookingForYou
entries.english:
Gramps was looking
for you.
entries.translation:
爷爷
正在找你哦。

entries.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText1
entries.english:
There's something
written here. Read it?
entries.translation:
……笔记本上写了字！
要读吗？

entries.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText2
entries.english:
To my brothers and
sisters: We take pride in
serving #MONtrainers. When trainers talk
to you, give themsomething useful. Love,
MONICA Keep reading?
entries.translation:
……能为宝可梦训练家
提供帮助，是我们一家的荣幸。 如果有训练家搭话，
那就要送他们方便的道具！ 致我的弟弟和妹妹
长女星琪一留…… 要读下一页吗？

entries.label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText3
entries.english:
Monday, MONICA
ROUTE 40 Tuesday, TUSCANY
ROUTE 29 Wednesday, WESLEY
LAKE OF RAGE Thursday, ARTHUR
ROUTE 36 Friday, FRIEDA
ROUTE 32 Saturday, SANTOS
BLACKTHORN CITY Sunday, SUNNY
ROUTE 37
entries.translation:
星期一的星琪一
……40号水道 星期二的星琪二
……29号道路 星期三的星祺三
……愤怒之湖 星期四的星祺四
……36号道路 星期五的星琪五
……32号道路 星期六的星祺六
……烟墨市 星期天的星祺天
……37号道路

entries.label: DiglettsCavePokefanMText
entries.english:
A bunch of DIGLETT
popped out of the ground! That was
shocking.
entries.translation:
之前有很多地鼠
从地底扑了过来！啊——吓死了——！

entries.label: DragonShrineClairThatCantBeText
entries.english: That can't be!
entries.translation: 不可能啊！

entries.label: DragonShrineClairYouPassedText
entries.english:
So how did it go? I guess there's no
point in asking. You did fail? ……………………………… …What? You passed?
entries.translation:
结果如何？ 这个问题真多余……
你肯定不合格啊。…… …… …… …… …… ………… 什么！合格了？

entries.label: DragonShrineClairYoureLyingText
entries.english:
You're lying! Even I haven't
been approved!
entries.translation:
骗人的吧！
就、就连我都还没得到认可啊！

entries.label: DragonShrineClairsGrandfatherText
entries.english:
CLAIR appears to
have learned an invaluable lesson
from you. I thank you as her
grandfather.
entries.translation:
遇见你之后，
小椿的想法好像变了…… 我身为祖父应该感谢你。

entries.label: DragonShrineComeAgainText
entries.english:
Come again, if you
so desire.
entries.translation: 只要你乐意，随时欢迎。

entries.label: DragonShrineElder2Text
entries.english:
It's been quite
some time since a trainer has gained
our MASTER's rareapproval. In fact, not since
Master LANCE.
entries.translation:
在阿渡大人之后，
就再也没见过能被长老认可的人了。

entries.label: DragonShrineElder3Text
entries.english:
You know young
Master LANCE? He looks so much
like our MASTERdid in his youth. It's in their
blood.
entries.translation:
你认识阿渡大人吗？ 阿渡大人长得很像
年轻时候的长老，正所谓血浓于水嘛……

entries.label: DragonShrineElderGreetingText
entries.english:
Hm… Good to see
you here. No need to explain
why you came. CLAIR sent you
here, didn't she? That girl is a
handful… I am sorry, but I
must test you. Not to worry, you
are to answer onlya few questions. Ready?
entries.translation:
嗯……你终于来了。 不必担心，
什么都不说我也明白！你是听了小椿的话，才会来这个祠堂吧？ 真拿那个丫头没办法…… 哎呀……可能有点为难你，
不过我想做点小测试。别紧张，你只用张口回答我的几个问题就行了。 那么，开始吧……

entries.label: DragonShrineElderScoldsClairText
entries.english:
CLAIR… Reflect upon what
it is that you lack and this
child has.
entries.translation:
小椿啊…… 你一定要时刻思考
这个孩子具备而你所没有的品质是什么。

entries.label: DragonShrineHereRisingBadgeText
entries.english:
Here, this is the
RISINGBADGE… Hurry up! Take it!
entries.translation:
这就是升龙徽章……
你赶紧拿走吧！

entries.label: DragonShrineIUnderstandText
entries.english: I-I understand…
entries.translation: 我、我明白了…

entries.label: DragonShrineMustIInformLanceText
entries.english:
CLAIR! This child is
impeccable, inskill and spirit! Admit defeat and
confer the RISING-BADGE! …Or must I inform
LANCE of this?
entries.translation:
这不是小椿吗！ 眼前的这个孩子
技巧纯熟、心地善良。小椿，你还是认了吧，不要吝惜升龙徽章了！ 要不然……
我就把这件事告诉阿渡！

entries.label: DragonShrinePartyFullText
entries.english:
Hm? Your #MON
party is full.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
同行宝可梦到达上限了。

entries.label: DragonShrinePassedTestText
entries.english:
Hm… I see… You care deeply
for #MON. Very commendable. That conviction is
what is important! {PLAYER}, don't
lose that belief. It will see you
through at the#MON LEAGUE.
entries.translation:
嗯，原来如此…… 想必你一定
非常重视宝可梦啊…… 佩服，佩服。
你的想法真是难能可贵！ {PLAYER}啊，
一定要珍惜现在的想法。只要你能一直记着它，就算去了宝可梦联盟，也可以一往无前！

entries.label: DragonShrinePlayerReceivedDratiniText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
DRATINI!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从长老那里
得到了迷你龙！

entries.label: DragonShrinePlayerReceivedRisingBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
RISINGBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小椿那里
得到了升龙徽章！

entries.label: DragonShrineQuestion1Text
entries.english:
What are #MON
to you?
entries.translation:
对你而言，
宝可梦是什么？

entries.label: DragonShrineQuestion2Text
entries.english:
What helps you to
win battles?
entries.translation:
想打赢宝可梦对战的话，
必须具备什么？

entries.label: DragonShrineQuestion3Text
entries.english:
What kind of
trainer do youwish to battle?
entries.translation:
你向往的对手
是怎样的宝可梦训练家？

entries.label: DragonShrineQuestion4Text
entries.english:
What is most
important forraising #MON?
entries.translation:
培养宝可梦
最重要的事是什么？

entries.label: DragonShrineQuestion5Text
entries.english:
Strong #MON.
Weak #MON. Which is more
important?
entries.translation:
你更重视强大的宝可梦
还是弱小的宝可梦？

entries.label: DragonShrineRightAnswerText
entries.english: Oh, I understand…
entries.translation: 嗯，原来如此……

entries.label: DragonShrineRisingBadgeExplanationText
entries.english:
RISINGBADGE will
enable your #MON to use the
move for climbingwaterfalls. Also, all #MON
will recognize you as a trainer and
obey your every command without
question.
entries.translation:
拥有升龙徽章以后，
无论怎样的瀑布都能攀上去了……然后，所有的宝可梦都会承认你这个训练家，会服从一切命令……

entries.label: DragonShrineRivalIsInTrainingText
entries.english:
A boy close to
your age is intraining here. He is much like
CLAIR when she was younger. It is a
little worrisome…
entries.translation:
现在有个和你年纪相仿
的少年来修行了。 他很像以前的小椿，
让人有点担心啊……

entries.label: DragonShrineSymbolicDragonText
entries.english:
Dragon #MON are
symbolic of ourclan. You have shown
that you can be entrusted with
one.
entries.translation:
龙宝可梦是
我们一族的象征！ 你应该能堪重任。

entries.label: DragonShrineTakeThisDratiniText
entries.english:
Hm… Good to see
you here. Your arrival is
most fortunate. I have something
for you. Take this DRATINI
as proof that I have recognized
your worth.
entries.translation:
嗯……你终于来了。 来得正好，
有东西要交给你！ 这是被我认可的证明。
请你带上迷你龙吧！

entries.label: DragonShrineWrongAnswerText1
entries.english:
Hah? I didn't
quite catch that…
entries.translation:
哈？
我没有听清楚……

entries.label: DragonShrineWrongAnswerText2
entries.english:
What was it you
said?
entries.translation: 你说了什么？

entries.label: ClairText_DescribeDragonbreathDragonDen
entries.english:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH. No, it doesn't
have anything todo with my breath. If you don't want
it, you don't haveto take it.
entries.translation:
这里面是——
龙息。 ……不是那个最辣辣椒！
如果你不需要，我也不会强迫你的。

entries.label: ClairText_GiveDragonbreathDragonDen
entries.english:
CLAIR: I'm sorry
about this. Here, take this as
my apology.
entries.translation:
小椿：我很抱歉……
就用这个补偿你吧。

entries.label: ClairText_NoRoom
entries.english:
Oh? You don't have
any room for this. I'm going back to
the GYM, so make room, then come
see me there.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
好像拿不下更多了呢……我要回道馆了，你整理好了就去那找我。

entries.label: ClairText_Wait
entries.english: Wait!
entries.translation: 请等一下！

entries.label: ClairText_WhatsTheMatterDragonDen
entries.english:
CLAIR: What's the
matter? Aren't you going on to the
#MON LEAGUE? Do you know how to
get there? From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN. Then SURF east to
#MON LEAGUE. The route there is
very tough. Don't you dare
lose at the #-MON LEAGUE! If you do, I'll
feel even worse about having lost
to you! Give it everything
you've got.
entries.translation:
小椿：你愣着干什么？
该去宝可梦联盟了吧？ 知道该往哪走吗？ 如果从这里出发……
那就先去若叶镇吧！ 然后就用冲浪
一直朝着东方前进，就能到达宝可梦联盟了。但是，这段路可不平坦。 还有啊……
我不许你输给宝可梦联盟！ 要不然，
我这个手下败将情何以堪！ ……加油啊！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCaraAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Soon I'm going to
get permission from our MASTER to
use dragons. When I do, I'm
going to become an admirable dragon
trainer and gain our MASTER's
approval.
entries.translation:
长老大人马上就会
许可我使用龙宝可梦了。 得到了许可之后，
我要成为出色的龙使者，被长老认可的龙使者！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCaraBeatenText
entries.english: Oh yikes, I lost!
entries.translation: 讨厌，我输掉了！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCaraSeenText
entries.english:
You shouldn't be
in here!
entries.translation:
这种地方，
可不是你该进来的！

entries.label: CooltrainermDarinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The SHRINE ahead
is home to the MASTER of our
dragon-user clan. You're not allowed
to just go in!
entries.translation:
我们龙使者一族的
长老大人正在前面那个祠堂之中…… 我可不准你随便闯进去，
天晓得你会干什么！

entries.label: CooltrainermDarinBeatenText
entries.english: S-strong!
entries.translation: 太、太强了！

entries.label: CooltrainermDarinSeenText
entries.english:
You! How dare you
enter uninvited!
entries.translation:
你是什么人！
不准擅自进来！

entries.label: DragonShrineSignpostText
entries.english:
DRAGON SHRINE A shrine honoring
the dragon #MON said to have lived
in DRAGON'S DEN.
entries.translation:
龙之祠堂 里面供奉着曾经
住在龙穴的龙宝可梦。

entries.label: RivalText_Training1
entries.english:
…
What? {PLAYER}? …No, I won't
battle you now… My #MON aren't
ready to beat you. I can't push them
too hard now. I have to be dis-
ciplined to become the greatest #-
MON trainer…
entries.translation:
…… …… ……
原来是{PLAYER}啊…… ……不好意思，
我没打算当你的对手。 我手上这些宝可梦
现在还赢不了你，我才不会自讨没趣。 要不然，
我永远也无法成为最强的训练家……

entries.label: RivalText_Training2
entries.english:
… Whew… Learn to stay out
of my way…

entries.label: Text_FoundDragonFang
entries.english:
{PLAYER} found
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}找到了
{STRBUF}！

entries.label: Text_NoRoomForDragonFang
entries.english:
But {PLAYER} can't
carry any moreitems.
entries.translation:
但是，{PLAYER}
已经拿不下更多道具了！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedTM24
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM24.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小椿那里
得到了招式学习器24！

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
It was like having
to battle LANCE.
entries.translation:
仿佛是回到了从前，
和阿渡哥哥对战——

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia1BeatenText
entries.english: Ouchies.
entries.translation: 真痛啊——

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia1SeenText
entries.english:
It's a stranger we
don't know.
entries.translation: 没见过你呀——

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
We'll tell on you. MASTER will be
angry with you.
entries.translation:
我要告诉爷爷，
让他狠狠骂你一顿——

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia2BeatenText
entries.english: Meanie.
entries.translation: 太过分了——

entries.label: TwinsLeaandpia2SeenText
entries.english: Who are you?
entries.translation: 你是谁啊——

entries.label: AcademyBlackboardText2
entries.english: Read which topic?
entries.translation: 要阅读哪个主题？

entries.label: AcademyBlackboardText
entries.english:
The blackboard
describes #MON status changes in
battle.
entries.translation:
黑板上写着：
宝可梦对战时可能会出现的异常身体状况。

entries.label: AcademyBurnText
entries.english:
A burn steadily
consumes HP. It also reduces
attack power. A burn lingers
after battle. Use a BURN HEAL as
the cure.
entries.translation:
灼伤时体力会不断减少，
攻击力也会降低。 即使战斗结束了，
也会一直处于灼伤状态。用灼伤药来治疗吧。

entries.label: AcademyEarlIntroText
entries.english:
EARL, I am! Wonderful are
#MON, yes! Teach you I will
to be a bettertrainer! What you want to
know? Want to bea winner is you?
entries.translation:
我是初始～！
宝可梦是最～好的！ 想要变强的话，
我会教你各种知～识。 想了解什么？
想知道怎么做才会变强噜？

entries.label: AcademyEarlNoMoreToTeachText
entries.english:
Oh! Smart student
you are! Nothingmore do I teach! Good to #MON
you must be!
entries.translation:
哇～你是好学生！
已经没东西可以教你了噜～ 请你和捕捉到的宝可梦
好好相处哦～！

entries.label: AcademyEarlTeachHowToRaiseWellText
entries.english:
Fine! Teach you,
I will! If #MON come
out in battle even briefly, some EXP.
Points it gets. At top of list put
weak #MON. Switch in battle
quick! This way, weak
#MON strongbecome!
entries.translation:
那么～
我就来指导你吧～！ 对战的时候，
只要宝可梦露过一次脸就能分享到经验值～！ 把弱小的宝可梦放到
同行宝可梦的首位，对战的时候立刻替换掉！ 这样弱小的宝可梦
也能得到成长噜～！

entries.label: AcademyEarlTeachHowToWinText
entries.english:
Good! Teach you,
I will! In battle, #MON
top on list jumpout first! Change order in
list, make battleeasy, maybe! More from me you
want to hear?
entries.translation:
那么～
我就来指导你吧～！ 对战的时候
同行宝可梦之中首位的那只宝可梦会头一个出场～！ 调整一下列表的排序，
对战会变得更顺利噜～！ 还有什么想问的噜？

entries.label: AcademyEarlTeachMoreText
entries.english:
So, want to know
how to raise#MON well?
entries.translation:
那么～
你想知道怎么做才能成功培育宝可梦？

entries.label: AcademyFreezeText
entries.english:
If your #MON is
frozen, it can'tdo a thing. It remains frozen
after battle. Thaw it out with
an ICE HEAL.
entries.translation:
冻住了的话，
会变得无法行动。 即使战斗结束了，
也会一直处于冰冻状态。用解冻药来治疗吧。

entries.label: AcademyNotebookText1
entries.english:
Before throwing a
# BALL, weakenthe target first. A poisoned or
burned #MON iseasier to catch. Keep reading?
entries.translation:
投出精灵球之前，
用宝可梦的招式使对手陷入中毒、灼伤等状态，会好捉很多！ 还要往下看吗？

entries.label: AcademyNotebookText2
entries.english:
Some moves may
cause confusion. Confusion may make
a #MON attackitself. Leaving battle
clears up anyconfusion. Keep reading?
entries.translation:
另外，有些宝可梦的招式
能让对手陷入混乱。 一旦陷入混乱状态，
有时会不小心误伤到自己。 只要脱离一次战斗，
就能恢复原样…… 还要往下看吗？

entries.label: AcademyNotebookText3
entries.english:
People who catch
and use #MON in battle are
#MON trainers. They are expected
to visit #MON GYMS and defeat
other trainers. The next page
is… Blank! Boy: E-he-he… I haven't written
anymore…
entries.translation:
像这样培育捕捉的宝可梦、
并让它们进行对战的人就是宝可梦训练家。 训练家的目标是
战胜各个道馆中那些强大的训练家！ 然后就是……
一片空白！ 少年：哎嘿嘿……
接下来就啥也没写了……

entries.label: AcademyNotebookText
entries.english:
It's this kid's
notebook… Catch #MON
using # BALLS. Up to six can be
in your party. Keep reading?
entries.translation:
是这个孩子的笔记本…… 用精灵球
捕捉到宝可梦之后，一次可以带6只同行。 还要往下看吗？

entries.label: AcademyParalysisText
entries.english:
Paralysis reduces
speed and mayprevent movement. It remains after
battle, so usea PARLYZ HEAL.
entries.translation:
麻痹的话，速度会降低，
有时还会使不出招式。 即使战斗结束了，
也会一直处于麻痹状态。用解麻药来治疗吧。

entries.label: AcademyPoisonText
entries.english:
If poisoned, a
#MON steadilyloses HP. Poison lingers
after the battle, and HP is lost as
you walk. To cure it, use an
ANTIDOTE.
entries.translation:
中毒的话，
体力会不断地减少。 对战之后毒素不会消退，
每走几步体力就会减少。用解毒药来治疗吧。

entries.label: AcademySleepText
entries.english:
If asleep, your
#MON can't makea move. A sleeping #MON
doesn't wake upafter battle. Wake it up with
an AWAKENING.
entries.translation:
睡着了的话，
这段时间会无法攻击。 即使战斗结束了，
也会一直处于睡眠状态。用解眠药来治疗吧。

entries.label: AcademyStickerMachineText
entries.english:
This super machine
prints data out as stickers!
entries.translation:
这台机器非常厉害，
能把各种资料打印成贴纸！

entries.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid1Text
entries.english:
I traded my best
#MON to theguy beside me.
entries.translation:
我把自己喜欢的宝可梦
送给了旁边的小朋友！

entries.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid2Text
entries.english:
Huh? The #MON I
just got is hold-ing something!
entries.translation:
哎呀？传送过来的宝可梦
携带了道具！？

entries.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster1Text
entries.english:
I'm taking notes
of the teacher'slecture. I'd better copy
the stuff on theblackboard too.
entries.translation:
我把老师说的话
写在笔记本上背下来了！ 黑板上写的东西，
也要抄到笔记本上才行……

entries.label: EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster2Text
entries.english:
A #MON holding
a BERRY will healitself in battle. Many other items
can be held by#MON… It sure is tough
taking notes…
entries.translation:
……让宝可梦携带树果，
它就会自动回复体力。 还有很多可以
让宝可梦携带的道具…… 老老实实做笔记
可真辛苦……

entries.label: BurnedTowerSignText
entries.english:
BURNED TOWER It was destroyed
by a mysteriousfire. Please stay away,
as it is unsafe.
entries.translation:
烧焦塔 在神秘的大火中焚毁。
里面非常危险，请勿靠近。

entries.label: EcruteakCityFisherText
entries.english:
I heard a rumor
about OLIVINELIGHTHOUSE. The #MON that
serves as the beacon fell ill.
Sounds like theyare in trouble.
entries.translation:
这是听别人说的：
浅葱市的灯塔里…… 有只照亮黑暗的宝可梦，
它现在病得很重。

entries.label: EcruteakCityFisherText_JasmineReturned
entries.english:
The #MON at
OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSEhas been cured. Boats can safely
sail out to sea atnight again.
entries.translation:
我听说浅葱灯塔的
那只宝可梦痊愈了，这下晚上也能出船了。

entries.label: EcruteakCityGramps1Text
entries.english:
ECRUTEAK used to
have two towers: one each in the
east and west.
entries.translation:
以前好像有两座塔
分别位于缘朱东西二侧……

entries.label: EcruteakCityGramps2Text
entries.english:
Ah, child.
Have you learned to dance like the
KIMONO GIRLS? If you go to their
DANCE THEATER, an odd old man will
give you somethingnice, I hear.
entries.translation:
呵、呵，你有没有学过
年轻和服女孩的舞蹈？ 现在去舞场的话，
可以看到一个奇怪的客人，他好像会送出好东西呢。

entries.label: EcruteakCityGramps3Text
entries.english:
In the distant
past… This tower burned
in a fire. Three nameless #MON
perished in it. A rainbow-colored
#MON descended from the sky and
resurrected them… It's a legend that
has been passed down by ECRUTEAK
GYM LEADERS. Me? I was a trainer
way back when.Hohoho!
entries.translation:
很久很久以前…… 这个塔里发生了大火灾，
有三只无名的宝可梦死在了大火之中。 虹色的宝可梦从天而降
将他们复活…… 这是缘朱道馆的馆主
代代相传的传说。 你问我是谁？ 我在很久很久以前，
也是一名训练家。呵、呵、呵、呵。

entries.label: EcruteakCityLass1Text
entries.english:
I'm going to prac-
tice at the DANCE THEATER. Care to
join me?
entries.translation:
我接下来要去舞场
练习舞蹈，你要不要也去看看？

entries.label: EcruteakCityLass2Text
entries.english:
The tower that
used to be here… My grandma told me
it used to be muchtaller.
entries.translation:
这是奶奶告诉我的：
这里的这座塔…… 在很久以前，
非常非常高。

entries.label: EcruteakCityLass2Text_ReleasedBeasts
entries.english:
Three big #MON
ran off in differ-ent directions.What were they?
entries.translation:
有三只巨大的宝可梦
往各个方向跑走了，那是什么啊？

entries.label: EcruteakCitySignText
entries.english:
ECRUTEAK CITY
A Historical City Where the Past
Meets the Present
entries.translation:
这里是缘朱市。
过去与未来之间的历史名城。

entries.label: EcruteakCityYoungsterText
entries.english:
I hear #MON are
rampaging at the LAKE OF RAGE. I'd
like to see that.
entries.translation:
听别人说在愤怒之湖里，
有宝可梦在大闹特闹，真想去看看。

entries.label: EcruteakDanceTheaterSignText
entries.english:
ECRUTEAK DANCE
THEATER
entries.translation:
缘朱舞场
正式名称：歌舞练场

entries.label: EcruteakGymSignText
entries.english:
ECRUTEAK CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: MORTY The Mystic Seer of
the Future
entries.translation:
缘朱市宝可梦道馆
馆主：松叶千里眼的修验者

entries.label: TinTowerSignText
entries.english:
TIN TOWER A legendary #-
MON is said toroost here.
entries.translation:
铃铛塔 据说传说的宝可梦
会降临于此。

entries.label: UnusedMissingDaughterText
entries.english:
Oh, no. Oh, no… My daughter is
missing. No… She couldn't
have gone to theBURNED TOWER. I told her not to
go near it… People seem to
disappear there… Oh, what should I
do…?
entries.translation:
好担心啊……
我女儿不见了。 难不成……
她去了烧焦塔？ 我都跟她说了，
去了那儿会被神隐的……这可如何是好啊……

entries.label: EcruteakGymClosedText
entries.english:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is absent. Sorry, but you'll
have to leave. Hohohoho.
entries.translation:
馆主松叶现在不在里面。
非常抱歉，你请回吧。 呵、呵、呵、呵。

entries.label: EcruteakGymGuideText
entries.english:
The trainers here
have secret mo-tives. If you win, they
may tell you some deep secrets about
ECRUTEAK.
entries.translation:
听说这里的训练家
因为一些神秘的原因，都在不断地修行。 如果赢了他们，
或许能得知缘朱的秘密吧。

entries.label: EcruteakGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Whew, {PLAYER}.
You did great! I was cowering in
the corner out ofpure terror!

entries.label: MediumGraceAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Fine. I shall tell
you the secret of the invisible
floor. The path is right
before our eyes!
entries.translation:
好吧，
我告诉你隐形地板的秘密。 真正的道路
就在我们眼前！

entries.label: MediumGraceBeatenText
entries.english: Wha-what?
entries.translation: 怎、怎么会！

entries.label: MediumGraceSeenText
entries.english:
Stumped by our in-
visible floor? Defeat me if you
want a hint!
entries.translation:
隐形地板让你很惶恐吧？
如果你能战胜我，我会给你点小提示！

entries.label: MediumMarthaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The one who wants
to win most--will!
entries.translation:
越渴望胜利的人，
越容易获得最终胜利！

entries.label: MediumMarthaBeatenText
entries.english: I, I, I lost!
entries.translation: 输、输了——！

entries.label: MediumMarthaSeenText
entries.english: I shall win!
entries.translation: 我、我要赢——！！

entries.label: MortyFightDoneText
entries.english:
I see… Your journey has
taken you to far-away places. And you have wit-
nessed much morethan I. I envy you for
that…
entries.translation:
这样啊， 你去过了很多地方，
见识过很多我不知道的事物…… 我还挺羡慕你的。

entries.label: MortyIntroText
entries.english:
Good of you to
have come. Here in ECRUTEAK,
#MON have beenrevered. It's said that a
rainbow-colored #MON will come
down to appear before a truly
powerful trainer. I believed that
tale, so I have secretly trained
here all my life. As a result, I can
now see whatothers cannot. Just a bit more… With a little
more, I could see a future in which
I meet the #MONof rainbow colors. You're going to
help me reach thatlevel!
entries.translation:
你来得正好。 在缘朱市，
人们从古至今一直把宝可梦奉为神明。 然后还流传着一个说法：
虹色的宝可梦会在那些有实力的训练家面前降临…… 从出生开始就一直在此
进行秘密修行的我对这个传说深信不疑。 多亏了多年的修行，
我现在已经能看见其他人所看不见的东西。 只差一点了…… 我只差一点
就能见到虹色的宝可梦。我几乎能预见这样的未来。 为了实现我的梦想
我要继续修行，就请你来辅助我吧！

entries.label: MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech
entries.english:
By having FOG-
BADGE, #MON up to L50 will obey
you. Also, #MON that
know SURF will be able to use that
move anytime. I want you to have
this too.
entries.translation:
只要带上魅影徽章，
等级50以内的宝可梦全部都会服从于你。 另外，叫做冲浪的招式
也可以使用了。 接下来要送你这个。

entries.label: MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech
entries.english:
It's SHADOW BALL.
It causes damage and may reduce
SPCL.DEF. Use it if it
appeals to you.
entries.translation:
这是暗影球。 不只是能攻击对方，
有时还能降低其特殊防御。 按你的喜好去使用吧。

entries.label: MortyWinLossText
entries.english:
I'm not good
enough yet… All right. This
BADGE is yours.
entries.translation:
还不够吗…… 我知道了，
这个徽章归你了！

entries.label: SageJeffreyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Where did #MON
come from?
entries.translation: 宝可梦到底是从哪来的呢？

entries.label: SageJeffreyBeatenText
entries.english:
Wins and losses, I
experienced both.
entries.translation:
赢了很多次，
也输过很多次。

entries.label: SageJeffreySeenText
entries.english:
I spent the spring
with my #MON. Then summer, fall
and winter… Then spring came
again. We have lived together
for a long time.
entries.translation:
与宝可梦一起度过春天、
夏天、秋天、冬天，然后又是一年春…… 就这样，我们与宝可梦
共度了无数寒暑。

entries.label: SagePingAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We use only ghost-
type #MON. No normal-type
attack can harmthem!
entries.translation:
我放出来的宝可梦
全都是幽灵属性的。 一般属性的攻击
无法对它们造成伤害！

entries.label: SagePingBeatenText
entries.english: Ah! Well done!
entries.translation: 哦，还挺厉害！

entries.label: SagePingSeenText
entries.english:
Can you inflict
any damage on our#MON?
entries.translation:
能不能让我们的宝可梦
对你造成一些伤害？

entries.label: Text_ReceivedFogBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
FOGBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从松叶那里
得到了魅影徽章！

entries.label: EcruteakHistoryBookText
entries.english:
HISTORY OF
ECRUTEAK Want to read it?
entries.translation: 缘朱历史…… 要读吗？

entries.label: EcruteakItemfinderAdventureText
entries.english:
Ah. You're on an
adventure withyour #MON? Well, what's an
adventure withouttreasure hunting? Am I right, or am
I right?
entries.translation:
喔！你和宝可梦
正在四处探险啊。 去探险的话，当然要寻宝！
你也这么认为吧？

entries.label: EcruteakItemfinderToEachHisOwnText
entries.english:
Oh… To each his
own, I suppose…
entries.translation:
这样啊……
人各有志嘛。

entries.label: EcruteakItemfinderTrueSpiritText
entries.english:
Good! You under-
stand the true spirit of adven-
ture. I like that! Take
this with you.
entries.translation:
哦！
你也很懂男人的浪漫啊。 我看好你！
这个就给你了！

entries.label: EcruteakThreeMonText
entries.english:
ECRUTEAK was also
home to three #MON that raced
around the town. They were said to
have been born of water, lightning
and fire. But they could not
contain theirexcessive power. So they say the
three ran like the wind off into the
grassland.
entries.translation:
还有传说记载：
有一些宝可梦奔驰在缘朱周围。 据说它们分别是：
雷的化身、火的化身，以及水的化身。 然而它们拥有的力量
实在是过于强大，只能像疾风一样穿越一片又一片草丛……以上就是古代的传说。

entries.label: EcruteakTwoTowersText
entries.english:
In ECRUTEAK, there
were two towers. Each tower was the
roost of powerfulflying #MON. But one of the
towers burned tothe ground. The two #MON
haven't been seensince… Keep reading?
entries.translation:
传说中记载：
缘朱有两座塔，分别有不同的宝可梦会在两座塔上降临。 但是其中一座塔失火之后，
宝可梦也无影无踪了…… 要继续读下去吗？

entries.label: ItemfinderExplanationText
entries.english:
There are many
items lying about that aren't ob-
vious. Use ITEMFINDER to
check if there is an item on the
ground near you. It doesn't show
the exact spot, so you'll have to
look yourself. Oh yeah--I heard
there are items in ECRUTEAK's
BURNED TOWER.
entries.translation:
有些看不见的道具
掉落在各种地方。 只要使用探宝器，
就可以确认一下有没有道具掉落在你的周围。 不过，具体的掉落地点
还是得自己去找出来。 对了！
据说缘朱市的烧焦塔里，散落了很多宝贝哦。

entries.label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseGrampsText
entries.english:
This happened when
I was young. The sky suddenly
turned black. A giant flying #-
