MON was blockingout the sun. I wonder what that
#MON was?  It was like a bird
and a dragon.
entries.translation:
这是我小时候发生的事： 有天，天空突然暗了下来。
我抬头一看，一只巨大的宝可梦正在从天上飞过。 那只像龙又像鸟的宝可梦
到底是什么呢？

entries.label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseYoungsterText
entries.english:
Is there really a
#MON that big? If it exists, it
must be powerful.
entries.translation:
这世上真的有
那么大的宝可梦吗？要是有的话，肯定超级强。

entries.label: EcruteakMartGrannyText
entries.english:
If you use REVIVE,
a #MON that's fainted will wake
right up.
entries.translation:
如果使用了活力碎片，
濒死的宝可梦马上就好了。

entries.label: EcruteakMartSuperNerdText
entries.english:
My EEVEE evolved
into an ESPEON. But my friend's
EEVEE turned intoan UMBREON. I wonder why? We
both were raising our EEVEE in the
same way…
entries.translation:
我的伊布
进化成太阳伊布了。 可我朋友的伊布
却进化成了月亮伊布。 到底是哪里不一样呢？
明明我们都坚持不让伊布进化啊……

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is soooocool. His #MON are
really tough too.
entries.translation:
道馆馆主松叶
真的很不错啊。我就喜欢这种酷酷的感觉。 而且他的宝可梦
也非常强大哦。

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FGymGuideText
entries.english:
LAKE OF RAGE… The appearance of
a GYARADOS swarm… I smell a conspir-
acy. I know it!
entries.translation:
愤怒之湖……
出现了大量暴鲤龙……我感觉要出大事。

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMText
entries.english:
The way the KIMONO
GIRLS dance is marvelous. Just
like the way theyuse their #MON.
entries.translation:
和服女孩跳舞的样子和
使用宝可梦的样子都很美。

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMTextMobile
entries.english:
You must be hoping
to battle more people, right?
There's apparently some place where
trainers gather. Where, you ask? It's a little past
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.translation:
都到了这个时候，
你肯定很希望能和更多更多的人进行宝可梦对战，对吧？ 听说有一个地方聚集了
很多这样的训练家。你问那个地方在哪？就在浅葱市往西不远处。

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText1
entries.english:
Hi, I'm BILL. And
who are you? Hmm, {PLAYER}, huh?
You've come at theright time.
entries.translation:
我是正辉，
您是……？ 是{PLAYER}啊？
您来得正好。

entries.label: EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText2
entries.english:
I just finished
adjustments on myTIME CAPSULE. You know that
#MON can betraded, right? My TIME CAPSULE
was developed to enable trades with
the past. But you can't send
anything that didn't exist in
the past. If you did, the PC
in the past wouldhave a breakdown. So you have to
remove anything that wasn't around
in the past. Put simply, no
sending new moves or new #MON in
the TIME CAPSULE. Don't you worry.
I'm done with theadjustments. Tomorrow, TIME
CAPSULES will be running at all
#MON CENTERS. I have to hurry on
back to GOLDENRODand see my folks. Buh-bye!
entries.translation:
我马上就能
把时光胶囊调整好了。 宝可梦可以拿去交换，
这您应该知道吧。 不过我还发明了
能和过去的人交换的时光胶囊。 ……可是呢，
要是送过去的玩意儿过去的人不认识，那电脑可得歇菜了。 您必须得先把
过去没有的东西拿下来。 说白了就是：
新宝可梦和新招式不能用时光胶囊进行连接交换。 估摸着马上就能完事儿。
等明个儿天一亮，全国宝可梦中心的时光胶囊应该就能用了。 我要回满金市去，
偶尔也得孝顺孝顺爹妈。 那就拜拜了。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceGrampsText
entries.english:
Two towers…
Two #MON… But when one
burned down, both #MON flew away,
never to return.
entries.translation:
2座塔对应
2只宝可梦…… 但是其中一座塔烧毁之后，
宝可梦也一去不回了……

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText
entries.english:
TIN TOWER is off
limits to anyone without ECRUTEAK
GYM's BADGE. Sorry, but you'll
have to leave.
entries.translation:
铃铛塔是一座神圣的塔，
拥有缘朱道馆徽章的人才能进行攀登。 非常抱歉，
施主请回吧。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_GotFogBadge
entries.english:
TIN TOWER is off
limits to anyone without ECRUTEAK
GYM's BADGE. Ah! ECRUTEAK's GYM
BADGE! Please, goright through.
entries.translation:
铃铛塔是一座神圣的塔，
拥有缘朱道馆徽章的人才能进行攀登。 哦！ 这正是缘朱道馆的徽章！ 请走这边。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HeardClearBell
entries.english:
That bell's chime
is indicative ofthe bearer's soul. You… You may be able to
make it throughTIN TOWER. Please, do go on.
entries.translation:
铃铛的声音
表明了持有者的心。 如果是这位施主…… 或许可以被允许
进入铃铛塔。 请走这边。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HearsClearBell
entries.english:
A momentous event
has occurred. I beg your pardon,
but I must ask youto leave. ……………… Ah! The sound of that
CLEAR BELL! It… It's sublime! I've never heard
so beautiful asound before! That bell's chime
is indicative ofthe bearer's soul. You… You may be able to
make it throughTIN TOWER. Please, do go on.
entries.translation:
发生了不得了的事情。 非常抱歉，
施主请回吧。 ……… 哦！ 这是透明铃铛的响声！ 真是美妙的响声啊。 我从未听过
如此清脆的音色。 铃铛的声音
表明了持有者的心。 如果是这位施主…… 或许可以被允许
进入铃铛塔。 请走这边。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_NoClearBell
entries.english:
A momentous event
has occurred. I beg your pardon,
but I must ask youto leave. …What soothes the
soul… The WISE TRIO say
things that are so very difficult to
understand…
entries.translation:
发生了不得了的事情。 非常抱歉，
施主请回吧。 心灵镇静之人…… 无法理解
三人组在说什么。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_PleaseDoGoOn
entries.english: Please, do go on.
entries.translation: 请走这边。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceWanderingSageText
entries.english:
The TIN TOWER
ahead is a nine- tier tower of
divine beauty. It soothes the
soul of all whosee it.
entries.translation:
前方的铃铛塔
能使人心灵镇静，是一座神圣的九重塔。

entries.label: EcruteakTinTowerEntranceWanderingSageText_GotClearBell
entries.english:
The TIN TOWER
shook! A #MON must have returned
to the top!
entries.translation:
刚才铃铛塔震动了！ 这一定是因为
宝可梦回到了塔顶！

entries.label: ElmsHouseLabFoodText
entries.english:
There's some food
here. It must befor the LAB.
entries.translation:
这里有些食物，
是给研究所准备的吧？

entries.label: ElmsHousePCText
entries.english:
#MON. Where do
they come from?  Where are they
going? Why has no one
ever witnessed a#MON's birth? I want to know! I
will dedicate my life to the study
of #MON! … It's a part of
PROF.ELM's re-search papers.
entries.translation:
宝可梦从哪里来？
又要去往何方？ 为什么从来没人见过
宝可梦诞生的那个瞬间？ 我想了解这一点！
我将耗费我的一生对此进行研究！ ……………… 这是空木博士写的
研究报告的一部分！

entries.label: ElmsHousePokemonFoodText
entries.english:
There's some food
here. This must befor #MON.
entries.translation:
这里有些食物，
这些是给宝可梦准备的吧？

entries.label: ElmsSonText
entries.english:
When I grow up,
I'm going to helpmy dad! I'm going to be a
great #MONprofessor!
entries.translation:
等我长大了，
一定要给爸爸帮忙！ 然后，我还要成为
了不起的宝可梦博士！

entries.label: ElmsWifeText
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}! My
husband's always so busy--I hope
he's OK. When he's caught
up in his #MON research, he even
forgets to eat.
entries.translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}！ 我家的老公啊，
看起来永远都很忙，会不会太辛苦了？ 他沉迷于宝可梦研究，
真的是废寝忘食了。

entries.label: AideText_AfterTheft
entries.english:
…sigh… That
stolen #MON. I wonder how it's
doing. They say a #MON
raised by a bad person turns bad
itself.
entries.translation:
……唉。
……被偷走的宝可梦现在怎么样了啊…… 大家都说如果人品不行，
培育的宝可梦也会变坏。

entries.label: AideText_AlwaysBusy
entries.english:
There are only two
of us, so we'realways busy.
entries.translation:
因为这里只有两个人，
有一点事就顾不过来…… 啊，真是太忙了。

entries.label: AideText_ExplainBalls
entries.english:
To add to your
#DEX, you haveto catch #MON. Throw # BALLS
at wild #MONto get them.
entries.translation:
想完成宝可梦图鉴，
就得多捕捉宝可梦！ 对野生宝可梦
扔出精灵球，就可以对它进行捕捉了！

entries.label: AideText_GiveYouBalls
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! Use these on your
#DEX quest!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！ 既然你要完成宝可梦图鉴，
这个就送你了！

entries.label: AideText_GiveYouPotion
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, I want
you to have thisfor your errand.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！
非常感谢你愿意帮助，这个就送你了！

entries.label: AideText_TheftTestimony
entries.english:
There was a loud
noise outside… When we went to
look, someonestole a #MON. It's unbelievable
that anyone woulddo that! …sigh… That
stolen #MON. I wonder how it's
doing. They say a #MON
raised by a bad person turns bad
itself.
entries.translation:
一开始外面有很大动静…… 我和博士就想出去看看，
这时有人偷走了宝可梦…… 居然会偷别人的东西，
真是难以置信！ ……唉。
……被偷走的宝可梦现在怎么样了啊…… 大家都说如果人品不行，
培育的宝可梦也会变坏。

entries.label: ChoseStarterText
entries.english:
ELM: I think
that's a great#MON too!
entries.translation:
空木：我也觉得
它是最好的宝可梦！

entries.label: DidntChooseStarterText
entries.english:
ELM: Think it over
carefully. Your partner is
important.
entries.translation:
空木：你仔细想好了
再做决定吧。毕竟是重要的伙伴嘛。

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText1
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}, this
is terrible… Oh, yes, what was
MR.#MON's bigdiscovery?
entries.translation:
空木：{PLAYER}……
大事不妙了。 啊，对了，
宝可梦爷爷说的重大发现是什么东西？

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText2
entries.english:
{PLAYER} handed
the MYSTERY EGG toPROF.ELM.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}把
神奇蛋交给了空木博士。

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText3
entries.english: ELM: This?
entries.translation: 空木：这个……

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText4
entries.english:
But… Is it a
#MON EGG? If it is, it is a
great discovery!
entries.translation:
……难道是
宝可梦的蛋！？ 如果是真的，那的确是
重、重、重大发现啊！

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText5
entries.english:
ELM: What?!? PROF.OAK gave you
a #DEX? {PLAYER}, is that
true? Th-that'sincredible! He is superb at
seeing the poten-tial of people astrainers. Wow, {PLAYER}. You
may have what it takes to become
the CHAMPION. You seem to be
getting on greatwith #MON too. You should take
the #MON GYMchallenge. The closest GYM
would be the onein VIOLET CITY.
entries.translation:
空木：嗯？你从大木博士
那里得到了宝可梦图鉴！？ {PLAYER}，真、真的吗？
那、那可太了不起了！ 不管怎么说，大木博士
拥有一种可以看出训练家才能的能力。 我懂了，{PLAYER}，
你或许具备了成为冠军需要具备的素质。 宝可梦似乎也很喜欢你，
要不，你干脆就去挑战各地的道馆怎么样？ 离这里最近的是
桔梗市的宝可梦道馆。

entries.label: ElmAfterTheftText6
entries.english:
…{PLAYER}. The
road to the championship will
be a long one. Before you leave,
make sure that youtalk to your mom.
entries.translation:
…… {PLAYER}，
想要成为冠军，今后的路还很长。 在出发之前
先和妈妈说一声吧。

entries.label: ElmAideHasEggText
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}?
Didn't you meet myassistant? He should have met
you with the EGG at VIOLET CITY's
#MON CENTER. You must have just
missed him. Try tocatch him there.
entries.translation:
空木：哎呀，{PLAYER}
你有没有见到我的助手？ 他要过去给你送蛋，
现在应该还待在桔梗市的宝可梦中心…… 你错过了吗？
就劳烦你去找找他吧。

entries.label: ElmDescribesMrPokemonText
entries.english:
MR.#MON goes
everywhere andfinds rarities. Too bad they're
just rare andnot very useful…
entries.translation:
宝可梦爷爷这个人啊，
总是会去各种地方寻找一些稀奇古怪的东西。 那些东西稀奇是很稀奇，
但是好像没什么用……

entries.label: ElmDirectionsText1
entries.english:
MR.#MON lives a
little bit beyond CHERRYGROVE, the
next city over. It's almost a
direct route there, so you
can't miss it. But just in case,
here's my phone number. Call me if
anything comes up!
entries.translation:
要找宝可梦爷爷的话，
先到隔壁的吉花市，然后再往前走几步。 因为基本就是
一条大直路，你应该不会弄错吧。 我要把我的
电话号码告诉你，有事情就联系我哦！

entries.label: ElmDirectionsText2
entries.english:
If your #MON is
hurt, you should heal it with this
machine. Feel free to use
it anytime.
entries.translation:
还有，如果宝可梦受伤了，
用那边的机器可以给宝可梦回复体力。 你想用的时候，
随时欢迎使用！

entries.label: ElmDirectionsText3
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, I'm
counting on you!
entries.translation:
那么，{PLAYER}，
事情就拜托你了！

entries.label: ElmGiveEverstoneText1
entries.english:
Thanks, {PLAYER}!
You're helping unravel #MON
mysteries for us! I want you to have
this as a token ofour appreciation.
entries.translation:
谢谢你，{PLAYER}！
你帮助我们解开了宝可梦的秘密！ 这是我们的谢礼，
不要客气，请收下吧。

entries.label: ElmGiveEverstoneText2
entries.english:
That's an
EVERSTONE. Some species of
#MON evolve when they grow to
certain levels. A #MON holding
the EVERSTONEwon't evolve. Give it to a #-
MON you don't wantto evolve.
entries.translation:
这是不变之石。 有些种类的宝可梦
培育到一定程度就会进化，样子也会随之改变。 而携带不变之石的宝可梦
不会进化。 如果希望宝可梦保持不变，
那就让宝可梦携带它吧。

entries.label: ElmGiveMasterBallText1
entries.english:
ELM: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Thanks to you, my research is going
great! Take this as a
token of myappreciation.
entries.translation:
空木：呀，{PLAYER}！
多亏了你，研究取得了很大进展哦。 这是我的一点心意，
希望你能用上！

entries.label: ElmGiveMasterBallText2
entries.english:
The MASTER BALL is
the best! It's the ultimate
BALL! It'll catch any #MON with-
out fail. It's given only to
recognized #MONresearchers. I think you can
make much better use of it than I
can, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
这是大师球！！ 是不论什么宝可梦
都必定能捕捉到的终极精灵球！ 听说大师球
一般只会赠与那些被认可的研究者…… 但是我觉得比起我，
你才能妥善地使用它。{PLAYER}，你收下吧！

entries.label: ElmGiveTicketText1
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}!
There you are! I called because I
have something foryou. See? It's an
S.S.TICKET. Now you can catch
#MON in KANTO.
entries.translation:
空木：呀，{PLAYER}，
你总算是来了！ 叫你过来是因为
有点东西想给你！ 瞧！
这是船票。 有了它就可以
去关都捉宝可梦了哦！

entries.label: ElmGiveTicketText2
entries.english:
The ship departs
from OLIVINE CITY. But you knew that
already, {PLAYER}. After all, you've
traveled all overwith your #MON. Give my regards to
PROF.OAK in KANTO!
entries.translation:
要坐高速船的话，
就要去浅葱市。 ……不过，{PLAYER}
你应该比我更懂这些。 毕竟你和宝可梦一起
去过了各种地方嘛。 那么，等你到了关都
代我向大木博士问好！

entries.label: ElmPokeBallText
entries.english:
It contains a
#MON caught byPROF.ELM.
entries.translation:
里面装着空木博士
发现的宝可梦！

entries.label: ElmStudyingEggText
entries.english:
ELM: Don't give
up! I'll call if I learn anything
about that EGG!
entries.translation:
空木：加油吧！
我会对蛋进行调查，只要有发现就会联系你的！

entries.label: ElmText_Accepted
entries.english:
Thanks, {PLAYER}! You're a great
help!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，谢谢了！
你帮了我很大忙！

entries.label: ElmText_CallYou
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}, I'll
call you if any-thing comes up.
entries.translation:
空木：{PLAYER}，
我有新发现会联系你的。

entries.label: ElmText_ChooseAPokemon
entries.english:
I want you to
raise one of the #MON contained
in these BALLS. You'll be that
#MON's firstpartner, {PLAYER}! Go on. Pick one!

entries.label: ElmText_GotAnEmail
entries.english:
Oh, hey! I got an
e-mail! ………………
Hm… Uh-huh… Okay…

entries.label: ElmText_Intro
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}!
There you are! I needed to ask
you a favor. I'm conducting new
#MON research right now. I was
wondering if you could help me with
it, {PLAYER}. You see… I'm writing a
paper that I want to present at a
conference. But there are some
things I don't quite understand
yet. So! I'd like you to
raise a #MON that I recently
caught.
entries.translation:
空木：啊，{PLAYER}！
总算是来了！  叫你过来是因为
有点事情要拜托你！ 我们现在
正在用全新的方式进行宝可梦研究。 希望{PLAYER}
你能配合我们的工作！ 其实啊…… 我正在编写资料，
打算拿到学会去发表。但还有些地方没搞明白…… 所以！ 我想让你帮忙培育
最近捕捉到的宝可梦。

entries.label: ElmText_LetYourMonBattleIt
entries.english:
If a wild #MON
appears, let your#MON battle it!
entries.translation:
只要带了宝可梦，
遇见野生的宝可梦的时候，就能让他们进行战斗了！

entries.label: ElmText_MissionFromMrPokemon
entries.english:
Hey, listen. I have an acquain-
tance called MR.#MON. He keeps finding
weird things and raving about his
discoveries. Anyway, I just got
an e-mail from him saying that this
time it's real. It is intriguing,
but we're busy with our #MON
research… Wait! I know! {PLAYER}, can you
go in our place?
entries.translation:
那个啊，我认识一个
叫宝可梦爷爷的人。 每当他看到奇怪的东西，
都会兴奋地大喊：“这是重大发现！” 我刚刚收到他寄来的邮件，
上面写着：“这次一定是真的！” 虽然我很好奇，
但是我和我的助手都忙于研究呢……啊！ 对了！ 拜托了，{PLAYER}！
你就代替我去一趟吧！

entries.label: ElmText_Refused
entries.english:
But… Please, I
need your help!
entries.translation:
不要那么说嘛！
拜托你了！

entries.label: ElmText_ResearchAmbitions
entries.english:
When I announce my
findings, I'm sure we'll delve a bit
deeper into the many mysteries of
#MON. You can count on
it!
entries.translation:
如果能
顺利地公布研究结果， 我们一定会更加接近
宝可梦之谜的真相！ 敬请期待哦！

entries.label: ElmThoughtEggHatchedText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? I thought
the EGG hatched. Where is the
#MON?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，
蛋应已经孵化了吧。孵出来的宝可梦在哪里？

entries.label: ElmWaitingEggHatchText
entries.english:
ELM: Hey, has that
EGG changed any?
entries.translation:
空木：怎么样，
蛋有发生什么变化吗？

entries.label: ElmsLabHealingMachineText1
entries.english:
I wonder what this
does?
entries.translation: 这是什么机器呢？

entries.label: ElmsLabHealingMachineText2
entries.english:
Would you like to
heal your #MON?
entries.translation: 要回复宝可梦吗？

entries.label: ElmsLabMonEggText
entries.english:
It's the #MON
EGG being studiedby PROF.ELM.
entries.translation:
这是空木博士研究的
宝可梦蛋。

entries.label: ElmsLabOfficerText1
entries.english:
I heard a #MON
was stolen here… I was just getting
some informationfrom PROF.ELM. Apparently, it was
a young male withlong, red hair… What? You battled a
trainer like that? Did you happen to
get his name?
entries.translation:
我听说这间宝可梦研究所
有宝可梦失窃了…… 刚才正在向空木博士
询问事件的详情。似乎是一个留着红色长发的少年干的。 什么！
你和那个训练家交过手？ 他有没有告诉你
他叫什么名字？

entries.label: ElmsLabOfficerText2
entries.translation:
明白了！
叫{RIVAL}是吧！ 非常感谢
你的协助！

entries.label: ElmsLabPCText
entries.english:
OBSERVATIONS ON
#MON EVOLUTION …It says on the
screen…
entries.translation: 《关于宝可梦的进化》 ……上面这么写着。

entries.label: ElmsLabTrashcanText
entries.english:
The wrapper from
the snack PROF.ELMate is in there…
entries.translation:
里面有空木博士扔掉的
点心包装袋……

entries.label: ElmsLabTravelTip1Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} opened a
book. Travel Tip 1: Press START to
open the MENU.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}拿了本书， 书名是《探险心得1》。 按下START键！
就能打开菜单。

entries.label: ElmsLabTravelTip2Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} opened a
book. Travel Tip 2: Record your trip
with SAVE!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}拿了本书， 书名是《探险心得2》。 写下宝可梦记录
就能保存进度！

entries.label: ElmsLabTravelTip3Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} opened a
book. Travel Tip 3: Open your PACK and
press SELECT tomove items.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}拿了本书， 书名是《探险心得3》。 打开背包
按下SELECT键！就能调换道具位置！

entries.label: ElmsLabTravelTip4Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} opened a
book. Travel Tip 4: Check your #MON
moves. Press the A Button to switch
moves.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}拿了本书， 书名是《探险心得4》。 看宝可梦可用招式时，
按下A键！就能调换招式位置！

entries.label: ElmsLabWindowText1
entries.english:
The window's open. A pleasant breeze
is blowing in.
entries.translation:
窗户开着，
外面的风好舒服！

entries.label: ElmsLabWindowText2
entries.english:
He broke in
through here!
entries.translation: 他从这里破窗而入！

entries.label: GotElmsNumberText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} got ELM's
phone number.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}获得了
空木博士的电话号码。

entries.label: LabWhereGoingText
entries.english:
ELM: Wait! Where
are you going?
entries.translation:
空木：等等，等等，
你要上哪去啊！

entries.label: ReceivedStarterText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
{STRBUF}!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从空木博士
那里得到了{STRBUF}！

entries.label: ShowElmTogepiText1
entries.english:
ELM: {PLAYER}, you
look great!
entries.translation:
空木：{PLAYER}，
你很有精神啊！

entries.label: ShowElmTogepiText2
entries.english:
What?
That #MON!?!
entries.translation:
什么？
那只宝可梦是……！

entries.label: ShowElmTogepiText3
entries.english:
The EGG hatched!
So, #MON areborn from EGGS… No, perhaps not
all #MON are. Wow, there's still
a lot of researchto be done.
entries.translation:
蛋孵出来了啊！ 所以，宝可梦是
从蛋中出生的…… 不，或许并不是
所有宝可梦都这样。 这里面还有
许多的研究要做。

entries.label: TakeChikoritaText
entries.english:
ELM: So, you like
CHIKORITA, thegrass #MON?
entries.translation:
空木：你很中意
草宝可梦菊草叶吗！？

entries.label: TakeCyndaquilText
entries.english:
ELM: You'll take
CYNDAQUIL, thefire #MON?
entries.translation:
空木：要选火宝可梦
火球鼠吗！？

entries.label: TakeTotodileText
entries.english:
ELM: Do you want
TOTODILE, thewater #MON?
entries.translation:
空木：水宝可梦
小锯鳄可以吗！？

entries.label: FastShip1FGrandpaText
entries.english:
Whoa! Excuse me.
I was in a hurry! My granddaughter
is missing! She's just a wee
girl. If you see her, please let me
know!
entries.translation:
不好意思啊！
叔叔我有件急事……！ 我的孙女不见了！
我现在正在找她！是个小个子的女孩！看到的话就告诉我！

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_InOlivine
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived inOLIVINE CITY.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
已经到达浅葱港！

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_InVermilion
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived inVERMILION CITY.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
已经到达枯叶港！

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToOlivine
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
is en route toOLIVINE CITY. We will make an
announcement whenwe arrive.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
即将前往浅葱市。 到达浅葱港之后，
会用广播进行通知。

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToVermilion
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
is en route toVERMILION CITY. We will make an
announcement whenwe arrive.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
即将前往枯叶市。 到达枯叶港之后，
会用广播进行通知。

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor2Text
entries.english:
Here's your cabin. You can heal your
#MON by takinga nap in the bed. The ship will
arrive whileyou're sleeping.
entries.translation:
你的房间在这里。 在床上休息后，
宝可梦就会变得健康。 船会在你睡觉的期间，
到达港口哦。

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor2Text_FirstTime
entries.english:
Here's your cabin. If your #MON
are hurt, take anap in the bed. That will heal
them.
entries.translation:
你的房间在这里。 宝可梦们受伤的话，
就在船上好好休息一下，这可以让大家恢复健康。

entries.label: FastShip1FSailor3Text
entries.english:
The passengers are
all trainers. They're all itch-
ing to battle intheir cabins.
entries.translation:
登船的游客
全都是训练家。 他们会待在房间里
等着对战的对手出现。

entries.label: BlackbeltWaiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I couldn't find
the KARATE KING inJOHTO. He's supposed to
be training in acave somewhere.
entries.translation:
空手道大王去城都修行了，
所以我没见到他。 现在应该是在某个洞窟里
进行修行吧……

entries.label: BlackbeltWaiBeatenText
entries.english:
Rocked and rolled
over!
entries.translation:
好——嘞！
咕噜咕噜转——！

entries.label: BlackbeltWaiSeenText
entries.english:
I'm building up my
legs by bracing against the ship's
rocking!
entries.translation:
好——嘞！
通过忍受船的摆动来锻炼自己的下盘吧！

entries.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorDirectionsText
entries.english:
The dining room is
up ahead. The stairs at the
end lead to theCAPTAIN's cabin.
entries.translation:
再往前是食堂哦。 最里面那个楼梯
通向船长室。

entries.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorRefusedText
entries.english:
Oh, gee… The CAPTAIN will
be furious…
entries.translation:
真头痛啊……
要挨船长的骂了。

entries.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorSawLittleGirlText
entries.english:
A little girl? I may have seen
her go by here.
entries.translation:
小女孩？ 说起来，我好像
看见她经过这里了。

entries.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorText
entries.english:
Hey, kid. Could I
get you to lookfor my buddy? He's goofing off
somewhere, thatlazy bum! I want to go find
him, but I'm onduty right now.
entries.translation:
喂、喂！说你呢！
能帮我找个朋友吗？ 他翘班溜走了，
真是受不了……！ 虽然我很想亲自去找他，
不过我还有工作啊……

entries.label: FastShipB1FOnDutySailorThanksText
entries.english:
Thanks, kid!
I chewed him out good so he'll quit
slacking off!
entries.translation:
谢谢！
我会好好批评他的，让他不要再旷工了！

entries.label: FisherJonahAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I plan to fish off
VERMILION's pier.
entries.translation:
我现在很期待
去枯叶市的栈桥上垂钓！

entries.label: FisherJonahBeatenText
entries.english:
I… I'm not bored
anymore…
entries.translation:
郁、
郁闷的感觉缓解了……

entries.label: FisherJonahSeenText
entries.english:
Even though we're
out on the sea, Ican't fish! This is boring!
Let's battle!
entries.translation:
上了船就不能垂钓了。
太郁闷了！我们对战吧！

entries.label: JugglerFritzAfterBattleText
entries.english:
No more ships for
me. Next time, I'm taking the
MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.translation:
我很怕坐船……
下次乘磁浮列车吧……

entries.label: JugglerFritzBeatenText
entries.english:
I can't move any-
more…
entries.translation: 已经动不了了……

entries.label: JugglerFritzSeenText
entries.english:
Urrf…
I'm seasick!
entries.translation:
呜呕！
我好像晕船了！

entries.label: PicnickerDebraAfterBattleText
entries.english:
SAFFRON, CELADON…
I hear there are many big cities
in KANTO.
entries.translation:
金黄市……
玉虹市……我听别人说关都也有很多大城市呢！

entries.label: PicnickerDebraBeatenText
entries.english:
Yow! You're too
strong!
entries.translation: 讨厌，这么强吗！

entries.label: PicnickerDebraSeenText
entries.english:
I'm so bored.
Want to battle?
entries.translation:
有点无聊呢！
和我对战吧！

entries.label: SailorGarrettAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We get different
passengers from VERMILION CITY to
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.translation:
如果是从枯叶市
乘到浅葱市的话，船上会有另一批乘客哦！

entries.label: SailorGarrettBeatenText
entries.english:
I lost on my home
field…
entries.translation:
居然在自家主场
被打败了！

entries.label: SailorGarrettSeenText
entries.english:
This is where we
sailors work!
entries.translation:
这里是我们这些水手
神圣的工作地点！

entries.label: SailorJeffAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I guess I can't
win if I don't getserious.
entries.translation:
不认真以待的话，
就不能变强吗……！？

entries.label: SailorJeffBeatenText
entries.english:
Win or lose, my
break's over!
entries.translation:
赢了也好，输了也好，
反正休息是结束了！

entries.label: SailorJeffSeenText
entries.english:
Nothing beats a
battle when I'mon my break.
entries.translation:
工作间隙的休息时间，
当然要进行宝可梦对战！

entries.label: SailorKennethAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Eight BADGES!
They must prove that you've beaten
GYM LEADERS. No wonder you're
so good!
entries.translation:
……那8个徽章莫非是
打败道馆馆主的凭证？ 难怪会这么强！

entries.label: SailorKennethBeatenText
entries.english:
My lack of train-
ing is obvious…
entries.translation: 练习不足难以掩饰！

entries.label: SailorKennethSeenText
entries.english:
I'm a sailor man! But I'm training
#MON, so I canbecome the CHAMP!
entries.translation:
我是水手！ 但是为了成为冠军
我也在进行宝可梦特训！

entries.label: SchoolboyNateAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Radios pick up
strange signalsinside the RUINS.
entries.translation:
如果在遗迹里听广播，
就会听见奇妙的声音哦。

entries.label: SchoolboyNateBeatenText
entries.english: Yaargh!

entries.label: SchoolboyNateSeenText
entries.english:
Do you know the
RUINS OF ALPH?
entries.translation:
喂，
你知道阿露福遗迹吗？

entries.label: SchoolboyRickyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I read that there
are four of thosestone panels.
entries.translation:
我在书上读到
石板一共有4块哦！

entries.label: SchoolboyRickyBeatenText
entries.english: I was done in!
entries.translation: 被打败了——！

entries.label: SchoolboyRickySeenText
entries.english:
There are some odd
stone panels inthe RUINS OF ALPH.
entries.translation:
我听说阿露福遗迹里
有神奇的石板！

entries.label: TeacherShirleyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We're on a field
trip to the RUINSoutside VIOLET.
entries.translation:
我们要去桔梗市
参观遗迹哦。

entries.label: TeacherShirleyBeatenText
entries.english: Aaack!
entries.translation: 呀！

entries.label: TeacherShirleySeenText
entries.english:
Don't lay a finger
on my students!
entries.translation:
不要对我的学生们
随便出手啊！

entries.label: BurglarCoreyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I found a pretty
coin here. Someone must have
lost it…
entries.translation:
我在房间里捡到了
一枚漂亮的硬币哦。 是之前住在这个房间的
客人掉的吗……？

entries.label: BurglarCoreyBeatenText
entries.english:
How unlucky!
I lost!
entries.translation:
怎么会输啊！
真不走运！

entries.label: BurglarCoreySeenText
entries.english:
Yeehaw!
Lucky!
entries.translation:
耶——！
真是走运！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCarolAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm going to beat
you someday!
entries.translation:
总有一天，
我会赢你的！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCarolBeatenText
entries.english:
What's so differ-
ent between us?
entries.translation:
我和你
不一样在哪里……！？

entries.label: CooltrainerfCarolSeenText
entries.english:
I'm training to
become the CHAMP!
entries.translation:
我的目标也是成为冠军！
我会好好加油的！

entries.label: CooltrainermSeanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Trainers from
JOHTO can battle with KANTO GYM
LEADERS.
entries.translation:
城都的训练家也可以
与关都的道馆馆主交战的哦！

entries.label: CooltrainermSeanBeatenText
entries.english: I wanted to win!
entries.translation: 我想赢啊……！

entries.label: CooltrainermSeanSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to KANTO
to test my skills.
entries.translation:
我要到关都去
试试身手！

entries.label: GentlemanEdwardAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I give up.
You don't have to look. Just forget
about it!
entries.translation:
算了，我还是放弃吧。
啊，对了对了！你就不用特地去找了，最好忘了这件事情！

entries.label: GentlemanEdwardBeatenText
entries.english:
I… I can't find
it…
entries.translation:
找……
找不到啊……！

entries.label: GentlemanEdwardSeenText
entries.english:
Oh, no. I've lost
something that'svery important.
entries.translation:
哇——糟了！
我弄丢了很重要的东西！

entries.label: HikerNolandAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I wonder if there
are any mountains worth climbing in
KANTO?
entries.translation:
在关都是不是也有
能让我感到满意的崇山峻岭？

entries.label: HikerNolandBeatenText
entries.english:
That's too much to
handle!
entries.translation: 太强了吧——！

entries.label: HikerNolandSeenText
entries.english:
Are you alone?
Then let's battle!
entries.translation:
你就一个人吗！？
那就来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: PokemaniacEthanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
LILY's nice, but
MARY's the best! I want to check
out JOHTO's radioprograms!
entries.translation:
莉莉丝小姐姐好是好，
但胡桃小姐姐更棒！好想听城都的广播啊！

entries.label: PokemaniacEthanBeatenText
entries.english: Gyaaaah!
entries.translation: 呜哇——！

entries.label: PokemaniacEthanSeenText
entries.english:
Do you know LILY?
She's a hot DJ inKANTO.
entries.translation:
你知道关都的人气主播
莉莉丝小姐姐吗？

entries.label: SailorStanlyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Being a sailor, I
have to do phys-ical labor. It'sexhausting!
entries.translation:
当水手是力气活，
真的很累人呀……

entries.label: SailorStanlyBeatenText
entries.english:
Sorry! It's all my
fault!
entries.translation:
对不起！
是我不对！

entries.label: SailorStanlySeenText
entries.english:
Yeah, I'm a sail-
or, all right. I wasn't goofing
off! This cabin was
vacant, so I justtook a quick nap! Ah, forget it!
Let's battle!
entries.translation:
如你所见，我是个水手！
我可没在偷懒！我看这个房间没人，所以就想睡个午觉……！ 真是的！
来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: PokefanfGeorgiaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Oh, yes! I have to
get my #MON outof DAY-CARE!
entries.translation:
想起来了，我要去培育屋
把寄放的宝可梦取出来！

entries.label: PokefanfGeorgiaBeatenText
entries.english:
What was I going
to do?
entries.translation: 要做什么来着……？

entries.label: PokefanfGeorgiaSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to shop
at the DEPT.STOREand then…
entries.translation:
我要去百货店买东西！
接下来呢……

entries.label: PokefanmColinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You're traveling
all alone? Isn't your mom
worried?
entries.translation:
一个人出来旅行？
你妈妈不担心吗？

entries.label: PokefanmColinBeatenText
entries.english: You're strong!
entries.translation: 真强哪！

entries.label: PokefanmColinSeenText
entries.english:
Hey, kid! Want to
battle with me?
entries.translation: 要陪叔叔我对战吗！

entries.label: PokefanmJeremyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I must go to the
#MON SALON andfix them up nice!
entries.translation:
我要去宝可梦美发沙龙
再次把它们弄漂亮！

entries.label: PokefanmJeremyBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, no! My beauti-
ful #MON!
entries.translation:
啊……！
好不容易才弄漂亮的！

entries.label: PokefanmJeremySeenText
entries.english:
What do you think?
My #MON arebeautiful, yes?
entries.translation:
如何？我的宝可梦
是不是非常漂亮？

entries.label: PsychicRodneyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I get it. You can
hear JOHTO's radioon the FAST SHIP.
entries.translation:
是吗，原来高速船里面
能收听城都的广播啊！

entries.label: PsychicRodneyBeatenText
entries.english:
…I hear some-
thing!
entries.translation: ……我听见了一个声音！

entries.label: PsychicRodneySeenText
entries.english:
Ssh! My brain is
picking up radiosignals!
entries.translation:
嗯嗯！我的大脑
捕捉到了电波！

entries.label: SSAquaCantFindGranddaughterText
entries.english:
Oh, hello… I still can't find
my granddaughter. If she's on the
ship, that's OK. She's an energetic
child, so she may be bugging some-
one. I'm worried…
entries.translation:
啊，你好啊……
还是找不到我孙女…… 其实我也不是担心她，
毕竟她离不开这艘船。但是我孙女精力旺盛，可能会给别人添麻烦。这样一想就很担心了……

entries.label: SSAquaCaptainExhaustingText
entries.english:
Whew! Thanks for
coming along. Keeping that lit-
tle girl amusedwas exhausting.
entries.translation:
啊——得救了！ 刚刚被那个小姑娘
拉去做她的玩伴，可把我给累坏了！

entries.label: SSAquaCaptainHowDoYouLikeText
entries.english:
How do you like
S.S.AQUA's ride? She practically
skates across thewaves.
entries.translation:
乘坐我们的水流号
感觉怎么样！？是不是感觉自己 翱翔在海面上！

entries.label: SSAquaEntertainedGranddaughterText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, was it?
I heard you enter-tained my grand-daughter. I want to thank
you for that.
entries.translation:
你是……{PLAYER}吧。
听说你陪我孙女一起玩。非常感谢！我必须表示一下谢意！

entries.label: SSAquaGranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMeText
entries.english:
CAPTAIN, play with
me, please? I'm bored! I want
to play more!
entries.translation:
船长先生，
和我一起玩嘛——！ 好无聊——！
再陪我玩一会嘛——！

entries.label: SSAquaGranddaughterHadFunText
entries.english:
I had lots of fun
playing!
entries.translation:
刚刚大家都在一起
愉快地玩耍呢！

entries.label: SSAquaGranddaughterHasToFindGrandpaText
entries.english:
Hi! Will you play
with me? …Oh! Grandpa's worried
about me? I have to go! I have to go find
Grandpa!
entries.translation:
喂喂，
你要不要陪我玩会儿？……诶！爷爷在担心我？那我要回去了！我要去找爷爷！

entries.label: SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingFText
entries.english:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing with the CAPTAIN
and this big girl!
entries.translation:
爷爷，我回来了——！
船长先生——还有这个姐姐——都愿意陪我玩呢——！

entries.label: SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingMText
entries.english:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing with the CAPTAIN
and this guy!
entries.translation:
爷爷，我回来了——！
船长先生——还有这个哥哥——都愿意陪我玩呢——！

entries.label: SSAquaGrandpaHaveThisText
entries.english:
I know! I'd like
you to have this!
entries.translation:
对了！如果你不嫌弃，
请收下这个吧！

entries.label: SSAquaGrandpaTravellingText
entries.english:
We're traveling
around the world.
entries.translation:
我们现在正在
环游世界哦。

entries.label: SSAquaHasArrivedVermilionText
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived inVERMILION CITY.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
已经到达枯叶港！

entries.label: SupernerdShawnAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You should use the
right BALLS to fitthe situation.
entries.translation:
最好还是根据状况
选出最合适的精灵球。

entries.label: SupernerdShawnBeatenText
entries.english:
Wait! Stop! Don't!
Please!
entries.translation:
讨厌，真是的！
你在干什么！

entries.label: SupernerdShawnSeenText
entries.english:
What kinds of #
BALLS do you havewith you?
entries.translation:
你有多少种
精灵球？

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Baby is a rude
name to call usgirls!
entries.translation:
叫我们小不点，
实在是太失礼了！

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg1BeatenText
entries.english: Oh! We lost!
entries.translation: 哎呀，我们输了！

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg1SeenText
entries.english:
You think I'm a
baby?That's not fair!
entries.translation:
你千万不要觉得
我们是小不点！

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Sometimes, kids
are smarter thangrown-ups!
entries.translation:
我相信，有些时候
小孩子比大人更聪明！

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg2BeatenText
entries.english: Oh! We lost!
entries.translation: 哎呀，我们输了！

entries.label: TwinsMegandpeg2SeenText
entries.english:
I'm not a baby! That's not nice to
say to a lady!
entries.translation:
我们才不是小不点呢，
那样可对女士不礼貌。

entries.label: BeautyCassieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A voyage is best
for getting overa broken heart. But a FAST SHIP
trip is too shortfor grieving.
entries.translation:
虽然乘船旅行很适合用来
缓解失恋的悲伤…… 但是高速船也太快了，
一点感觉都没有。

entries.label: BeautyCassieBeatenText
entries.english: My heart weeps…
entries.translation: 我的心在哭泣……

entries.label: BeautyCassieSeenText
entries.english:
I'm trying to
forget my woes.Let's battle!
entries.translation:
我要用宝可梦对战
来掩饰我的悲伤！请你配合我！

entries.label: BugCatcherKenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You can find lots
of #MON in thetrees of JOHTO!
entries.translation:
城都的树上
有很多宝可梦！

entries.label: BugCatcherKenBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, wow.
You're tough!
entries.translation: 呀——好强啊！

entries.label: BugCatcherKenSeenText
entries.english:
I'm visiting my
grandma to catchme some bugs!
entries.translation:
我要去奶奶那
捉虫子！

entries.label: FastShipArrivedOlivineText
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived inOLIVINE CITY.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
已到达浅葱港！

entries.label: FastShipArrivedVermilionText
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived inVERMILION CITY.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
已经到达枯叶港！

entries.label: FastShipBedText1
entries.english:
A comfy bed!
Time to sleep…
entries.translation:
有张松软的床！
好好休息一下吧……

entries.label: FastShipBedText2
entries.english:
Ah, refreshed and
restored!
entries.translation: 完全恢复活力了！

entries.label: FirebreatherLyleAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I guess fire is
weak on the sea. It doesn't matter?
Really?
entries.translation:
难道是因为火焰
不适应大海…… 你说没有这回事？
真的吗？

entries.label: FirebreatherLyleBeatenText
entries.english:
Fizzle… The
flame's tiny…
entries.translation:
嘶——嘶——
火苗太小了……

entries.label: FirebreatherLyleSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to KANTO
to put on fire-breathing shows!
entries.translation:
我要去关都
进行一场大型焰火表演！

entries.label: GuitaristClydeAfterBattleMobileText
entries.english:
I was going to
make my debut atthe BATTLE TOWER… I should go back
to VERMILION andredo my training…
entries.translation:
本来想顺路去对战塔，
来场简单的出道表演…… 现在还是应该回枯叶市
重新来过吧…

entries.label: GuitaristClydeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Speaking of the
RADIO STATION, what's this week's
lucky number?
entries.translation:
说到广播局，
这周幸运频道的中奖号码是什么呢……

entries.label: GuitaristClydeBeatenText
entries.english:
Yowza!
Total distortion!
entries.translation: 全跑调了！

entries.label: GuitaristClydeSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to audi-
tion my songs at GOLDENROD's RADIO
STATION.
entries.translation:
我要去满金的广播局
推销自己的歌！

entries.label: FightingDojoBlackBeltText
entries.english:
Hello! KARATE KING, the
FIGHTING DOJO's master, is in a
cave in JOHTO fortraining.
entries.translation:
你好！ 格斗道场的师傅
空手道大王现在正在城都的洞窟中进行修行！

entries.label: FightingDojoSign1Text
entries.english:
What goes around
comes around!
entries.translation: 因果报应

entries.label: FightingDojoSign2Text
entries.english:
Enemies on every
side!
entries.translation: 四面楚歌

entries.label: FuchsiaCityPokefanMText
entries.english:
KOGA's daughter
succeeded him as the GYM LEADER
after he joinedthe ELITE FOUR.
entries.translation:
现在的道馆馆主
是阿桔的女儿，而阿桔去当四天王了！

entries.label: FuchsiaCitySignText
entries.english:
FUCHSIA CITY Behold! It's
Passion Pink!
entries.translation:
这里是浅红市。
浅红即是华丽的红粉之色。

entries.label: FuchsiaCityTeacherText
entries.english:
The SAFARI ZONE is
closed… It's sad, considering it's
FUCHSIA's mainattraction.
entries.translation:
狩猎地带正在休业。
毕竟是浅红市名胜，感觉若有所失啊……

entries.label: FuchsiaCityYoungsterText
entries.english:
One of the ELITE
FOUR used to be the LEADER of
FUCHSIA's GYM.
entries.translation:
现在的四天王之中，
有一个人曾担任过浅红道馆的道馆馆主！

entries.label: FuchsiaGymSignText
entries.english:
FUCHSIA CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: JANINE The Poisonous
Ninja Master
entries.translation:
浅红市宝可梦道馆
馆主：阿杏毒行天下！

entries.label: NoLitteringSignText
entries.english:
No littering. Please take your
waste with you.
entries.translation:
禁止随地乱扔垃圾！
垃圾要自己处理！

entries.label: SafariZoneClosedSignText
entries.english:
The WARDEN is
traveling abroad. Therefore, the
SAFARI ZONE isclosed.
entries.translation:
狩猎地带的园长
去遥远的外国旅游了，所以正在休业。

entries.label: SafariZoneOfficeSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… SAFARI ZONE OFFICE
is closed untilfurther notice.
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ 狩猎地带事务局
正在休业

entries.label: WardensHomeSignText
entries.english:
SAFARI ZONE
WARDEN'S HOME
entries.translation:
狩猎地带
园长的家

entries.label: CamperBarryAfterText
entries.english:
Hey, you. Was my
disguise cute orwhat, huh?
entries.translation:
我刚刚的伪装
很可爱对吧！

entries.label: CamperBarryBeatenText
entries.english:
My disguise was
right on! Dang!
entries.translation:
我觉得我装得很完美啊！
不甘心！

entries.label: CamperBarryBeforeText
entries.english:
Wahahaha! You betcha!
I'm JANINE!
entries.translation:
哇、哈、哈！ 没错！
我就是阿杏！

entries.label: FuchsiaGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo, CHAMP in
making! Whoops! Take a
good look around you. The trainers
all look like theLEADER, JANINE. Which of them is
the real JANINE?
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！ ……哎呀！
您仔细瞧瞧周围！到处都是馆主阿杏，对吧！ 那么谁才是真的呢！？

entries.label: FuchsiaGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
That was a great
battle, trainerfrom JOHTO!
entries.translation:
真是场精彩的对战啊，
来自城都的训练家！

entries.label: JanineText_ApplyMyself
entries.english:
JANINE: I'm going
to really apply myself and improve
my skills. I want to become
better than bothFather and you!
entries.translation:
阿杏：我要继续修行，
让自己变得更更更强！ 我希望将来既不会输给你，
也不会输给我的父亲！

entries.label: JanineText_DisappointYou
entries.english:
Fufufufu… I'm sorry to dis-
appoint you… I'm only joking! I'm the real deal! JANINE of FUCHSIA
GYM, that's me!
entries.translation:
呵呵呵……
好遗憾哦…… 才怪！ 我是真的！
我就是浅红道馆的阿杏！

entries.label: JanineText_ToughOne
entries.english:
JANINE: You're a
tough one. Youdefinitely won… Here's SOULBADGE.
Take it.
entries.translation:
阿杏：很强嘛，你！
我彻底输了…… 好吧，拿走它吧！
这是粉红徽章！

entries.label: JanineText_ToxicSpeech
entries.english:
JANINE: You're so
tough! I have aspecial gift! It's TOXIC, a pow-
erful poison that steadily saps the
victim's HP.
entries.translation:
阿杏：你很强呀！
这个是特别奖励！ 里面是叫做剧毒的招式！
可以放出猛烈的毒素夺走对方的体力！

entries.label: LassAliceAfterText
entries.english:
How will you dis-
tinguish our realLEADER?
entries.translation:
你能不能看出来
谁才是真的馆主呢？

entries.label: LassAliceBeatenText
entries.english: I had you fooled…
entries.translation: 明明成功骗过去了啊……！

entries.label: LassAliceBeforeText
entries.english:
Fufufu! I'm JANINE, the
GYM LEADER! No, I'm not!
Gotcha, sucker!
entries.translation:
呵呵！
我就是馆主阿杏……骗你的！你上当啦！

entries.label: LassLindaAfterText
entries.english:
Well? Wasn't my
disguise perfect?
entries.translation:
怎么样？
我的伪装是不是以假乱真？

entries.label: LassLindaBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh… I lost…
You're not weak…
entries.translation:
输了……！
这个人怎么这么强！

entries.label: LassLindaBeforeText
entries.english:
Fooled you!
Hahaha!
entries.translation:
你被我骗了！
啊哈哈哈哈！

entries.label: PicnickerCindyAfterText
entries.english:
You must be
getting tired.
entries.translation:
你也应该
感到疲劳了吧！

entries.label: PicnickerCindyBeatenText
entries.english:
Darn it!
I wanted to win!
entries.translation:
……不甘心！
我也想赢啊！

entries.label: PicnickerCindyBeforeText
entries.english:
I'm JANINE! How did you know I
was real? Let's battle!
entries.translation:
我就是阿杏！
你很懂嘛！来对战吧！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedSoulBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
SOULBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿杏那里
得到了浅红徽章！

entries.label: FuchsiaMartCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
The SAFARI ZONE
WARDEN's grand-daughter lives intown.
entries.translation:
园长的孙女
还留在这个城市哦。

entries.label: FuchsiaMartFisherText
entries.english:
I was hoping to
buy some SAFARI ZONE souvenirs,
but it's closed…
entries.translation:
本来是想来狩猎地带
买一点纪念品的，没想到休业了。也太倒霉了吧！

entries.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I got quite a
shock at the GYM. There were all
these girls wholooked identical.
entries.translation:
一进道馆，你猜怎么着！
到处都是长相相同的小姑娘！

entries.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
Hey! You have a
brand new kind of#DEX. Did PROF.OAK give
that to you?
entries.translation:
喔！
这是最新型宝可梦图鉴！是大木博士给你的吗？

entries.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FJanineImpersonatorText1
entries.english:
I'm JANINE! Hocus-
pocus… Poof!
entries.translation:
我就是阿杏姐姐哦！
我变！

entries.label: FuchsiaPokecenter1FJanineImpersonatorText2
entries.english:
See? I look just
like her now!
entries.translation: 看，是不是一模一样？

entries.label: BorrowedABicycleText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} borrowed a
BICYCLE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
借到了自行车！

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopBicycleText
entries.english:
It's a shiny new
BICYCLE!
entries.translation: 有辆锃亮锃亮的自行车！

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkAgreedText
entries.english:
Really? Great! Give me your name
and phone number, and I'll loan you
a BICYCLE.
entries.translation:
真、真的吗？ 那就请你告诉我
你的名字和电话号码。我会借你自行车的。

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkFirstRateBikesText
entries.english:
My BICYCLES are
first-rate! You can ride them
anywhere.
entries.translation:
奇迹自行车店的自行车
性能绝佳！什么路况都能悠游自如！

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkIntroText
entries.english:
…sigh… I moved
here, but I can't sell my BICYCLES.
Why is that? Could you ride a
BICYCLE and adver-tise for me?
entries.translation:
唉……
特地搬到满金市，车子却一辆也卖不出去。 你愿意帮忙吗？
就是骑着自行车闲逛，到处帮我们做宣传。

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopClerkRefusedText
entries.english:
…sigh… Oh, for
the kindness ofpeople…
entries.translation:
唉……
就没有好心人吗。

entries.label: GoldenrodBikeShopJustReleasedCompactBikeText
entries.english:
Just released! First-rate compact
BICYCLES!
entries.translation:
终于上市！
最新款小型自行车！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityBikeShopSignText
entries.english:
The World is a
Cycle Path!BIKE SHOP
entries.translation:
去哪都能悠游自如！ 要找自行车，
就来奇迹自行车店！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text
entries.english:
Is that man in
black dressed up like a TEAM ROCKET
member? How silly!
entries.translation:
那个一身黑的人
是在模仿火箭队吗？真是个怪人！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text_ClearedRadioTower
entries.english:
Was that man in
black really part of TEAM ROCKET? I
can't believe it!
entries.translation:
那个一身黑的人
居然真的是火箭队？我到现在都不敢相信。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text
entries.english:
The RADIO TOWER in
GOLDENROD CITY isa landmark. They're running a
promotional cam- paign right now. They'll modify
your #GEAR, so it can also
serve as a radio.
entries.translation:
到满金市就要去电台！ 听说现在正在进行活动，
有机会让你的宝可装置获得听广播的功能！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text_GotRadioCard
entries.english:
Oh, your #GEAR
works as a radio!
entries.translation:
哇，你的宝可装置
可以听广播呢！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityFlowerShopSignText
entries.english:
Blooming Beautiful
FLOWER SHOP
entries.translation:
开满漂亮的鲜花！
花店

entries.label: GoldenrodCityGameCornerSignText
entries.english:
Your Playground! GOLDENROD CITY
GAME CORNER
entries.translation:
大家的游乐园！
……满金游戏城

entries.label: GoldenrodCityGrampsText
entries.english:
Whew! This is one
big town. I don't know where any-
thing is.
entries.translation:
嗬哟，这城市真气派啊！
不过实在是太大了，根本搞不清楚哪是哪啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityLassText
entries.english:
The man at that
house rates your#MON names. He can even rename
your #MON.
entries.translation:
可以去那间屋子里，
对宝可梦的昵称进行占卜哦。 你甚至还可以在那里
给宝可梦重新取个好名字。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAsk4000CoinsOkayText
entries.english:
It will cost you
4000 coins. Okay?
entries.translation:
你要给我4000枚代币，
可以吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAskTeachAMoveText
entries.english:
I can teach your
#MON amazing moves if you'd
like. Should I teach a
new move?
entries.translation:
我能教会宝可梦
超级厉害的招式…… 想让我教超厉害的招式吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAwwButTheyreAmazingText
entries.english:
Aww… But they're
amazing…
entries.translation: 真的很厉害哦……

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorBButText
entries.english: B-but…
entries.translation: 这、这样啊……

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorFarewellKidText
entries.english:
Wahahah!
Farewell, kid!
entries.translation:
哇、哈、哈！
那就告辞了！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorHmTooBadText
entries.english:
Hm, too bad. I'll
have to get somecash from home…
entries.translation:
真是的……
回去多要点零花钱吧……

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorIfYouUnderstandYouveMadeItText
entries.english:
If you understand
what's so amazing about this move,
you've made it asa trainer.
entries.translation:
成熟的训练家才能明白
这些招式的厉害之处。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorWhichMoveShouldITeachText
entries.english:
Wahahah! You won't
regret it! Which move should
I teach?
entries.translation:
哇、哈、哈！很好！
那么……要学哪个招式？

entries.label: GoldenrodCityMoveTutorYouDontHaveEnoughCoinsText
entries.english:
…You don't have
enough coins here…
entries.translation: ……你的代币不太够吧？

entries.label: GoldenrodCityNameRaterSignText
entries.english:
NAME RATER Get Your #MON
Nicknames Rated
entries.translation:
这里是姓名鉴定师的家
为您占卜宝可梦的姓名

entries.label: GoldenrodCityPokeComCenterSignText
entries.english:
For Mobile Tips!
#COM CENTER
entries.translation:
移动通信，尽在此处！
宝可梦对话中心

entries.label: GoldenrodCityPokefanMText
entries.english:
They built the new
RADIO TOWER to replace the old,
creaky one.
entries.translation:
原本在这里的塔太旧了，
随时可能会倒塌，所以改建成了全新的电台。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRadioTowerSignText
entries.english:
GOLDENROD CITY
RADIO TOWER
entries.translation: 满金电台

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket1Text
entries.english:
Stay out of the
way! Beat it!
entries.translation:
喂，不要在这里瞎晃悠！
你这样很烦人啊！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket2Text
entries.english:
Take over the
RADIO TOWER… What? It's none of
your business!
entries.translation:
如果能占领电台…… 你干嘛！
关你一个小孩什么事！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket3Text
entries.english:
#MON? They're
nothing more than tools for making
money!
entries.translation:
宝可梦？
那是用来挣钱的工具吧！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket4Text
entries.english:
Our dream will
soon come true… It was such a long
struggle…
entries.translation:
我们的野心马上就能……
实在是等了太久了……

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket5Text
entries.english:
Hey, brat! You
don't belong here!Get lost!
entries.translation:
喂！
你一个小孩来这里干嘛！？一边凉快去！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocket6Text
entries.english:
Come taste the
true terror ofTEAM ROCKET!
entries.translation:
你最好还是明白
火箭队到底有多可怕！

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText1
entries.english:
So this is the
RADIO TOWER…
entries.translation: 这里就是电台吗……

entries.label: GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText2
entries.english:
What do you want,
you pest? Scram!
entries.translation: 你怎么回事？一边去！

entries.label: GoldenrodCitySignText
entries.english:
GOLDENROD CITY The Festive City
of Opulent Charm
entries.translation:
这里是满金市
华丽绚烂，精致、精神、精美的城市

entries.label: GoldenrodCityStationSignText
entries.english:
GOLDENROD CITY
STATION
entries.translation: 这里是满金车站

entries.label: GoldenrodCityUndergroundSignNorthText
entries.english:
UNDERGROUND
ENTRANCE
entries.translation: 前方是地下通道

entries.label: GoldenrodCityUndergroundSignSouthText
entries.english:
UNDERGROUND
ENTRANCE
entries.translation: 前方是地下通道

entries.label: GoldenrodCityYoungster1Text
entries.english:
I know there's a
new BIKE SHOP, but I can't find it
anywhere.
entries.translation:
附近新开了一家自行车店，
但是到底在哪里啊？根本找不到啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodCityYoungster2Text
entries.english:
E-he-he-he… I got in trouble
for playing in the basement of the
DEPT.STORE.
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿……
本来想在百货店地下楼层玩捉迷藏，结果被批评了。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreSignText
entries.english:
Full Selection of
#MON Goods! GOLDENROD CITY
DEPT.STORE
entries.translation:
宝可梦物品应有尽有！
满金百货店

entries.label: GoldenrodGymSignText
entries.english:
GOLDENROD CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: WHITNEY The Incredibly
Pretty Girl!
entries.translation:
满金市宝可梦道馆
馆主：小茜火爆的可爱小姐姐！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FBugCatcherText
entries.english:
Mom's good at
bargain hunting. She always buys
stuff at lowerprices.
entries.translation:
妈妈很会买东西。 总能用低廉的价格
买到道具哦。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FDirectoryText
entries.english:
1F SERVICE COUNTER 2F TRAINER'S
MARKET 3F BATTLE
COLLECTION 4F MEDICINE BOX 5F TM CORNER 6F TRANQUIL SQUARE ROOFTOP LOOKOUT
entries.translation:
1楼 …… 服务柜台
2楼 …… 训练家广场3楼 …… 对战收藏4楼 …… 药品专区5楼 …… 招式学习器专柜6楼 …… 休息广场楼顶 …… 观景台

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
The DEPT.STORE
has a decent se-lection. But some items
are only available as GAME CORNER
prizes.
entries.translation:
在满金市的百货商店里，
各种商品一应俱全。 但是呢，在这个城市里
也有很多东西只能在游戏城作为奖品获得。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FPokefanFText
entries.english:
I'm raring to shop
again today!
entries.translation:
那么，
今天也要大买特买！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore1FReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome to GOLDEN-
ROD DEPT.STORE.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
这里是满金百货店。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I got my ABRA at
the GAME CORNER. Now it's my best
partner.
entries.translation:
我的凯西
是从游戏城里获得的，现在是我重要的同伴。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Your Travel
Companion 2F TRAINER'S
MARKET
entries.translation:
伴你同行
2楼 …… 训练家广场

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FGentlemanText
entries.english:
This DEPT.STORE
makes me realize that GOLDENROD is
a big city. The selection here
is unmatched any-where else.
entries.translation:
一到百货店就会觉得
满金市不愧是大城市。 商品琳琅满目，
其他地方根本没得比。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FUnusedText1
entries.english:
We intend to sell
items for #MONto hold. This is a free
gift. Have a #-MON hold it.
entries.translation:
我们打算在这卖一些
宝可梦能携带的道具。 这是特别礼品，
让宝可梦携带它吧。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FUnusedText2
entries.english:
By giving #MON
items to hold, I bet trainers will
develop new battletechniques.
entries.translation:
通过给宝可梦携带道具，
对战之中一定会出现各种新颖的战术！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore2FYoungsterText
entries.english:
#GEAR can store
up to ten phonenumbers. It's hard to de-
cide which numbersto keep.
entries.translation:
宝可装置至多可以
添加十个人的号码。 到底要添加谁的号码呢，
真的好难决定啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore3FDirectoryText
entries.english:
For Victory
Seekers 3F BATTLE
COLLECTION
entries.translation:
一切为了获胜
3楼 …… 对战收藏

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore3FRockerText
entries.english:
Hey! When you bat-
tle, do you use XSPECIAL? It's awesome. It
really jacks upSPECIAL ATTACK!
entries.translation:
喂，你有没有在对战时
给宝可梦用过特攻强化？ 特殊能力上升之后，
感觉超级棒哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore3FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
I, I, I'm really
impatient! I use X SPEED in
battle to speed upmy #MON.
entries.translation:
我、我是急、急性子，
宝、宝可梦对战要用速度强化提、提升速度！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FBugCatcherText
entries.english:
IRON adds to your
#MON's DEFENSE.
entries.translation:
防御增强剂可以
提升宝可梦的防御力哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
Hey. I love strong
#MON. I feed them PRO-
TEIN to crank uptheir ATTACK.
entries.translation:
我喜欢强大的宝可梦。
大量使用攻击增强剂之后，攻击力也会大量上升哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Let Us Pump Up
Your #MON! 4F MEDICINE BOX
entries.translation:
提升宝可梦的能力！
4楼 …… 药品专区

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore4FGameboyKidText
entries.english:
Some #MON
evolve only by being traded via a
Game Link cable. I know of four:
MACHOKE, KADABRA, HAUNTER and, um,
GRAVELER. I heard there are
others too.
entries.translation:
有的宝可梦穿越
连接线之后会进化。 比方说：豪力、勇基拉、
鬼斯通，还有隆隆石。不过听说不止这四种。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftExplanationText
entries.english:
MYSTERY GIFT. With just a
little beep, youget a gift.
entries.translation: 神秘礼物 哔！ 的一声，礼物收到了！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftRequiresGBCText
entries.english:
The MYSTERY GIFT
option requires aGame Boy Color.
entries.translation:
神秘礼物 您的Game Boy
无法接收……

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Customize Your
#MON 5F TM CORNER
entries.translation:
打造你专属的宝可梦
5楼 …… 招式学习器专柜

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FLassText
entries.english:
On Sundays, a lady
comes to check out#MON. She even gives
away TMs!
entries.translation:
有个大姐姐周日会过来。
让她看看宝可梦的状况，有机会得到招式学习器哦。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FPokefanMText
entries.english:
You can't rename a
#MON you get ina trade. The name is a re-
flection of the original trainer's
feelings for it.
entries.translation:
从别人那获得的宝可梦
是无法更改名字的。 因为名字里包含了
命名者的心意啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItLooksEvilHowAboutThisTMText
entries.english:
It looks evil. How
about this TM forit?
entries.translation:
它的眼神似乎不太友善呢。
对于这样的宝可梦，不妨试试这个招式学习器？

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItsAdorableText
entries.english:
It's adorable! You should teach
it good TM moves.
entries.translation:
相当可爱呢！ 一定要用招式学习器
让它多学几个好招式哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistOhYourMonDotDotDotText
entries.english:
Hello. Oh, your
#MON…
entries.translation: 欢迎光临！ 哎呀，您的宝可梦……

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThereAreTMsPerfectForMonText
entries.english:
There are sure to
be TMs that are just perfect for
your #MON.
entries.translation:
总有一款招式学习器
适合你的宝可梦。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThisMoveShouldBePerfectText
entries.english:
It's very attached
to you. This move should
be perfect for apair like you.
entries.translation:
和你极其亲密呢！
你们这一对组合一定能灵活运用这个招式！

entries.label: GoldenrodClangText
entries.english:
Clang! A can of
{STRBUF}popped out!
entries.translation: 哐当！ {STRBUF}已滑落至取物口！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FDirectoryText
entries.english:
Take a Break from
Shopping! 6F TRANQUIL SQUARE
entries.translation:
缓解您购物的疲劳
6楼 …… 休息广场

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FLassText
entries.english:
Do you listen to
LUCKY CHANNEL? If you want to
win, trade #MON with as many peo-
ple as possible to get different ID
numbers.
entries.translation:
喂，你听过广播里的
幸运频道吗？ 如果和很多人
交换过宝可梦，收集了很多ID的话，中奖的机会比较大哦。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStore6FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
If you're tired,
try the vendingmachine's drinks. Your #MON will
love them too.
entries.translation:
累了困了，就喝
自动贩卖机里的饮料！宝可梦也很爱喝饮料的。

entries.label: GoldenrodVendingNoMoneyText
entries.english:
Oops, not enough
money.
entries.translation: 钱不够！

entries.label: GoldenrodVendingNoSpaceText
entries.english:
There's no more
room for stuff.
entries.translation: 已经拿不下了！

entries.label: GoldenrodVendingText
entries.english:
A vending machine!
Here's the menu.
entries.translation:
是自动贩卖机！
想要的饮料是…………

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt1Text
entries.english:
Hey, kid! You're
holding us up! Our policy is to
work behind the scenes where no
one can see us!
entries.translation:
哎！别妨碍我工作！
没人在旁边才能工作，这是我们的基本原则！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt2Text
entries.translation:
要是被人看见了，
就没精力去搬运货物了！一边呆着去！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt3Text
entries.english:
Oohah! Oohah! The stuff on the
ground's junk. Take it if you
want it!
entries.translation:
哟吼，哟吼。 掉在地上的净是些破烂，
想要的话随便拿！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FMachokeText
entries.english: MACHOKE: Maaacho!
entries.translation: 豪力：豪、豪嗷嗷！

entries.label: Binoculars1Text
entries.english:
These binoculars
let me see far away. Maybe I can
see my own house. Is it the one with
the green roof?
entries.translation:
用望远镜可以看得很远！
就连我家都看得见！是那个绿色屋顶的房子吧？

entries.label: Binoculars2Text
entries.english:
Hey! Some trainers
are battling onthe road! A #MON fired a
flurry of leaves! That makes me feel
like battlingright now!
entries.translation:
啊！有两个人
在路上进行对战！ 宝可梦放出了
一大把叶子！看得我也跃跃欲试了！

entries.label: Binoculars3Text
entries.english:
A FISHER caught a
lot of MAGIKARP… They're SPLASHing
at the same time! Look at the water
going everywhere!
entries.translation:
大叔一竿接一竿，
钓上了一堆鲤鱼王，都在那里活蹦乱跳…… 溅起了好大的水花！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofBugCatcherText
entries.english:
My #MON always
get paralyzed or poisoned when the
chips are down… So I came to buy
some FULL HEAL. I wonder if
there's any left?
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
一到关键时刻就会陷入麻痹或者中毒，所以我想来买万灵药，应该还买得到吧……

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofFisherText
entries.english:
Pardon? Who says
an adult can't getinto this? I'm going to be
back every day to collect all the
dolls!
entries.translation:
什么？
大人沉迷其中也没关系吧！ 我每天都会来，
总有一天要集齐玩偶！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanFText
entries.english:
Whew, I'm tired. I sometimes come
up to the rooftop to take a break
from shopping.
entries.translation:
吁！好累啊！ 我偶尔会在购物时，
来到屋顶喘口气。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanMText
entries.english:
There's something
I really want, but I don't have the
necessary cash… Maybe I'll sell
off the BERRIESI've collected…
entries.translation:
虽然有非常想要的东西，
但是零花钱不够…… 要不，我去把
努力收集到的树果卖了……

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofSuperNerdOhWowText
entries.english: Oh, wow!
entries.translation: 哇，太厉害了！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofSuperNerdQuitBotheringMeText
entries.english:
Will you quit
bothering me?
entries.translation: 喂喂，别来烦我啊！

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTeacherText
entries.english:
Oh, everything is
so cheap! I bought so much,
my PACK's crammed!
entries.translation:
不论什么东西都很便宜！
我好像买太多东西了，背包都快胀破了啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTwinText
entries.english:
They have bargain
sales here everyso often.
entries.translation:
这个地方有时候
会进行打折活动哦。

entries.label: PokeDollVendingMachineText
entries.english:
A vending machine
for #MON dolls? Insert money, then
turn the crank… But it's almost
empty…
entries.translation:
把钱塞进去转动把手，
就会有小巧的宝可梦玩偶从这台自动贩卖机里出来！ 但是里面基本上是空的……

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopFloriaItReallyWasAMonText
entries.english:
So it really was a
#MON!
entries.translation: 那果然是只宝可梦啊！

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopFloriaWonderIfSisWillLendWaterBottleText
entries.english:
When I told my sis
about the jiggly tree, she told me
it's dangerous. If I beat WHITNEY,
I wonder if she'll lend me her water
bottle…
entries.translation:
我跟我姐姐讲了
那棵会动的树的事情，她却说太危险了别管它！ 如果我能打赢小茜，
她说就会给我喷壶吧……

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopFloriaYouBeatWhitneyText
entries.english:
Wow, you beat
WHITNEY? Cool!
entries.translation: 居然赢了小茜，真厉害啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherAskWantToBorrowWaterBottleText
entries.english:
Do you want to
borrow the water bottle too?
I don't want you doing anything
dangerous with it.
entries.translation:
你也想找我借喷壶？
不要想这种危险的事情啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherDontDoAnythingDangerousText
entries.english:
Don't do anything
too dangerous!
entries.translation: 不要做危险的事情啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherHeresTheSquirtbottleText
entries.english:
Oh, you're better
than WHITNEY… You'll be OK,
then. Here's theSQUIRTBOTTLE!
entries.translation:
哎呀，你居然
比小茜还要厉害啊…… 那应该就没问题了。
这个杰尼龟喷壶就给你了。

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherLalalaHavePlentyOfWaterText
entries.english:
Lalala lalalala.
Have plenty ofwater, my lovely!
entries.translation:
啦啦啦～啦啦啦啦～
浇水浇得饱饱哒～

entries.label: GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherMySisterWentToSeeWigglyTreeRoute36Text
entries.english:
Have you seen that
wiggly tree that's growing on ROUTE
36? My little sister
got all excited and went to see
it… I'm worried… Isn't
it dangerous?
entries.translation:
你有没有在36号道路
看到一棵会动的树？ 我妹妹觉得很有意思，
就跑去看了……我担心她会遇到危险……

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I won't quit until
I win!
entries.translation: 没赢到钱绝不撒手！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
Life is a gamble.
I'm going to flipcards till I drop!
entries.translation:
人生成败，在此一举！
翻牌、翻牌，赶紧翻牌！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerGentlemanText
entries.english:
I taught BLIZZARD
to my #MON. It was hard to get
enough coins for it, but it was
worth it.
entries.translation:
我让我的宝可梦
记住了“暴风雪”哦。 积攒代币确实不容易，
但是也是相当有意义的。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerLeftTheirDrinkText
entries.english:
Someone left their
drink. It smells sweet.
entries.translation:
有一杯没喝完的饮品，
散发着香甜的桃子味……

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPharmacistText
entries.english:
I always play this
slot machine. It pays out more than
others, I think.
entries.translation:
我总是玩这台老虎机。
比起其他的机子，这台好像更容易出代币。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanFText
entries.english:
Card flip… I prefer it over
the slots because it's easier to
figure the odds. But the payout is
much lower.
entries.translation:
翻牌游戏…… 靠自己就能轻松预判，
虽然赔率不如老虎机，但是我更喜欢玩这个。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM1Text
entries.english:
I just love this
new slot machine. It's more of a
challenge than theones in CELADON.
entries.translation:
最新款老虎机就是好。
比起在玉虹市的机子，这台更有挑战性！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM2Text
entries.english:
I couldn't win at
the slots, and I blew it on card
flipping… I got so furious,
I tossed out my COIN CASE in the
UNDERGROUND.
entries.translation:
玩老虎机赢不了钱！
玩翻牌游戏也赢不了钱！ 一时生气，我就把代币盒
丢在地下通道了！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorConfirmPrizeText
entries.english:
{STRBUF}.
Is that right?
entries.translation: {STRBUF}，可以吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorHereYouGoText
entries.english: Here you go!
entries.translation: 给，请收下！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorIntroText
entries.english:
Welcome! We exchange your
game coins forfabulous prizes!
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！ 您可以在这里，
把游戏中积攒的代币兑换成精美奖品！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNeedMoreCoinsText
entries.english:
Sorry! You need
more coins.
entries.translation: 您的代币不够哦。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoCoinCaseText
entries.english:
Oh? You don't have
a COIN CASE.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
你没有代币盒呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoMoreRoomText
entries.english:
Sorry. You can't
carry any more.
entries.translation: 已经拿不下了。

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorQuitText
entries.english:
OK. Please save
your coins andcome again!
entries.translation:
啊，这样吗。
请多积攒一些代币再来！

entries.label: GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorWhichPrizeText
entries.english:
Which prize would
you like?
entries.translation: 要哪个呢？

entries.label: MoveTutorInsideText
entries.english:
Wahahah! The coins
keep rolling in!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈！代币变多了，
笑得合不拢嘴！

entries.label: BeautySamanthaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I taught MEOWTH
moves for takingon any type…
entries.translation:
为了能应付
各种属性的宝可梦，我特地让它们学会了招式。

entries.label: BeautySamanthaBeatenText
entries.english:
No! Oh, MEOWTH,
I'm so sorry!
entries.translation:
讨厌～！！
抱歉啊，我的小喵喵。

entries.label: BeautySamanthaSeenText
entries.english:
Give it your best
shot, or I'll takeyou down!
entries.translation:
如果不认真一点，
可没有好果子吃哦！

entries.label: BeautyVictoriaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Wow, you must be
good to beat me!Keep it up!
entries.translation:
居然把姐姐打败了，
了不起，了不起！就这样继续努力吧。

entries.label: BeautyVictoriaBeatenText
entries.english:
Let's see… Oops,
it's over?
entries.translation:
呃……
哎呀，结束了？

entries.label: BeautyVictoriaSeenText
entries.english:
Oh, you are a cute
little trainer!  I like you, but I
won't hold back!
entries.translation:
哎呀，这个训练家真可爱！
姐姐我很中意你！不过我可不会手下留情哦！

entries.label: BridgetWhitneyCriesText
entries.english:
Oh, no. You made
WHITNEY cry. It's OK. She'll
stop soon. She always cries when
she loses.
entries.translation:
哎呀，
你把小茜弄哭了啊…… 没事啦！
过一会儿就好了，她每次输了都会哭。

entries.label: GoldenrodGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! This GYM is home
to normal-type#MON trainers. I recommend you
use fighting-type#MON.
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！ 这个道馆中
聚集了很多使用一般属性宝可梦的高手哦！ 如果你想和她们对战，
我建议你使用格斗属性的宝可梦！

entries.label: GoldenrodGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
You won? Great! I
was busy admiringthe ladies here.
entries.translation:
赢了吗？那太好了！
我光顾着看这些姑娘了。

entries.label: LassBridgetAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm trying to beat
WHITNEY, but…It's depressing. I'm okay! If I
lose, I'll just try harder next
time!
entries.translation:
我一直都在努力练习，
希望有一天能打败小茜。看来现在还差很远呢…… 骗你的啦！
这次输了，下次就要努力！

entries.label: LassBridgetBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, no, no, no!
entries.translation: 啊，不行不行！

entries.label: LassBridgetSeenText
entries.english:
I like cute #-
MON better thanstrong #MON. But I have strong
and cute #MON!
entries.translation:
比起强大的宝可梦，
我更喜欢可爱的宝可梦！ 不过我的宝可梦，
既强大又可爱！

entries.label: LassCarrieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Do my #MON
think I'm cute?
entries.translation:
不知道宝可梦
会不会觉得我很可爱？

entries.label: LassCarrieBeatenText
entries.english:
Darn… I thought
you were weak…
entries.translation:
输掉了……
好像是我太不小心了。

entries.label: LassCarrieSeenText
entries.english:
Don't let my
#MON's cute looks fool you.
They can whip you!
entries.translation:
别看我的宝可梦这么可爱，
你一不小心就会吃苦头的！

entries.label: PlayerReceivedPlainBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
PLAINBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小茜那里
得到了标准徽章！

entries.label: WhitneyAttractText
entries.english:
It's ATTRACT!
It makes full use of a #MON's
charm. Isn't it just per-
fect for a cutielike me?
entries.translation:
这是叫做迷人的招式，
可以让宝可梦最大限度地发挥出自个儿的魅力，特适合我这种可爱的姑娘！

entries.label: WhitneyBeforeText
entries.english:
Hi! I'm WHITNEY! Everyone was into
#MON, so I gotinto it too! #MON are
super-cute! You want to bat-
tle? I'm warningyou--I'm good!
entries.translation:
嘿～！
我是小茜！！ 大家都在玩宝可梦，
所以我也跟着玩起来了。宝可梦真是越看越可爱！ 哎～你是来挑战的？
那你必须清楚，我可是强得不得了哦！

entries.label: WhitneyGoodCryText
entries.english:
Ah, that was a
good cry! Come for a visit
again! Bye-bye!
entries.translation:
哼！
哭出来以后舒服多了！ 下次再来玩儿吧！
拜拜！

entries.label: WhitneyPlainBadgeText
entries.english:
PLAINBADGE lets
your #MON use STRENGTH outside
of battle. It also boosts
your #MON'sSPEED. Oh, you can have
this too!
entries.translation:
如果持有标准徽章，
即使不在战斗中，也可以使用怪力了。宝可梦的速度也会上升。 然后还有这个！

entries.label: WhitneyShouldntBeSoSeriousText
entries.english:
Sob… …Waaaaaaah!
You're mean! You shouldn't be
so serious! You…you child, you!
entries.translation:
呜呜…… ……哇——！！
过分，过分！！ 我才没使小性儿呢！！
像你这种小孩儿……

entries.label: WhitneyWhatDoYouWantText
entries.english:
…Sniff… What? What do you
want? A BADGE? Oh, right.
I forgot. Here'sPLAINBADGE.
entries.translation:
呜…… 怎么了？你还想怎么样？
啊，徽章？ 抱歉，我忘了。
给，这是标准徽章，你很想要，对吧！

entries.label: WhitneyYouMeanieText
entries.english:
Waaaaah! Waaaaah! …Snivel, hic…
…You meanie!
entries.translation:
哇——！！ 哇——！！ 呜呜呜……
太过分了！！

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterPokefanMText
entries.english:
I keep losing in
battles, and my #MON end up
fainting… Maybe that's why
my #MON don'tlike me much…
entries.translation:
在宝可梦对战中总是打输，
让宝可梦陷入濒死状态…… 或许就是因为这样，才会
和宝可梦亲密不起来的。

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterTeacherText
entries.english:
If you treat your
#MON nicely, they will love you
in return. Oh? Let me see
your {STRBUF}…
entries.translation:
只要对宝可梦好，
宝可梦就会亲近你。 哎呀？
你的{STRBUF}……

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRaterTwinText
entries.english:
When I use an item
on my #MON, itacts really glad!
entries.translation:
如果给宝可梦使用道具
它就会变得非常开心哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LooksMean
entries.english:
It doesn't seem to
like you at all.It looks mean.
entries.translation:
对你完全没有亲密感，
它的眼神似乎不太友善。

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LovesYouALot
entries.english:
It looks really
happy! It mustlove you a lot.
entries.translation:
真是无比幸福啊！
它一定和你极其亲密呢！

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_NotUsedToYou
entries.english:
You should treat
it better. It'snot used to you.
entries.translation:
你对它多付出一点关爱吧？
感觉它还没有适应你。

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_QuiteCute
entries.english: It's quite cute.
entries.translation: 相当可爱呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_ReallyTrustsYou
entries.english:
I get the feeling
that it reallytrusts you.
entries.translation:
对你非常信赖，
我是这么感觉的。

entries.label: GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_SortOfHappy
entries.english:
It's friendly to-
ward you. It lookssort of happy.
entries.translation:
正在和你亲密起来，
它好像很幸福呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationGentlemanText
entries.english:
I'm the PRESIDENT. My dream was to
build a train that is faster than any
#MON. It really brings
JOHTO much closerto KANTO.
entries.translation:
我是这儿的老板！ 我的梦想是建设
比宝可梦还快的铁路！ 那样一来，城都和关都的
距离一下子就缩短了！

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYouComingAboardText
entries.english:
We'll soon depart
for SAFFRON. Are you coming
aboard?
entries.translation:
开往金黄市的列车
马上就要出发了，请问您要乘坐吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrivedInGoldenrodText
entries.english:
We have arrived in
GOLDENROD. We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
路上辛苦了。
列车已经到达满金市。 衷心期待
您下次乘坐我们的列车！

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeToSeeYouAgainText
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.translation:
衷心期待
您下次乘坐我们的列车！

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightThisWayText
entries.english:
May I see your
rail PASS, please? OK. Right this
way, please.
entries.translation:
请出示一下车票！ 好了！
请走这边！

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerTheTrainHasntComeInText
entries.english:
The train hasn't
come in… I know! I'll carry
the passengers onmy back! That won't work.
entries.translation:
电车没有入站！ 作为对乘客的补偿
只好由我背着各位…… 好像不太现实。

entries.label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDontHaveARailPassText
entries.english:
Sorry. You don't
have a rail PASS.
entries.translation:
啊呀，这位乘客
您没有带车票呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseFisherText
entries.english:
Once while I was
battling, my #MON couldn't
make any moves. The POWER POINTS,
or PP, of its moves were all
gone.
entries.translation:
我之前进行对战的时候，
宝可梦使不出招式了。 因为招式点数
变成0了啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseLassText
entries.english:
Sometimes, a
healthy #MON may be unable to
use its moves. If that happens,
heal it at a #-MON CENTER or usean item.
entries.translation:
即使宝可梦还有精力，
也可能会用不出招式！ 这时要去宝可梦中心，
或者使用道具来治愈！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPleaseAcceptGSBallText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, isn't it? Congratulations! As a special deal,
a GS BALL has beensent just for you! Please accept it!
entries.translation:
您是{PLAYER}吧？ 恭喜！ 我们接收到了
叫做GS球的物品，将会转赠给您！ 请收下！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPleaseDoComeAgainText
entries.english:
Please do come
again!
entries.translation: 欢迎再次光临！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FAskGiveAwayAnEonMailText
entries.english:
Give away an EON
MAIL?
entries.translation: 要给出布布邮件吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FGameboyKidText
entries.english:
The COLOSSEUM
upstairs is forlink battles. Battle records are
posted on the wall, so I can't
afford to lose.
entries.translation:
在2楼的竞技场中
可以进行连接对战。 墙上可以看到自己的成绩，
所以不能输太惨啊。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FLassText
entries.english:
A higher level
#MON doesn'talways win. After all, it may
have a type dis-advantage. I don't think
there is a single #MON that is
the toughest.
entries.translation:
因为有属性相克，
不论等级多高， 绝对强大的宝可梦
也是几乎不存在的。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPlayerGaveAwayTheEonMailText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} gave away
the EON MAIL.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}交出了
布布邮件！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFAnotherTimeThenText
entries.english:
Oh… Well, another
time, then.
entries.translation:
哎呀……
那还是下次再说吧。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFDaughterWillBeDelightedText
entries.english:
My daughter will
be delighted!
entries.translation: 我女儿一定会很高兴的！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFDoYouHaveEonMailText
entries.english:
Oh my, your pack
looks so heavy! Oh! Do you happen
to have somethingnamed EON MAIL? My daughter is
after one. You can part with
one, can't you?
entries.translation:
哎呀哎呀！你的背包里
装了许多东西对吧？ 对了！你有没有
叫做布布邮件的道具？我的女儿说她很想要，你能分我一个吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFThisIsForYouText
entries.english:
Oh, that's great!
Thank you, honey! Here, this is for
you in return!
entries.translation:
啊啊，帮大忙了！
谢谢你啊。 白拿你的东西也不太好，
这个就当是回礼了。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFTooBadText
entries.english:
Oh? You don't have
one? Too bad.
entries.translation: 哎呀，没有吗？真可惜……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecenter1FWeHopeToSeeYouAgainText_2
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
期待您的
下次光临！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterAlreadyHoldingMonText
entries.english:
Oh? Aren't we
already holding a#MON of yours?
entries.translation:
哎呀？我记得……
您好像寄放过宝可梦了？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptAbnormalMonText
entries.english:
Sorry, but your
#MON appears to be abnormal. We
can't accept it.
entries.translation:
宝可梦有异常，
无法寄放！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptEggText
entries.english:
Sorry. We can't
accept an EGG.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，
您不能寄放蛋。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptLastMonText
entries.english:
If we accept that
#MON, what willyou battle with?
entries.translation:
如果寄放这只宝可梦，
可战斗的同行宝可梦 就要没有了！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCheckingTheRoomsText
entries.english:
We'll check the
rooms. Please wait.
entries.translation:
那么，我们讲核对房间，
请耐心等待……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCommunicationErrorText
entries.english:
Communication
error…
entries.translation: 连接错误

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterContinueToHoldYourMonText
entries.english:
Fine. We will
continue to holdyour #MON.
entries.translation:
那么，我们会
继续帮您保管宝可梦。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterCorruptedNewsDataText
entries.english:
The NEWS data is
corrupted. Please download
the NEWS again.
entries.translation:
新闻数据已经损坏，
请重新读取。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterEggTicketText
entries.english:
Oh! I see you have an
EGG TICKET! It's a coupon that
special people can redeem for a
special #MON!
entries.translation:
啊！ 您身上带着
“蛋兑换券”呢！ 蛋兑换券是特殊的兑换券，
可以将特别的宝可梦送给特别的人。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterHereIsYourOddEggText
entries.english:
Thank you for
waiting. We received your
ODD EGG. Here it is! Please raise it
with loving care.
entries.translation:
久等了！
我们已经收到谜之蛋了！ 这个谜之蛋送给你。 请您一定要
好好培育。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterItsYourNewPartnerText
entries.english:
It's your new
partner. Please take care
of it with love. We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
这是您的新同伴，
请您细心照料。 那么，
期待您的下次光临！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterMakingPreparationsText
entries.english:
We're making
preparations. Please come back
later.
entries.translation:
正在进行准备……
欢迎下次光临。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineExplanationText
entries.english:
#MON NEWS is
news compiled from the SAVE files of
#MON trainers. When reading the
NEWS, your SAVE file may be sent
out. The SAVE file data
will contain your adventure log and
mobile profile. Your phone number
will not be sent. The contents of
the NEWS will vary depending on the
SAVE files sent by you and the other
#MON trainers. You might even be
in the NEWS!
entries.translation:
宝可梦新闻是
收集大家的宝可梦记录从中整合出来的新闻！ 读取新的新闻时，
可能会上传您的宝可梦记录。 上传的记录内容是
你的冒险记录和移动档案。 而电话号码不会上传。 新闻的内容也会
根据大家上传的记录而产生不同的变化。 说不定
你的名字也会上新闻！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineNotYetText
entries.english:
It's a #MON
NEWS MACHINE! It's not in
operation yet…
entries.translation: 这是宝可梦播报机！ 现在好像还不能看新闻……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineText
entries.english:
It's a #MON
NEWS MACHINE.
entries.translation: 宝可梦新闻播报机！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoEggTicketServiceText
entries.english:
I'm awfully sorry. The EGG TICKET
exchange serviceisn't running now.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉！ 就在刚才，
蛋兑换券的服务中止了。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoOldNewsText
entries.english:
There is no old
NEWS…
entries.translation: 没有以前的新闻！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoTradePartnerFoundText
entries.english:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has come forward as a
trade partner. Would you like
your #MON back?
entries.translation:
非常遗憾……
目前还没找到交换对象。 您要取回
之前寄放的宝可梦吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterOddEggBriefingText
entries.english:
Let me give you a
quick briefing. Trades held at the
TRADE CORNER are between two
trainers who don't know each other's
identity. As a result, it
may take time. However, an ODD
EGG is availablejust for you. It will be sent to
you right away. Please choose one
of the rooms in the CENTER.
An ODD EGG will be sent from the
chosen room.
entries.translation:
那么，请允许我
简单地说明一下！ 在交换角落进行交换的话，
将会与从未见面的朋友们进行交换。这可能要花一点时间。 谜之蛋
是为您特别准备的，马上就能进行传送。 中心里有很多房间。
接下来， 您要选一间房间，
房间里的谜之蛋会传送到这里。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson10Text
entries.english:
I get anxious if I
don't check outthe latest NEWS!
entries.translation:
必须要是场检查新消息，
不然就很不舒服！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson11Text
entries.english:
If I get in the
NEWS and become famous, I bet I'll
be adored. I wonder how I
could get in theNEWS?
entries.translation:
如果我的名字上了新闻，
那我就出名了，一定会很受欢迎吧…… 不过，怎么才能上新闻？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson12Text
entries.english:
I came over here
when I got word that GOLDENROD's
#MON CENTER has new machines that
no one's ever seenbefore. But it looks like
they're still busy with all their
preparations…
entries.translation:
我听说满金市宝可梦中心
有很多没见过的机器，所以就过来了…… 但是工作人员好像
还在忙于准备工作呢……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson13Text
entries.english:
Just seeing all
these new things here makes me feel
younger!
entries.translation:
待在这里，
看到这么多新奇的东西，感觉自己也变年轻了呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson1Text
entries.english:
Whoa, this #MON
CENTER is huge. They just built
this place. They installed lots of
new machines too.
entries.translation:
这个宝可中心真大啊——
太厉害了—— 这里是新建成的，
里面放了很多新型机器哦！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson2Text
entries.english:
I thought up a fun
new thing for theTRADE CORNER! I make a PIDGEY
hold MAIL, then put it up for
trade for anotherone! If everyone did
that, MAIL could be traded with all
sorts of people! I call it PIDGEY
MAIL! If it becomes
popular, I might make lots of new
friends!
entries.translation:
我发现了
交换角落的新玩法！ 先让波波携带邮件，
然后再用它去交换我想要的宝可梦！ 如果大家都这么做，
那我就可以和很多人成为笔友了！ 我称之为波波邮件！ ……用了这种方式，
一定能交到很多朋友！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson3Text
entries.english:
They said you can
trade #MON with total strangers up
here. But they're still
adjusting things.
entries.translation:
我听说，在这里
可以和素未谋面的人进行交换！ 不过，
现在好像还在调整。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson4Text
entries.english:
Some girl I don't
know sent me her HOPPIP.
You should trade for a #MON that
you want.
entries.translation:
刚才有个不认识的女孩
送来了毽子草！ 能换到自己想要的宝可梦，
这不是很棒吗！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson5Text
entries.english:
I received a
female HOPPIP, butits named STANLEY! That's my dad's
name!
entries.translation:
收到的毽子草明明是母的，
名字却叫做康夫君！我爸也叫这个名字……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson6Text
entries.english:
What is the NEWS
MACHINE? Does it get news
from a wider areathan the radio?
entries.translation:
新闻播报机是什么啊？ 难道它的信号范围，
比广播要宽得多？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson7Text
entries.english:
The #COM CENTER
will link with all #MON CENTERS in
a wireless net. That must mean
I'll be able to link with all
sorts of people.
entries.translation:
据说宝可梦对话中心
和其他的宝可梦中心用无线电波相连！ 接下来
一定可以和更多的人进行连接了！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson8Text
entries.english:
The machines here
can't be used yet. Still, it's nice
coming to a trendy place before other
people.
entries.translation:
这里的设备
好像还不能使用。 但是我比别人更快看到
传说中的建筑物，还是非常开心的！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson9Text
entries.english:
My friend was in
the NEWS a while back. I was really
surprised!
entries.translation:
之前的新闻中出现了
朋友的名字，我很惊讶呢！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterPleaseWaitAMomentText
entries.english:
Please wait a
moment.
entries.translation:
马上进行准备，
请耐心等待……
