entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterReadingTheLatestNewsText
entries.english:
Reading the latest
NEWS… Please wait.
entries.translation:
正在读取新的新闻，
请在这里耐心等待。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterRecentlyLeftYourMonText
entries.english:
Oh? You left your
#MON with usonly recently. Please come back
later.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
从您宝可梦寄放之后好像还没有经过多少时间。 过了一段时间之后，
欢迎再次光临。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterReturnedYourMonText
entries.english:
We have returned
your #MON.
entries.translation:
已经将宝可梦
归还给您了。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeNewsMachineText
entries.english:
We will SAVE your
progress before starting the NEWS
MACHINE.
entries.translation:
启动新闻播报机之前，
将会写下记录。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeTradeCornerText
entries.english:
We'll SAVE before
connecting to theCENTER.
entries.translation:
在连接中心之前，
将会写下记录。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterSignText
entries.english:
#COM CENTER
1F INFORMATION Left:
ADMINISTRATION Center:
TRADE CORNER Right:
#MON NEWS
entries.translation:
宝可梦对话中心
1楼指南左侧……管理室中央……交换角落右侧……宝可梦新闻

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterTradeCanceledText
entries.english:
Sorry, but we must
cancel the trade.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，
我们将取消交换。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterTradePartnerHasBeenFoundText
entries.english:
Thank you for your
patience. A trade partner
has been found.
entries.translation:
让您久等了！
应该已经找到交换对象了。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeHopeToSeeYouAgainText
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
期待您的
下次光临！

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeMustHoldYourMonText
entries.english:
To make a trade,
we must hold your#MON. Would you like to
trade?
entries.translation:
为了进行交换，
您要先将宝可梦寄放…… 要进行交换吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeWillTradeYourMonForMonText
entries.english:
Fine. We will try
to trade your {STRBUF} for
{STRBUF}. We'll have to hold
your #MONduring the trade. Please wait while
we prepare theroom for it.
entries.translation:
我明白了。
用您的{STRBUF}和{STRBUF}进行交换。 那么，
我们将保管您的宝可梦。 接下来要准备房间，
请耐心等待……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeWillTradeYourMonForNewText
entries.english:
Fine. We will try
to trade your {STRBUF} for a
#MON that youhave never seen. We'll have to hold
your #MONduring the trade. Please wait while
we prepare theroom for it.
entries.translation:
明白了，用您的{STRBUF}
和您还没发现的宝可梦进行交换。 那么，
我们将保管您的宝可梦。 接下来要准备房间，
请耐心等待……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWelcomeToTradeCornerText
entries.english:
Hello! Welcome to
#COM CENTERTRADE CORNER. You can trade
#MON with otherpeople far away.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦对话中心
交换角落！ 您可以在这里
与从未见面的朋友们一起乐享宝可梦交换。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhatMonDoYouWantText
entries.english:
What kind of
#MON do youwant in return?
entries.translation:
接下来，
请说出您想要的宝可梦。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhatToDoText
entries.english:
What would you
like to do?
entries.translation: 要做什么？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhichMonToTradeText
entries.english:
Which #MON do
you want to trade?
entries.translation:
那么，请选择
要用于交换的宝可梦吧。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterWouldYouLikeTheNewsText
entries.english:
Would you like to
get the NEWS?
entries.translation:
要读取
新的新闻吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterYouHaveOnlyOneMonText
entries.english:
Oh? You have only
one #MON inyour party.  Please come back
once you've in-creased the sizeof your party.
entries.translation:
哎呀？您的同行宝可梦
好像仅有1只啊…… 增加同行宝可梦之后，
欢迎再次光临。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourMonHasBeenReceivedText
entries.english:
Your trade #MON
has been received. It will take time
to find a trade partner. Please
come back later.
entries.translation:
我们已经顺利地
接受了您的宝可梦。 由于寻找交换对象
需要花一些时间，请过一段时间再过来。

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourMonIsLonelyText
entries.english:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has come forward as a
trade partner. We've held your
#MON for a long time. As a result,
it is very lonely. Sorry, but we must
return it to you.
entries.translation:
非常遗憾……
目前还没找到交换对象。 因为寄放的时间太长，
您的宝可梦似乎非常地失落。 所以我们要把之前寄放的
宝可梦归还给您……

entries.label: GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourPartyIsFullText
entries.english:
Uh-oh. Your party
is already full. Please come back
when you have roomin your party.
entries.translation:
但是，您的同行宝可梦
好像已经满了…… 减少同行宝可梦之后，
欢迎再次光临。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundBasementKeyOpenedDoorText
entries.english:
The BASEMENT KEY
opened the door.
entries.translation:
使用了地下钥匙！
门打开了！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundNoEntryText
entries.english:
NO ENTRY BEYOND
THIS POINT
entries.translation: 前方禁止入内！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherAllDoneText
entries.english: There! All done!
entries.translation: 好了，结束了！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherAskWhichMonText
entries.english:
Which #MON
should I work on?
entries.translation: 要让哪只宝可梦变美？

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherOfferHaircutText
entries.english:
Welcome! I run the #MON
SALON! I'm the older and
better of the twoHAIRCUT BROTHERS. I can make your
#MON beautifulfor just $500. Would you like me
to do that?
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
这里是宝可梦美发沙龙！ 我是美发兄弟中的哥哥，
特点是手法稳健，只需500元就能让您的宝可梦变漂亮！ 怎么样？
想变漂亮吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherOneHaircutADayText
entries.english:
I do only one
haircut a day. I'mdone for today.
entries.translation:
1天只剪1次。
今天的营业结束了！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherThatsAShameText
entries.english:
Is that right?
That's a shame!
entries.translation:
是吗？
太遗憾了。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherWatchItBecomeBeautifulText
entries.english:
OK! Watch it
become beautiful!
entries.translation:
好——！
我要把它变得美美的！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherYoullNeedMoreMoneyText
entries.english:
You'll need more
money than that.
entries.translation: 看来你的钱不够呢。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundTheDoorIsOpenText
entries.english: The door is open.
entries.translation: 门开着。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundTheDoorsLockedText
entries.english: The door's locked…
entries.translation: 锁得紧紧的！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundWeAreNotOpenTodayText
entries.english:
We're not open
today.
entries.translation: 今天不开张。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherAllDoneText
entries.english:
There we go!
All done!
entries.translation: 好，完成了！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherAskWhichMonText
entries.english:
OK, which #MON
should I do?
entries.translation: 要让哪只宝可梦变帅？

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherHowDisappointingText
entries.english:
No? 
How disappointing!
entries.translation:
是吗？
真遗憾。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherIllMakeItLookCoolText
entries.english:
OK! I'll make it
look cool!
entries.translation:
好——！
我要把它变得帅帅的！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherOfferHaircutText
entries.english:
Welcome to the
#MON SALON! I'm the younger
and less expen-sive of the twoHAIRCUT BROTHERS. I'll spiff up your
#MON for just$300. So? How about it?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦美发沙龙！ 我是
美发兄弟中的弟弟！ 特点是物美价廉！
只需300元就能让您的宝可梦变漂亮哟！ 怎么样？
想交给我吗？

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherOneHaircutADayText
entries.english:
I can do only one
haircut a day. Sorry, but I'm all
done for today.
entries.translation:
1天只剪1次。
抱歉，今天打烊了！

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrotherShortOnFundsText
entries.english:
You're a little
short on funds.
entries.translation: 看来你的钱不够呢。

entries.label: HaircutBrosText_Happier
entries.english:
{STRBUF} looks
happy.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}
很高兴！

entries.label: HaircutBrosText_MuchHappier
entries.english:
{STRBUF} looks
delighted!
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}
非常高兴！

entries.label: HaircutBrosText_SlightlyHappier
entries.english:
{STRBUF} looks a
little happier.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}
有点高兴。

entries.label: PokemaniacDonaldAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Are you making a
#DEX? Here's ahot tip. The HIKER on ROUTE
33, ANTHONY, is agood guy. He'll phone you if
he sees any rare#MON.
entries.translation:
你在收集宝可梦图鉴？
我这里有宝贵的情报哦！ 33号道路有个登山男，
名字叫做勤快。 他一看到稀有的宝可梦，
就会打电话通知你哦！

entries.label: PokemaniacDonaldBeatenText
entries.english:
Gaah! I lost!
That makes me mad!
entries.translation:
哇啊——！
输了！好气啊！

entries.label: PokemaniacDonaldSeenText
entries.english:
I think you have
some rare #MONwith you. Let me see them!
entries.translation:
我感觉……
你带着稀有的宝可梦呢。听话，让我看看。

entries.label: PokemaniacIssacAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Your #MON will
like you more if you give them
haircuts.
entries.translation:
给宝可梦剪了头发之后，
我们的关系好像更亲密了。

entries.label: PokemaniacIssacBeatenText
entries.english: Aiyeeee!

entries.label: PokemaniacIssacSeenText
entries.english:
My #MON just
got a haircut! I'll show you how
strong it is!
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦刚剪了头！
就让你看看它的实力吧！

entries.label: SupernerdEricAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I guess I have to
do things fair andsquare…
entries.translation:
果然还是要
光明正大地做人吗……

entries.label: SupernerdEricBeatenText
entries.english: …Grumble…
entries.translation: ……嘟嘟囔囔。

entries.label: SupernerdEricSeenText
entries.english:
I got booted out
of the GAME COR-NER. I was trying to
cheat using my#MON…
entries.translation:
本来想用宝可梦来作弊。
不巧被人发现了，游戏城就把我赶出来了……

entries.label: SupernerdTeruAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I know my #MON
type alignments. But I only use one
type of #MON.
entries.translation:
虽然我很懂属性相克，
但我只使用同一种属性的宝可梦……

entries.label: SupernerdTeruBeatenText
entries.english: Ow, ow, ow!
entries.translation: 啊痛痛痛！

entries.label: SupernerdTeruSeenText
entries.english:
Do you consider
type alignments inbattle? If you know your
type advantages, you'll do better
in battle.
entries.translation:
你有没有研究过
宝可梦的属性相克？ 如果合理利用属性相克，
宝可梦就会变得更强哦！

entries.label: BurglarDuncanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Steal and sell!
That's basic incrime, kid!
entries.translation:
偷了别人的东西
再拿去卖掉……这是很坏的做法。

entries.label: BurglarDuncanBeatenText
entries.english: Mercy!
entries.translation: 一团浆糊！

entries.label: BurglarDuncanSeenText
entries.english:
Fork over your
goodies!
entries.translation:
把你的宝贝
乖乖交出来！

entries.label: BurglarEddieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
UNDERGROUND WARE-
HOUSE? What do you want
to go there for? There's nothing
down there.
entries.translation:
要去地下仓库吗？ 我还是劝你放弃吧，
那里什么都没有。

entries.label: BurglarEddieBeatenText
entries.english: Over the top!
entries.translation: 真强……

entries.label: BurglarEddieSeenText
entries.english:
They ditched this
project beforethey finished. I'm searching for
leftover loot.
entries.translation:
这里是烂尾建筑，
没建好就被弃置了……说不定能捡到什么宝贝。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_SuperNerdText
entries.english:
I was challenged
to a battle down-stairs. It's rough down
there. You'dbetter be careful.
entries.translation:
呼……有人在地下
向我发起宝可梦对战，害我吃了顿苦头。 你也要小心为妙。

entries.label: GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_TeacherText
entries.english:
There are some
shops downstairs… But there are
also trainers. I'm scared to go
down there.
entries.translation:
在地下有很多店铺…… 但是训练家也不少，
所以我不太敢靠近……

entries.label: GruntF3AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Go wherever you'd
like! Get lost!See if I care!
entries.translation:
够了！
爱上哪上哪去！最好赶紧迷路！

entries.label: GruntF3BeatenText
entries.english: How could you?
entries.translation: 啊，怎么可能！

entries.label: GruntF3SeenText
entries.english:
Are you lost? No,
you can't be. You don't have
that scared look. I'll give you
something to bescared about!
entries.translation:
迷路了吗？似乎不是呢。 你的眼神里充满了无畏。
那就让大姐姐我来教教你什么是真正的恐怖吧！

entries.label: GruntM11AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm confused too…
The switch on the end is the one to
press first, but…
entries.translation:
……我也迷路了。 本来应该先按
最里面的开关才对。

entries.label: GruntM11BeatenText
entries.english:
Drat! I was sunk
by indecision!
entries.translation:
可恶！
我的战斗太犹豫了吗。

entries.label: GruntM11SeenText
entries.english:
Open one shutter,
another closes. Bet you can't get
where you want!
entries.translation:
有一个卷帘门打开，
就会有另一个卷帘门关上。你能到达目的地吗？

entries.label: GruntM13AfterBattleText
entries.english:
You must have ice
in your veins todis TEAM ROCKET.
entries.translation:
居然敢对反抗火箭队，
真是不知天高地厚啊……

entries.label: GruntM13BeatenText
entries.english:
Urk! Yeah, think
you're cool, huh?
entries.translation:
切！
装什么酷啊！

entries.label: GruntM13SeenText
entries.english:
I don't care if
you're lost. You show up here,
you're nothing buta victim!
entries.translation:
管他是迷途小鬼还是羔羊，
敢在我面前出现的家伙，我全部都要打倒！

entries.label: GruntM25AfterBattleText
entries.english:
All right. A hint! Change the order
of switching. That'll change the
ways the shuttersopen and close.
entries.translation:
好吧，说好的提示。 如果以不同的顺序
按下卷帘门开关，连通的区域也会发生变化。

entries.label: GruntM25BeatenText
entries.english:
Uwww…
I blew it.
entries.translation:
呜呜……
被打败了。

entries.label: GruntM25SeenText
entries.english:
Kwahaha! Confounded by the
shutters, are we? I'll let you in on
a secret if youcan beat me!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈！ 被卷帘门的机关
搞糊涂了吧！ 如果你能战胜本大爷，
我就给你一个好消息。

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_Emergency
entries.english:
It's labeled
EMERGENCY.
entries.translation:
上面写着
“紧急开关”。

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_OffTurnOn
entries.english:
It's OFF.
Turn it ON?
entries.translation:
已经关上了，
要打开吗？

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_OnTurnOff
entries.english:
It's ON.
Turn it OFF?
entries.translation:
已经打开了，
要关上吗？

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch1
entries.english:
It's labeled
SWITCH 1.
entries.translation: 上面写着“开关1”

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch2
entries.english:
It's labeled
SWITCH 2.
entries.translation: 上面写着“开关2”

entries.label: SwitchRoomText_Switch3
entries.english:
It's labeled
SWITCH 3.
entries.translation: 上面写着“开关3”

entries.label: UndergroundRivalAfterText
entries.english:
…I don't under-
stand… Is what that LANCE
guy said true? That I don't treat
#MON properly? Love… Trust… Are they really
what I lack? Are they keeping
me from winning? I… I just don't
understand. But it's not going
to end here. Not now. Not
because of this. I won't give up my
dream of becoming the world's best
#MON trainer!
entries.translation:
……可恶，我不明白！ 难道真像那个阿渡所说，
因为我缺乏对宝可梦的 爱意…… 信赖…… 所以我才赢不了？ 不知道到底是怎么回事！ 但是，我不能止步于此。 怎么能就这样放弃
成为最强的梦想……

entries.label: UndergroundRivalBeforeText
entries.english:
Hold it! I saw you, so I
tailed you. I don't need you
underfoot while I take care of TEAM
ROCKET. …Wait a second.
You beat me be-fore, didn't you? That was just a
fluke. But I repay my
debts!
entries.translation:
慢着！ 我刚才凑巧看见你，
所以就跟在你的后面。 你怎么每次都跑出来
妨碍我击溃火箭队！ ……我想起来了，
上次我好像输给了你来着。 那回只是侥幸罢了，
出来混总是要还的！

entries.label: UndergroundRivalLossText
entries.english:
Humph. This is my
real power, wimp. I'll make TEAM
ROCKET history. And I'm going to
grind that LANCEunder my heels.
entries.translation:
这就是我的实力。 我要一鼓作气击溃火箭队！
然后再去打败那个叫阿渡的家伙！

entries.label: UndergroundRivalWinText
entries.english:
…Why…
Why do I lose? I've assembled the
toughest #MON. I didn't ease up
on the gas. So why do I lose?
entries.translation:
……为什么！
为什么我会输！ 我手上有最强的宝可梦，
对战中也没有放水啊…… 到底是为什么？

entries.label: DirectorAfterText
entries.english:
I'm begging you to
help. There's no telling
what they'll do if they control the
transmitter. They may even be
able to control #MON using a
special signal! You're the only
one I can call on. Please save the
RADIO TOWER… And all the #-
MON nationwide!
entries.translation:
拜托了！万一广播被劫持，
后果不堪设想！ 说不定他们会通过广播
释放奇怪的电波，以此来操纵宝可梦。 我现在只能指望你了……
请你拯救电台！拯救全国的宝可梦！

entries.label: DirectorCardKeyText
entries.english:
DIRECTOR: Use that
to open the shut-ters on 3F.
entries.translation:
局长：只要有这个，
就能打开3楼的卷帘门。

entries.label: DirectorIntroText
entries.english:
DIRECTOR: Who?
What? You came torescue me? Thank you! The RADIO TOWER! What's happening
there? Taken over by TEAM
ROCKET? Here. Take this
CARD KEY.
entries.translation:
局长：……你、你是？
啊，你是来救我的吗？真的是非常感谢啊。 对、对了！
电台现在怎么样了？ 什么？到处都有火箭队！
明白了！这个钥匙卡交给你了。

entries.label: GruntM14AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I lost… Please forgive me,
GIOVANNI!
entries.translation:
我输掉了……
坂木老大，对不起……

entries.label: GruntM14BeatenText
entries.english: Blast it!
entries.translation: 框当！！

entries.label: GruntM14SeenText
entries.english:
You're not going
any farther! I don't show mercy
to my enemies, noteven brats!
entries.translation:
见鬼！
别想再往前一步！ 就算对面是小孩子，
我也不会手下留情的！

entries.label: GruntM15AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
That was a blast!I'll remember you!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！有点意思！
我会记住你的。

entries.label: GruntM15BeatenText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
So, that's how?
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！
又是这样吗。

entries.label: GruntM15SeenText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
I remember you! You got me good
at our hideout!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！ 我还记得你哦。
在基地承蒙关照了。

entries.label: GruntM24AfterBattleText
entries.english:
TEAM ROCKET will
keep going, wait-ing for the returnof GIOVANNI. We'll do whatever
it takes.
entries.translation:
只要坂木老大还没回来，
我们就会一直守护着火箭队。 上天入地，在所不惜！

entries.label: GruntM24BeatenText
entries.english: I got disposed of…
entries.translation: 被收拾的人是我！

entries.label: GruntM24SeenText
entries.english:
How did you get
this far? I guess it can't
be helped. I'lldispose of you.
entries.translation:
居然能来到这里…… 那就没办法了，
就让我来收拾你吧！

entries.label: GuideGentsHouseGuideGentText
entries.english:
When I was a wee
lad, I was a hot-shot trainer! Here's a word of
advice: Catch lotsof #MON! Treat them all
with kindness!
entries.translation:
我年轻的时候
也是个充满干劲的训练家！ 那么，我给你一个建议！
多捉宝可梦！ 然后要温柔地
对待宝可梦！

entries.label: HallOfFame_LanceText
entries.english:
LANCE: It's been a
long time since Ilast came here. This is where we
honor the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS for all
eternity. Their courageous
#MON are alsoinducted. Here today, we
witnessed the rise of a new LEAGUE
CHAMPION--a trainer who feels
compassion for, and trust toward,
all #MON. A trainer who
succeeded through perseverance and
determination. The new LEAGUE
CHAMPION who has all the makings
of greatness! {PLAYER}, allow me
to register you and your partners
as CHAMPIONS!
entries.translation:
阿渡：……我已经很久
没进过这个房间了。 建这个房间是为了
彰显联盟冠军的荣光，也是为了让人永远记住那些经历了无数恶战的宝可梦们！ 此时此刻，
对宝可梦充满信任与关爱， 对自己怀有坚毅与严格， 拥有无数宝贵品质的
新冠军诞生了！ 来吧，{PLAYER}！
让我们好好记录你与你的伙伴们！

entries.label: IcePathBoulderFellThroughText
entries.english:
The boulder fell
through.
entries.translation: 石块掉下去了！

entries.label: IcePathB2FMahoganySideBoulderText
entries.english:
It's immovably
imbedded in ice.
entries.translation:
深深陷在冰面里，
根本就推不动……

entries.label: BugCatcherWayneAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A #MON I've
never seen before fell out of the
tree when I usedHEADBUTT. I ought to use
HEADBUTT in otherplaces too.
entries.translation:
刚刚对这棵树用了头锤，
掉下来的宝可梦从没见过。 看来我应该去更多地方，
用头锤撞更多的树……

entries.label: BugCatcherWayneBeatenText
entries.english:
I hadn't seen that
#MON before…
entries.translation:
那只宝可梦
我可是第一次遇见啊……

entries.label: BugCatcherWayneSeenText
entries.english:
Don't sneak up on
me like that! You frightened a
#MON away!
entries.translation:
不要突然和我搭话啊！
宝可梦都跑掉了啊！

entries.label: IlexForestApprenticeAfterText
entries.english:
Wow! Thanks a
whole bunch! My boss's #MON
won't obey me be-cause I don't havea BADGE.
entries.translation:
非常谢谢你！ 因为我没有徽章，
所以师傅的宝可梦不愿意听我的话。

entries.label: IlexForestApprenticeIntroText
entries.english:
Oh, man… My boss
is going to besteaming… The FARFETCH'D
that CUTS trees for charcoal took
off on me. I can't go looking
for it here in theILEX FOREST. It's too big, dark
and scary for me…
entries.translation:
怎么办！
师傅会生气的！ 大葱鸭不知道跑哪去了！
平时制作木炭的木料都是靠大葱鸭砍来的…… 栎树林幽深阴暗，
我一个人怕得不敢动啊。

entries.label: IlexForestSignpostText
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST is
so overgrown with trees that you
can't see the sky. Please watch out
for items that mayhave been dropped.
entries.translation:
这片栎树林
草木葱茏、枝繁叶茂，天空都被遮住了。 四周比较黑暗，
务必注意脚边的遗失物。

entries.label: Text_CharcoalMasterIntro
entries.english:
Ah! My FARFETCH'D! You found it for
us, kid? Without it, we
wouldn't be able to CUT trees for
charcoal. Thanks, kid! Now, how can I
thank you… I know! Here, take
this.
entries.translation:
啊！大葱鸭！
是你帮我们找回来的吗？ 如果没有它帮忙砍树，
我们就没法制炭了！ 多谢你啊！
必须得送点谢礼才行…… 对了！就把这个拿去吧！

entries.label: Text_CharcoalMasterOutro
entries.english:
That's the CUT HM.
Teach that to a #MON to clear
small trees. Of course, you
have to have the GYM BADGE from
AZALEA to use it.
entries.translation:
里面是秘传的居合斩！！
让宝可梦记住的话，就可以砍掉小树了！ 但是要有桧皮道馆的徽章
才能使用哦。

entries.label: Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter
entries.english:
Do you want to
apprentice as a charcoal maker
with me? You'll be first-
rate in ten years!
entries.translation:
要去我那里修行吗？
花个10年就能出师哦！

entries.label: Text_HeadbuttIntro
entries.translation:
你问我在干嘛？ 我在用头锤摇树啊。
超级有趣的，你也试试看吧！

entries.label: Text_HeadbuttOutro
entries.english:
Rattle trees with
HEADBUTT. Some-times, sleeping#MON fall out.
entries.translation:
用头锤摇树的时候，
偶尔也会掉下来睡着的宝可梦哦。

entries.label: Text_IlexForestLass
entries.english:
Did something
happen to theforest's guardian?
entries.translation:
森林之神那边是不是
发生什么事情了……

entries.label: Text_IlexForestShrine
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE… It's in honor of
the forest'sprotector…
entries.translation:
栎树林的祠堂……
供奉着森林之神。

entries.label: Text_InsertGSBall
entries.english:
{PLAYER} put in the
GS BALL.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}把GS球
放进了祠堂中！

entries.label: Text_ItsTheMissingPokemon
entries.english:
It's the missing
#MON!
entries.translation: 遇见了走失的宝可梦！

entries.label: Text_KurtCaughtCelebi
entries.english:
Whew, wasn't that
something! {PLAYER}, that was
fantastic. Thanks! The legends about
that SHRINE werereal after all. I feel inspired by
what I just saw. It motivates me to
make better BALLS! I'm going!
entries.translation:
哎呀，了不起啊！ {PLAYER}！
是你让我看到了如此美妙的场景！ 那间小祠堂的传说
看来是真的啊。 哎，一看到好东西，
就特别想制作球。 我要回去了！

entries.label: Text_Kwaaaa
entries.english: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!
entries.translation: 大葱鸭：呱——

entries.label: Text_ShrineCelebiEvent
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE… It's in honor of
the forest'sprotector… Oh? What is this? It's a hole.
It looks like the GS BALL would fit
inside it. Want to put the GS
BALL here?
entries.translation:
栎树林的祠堂……
供奉着森林之神。 嗯？ 上面有个洞，
正好能把GS球放进去！ 要放进去看看吗？

entries.label: IlexForestAzaleaGateGrannyText
entries.english:
The FOREST is
watched over byits protector. Stay out of
mischief!
entries.translation:
据说森林里有神……
可千万不要干坏事哦。

entries.label: IlexForestAzaleaGateOfficerText
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST is
big. Be careful!Don't get lost.
entries.translation:
栎树林非常大，
千万别走迷路了！

entries.label: AbraText
entries.english: ABRA: Aabra…
entries.translation: 凯西：西……

entries.label: IndigoPlateauPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
At the #MON
LEAGUE, you'll get tested by the
ELITE FOUR. You have to beat
them all. If you lose, you have to
start all over!
entries.translation:
宝可梦联盟
会对你进行考验，看看你能否战胜四天王。 如果不幸战败了，
那当然是从头来过！

entries.label: PlateauRivalLoseText
entries.english:
… Whew…
With my partners, I'm going to be
the CHAMPION!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 呼……
下一步就是和我的宝可梦一起成为冠军！

entries.label: PlateauRivalText1
entries.english:
Hold it. You're going to
take the #MON LEAGUE challenge
now? That's not going
to happen. My super-well-
trained #MON are going to pound
you. {PLAYER}!
I challenge you!
entries.translation:
等一下。 ……这就要去
挑战宝可梦联盟了？ 别做梦了。 我那些经历
千锤百炼的宝可梦会把你打倒的。 {PLAYER}！
和我对战吧！

entries.label: PlateauRivalText2
entries.english:
…Darn… I still
can't win… I… I have to think
more about my#MON… Humph! Try not to
lose!
entries.translation:
……切。
还是赢不了你…… 也就是说……
我还需要……给予宝可梦更多的关爱吗。 ……哼！
你就苟延残喘吧。

entries.label: PlateauRivalWinText
entries.english: … OK--I lost…

entries.label: TeleportGuyNoText
entries.english:
OK, OK. The best
of luck to you!
entries.translation:
这样啊，
那就加油吧！

entries.label: TeleportGuyText1
entries.english:
Ah! You're chal-
lenging the ELITE FOUR? Are you sure
you're ready? If you need to
train some more, my ABRA can help
you. It can TELEPORT
you home. Would you like to
go home now?
entries.translation:
哦，要挑战四天王吗！
你不觉得应该再多修行一会儿吗？ 我的凯西会使出
瞬间移动，马上就能把你送回家哦！ 怎么样呢，
需要帮你传送吗？

entries.label: TeleportGuyYesText
entries.english:
OK, OK. Picture
your house in yourmind…
entries.translation:
这样啊。
那就请在脑中浮想起自己的家吧。

entries.label: KarenScript_KarenBeatenText
entries.english:
Well, aren't you
good. I like thatin a trainer.
entries.translation:
嗯，有两下子。
这点很不错。

entries.label: KarenScript_KarenBeforeText
entries.english:
I am KAREN of the
ELITE FOUR. You're {PLAYER}?
How amusing. I love dark-type
#MON. I find their wild,
tough image to be so appealing. And
they're so strong. Think you can take
them? Just try toentertain me. Let's go.
entries.translation:
我是四天王梨花！ 你是{PLAYER}吧。
嗯，好像很有意思呢。 我一直钟爱着
恶属性的宝可梦！ 那种狂野粗犷的感觉，
不是很美妙吗？而且它们也非常强大哦。 你要当我的对手吗？
为了让我尽兴，希望你能好好努力吧。 那就开始吧！

entries.label: KarenScript_KarenDefeatText
entries.english:
Strong #MON. Weak #MON. That is only the
selfish perceptionof people. Truly skilled
trainers should try to win with
their favorites. I like your style.
You understandwhat's important. Go on--the CHAM-
PION is waiting.
entries.translation:
“强大的宝可梦” “弱小的宝可梦” 都只是人类的一厢情愿。 真正强大的训练家
应该靠自己喜欢的宝可梦去努力追求胜利。 你很不错呢，
能明白孰是孰非。 继续前进吧。
冠军在等着你呢。

entries.label: KogaScript_KogaBeatenText
entries.english:
Ah!
You have provenyour worth!
entries.translation:
哦！
你有点本事啊！

entries.label: KogaScript_KogaBeforeText
entries.english:
Fwahahahaha! I am KOGA of the
ELITE FOUR. I live in shadows,
a ninja! My intricate style
will confound anddestroy you! Confusion, sleep,
poison… Prepare to be the
victim of my sin-ister technique! Fwahahahaha! #MON is not
merely about brute force--you shall
see soon enough!
entries.translation:
……哈！哈！哈！ 在下是四天王阿桔！
人称“当代活忍者”！ 在下使用的战术
绝非寻常方法能敌！ 使之乱，使之寐，
使之中毒…… 我的招式可以说是
变换自在，诡计多端！ ……哈！哈！哈！ 宝可梦的深妙之处，
光靠力量是无法领悟的！你就好好感受一下吧！

entries.label: KogaScript_KogaDefeatText
entries.english:
I subjected you to
everything I couldmuster. But my efforts
failed. I musthone my skills. Go on to the next
room, and put yourabilities to test!
entries.translation:
我已经使出了浑身解数。 即便如此还是输了，
我还需要进一步修行啊。 你还是前往下一个房间
去测试自己的实力吧！

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterDadText
entries.english:
Dad works at SILPH
where he studies# BALLS. I have to stay
home with Grandpaand SLOWPOKE.
entries.translation:
爸爸在一家叫西尔佛的公司
进行新型精灵球的研究工作。 这段时间，就由我和爷爷
还有呆呆兽一起看家。

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterFunText
entries.english:
It's fun to make
BALLS!
entries.translation: 制球真是太开心了！

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterGSBallText
entries.english:
Grandpa's checking
a BALL right now. So I'm waiting
till he's done.
entries.translation:
我爷爷正在
调查这个球。 结束之前好好等着吧。

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterHelpText
entries.english:
I get to help
Grandpa now! We'll make good
BALLS for you, soplease wait!
entries.translation:
我也会给爷爷帮忙的。
正在努力中，你再等等吧。

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterLonelyText
entries.english:
Grandpa's gone…
I'm so lonely…
entries.translation:
爷爷你在哪啊……？
我一个人好孤单……

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeBackText
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE my
dad gave me came back! Its TAIL is
growing back too!
entries.translation:
爸爸送给我的
呆呆兽回来了！尾巴也会再长出来的！

entries.label: KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeGoneText
entries.english:
The SLOWPOKE are
gone… Were they taken away by bad
people?
entries.translation:
呆呆兽都不见了……
怎么办……是不是被坏人带走了？

entries.label: KurtsHouseCelebiStatueText
entries.english:
It's a statue of
the forest's pro-tector.
entries.translation: 供奉着森林之神。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtAhHaISeeText
entries.english:
Ah-ha! I see!
So…
entries.translation: 哦哦！是这样！哎呀呀！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtAskYouHaveAnApricornText
entries.english:
KURT: You have an
APRICORN for me? Fine! I'll turn it
into a BALL.
entries.translation:
钢铁：哦哦，
这不是带着球果儿嘛！ 好嘞，我要制球儿了！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtBallsFromApricornsText
entries.english:
KURT: I make BALLS
from APRICORNS. Collect them from
trees and bring'em to me. I'll make BALLS
out of them.
entries.translation:
钢铁：我能用球果儿
制作特制的球儿。 调查一下外面的球果树，
收集了果实再过来，那样我就能做成球儿了。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtDontBotherMeText
entries.english:
KURT: I'm working!
Don't bother me!
entries.translation:
钢铁：我在制作呢，
别碍事儿！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtGranddaughterHelpingWorkFasterText
entries.english:
KURT: Now that my
granddaughter is helping me, I can
work much faster.
entries.translation:
钢铁：有孙女帮着打下手，
工作顺利得很。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtHonoredToMakeBallsText
entries.english:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}! You handled your-
self like a realhero at the WELL. I like your style! I would be honored
to make BALLS for a trainer like
you. This is all I have
now, but take it.
entries.translation:
钢铁：哟，{PLAYER}，
您在井里的表现可忒棒了！ 我很欣赏您！
看到您这样的训练家，我就特别想制球儿。 不过现在手边只有这个， 
您尽管收下！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtImCheckingItNowText
entries.english:
I'm checking it
now.
entries.translation: 现在正调查着呢。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtItWillTakeADayText
entries.english:
KURT: It'll take a
day to make you a BALL. Come back
for it later.
entries.translation:
钢铁：完成制球儿
估摸着要1天的时间。到时候您再来拿吧。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtJustFinishedYourBallText
entries.english:
KURT: Ah, {PLAYER}!
I just finishedyour BALL. Here!
entries.translation:
钢铁：哦，{PLAYER}吗？
这会儿球刚做好，拿去！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtMakingBallsMustWaitText
entries.english:
Hm? Who are you? {PLAYER}, eh? You
want me to makesome BALLS? Sorry, but that'll
have to wait. Do you know TEAM
ROCKET? Ah, don't worry. I'll tell
you anyhow. TEAM ROCKET's an
evil gang that uses #MON for
their dirty work. They're supposed
to have disbandedthree years ago. Anyway, they're at
the WELL, cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS
for sale! So I'm going to
go give them alesson in pain! Hang on, SLOWPOKE!
Old KURT is on hisway!
entries.translation:
哟，您哪位啊？ 这样吗，叫{PLAYER}啊。
是来拜托我做球儿的？不好意思，现在做不了。 知道火箭队不？
不知道也没事儿，我接着往下说吧。 叫火箭队的是一帮
强迫宝可梦做坏事儿、吊儿郎当的混子。 本来在3年前，
应该已经解散了的…… 就是他们这帮人，
在井里切了呆呆兽的尾巴，大量往外倒腾。 所以我要过去
教训教训丫的！ 好嘞！等着我，呆呆兽！
纯爷们儿钢铁来救你们了！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtThatsALetdownText
entries.english:
KURT: Oh…
That's a letdown.
entries.translation:
钢铁：这样吗……
还挺失望。

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtThisBallStartedToShakeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}! This BALL started
to shake while Iwas checking it. There must be
something to this!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！ 我在调查的时候，
这个球突然剧烈摇晃了起来。 想必要发生什么了……！！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtTurnedOutGreatText
entries.english:
KURT: That turned
out great. Try catching
#MON with it.
entries.translation:
钢铁：这可是优良成品！ 试着去和宝可梦对战，
看看能不能用它捕捉！

entries.label: KurtsHouseKurtWhatIsThatText
entries.english:
Wh-what is that? I've never seen
one before. It looks a lot
like a # BALL, but it appears to
be something else. Let me check it
for you.
entries.translation:
那、那、那个是！！ 什么东西？
我还是头一次看见！ 虽然很像精灵球……
但似乎是其他的道具啊。 让我稍微调查一下。

entries.label: KurtsHouseOakPhotoText
entries.english:
…A young PROF.
OAK?
entries.translation: ……年轻时的大木博士？

entries.label: KurtsHouseSlowpokeText
entries.english:
SLOWPOKE: …
Yawn?

entries.label: CooltrainerfLoisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Come to think of
it, I've seen apink BUTTERFREE.
entries.translation:
说起来，
我以前见过粉红色巴大蝶！

entries.label: CooltrainerfLoisBeatenText
entries.english: Good going!
entries.translation: 精彩。

entries.label: CooltrainerfLoisSeenText
entries.english:
What happened to
the red GYARADOS? It's gone? Oh, darn. I came
here for nothing? I know--let's
battle!
entries.translation:
红色暴鲤龙去哪了？ 啊，已经没了？
我特地过来看它的啊…… 算了，你和我对战吧！

entries.label: CooltrainermAaronAfterBattleText
entries.english:
#MON and their
trainer become powerful through
constant battling.
entries.translation:
宝可梦与训练家都能
在一次又一次的战斗中获得锻炼！

entries.label: CooltrainermAaronBeatenText
entries.english:
Whew…
Good battle.
entries.translation:
呼……
不错的战斗。

entries.label: CooltrainermAaronSeenText
entries.english:
If a trainer spots
another trainer, he has to make a
challenge. That is our
destiny.
entries.translation:
发现训练家之后
一定要发起挑战！这是训练家的宿命！

entries.label: FisherAndreAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I won't lose as an
angler! I catch#MON all day.
entries.translation:
比垂钓我可不会输！
毕竟我一整天都在垂钓宝可梦！

entries.label: FisherAndreBeatenText
entries.english:
I might be an ex-
pert angler, but I stink as a #-
MON trainer…
entries.translation:
虽然垂钓技巧很成熟，
但是宝可梦很不成熟……

entries.label: FisherAndreSeenText
entries.english:
Let me battle with
the #MON I justcaught!
entries.translation:
用我刚刚垂钓到的
引以为豪的宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: FisherRaymondAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Why can't I catch
any good #MON?
entries.translation:
为什么就是钓不到
好宝可梦啊，讨厌！

entries.label: FisherRaymondBeatenText
entries.english:
My line's all
tangled up…
entries.translation: ……钓鱼线缠成一团了。

entries.label: FisherRaymondSeenText
entries.english:
No matter what I
do, all I catch are the same #-
MON…
entries.translation:
不管怎么努力，永远只能
钓到同一种宝可梦！

entries.label: FishingGurusHouseSignText
entries.english:
FISHING GURU'S
HOUSE
entries.translation: 垂钓名人的家

entries.label: LakeOfRageCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
Did my eyes de-
ceive me? I saw a red GYARADOS in
the LAKE… But I thought
GYARADOS wereusually blue?
entries.translation:
我是不是看错了？
怎么看到湖里有只红色的暴鲤龙…… 要说暴鲤龙，
一般应该是蓝色吧？

entries.label: LakeOfRageGotRedScaleText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} obtained a
RED SCALE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
拿到了红色鳞片！

entries.label: LakeOfRageGrampsText
entries.english:
The GYARADOS are
angry! It's a bad omen!
entries.translation:
暴鲤龙生气了！
肯定要发生坏事了……

entries.label: LakeOfRageGrampsText_ClearedRocketHideout
entries.english:
Hahah! The MAGI-
KARP are biting!
entries.translation:
嚯嚯！
你带着的鲤鱼王不错啊。

entries.label: LakeOfRageGyaradosCryText
entries.english: GYARADOS: Gyashaa!
entries.translation: 暴鲤龙：暴鲤——！！

entries.label: LakeOfRageLanceAskHelpText
entries.english:
LANCE: Hm? Are you
going to help me?
entries.translation:
阿渡：嗯？
你愿意帮忙吗？

entries.label: LakeOfRageLanceForcedToEvolveText
entries.english:
This lake is full
of GYARADOS butnothing else… So the MAGIKARP
are being forcedto evolve…
entries.translation:
在这个湖里
到处都是暴鲤龙…… 肯定是有人做了手脚，
强行让湖里的鲤鱼王进化了……

entries.label: LakeOfRageLanceIntroText
entries.english:
Did you come here
because of therumors? You're {PLAYER}?
I'm LANCE, atrainer like you. I heard some ru-
mors, so I came toinvestigate… I saw the way you
battled earlier,{PLAYER}. I can tell that
you're a trainer with considerable
skill. If you don't mind,
could you help meinvestigate?
entries.translation:
你也是听了传言
才跑过来的吧？ 你叫{PLAYER}吗？
我是阿渡，和你一样，我也是训练家。 得知到这里的事情之后，
我很想查明真相…… {PLAYER}！
我看了刚才的战斗，知道你是相当有实力的训练家。 你愿不愿意
和我一起进行调查？

entries.label: LakeOfRageLanceRadioSignalText
entries.english:
LANCE: Excellent! It seems that the
LAKE's MAGIKARP are being forced
to evolve. A mysterious radio
broadcast coming from MAHOGANY is
the cause. I'll be waiting
for you, {PLAYER}.
entries.translation:
阿渡：那可帮大忙了！ 好像是某种神秘电波
强行让湖里的鲤鱼王进化。而这个神秘的电波是从卡吉镇发出来的。 {PLAYER}！
我先过去等你吧！

entries.label: LakeOfRageLanceRefusedText
entries.english:
Oh… Well, if you
change your mind,please help me.
entries.translation:
这样吗……
等你改主意了再过来吧。

entries.label: LakeOfRageSignText
entries.english:
LAKE OF RAGE,
also known asGYARADOS LAKE.
entries.translation:
这里是愤怒之湖
别名：暴鲤龙湖

entries.label: LakeOfRageSuperNerdText
entries.english:
I heard this lake
was made by ram-paging GYARADOS. I wonder if there
is any connection to their mass out-
break now?
entries.translation:
听说以前就有暴鲤龙
在这一带大闹的先例。 这和这次的大量出现事件
是不是有某种关联呢？

entries.label: MeetWesleyText
entries.english:
WESLEY: Well, how
do you do? Seeing as how it's
Wednesday today, I'm WESLEY of
Wednesday.
entries.translation: 星祺三：呀，初次见面！ 我是星期三的星祺三！

entries.label: WesleyGaveGiftText
entries.english:
WESLEY: BLACKBELT
beefs up the powerof fighting moves.
entries.translation:
星祺三：那是黑带。
这个道具可以提升格斗属性招式的威力！

entries.label: WesleyGivesGiftText
entries.english:
Pleased to meet
you. Please take asouvenir.
entries.translation:
难得能见到你，
请收下这个吧！

entries.label: WesleyNotWednesdayText
entries.english:
WESLEY: Today's
not Wednesday.That's too bad.
entries.translation:
星祺三：今天好像
不是星琪三呢！好可惜啊！

entries.label: WesleyWednesdayText
entries.english:
WESLEY: Since you
found me, you must have met my broth-
ers and sisters. Or did you just
get lucky?
entries.translation:
星祺三：既然能找到我，
那你应该见过其他的兄弟姐妹吧？ 或者说这次是运气好？

entries.label: HiddenPowerGuyText1
entries.english:
…You have strayed
far… Here I have medi-
tated. Inside me, a new power has
been awakened. Let me share my
power with your #MON.
Take this, child.
entries.translation:
…… …… ……
居然有人特地来这里…… 我一直这里冥想，
已经参悟出了新能力！ 我把这个能力
分给你的宝可梦吧！请带上这个。

entries.label: HiddenPowerGuyText2
entries.english:
Do you see it? It
is HIDDEN POWER! It draws out the
power of #MONfor attacking. Remember this: its
type and power de-pend on the #-MON using it.
entries.translation:
……知道吗，
这是觉醒力量！ 用这个招式攻击的时候，
可以发挥出宝可梦的潜力！ 不过，招式的属性和威力
会随着宝可梦而改变。

entries.label: HiddenPowerGuyText3
entries.english: I am meditating…
entries.translation: 我正在冥想…… ……

entries.label: LakeOfRageMagikarpHouseUnusedRecordText
entries.english:
CURRENT RECORD {STRBUF} caught by
{STRBUF}
entries.translation:
目前的纪录是……
{STRBUF} {STRBUF}

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Bonus
entries.english:
The record is the
important thing. Think of that as
a bonus!
entries.translation:
毕竟最要紧的是新纪录，
这只就当余兴节目吧。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_LakeOfRageHistory
entries.english:
LAKE OF RAGE is
actually a crater made by rampaging
GYARADOS. The crater filled
up with rainwater and the LAKE was
formed. That's the story
passed on from my Grandpa's great-
great-grandpa. It used to be that
you could catch lively MAGIKARP
there, but… I don't understand
what's happening.
entries.translation:
这个愤怒之湖原本是
暴鲤龙大闹后形成的坑，积满雨水就成了湖泊。 这是我爷爷的爷爷的爷爷
那一代的事情了。 之前在这个湖泊里
还可以垂钓到非常不错的鲤鱼王…… 现在到底是怎么了？

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Memento
entries.english:
Wow! This one is
outstanding! I tip my hat to
you! Take this as a
memento!
entries.translation:
这只真是绝了！ 你的垂钓术值得尊敬！
作为纪念，请收下这个。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_MenInBlack
entries.english:
The LAKE hasn't
been normal since those men wearing
black arrived.
entries.translation:
之前有群黑衣服的男人
在附近鬼鬼祟祟的，然后湖里就变得不对劲了。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_NotMagikarp
entries.english:
What? That's not a
MAGIKARP!
entries.translation:
我擦！
这不是鲤鱼王啊。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_Refused
entries.english:
Oh… So you didn't
get one good enough to show me?
Maybe next time.
entries.translation:
这样啊……
没钓到值得一看的鲤鱼王。下次一定要带来大家伙啊。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_TooShort
entries.english:
Wow! This one is
outstanding! …I wish I could
say that, but I've seen a bigger one
before.
entries.translation:
这只真是绝了！ 虽然很想这么说，
但还是上一只更大呢。

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_WorldsLargestMagikarp
entries.english:
LAKE OF RAGE is
back to normal. The MAGIKARP have
returned. I may yet realize
my dream of see-ing the world'slargest MAGIKARP. Do you have a ROD?
Please help me ifyou do.
entries.translation:
哎呀，
愤怒之湖变回了以前那样，又能钓到新鲜的鲤鱼王了。 这样一来，
见到世上最大鲤鱼王的梦想也有机会实现了。 你带了钓竿吧，
能不能助我圆梦呢？

entries.label: MagikarpLengthRaterText_YouHaveAMagikarp
entries.english:
Ah, you have a
MAGIKARP! Let's see how big that
baby is.
entries.translation:
哦，你带着鲤鱼王啊。
那就让我看看你引以为豪的鲤鱼王吧！

entries.label: LanceBattleAfterText
entries.english:
…Whew. You have become
truly powerful,{PLAYER}. Your #MON have
responded to your strong and up-
standing nature. As a trainer, you
will continue to grow strong with
your #MON.
entries.translation:
……呼。 成长了不少呢，
{PLAYER}。你现在已经这么强了。 身为训练家，你只要
怀有一颗正直而强大的心，就能获得宝可梦的青睐。 这样一来，宝可梦就能
和训练家共同进步……

entries.label: LanceBattleIntroText
entries.english:
LANCE: I've been
waiting for you. {PLAYER}! I knew that you,
with your skills, would eventually
reach me here. There's no need
for words now. We will battle to
determine who is the stronger of
the two of us. As the most power-
ful trainer and as the #MON LEAGUE
CHAMPION… I, LANCE the drag-
on master, acceptyour challenge!
entries.translation:
阿渡：我等了很久啊！ {PLAYER}！ 我很清楚，以你的实力，
到这里只是时间问题。 无须多言！ 还是通过对战
来一决高下吧！ 最强训练家、
联盟冠军—— 龙使者阿渡
前来讨教！

entries.label: LanceBattleWinText
entries.english:
…It's over. But it's an odd
feeling. I'm not angry that
I lost. In fact, Ifeel happy. Happy that I
witnessed the rise of a great new
CHAMPION!
entries.translation:
……结束了。 我现在的心情很复杂呢。 虽然也有失败后的懊恼，
但是我感到更多的是亲眼见证优秀冠军诞生时所产生的喜悦感。

entries.label: LancesRoomMaryInterviewText
entries.english:
MARY: Let's inter-
view the brand newCHAMPION!
entries.translation:
胡桃：那么，接下来
我要采访一下新冠军。

entries.label: LancesRoomMaryNoInterviewText
entries.english:
MARY: Oh, wait!
We haven't donethe interview!
entries.translation:
胡桃：啊！
采访都还没开始啊！

entries.label: LancesRoomMaryOhNoOakText
entries.english:
MARY: Oh, no!
It's all over! PROF.OAK, if you
weren't so slow…
entries.translation:
胡桃：啊——都结束了！
真是的，都怪博士太慢了！

entries.label: LancesRoomNoisyText
entries.english:
LANCE: This is
getting to be abit too noisy… {PLAYER}, could you
come with me?
entries.translation:
阿渡：……这里好像
越来越吵了…… {PLAYER}！ 能跟我来一下吗？

entries.label: LancesRoomOakCongratulationsText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK: Ah,
{PLAYER}! It's been a long
while. You certainly look
more impressive. Your conquest of
the LEAGUE is justfantastic! Your dedication,
trust and love for your #MON made
this happen. Your #MON were
outstanding too. Because they be-
lieved in you as a trainer, they per-
severed. Congratulations,
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
大木：{PLAYER}！
好久不见啊。哎呀，你真是出人头地了！ 能称霸宝可梦联盟
真的是非常了不起啊！ 你一路上都没有
忘记对宝可梦的爱与信赖，真正做到了砥砺前行。所以才能有今天的成果。 哎呀，宝可梦也很伟大啊！
它们愿意去相信训练家，所以才能那么努力！ {PLAYER}
真是恭喜你了！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FDirectoryText
entries.english:
1F RECEPTION
2F SALES 3F PERSONNEL
4F PRODUCTION 5F DIRECTOR'S
OFFICE
entries.translation:
1楼 …… 服务柜台
2楼 …… 营业部3楼 …… 总务部4楼 …… 制作室5楼 …… 局长室

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
Oh, no, no, no! We've been off the
air ever since the POWER PLANT shut
down. All my efforts to
start this station would be wasted if
I can't broadcast. I'll be ruined!
entries.translation:
啊，大事不妙！ 发电厂无法运作
叫我怎么放广播啊！ 好不容易才能运营电台，
要是没法播节目，我就完了啊！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_GotExpnCard
entries.english:
With that thing,
you can tune into the radio programs
here in KANTO. Gahahahaha!
entries.translation:
只要有了这个，
你就能搜索到新的广播节目了！嘎、哈、哈、哈、哈、哈！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
Ah! So you're the
{PLAYER} who solved the POWER PLANT's
problem? Thanks to you, I
never lost my job. I tell you, you're
a real lifesaver! Please take this
as my thanks.
entries.translation:
哦！
你就是解决发电厂事件的{PLAYER}吧！ 多亏了你，
我才能保住饭碗！真是谢天谢地啊！ 这是我的心意！
你一定要收下！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FOfficerText
entries.english:
Sorry, but you can
only tour theground floor. Ever since JOHTO's
RADIO TOWER was taken over by a
criminal gang, we have had to step
up our security.
entries.translation:
参观仅限于1楼。 因为之前城都的电台
被不法分子占领了，所以这里加强了戒备！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FPokeFluteSignText
entries.english:
Perk Up #MON
with Mellow Sounds of the # FLUTE
on CHANNEL 20
entries.translation:
用这清脆的笛声
唤醒宝可梦的活力！频道20！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome!
Feel free to look around anywhere on
this floor.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！ 整个1楼
都对外开放参观！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FReferenceLibraryText
entries.english:
Wow! A full rack
of #MON CDs andvideos. This must be the
reference library.
entries.translation:
摆放着很多关于宝可梦的
CD和录像带！大概是节目资料吧？

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd1Text
entries.english:
Many people are
hard at work here in the RADIO
TOWER. They must be doing
their best to puton good shows.
entries.translation:
据说有很多人
在电台里工作！ 他们一定在努力地
制作有趣的广播节目！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text
entries.english:
Hey there! I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR! Huh? Your #GEAR
can't tune into my music programs.
How unfortunate! If you get an EXPN
CARD upgrade, you can tune in. You'd
better get one!
entries.translation:
嗨——！
我是音乐节目的超级导播！ 哎呀，你的宝可装置……
好遗憾啊，你现在还收不到我的节目！ 想要收听的话，
就要有升级版本的广播卡！

entries.label: LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text_GotExpnCard
entries.english:
Hey there! I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR! I'm responsible
for the gorgeous melodies that go
out over the air. Don't be square.
Grab your musicoff the air!
entries.translation:
嗨——！
我是音乐节目的超级导播！ 我正在播放
优美的旋律哦！请多关照哦！

entries.label: LavenderMartPokefanMText
entries.english:
REPEL is a neces-
sity if you are going to explore a
cave. Even though I like
exploring, I still haven't made it to
all the caves.
entries.translation:
如果要进行洞窟探险，
除虫喷雾当然必不可少！ 即使是我这种探险行家，
至今也没有走遍洞窟的每一个角落。

entries.label: LavenderMartRockerText
entries.english:
I heard about a
craftsman who makes custom BALLS
in the JOHTO town of AZALEA. I wish
I had some.
entries.translation:
我听说城都的桧皮镇
有一位工匠专门制作特制的精灵球！ 我也好想要啊！

entries.label: LavenderPokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
To the north of
LAVENDER is ROCK TUNNEL. Go through
it to get to thePOWER PLANT.
entries.translation:
穿越紫苑镇北边的
岩山隧道，就能看到发电厂哦。

entries.label: LavenderPokecenter1FTeacherText
entries.english:
There's a radio
program that plays# FLUTE music. Oh? Ah, your radio
needs an EXPN CARDto tune into it.
entries.translation:
有个频道可以收听到
宝可梦之笛吹奏的乐曲哦。 但是必须要有扩展卡
才能收到那个频道。

entries.label: LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
If the POWER PLANT
isn't running, the MAGNET TRAIN won't
run either… It also means the
RADIO STATIONcan't broadcast…
entries.translation:
发电厂无法运作的话，
磁浮列车也无法运作…… 就连广播节目也
不能顺利播放了。

entries.label: LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
The DIRECTOR of
the RADIO STATIONsure was happy. He said they're
back on the air because the POWER
PLANT is runningsmoothly again.
entries.translation:
因为发电厂修复，
终于能播放广播节目了。局长非常高兴啊。

entries.label: LavenderSpeechHousePokefanFText
entries.english:
LAVENDER is a
tiny, quiet town at the foot of the
mountains. It's gotten a bit
busier since the RADIO TOWER was
built.
entries.translation:
紫苑镇是
山脚下的安静小镇！ 不过建了电台之后，
就比以前喧闹一些了！

entries.label: KantoRadioStationSignText
entries.english:
KANTO RADIO
STATION Your Favorite
Programs On-AirAround the Clock!
entries.translation:
这里是关都广播局。
广播节目热播中！

entries.label: LavenderTownGrampsText
entries.english:
People come from
all over to pay their respects to
the departed soulsof #MON.
entries.translation:
很多来自不同城市的人
都会来这里扫墓。

entries.label: LavenderTownPokefanMText
entries.english:
That's quite some
building, eh? It's KANTO's RADIO
TOWER.
entries.translation:
这栋楼很大吧？
这可是关都的电台哦！

entries.label: LavenderTownSignText
entries.english:
LAVENDER TOWN The Noble Purple
Town
entries.translation:
这里是紫苑镇。
紫苑即是高贵的紫兰之色。

entries.label: LavenderTownTeacherText
entries.english:
KANTO has many
good radio shows.
entries.translation:
关都地区也会播放
一些有趣的广播节目哦。

entries.label: LavenderTownYoungsterText
entries.english:
You need a #
FLUTE to wakesleeping #MON. Every trainer has
to know that!
entries.translation:
如果想唤醒睡着的宝可梦，
最好使用宝可梦之笛！这是训练家的常识！

entries.label: SoulHouseSignText
entries.english:
SOUL HOUSE May the Souls of
#MON Rest Easy
entries.translation:
这里是灵魂之家。
宝可梦安眠于此。

entries.label: VolunteerPokemonHouseSignText
entries.english:
LAVENDER VOLUNTEER
#MON HOUSE
entries.translation:
爱心志愿者聚首于此。
宝可梦之家

entries.label: BoarderBradAfterBattleText
entries.english:
This GYM is great.
I love boardingwith my #MON!
entries.translation:
这个道馆很棒啊！
不管什么时候都能和宝可梦一起溜冰哦！

entries.label: BoarderBradBeatenText
entries.english:
Do you see how
serious we are?
entries.translation:
我们真的不是来玩的，
你现在应该能明白吧?

entries.label: BoarderBradSeenText
entries.english:
This GYM has a
slippery floor. It's fun, isn't
it? But hey--we're
not playing gameshere!
entries.translation:
卡吉道馆里面滑溜溜的，
很好玩吧？ 话虽如此，
我们可不是来玩的哦！

entries.label: BoarderDouglasAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The secret behind
PRYCE's power… He meditates under
a waterfall daily to strengthen his
mind and body.
entries.translation:
柳伯之所以那么强大…… 是因为他每天都去
经受冰冷瀑布的冲刷，既磨砺肉体，也磨砺精神！

entries.label: BoarderDouglasBeatenText
entries.english:
OK. I'll tell you
PRYCE's secret.
entries.translation:
伤脑筋，
我就把秘密分享给你吧。

entries.label: BoarderDouglasSeenText
entries.english:
I know PRYCE's
secret.
entries.translation:
我其实知道
柳伯保持强大的秘诀哦！

entries.label: BoarderRonaldAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I think there's a
move a #MON can use while it's
frozen.
entries.translation:
说起来……有的招式
能在冰冻状态中使出哦。

entries.label: BoarderRonaldBeatenText
entries.english:
Darn. I couldn't
do a thing.
entries.translation: 无法动弹的是我啊！

entries.label: BoarderRonaldSeenText
entries.english:
I'll freeze your
#MON, so youcan't do a thing!
entries.translation:
我要冻住你的宝可梦，
使它无法动弹了！

entries.label: MahoganyGymGuideText
entries.english:
PRYCE is a veteran
who has trained #MON for some
50 years. He's said to be
good at freezing opponents with
ice-type moves. That means you
should melt him with your burning
ambition!
entries.translation:
和宝可梦相处了50年的
柳伯是一名强大的战士！ 据说他最拿手的就是
使用冰属性的招式彻底冻住对手的宝可梦！ 所以你应该尝试
用燃烧的激情去融化它！

entries.label: MahoganyGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
PRYCE is some-
thing, but you'resomething else! That was a hot
battle that bridged the gen-
eration gap!
entries.translation:
柳伯很了不起，
战胜他的你也很了不起！ 这场炽热的战斗
超越了年龄的差距！

entries.label: PryceText_CherishYourPokemon
entries.english:
When the ice and
snow melt, springarrives. You and your #-
MON will be to- gether for many
years to come. Cherish your time
together!
entries.translation:
冰雪融化之后……
春天就会到来。 今后你还要和宝可梦
相处很长的一段时间，好好珍惜吧。

entries.label: PryceText_GlacierBadgeSpeech
entries.english:
That BADGE will
raise the SPECIALstats of #MON. It also lets your
#MON use WHIRL-POOL to get acrossreal whirlpools. And this… This is
a gift from me!
entries.translation:
只要带着它，
就可以提高特殊能力。 还有，
能让人穿越汹涌的漩涡的“潮旋”也能使用了。 另外，这个是
老夫送你的饯别礼物。

entries.label: PryceText_IcyWindSpeech
entries.english:
That TM contains
ICY WIND. It inflicts damage
and lowers speed. It demonstrates
the harshness ofwinter.
entries.translation:
这是冰冻之风。 造成伤害的同时，
还能降低对方的速度…… 这个招式能让人
感受到隆冬严寒。

entries.label: PryceText_Impressed
entries.english:
Ah, I am impressed
by your prowess. With your strong
will, I know you will overcome all
life's obstacles. You are worthy of
this BADGE!
entries.translation:
嗯嗯，
非常出色的战斗方式。 只要怀着那颗坚韧的心，
不管遇到什么困难，最终也一定能战胜。 好！
这个徽章你就拿去吧！

entries.label: PryceText_Intro
entries.english:
#MON have many
experiences in their lives, just 
like we do.  I, too, have seen
and suffered muchin my life. Since I am your
elder, let me showyou what I mean. I have been with
#MON since before you were
born. I do not lose
easily. I, PRYCE--the
winter trainer-- shall demonstrate
my power!
entries.translation:
宝可梦也好，人也好，
活着就会经历很多事。 我也体会过
各种各样的辛酸。 我作为人生的长者，
要教你一点人生经验。 在你出生之前，
我就和宝可梦一起生活，遇到困难绝不轻易认输。 现在就让你见识见识
“严冬柳伯”的能耐！

entries.label: SkierClarissaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I shouldn't have
been braggingabout my skiing…
entries.translation:
明明是宝可梦对战，
我怎么炫耀起滑雪技术了！

entries.label: SkierClarissaBeatenText
entries.english:
No! You made me
wipe out!
entries.translation:
呀！吓了一跳，
不小心摔了个屁股蹲！

entries.label: SkierClarissaSeenText
entries.english:
Check out my
parallel turn!
entries.translation: 这华丽的尾迹，看好了！！

entries.label: SkierRoxanneAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If you don't skate
with precision, you won't get far
in this GYM.
entries.translation:
不好好研究溜冰路线，
就去不了想去的地方，这是本道馆的乐趣所在。

entries.label: SkierRoxanneBeatenText
entries.english:
I wouldn't lose to
you in skiing!
entries.translation:
真是的——！
如果是滑雪我就赢了……

entries.label: SkierRoxanneSeenText
entries.english:
To get to PRYCE,
our GYM LEADER, you need to think
before you skate.
entries.translation:
如果你想见到馆主柳伯，
那你就得好好思考，制定一条溜冰路线哦！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedGlacierBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
GLACIERBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从柳伯那里
得到了冰雪徽章！

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText
entries.english:
Heheh! The experi-
ment worked like acharm. MAGIKARP are just
worthless, but GYARADOS are big
moneymakers.
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿！
实验大成功！ 虽然鲤鱼王没人买，
但暴鲤龙就不一样了！

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText_LanceEntered
entries.english:
Urrgh… That guy's dragon
#MON are tough…
entries.translation:
呜呜…… 那家伙的龙宝可梦……
太强了吧……

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceDragoniteHyperBeamText
entries.english:
LANCE: DRAGONITE,
HYPER BEAM.
entries.translation: 阿渡：快龙，破坏光线！

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceRadioText
entries.english:
What took you,
{PLAYER}? Just as I thought,
that strange radio signal is coming
from here.
entries.translation:
好慢啊，{PLAYER}！ 奇怪的电波
果然是从这里发出的。

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceSplitUpText
entries.english:
LANCE: {PLAYER}, we
should split up to check this place.
I'll go first.
entries.translation:
阿渡：{PLAYER}！
我们分头去找！我先走一步了！

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FLanceStairsText
entries.english:
The stairs are
right here.
entries.translation: 楼梯就在这里！

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FPharmacistText_LanceEntered
entries.english:
Arrgh… You found
the secret stair-way…
entries.translation:
通向地下的楼梯
暴露了……

entries.label: MahoganyMart1FRageCandyBarText
entries.english:
Hello, kiddo! How would you like
some RAGECANDYBAR? It's the thing to
eat in MAHOGANY!
entries.translation:
小朋友，你来得正好！
快买一个吧！ 这可是“愤怒馒头”！
传说中的卡吉镇特产！

entries.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
#MON do become
stronger when they evolve, but they
also learn movesmore slowly.
entries.translation:
宝可梦进化之后，
虽然能力会得到提升，但学招式的进度会变慢。

entries.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FPokefanMText
entries.english:
What's this? TEAM
ROCKET has comeback? I saw some men in
black at LAKE OFRAGE…
entries.translation:
怎么回事！
火箭队复活了吗？ 我在愤怒之湖看到了
几个全身黑的人……

entries.label: MahoganyPokecenter1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
I stop my #MON
from evolving tooearly. I make them learn
certain moves be-fore I let themevolve.
entries.translation:
为了让自己培育的宝可梦
提前学会一些招式，我选择“进化取消”哦。

entries.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseBlackBeltText
entries.english:
I heard that a red
GYARADOS appearedat the LAKE. That's odd, since
even ordinary GYARADOS are rare
in that lake…
entries.translation:
湖泊中出现了
红色的暴鲤龙呢！ 暴鲤龙平时很少会
在那座湖中出现啊……

entries.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseTeacherText
entries.english:
My favorite radio
program? I'd say#MON MUSIC.
entries.translation:
我喜欢的广播节目？
应该是宝可梦音乐台吧。

entries.label: MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseTeacherText_RocketsInRadioTower
entries.english:
I've been hearing
laughter on the radio…
It's creepy.
entries.translation:
最近总能在广播里
听见一些笑声……感觉有些诡异啊。

entries.label: MahoganyGymSignText
entries.english:
MAHOGANY TOWN
#MON GYMLEADER: PRYCE The Teacher of
Winter's Harshness
entries.translation:
卡吉镇宝可梦道馆
馆主：柳伯传授严寒的老师

entries.label: MahoganyTownFisherText
entries.english:
Since you came
this far, take the time to do some
sightseeing. You should head
north and check out LAKE OF RAGE
right now.
entries.translation:
哎呀哎呀，来都来了，
不如好好观光一番吧。 现在北方的愤怒之湖
非常值得一看哦！

entries.label: MahoganyTownGrampsText
entries.english:
Are you off to see
the GYARADOS ram-page at the LAKE?
entries.translation:
您也去湖边看了
舞姿狂野的暴鲤龙吗？

entries.label: MahoganyTownGrampsText_ClearedRocketHideout
entries.english:
MAGIKARP have
returned to LAKEOF RAGE. That should be
good news for theanglers there.
entries.translation:
说起这愤怒之湖啊，
鲤鱼王好像都回来了。 湖畔的垂钓者们
应该也会很开心吧？

entries.label: MahoganyTownLassText
entries.english:
Visit Grandma's
shop. She sells stuff that nobody
else has.
entries.translation:
有空去婆婆的小店看看？
有些东西只在那里卖哦！

entries.label: MahoganyTownRagecandybarSignText
entries.english:
While visiting
MAHOGANY TOWN, trya RAGECANDYBAR!
entries.translation:
既然来了卡吉镇，
必须尝尝“愤怒馒头”！！

entries.label: MahoganyTownSignText
entries.english:
MAHOGANY TOWN Welcome to the
Home of the Ninja
entries.translation:
这儿是卡吉镇，
欢迎来到忍者之乡！

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantNoRoomText
entries.english:
You don't have
room for this.
entries.translation: 拿不下更多了！

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantNotEnoughMoneyText
entries.english:
You don't have
enough money.
entries.translation: 你的钱不够啊。

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantRefusedText
entries.english: Oh, fine then…
entries.translation: 啊，这样啊……

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantSavorItText
entries.english: Good! Savor it!
entries.translation: 哦哦，吃个痛快吧！

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantSoldOutText
entries.english:
RAGECANDYBAR's
sold out. I'm packing up.
Don't bother me,kiddo.
entries.translation:
愤怒馒头卖完了，
我正在收拾东西呢，你别来打搅我！

entries.label: RageCandyBarMerchantTryOneText
entries.english:
Hiya, kid! I see you're new
in MAHOGANY TOWN. Since you're new,
you should try a yummy RAGECANDY-
BAR! Right now, it can
be yours for just$300! Want one?
entries.translation:
喂、喂！ 难得来趟卡吉镇，
当然要买愤怒馒头啦！这是旅行小贴士哦！ 立即抢购，只需300元，
心动不如行动？

entries.label: ManiaText_AskLookAfterShuckle
entries.english:
I, I'm in shock! A guy about your
age with piercing eyes and long hair
came in. He scared me into
giving him myprized #MON! I still have one
left, but what ifhe comes back? You look strong.
Could you look after my #MON
for a while?
entries.translation:
这、这算什么啊…… 有个和你年纪差不多、
目光凶狠、长发飘飘、样子有些可怕的少年把我宝贵的宝可梦抢走了！ 我身边只剩1只了，
要是再次遇袭的话…… 你看起来挺强的啊。
暂时帮我保管宝可梦吧！

entries.label: ManiaText_CanIHaveMyMonBack
entries.english:
Hi! How's my #-
MON? I think I'm safe
now, so may I haveit back?
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦还好吗？ 好像不会再遇袭了，
我希望你把宝可梦还给我。

entries.label: ManiaText_GotShuckle
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received a
#MON.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从狂热迷
那里接管了宝可梦！

entries.label: ManiaText_HappinessSpeech
entries.english:
For #MON, hap-
piness is being with a person who
treats them well.
entries.translation:
对宝可梦而言，
和珍爱自己的训练家同行是一件非常幸福的事情吧？

entries.label: ManiaText_IfHeComesBack
entries.english:
Oh, no… What'll
I do if he comesback?
entries.translation:
怎、怎么这样……
下次遇袭该怎么办啊？

entries.label: ManiaText_PartyFull
entries.english:
Your #MON party
is full.
entries.translation: 你的宝可梦太多了！

entries.label: ManiaText_SameAsBeingRobbed
entries.english:
Oh, no, no… That's
the same as beingrobbed.
entries.translation:
怎、怎么这样……
这和遇袭有什么区别？

entries.label: ManiaText_ShuckleIsYourLastMon
entries.english:
If I take my #-
MON back, what are you going to use
in battle?
entries.translation:
我要是把宝可梦拿回来，
你用什么战斗啊？

entries.label: ManiaText_ShuckleLikesYou
entries.english:
My #MON has
come to like you. All right, you
should keep it. But promise to
be good to it!
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
和你非常亲近呢。 好吧！宝可梦就给你了！
不过你一定要好好对它哦。

entries.label: ManiaText_ShuckleNotThere
entries.english:
Hey, you don't
have my #MONwith you.
entries.translation: 我的宝可梦不在这里啊。

entries.label: ManiaText_TakeCareOfShuckle
entries.english:
Oh, thank you! Take good care of
it, please!
entries.translation:
那就定了，拜托你了！
一定要好好对它！

entries.label: ManiaText_ThankYou
entries.english: Thank you!
entries.translation: 感谢！

entries.label: MobileBattleRoom_EstablishingCommsText
entries.english:
Establishing
communications…
entries.translation: 开始连接！

entries.label: MobileBattleRoom_HealText
entries.english:
Your #MON will
be fully healedbefore battle.
entries.translation:
进行对战之前，
先为您回复宝可梦。

entries.label: MobileTradeRoom_EstablishingCommsText
entries.english:
Establishing
communications…
entries.translation: 开始连接！

entries.label: MountMoonRivalTextAfter
entries.english:
…… …… …… …You won, fair
and square. I admit it. But
this isn't theend. I'm going to be
the greatest #-MON trainer ever. Because these guys
are behind me. …Listen, {PLAYER}. One of these days
I'm going to prove how good I am by
beating you.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… ……确实是我输了。 这次我就认输吧。
但绝不会到此为止！ 我总有一天会成为
最强的宝可梦训练家！ ……因为有
宝可梦们跟着我。 ……听好了，{PLAYER}，
总有一天我会打倒你，让你深切体会我的实力！

entries.label: MountMoonRivalTextBefore
entries.english:
…… …… …… It's been a while,
{PLAYER}. …Since I lost to
you, I thought about what I was
lacking with my#MON… And we came up
with an answer. {PLAYER}, now we'll
show you!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 久违了，{PLAYER}。 ……我输给你之后，
一直都在和我的宝可梦一起探讨我到底有什么不足…… 然后我终于找到答案了，
{PLAYER}！你就好好看着吧！

entries.label: MountMoonRivalTextLoss
entries.english:
…… …… …… I've repaid my
debt to you. With my #MON,
I'm going to beat the CHAMPION and
become the world'sgreatest trainer.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 这样就算清帐了。 ……下次我要和宝可梦们
一起打倒冠军，然后成为世界上最强的宝可梦训练家。

entries.label: MountMoonRivalTextWin
entries.english:
…… …… …… I thought I raised
my #MON to be the best they
could be… …But it still 
wasn't enough…
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 还以为我的培育方式
可以最大限度地发挥宝可梦的潜力…… ……还是不够吗。

entries.label: MountMoonGiftShopLassText
entries.english:
When the sun goes
down, CLEFAIRYcome out to play.
entries.translation:
听说太阳落山之后
皮皮就会出来玩！

entries.label: DontLitterSignText
entries.english:
MT.MOON SQUARE
DON'T LITTER
entries.translation:
月见山广场
……请不要乱丢垃圾！

entries.label: PokemaniacMillerAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A while back, this
karate dude wanted to battle. He was
ridiculously good. He just thrashed
us silly. He went in deeper
saying it was for his training. I
wonder how he is?
entries.translation:
之前有一个空手道大叔
跑过来发起挑战。 真是强得一塌糊涂，
把我们打得落花流水…… 他进里面修行去了，
不知道现在还好吗。

entries.label: PokemaniacMillerBeatenText
entries.english:
I lost to some
kid…?
entries.translation: 竟然连小孩都打不过……

entries.label: PokemaniacMillerSeenText
entries.english:
I'm not losing
this time!
entries.translation: 这次可不会输了！

entries.label: SupernerdMarkusAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I came to explore
MT.MORTAR, but I got separated from
my partner… Did you run into a
trainer who uses a SEADRA that knows
WATERFALL?
entries.translation:
我是来擂钵山
进行调查的。但是和同伴走散了…… 这里有个训练家的
海刺龙能使出攀瀑，你有印象吗？

entries.label: SupernerdMarkusBeatenText
entries.english:
I mistook you for
someone else…
entries.translation: 啊呀，认错人了……

entries.label: SupernerdMarkusSeenText
entries.english: Hey! HUGH!
entries.translation: 喂——！贵文！

entries.label: SupernerdHughAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm investigating
MT.MORTAR, but mypal's gone AWOL. Have you seen a
trainer who has a SLOWPOKE that can
use STRENGTH?
entries.translation:
我是来擂钵山
进行调查的。但是和同伴走散了… 这里有个训练家的
呆呆兽能使出怪力，你有印象吗？

entries.label: SupernerdHughBeatenText
entries.english: Sorry, my mistake.
entries.translation: 对不起，搞错了……

entries.label: SupernerdHughSeenText
entries.english: Yo! MARKUS!
entries.translation: 喂——！学务！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoFullPartyText
entries.english:
You have no room
in your party!
entries.translation:
嘿呀！
已满了就拿不下了！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoGotTyrogueText
entries.english:
TYROGUE is a
fighting-type. It evolves into a
tougher #MON. Keep up the hard
work. I'll keeptraining too. Farewell!
entries.translation:
无畏小子的属性是格斗！ 培育得当的话，它就能
进化成强大的宝可梦。 你也要加油！
我要继续修行了！嘿呀！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoIntroText
entries.english:
Hey! I am the KARATE
KING! I train alone here
in the dark! You!
Battle with me! Hwaaarggh!
entries.translation:
你好！
我就是空手道大王！ 我正独自待在
漆黑的洞穴中修行！ 喂！
你！过两招吧！嘿呀——！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FKiyoWinText
entries.english:
Waaaarggh!
I'm beaten!
entries.translation:
哇哦哦！
哒——！我输了啊！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FReceiveMonText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TYROGUE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从空手道大王
那里得到了无畏小子！

entries.label: MountMortarB1FTyrogueRewardText
entries.english:
I… I'm crushed… My training is
still not enough… But a loss is a
loss. I admit it. As proof that you
defeated me, I'll give you a rare
fighting #MON.
entries.translation:
遗……遗憾！
修为不足吗……！ 输了就是输了！
就算不甘心也得承认！ 喂！作为战胜我的证明，
把我珍贵的格斗宝可梦交给你了！

entries.label: MrFujisHouseLassText
entries.english:
Some cold-hearted
people stop caringfor their #MON. Grandpa takes in
the poor homeless #MON and takes
care of them.
entries.translation:
有些人中途放弃了
对宝可梦的照料。 于是爷爷就收留了
这些可怜的宝可梦，并且好好培育它们。

entries.label: MrFujisHouseSuperNerdText
entries.english:
MR.FUJI does live
here, but he's not home now. He should be at
the SOUL HOUSE.
entries.translation:
虽然这里是富士老人的家，
但是爷爷他现在不在这里。 你去灵魂之家
找找看吧。

entries.label: MrFujisNidorinoText
entries.english: NIDORINO: Gyun!
entries.translation: 尼多力诺：啾嗯！！

entries.label: MrFujisPidgeyText
entries.english: PIDGEY: Pijji!
entries.translation: 波波：波波～！

entries.label: MrFujisPsyduckText
entries.english: PSYDUCK: Gu-guwa?
entries.translation: 可达鸭：嘎，呱？

entries.label: MrPokemonIntroText1
entries.english:
Hello, hello! You
must be {PLAYER}. PROF.ELM said that
you would visit.
entries.translation:
哎呀哎呀，
你就是{PLAYER}吧。 空木博士已经联系过我了，
我在等着你过来。

entries.label: MrPokemonIntroText2
entries.english:
This is what I
want PROF.ELM toexamine.
entries.translation:
这个就是我想委托
空木博士调查的东西！

entries.label: MrPokemonIntroText3
entries.english:
I know a couple
who run a #MONDAY-CARE service. They gave me that
EGG. I was intrigued,
so I sent mail toPROF.ELM. For #MON evolu-
tion, PROF.ELM isthe authority.
entries.translation:
有一对夫妇专门负责
培育别人寄放的宝可梦。这东西就是从他们那得到。 我觉得这或许是大事件，
就给空木博士发了邮件。 在宝可梦进化方面的研究，
空木博士可是第一人！

entries.label: MrPokemonIntroText4
entries.english:
Even PROF.OAK here
recognizes that.
entries.translation:
毕竟得到了这位
大木博士的认可嘛。

entries.label: MrPokemonIntroText5
entries.english:
If my assumption
is correct, PROF.ELM will know it.
entries.translation:
我的想法究竟是对是错，
空木博士肯定能给我答案！

entries.label: MrPokemonText_AlwaysNewDiscoveries
entries.english:
Life is delight-
ful! Always, new discoveries to be
made!
entries.translation:
这个世界太有趣了！
总会有很多新发现！

entries.label: MrPokemonText_Disappointed
entries.english:
That's disappoint-
ing. That happensto be very rare.
entries.translation:
真是太遗憾了！
那真是非常少见的宝贝……

entries.label: MrPokemonText_GimmeTheScale
entries.english:
Hm? That SCALE!
What's that?A red GYARADOS? That's rare! 
I, I want it… {PLAYER}, would you
care to trade it? I can offer this
EXP.SHARE I gotfrom PROF.OAK.
entries.translation:
嗯？那个鳞片是？
什么！红色暴鲤龙？ 真、真是太稀有了！
我、我好想要…… {PLAYER}，
要不要和我交换一下？我可以给你从大木博士那里拿来的学习装置。

entries.label: MrPokemonText_ImDependingOnYou
entries.english:
I'm depending on
you!
entries.translation: 那么就拜托你了！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_BrokenComputerText
entries.english:
It's a big com-
puter. Hmm. It'sbroken.
entries.translation:
有台大型计算机！
……好像坏掉了。

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_ForeignMagazinesText
entries.english:
It's packed with
foreign magazines. Can't even read
their titles…
entries.translation:
上面摆满了
世界各地的杂志！ …… ……
看不懂是什么标题……

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_GetDexText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
#DEX!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从大木那里
得到了宝可梦图鉴！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_GotEggText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
MYSTERY EGG.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从宝可梦爷爷
那里拿到了神奇蛋！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_MrPokemonHealText
entries.english:
You are returning
to PROF.ELM? Here. Your #MON
should have somerest.
entries.translation:
你差不多也要
回空木博士那里了吧？ 不妨先让宝可梦
休息一下吧！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_OakText1
entries.english:
OAK: Aha! So
you're {PLAYER}! I'm OAK! A #MON
researcher. I was just visit-
ing my old friendMR.#MON. I heard you were
running an errand for PROF.ELM, so I
waited here. Oh! What's this?
A rare #MON! Let's see… Hm, I see! I understand why
PROF.ELM gave you a #MON for this
errand. To researchers
like PROF.ELM and I, #MON are our
friends. He saw that you
would treat your #MON with love
and care. …Ah! You seem to be
dependable. How would you like
to help me out? See? This is the
latest version of#DEX. It automatically
records data on #MON you've
seen or caught. It's a hi-tech
encyclopedia!
entries.translation:
大木：呵呵！
你就是{PLAYER}吗！ 我是大木，
是个宝可梦研究员！ 宝可梦爷爷是我多年好友，
我拜访他的时候，听说空木那边正好有事让你过来一趟，所以一直都在等你！ 呵呵！
你带着很少见的宝可梦嘛！ 而且…… …… 嗯嗯，我明白了！ 也难怪空木会
把宝可梦交给你，并委托你帮忙！ 对于我或者空木
这样的研究者而言，宝可梦是重要的伙伴！ 我相信你一定可以
精心地去培育宝可梦。 ……对了！ 毕竟我很看好你嘛，
就拜托你一件事情吧！ 其实呢…… 瞧！
这是宝可梦图鉴！ 它可以自动记录
你发现的宝可梦数据，页面也会随之增加，是一部高科技的图鉴哦！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_OakText2
entries.english:
Go meet many kinds
of #MON and complete that
#DEX! But I've stayed
too long. I have to get to
GOLDENROD for myusual radio show. {PLAYER}, I'm
counting on you!
entries.translation:
我希望
你能多与宝可梦相遇，将这个图鉴彻底填满！ 哎呀！
我的话好像太长了！ 接下来我必须得
去满金市录制那个我经常作客的广播节目！ 那么，{PLAYER}！
就拜托你了！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouse_StrangeCoinsText
entries.english:
A whole pile of
strange coins! Maybe they're from
another country…
entries.translation:
上面散落着一堆
从没见过的硬币！是外国的货币吗？

entries.label: MrPsychicText1
entries.english: … … … …I got it! You wanted this!

entries.label: MrPsychicText2
entries.english:
TM29 is PSYCHIC. It may lower the
target's SPCL.DEF.
entries.translation:
招式学习器29是精神强念
……你知道吗？ ……如果运气好，
说不定就可以降低对手的特殊能力！

entries.label: LassKriseAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I thought you were
staring at mebecause I'm cute!
entries.translation:
因为人家很可爱，
所以才会觉得你一直在偷窥人家！

entries.label: LassKriseBeatenText
entries.english: …Hmmm…

entries.label: LassKriseSeenText
entries.english:
Hello? Why are you
staring at me? Oh, a battle?
entries.translation:
怎么了，
你干嘛盯着别人的脸？ 诶，要和我对战？

entries.label: NationalParkBattleNoticeText
entries.english:
What is this
notice? Please battle only
in the grass. NATIONAL PARK
WARDEN'S OFFICE
entries.translation:
这里贴着一张告示！ 宝可梦对战
只能在草丛中进行。 ……自然公园
管理事务所留……

entries.label: NationalParkGameboyKidText
entries.english:
I'm printing out
my #DEX. You can also print
out stuff like MAIL and your PC
BOXES.
entries.translation:
我正在用打印机
打印宝可梦图鉴！ 邮件或电脑盒子
也是可以打印的哦！

entries.label: NationalParkLassText
entries.english:
Look! Check out my
bag! I printed out my
favorites from my #DEX and stuck
them on my bag.
entries.translation:
快看，快看！
我的包包！ 把最喜欢的宝可梦图鉴
打印出来贴上去了！

entries.label: NationalParkPersianText
entries.english: PERSIAN: Fufushaa!
entries.translation: 猫老大：呼，呼沙——！

entries.label: NationalParkPokefanFText
entries.english:
This is MAIL I got
from my daughter.It cheers me up.
entries.translation:
这张小纸片啊，
是我女儿寄来的邮件。我很高兴呢。

entries.label: NationalParkRelaxationSquareText
entries.english:
RELAXATION SQUARE
NATIONAL PARK
entries.translation:
休息广场
自然公园

entries.label: NationalParkTeacher1Text
entries.english:
Pay attention,
please! …Oops, I have to
quit thinking like a teacher all the
time. You must be a
#MON trainer. Since you're work-
ing so hard, I want you to have
this.
entries.translation:
喂，别开小差——！ ……啊，糟糕，
当老师当习惯了。 你是宝可梦训练家吧？ 看在你这么努力的份上，
就把这个送给你吧！

entries.label: NationalParkTeacher1Text_GotQuickClaw
entries.english:
Let a #MON hold
that QUICK CLAW. Sometimes it will
strike firstduring battle.
entries.translation:
这是先制之爪。
让宝可梦携带后，偶尔可以抢先发起进攻哦！

entries.label: NationalParkTeacher2Text
entries.english:
I take walks in
the PARK, but I never go into the
grass. Trainers always
want to battle…
entries.translation:
我经常来公园里散步，
但是从来没进过草坪。 因为那里的训练家
总是会找人对战！

entries.label: NationalParkTrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS Print out MAIL by
opening it thenpressing START.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 在邮件的界面
按START键，就能打印邮件！

entries.label: NationalParkYoungster1Text
entries.english:
I'm playing with
stickers I printedfrom my #DEX.
entries.translation:
我把宝可梦图鉴打印出来
和朋友玩游戏！

entries.label: NationalParkYoungster2Text
entries.english:
I get the other
guy's #DEXsticker if I win.
entries.translation:
谁赢了，谁就能拿走
对手的图鉴贴纸！

entries.label: PokefanBeverlyCuteMonText
entries.english:
I must say, your
#MON are quitecute, too.
entries.translation:
我觉得你的宝可梦
也是可可爱爱呢。

entries.label: PokefanFBeverlyMarillFriendText
entries.english:
My friend keeps a
MARILL! I find them very
endearing. Oh, I wish for a
MARILL of my own…
entries.translation:
朋友有只玛力露！
玛力露超级可爱啊。 真好啊，
我也想要玛力露……

entries.label: PokefanfBeverly1BeatenText
entries.english:
I can beat you in
pride, but…
entries.translation:
对战我是赢不了你了。
比自尊心我肯定能赢……

entries.label: PokefanfBeverly1SeenText
entries.english:
My #MON are
simply darling. Let me tell you
how proud mydarlings make me.
entries.translation:
人家的宝可梦
真是太可爱了。我都有点骄傲了呢。

entries.label: PokefanmWilliamAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I lost the battle,
but my #MON win the prize for
being most lovely.
entries.translation:
虽然输了对战，
但是我的宝可梦更可爱，这方面是我赢了！

entries.label: PokefanmWilliamBeatenText
entries.english: M-my #MON!
entries.translation: 小、小宝可梦！

entries.label: PokefanmWilliamSeenText
entries.english:
We adore our #-
MON, even if theydislike us. That's what being
a FAN is about.
entries.translation:
永远都要疼爱宝可梦！
哪怕会被宝可梦嫌弃！这是发烧友俱乐部规定！

entries.label: SchoolboyJack1BeatenText
entries.english: Wha-wha-what?
entries.translation: 唔唔唔？

entries.label: SchoolboyJack1SeenText
entries.english:
The world of
#MON is deep. There are still
lots of things wedon't know. But I know more
than you do!
entries.translation:
宝可梦学非常深奥，
现在还有很多未解之谜。 但是我的知识储备量
肯定是比你丰富的！

entries.label: SchoolboyJackTradeMonText
entries.english:
There is a lot
to learn. For example… There are 50 kinds
of TMs. Traded #MON
level up faster.
entries.translation:
有很多知识必须要记住。 比如说……
招式学习器共有50种，与人交换得到的宝可梦成长的速度会更快。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant10AText
entries.english:
KIPP: I've studied
about bug #MONa lot. I'm going to win
for sure.
entries.translation:
智行：我学过很多
虫宝可梦的相关知识，我一定会是第一名！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant1AText
entries.english:
DON: I'm going to
win! Don't botherme.
entries.translation:
干泰：第一名一定是我！
不要妨碍我！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant2AText
entries.english:
ED: My PARASECT
puts #MON tosleep with SPORE.
entries.translation:
辉奇：我的派拉斯特
会使出蘑菇孢子让扑过来的宝可梦睡着！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant3AText
entries.english:
NICK: I'm raising
fast #MON forbattles.
entries.translation:
小建：为了赢得比赛，
我专门培养敏捷的宝可梦！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant4AText
entries.english:
WILLIAM: I'm not
concerned aboutwinning. I'm just looking
for rare #MON.
entries.translation:
彰宏：第几名无所谓，
我只想找稀有的宝可梦。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant5AText
entries.english:
BENNY: Ssh! You'll
scare off SCYTHER. I'll talk to you
later.
entries.translation:
贞夫：……嘘！
飞天螳螂要跑了！回头聊。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant6AText
entries.english:
BARRY: You should
weaken bug #MON first, then throw
a BALL.
entries.translation:
雄一：捉虫宝可梦之前，
要先削弱它们再投球，这点很重要的。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant7AText
entries.english:
CINDY: I love bug
#MON. I guess you must
like them too.
entries.translation:
里美：你有意见？
女生收集虫宝可梦怎么了？

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant8AText
entries.english:
JOSH: I've been
collecting bug #MON since I
was just a baby. There's no way I'm
going to lose!
entries.translation:
友道：从出生开始
我就一心捕捉虫宝可梦，怎么可能会输呢！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant9AText
entries.english:
SAMUEL: If you've
got the time to chat, go find some
bug #MON.
entries.translation:
康太：有时间闲聊的话，
去找宝可梦不是更好吗？

entries.label: NationalParkBugContestBattleNoticeText
entries.english:
What is this
notice? Please battle only
in the grass. NATIONAL PARK
WARDEN'S OFFICE
entries.translation:
这里贴着一张告示！ 宝可梦对战
只能在草丛中进行。 ……自然公园
管理事务所留……

entries.label: NationalParkBugContestRelaxationSquareText
entries.english:
RELAXATION SQUARE
NATIONAL PARK
entries.translation:
休息广场
自然公园

entries.label: NationalParkBugContestTrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS Print out MAIL by
opening it thenpressing START.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 在邮件的界面
按START键，就能打印邮件！

entries.label: NewBarkTownElmsHouseSignText
entries.english: ELM'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 这里是空木的家。

entries.label: NewBarkTownElmsLabSignText
entries.english: ELM #MON LAB
entries.translation: 空木宝可梦研究所。

entries.label: NewBarkTownPlayersHouseSignText
entries.english: {PLAYER}'s House
entries.translation: 这里是{PLAYER}的家。

entries.label: NewBarkTownRivalText1
entries.english:
…… So this is the
famous ELM #MONLAB…
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 这里就是著名的
空木博士研究所……

entries.label: NewBarkTownRivalText2
entries.english:
…What are you
staring at?
entries.translation:
……干嘛？
别用那种眼神盯着别人！

entries.label: NewBarkTownSignText
entries.english:
NEW BARK TOWN The Town Where the
Winds of a NewBeginning Blow
entries.translation:
这里是若叶镇
吹起开始之风的城镇

entries.label: Text_CallMomOnGear
entries.english:
Call your mom on
your #GEAR to let her know how
you're doing.
entries.translation:
只要有宝可装置，
随时都能给妈妈打电话， 让她听一听
你那充满活力的声音。

entries.label: Text_ElmDiscoveredNewMon
entries.english:
Yo, {PLAYER}! I hear PROF.ELM
discovered somenew #MON.
entries.translation:
哟，{PLAYER}！ 我听说空木博士
发现了新的宝可梦呢。

entries.label: Text_GearIsImpressive
entries.english:
Wow, your #GEAR
is impressive! Did your mom get
it for you?
entries.translation:
哇，好酷的宝可装置！
是你妈妈买给你的吗？

entries.label: Text_ItsDangerousToGoAlone
entries.english:
It's dangerous to
go out without a#MON! Wild #MON
jump out of the grass on the way
to the next town.
entries.translation:
真是的！没有宝可梦同行
就走进道路是很危险的！ 去隔壁城镇的这条路
到处都是会跳出野生宝可梦的草丛哦！

entries.label: Text_TellMomIfLeaving
entries.english:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
Leaving again? You should tell
your mom if youare leaving.
entries.translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}，
你又要出门吗？ 要踏上旅途的话，
得先跟你妈妈讲一句哦！

entries.label: Text_WaitPlayer
entries.english: Wait, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation: 啊！{PLAYER}！

entries.label: Text_WhatDoYouThinkYoureDoing
entries.english:
What do you think
you're doing?
entries.translation: 你一个人要上哪去啊！？

entries.label: Text_YourMonIsAdorable
entries.english:
Oh! Your #MON
is adorable!I wish I had one!
entries.translation:
哇！好可爱的宝可梦！
我也好想要啊！

entries.label: OakLabDexCheckText
entries.english:
How is your #-
DEX coming? Let's see…
entries.translation:
宝可梦图鉴进展如何？
让我看看吧。 嗯……

entries.label: OakLabGoodbyeText
entries.english:
If you're in the
area, I hope youcome visit again.
entries.translation:
你下次要是再经过这里，
一定要进来坐坐啊。

entries.label: OakNoKantoBadgesText
entries.english:
OAK: Hmm? You're
not collectingKANTO GYM BADGES? The GYM LEADERS in
KANTO are as tough as any you battled
in JOHTO. I recommend that
you challengethem.
entries.translation:
大木：哎呀？
你好像还没开始收集关都的徽章啊。 关都的道馆训练家们
绝不比城都逊色，其中高手如云！你不妨去挑战一下吧。

entries.label: OakOpenMtSilverText
entries.english:
OAK: Wow! That's
excellent! You collected the
BADGES of GYMS inKANTO. Well done! I was right in my
assessment of you. Tell you what,
{PLAYER}. I'll make arrangements so
that you can go toMT.SILVER. MT.SILVER is a big
mountain that is home to many wild
#MON. It's too dangerous
for your average trainer, so it's
off limits. But we can make an
exception in yourcase, {PLAYER}. Go up to INDIGO
PLATEAU. You can reach MT.SILVER
from there.
entries.translation:
大木：哦，太了不起了！
居然能集齐关都的徽章！我果然没有看错人啊！ {PLAYER}！
我现在帮你办理进入白银山的手续吧！ 白银山非常大，
上面有很多野生宝可梦！ 那里实在是太危险了，
所以禁止一般训练家进入。{PLAYER}另当别论！ 你现在去石英高原看看，
那里有通往白银山的路。

entries.label: OakWelcomeKantoText
entries.english:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
It's good of you to come all this
way to KANTO. What do you think
of the trainers out here?
Pretty tough, huh?
entries.translation:
大木：哦，{PLAYER}！
你居然特地来我这里了！ 怎么样？
关都地区的训练家不太好对付吧？

entries.label: OakYesKantoBadgesText
entries.english:
OAK: Ah, you're
collecting KANTOGYM BADGES. I imagine that
it's hard, but the experience is sure
to help you. Come see me when
you get them all. I'll have a gift
for you. Keep trying hard,
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
大木：你好像正在
收集关都的徽章吧！ 虽然并不轻松，
但经验一定会成为你的力量！ 等你全部集齐以后，
再来我这里玩吧。到时候我有礼物送你！ {PLAYER}，
加油吧！

entries.label: OaksAssistant1Text
entries.english:
The PROF's #MON
TALK radio program isn't aired here
in KANTO. It's a shame--I'd
like to hear it.
entries.translation:
博士的宝可梦讲座
并没有在关都播放。真遗憾！我好想听啊。

entries.label: OaksAssistant2Text
entries.english:
Thanks to your
work on the #-DEX, the PROF's research is coming
along great.
entries.translation:
多亏你努力地
填满图鉴，博士的研究工作进展得非常顺利！

entries.label: OaksAssistant3Text
entries.english:
Don't tell anyone,
but PROF.OAK'S #MON TALK isn't
a live broadcast.
entries.translation:
……我只告诉你一个人！ 大木博士的宝可梦讲座
其实并不是现场直播！

entries.label: OaksLabPCText
entries.english:
There's an e-mail
message on the PC. … PROF.OAK, how is
your researchcoming along? I'm still plugging
away. I heard rumors
that {PLAYER} is getting quite a
reputation. I'm delighted to
hear that. ELM in NEW BARK
TOWN 8-)
entries.translation:
往电脑屏幕看的时候，
发现了一封电子邮件！ …… …… …… 大木博士，
您的研究进展顺利吗？ 我这边嘛……
总之在努力就对了！ 听说{PLAYER}
现在也非常努力，我由衷地感到高兴！ ……若叶镇空木敬上
…… …… ……

entries.label: OaksLabPoster1Text
entries.english:
Press START to
open the MENU.
entries.translation:
按下START键！
就能打开菜单。

entries.label: OaksLabPoster2Text
entries.english:
The SAVE option is
on the MENU. Use it in a timely
manner.
entries.translation:
想要保存的时候，
一定要仔细地写下记录。

entries.label: OaksLabTrashcanText
entries.english:
There's nothing in
here…
entries.translation: 里面是空的……

entries.label: OlivineCafeFishingGuruText
entries.english:
OLIVINE CAFE's
menu is chock full of hearty fare for
beefy SAILORS!
entries.translation:
在这家浅葱咖啡馆
有很多菜色对得上那个大力水手的胃口！

entries.label: OlivineCafeSailorText
entries.english:
Whenever I roll
into this town, I always visit the
OLIVINE CAFE. Everything on the
menu makes me feel stronger. I can't
stop eating!
entries.translation:
既然来了这个城市，
就要来这家浅葱食堂。 每道菜吃了都能长力气，
根本停不下来！

entries.label: OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText
entries.english:
Hah! Your #MON
sure look likelightweights! They don't have
the power to moveboulders aside. Here, use this
and teach themSTRENGTH!
entries.translation:
哎呀？
你的宝可梦看着好柔弱啊。 这样子怎么可能
推得动大石头呢？ 快用这个来教它们
叫做“怪力”的招式！

entries.label: OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText_GotStrength
entries.english:
On the sea, the
only thing you can count on is your
own good self! I'm so proud of my
