buff bod!
entries.translation:
在茫茫大海中，
只能依赖自己的肉体！我对自己的力气很有自信！

entries.label: OlivineCityBattleTowerSignText
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER AHEAD
Opening Now!
entries.translation:
前方是对战塔
正在营业！

entries.label: OlivineCityBattleTowerSignText_NotYetOpen
entries.english: BATTLE TOWER AHEAD
entries.translation: 前方是对战塔

entries.label: OlivineCityPortSignText
entries.english:
OLIVINE PORT
FAST SHIP PIER
entries.translation:
浅葱港
高速船的登船口

entries.label: OlivineCityRivalText
entries.english:
… You again? There's no need to
panic. I don't bother with wimps
like you. Speaking of weak-
lings, the city's GYM LEADER isn't
here. Supposedly taking
care of a sick #MON at the
LIGHTHOUSE. Humph! Boo-hoo!
Just let sick#MON go! A #MON that
can't battle isworthless! Why don't you go
train at theLIGHTHOUSE? Who knows. It may
make you a bitless weak!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… ……又是你吗？ 用不着那么提防吧？
我也没打算搭理像你这样的弱者。 说起弱者，
这里的道馆馆主也没影了。 听说她去了灯塔
在那照料虚弱的宝可梦。 ……哼，蠢死了！
碰到虚弱的宝可梦放着不管不就好了。 无法拿来对战的宝可梦，
根本就是毫无价值。 你要不要顺便去灯塔
自我修行一下？ 说不定啊，
可以强那么一丢丢呢。

entries.label: OlivineCitySailor1Text
entries.english:
Dark roads are
dangerous atnight. But in the pitch-
black of night, the sea is even
more treacherous! Without the beacon
of the LIGHTHOUSE to guide it, no
ship can sail.
entries.translation:
晦暗的夜路十分危险！
晦暗的大海也充满危机！ 没有灯塔的光芒指引，
船只无法在海上移动。

entries.label: OlivineCitySailor2Text
entries.english:
The sea is sweet! Sunsets on the sea
are marvelous! Sing with me! 
Yo-ho! Blow theman down!…
entries.translation:
大海超级棒——
夕阳无限好！ 大——海——汪——洋
无——边——无——际！

entries.label: OlivineCitySignText
entries.english:
OLIVINE CITY The Port Closest
to Foreign Lands
entries.translation:
这里是浅葱市
最接近遥远异国的港口城市

entries.label: OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokedexText
entries.english:
Wow, you have a
#DEX! That is just so
awesome.
entries.translation:
你身上的那个东西，
是传说中的宝可梦图鉴吧？真好啊，太酷了吧！

entries.label: OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokegearText
entries.english:
That thing you
have--it's a #-GEAR, right? Wow,that's cool.
entries.translation:
你身上的那个东西，
是传说中的宝可装置吧？真好啊，太酷了吧！

entries.label: OlivineGymSignText
entries.english:
OLIVINE CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: JASMINE The Steel-Clad
Defense Girl
entries.translation:
浅葱市宝可梦道馆
馆主：阿蜜铜墙铁壁般的少女

entries.label: OlivineLighthouseSignText
entries.english:
OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE
Also known as theGLITTER LIGHTHOUSE
entries.translation:
浅葱灯塔
别名：光辉灯塔

entries.label: DontWantGoodRodText
entries.english:
Whaaat? You don't
like to fish!?Incomprehensible!
entries.translation:
你说什么！
你讨厌钓鱼？难以置信！

entries.label: GaveGoodRodText
entries.english:
Fish aren't found
in the sea alone. They go wherever
there is water.
entries.translation:
不只是大海，
只要是有水的地方随时可以使用钓竿哦！

entries.label: GiveGoodRodText
entries.english:
Ah, hahah!
We have ourselvesa new angler!
entries.translation:
喔、呵、呵！
又诞生了一名垂钓者！

entries.label: HaveGoodRodText
entries.english:
How are things?
Land the big one?
entries.translation: 怎么样？钓到好东西了吗？

entries.label: OfferGoodRodText
entries.english:
OLIVINE is on the
sea! And if it's on the
sea, there arebound to be fish! I've fished here
for 30 years. Would you like to
face the sea andfish?
entries.translation:
说起浅葱就会想到大海！
说起大海就会想到钓鱼！ 我已经在这里
垂钓了30年！ 你要不要试试挥舞钓竿
向大海发起挑战？

entries.label: Jasmine_BadgeSpeech
entries.english:
MINERALBADGE
raises #MON'sDEFENSE. …Um… Please take
this too…
entries.translation:
……钢铁徽章拥有
提升宝可梦防御力的特殊效果哦。 ……那个，这个也请收下。

entries.label: Jasmine_BetterTrainer
entries.english:
…You are a better
trainer than me, in both skill and
kindness. In accordance with
LEAGUE rules, I confer upon you
this BADGE.
entries.translation:
……作为宝可梦训练家，
你似乎比我优秀得多。你更强大，也更温柔呢。 ……那么按照联盟的规矩，
我要把徽章交给你。

entries.label: Jasmine_GoodLuck
entries.english:
Um… I don't know
how to say this,but good luck…
entries.translation:
呃、呃……
我也不太会说话， ……总之请你好好加油吧。

entries.label: Jasmine_IronTailSpeech
entries.english:
…You could use
that TM to teachIRON TAIL.
entries.translation:
……使用那个招式学习器，
可以教授“铁尾”。

entries.label: Jasmine_SteelTypeIntro
entries.english:
…Thank you for
your help at theLIGHTHOUSE… But this is dif-
ferent. Please allow me to intro-
duce myself. I am JASMINE, a
GYM LEADER. I usethe steel-type. …Do you know about
the steel-type? It's a type that
was only recentlydiscovered. …Um… May I begin?
entries.translation:
……之前灯塔的事情
我必须向你表示感谢。 ……可是对战归对战。
我要重新自我介绍一下： 我是道馆馆主——阿蜜，
使用的宝可梦，全都是钢属性。 ……所谓的“钢属性”
你听说过吗？ 这是最近才发现的
宝可梦的一种新属性。 ……呃、呃呃。
那就开始吧？

entries.label: OlivineGymGuidePreText
entries.english:
JASMINE, the GYM
LEADER, is at theLIGHTHOUSE. She's been tending
to a sick #MON. A strong trainer
has to be compas-sionate.
entries.translation:
就因为灯塔的宝可梦
身体状况不是很好，道馆馆主阿蜜一直在旁边照顾它哦。 所谓的强大的训练家，
也要拥有温柔的心呢。

entries.label: OlivineGymGuideText
entries.english:
JASMINE uses the
newly discoveredsteel-type. I don't know very
much about it.
entries.translation:
阿蜜使用的宝可梦
都具有最新发现的属性——钢属性。 至于这个属性的特点，
我就不太清楚了。

entries.label: OlivineGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
That was awesome. The steel-type,
huh? That was a close
encounter of anunknown kind!
entries.translation:
哎呀，真不得了。
与钢属性相遇……几乎就是与未知相遇啊！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedMineralBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
MINERALBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿蜜那里
得到了钢铁徽章！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedTM09
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM09.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿蜜那里
获得了招式学习器09！

entries.label: OlivineHouseBetaRhydonText
entries.english: RHYDON: Gugooh!
entries.translation: 钻角犀兽：咕嗷——！

entries.label: OlivineHouseBetaTeacherText
entries.english:
When my #MON
got sick, the PHARMACIST in
ECRUTEAK made somemedicine for me.
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
之前也生过一场病，于是我就委托缘朱市的药店帮忙做了一些药。

entries.label: OlivineLighthouse1FPokefanFText
entries.english:
In the past, #-
MON used to light the sea around
OLIVINE at night. The LIGHTHOUSE was
made in honor ofthose #MON.
entries.translation:
从古至今，浅葱市一直有
宝可梦在夜间照亮大海。 为了纪念它们
人们就建造了这座灯塔。

entries.label: OlivineLighthouse1FSailorText
entries.english:
People train at
this LIGHTHOUSE. It's not easy to
climb because ofall the trainers.
entries.translation:
这座灯塔
也是修行的地方。 因为训练家非常多，
想往上爬还挺费力的。

entries.label: GentlemanAlfredAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Up top is a #-
MON that keeps theLIGHTHOUSE lit. But I hear that
it's sick now and can't be cured by
ordinary medicine.
entries.translation:
顶层有一只宝可梦
总是会发光。 听说它现在生病了，
而且普通的伤药无法治好。

entries.label: GentlemanAlfredBeatenText
entries.english:
Ah! I can see that
you're serious.
entries.translation: 哦哦，你是认真的！

entries.label: GentlemanAlfredSeenText
entries.english:
Hm? This is no
place for playing.
entries.translation:
哦，你是……？
这里可不是给你玩的。

entries.label: SailorHueyBeatenText
entries.english:
Urf!
I lose!
entries.translation:
噢！
是我输了！

entries.label: SailorHueyGiveProteinText
entries.english:
Man! You're as
tough as ever! Anyway, here's
that medicine frombefore.
entries.translation:
可恶——！
你还是那么强啊…… 算了，先不说这个……
这是之前说的药，给！

entries.label: SailorHueySeenText
entries.english:
Men of the sea are
always spoilingfor a good fight!
entries.translation:
大海男儿
该出手时就出手！

entries.label: SailorHueyUnusedText
entries.english:
What power!
How would you like to sail the seas
with me?
entries.translation:
你的实力，我很看好！
要一起去外国吗？

entries.label: BirdKeeperTheoAfterBattleText
entries.english:
How the heck do
you go up? I want to visit
the sick #MON, but I can't get up
there…
entries.translation:
顶层要怎么走啊？
本来想去探望一下的，却找不到路，头疼。

entries.label: BirdKeeperTheoBeatenText
entries.english:
You really are
concerned…
entries.translation:
不是来玩啊……
真的是来探望呢。

entries.label: BirdKeeperTheoSeenText
entries.english:
Why are you here?
Are you just going to gawk? I suggest
that you leave!
entries.translation:
你是来干嘛的？
探望？闲逛？闲逛的话还是回去吧！

entries.label: GentlemanPrestonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
JASMINE used to
use rock #MONlike ONIX.
entries.translation:
以前的阿蜜用的都是
大岩蛇一类的宝可梦，那时还是擅长岩石属性的宝可梦训练家。

entries.label: GentlemanPrestonBeatenText
entries.english:
…sigh… I must
train some more…
entries.translation:
哎……
修行还不够啊……

entries.label: GentlemanPrestonSeenText
entries.english:
I travel the world
to train my #-MON. I wish tobattle with you.
entries.translation:
我周游世界，
以此来锻炼宝可梦。来和我对战吧！

entries.label: SailorTerrellAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Every time I come
back to OLIVINE, Ivisit the GYM. The GYM LEADER's
#MON type has changed without me
noticing.
entries.translation:
只要我回到浅葱市，
必定会去一趟道馆。 馆主使用的宝可梦属性
似乎和以前不太一样……

entries.label: SailorTerrellBeatenText
entries.english:
You are both kind
and strong…
entries.translation:
你的战斗方式
温柔而强大呢。

entries.label: SailorTerrellSeenText
entries.english:
Sailors are both
kind and strong.How about you?
entries.translation:
海上男儿既强大
又不失温柔。你又是哪种人呢？

entries.label: LassConnie1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Right. Anybody
would be worriedif his or her own#MON were hurt. I'll pray for the
#MON here, so JASMINE can come
back to the GYM.
entries.translation:
宝可梦受伤了的话，
确实很让人担心呢。 我会在这里祈祷，
希望阿蜜尽快重返道馆。

entries.label: LassConnie1BeatenText
entries.english: Aaack! My #MON!
entries.translation: 啊啊，我的宝可梦！

entries.label: LassConnie1SeenText
entries.english:
JASMINE is this
city's GYM LEADER. I mean to bring
her back with me. Nobody had better
get in my way!
entries.translation:
阿蜜毕竟还是
这个城市的道馆馆主…… 我一定要把她带回去！
谁也别想妨碍我！

entries.label: SailorKentAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Speaking of sick,
I've heard there's a good PHARMACY in
CIANWOOD.
entries.translation:
要……药！
我记得听别人说过，湛蓝市有家妙手药店！

entries.label: SailorKentBeatenText
entries.english:
I can't manage a
smile either…
entries.translation: 我也要忘记怎么笑了……

entries.label: SailorKentSeenText
entries.english:
JASMINE must be
worried sick aboutthe #MON here. She won't even
smile these days.
entries.translation:
阿蜜……
很担心宝可梦呢……仿佛要永远地失去笑容了。

entries.label: BirdKeeperDenisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
My #MON learned
how to use FLY inCIANWOOD. Well, since I'm a
loser, I'll FLYacross the sea…
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦在湛蓝市
学会了叫飞翔的招式。 算了，既然输了，
那就干脆飞越大海吧。

entries.label: BirdKeeperDenisBeatenText
entries.english: Oops…They crashed…
entries.translation:
啊呀呀，
状态突然就没了……

entries.label: BirdKeeperDenisSeenText
entries.english:
We're pretty high
up here. My bird #MON are in
prime form.
entries.translation:
天空近在咫尺，
我的鸟宝可梦状态绝佳！

entries.label: SailorErnestAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A GYM LEADER isn't
just about being strong. A LEADER
also needs to becompassionate.
entries.translation:
馆主不仅要有强大的实力，
还需要一颗温柔的心。

entries.label: SailorErnestBeatenText
entries.english:
Whoa, whoa. You're
overwhelming!
entries.translation:
哦、哦！
强到离谱！

entries.label: SailorErnestSeenText
entries.english:
I wanted to battle
JASMINE, but she's not up to it now.
So, how about you?
entries.translation:
本来是想和阿蜜对战的，
但现在好像不是时候。那就让你来代替她吧！

entries.label: AmphyBreathingLaboredText
entries.english:
Its breathing is
terribly labored…
entries.translation: 感觉它有些呼吸困难

entries.label: AmphyPalPalooText
entries.english:
AMPHY: …
…Pa… paloo…

entries.label: AmphyPaluPaluluText
entries.english:
AMPHY: Palu!
Palulu!
entries.translation: 光儿：帕鲁！帕鲁鲁！

entries.label: JasmineAmphyHangOnText
entries.english: …AMPHY, hang on!
entries.translation: ……光儿，撑住啊！

entries.label: JasmineAmphyHowAreYouFeelingText
entries.english:
JASMINE: … AMPHY, how are you
feeling?
entries.translation: 阿蜜：…… …… …… 光儿，感觉怎么样？

entries.label: JasmineCianwoodPharmacyText
entries.english:
JASMINE: … This
#MON always kept the sea lit
at night. …But it suddenly
got sick… It'sgasping for air… …I understand
that there is a wonderful PHARMACY
in CIANWOOD… But that's across
the sea… And I can't leave
AMPHY unattended…
entries.translation:
阿蜜：……这只宝可梦
一直为我们照亮大海。 ……可是，
有一天它突然没了精神，变得奄奄一息…… ……有传闻说，
在大海彼岸的湛蓝市有一家神奇的药店…… 可是我现在不能
放着光儿不管啊……

entries.label: JasmineCureAmphyText
entries.english:
JASMINE: …Will
that medicine cureAMPHY?
entries.translation:
阿蜜：……那个药
真的能治好光儿吗？

entries.label: JasmineDontBeOffendedText
entries.english:
JASMINE: …Um,
please don't beoffended… …AMPHY will not
take anything fromanyone but me…
entries.translation:
阿蜜：……那、那个，
希望你别见怪。 因为光儿……
不喜欢别人给的东西，只有我是例外。

entries.label: JasmineGetSomeMedicineText
entries.english:
…May I ask you to
get some medicinefor me? Please?
entries.translation:
我有个不情之请……
能不能请你代替我去把药带回来呢？

entries.label: JasmineISeeText
entries.english: JASMINE: …I see…
entries.translation: 阿蜜：……是吗。

entries.label: JasmineThankYouText
entries.english:
JASMINE: …Oh, I'm
so relieved… This is just so
wonderful… Thank you so very,
very much. …I will return to
the GYM…
entries.translation:
阿蜜：……啊，太好了！
真是太好了！ 真是非常感谢，
这都多亏了你。 那么……
我也该回道馆了。

entries.label: PlayerHandedSecretpotionText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} handed the
SECRETPOTION toJASMINE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}把秘传之药
交给了阿蜜。

entries.label: OlivineMartCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
Do your #MON
already know the move for carrying
people on water?
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦有没有学会
载人渡海的那个招式？

entries.label: OlivineMartLassText
entries.english:
My BUTTERFREE came
from my boyfriendoverseas. It carried some
MAIL from him. Want to know what
it says? Let's see… Nope!
It's a secret!
entries.translation:
身在外国的男朋友
给我送来了巴大蝶，而且还携带着邮件！ 你想知道写了什么嘛？
这个嘛…… 果然还是不·能·说！

entries.label: OlivinePokecenter1FFisherText
entries.english:
The SAILOR in the
OLIVINE CAFE next door is really
generous. He taught my
#MON STRENGTH. Now it can move
big boulders.
entries.translation:
隔壁有家浅葱咖啡馆，
有个水手正在那吃东西，他是个豪爽的男人哦！ 竟然免费送给我
能够推动巨大岩石的秘传学习器——怪力！

entries.label: OlivinePokecenter1FTeacherText
entries.english:
There's a person
in CIANWOOD CITYacross the sea. I heard him brag-
ging about hisrare #MON.
entries.translation:
湛蓝市位于大海彼岸，
那里有个人喜欢显摆自己拥有的稀有宝可梦。

entries.label: OlivinePortAskBoardText
entries.english:
Welcome to FAST
SHIP S.S.AQUA. Will you be board-
ing today?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到
高速船水流号！要乘船吗？

entries.label: OlivinePortAskTicketText
entries.english:
May I see your
S.S.TICKET?
entries.translation: 那么，请出示一下船票。

entries.label: OlivinePortCantBoardText
entries.english:
Sorry. You can't
board now.
entries.translation: 现在无法登船！

entries.label: OlivinePortComeAgainText
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.translation:
下次再见，
请多关照。

entries.label: OlivinePortCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
There are lots of
#MON in KANTO. I wish I could go…
entries.translation:
在关都也有
许多宝可梦呢！我也想去看看。

entries.label: OlivinePortFishingGuru1Text
entries.english:
SHELLDER are easy
to catch here. They're kind of
rare elsewhere.
entries.translation:
别的地方很难钓到大舌贝，
在这里却很容易上钩！

entries.label: OlivinePortFishingGuru2Text
entries.english:
How many RODS do
you have? Different RODS
catch different#MON.
entries.translation:
你有几根
钓竿？ 钓竿种类不同，
能钓的宝可梦也不一样！

entries.label: OlivinePortFlashTicketText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} flashed
the S.S.TICKET. That's it.
Thank you!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}向船员
出示了船票！ 好的！可以了！

entries.label: OlivinePortFridayShipText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Friday.
entries.translation:
高速船预定
在下个周五启航。

entries.label: OlivinePortMondayShipText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Monday.
entries.translation:
高速船预定
在下个周一启航。

entries.label: OlivinePortNoTicketText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} tried to
show the S.S.TICKET… …But no TICKET! Sorry!
You may board only if you have an
S.S.TICKET.

entries.label: OlivinePortSailorBeforeHOFText
entries.english:
We don't want you
to fall into the sea, so you're not
allowed in.
entries.translation:
要是掉进海里
可就危险了，所以前方禁止通行。

entries.label: OlivinePortSailorGetOnBoardText
entries.english:
We're departing
soon. Please geton board.
entries.translation:
马上就要启航了，
请上船。

entries.label: OlivinePortYoungsterText
entries.english:
S.S.AQUA uses jets
to skim over thewaves!
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
借喷射机的力量微微悬浮，所以才能飞驰于海面哦！

entries.label: OlivinePortPassagePokefanMText
entries.english:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
sails to KANTO on Mondays and Fri-
days.
entries.translation:
高速船水流号
每逢周一与周五都会启航前往关都！

entries.label: OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDadText
entries.english:
Along the way to
CIANWOOD, there are four deserted
islands. Bad kids are taken
to the islands aspunishment!
entries.translation:
通往湛蓝市的那片海域
有4座无人岛。 如果想要惩罚坏孩子，
不妨把他带到那些岛上！

entries.label: OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDaughterText
entries.english:
Whenever I get in
trouble, Daddyalways scares me.
entries.translation:
只要我做了什么恶作剧，
爸爸马上就会吓唬我……

entries.label: BluesHouseSignText
entries.english: BLUE'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 这里是青绿的家

entries.label: OaksLabSignText
entries.english:
OAK #MON
RESEARCH LAB
entries.translation:
这里是大木博士的
宝可梦研究所

entries.label: PalletTownFisherText
entries.english:
Technology is
incredible! You can now trade
#MON acrosstime like e-mail.
entries.translation:
科学的力量好厉害！ 据说现在的电脑连接技术
已经可以实现超越时空的宝可梦交换了。

entries.label: PalletTownSignText
entries.english:
PALLET TOWN A Tranquil Setting
of Peace & Purity
entries.translation:
这里是真新镇。
真新即是无垢的纯白之色。

entries.label: PalletTownTeacherText
entries.english:
I'm raising #-
MON too. They serve as my
private guards.
entries.translation:
我也一直都在
培育宝可梦！它们现在是我的保镖！

entries.label: RedsHouseSignText
entries.english: RED'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 这里是赤红的家

entries.label: PewterCityBugCatcherText
entries.english:
At night, CLEFAIRY
come out to playat MT.MOON. But not every
night.
entries.translation:
听说每当夜幕降临，
月见山的皮皮们就会现身哦。 但好像不是每天都这样。

entries.label: PewterCityCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
Have you visited
PEWTER GYM? The LEADER uses
rock-type #MON.
entries.translation:
去过深灰道馆吗？ 那里的道馆馆主使用的是
岩石属性宝可梦哦！

entries.label: PewterCityGrampsText
entries.english:
Ah, you came all
the way out herefrom JOHTO? That brings back
memories. When I was young, I went
to JOHTO to train. You remind me so
much of what I was like as a young
man. Here. I want you
to have this itemI found in JOHTO.
entries.translation:
喔！
居然从城都远道而来啊！ 嗯，真令人怀念啊。
我年轻的时候也在城都进行过训练家修行。 我觉得我们很聊得来。
就把我在城都发现的羽毛送给你好了！

entries.label: PewterCityGrampsText_GotSilverWing
entries.english:
Going to new, un-
known places andseeing new people… Those are the joys
of travel.
entries.translation:
去各种各样的地方，
经历各种各样的事情。这就是旅行的乐趣所在。

entries.label: PewterCityMtMoonGiftShopSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… MT.MOON GIFT SHOP
NOW OPEN!
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ 月见山礼品店
隆重开业！

entries.label: PewterCitySignText
entries.english:
PEWTER CITY
A Stone Gray City
entries.translation:
这里是深灰市。
深灰即是磐石的灰黑之色。

entries.label: PewterCityWelcomeSignText
entries.english:
WELCOME TO
PEWTER CITY!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到深灰市！

entries.label: PewterGymSignText
entries.english:
PEWTER CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: BROCK The Rock Solid
#MON Trainer
entries.translation:
深灰市宝可梦道馆
馆主：小刚如岩石般强大的男人。

entries.label: PewterMuseumSignText
entries.english:
There's a notice
here… PEWTER MUSEUM OF
SCIENCE is closedfor renovations…
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ 由于正在进行改装，
深灰科学博物馆闭馆中。

entries.label: BrockBoulderBadgeText
entries.english:
BROCK: {PLAYER},
thanks. I enjoyed battling you, even
though I am a bitupset. That BOULDERBADGE
will make your #MON even more
powerful.
entries.translation:
小刚：谢谢你，
{PLAYER}！让我痛快地打了一场！ 有了我的灰色徽章，
你的宝可梦会变得更加强大哦。让人不太甘心呢！

entries.label: BrockFightDoneText
entries.english:
BROCK: The world
is huge. There are still many strong
trainers like you. Just wait and see.
I'm going to be-come a lot strong-er too.
entries.translation:
小刚：这个世界很大……
像你这样强大的训练家一定多不胜数。 我也要成为更更更
强大的训练家啊！

entries.label: BrockIntroText
entries.english:
BROCK: Wow, it's
not often that we get a challenger
from JOHTO. I'm BROCK, the
PEWTER GYM LEADER. I'm an expert on
rock-type #MON. My #MON are im-
pervious to most physical attacks.
You'll have a hard time inflicting
any damage. Come on!
entries.translation:
小刚：真少见，
居然有城都来的挑战者！ 我是深灰宝可梦道馆的
道馆馆主——小刚！我是岩石属性的专家！ 太慢太柔弱的攻击
对我的宝可梦来说完全不痛不痒！ 尽管上吧！

entries.label: BrockWinLossText
entries.english:
BROCK: Your #-
MON's powerful at-tacks overcame myrock-hard defense… You're stronger
than I expected… Go ahead--take
this BADGE.
entries.translation:
小刚：……攻势真猛烈，
令我防不胜防啊……完全超出我的想象……！ 好吧，
拿走这枚徽章吧！

entries.label: CamperJerryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Hey, you! Trainer
from JOHTO! BROCK is tough. He'll
punish you if you don't take him
seriously.
entries.translation:
小刚很强的！
一不小心就会让你吃苦头。别大意啊，城都训练家！

entries.label: CamperJerryBeatenText
entries.english:
I have to win
these battles…
entries.translation: 对战必须获胜……

entries.label: CamperJerrySeenText
entries.english:
The trainers of
this GYM use rock-type #MON. The rock-type has
high DEFENSE. Battles could end
up going a long time. Are you
ready for this?
entries.translation:
这间道馆的训练家
擅长使用岩石宝可梦！ 因为岩石属性
拥有惊人的防御力！ 接下来会是持久战哦！
做好心理准备吧！

entries.label: PewterGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! You're really rocking.
Are you battling the GYM LEADERS of
KANTO? They're strong and
dedicated people, just like JOHTO's
GYM LEADERS.
entries.translation:
嗨～未来的冠军！
看起来状况不错嘛！ 你正在挑战
关都的道馆馆主吗？ 他们都不太好对付哦，
绝不会比城都逊色！

entries.label: PewterGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! That GYM didn't give you
much trouble. The way you took
charge was really inspiring. I mean
that seriously.
entries.translation:
不愧是未来的冠军！
这是场有惊无险的对战！我好感动啊，真的！

entries.label: ReceivedBoulderBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
BOULDERBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从小刚那里
得到了灰色徽章！

entries.label: PewterMartSuperNerdText
entries.english:
There once was a
weird old man whosold MAGIKARP. He was saying the
MAGIKARP from the LAKE OF RAGE were
excellent.
entries.translation:
以前有个奇怪的大叔
在兜售宝可梦。 他说愤怒之湖里的
鲤鱼王特别好。

entries.label: PewterMartYoungsterText
entries.english:
Hi! Check out my
GYARADOS! I raised it from a
MAGIKARP. I can't believe how strong
it has become.
entries.translation:
看，我的暴鲤龙！ 我从鲤鱼王开始培育的，
现在已经这么强了！

entries.label: PewterNidoranSpeechHouseSuperNerdText
entries.english: NIDORAN, shake!
entries.translation: 尼多朗，握手！

entries.label: PewterNidoranText
entries.english: NIDORAN: Gau gau!
entries.translation: 尼多朗：嘎噢，嘎噢！

entries.label: PewterJigglypuffText
entries.english:
JIGGLYPUFF: Puu
pupuu.
entries.translation: 胖丁：胖～胖胖～～

entries.label: PewterPokecenter1FBugCatcherText
entries.english:
Most #MON get
drowsy if they hear a JIGGLYPUFF
singing. There are several
moves that can be used only while a
#MON is asleep.
entries.translation:
只要听到胖丁的歌声……
大多数的宝可梦都会犯困。 不过有几种招式
可以在睡梦中使出哦！

entries.label: PewterPokecenter1FTeacherText
entries.english:
…Yeah, and the
GYM in CINNABAR's gone. I was really
amazed. …Yes? I'm on the
phone. Go away!
entries.translation:
那个，那个……
红莲镇的道馆没了呢！人家真的超级惊讶哦！ ……干嘛？
老娘打电话呢，别碍事！

entries.label: PewterSnoozeSpeechHouseGrampsText
entries.english:
I like snoozing
with the radio on……Zzzz…
entries.translation:
我喜欢一边听广播
一边打瞌睡……呼……呼噜呼噜……

entries.label: ComeHomeForDSTText
entries.english:
Come home to
adjust your clock for Daylight
Saving Time. By the way, do you
know how to usethe PHONE?
entries.translation:
对了，
你知道怎么使用电话吗？

entries.label: DontKnowTheInstructionsText
entries.english:
I'll read the
instructions. Turn the #GEAR
on and select thePHONE icon.
entries.translation:
那我就念说明书了。 “打开宝可装置，
选择电话图标。”

entries.label: ElmsLookingForYouText
entries.english:
Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our
neighbor, PROF. ELM, was looking
for you. He said he wanted
you to do some-thing for him. Oh! I almost for-
got! Your #MON GEAR is back from
the repair shop. Here you go!
entries.translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我们的邻居空木博士正在找你哦。 好像是有什么事情
想要拜托你。 对了！差点就忘了，
送去维修的宝可装置已经拿回来了。 给！

entries.label: HurryUpElmIsWaitingText
entries.english:
PROF.ELM is wait-
ing for you. Hurry up, baby!
entries.translation:
空木博士在叫你哦，
赶快过去吧！

entries.label: ImBehindYouText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, do it! I'm behind you all
the way!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，去吧！
妈妈会给你加油的！

entries.label: InstructionsNextText
entries.english:
Phone numbers are
stored in memory. Just choose a name
you want to call. Gee, isn't that
convenient?
entries.translation:
电话号码会
自动登录在上面，只要选择通话对象就好了。 打电话竟然这么轻松，
真是太厉害了。

entries.label: IsItDSTText
entries.english:
Is it Daylight
Saving Time now?
entries.translation:
那么现在是夏令时
对吧？

entries.label: KnowTheInstructionsText
entries.english:
Don't you just
turn the #GEAR on and select the
PHONE icon?
entries.translation:
打开宝可装置选择
电话图标就好了，对吧？

entries.label: MomGivesPokegearText
entries.english:
#MON GEAR, or
just #GEAR. It's essential if
you want to be agood trainer. Oh, the day of the
week isn't set. You mustn't forget
that!
entries.translation:
宝可梦装置，
简称宝可装置。 想成为成熟的训练家，
这是必不可少的装备哦。 哎呀？还没输入星期呢。
用之前得先输入今天是星期几。

entries.label: NeighborDayIntroText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
I'm visiting!
entries.translation:
你好啊，{PLAYER}！
我来串门了！

entries.label: NeighborMornIntroText
entries.english:
Good morning,
{PLAYER}! I'm visiting!
entries.translation:
早上好，{PLAYER}！
我来串门了！

entries.label: NeighborNiteIntroText
entries.english:
Good evening,
{PLAYER}! I'm visiting!
entries.translation:
晚上好，{PLAYER}！
我来串门了！

entries.label: NeighborText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, have you
heard? My daughter is
adamant about becoming PROF.
ELM's assistant. She really loves
#MON!
entries.translation:
对了，{PLAYER}。 我家女儿有没有
对你说过她想成为空木博士的助手？ 她真的很喜欢宝可梦呢！

entries.label: PlayersHouse1FFridgeText
entries.english:
Let's see what's
in the fridge… FRESH WATER and
tasty LEMONADE!
entries.translation:
冰箱里头…… 有好多美味之水，
还有甜～甜的果汁牛奶！

entries.label: PlayersHouse1FSinkText
entries.english:
The sink is spot-
less. Mom likes itclean.
entries.translation:
亮晶晶的水槽！
妈妈有点小洁癖。

entries.label: PlayersHouse1FStoveText
entries.english:
Mom's specialty! CINNABAR VOLCANO
BURGER!
entries.translation:
妈妈的拿手好菜！
红莲风味火山汉堡！

entries.label: PlayersHouse1FTVText
entries.english:
There's a movie on
TV: Stars dot the sky as two boys
ride on a train… I'd better get
rolling too!
entries.translation:
电视上正在放电影！
两个男孩结伴旅行，火车车窗映着群星…… ……我也该赶紧出发了！

entries.label: SoWhatWasProfElmsErrandText
entries.english:
So, what was PROF.
ELM's errand? … That does sound
challenging. But, you should be
proud that peoplerely on you.
entries.translation:
空木博士
找你有什么事？ ……………… 听起来很了不得了啊。
但是，别人有求于你，你要放在心上哦！

entries.label: PlayersRadioText1
entries.english:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK! Please tunein next time!
entries.translation:
大木博士的宝可梦讲座！
大家一定要好好收听！

entries.label: PlayersRadioText2
entries.english: #MON CHANNEL!
entries.translation: 这是宝可梦频道！

entries.label: PlayersRadioText3
entries.english:
This is DJ MARY,
your co-host!
entries.translation:
我的搭档是——
胡桃主播！

entries.label: PlayersRadioText4
entries.english:
#MON!
#MON CHANNEL…
entries.translation:
宝可梦
宝可梦频道……

entries.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText1
entries.english:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK! Please tunein next time!
entries.translation:
大木博士的宝可梦讲座！
大家一定要好好收听！

entries.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText2
entries.english: #MON CHANNEL!
entries.translation: 这是宝可梦频道！

entries.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText3
entries.english:
This is DJ MARY,
your co-host!
entries.translation:
我的搭档是——
胡桃主播！

entries.label: PlayerNeighborRadioText4
entries.english:
#MON!
#MON CHANNEL…
entries.translation:
宝可梦
宝可梦频道……

entries.label: PlayersNeighborText
entries.english:
My daughter is
adamant about becoming PROF.
ELM's assistant. She really loves
#MON! But then, so do I!
entries.translation:
我家女儿有没有
对你说过她想成为空木博士的助手？ 她真的很喜欢宝可梦呢！ 不过我也很喜欢……

entries.label: PlayersNeighborsDaughterText
entries.english:
PIKACHU is an
evolved #MON. I was amazed by
PROF.ELM's find-ings. He's so famous for
his research on#MON evolution. …sigh… I wish I could be
a researcher likehim…
entries.translation:
皮卡丘竟然是
进化过一次的宝可梦！ 看了那位空木博士的发表，
我也非常震撼！ 不愧是研究宝可梦进化的
著名的博士。 唉……我也想成为
像他那样了不起的研究员。

entries.label: Text_BattleReceptionistIntro
entries.english:
Welcome to CABLE
CLUB COLOSSEUM. You may battle a
friend here. Would you like to
battle?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦
连接俱乐部竞技场！ 您在这里可以与朋友
一起游玩宝可梦对战。 要进行对战吗？

entries.label: Text_BattleReceptionistMobile
entries.english:
Would you like to
battle over a GAME LINK cable or by
mobile phone?
entries.translation:
要用那种方式对战呢？
手机还是连接线？

entries.label: Text_BattleRoomClosed
entries.english:
I'm sorry--the
BATTLE MACHINE isbeing adjusted.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，
目前我们正在调整对战机器。

entries.label: Text_BrokeStadiumRules
entries.english:
Excuse me! For STADIUM rules,
please bring six different #MON,
excluding EGGS. The six #MON
must be different. Also, they must
not be holdingidentical items. Please come back
when you're ready.
entries.translation:
这位客人！ 按照竞技场规则，
您要带上6只不同种类的宝可梦，其中不能含有蛋。 不仅6只宝可梦的
种类要完全不同， 每只宝可梦携带的道具
也必须是不一样的。 等你做好一切准备，
请再次光临。

entries.label: Text_CantLinkToThePast
entries.english:
You can't link to
the past here.
entries.translation:
这里无法与过去
进行连接。

entries.label: Text_ChangeTheLook
entries.english:
We need to change
the look here…
entries.translation: 今天不如换个造型……

entries.label: Text_IncompatibleRooms
entries.english:
Incompatible rooms
were chosen.
entries.translation:
您和您的朋友好像
选择了不同的房间。

entries.label: Text_LikeTheLook
entries.english:
How does this
style look to you?
entries.translation:
比方说变成这个样子，
你觉得合适吗？

entries.label: Text_LinkTimedOut
entries.english:
The link has been
closed because ofinactivity. Please contact
your friend andcome again.
entries.translation:
由于等待时间过长，
我们将取消本次服务！ 等你联系到了朋友，
请再次光临！

entries.label: Text_MustSaveGame
entries.english:
Before opening the
link, you mustsave your game.
entries.translation:
进行连接之前
将写下记录。

entries.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_HereYouGo
entries.english: Here you go!
entries.translation: 请收下！

entries.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Intro
entries.english:
Hello! You're
{PLAYER}, right? I have some-
thing for you.
entries.translation:
您就是{PLAYER}吧？
这里有您的包裹。

entries.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_NoRoom
entries.english:
Oh, you have no
space for this. Stop in at any
#MON CENTER across the country
to pick it up.
entries.translation:
你带不了更多了呢。 我们的人遍布在
全国的宝可梦中心，您随时都可以来领取。

entries.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Outro
entries.english:
We hope to serve
you again.
entries.translation:
啊，签收就免了。
希望下次也能为您服务。

entries.label: Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_SaidNo
entries.english:
No? That's very
strange…
entries.translation: 哎呀，好奇怪啊……

entries.label: Text_OhPleaseWait
entries.english: Oh, please wait.
entries.translation: 啊，请你等一下！

entries.label: Text_PleaseComeAgain
entries.english: Please come again.
entries.translation: 那么，欢迎下次再来。

entries.label: Text_PleaseComeIn
entries.english: Please come in.
entries.translation:
那么，
请进房间。

entries.label: Text_PleaseComeInDuplicate
entries.english: Please come in.
entries.translation:
那么，接下来
由我为您带路。

entries.label: Text_PleaseEnter
entries.english: Please enter.
entries.translation: 那么，请往里走。

entries.label: Text_PleaseWait
entries.english: Please wait.
entries.translation: 请您耐心等待。

entries.label: Text_RejectMonWithMail
entries.english:
You can't take the
{STRBUF} thathas MAIL with you.
entries.translation:
携带了邮件的
{STRBUF}无法带入！

entries.label: Text_RejectMonWithNewMove
entries.english:
You can't take the
{STRBUF} with a{STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
携带了{STRBUF}的
{STRBUF}无法带入！

entries.label: Text_RejectNewMon
entries.english:
Sorry--{STRBUF}
can't be taken.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}
无法带入！

entries.label: Text_TemporaryStagingInLinkRoom
entries.english:
We'll put you in
the link room forthe time being.
entries.translation:
我们先将您
带到连接房间。

entries.label: Text_ThisWayToMobileRoom
entries.english:
This way to the
MOBILE ROOM.
entries.translation:
那么，我将带您
前往手机房间。

entries.label: Text_TimeCapsuleClosed
entries.english:
I'm sorry--the
TIME CAPSULE isbeing adjusted.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，
目前我们正在调整时光胶囊。

entries.label: Text_TimeCapsuleReceptionistIntro
entries.english:
Welcome to CABLE
CLUB TIME CAPSULE. You can travel to
the past and tradeyour #MON. Would you like to
trade across time?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦
连接俱乐部时光胶囊！ 您在这里可以前往过去的
世界进行宝可梦交换。 您需要使用
时光胶囊吗？

entries.label: Text_TradeReceptionistIntro
entries.english:
Welcome to CABLE
TRADE CENTER. You may trade your
#MON here witha friend. Would you like to
trade?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦
连接俱乐部交换中心！ 您在这里可以与朋友
一起进行宝可梦交换。 要进行交换吗？

entries.label: Text_TradeReceptionistMobile
entries.english:
Would you like to
trade over a GAME LINK cable or by
mobile phone?
entries.translation:
要用那种方式交换呢？
手机还是连接线？

entries.label: Text_TradeRoomClosed
entries.english:
I'm sorry--the
TRADE MACHINE isbeing adjusted.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，
目前我们正在调整连接机器。

entries.label: YourFriendIsNotReadyText
entries.english:
Your friend is not
ready.
entries.translation:
您的朋友
好像还没准备好。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text
entries.english:
It's a notice
about where MOBILE ADAPTERS are to be
used…
entries.translation:
上面写出了可以使用
移动适配器的地点。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text_MobileCenter
entries.english:
To use the TRADE
CORNER or read the #MON NEWS, you
need to phone theMOBILE CENTER. You must register
at the MOBILE CENTER before
connecting there.
entries.translation:
在交换角落进行交换时，
或者读取宝可梦新闻时， 要打电话给一个
叫做移动中心的地方。 如果想连接移动中心，
就要先在移动中心进行登录。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1Text_PokeComClub
entries.english:
There's a #COM
CLUB upstairs in any #MON
CENTER. There, you can
battle or trade with a friend far
away by using aMOBILE ADAPTER. To link up, your
friend must have the same kind of
MOBILE ADAPTER asyou.
entries.translation:
在宝可梦中心2楼的
宝可梦连接俱乐部中， 可以通过移动适配器
来和身处远方的朋友进行对战或者交换。 请和那些使用
同样规格移动适配器的朋友进行交换。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text
entries.english:
It's a notice
about using thephone…
entries.translation:
上面写出了
使用电话的时间。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text_DontUsePhone
entries.english:
If the server is
busy, it may not be possible to log
on. If so, please call
back later. If you are unable
to log on or don't understand the
error messages, call a support
center or read theinstructions.
entries.translation:
电话忙的时候，
可能会无法连接。 这时可以先退出，
稍后再拨。 如果无论如何也连不上，
或者不明白错误信息时， 请仔细阅读说明书
或者咨询服务中心。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2Text_UsePhone
entries.english:
Please ensure that
your phone and MOBILE ADAPTER are
properly linked. Please make sure
the wireless phonesignal is strong. Don't touch or
hang up the phonewhile linking.
entries.translation:
请确保电话已经
连接到移动适配器， 请去容易接收信号的地方
进行连接。 连接时请不要触摸按键，
以免电话挂断。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer3Text
entries.english:
The ADMINISTRATION
OFFICE received ane-mail. It says… …… …… …… To the #COM
CENTER staff… Wireless communi-
cation has enabled #MON trainers
to interact across the nation. Let's
keep working for the day when all
the trainers in the world can link
without barriers! …… …… ……
entries.translation:
管理室收到了一封邮件！ …… …… …… “致
宝可梦对话中心的员工 通过无线电连接技术，
现在终于可以和全国的宝可梦训练家进行交流了！ 请你们继续努力！
我相信未来终有一天，所有的宝可梦训练家都能进行连接！ …… …… ……

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist1Text
entries.english:
#COM CENTER and
MOBILE CENTER were built to satisfy
demands for trades and battles with
trainers far away and with total
strangers.
entries.translation:
之所以建立移动中心和
宝可梦对话中心 是因为有很多人希望
自己可以和那些身在远方的训练家或者不认识的训练家进行对战或交换。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist2Text
entries.english:
When you linked
with someone by mobile phone for
the first time, weren't you
impressed? When my first try
worked, I was so impressed that I
got the shakes!
entries.translation:
第一次通过移动设备
连接成功的那一刻，一定很感动吧？ 连接实验
第一次成功的时候，我们也激动得不得了。

entries.label: PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist3Text
entries.english:
They were able to
build this huge facility thanks to
advances in wire-less technology.
entries.translation:
能建成这么大的设施，
也是多亏了无线通讯技术取得了很大进展呢。

entries.label: PokemonFanClubBayleefText
entries.english: BAYLEEF: Li liif!
entries.translation: 月桂叶：叶，叶！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubBraggingSignText
entries.english:
If someone brags,
brag right back!
entries.translation:
如果有人跟你炫耀，
你就10倍炫耀回去吧！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanDidYouVisitToHearAboutMyMonText
entries.english:
I'm the CHAIRMAN
of the #MON FANCLUB. I've raised over
150 #MON. I'm very fussy
when it comes to#MON. Did you visit just
to hear about my#MON?
entries.translation:
宝可梦发烧友俱乐部的会长
正是老夫！ 老夫手里的宝可梦
已经超过了150只！ 要老夫说起宝可梦的事，
那可三天三夜都说不完哇！ 你一定是来倾听老夫炫耀
那些赞赞的宝可梦的吧？

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanHowDisappointingText
entries.english:
How disappointing… Come back if you
want to listen.
entries.translation:
什么嘛，真没意思……
等你想听的时候再来吧！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanIWantYouToHaveThisText
entries.english:
Thanks for hearing
me out. I want youto have this!
entries.translation:
你听老夫称赞宝可梦
听得还挺有耐心的哇！……收下老夫的一点心意！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanItsARareCandyText
entries.english:
It's a RARE CANDY
that makes #MONstronger. I prefer making my
#MON stronger by battling, so
you can have it.
entries.translation:
这是能让宝可梦变强的
神奇糖果哇！ 一起战斗，
慢慢变强。老夫也很喜欢呢。 那个糖就给你吧！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanMoreTalesToTellText
entries.english:
Hello, {PLAYER}! Did you come see
me about my #-MON again? No? Oh… I had more
tales to tell…
entries.translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}！ 又想来听老夫介绍
引以为豪的宝可梦了吧！ ……啥？不是？
什么嘛……真没意思……

entries.label: PokemonFanClubChairmanRapidashText
entries.english:
Good!
Then listen up! So… my favorite
RAPIDASH… It… cute… lovely…
smart… unbearably…plus… amazing… oh…you think so?…Too much… wild…beautiful… kindly…love it! Hug it… when…
sleeping… warm andcuddly… Oh, and…spectacular…ravishing… simplydivine…Oops! Look at thetime! I've keptyou too long!
entries.translation:
果然是吧！
那老夫就开始喽！ 那啥……那就先介绍
老夫钟爱的烈焰马吧…… ……它呀……就是……
…… ……可爱的唷……了不得哇……唔…………而且它啊……已经……棒棒…… ……的…………你也这么觉得吗…………哈——！ …… ……抱一抱唷……
它睡觉的时候哇……洗澡的时候也…………对吧！…… ………… ……艺术品啊……！…… 优美到飞天………… ……哎哟！已经这个点了！老夫说得太多喽！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyDollText
entries.english:
It's a CLEFAIRY!
Huh? Oh, right. It's a
CLEFAIRY #DOLL.
entries.translation:
是皮皮！
……？ 原来只是皮皮玩偶！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyClefairyIsSoAdorableText
entries.english:
I love the way
CLEFAIRY waggles its finger when
it's trying to use METRONOME.
It's so adorable!
entries.translation:
只要一想起
那个挥指的动作……呜呜——！皮皮太可爱了吧！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyGoingToGetARealClefairyText
entries.english:
You watch. I'm
going to get a real CLEFAIRY as
my friend.
entries.translation:
我一定要和真正的皮皮
成为朋友！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyMakingDoWithADollIFoundText
entries.english:
I love CLEFAIRY,
but I could never catch one. So I'm
making do with a # DOLL that I
found.
entries.translation:
我特别喜欢皮皮，
但是怎么也捉不到。 实在是很无奈。
只好先用捡到的皮皮玩偶忍耐一下了……

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyPackIsJammedFullText
entries.english:
Your PACK is
jammed full.
entries.translation:
你的背包
已经装不下了！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyTakeThisDollBackToGirlText
entries.english:
Oh, I see now. The
girl who lost this # DOLL is sad… OK. Could you take
this # DOLL back to that poor
little girl? I'll befriend a
real CLEFAIRY on my own one day.
No worries!
entries.translation:
这样啊，
遗失这个玩偶的女孩子现在很难过吗…… 我明白了！
请你帮我把皮皮玩偶还给那个姑娘吧！ 我要用自己的力量
与皮皮成为朋友！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubListenSignText
entries.english:
Let's all listen
politely to othertrainers.
entries.translation:
请静心聆听训练家
炫耀他们的宝可梦！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubPlayerReceivedDollText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
# DOLL.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
暂时保管了皮皮玩偶！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubReceptionistText
entries.english:
Our CHAIRMAN is
very vocal when itcomes to #MON…
entries.translation:
我们会长
对宝可梦十分讲究！

entries.label: PokemonFanClubTeacherText
entries.english:
Look at my darling
BAYLEEF! The leaf on its
head is so cute!
entries.translation:
你看、你看！
我的月桂叶！ 头上的叶子
真可爱啊！

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide1GeneratorUpAndRunningText
entries.english:
The generator's up
and running. It's making electricity
to spare.
entries.translation:
现在，每天都能输出
大量的电力！

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide1SomeoneStoleAPartText
entries.english:
Someone made off
with a part that's essential for the
generator. Without it, the
new generator'suseless!
entries.translation:
发电机的零件
被别人偷走了！ 缺了那个零件的话，
新型发电机就废了！

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide2GeneratorIsRunningAgainText
entries.english:
The generator's
running again!
entries.translation:
发电机终于可以
顺利地启动了！

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide2PowerPlantUpAndRunningText
entries.english:
This POWER PLANT
had been abandonedin the past. We got it back up
and running to provide power to
the MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.translation:
这里曾经是一座
无人发电厂。 后来为了给磁浮列车
提供足够的电量，就把它改建了。

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide4MagnetTrainConsumesElectricityText
entries.english:
The MAGNET TRAIN
consumes a lot ofelectricity. It can't move if
the new generatorisn't operating.
entries.translation:
毕竟磁浮列车
需要消耗大量电力。 如果新型发电机不能运作，
磁浮列车就只能一直停着。

entries.label: PowerPlantGymGuide4WeCanGetMagnetTrainRunningText
entries.english:
All right! We can
finally get the MAGNET TRAIN
running again.
entries.translation:
磁浮列车
终于可以再次运营了！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerIWontForgiveCulpritText
entries.english:
MANAGER: I won't
forgive him! The culprit can
cry and apologize, but I'll still
hammer him! Gahahahah!
entries.translation:
厂长：我绝不原谅犯人！
就算哭着求我也没用！嘎哈、哈、哈……！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerMyBelovedGeneratorText
entries.english:
MANAGER: My be-
loved generator! Keep pumping the
electricity out!
entries.translation:
厂长：我的发电机！
源源不断地输出电力！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerTM07IsZapCannonText
entries.english:
MANAGER: TM07 is
my ZAP CANNON. It's a powerful
technique! It's not what any-
one would consider accurate, but it
packs a wallop!
entries.translation:
厂长：招式学习器07是
我的必杀电磁炮！这招式非常带劲儿！ 虽然不太好打中……
但它威力大啊！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerTakeThisTMText
entries.english:
Wahah! Thanks! Here! Take this TM
as a reward!
entries.translation:
小英雄！！
太谢谢你了！为表示感谢，请收下这个招式学习器！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerThatsThePartText
entries.english:
MANAGER: Ah! Yeah! That's the missing
PART from my be-loved generator!You found it?
entries.translation:
厂长：哦、哦、哦、哦！！ 这不是我那可爱的
发电机的零件吗！是你帮我找到的吗！

entries.label: PowerPlantManagerWhoWouldRuinMyGeneratorText
entries.english:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm
ready to blastsomeone! Who would dare
ruin my generator? I spent so much
time on it! If I catch him,
he's going to get a taste of my ZAP
CANNON!
entries.translation:
厂长：不、不可原谅！ 居然敢弄坏发电机！
我的心血都付诸东流了！ 如果我抓到他，
一定要使出必杀电磁炮干他一炮——！！

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer1AThiefBrokeInText
entries.english:
A thief broke into
the POWER PLANT… What is the world
coming to?
entries.translation:
居然有小偷
悄悄混进发电厂，真是前所未闻啊……

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer1CeruleanShadyCharacterText
entries.english:
I just got word
from CERULEAN. It appears that a
shady character has been loitering
around.
entries.translation:
从华蓝市
发来了消息！ 说有个形迹可疑的男人
在城里到处溜达！

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer1CouldIAskForYourCooperationText
entries.english:
Could I ask for
your cooperation?
entries.translation:
你要是愿意的话，
能给我们帮忙吗？

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer1HaveToBeefUpSecurityText
entries.english:
We'll have to beef
up our securitypresence.
entries.translation:
从今以后
必须加强安保工作！

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenCheerfulText
entries.english:
Since the gener-
ator's been fixed, the MANAGER has
been cheerful.
entries.translation:
机器修好了，
厂长的心情也变好了！

entries.label: PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenSadAndFuriousText
entries.english:
The POWER PLANT's
MANAGER is upahead. But since someone
wrecked the gener-ator, he's beenboth sad andfurious…
entries.translation:
这前方是发电室，
厂长就在那里。自从机器坏掉后，他变得无比悲愤……

entries.label: GruntM3AfterBattleText
entries.english:
You're too strong. Our plan could be
ruined. I mustwarn the others…
entries.translation:
你太强了。 这样下去计划肯定会泡汤，
必须通知其他同伴……

entries.label: GruntM3BeatenText
entries.english:
Too strong! We
must watch you…
entries.translation:
这，这家伙好强……
其他人也要小心啊。

entries.label: GruntM3SeenText
entries.english:
We've finally
taken over theRADIO TOWER! Now everyone will
get to experience the true terror of
TEAM ROCKET! We'll show you
how scary we are!
entries.translation:
终于占领了电台！
我们要让全国领教火箭队的厉害！ 就先让你先感受感受
我们的厉害吧！

entries.label: RadioTower1FDirectoryText
entries.english:
1F RECEPTION
2F SALES 3F PERSONNEL
4F PRODUCTION 5F DIRECTOR'S
OFFICE
entries.translation:
1楼 …… 服务柜台
2楼 …… 营业部3楼 …… 总务部4楼 …… 制作室5楼 …… 局长室

entries.label: RadioTower1FLassText
entries.english:
BEN is a fabulous
DJ. His sweet voice
makes me melt!
entries.translation:
说到主播，就要提到靖史！
他那甜美的声音…… 真是令人着迷！

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyChannelSignText
entries.english:
LUCKY CHANNEL! Win with #MON
ID numbers! Trade your #MON
to collect differ-ent ID numbers!
entries.translation:
幸运频道！
你的宝可梦的ID是？ 通过交换宝可梦
来收集各种ID吧！

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManAskToPlayText
entries.english:
Hi, are you here
for the LUCKY NUM-BER SHOW? Want me to check
the ID numbers ofyour #MON? If you get lucky,
you win a prize.
entries.translation:
您好，这里是兑换处。 我们会核对您拥有的
宝可梦的ID号码，运气好的话就能得到奖品！

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManCheckIfMatchText
entries.english:
Let's see if you
have a match.
entries.translation:
那么请允许我
立刻核对一下。

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManComeAgainText
entries.english:
Please come back
next week for thenext LUCKY NUMBER.
entries.translation:
下次公布时，
期待您能再次光临。

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoRoomForYourPrizeText
entries.english:
You've got no room
for your prize. Make room and come
back right away.
entries.translation:
您的行李已经满了。
等您整理行好李之后，请尽快回来领奖。

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoneOfYourIDNumbersMatchText
entries.english:
Nope, none of your
ID numbers match.
entries.translation:
非常遗憾，
没有一位数对得上。

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManOkayMatchText
entries.english:
Hey! You've
matched the lastthree numbers! You've won second
prize, an EXP.SHARE!
entries.translation:
哇，最后3位数完全一致！
是2等奖！ 2等奖奖品是——
学习装置！

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManPerfectMatchText
entries.english:
Wow! You have a
perfect match ofall five numbers! We have a grand
prize winner! You have won a
MASTER BALL!
entries.translation:
5、5位数完全一致！
1等奖！是1等奖！ 1等奖奖品是——
大师球！

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManThisWeeksIdIsText
entries.english:
This week's ID
number is {STRBUF}.
entries.translation:
本次的ID号码是
{STRBUF}。

entries.label: RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManWeakMatchText
entries.english:
Ooh, you've
matched the lasttwo numbers. You've won third
prize, a PP UP.
entries.translation:
最后2位数完全一致！
中了3等奖！ 3等奖奖品是——
PP提升剂！

entries.label: RadioTower1FPokegearIsARadioText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}'s #GEAR
can now double asa radio!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}的宝可装置
现在可以听广播了！

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanNotTakingQuizText
entries.english:
Oh. I see. Please
see me if youchange your mind.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
等你有兴趣的话再来吧。

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanOfferQuizText
entries.english:
We have a special
quiz campaign onright now. Answer five ques-
tions correctly towin a RADIO CARD. Slide it into your
#GEAR to play the radio anytime,
anywhere. Would you like to
take the quiz?
entries.translation:
现在正在进行特别活动！ 如果能完全答对
我们提出的5个问题，我们将会奖励广播卡！ 广播卡插入宝可装置后，
随时随地都能收听广播。你想挑战一下吗？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion1Text
entries.english:
Question 1: Is there a #MON
that appears onlyin the morning?
entries.translation:
好的，第1题！ 有的宝可梦只在清晨出现
这是真的吗？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion2Text
entries.english:
Correct!
Question 2: Is this statement
correct? You can't buy a
BERRY at a MART.
entries.translation:
回答正确。
下面是第2题！ 商店里买不到树果，对吗？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion3Text
entries.english:
Bull's-eye!
Question 3: Does HM01 contain
the move FLASH?
entries.translation:
回答正确。
接着是第3题！ 秘传学习器01
是不是“间合斩”？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion4Text
entries.english:
So far so good!
Question 4: Is FALKNER the
VIOLET GYM LEADER who uses bird
#MON?
entries.translation:
又回答正确了。
那么第4题！ 桔梗市的宝可梦道馆中
擅长鸟宝可梦的馆主名字是不是“阿速”？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion5Text
entries.english:
Wow! Right again!
Here's the finalquestion: Do GOLDENROD GAME
CORNER's slots have CHARMANDER
on their reels?
entries.translation:
真厉害！
终于到最后一问了。 满金市游戏城中的
老虎机上面有没有出现小火龙的图案？

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanTuneInText
entries.english:
Please tune in to
our radio shows.
entries.translation:
希望您随时都能
收听我们的节目！

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanWrongAnswerText
entries.english:
Oh, dear.
Sorry, but you got it wrong.
Please try again!
entries.translation:
哎呀，答错了呢。
真可惜！请您再接再厉！

entries.label: RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanYouWinText
entries.english:
Bingo! You got it!
Congratulations! Here's your prize,
a RADIO CARD!
entries.translation:
全部回答正确，
恭喜您！请收下奖品——广播卡！

entries.label: RadioTower1FReceptionistNoToursText
entries.english:
Hello. I'm sorry,
but we're notoffering any tourstoday.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临……
非常抱歉，现在不能参观。

entries.label: RadioTower1FReceptionistWelcomeText
entries.english: Welcome!
entries.translation: 欢迎光临！

entries.label: RadioTower1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
I love MARY, from
#MON TALK. I only know what
she sounds like,though.
entries.translation:
我喜欢宝可梦讲座的
胡桃小姐姐哦！ ……虽然只听过她的声音。

entries.label: GruntF2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
You beat me, and
I won't forget it!
entries.translation: 居然比我还强…… 不可原谅！

entries.label: GruntF2BeatenText
entries.english: Wh-who are you?
entries.translation: 你是何方神圣！？

entries.label: GruntF2SeenText
entries.english:
Hahaha! How boring.
It was far too easy to take over
this place! Come on, keep me
amused!
entries.translation:
嚯嚯嚯！
没想到轻易就占领了这里，真没意思！ 你来陪我解解闷吧？

entries.label: GruntM4AfterBattleText
entries.english:
We won't let you
ruin our plansfor our comeback!
entries.translation:
怎么能让你一个小屁孩
妨碍我们的复活大计！

entries.label: GruntM4BeatenText
entries.english:
Gwah! Don't get
cute!
entries.translation:
咕，
这家伙一点都不可爱。

entries.label: GruntM4SeenText
entries.english:
Three years ago,
TEAM ROCKET wasforced to disband. But we're making a
comeback here!
entries.translation:
3年前，火箭队走投无路
被迫选择解散…… 但是，我们要在此宣布：
火箭队复活了！

entries.label: GruntM5AfterBattleText
entries.english:
We're not always
evil. We just dowhatever we like.
entries.translation:
别老是说
我们火箭队在做坏事！我们是在做喜欢的事！

entries.label: GruntM5BeatenText
entries.english:
You think you're a
hero?
entries.translation: 你想表演正义的伙伴？

entries.label: GruntM5SeenText
entries.english:
We're TEAM ROCKET,
the exploiters of#MON! We love being
evil! Scared?
entries.translation:
我们是——
宝可梦黑手党火箭队！专门喜欢干坏事。 哦哟，吓到了吗？

entries.label: GruntM6AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Our EXECUTIVES are
trying to takethis place over. They have some big
plan. I wonderwhat that is?
entries.translation:
干部们劫持这里
好像是要密谋什么大事，那么，究竟是要干什么呢？

entries.label: GruntM6BeatenText
entries.english: Arggh. I give up.
entries.translation: 呜呜……真没办法。

entries.label: GruntM6SeenText
entries.english:
Hey, hey! Keep out
of our way!
entries.translation:
喂喂！
不要妨碍我们啊！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBlackBelt1Text
entries.english:
Sorry. Authorized
personnel onlybeyond this point. It wasn't that way
before. There's something
wrong with theDIRECTOR…
entries.translation:
居然说上面的楼层
“闲人免入”…… 这可真是前所未闻，
局长最近很不对劲啊。

entries.label: RadioTower2FBlackBelt2Text
entries.english:
Feel free to look
around anywhere. The DIRECTOR is
nice again, justas he was before.
entries.translation:
所有地方都能自由参观。
局长终于又变回了以前那个和善的局长！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaAlreadyPlayedText
entries.english:
BUENA: Sorry… You get just one
chance each day. Come back tomorrow
for another try!
entries.translation:
葵妍：抱歉——
回答问题的机会每天只有一次。 明天再来吧！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCallMeText
entries.english:
BUENA: I look
forward to hearingfrom you!
entries.translation: 葵妍：期待你的来电！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCardIsFullText
entries.english:
BUENA: Your BLUE
CARD's full. Trade it in for a
fabulous prize!
entries.translation:
葵妍：你的点数
已经达到上限了！ 去兑换一些奖品吧！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaComeBackAfterListeningText
entries.english:
BUENA: Come back
after you listen to my show, OK?
Catch ya later!
entries.translation:
葵妍：那么，
等你听了我的节目以后，再来找我吧！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaCorrectAnswerText
entries.english:
BUENA: YIPPEE!
That's right! You did tune in!
I'm so happy! You earned one
point! Congrats!
entries.translation:
葵妍：呀——回答正确！ 你听得很认真呢！
我很高兴啊。 恭喜你，
获得了1点数！！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaDidYouForgetText
entries.english:
BUENA: Aww…
That's not it… Did you forget the
password?
entries.translation:
葵妍：啊——
真遗憾，回答错误！ 你是不是忘记密语了？

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaDoYouKnowPasswordText
entries.english:
BUENA: Hi!
Did you tune in tomy radio show? Do you remember
today's password?
entries.translation:
葵妍：你有没有听我的
广播节目呢？ 记住今天的密语了吗？

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaEveryoneSayPasswordText
entries.english:
BUENA: Everyone
ready? I want to hear you
shout out today's password for
{PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
葵妍：各位，准备好了吗！ 我们要请{PLAYER}
说出今天的密语， 那就开始吧——！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaJoinTheShowText
entries.english:
BUENA: Oh, wow!
Thank you! What was your name
again? …{PLAYER}, OK! Come on, {PLAYER}.
Join the show.
entries.translation:
葵妍：哇——非常感谢！
那个……你的名字是？ ……{PLAYER}啊！ 那么，{PLAYER}，
请你一定要参加节目哦！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaNoBlueCardText
entries.english:
BUENA: Oh? You
forgot to bringyour BLUE CARD? I can't give you
points if youdon't have it.
entries.translation:
葵妍：哎呀？
忘记把蓝卡带过来了吗？ 没有蓝卡
就不能给你点数呢……

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaOfferNumberAgainText
entries.english:
BUENA: {PLAYER},
do you want to register my phone
number?
entries.translation:
葵妍：{PLAYER}，
要添加我的电话号码吗？

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaOfferPhoneNumberText
entries.english:
BUENA: Oh! Your
BLUE CARD reached 30 points today!
That's so wild! Hmm… There isn't a
prize for hitting30 points, but… You came by so
often, {PLAYER}. I'll make you a
special deal! How would you like
my phone number?
entries.translation:
葵妍：啊！今天
你的蓝卡攒到30点数了！厉害，真厉害！ ……哎呀！
我们并没有准备30点数的奖品呢…… 难得{PLAYER}总是过来，
就给你特别奖励吧！ 葵妍的电话号码
你感兴趣吗？

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaPasswordIsHelpText
entries.english:
BUENA: Huh?
Today's password? HELP, of course!
entries.translation:
葵妍：嗯？
今天的密语？ 当然是救命啊——！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistNoCardText
entries.english:
You can't trade in
points withoutyour BLUE CARD. Don't forget your
BLUE CARD!
entries.translation:
没带蓝卡就
不能交换奖品。 下次来的时候
不要忘了蓝卡哦！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistPointsForPrizesText
entries.english:
You can cash in
your saved points for a lovely prize
of your choice!
entries.translation:
使用积攒的点数
就能在这边交换心仪的奖品！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaSadRejectedText
entries.english:
BUENA: Aww… It's a
special prize…
entries.translation:
葵妍：哎？这可是
特大福利呀……

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaShowIntroductionText
entries.english:
BUENA: Hi! I'm
BUENA! Do you know about
a radio programcalled PASSWORD? If you can tell me
the password from the program, you
will earn points. Save up those
points and trade them to that sweet
young lady over there for some
choice prizes! Here you go! It's your very own
point card!
entries.translation:
葵妍：你好，我是葵妍！ 你知道叫做“密语”的
广播节目吗？ 只要将节目中播报的
密语告诉我，就能获得点数。 积攒一定的点数，
就可以找那边的姐姐，她会给你兑换精美的奖品哦！ 对了！ 这个是
用来积攒点数的卡片！ 送给你了！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaThanksForComingText
entries.english:
BUENA: Yup! Our
contestant was {PLAYER}.
Thanks for coming! I hope all you
listeners will come too!
I'll be waiting!
entries.translation:
葵妍：好！
刚才是{PLAYER}为我们带来的精彩回答！非常感谢。 大家也要继续收听哦！
我非常期待！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInAfterSixText
entries.english:
BUENA: Tune in to
PASSWORD every night from six to
midnight! Tune in, then drop
in for a visit!
entries.translation:
葵妍：密语节目
每天午后从6点到深夜0点持续播放！ 听完后，欢迎前来访问！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInToMyShowText
entries.english:
BUENA: Tune in to
my PASSWORD SHOW!
entries.translation:
葵妍：今后也请关照
我的节目呀！

entries.label: RadioTower2FBuenaYourPhoneIsFullText
entries.english:
BUENA: {PLAYER},
your phone list has no room left
for me…
entries.translation:
葵妍：{PLAYER}，
你已经存满号码了！

entries.label: RadioTower2FOaksPKMNTalkSignText
entries.english:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK The Hottest Show
on the Air!
entries.translation:
大木博士的宝可梦讲座，
时下最火爆的广播节目！

entries.label: RadioTower2FPokemonRadioSignText
entries.english:
Anywhere, Anytime
#MON Radio
entries.translation:
随时随地都能收听——
宝可梦广播

entries.label: RadioTower2FRegisteredBuenasNumberText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} registered
BUENA's number.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}添加了
葵妍的电话号码！

entries.label: RadioTower2FSalesSignText
entries.english: 2F SALES
entries.translation: 2楼 …… 营业部

entries.label: RadioTower2FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
You can listen to
the radio any-where. Tune in!
entries.translation:
随时随地都能听广播！
随时随地都要听广播！

entries.label: RadioTower2FTeacherText
entries.english:
Lullabies on the
radio may make#MON sleep.
entries.translation:
收音机里播出的摇篮曲
也能让宝可梦睡着哦。

entries.label: RadioTower2FTeacherText_Rockets
entries.english:
Why would they
want to take overthe RADIO TOWER?
entries.translation:
他们占领广播局
到底是出于什么目的……？

entries.label: RadioTowerJigglypuffText
entries.english:
JIGGLYPUFF:
Jiggly…
entries.translation: 小胖丁：噗……噗噗……

entries.label: GruntM7AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I failed in my
duties… I'll be docked pay
for this…
entries.translation:
任务失败了……
要扣工资了……

entries.label: GruntM7BeatenText
entries.english: What?!

entries.label: GruntM7SeenText
entries.english:
I've been given
strict orders. I'm to crush any-
one who challengesTEAM ROCKET!
entries.translation:
我的任务嘛…… 就是把妨碍火箭队的人
打得站不起来！

entries.label: GruntM8AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I feel lousy over
losing! Darn it! I hate
useless #MON!
entries.translation:
失败真让人不爽！
可恶啊！这帮废物宝可梦！

entries.label: GruntM8BeatenText
entries.english: You're kidding!
entries.translation: ……什么！

entries.label: GruntM8SeenText
entries.english:
It feels great
ordering #MONto commit crimes.
entries.translation:
下令让宝可梦干坏事，
感觉超级爽！

entries.label: GruntM9AfterBattleText
entries.english:
What?! You made it
past our men inthe UNDERGROUND? How could you?
entries.translation:
什么！
竟然突破了地下通道！？你到底是什么来头！

entries.label: GruntM9BeatenText
entries.english: I'm done for!
entries.translation: 被打败了。

entries.label: GruntM9SeenText
entries.english:
Why did the shut-
ter open? Did you have something to
do with this?
entries.translation:
卷帘门开了？怎么回事？
是因为你小子吗？

entries.label: InsertedTheCardKeyText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} inserted
the CARD KEY.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}插入了
钥匙卡！

entries.label: RadioTower3FCardKeySlotText
entries.english:
It's the CARD KEY
slot.
entries.translation: 有钥匙卡的插口！

entries.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFIsDirectorSafeText
entries.english:
Is the DIRECTOR
safe?
entries.translation: 局长没事吧？

entries.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFItsSunnyDayText
entries.english:
It's SUNNY DAY.
It powers up fire-type moves for awhile.
entries.translation:
里面是大晴天。
使用一次后，火属性的威力会暂时提高。

entries.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFPleaseSaveDirectorText
entries.english:
The TEAM ROCKET
boss has lockedhimself in. But the DIRECTOR
can open it. He's up on the
fifth floor. Please save him!
entries.translation:
这帮家伙的老大
锁在门里面不出来。 就算是从内部上锁，
局长也有办法打开！ 局长现在在5楼！
求你了，去救救他吧！

entries.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFYouWereMarvelousText
entries.english:
You were simply
marvelous!
entries.translation: 你的表现真是出色！

entries.label: RadioTower3FCooltrainerFYoureMyHeroText
entries.english:
Thank you!
You're my hero! This is a token of
my appreciation.
entries.translation:
谢谢你，小英雄！
这是我送的谢礼！

entries.label: RadioTower3FGymGuideText
entries.english:
We run 24 hours a
day to broadcast entertaining pro-
grams. I'll do my best to
run around theclock too!
entries.translation:
我们全天候营业！ 为了让大家随时都能
拥有愉快的节目体验，我也会努力一整天！

entries.label: RadioTower3FGymGuideText_Rockets
entries.english:
To trainers, #-
MON are theirbeloved partners. It's terrible how
TEAM ROCKET is trying to control
#MON.
entries.translation:
对训练家而言，
宝可梦是重要的搭档。 竟然有人粗暴地使唤它们，
宝可梦也太可怜了！

entries.label: RadioTower3FPersonnelSignText
entries.english: 3F PERSONNEL
entries.translation: 3楼 …… 总务部

entries.label: RadioTower3FPokemonMusicSignText
entries.english:
#MON MUSIC with
Host DJ BEN
entries.translation:
宝可梦音乐台
由我靖史主持啦。

entries.label: RadioTower3FSuperNerdText
entries.english:
We have recordings
of the cries of all #MON that
have been found. We must have about
200 kinds.
entries.translation:
完全收录了迄今发现的
所有宝可梦叫声！共计200多种呢！

entries.label: ScientistMarcAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Bwahahaha… I can transmit as
strong a signal asI need from here.
entries.translation:
咳咳咳……在这个地方
可以随心所欲地发射电波。

entries.label: ScientistMarcBeatenText
entries.english:
Tch! I took you
too lightly!
entries.translation:
切，
我太小看你了。

entries.label: ScientistMarcSeenText
entries.english:
An unknown child
wandering here? Who are you?
entries.translation:
这陌生小孩鬼鬼祟祟的……
你是来干嘛的！？

entries.label: Executivem2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
You've earned my
respect, so here'ssome advice. It's not too late.
You can still turnback.
entries.translation:
你是个值得尊重的人，
我想给你一句忠告： 现在回头还来得及，
望自珍重……

entries.label: Executivem2BeatenText
entries.english:
The fortress came
down!
entries.translation: 堡垒沦陷……

entries.label: Executivem2SeenText
entries.english:
Stop! I'm known as
the TEAM ROCKETfortress! You're not taking
another step!
entries.translation:
且慢！我被人称为
“火箭队堡垒”！你别想再前进一步！

entries.label: GruntF4AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I love my
beautiful self! Who cares about
#MON?
entries.translation:
我自己最可爱！
宝可梦就算了吧！

entries.label: GruntF4BeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, no! They're so
useless!
entries.translation:
够了！
真是没用！

entries.label: GruntF4SeenText
entries.english:
Don't I think
#MON are cute? I'll think my
#MON are cute-- after they beat
yours!
entries.translation:
你问我宝可梦可不可爱？
嗯，如果能在这击败你的宝可梦，那就能算可爱！

entries.label: GruntM10AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I don't believe
it! I was beaten!
entries.translation:
怎么回事！
被打倒的居然是我！

entries.label: GruntM10BeatenText
entries.english: No! Unbelievable!
entries.translation: 我的天呐！

entries.label: GruntM10SeenText
entries.english:
You plan to rescue
the DIRECTOR? That won't be pos-
sible because I'mgoing to beat you!
entries.translation:
你打算救局长？
这可不太现实啊。因为我会在这打倒你！

entries.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText
entries.english:
MARY: Why? Why do
I have to sufferthrough this? MEOWTH, help me!
entries.translation:
胡桃；为什么……
会变成这样啊……？ 小喵喵，救救我——！

entries.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_After
entries.english:
MARY: Please tune
into me on PROF. OAK'S #MON TALK
show.
entries.translation:
胡桃：要听我和大木博士
的宝可梦讲座哦！

entries.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_ClearedRockets
entries.english:
MARY: Oh! You're
my little savior! Will you take this
as my thanks?
entries.translation:
胡桃：啊——
是你救了我！ 那就请你收下这个，
算是我的心意！

entries.label: RadioTower4FDJMaryText_GivePinkBow
entries.english:
MARY: It's just
right for #MON that know normal-
type moves.
entries.translation:
胡桃：这个东西呢，
好像很适合那些能使出一般属性招式的宝可梦！

entries.label: RadioTower4FFisherText
entries.english:
I listened to the
radio while I wasat the RUINS. I heard a strange
broadcast there.
entries.translation:
我去遗迹里玩的时候，
在收音机里面听到了奇怪的广播。

entries.label: RadioTower4FProductionSignText
entries.english: 4F PRODUCTION
entries.translation: 4楼 …… 制作室

entries.label: RadioTower4FStudio2SignText
entries.english: 4F STUDIO 2
entries.translation: 4楼 …… 第2工作室

entries.label: RadioTowerMeowthText
entries.english: MEOWTH: Meowth…
entries.translation: 喵喵：……喵嗷。

entries.label: ScientistRichAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Do you honestly
believe you canstop TEAM ROCKET?
entries.translation:
你以为你这样的小鬼
真的能撼动火箭队吗？

entries.label: ScientistRichBeatenText
entries.english:
Hmmm… All grand plans
come with snags.
entries.translation:
哎呀呀，
正所谓“好事多磨”，伟大的计划总会遇上麻烦。

entries.label: ScientistRichSeenText
entries.english:
Most excellent. This RADIO TOWER
will fulfill ourgrand design.
entries.translation:
太妙了！ 有了这座电台，
我们的野心终于能实现了！

entries.label: BenText
entries.english:
BEN: Do you listen
to our music?
entries.translation: 靖史：你爱听音乐吗？

entries.label: Executivef1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, isn't it? A brat like you
won't appreciate the magnificence
of TEAM ROCKET. That's too bad.
I really admireyour power.
entries.translation:
你叫{PLAYER}吧？ 像你这样的孩子
应该无法理解我们的优越之处。 真遗憾呢，
我原本还很欣赏你的实力。

entries.label: Executivef1BeatenText
entries.english:
This can't be
happening! I fought hard, but
I still lost…
entries.translation:
……！ 明明全力应战了……
怎么还是输了……

entries.label: Executivef1SeenText
entries.english:
Remember me from
the HIDEOUT inMAHOGANY TOWN? I lost then, but I
won't this time.
entries.translation:
哎呀！
这可真是冤家路窄！ 在卡吉镇基地是我输了，
但这次不会重蹈覆辙！

entries.label: FakeDirectorTextAfter
entries.english:
We stashed the
real DIRECTOR in the UNDERGROUND
WAREHOUSE. It's at the far
end of the UNDER-GROUND. But I doubt you'll
get that far.
entries.translation:
真正的局长…… 被关在地下仓库里！ 知道地下仓库吗？
在地下通道深之又深处。你大概到不了那里吧……

entries.label: FakeDirectorTextBefore1
entries.english:
Y-you! You came to
rescue me?
entries.translation:
好、好心人！
你是来救我的，对吗……

entries.label: FakeDirectorTextBefore2
entries.english:
Is that what you
were expecting? Wrong!
I'm an imposter! I pretended to be
the real thing to prepare for our
takeover. Do you want to
know where we hidthe real DIRECTOR? Sure, I'll tell
you. But only ifyou can beat me!
entries.translation:
很期待这句台词吧！
本大爷在给你演戏呢！ 为了顺利劫持电台，
我特意假扮成真货！ 哈——哈哈，你一定
很想知道局长在哪吧！ 我当然可以告诉你啊。
如果你能赢我的话！

entries.label: FakeDirectorWinText
entries.english:
OK, OK. I'll tell
you where he is.
entries.translation:
明，明白了……
这就告诉你局长在哪。

entries.label: RadioTower5FDirectorDescribeClearBellText
entries.english:
There used to be a
tower right herein GOLDENROD CITY. But it was old and
creaky. So we replaced it
with our RADIOTOWER. We dug up that
bell duringconstruction. I heard that all
sorts of #MON lived in GOLDENROD
in the past. Perhaps… That bell has some
connection to the TIN TOWER in
ECRUTEAK CITY… Ah! That reminds me… I overheard TEAM
ROCKET whispering. Apparently, some-
thing is going onat the TIN TOWER. I have no idea
what is happening, but you might look
into it. OK, I better go to
my OFFICE.
entries.translation:
过去满金市也有一座塔。
因为太过古老，成了危房。于是就改建成了电台。 施工的时候，
人们挖开地面发现了这个铃铛。 据说啊，
以前有很多宝可梦在满金市栖息。 说不定…… 这个铃铛，
和缘朱市的铃铛塔具有某种关联。 啊！ 说起来…… 刚才我听到
火箭队的人闲聊， 说铃铛塔里面
发生了什么事情。 我也没个头绪，
你最好去看看吧。 那么，
我就先回局长室了。

entries.label: RadioTower5FDirectorText
entries.english:
DIRECTOR: Hello,
{PLAYER}! You know, I love
#MON. I built this RADIO
TOWER so I could express my love
of #MON. It would be nice
if people enjoyedour programs.
entries.translation:
局长：{PLAYER}，
我非常非常喜欢宝可梦。所以才想到通过广播来传播这份心意。 如果节目让人喜闻乐见，
那我就太高兴了。

entries.label: RadioTower5FDirectorThankYouText
entries.english:
DIRECTOR: {PLAYER},
thank you! Your courageous
actions have saved #MON nation-
wide. I know it's not
much, but pleasetake this.
entries.translation:
局长：啊，{PLAYER}！
真是太感谢你了。 你的奋勇表现
拯救了全国的宝可梦。 这是我一点点心意，
希望你不要嫌弃啊。

entries.label: RadioTower5FDirectorsOfficeSignText
entries.english:
5F DIRECTOR'S
OFFICE
entries.translation: 5楼 …… 局长室

entries.label: RadioTower5FRocketBossAfterText
entries.english:
How could this be? Our dreams have
come to naught. I wasn't up to the
task after all. Like GIOVANNI did
before me, I will disband TEAM
ROCKET here today. Farewell.
entries.translation:
……啊啊，这是怎么回事！ 我们的梦想
如今全部破灭了！ 我还是不够格吗…… 没办法，
只能效仿坂木老大了。我宣布：我们火箭队在此解散！ 再见了。

entries.label: RadioTower5FRocketBossBeforeText
entries.english:
Oh? You managed to
get this far? You must be quite
the trainer. We intend to take
over this RADIO STATION and an-
nounce our come-back. That should bring
our boss GIOVANNI back from his solo
training. We are going to
regain our formerglory. I won't allow you
to interfere withour plans.
entries.translation:
了不起，居然能到这里。 你一定是一位
相当优秀的训练家。 我们之所以劫持广播局，
是为了向全国宣布火箭队的复活。 这样一来，
在外修行的坂木老大肯定也会回到我们身边。 这次一定要
重现昔日的荣光……你别想妨碍我们！

entries.label: RadioTower5FRocketBossWinText
entries.english:
No! Forgive me,
GIOVANNI!
entries.translation:
唔……
坂木老大，请原谅我……

entries.label: RadioTower5FStudio1SignText
entries.english: 5F STUDIO 1
entries.translation: 5楼 …… 第1工作室

entries.label: RedsHouse1FTVText
entries.english:
They have programs
that aren't shownin JOHTO…
entries.translation:
正在播放在城都
从来没听过的节目……！

entries.label: RedsMomText1
entries.english:
Hi! RED's been away
for a long time. He hasn't called
either, so I have no idea where he
is or what he'sbeen doing. They say that no
word is proof that he's doing fine,
but I do worryabout him.
entries.translation:
你好！ 赤红一直在外旅行，
已经有很长时间没有联系过家里了。他现在在哪里做什么呢…… 虽然俗话说
没有消息就是好消息，但我还是很担心啊。

entries.label: RedsMomText2
entries.english:
I worry about RED
getting hurt or sick, but he's a
boy. I'm proud that he is doing
what he wants to do.
entries.translation:
很担心他有没有伤病，
男孩子要爱惜身体啊！

entries.label: RedsHouse2FN64Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} played the
N64. Better get going--
no time to lose!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
正在玩神游机！…… …… 好了！也该出发了！

entries.label: RedsHouse2FPCText
entries.english:
It looks like it
hasn't been usedin a long time…
entries.translation:
……好像有很长的时间
没有被人使用过了。

entries.label: CooltrainerfQuinnAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You're strong. You obviously must
have trained hard.
entries.translation:
你好强啊。
经历过很长久的修行吧。

entries.label: CooltrainerfQuinnBeatenText
entries.english: Down and out…
entries.translation: 输了……！

entries.label: CooltrainerfQuinnSeenText
entries.english:
You there!
Want to battle?
entries.translation:
你等等！
和我来场对战吧？

entries.label: Route1SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 1 PALLET TOWN -
VIRIDIAN CITY
entries.translation:
这里是1号道路
真新镇   ……   常青市

entries.label: SchoolboyDannyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
For trainers, it's
a given that we'll battle whenever we
meet.
entries.translation:
对训练家来说，
对战也是一种问候。

entries.label: SchoolboyDannyBeatenText
entries.english:
Awww… I've got a
losing record…
entries.translation: 输掉了——！

entries.label: SchoolboyDannySeenText
entries.english:
If trainers meet,
the first thing todo is battle.
entries.translation:
只要碰到训练家，
来场对战就对了！

entries.label: PowerPlantSignText
entries.english: KANTO POWER PLANT
entries.translation: 这里是关都发电厂

entries.label: Route10Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
When you go out-
side, you can see the roof of a big
building. That's the POWER
PLANT.
entries.translation:
站在外面不是能看到
建筑物的屋顶吗？那就是发电厂哦！

entries.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
A #MON CENTER
near a cave? That's mighty
convenient.
entries.translation:
难得有宝可梦中心建在
洞窟附近，真令人高兴。

entries.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText
entries.english:
The POWER PLANT's
MANAGER is looking for a strong #-
MON trainer. He needs help
getting back something that
was stolen.
entries.translation:
发电厂的厂长
正在寻找强大的训练家。 听说他想把
小偷偷走的东西拿回来。

entries.label: Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
I hear TEAM ROCKET
got back together in JOHTO but fell
apart right away. I didn't know any-
thing about that.
entries.translation:
我听说，
火箭队在城都复活了。然后好像又光速解散了。 真的假的啊！

entries.label: HikerJimAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Hay fever is
making me sneeze!Ahahah-CHOO!
entries.translation:
嘻——嘻、嘻、嘻！
……哈嘻、哈嘻嘻……

entries.label: HikerJimBeatenText
entries.english: Hahaha-hachoo!
entries.translation:
哈——哈、哈、哈！
嘻——嘻、嘻、嘻！不小心吃了笑菇！

entries.label: HikerJimSeenText
entries.english: Hahahah!
entries.translation: 哈——哈、哈、哈、哈！

entries.label: PokefanmRobertAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Look what you did
to my #MON… I won't forget
this…
entries.translation:
我宝贵的宝可梦们……
我不会忘记你的……

entries.label: PokefanmRobertBeatenText
entries.english:
I'd have to say
that's my loss.
entries.translation:
这也就是说
我输了吧！

entries.label: PokefanmRobertSeenText
entries.english:
You like #MON,
don't you? Me too!
entries.translation:
您很喜欢宝可梦吧？
我也非常喜欢！

entries.label: Route10SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 10 CERULEAN CITY -
LAVENDER TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是10号道路
华蓝市   ……   紫苑镇

entries.label: PsychicFidelAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Strength in con-
viction… You're strong be-
cause you believein your #MON.
entries.translation:
信赖的力量…… 因为你信赖着宝可梦，
所以才会这么强吗……

entries.label: PsychicFidelBeatenText
entries.english:
I couldn't foresee
your power…
entries.translation:
你的实力，
高深莫测……

entries.label: PsychicFidelSeenText
entries.english:
I can see it… Everything to see
about you…
entries.translation:
我能看到……
你的全部……

entries.label: PsychicHermanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
… I lost while I had
my eyes closed…
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 一直闭着眼睛，
不知怎么就输掉了……

entries.label: Route11SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 11
entries.translation: 这里是11号道路

entries.label: YoungsterJasonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm going to catch
more #MON inthe grass.
entries.translation:
我要在草丛里
捉到更多宝可梦！

entries.label: YoungsterJasonBeatenText
entries.english:
Aiyaaah!
I got stomped!
entries.translation:
呜呜——，
输掉了——！

entries.label: YoungsterJasonSeenText
entries.english:
It itches and
tickles a bit when I wear shorts in
the grass.
entries.translation:
只要穿短裤走在草丛里，
就会被树叶弄得又刺又痒！

entries.label: YoungsterOwenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I fought fair and
square with honor. I don't regret
this at all.
entries.translation:
因为堂堂正正地战斗了！
所以我绝不后悔！

entries.label: YoungsterOwenBeatenText
entries.english:
Huh? How did this
happen?
entries.translation:
哎呀？
这不可能呀……

entries.label: YoungsterOwenSeenText
entries.english:
There's no cheat-
ing in #MON. Let's keep it fair
and square!
entries.translation:
绝不能对宝可梦使诈！
要堂堂正正地对战！

entries.label: FisherBarneyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I think electric-
ity is the most important thing in
our daily lives. If it weren't,
people wouldn't have made such a
fuss when the POWER PLANT went
out of commission.
entries.translation:
我觉得嘛，
答案是电力！ 不然，发电厂无法运作
也不会给我们带来这么大的恐慌。

entries.label: FisherBarneyBeatenText
entries.english:
The answer is
coming up next!
entries.translation: 答案稍后揭晓！

entries.label: FisherBarneySeenText
entries.english:
What's most impor-
tant in our every-day lives?
entries.translation:
在我们的日常生活中
什么东西最重要？

entries.label: FisherKyleAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The tug you feel
on the ROD when you hook a #-
MON… That's the best
feeling ever foran angler like me.
entries.translation:
垂钓宝可梦时，
钓竿上的那种感触！就是垂钓的乐趣所在啊！

entries.label: FisherKyleBeatenText
entries.english: You do remember?
entries.translation: 真能体会到吗——！？

entries.label: FisherKyleSeenText
entries.english: Do you remember?
entries.translation: 你能体会到吧……！？

entries.label: FisherMartinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm too impatient
for fishing…
entries.translation:
我这种急性子，
或许不适合钓鱼……

entries.label: FisherMartinBeatenText
entries.english: Gwaaah!
entries.translation: 忍！忍！

entries.label: FisherMartinSeenText
entries.english:
Patience is the
key to both fish-ing and #MON.
entries.translation:
钓鱼要有耐心！
对宝可梦也要有耐心！

entries.label: FisherStephenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Have you checked
out KANTO's radio programs? We get a
good variety here.
entries.translation:
你有没有听过
关都的广播电台？这边也有很多节目哦！

entries.label: FisherStephenBeatenText
entries.english:
My stupid radio
distracted me!
entries.translation:
因为一直在听广播……
所以才输了！

entries.label: FisherStephenSeenText
entries.english:
I feel so content,
fishing while lis-tening to sometunes on my radio.
entries.translation:
垂钓的同时还能听广播，
这真是太幸福了！

entries.label: FishingSpotSignText
entries.english: FISHING SPOT
entries.translation: 这里是垂钓名胜

entries.label: Route12SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 12 NORTH TO LAVENDER
TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是12号道路
往北 …… 紫苑镇

entries.label: DontWantSuperRodText
entries.english:
Huh? My own eyes
deceived me?
entries.translation:
哎呀？
我看走眼了吗……

entries.label: GaveSuperRodText
entries.english:
Try your hand at
fishing whereverthere is water. Remember--you can
catch different #MON using
different RODS.
entries.translation:
一定要去各种地方
体验一下垂钓的乐趣！ 使用的钓竿不同，
上钩的宝可梦也会不一样！

entries.label: GiveSuperRodText
entries.english:
Yes, yes. Just as
I thought! Here, fishing fan!
Take this--it's aSUPER ROD.
entries.translation:
嗯，嗯！
和我想的一样！看你这么喜欢垂钓！就把厉害钓竿送给你吧！

entries.label: OfferSuperRodText
entries.english:
I'm the FISHING
GURU's youngerbrother. I can see that you
like fishing. There's no doubt
in my mind at all! So? I know I'm
right.
entries.translation:
我是钓鱼大叔的弟弟！
你的脸上洋溢着对垂钓的爱！我肯定没看走眼！ 怎样？
我猜对了吧？

entries.label: BirdKeeperBretAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If you groom them,
#MON get happy.
entries.translation:
把宝可梦整得漂漂亮亮的，
宝可梦也会很开心呢！

entries.label: BirdKeeperBretBeatenText
entries.english:
Shoot!
Not good enough!
entries.translation:
见鬼——！
干不过呀！

entries.label: BirdKeeperBretSeenText
entries.english:
Check out my #-
MON. Just look at their coloring and
their plumage.
entries.translation:
好好看看我的宝可梦！
这是多么美妙的色泽呀！

entries.label: BirdKeeperPerryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Your #MON are
remarkably well-trained.
entries.translation:
锻炼得很出色呢，
你的宝可梦们！

entries.label: BirdKeeperPerryBeatenText
entries.english:
You beat me with
your speed…
entries.translation:
怎么可能！？
居然靠速度打败了我！？

entries.label: BirdKeeperPerrySeenText
entries.english:
Agility is the key
attribute of bird#MON.
entries.translation:
动作迅速是
鸟宝可梦的特长！

entries.label: HikerKennyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Geological fea-
tures don't appearto change. But they actually
change, little bylittle.
entries.translation:
天然的地形乍一看
好像万年不变。 其实它们是在
一点一点地变化着。

entries.label: HikerKennyBeatenText
entries.english: I lost…
entries.translation: 输掉了！

entries.label: HikerKennySeenText
entries.english:
I should go to
ROCK TUNNEL to getmyself an ONIX.
entries.translation:
我要去岩山隧道
捕捉大岩蛇！

entries.label: PokefanmAlexAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Doesn't everyone
wish to someday bea king?
entries.translation:
既然生而为男人，
任谁都想称王称霸吧？

entries.label: PokefanmAlexBeatenText
entries.english:
How… How dare you
mock royalty!
entries.translation: 遗、遗憾……

entries.label: PokefanmAlexSeenText
entries.english:
Bow down before my
regal #MON!
entries.translation:
看到我那威严的宝可梦，
还不赶紧跪下！

entries.label: PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You look like you
have many #MON, but PIKACHU is
still the best.
entries.translation:
不管你拥有
多少宝可梦，最棒的还是皮卡丘！

entries.label: PokefanmJoshuaBeatenText
entries.english: PI-PIKACHU!
entries.translation: 皮、皮卡丘啊！

entries.label: PokefanmJoshuaSeenText
entries.english:
Nihihi! Would you
like to battle myPIKACHU gang?
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻嘻！
要和皮卡丘对战吗？

entries.label: Route13DirectionsSignText
entries.english:
NORTH TO LAVENDER
TOWN WEST TO FUCHSIA
CITY
entries.translation:
往北 …… 紫苑镇
往西 …… 浅红市

entries.label: Route13SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 13 NORTH TO SILENCE
BRIDGE
entries.translation:
这里是13号道路
往北 …… 寂静桥

entries.label: Route13TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS Look! Right there,
at the left sideof the post.
entries.translation:
……有用的公告牌！ 没错没错！
就是栅栏的另外一边！

entries.label: BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You have #MON
that know the HM move FLY, don't
you? I envy you.
entries.translation:
你肯定
让自己的宝可梦记住了秘传招式飞翔吧？我好羡慕啊……

entries.label: BirdKeeperRoyBeatenText
entries.english:
I can dream, but I
can't ever fly…
entries.translation:
啪嗒啪嗒——！
怎么挥手都飞不起来！

entries.label: BirdKeeperRoySeenText
entries.english:
My dream is to fly
with my belovedbird #MON.
entries.translation:
我的梦想是与心爱的
鸟宝可梦共同翱翔！

entries.label: PokefanmCarterAfterBattleText
entries.english:
SQUIRTLE, CHARMAN-
DER and BULBASAUR… I think that's a
well-balanced mix.
entries.translation:
杰尼龟、小火龙，
再加上妙蛙种子，这种组合非常均衡！

entries.label: PokefanmCarterBeatenText
entries.english: Awaaah!
entries.translation: 呜哇……！

entries.label: PokefanmCarterSeenText
entries.english:
Let me tell you,
I had a hard time catching my prized
#MON.
entries.translation:
这些令我自豪的宝可梦
来之不易，陪它们对战吧！

entries.label: PokefanmTrevorAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If only there were
an easy way to identify where I
got my #MON…
entries.translation:
与自己的小宝可梦
在何时何地相遇……要是能简单记住就好了。

entries.label: PokefanmTrevorBeatenText
entries.english:
Where did I meet
this PSYDUCK?
entries.translation:
说起来，我和小可达鸭
是什么时候在哪相遇的呢？

entries.label: PokefanmTrevorSeenText
entries.english:
Hi. Did you know…? #MON get more
friendly if you train them in a
place that theyremember.
entries.translation:
呀，呀！你知道吗？ 如果在充满回忆的地点
锻炼小宝可梦，它们会更加亲近你哦。

entries.label: Route15SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 15 FUCHSIA CITY -
LAVENDER TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是15号道路
浅红市   ……   紫苑镇

entries.label: SchoolboyBillyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If #MON were a
subject at school,I'd be the best!
entries.translation:
如果上课让带宝可梦，
那我就是第一名了！

entries.label: SchoolboyBillyBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, no!
How could I lose?
entries.translation:
糟糕——！
输了——！

entries.label: SchoolboyBillySeenText
entries.english:
My favorite class
is gym!
entries.translation:
我最擅长的科目是——
体育！

entries.label: SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm tired of walk-
ing. I need totake a break.
entries.translation:
已经走累了……
让我休息一下吧。

entries.label: SchoolboyJohnnyBeatenText
entries.english:
You're wickedly
tough!
entries.translation: 你太强了啊！
