entries.label: SchoolboyJohnnySeenText
entries.english:
We're on a field
trip to LAVENDER RADIO TOWER for
social studies.
entries.translation:
我们要去紫苑镇电台
进行社会实践！

entries.label: SchoolboyKippAfterBattleText
entries.english:
My mom worries so
much about me, I have to phone her
all the time.
entries.translation:
我妈妈总是大惊小怪的，
所以我要经常联系她。

entries.label: SchoolboyKippBeatenText
entries.english:
Sorry, Mom!
I was beaten!
entries.translation:
抱歉，妈妈！
我输掉了！

entries.label: SchoolboyKippSeenText
entries.english:
Hang on. I have to
phone my mom.
entries.translation:
你等一下，
我要先打电话给妈妈。

entries.label: SchoolboyTommyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Sayonara! I just
learned that in myJapanese class.
entries.translation:
How do you do——！
这是昨天刚学的！

entries.label: SchoolboyTommyBeatenText
entries.english:
I forgot to do my
homework!
entries.translation:
补习班的作业
忘记做了——！

entries.label: SchoolboyTommySeenText
entries.english:
Let's battle.
I won't lose!
entries.translation:
来对战吧！
我不会输的！

entries.label: TeacherColetteAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Before I became a
teacher, I used to forget a lot of
things.
entries.translation:
老师我呢，
小时候也经常忘东忘西。

entries.label: TeacherColetteBeatenText
entries.english: Kyaaah!

entries.label: TeacherColetteSeenText
entries.english:
Have you forgotten
anything?
entries.translation: 你有没有忘记什么东西？

entries.label: TeacherHillaryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Studying is impor-
tant, but exerciseis just as vital.
entries.translation:
虽然学习很重要，
但是运动也很重要！

entries.label: TeacherHillaryBeatenText
entries.english:
I didn't want to
lose…
entries.translation: 输掉了……

entries.label: TeacherHillarySeenText
entries.english:
On sunny days, I
think that the kids would rather
be playing in the schoolyard than
studying in class.
entries.translation:
只要碰上好天气，
就不想待在教室里学习。真想去操场上做运动啊！

entries.label: Route15FuchsiaGateOfficerText
entries.english:
You're working on
a #DEX? That's really something.
Don't give up!
entries.translation:
你的目标大概是
完成宝可梦图鉴吧？加油啊！

entries.label: CyclingRoadSignText
entries.english:
CYCLING ROAD DOWNHILL COASTING
ALL THE WAY!
entries.translation:
享受坡道！
自行车道！

entries.label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouseSuperNerdText
entries.english:
If you cruise down
CYCLING ROAD, you will end up in
FUCHSIA CITY.
entries.translation:
顺着自行车道，
一直往下冲，就能到达浅红市了。

entries.label: Route16GateCannotPassText
entries.english:
Hey! Whoa! Stop! You can't go out
on the CYCLING ROAD without a
BICYCLE.
entries.translation:
嘿，你！停下！ 没带自行车的人
不允许擅自进入自行车道！

entries.label: Route16GateOfficerText
entries.english:
CYCLING ROAD
starts here. It's all downhill,
so it's totallyexhilarating. It's a great sort
of feeling that you can't get from
a ship or train.
entries.translation:
前方就是自行车道。 在这里骑上自行车，
飞驰的感觉超级棒！ 列车和轮船可不能给你
带来这种快感！

entries.label: BikerCharlesAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Reckless driving
causes accidents!Take it easy!
entries.translation:
事故源自鲁莽，
大家要引以为戒啊……！

entries.label: BikerCharlesBeatenText
entries.english:
Arrrgh! Crash and
burn!
entries.translation: 勇往直前！

entries.label: BikerCharlesSeenText
entries.english:
We're fearless
highway stars!
entries.translation:
我们是
不要命的暴走侠！

entries.label: BikerGlennAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Hands-free riding
is considered coolon CYCLING ROAD.
entries.translation:
在自行车道上，
松手骑车感觉真棒。

entries.label: BikerGlennBeatenText
entries.english:
Yikes! You've got
awesome torque!
entries.translation: 脚力惊人……

entries.label: BikerGlennSeenText
entries.english:
Hey! Want to have
a speed battle?
entries.translation:
陪大爷来场高速对战，
怎么样？

entries.label: BikerJoelAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I look cool, but
I'm weak, so I'mnot really cool. I have to train
harder…
entries.translation:
不管装得有多酷，
弱者就是逊啦……我还要努力啊！

entries.label: BikerJoelBeatenText
entries.english:
But you don't just
look cool…
entries.translation: 不是做做样子啊……！

entries.label: BikerJoelSeenText
entries.english:
Wow. That's a cool
BICYCLE!
entries.translation:
哟，哟！
真是帅气的自行车啊！

entries.label: BikerRileyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Don't get cocky,
you JOHTO punk!
entries.translation:
城都佬，
你别太嚣张啊——！

entries.label: BikerRileyBeatenText
entries.english: Whoa, you kick!
entries.translation: 强无敌……！

entries.label: BikerRileySeenText
entries.english:
Hey, you! You're
from JOHTO, huh?
entries.translation:
喂！
你是从城都来的吧！

entries.label: Route17Route18GateCannotPassText
entries.english:
Hang on! Don't you
have a BICYCLE? The CYCLING ROAD
is beyond here. You have to have a
BICYCLE to go on.
entries.translation:
喂，说你呢！
你没带自行车吧？ 前方是自行车道！
没带自行车的人谢绝进入！

entries.label: Route17Route18GateOfficerText
entries.english:
CYCLING ROAD
Uphill Starts Here
entries.translation:
自行车道
前方是上坡路

entries.label: BirdKeeperBobAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If you don't have
a BICYCLE, you're not allowed to use
the shortcut.
entries.translation:
如果没有自行车的话，
就无法走捷径了。

entries.label: BirdKeeperBobBeatenText
entries.english: …Whew!

entries.label: BirdKeeperBobSeenText
entries.english:
CYCLING ROAD is a
quick shortcut toCELADON.
entries.translation:
自行车道
是前往玉虹的捷径！

entries.label: BirdKeeperBorisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Since you're so
strong, it must befun to battle.
entries.translation:
如果我有你那么强，
对战也会很有意思吧。

entries.label: BirdKeeperBorisBeatenText
entries.english: Ayieee!

entries.label: BirdKeeperBorisSeenText
entries.english:
If you're looking
for #MON, you have to look in
the tall grass.
entries.translation:
寻找宝可梦的诀窍是：
每见到一块新草丛只管进去就对了！

entries.label: Route18SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 18 CELADON CITY -
FUCHSIA CITY
entries.translation:
这里是18号道路
玉虹市   ……   浅红市

entries.label: CarefulSwimmingSignText
entries.english:
Please be careful
if you are swim-ming to SEAFOAMISLANDS. FUCHSIA POLICE
entries.translation:
打算游到双子岛的人
一定要多加小心！ ……浅红市警署留

entries.label: Route19Fisher1Text
entries.english:
Sorry. This road
is closed forconstruction. If you want to get
to CINNABAR, you'd better go south
from PALLET TOWN.
entries.translation:
这里正在施工，无法前进。
要去红莲镇的话，还是从真新镇绕过去吧。

entries.label: Route19Fisher1Text_RocksCleared
entries.english:
I'm all sweaty.
Time for a swim!
entries.translation:
我出了很多汗，
正打算去游个泳！

entries.label: Route19Fisher2Text
entries.english:
Who knows how long
it would take tomove this boulder…
entries.translation:
搬掉这块岩石
到底需要花多久啊……

entries.label: Route19Fisher2Text_RocksCleared
entries.english:
The roadwork is
finally finished. Now I can go
fishing again.
entries.translation: 终于施工完毕了！ 这下就可以去垂钓了！

entries.label: Route19SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 19 FUCHSIA CITY -
SEAFOAM ISLANDS
entries.translation:
这里是19号水道
浅红市   ……   双子岛

entries.label: SwimmerfDawnAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's a quick swim
between FUCHSIA and SEAFOAM IS-
LANDS… Sheesh, some big
man my boyfriend is! What a wimp!
entries.translation:
不就是往返于
浅红市和双子岛吗……是男人就加油啊！

entries.label: SwimmerfDawnBeatenText
entries.english:
I could beat you
at swimming…
entries.translation: 比游泳的话就能赢了……

entries.label: SwimmerfDawnSeenText
entries.english:
I'm disgusted by
wimpy people!
entries.translation:
没出息的人
真让人恶心！

entries.label: SwimmermHaroldAfterBattleText
entries.english:
At night, the sea
turns black. It feels like it will
swallow you up.
entries.translation:
夜间的大海黑洞洞的，
仿佛能把人吸进去。

entries.label: SwimmermHaroldBeatenText
entries.english: Glub…
entries.translation: 哗啦——！

entries.label: SwimmermHaroldSeenText
entries.english:
Have you ever gone
swimming in thesea at night?
entries.translation:
你试过天黑以后
在海里游泳吗？

entries.label: SwimmermJeromeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I might be bad at
swimming, but Ilove the sea.
entries.translation:
就算不太擅长游泳，
我也依然爱着大海！

entries.label: SwimmermJeromeBeatenText
entries.english:
I thought I could
win.
entries.translation: 还以为会赢呢……！

entries.label: SwimmermJeromeSeenText
entries.english:
Swimming?
I'm lousy at it. I'm just splashing
around in theseshallow waters.
entries.translation:
游泳……？
我不太擅长。我这是在浅滩泡水呢。

entries.label: SwimmermTuckerAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I… asked my girl-
friend to swim toFUCHSIA… Gasp…
entries.translation:
我答应女朋友
我要游到浅红市……吁吁……

entries.label: SwimmermTuckerBeatenText
entries.english: I'm drowning!
entries.translation: 溺、溺水了——！

entries.label: SwimmermTuckerSeenText
entries.english:
Pant, pant…
Just… a little… farther… to…
FUCHSIA…
entries.translation:
吁吁……
马上就能……吁吁……到浅红市了……

entries.label: Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText
entries.english:
CINNABAR's volcano
erupted. It hurled boulders
that cut off ROUTE19 indefinitely. I wonder if the
people of CINNABARare safe…
entries.translation:
红莲镇的火山喷发导致
19号道路被岩石堵塞，现在无法通行了。 话说红莲镇的人们
没事吧？

entries.label: Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText_RocksCleared
entries.english:
No CINNABAR citi-
zens were injured by the eruption.
That's great!
entries.translation:
红莲镇的人
看起来全部都没事，太好了，太好了。

entries.label: BugCatcherDougAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Bug #MON squish
like plush toys when you squeeze
their bellies. I love how they
feel!
entries.translation:
要是你试着摸摸
虫宝可梦的小肚肚，就能感受到柔软的触感！我喜欢的就是这一点！

entries.label: BugCatcherDougBeatenText
entries.english: No good!
entries.translation: 不行啊！

entries.label: BugCatcherDougSeenText
entries.english:
Why don't girls
like bug #MON?
entries.translation:
女孩子为什么
不能喜欢虫宝可梦呢？

entries.label: BugCatcherEdAfterBattleText
entries.english:
They'll really
sting when youtake a bath.
entries.translation:
在洗澡的时候
会有强烈的渗痛感！

entries.label: BugCatcherEdBeatenText
entries.english: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
entries.translation: 痛痛痛痛痛……！

entries.label: BugCatcherEdSeenText
entries.english:
If you walk in
tall grass wearing shorts, do you get
nicks and cuts?
entries.translation:
穿着短裤走进草丛里
不会被草划伤腿吗？

entries.label: BugCatcherRobAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm going to look
for stronger bug#MON.
entries.translation:
还要去找
更强的虫宝可梦才行！

entries.label: BugCatcherRobBeatenText
entries.english: I was whipped…
entries.translation: 被打败了——！

entries.label: BugCatcherRobSeenText
entries.english:
My bug #MON are
tough. Prepare tolose!
entries.translation:
我的虫宝可梦很强！
做好觉悟吧！

entries.label: Route2DiglettsCaveSignText
entries.english: DIGLETT'S CAVE
entries.translation: 这里是地鼠洞穴

entries.label: Route2SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 2 VIRIDIAN CITY -
PEWTER CITY
entries.translation:
这里是2号道路
常青市   ……   深灰市

entries.label: CinnabarGymSignText
entries.english:
What does this
sign say? CINNABAR GYM
LEADER: BLAINE
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张纸条！ 这里是红莲镇的道馆！
道馆馆主：夏伯

entries.label: SwimmerfLoriAfterBattleText
entries.english:
SURF is no longer
the only HM moveyou use in water.
entries.translation:
能在水上使用的秘传招式
并不只有冲浪哦。

entries.label: SwimmerfLoriBeatenText
entries.english: No!

entries.label: SwimmerfLoriSeenText
entries.english:
What an impressive
collection of GYM BADGES. We should
battle!
entries.translation:
居然已经取得了这么多
徽章！来和我对战吧！

entries.label: SwimmerfNicoleAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Swimming exercises
your full body. It's really good
for you.
entries.translation:
因为游泳能锻炼全身，
所以对健康非常有益哦！

entries.label: SwimmerfNicoleBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, no!
entries.translation: 讨厌！

entries.label: SwimmerfNicoleSeenText
entries.english:
I feel so much
lighter in water.
entries.translation:
待在水中
感觉身体都变轻了不少。

entries.label: SwimmermCameronAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Besides the sea, I
can also swim inponds and rivers.
entries.translation:
就算找不到大海……
江河湖泊也是随处可见的。

entries.label: SwimmermCameronBeatenText
entries.english: Aiyah!
entries.translation: 呜呀——！

entries.label: SwimmermCameronSeenText
entries.english:
I guess it's im-
possible to swim all the way to
JOHTO.
entries.translation:
就这样游到城都
是不可能的吧。

entries.label: FisherArnoldAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'll just go back
to fishing…
entries.translation: 还是乖乖地垂钓吧……

entries.label: FisherArnoldBeatenText
entries.english: Utter failure…
entries.translation: 惨败……

entries.label: FisherArnoldSeenText
entries.english:
I'm bored by fish-
ing. Let's battle!
entries.translation:
垂钓也腻了！
好！来对战吧！

entries.label: SwimmerfNikkiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I have to watch
out for blemishescaused by the sun.
entries.translation:
我这个年纪
最怕色素和雀斑了。

entries.label: SwimmerfNikkiBeatenText
entries.english:
I'm worried about
sunburn…
entries.translation: 要被晒伤了啊……

entries.label: SwimmerfNikkiSeenText
entries.english:
If I win, you have
to help me with mysuntan lotion!
entries.translation:
喂！ 如果我赢了的话，
你就给我涂防晒油吧！

entries.label: SwimmermSethAfterBattleText
entries.english:
This arrogant guy
was at CINNABAR'svolcano.
entries.translation:
有个人在红莲镇的
火山附近装模做样。

entries.label: SwimmermSethBeatenText
entries.english: Glug…
entries.translation: 扑通——！

entries.label: SwimmermSethSeenText
entries.english:
Land ho! Gotta
keep going!
entries.translation:
加油啊！
看到陆地了！

entries.label: VictoryRoadEntranceSignText
entries.english:
#MON LEAGUE VICTORY ROAD
ENTRANCE
entries.translation:
这里是宝可梦联盟
冠军之路的入口

entries.label: IndigoPlateauSignText
entries.english:
INDIGO PLATEAU The Ultimate Goal
for Trainers! #MON LEAGUE HQ
entries.translation:
这里是石英高原。 宝可梦训练家的顶点！
宝可梦最高机构，宝可梦联盟总部。

entries.label: Route24RocketAfterBattleText
entries.english:
OK. Tell you mine
secret will I. MACHINE PART steal
by me, hide it I did in GYM of the
CERULEAN. Inside water put
it I did. Look for in water center of
GYM at. But you forget me
not! Beat you for sure
will TEAM ROCKET. Come from JOHTO
will they, mine friends, yes. Will
revenge they are.
entries.translation:
好吧……
就告诉你my secret吧。 被盗走的machine零件
In the GYM of 华蓝! 在水中look for以后，
You就能找到它。就在center那块哦！ 但是！
Don't forget! 我们火箭队一定会
好好教训you！城都的my friend正在来这里的路上呢！

entries.label: Route24RocketBeatenText
entries.english:
Ayieeeh! No, no,
no, believe it Ican't! Strong very much
be you! Match I amnot to you!
entries.translation:
Oh! No!
Can't believe! You真是blueberry！ 
……Sorry, mistake!You真是very strong!打不过啊！

entries.label: Route24RocketDisappearsText
entries.english:
… You say what? TEAM
ROCKET bye-bye a go-go? Broken it
is says you? Oh, no! Should I
do what now onfrom, me?
entries.translation:
…… …… ……
…… …… ……For what?火箭队broken？已经没了——？ Oh! No!
我从今以后该何去何从啊——！？

entries.label: Route24RocketSeenText
entries.english:
Hey, kid! Me am a
TEAM ROCKET memberkind of guy! Come from another
country, a trainernumber one, me! Think I did, if
stop the energy, be big panic for
here people! Secret it is my
mission, so tellyou I not! But! If win you do
versus me, a man I be and mine secret
to you I tell. Hey, kid! Battle
begin we do!
entries.translation:
嗨, kid!
我是火箭队member！ 我也是foreign的
number one训练家！ 我打算
让energy完全stop，吓people一跳！让they陷入恐慌！ My作战计划
才不告诉you！ But！
如果能win过我,我是守信用的纯man，会把secret告诉you！ Hey! Kid!
Let's battle begin!

entries.label: BillsHouseSignText
entries.english:
SEA COTTAGE
BILL'S HOUSE
entries.translation:
这里是海角小屋
正辉的家

entries.label: CamperLloydAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽力了，
无怨无悔！

entries.label: CamperLloydBeatenText
entries.english: Whoa! Too much.
entries.translation: 你可真了不起！

entries.label: CamperLloydSeenText
entries.english:
OK! I'm No. 5.
I'll stomp you!
entries.translation:
好！我是你的第5个对手！
来对战吧！

entries.label: CooltrainermKevinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
That was a great
battle! You and your #-
MON are truly out-standing!
entries.translation:
真是美妙的战斗！ 你和你的宝可梦们
真的很强呢！

entries.label: CooltrainermKevinBeatenText
entries.english:
I've never had a
battle this good!
entries.translation:
我从来没体验过
这么精彩的对战！

entries.label: CooltrainermKevinNuggetText
entries.english:
You took on one
more battle than you expected, but
you won anyway. As promised, you
win a prize.
entries.translation:
虽然多打了一场，
但你还是非常精彩地战胜了所有人！ 按之前说好的，
我要给你奖品！

entries.label: CooltrainermKevinSeenText
entries.english:
But after seeing
how you battle, I want to see how
I'll fare. How about it? Let
me take you on.
entries.translation:
……哎呀，
看了你的战斗后，我也跃跃欲试了。 请一定要与我对战！
来吧！

entries.label: LassEllenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽全力了，
无怨无悔！

entries.label: LassEllenBeatenText
entries.english: How could I lose?
entries.translation: 简直不可置信！

entries.label: LassEllenSeenText
entries.english:
I'm second.
Now it's serious!
entries.translation:
我是你的第2个对手！
接下来可要来真的了！

entries.label: LassLauraAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽全力了，
无怨无悔！

entries.label: LassLauraBeatenText
entries.english: I lost too…
entries.translation: 我也输了呢。

entries.label: LassLauraSeenText
entries.english:
I'm No. 4!
Getting tired?
entries.translation:
我是你的第4个对手！
你差不多该累趴下了吧？

entries.label: LassShannonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽全力了，
无怨无悔！

entries.label: LassShannonBeatenText
entries.english: You're kidding.
entries.translation: 骗人的吧！

entries.label: LassShannonSeenText
entries.english:
I'm the last in
line, but I tellyou, I'm tough!
entries.translation:
第6个对手是我！
最后且最强的对手！

entries.label: Route25MistyDateText
entries.english:
MISTY: Aww! Why
did you have to show up and bug us
now? Do you know what
they call peoplelike you? Pests! You heard
me right, pest! … …Oh? Those BADGES
you have… Are theyJOHTO GYM BADGES? If you have eight,
you must be good. OK, then. Come to
CERULEAN GYM. I'll be happy to
take you on. I'm MISTY, the
GYM LEADER inCERULEAN.
entries.translation:
小霞：你这人怎么回事！
突然出来碍事！ 你知不知道你这种人
应该怎么称呼呢！？那当然是“电灯泡”！ …… …… ……
哎呀？你那些徽章……难道是城都的道馆徽章？ 居然集齐了8个，
看起来你还挺有一手……！ 好吧！
请来华蓝道馆吧！我来做你的对手！ 我是小霞！
是华蓝市的道馆馆主！

entries.label: SchoolboyDudleyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽力了，
无怨无悔！

entries.label: SchoolboyDudleyBeatenText
entries.english: Whoo! Good stuff.
entries.translation: 你很厉害啊。

entries.label: SchoolboyDudleySeenText
entries.english:
Beat the six of us
trainers to win afabulous prize! Think you've got
what it takes?
entries.translation:
如果能连胜我们6人，
就有豪华奖品！ 那么！
你办得到吗？

entries.label: SchoolboyJoeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.translation:
我尽力了！
无怨无悔！

entries.label: SchoolboyJoeBeatenText
entries.english: Ow! Stomped flat!
entries.translation: 哎呀呀，我不行了。

entries.label: SchoolboyJoeSeenText
entries.english:
Here's No. 3!
I won't be easy.
entries.translation:
你的第3个对手登场！
我不会让你轻易过去！

entries.label: SupernerdPatAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm sorry… I won't
cheat anymore…
entries.translation:
非常抱歉……
我不会再耍诈了！

entries.label: SupernerdPatBeatenText
entries.english:
Aren't you tired
at all?
entries.translation:
你总不会是不知疲惫的
不死训练家吧！？

entries.label: SupernerdPatSeenText
entries.english:
Mufufufu… I have nothing to
do with the six-pack trainers. I waited here to
beat you when you were tired out by
all the battles.
entries.translation:
呼、呼、呼…… 6人车轮战里面
可没有包括我哦。 我之所以会在这里，
就是想等你精疲力竭，坐收渔翁之利哦！

entries.label: UnusedBillsHouseSignText
entries.english: BILL'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 正辉的家

entries.label: CooltrainerfBeth1BeatenText
entries.english:
#MON aren't
tools of war.
entries.translation:
宝可梦当然不是
用来战斗的工具。

entries.label: CooltrainerfBeth1SeenText
entries.english:
I lost to a train-
er named {RIVAL}. He was really
strong, but… It was as if he
absolutely had towin at any cost. I felt sorry for
his #MON.

entries.label: CooltrainerfBethAfterText
entries.english:
#MON are in-
valuable, lifelongpartners.
entries.translation:
宝可梦应该是
贯穿人生的重要伙伴。

entries.label: CooltrainerfJoyceAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I've defeated
eight GYM LEADERS, so I was feeling
confident. I'll have to try
harder next time.
entries.translation:
战胜8个道馆馆主
让我很有自信…… 看来还要更加努力！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJoyceBeatenText
entries.english:
No! I don't
believe this!
entries.translation:
骗人！
我不相信！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJoyceSeenText
entries.english:
Since you've come
this far, you mustbe good. I'm going to give
this battle every-thing I've got!
entries.translation:
能够站在这里就说明
你有一定的实力！ 我也会尽全力
与你对战！

entries.label: CooltrainermGaven3BeatenText
entries.english:
Gaah! Life is even
tougher!
entries.translation: 人生更加严酷啊！

entries.label: CooltrainermGaven3SeenText
entries.english:
By experiencing
tough battles, yougain power.
entries.translation:
不断进行严酷的战斗，
就能领悟真正的强大！

entries.label: CooltrainermGavenAfterText
entries.english:
To get to #MON
LEAGUE, you have to get through
VICTORY ROAD. But VICTORY ROAD
is tough. Practically nobody
goes there!
entries.translation:
要去宝可梦联盟
必须穿过冠军之路…… 不过，冠军之路非常艰险，
谁也不敢去。

entries.label: CooltrainermJakeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's going to be
tough to win atthe LEAGUE. I need to do some
more training. I hear that the
LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR are tougher
than GYM LEADERS.
entries.translation:
如果宝可梦缺乏锻炼，
想获胜就很难了。 宝可梦联盟的四天王
实力远超现在的所有道馆馆主！

entries.label: CooltrainermJakeBeatenText
entries.english: I blew it!
entries.translation: 失、失误了！

entries.label: CooltrainermJakeSeenText
entries.english:
I'm making my
final preparations for the #MON
LEAGUE.
entries.translation:
为了挑战宝可梦联盟，
我在做最后的调整。

entries.label: FisherScottAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Just like in fish-
ing, it's all over in #MON if you
give up.
entries.translation:
垂钓也好，宝可梦也好，
放弃的话就全部结束了。

entries.label: FisherScottBeatenText
entries.english:
No! Not in this
battle!
entries.translation:
哎呀呀，
想对战还差了点吗？

entries.label: FisherScottSeenText
entries.english:
I'm feeling great
today! I feel like I
could boot eventhe LEAGUE CHAMP!
entries.translation:
今天状态极好！
感觉现在的自己甚至可以战胜宝可梦联盟的冠军！

entries.label: PsychicRichardAfterBattleText
entries.english:
People and #MON
grow from theirexperiences. Don't get lazy and
complacent.
entries.translation:
人和宝可梦想要获得成长，
就要经历各种磨难。 你今后也不能大意，
要继续努力啊！

entries.label: PsychicRichardBeatenText
entries.english: Good battle!
entries.translation: 真是不错的战斗！

entries.label: PsychicRichardSeenText
entries.english:
Wow, look at all
those BADGES!I'm impressed. But you're not
satisfied by just collecting them,
right?
entries.translation:
居然有这么多徽章，
真了不起！ 但是你应该不会
仅仅满足于收集徽章吧。

entries.label: Route26SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 26 #MON LEAGUE
RECEPTION GATE
entries.translation:
这里是26号道路
宝可梦联盟接待处入口

entries.label: Route26HealHouseKeepAtItText
entries.english:
There! Your #MON are
looking good! Keep at it!
entries.translation:
嗯！
宝可梦变得活力充沛了！那么请加油！

entries.label: Route26HealHouseRestAWhileText
entries.english:
Your #MON look
a little tired. You should rest
them a while.
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦
看起来很累…… 请稍微让它们休息一下吧。

entries.label: BirdKeeperJose2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
BIRD KEEPERS like
me mimic bird whistles to com-
mand #MON.
entries.translation:
我们养鸟人用口哨
模仿宝可梦的叫声，以此来下达命令。

entries.label: BirdKeeperJose2BeatenText
entries.english: Tweet!

entries.label: BirdKeeperJose2SeenText
entries.english:
Tweet! Tweet!
Tetweet!
entries.translation: 哔，咻，哔哔咿咿！

entries.label: CooltrainerfMeganAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm checking out
pre- and post-evolution #MON. Evolution really
does make #MONstronger. But evolved forms
also learn moveslater on.
entries.translation:
有的宝可梦我让它进化，
有的宝可梦我不让它进化，以此来研究宝可梦的特性。 进化后虽然会变强，
但学会招式的时机会变迟。

entries.label: CooltrainerfMeganBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh! You're really
strong!
entries.translation: 呃，太强了吧。

entries.label: CooltrainerfMeganSeenText
entries.english:
It's rare to see
anyone come here. Are you training
on your own?
entries.translation:
哎呀，真少见，
居然有人经过这里。你在磨练技术吗？

entries.label: CooltrainerfReenaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You're just a kid,
but you're not to be underestimated
either.
entries.translation:
我不应该小看，
你这样的小朋友！

entries.label: CooltrainerfReenaBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh! You're much
too strong!
entries.translation: 啊啊，太强了！

entries.label: CooltrainerfReenaSeenText
entries.english:
You shouldn't
underestimate the wild #MON in
these parts.
entries.translation:
千万不要小看
这一带的野生宝可梦！

entries.label: CooltrainermBlakeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If you prevail on
this harsh trek, the truth will be
revealed! Heh, sorry, I just
wanted to saysomething cool.
entries.translation:
当你越过这条漫长的路，
你一定会获得许多感悟。 抱歉，其实
我只是想说点帅气的话。

entries.label: CooltrainermBlakeBeatenText
entries.english: Yow!

entries.label: CooltrainermBlakeSeenText
entries.english:
You look pretty
strong.Let me battle you!
entries.translation:
你看起来很强呢。
那就请你和我交手吧！

entries.label: CooltrainermBrianAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A good trainer can
recognize othergood trainers.
entries.translation:
强大的训练家之间
是会产生共鸣的！

entries.label: CooltrainermBrianBeatenText
entries.english: Just as I thought!
entries.translation: 不出所料！

entries.label: CooltrainermBrianSeenText
entries.english:
Hm? You're good,
aren't you?
entries.translation: 唔，你丫有两下啊！

entries.label: PsychicGilbertAfterBattleText
entries.english:
With your skills,
you'll do well atthe LEAGUE. That's what my
premonition says.
entries.translation:
以你的实力，
在宝可梦联盟也会顺利，这是我预测到的结果。

entries.label: PsychicGilbertBeatenText
entries.english: You're too much!
entries.translation: ……太强了！

entries.label: PsychicGilbertSeenText
entries.english:
Don't say a thing! Let me guess what
you're thinking. Mmmmmmm… I got it! You're
on the #MONLEAGUE challenge!
entries.translation:
我来猜猜你的想法。 ……嗯嗯嗯。 明白了！
是挑战宝可梦联盟吧！

entries.label: Route27FisherHeyText
entries.english: Hey!
entries.translation: 嘿！

entries.label: Route27FisherText
entries.english:
Do you know what
you just did? You've taken your
first step intoKANTO. Check your #-
GEAR MAP and see.
entries.translation:
就在这一刻！ 你迈出了
关都地区的第一步！ 你不妨打开地图
确认一下吧！

entries.label: TohjoFallsSignText
entries.english:
TOHJO FALLS THE LINK BETWEEN
KANTO AND JOHTO
entries.translation:
这里是都城瀑布
关都与城都的交界处

entries.label: SandstormHouseSandstormDescription
entries.english:
TM37 happens to be
SANDSTORM. It's a move that
inflicts damage onboth battlers. It's for advanced
trainers only. Use it if you
dare. Good luck!
entries.translation:
招式学习器37是沙暴！ 使用后双方都会受到伤害，
是面向高级训练家的招式。 总之，请加油吧。

entries.label: SandstormHouseWomanDisloyalText
entries.english:
If it doesn't come
to trust you some more, it could be
tough going. Trust is the tie
that binds #MONand trainers.
entries.translation:
不稍微改善关系的话，
想获胜就很难了。 训练家与宝可梦之间
要用信赖进行维系。

entries.label: SandstormHouseWomanLoyalText
entries.english:
Ah! Your #MON
trusts you verymuch. It's nice to see a
good trainer. Here. A gift for
your journey.
entries.translation:
哦哦，你们非常亲密啊。
碰到优秀的训练家真高兴， 这是饯别礼，
请拿去吧！

entries.label: SandstormHouseWomanText1
entries.english:
Where are you off
to with #MON? #MON LEAGUE? Are your #MON
loyal enough foryou to win? Let me see…
entries.translation:
咻咻咻，
你要带着宝可梦去哪？ 宝可梦联盟吗？
你们之间的牵绊够强吗？能不能战无不胜呢？ 就让我给你看看吧……

entries.label: Route28SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 28
entries.translation: 这里是28号道路

entries.label: CelebrityText1
entries.english:
Oh, dear.
You've found me. Please don't tell
anyone about me. I'll give you this
for keeping mysecret. Please?
entries.translation:
哎呀呀……！
被你发现了呢！ 能不能不要
告诉别人我在这里呀？这个送给你，……拜托帮我保密吧！

entries.label: CelebrityText2
entries.english:
It's tough being a
top celebrity. Everywhere I go,
people chase me. I just want to be
left alone…
entries.translation:
当热门偶像真是辛苦，
去哪里都有人跟着。我只想过安静的生活……

entries.label: CelebritysFearowText
entries.english: FEAROW: Feero!
entries.translation: 大嘴雀：大嘴！

entries.label: CatchingTutorialBoxFullText
entries.english:
#MON hide in
the grass. Who knows when they'll
pop out…
entries.translation:
宝可梦潜伏在草丛中，
随时都可能会扑过来。

entries.label: CatchingTutorialDebriefText
entries.english:
That's how you do
it. If you weaken them
first, #MON areeasier to catch.
entries.translation:
嗯嗯，就是这种感觉！ 先削弱对方，
就会变得更容易捕捉！

entries.label: CatchingTutorialDeclinedText
entries.english:
Oh. Fine, then. Anyway, if you
want to catch #MON, you have
to walk a lot.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
那就算了吧。 如果有想捕捉的宝可梦，
来回走就对了！

entries.label: CatchingTutorialIntroText
entries.english:
I've seen you a
couple times. How many #MON have
you caught? Would you like me
to show you how tocatch #MON?
entries.translation:
我看你经过好几次了，
现在捕捉到多少宝可梦了？ 要不，我告诉你
捕捉宝可梦的方法吧？

entries.label: CatchingTutorialRepeatText
entries.english:
Huh? You want me
to show you how tocatch #MON?
entries.translation:
嗯？希望我来教你
宝可梦的捕捉方法吗？

entries.label: MeetTuscanyText
entries.english:
TUSCANY: I do be-
lieve that this is the first time
we've met? Please allow me to
introduce myself. I am TUSCANY of
Tuesday.
entries.translation:
星琪二：我们这是
初次见面吧？ 我是星期二的星琪二。

entries.label: Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForDay
entries.english:
I'm waiting for
#MON that appear only in the
daytime.
entries.translation:
有的宝可梦只在白天出现，
我在这等着捕捉它们呢。

entries.label: Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForMorning
entries.english:
I'm waiting for
#MON that appear only in the
morning.
entries.translation:
有的宝可梦只在清晨出现，
我在这等着捕捉它们呢。

entries.label: Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForNight
entries.english:
I'm waiting for
#MON that appear only at
night.
entries.translation:
有的宝可梦只在夜晚出现，
我在这等着捕捉它们呢。

entries.label: Route29FisherText
entries.english:
I wanted to take a
break, so I saved to record my
progress.
entries.translation:
因为我想稍微休息一下，
所以正在写记录。

entries.label: Route29Sign1Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 29 CHERRYGROVE CITY -
NEW BARK TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是29号道路
吉花市   ……   若叶镇

entries.label: Route29Sign2Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 29 CHERRYGROVE CITY -
NEW BARK TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是29号道路
吉花市   ……   若叶镇

entries.label: Route29TeacherText
entries.english:
See those ledges?
It's scary to jumpoff them. But you can go to
NEW BARK without walking through
the grass.
entries.translation:
那里不是有个断坡吗？ 虽然直接往下跳挺吓人的，
但是可以避开草丛，直达若叶镇哦！

entries.label: Route29YoungsterText
entries.english:
Yo. How are your
#MON? If they're weak
and not ready for battle, keep out
of the grass.
entries.translation:
哟，
你的宝可梦还好吗？ 如果宝可梦太虚弱，
不想让它战斗，那你走路的时候尽量避开草丛比较好。

entries.label: TuscanyGaveGiftText
entries.english:
TUSCANY: Wouldn't
you agree that itis most adorable? It strengthens
normal-type moves. I am certain it
will be of use.
entries.translation:
星琪二：你不觉得
这条丝带非常可爱吗？ 这是可以强化一般属性
招式的道具。我想它一定会派上用场的。

entries.label: TuscanyGivesGiftText
entries.english:
By way of intro-
duction, please accept this gift,
a PINK BOW.
entries.translation:
作为我的问候，
请你收下这个。这是粉红丝带。

entries.label: TuscanyNotTuesdayText
entries.english:
TUSCANY: Today is
not Tuesday. Thatis unfortunate…
entries.translation:
星琪二：今天好像
不是星期二呢。真遗憾……

entries.label: TuscanyTuesdayText
entries.english:
TUSCANY: Have you
met MONICA, myolder sister? Or my younger
brother, WESLEY? I am the second of
seven children.
entries.translation:
星琪二：你见到了
星琪一姐姐吗？那星祺三弟弟呢？ 我在7个兄弟姐妹里
排行老二哦。

entries.label: Route29Route46GateOfficerText
entries.english:
You can't climb
ledges. But you can jump
down from them totake a shortcut.
entries.translation:
断坡是不可以逆向攀爬的。 但是跳下来的时候很快，
感觉不亏呢。

entries.label: Route29Route46GateYoungsterText
entries.english:
Different kinds of
#MON appearpast here. If you want to
catch them all, you have to look
everywhere.
entries.translation:
再往前走几步，
出现的宝可梦会略有不同。 想要搜集各种宝可梦，
就得探索各种地方！

entries.label: Route2GateScientistText
entries.english:
Are you {PLAYER}? I work as PROF.
OAK's AIDE. I had no idea that
you were out here. PROF.OAK's LAB is
nearby in PALLETTOWN.
entries.translation:
你是{PLAYER}？ 我正在担任
大木博士的助手。 没想到你能到这里呢！
大木博士的研究所就在不远处的真新镇！

entries.label: Route2NuggetHouseFisherText
entries.english:
Hi! Wow, I'm glad
to see you. You're the first
visitor I've hadin a long time. I'm super-happy!
Let me give you alittle present.
entries.translation:
呀，来得好！
好久没过游客了！ 大叔真的很高兴哦！
这个给你！

entries.label: Route2NuggetHouseFisherText_GotNugget
entries.english:
That's a NUGGET. I can't give you
any nuggets of wisdom, so that'll
have to do!
entries.translation:
这是大叔的金珠！
妥善地去使用它吧！这毕竟是大叔的金珠呀！

entries.label: FirebreatherBurtAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The greatest fire-
breather in KANTO,that's me. But not the best
trainer…
entries.translation:
关都第一喷火艺人
就是本大爷！……虽然输了宝可梦对战。

entries.label: FirebreatherBurtBeatenText
entries.english: Yow! That's hot!
entries.translation: 好烫——！

entries.label: FirebreatherBurtSeenText
entries.english:
Step right up and
take a look!
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
随意参观！

entries.label: FirebreatherOtisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
When it rains,
it's hard to getignition…
entries.translation:
一旦下雨，
就很难生火了。啪！

entries.label: FirebreatherOtisBeatenText
entries.english:
It's sunny, but
I'm all wet…
entries.translation:
天空万里无云，
我的心里却在下雨……

entries.label: FirebreatherOtisSeenText
entries.english:
Ah! The weather's
as fine as ever.
entries.translation:
啊——！
今天天气也很好——！

entries.label: Route3MtMoonSquareSignText
entries.english:
MT.MOON SQUARE Just go up the
stairs.
entries.translation:
月见山广场
……爬上楼梯近在眼前！

entries.label: YoungsterJimmyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I wear shorts the
whole year round. That's my fashion
policy.
entries.translation:
一年到头都要穿短裤！
这是我的原则！

entries.label: YoungsterJimmyBeatenText
entries.english: Blown away!

entries.label: YoungsterJimmySeenText
entries.english:
I can run like the
wind!
entries.translation:
我是风之子，
充满了活力！

entries.label: YoungsterWarrenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You looked strong. I was afraid to
take you on…
entries.translation:
你看着很强，
我不太敢和你对战……

entries.label: YoungsterWarrenBeatenText
entries.english: I knew I'd lose…
entries.translation: 还是输了……

entries.label: YoungsterWarrenSeenText
entries.english:
Hmmm… I don't know
what to do…
entries.translation:
嗯……
怎么办呢……

entries.label: BugCatcherDonAfterText
entries.english:
I ran out of #
BALLS while I wascatching #MON. I should've bought
some more…
entries.translation:
我在捕捉宝可梦时
耗费了许多精灵球。 我之前就应该
多买一些的……

entries.label: BugCatcherDonBeatenText
entries.english:
Argh! You're too
strong!
entries.translation: 嗷！你太强了！

entries.label: BugCatcherDonSeenText
entries.english:
Instead of a bug
#MON, I founda trainer!
entries.translation:
虫宝可梦没碰到，
倒是碰到了个训练家！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouseDirectionsSignText
entries.english:
MR.#MON'S HOUSE
STRAIGHT AHEAD!
entries.translation:
宝可梦爷爷的家
就在前面！

entries.label: MrPokemonsHouseSignText
entries.english: MR.#MON'S HOUSE
entries.translation: 宝可梦爷爷的家

entries.label: Route30CooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I'm not a trainer. But if you look
one in the eyes,prepare to battle.
entries.translation:
我不是训练家。 但是我知道
训练家目光交汇的那一刻就意味着对战开始了。

entries.label: Route30SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 30 VIOLET CITY -
CHERRYGROVE CITY
entries.translation:
这里是30号道路
桔梗市   ……   吉花市

entries.label: Route30TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS No stealing other
people's #MON! # BALLS are to
be thrown only atwild #MON!
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 捕捉别人的宝可梦
是小偷行为！ 精灵球只能
投向野生的宝可梦！

entries.label: Route30YoungsterText_DirectionsToMrPokemonsHouse
entries.english:
MR.#MON's
house? It's a bitfarther ahead.
entries.translation:
你要去宝可梦爷爷的家？
再往前一点就到了哦。

entries.label: Route30YoungsterText_EveryoneIsBattling
entries.english:
Everyone's having
fun battling!You should too!
entries.translation:
看他们进行宝可梦对战
还挺开心的！要不你也来试试？

entries.label: Text_ThisIsABigBattle
entries.english:
What? This is a
big battle!Leave me alone!
entries.translation:
你干嘛？
这是场关键的对决！一边待着去！

entries.label: Text_UseTackle
entries.english: Go, RATTATA! TACKLE!
entries.translation: 上啊，小拉达！ 撞击！

entries.label: YoungsterJoey1AfterText
entries.english:
Do I have to have
more #MON in order to battle
better? No! I'm sticking
with this one nomatter what!
entries.translation:
我收集的宝可梦太少了，
所以对战时很吃力吧？ ……不！既然如此，
我就偏偏只用一只，我要让它更强！

entries.label: YoungsterJoey1BeatenText
entries.english:
Ack! I lost again!
Doggone it!
entries.translation:
啊！
我又输了！真可恶！

entries.label: YoungsterJoey1SeenText
entries.english:
I just lost, so
I'm trying to findmore #MON. Wait! You look
weak! Come on,let's battle!
entries.translation:
我刚才输了，所以我要
寻找更多的宝可梦。 不过嘛，你看起来很弱！
好！来对战吧！

entries.label: YoungsterJoeyText_GiveHPUpAfterBattle
entries.english:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough! Oh yeah, I almost
forgot that I hadto give you this. Use it to get even
tougher, OK? I'm going to get
tougher too.
entries.translation:
我又输了……
你也太强了吧！ 对了，
差点忘了给你这个。 有了它你就能变得更强！
我也要变得更强！

entries.label: YoungsterMikeyAfterText
entries.english:
Becoming a good
trainer is reallytough. I'm going to bat-
tle other peopleto get better.
entries.translation:
宝可梦之路
真是艰险而漫长…… 好！我要挑战各种训练家，
以此来锻炼自己！

entries.label: YoungsterMikeyBeatenText
entries.english:
That's strange.
I won before.
entries.translation:
太奇怪了。
之前我还是能赢的啊？

entries.label: YoungsterMikeySeenText
entries.english:
You're a #MON
trainer, right? Then you have to
battle!
entries.translation:
你是宝可梦训练家吧？
那就来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: Route30BerrySpeechHouseCheckTreesText
entries.english:
Check trees for
BERRIES. They justdrop right off.
entries.translation:
如果你去调查树，
就会有树果掉下来哦。

entries.label: Route30BerrySpeechHouseMonEatBerriesText
entries.english:
You know, #MON
eat BERRIES. Well, my #MON
got healthier byeating a BERRY. Here. I'll share
one with you!
entries.translation:
你知道吗，
宝可梦会主动吃树果。 我家的宝可梦吃了树果后
就变得有活力了。对了！也分给你一些吧！

entries.label: BugCatcherWade1AfterText
entries.english:
You can catch
#MON even if you have six with
you. If you catch one,
it'll go to yourBOX automatically.
entries.translation:
即使已经带了6只宝可梦，
也可以继续捉喔。捉住的新宝可梦会自动传进电脑的盒子里。

entries.label: BugCatcherWade1BeatenText
entries.english: Awwwww…
entries.translation: 怎么回事啊……

entries.label: BugCatcherWade1SeenText
entries.english:
I caught a bunch
of #MON. Let mebattle with you!
entries.translation:
我捉到了很多宝可梦，
来和我对战吧！

entries.label: DarkCaveSignText
entries.english: DARK CAVE
entries.translation: 这里是黑暗洞穴

entries.label: Route31CooltrainerMText
entries.english:
DARK CAVE… If #MON could
light it up, I'dexplore it.
entries.translation:
这是黑暗洞穴……
如果我的宝可梦会用照亮周围的招式就好了，那我就可以去里面调查了。

entries.label: Route31SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 31 VIOLET CITY -
CHERRYGROVE CITY
entries.translation:
这里是31号道路
桔梗市   ……   吉花市

entries.label: Route31YoungsterText
entries.english:
I found a good
#MON in DARKCAVE. I'm going to raise
it to take onFALKNER. He's the leader of
VIOLET CITY's GYM.
entries.translation:
我在黑暗洞穴里
捕捉到了不错的宝可梦！ 我要锻炼它，
然后用它去挑战桔梗道馆的馆主阿速！

entries.label: Text_Route31CantTakeLastMon
entries.english:
If I take that
#MON from you, what are you going
to use in battle?
entries.translation:
我拿走那只宝梦后，
你拿什么出战呢！

entries.label: Text_Route31DeclinedToHandOverMail
entries.english:
What? You don't
want anything?
entries.translation: 什么？什么都没有？

entries.label: Text_Route31DescribeNightmare
entries.english:
TM50 is NIGHTMARE. It's a wicked move
that steadily cuts the HP of a sleep-
ing enemy. Ooooh…
That's scary… I don't want to
have bad dreams.
entries.translation:
招式学习器50是恶梦。 用这个招式可以慢慢削减
睡眠中的对手的体力。 呜——太可怕了……
我可不想做恶梦啊……

entries.label: Text_Route31HandOverMailMon
entries.english:
{PLAYER} handed
over the #MONholding the MAIL.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}交出了
携带邮件的宝可梦！

entries.label: Text_Route31MissingMail
entries.english:
Why is this #-
MON so special? It doesn't have
any MAIL.
entries.translation:
那只宝可梦怎么了？
没有邮件啊。

entries.label: Text_Route31ReadingMail
entries.english:
Let's see… …DARK CAVE leads
to another road… That's good to
know. Thanks for bring-
ing this to me. My friend's a good
guy, and you'reswell too! I'd like to do
something good inreturn too! I know! I want you
to have this!
entries.translation:
我看看…… 上面写着
“其实，黑暗洞穴还能通往其他道路” 感谢你特地送来！ 我朋友可真够意思，
你也很够意思！ 看到别人这么够意思，
我也想意思意思！ 对了，
这个送给你吧！

entries.label: Text_Route31SleepyMan
entries.english:
… Hnuurg… Huh? I walked too far
today looking for#MON. My feet hurt and
I'm sleepy… If I were a wild
#MON, I'd beeasy to catch… …Zzzz…
entries.translation:
唔，呼噜呼噜…… 为了找宝可梦跋山涉水，
脚很痛，人又很困…… 如果我是野生的宝可梦，
现在这样应该很好捕捉……呼……呼噜呼噜……

entries.label: Text_Route31SleepyManGotMail
entries.english:
…Zzzz… Huh? What's that? You
have MAIL for me?
entries.translation:
呼……唔姆唔姆…… 嗯？什么？
有邮件要给我？

entries.label: Text_Route31WrongMail
entries.english:
This MAIL isn't
for me.
entries.translation: 这封邮件不是给我的。

entries.label: Route31VioletGateCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I came too far
out. I'd betterphone home!
entries.translation:
已经走了相当远了！
要给家里打个电话呀！

entries.label: Route31VioletGateOfficerText
entries.english:
Hi there!
Did you visitSPROUT TOWER?
entries.translation:
哟，你去喇叭芽之塔
参观过了吗？

entries.label: BirdKeeperPeterAfterText
entries.english:
I should train
again at the GYMin VIOLET CITY.
entries.translation:
我该回桔梗市宝可梦道馆
重新历练自己了吧。

entries.label: BirdKeeperPeterBeatenText
entries.english:
I know what my
weaknesses are.
entries.translation: 我知道自己不够成熟。

entries.label: BirdKeeperPeterSeenText
entries.english:
That BADGE! It's
from VIOLET CITY! You beat FALKNER?
entries.translation:
哦，那个徽章是…… 桔梗的道馆徽章！
你战胜了阿速先生吗！

entries.label: CamperRolandAfterText
entries.english:
If you don't want
to battle, justavoid eye contact.
entries.translation:
不想对战的话，
就不要和别人目光交汇。

entries.label: CamperRolandBeatenText
entries.english:
Hmmm. This is
disappointing.
entries.translation: 嗯，遗憾。

entries.label: CamperRolandSeenText
entries.english:
That glance…
It's intriguing.
entries.translation:
你的目光……
很令人在意啊。

entries.label: FisherHenryAfterText
entries.english:
Freshly caught
#MON are no match for properly
raised ones.
entries.translation:
新捉到的宝可梦
和以前的宝可梦合不来啊。

entries.label: FisherHenryBeatenText
entries.english: SPLASH?
entries.translation: 扑通扑通。

entries.label: FisherHenrySeenText
entries.english:
My #MON?
Freshly caught!
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦新鲜得很，
现在还在活蹦乱跳呢！

entries.label: FisherJustinAfterText
entries.english:
Calm, collected…
The essence of fishing and #-
MON is the same.
entries.translation:
不能急，不能躁…… 不论钓鱼还是宝可梦，
诀窍都是一样的。

entries.label: FisherJustinBeatenText
entries.english: Sploosh!
entries.translation: 咕咚！

entries.label: FisherJustinSeenText
entries.english:
Whoa! You made me lose
that fish!
entries.translation: 哇！ 你吓跑了我的猎物啊！

entries.label: FisherRalph1BeatenText
entries.english:
Tch! I tried to
rush things…
entries.translation: 急着起竿了……

entries.label: FisherRalph1SeenText
entries.english:
I'm really good at
both fishing and#MON. I'm not about to
lose to any kid!
entries.translation:
虽然我比较擅长垂钓，
不过比宝可梦也是不会输给年轻人的！

entries.label: FisherRalphAfterText
entries.english:
Fishing is a life-
long passion. #MON are life-
long friends!
entries.translation:
钓鱼是一生的乐趣！
宝可梦是一生的朋友！

entries.label: FisherRalphSwarmText
entries.english:
One, two, three…
Muahahaha, what a great haul!
I'm done! Go ahead and catch as many
as you can, kid!
entries.translation:
一、二、三……
哇哈哈，大丰收，大丰收！ 我已经满足了。
你也多钓点呀，年轻人！

entries.label: FriedaFridayText
entries.english:
FRIEDA: Hiya! What
day do you like? I love Friday. No
doubt about it! Don't you think
it's great too?
entries.translation:
星琪五：哎呀呀！
你最喜欢星期几啊？ 人家选星期五哦！
这还用说嘛！ 你也这么认为吧？

entries.label: FriedaGaveGiftText
entries.english:
FRIEDA: Give it to
a #MON that haspoison-type moves. Oh! It's wicked! You'll be shocked
how good it makespoison moves!
entries.translation:
星琪五：让宝可梦携带它
再使出毒属性招式…… 啊！ 你猜怎么着！ 招式的威力居然变强了！

entries.label: FriedaGivesGiftText
entries.english:
Here's a POISON
BARB for you!
entries.translation:
瞧，这是毒针！
就把它送给你了！

entries.label: FriedaNotFridayText
entries.english:
FRIEDA: Isn't it
Friday today? It's so boring
when it's not!
entries.translation:
星琪五：今天不是
星期五吗？真的是太无聊了！

entries.label: MeetFriedaText
entries.english:
FRIEDA: Yahoo!
It's Friday! I'm FRIEDA of
Friday! Nice to meet you!
entries.translation:
星琪五：哟呵——！ 人家是星期五的星琪五！
请多关照哦！

entries.label: PicnickerLiz1AfterText
entries.english:
I was having a
nice chat too.
entries.translation: 刚刚我还聊得很开心的……

entries.label: PicnickerLiz1BeatenText
entries.english:
Oh! I've got to
relieve my anger!
entries.translation:
讨厌！这种不爽的心情，
该怎么排解啊！

entries.label: PicnickerLiz1SeenText
entries.english:
Uh-huh. Yeah, and
you know… Pardon? Battle?
I'm on the phone. Oh, all right. But
make it fast.
entries.translation:
……对对，
就是这么一回事！ 啊，什么？宝可梦对战？
可我还在打电话啊。算了，只好速战速决了。

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_AideIsWaiting
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, right?
Some guy wearing glasses was look-
ing for you. See for yourself.
He's waiting for you at the #MON
CENTER.
entries.translation:
你就是{PLAYER}吧？
好像有个眼镜男正在到处找你哦。 这会儿应该在宝可梦中心
等着你吧。你去看看吧！

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_ExperiencesShouldBeUseful
entries.english:
Your experiences
in VIOLET CITY should be useful
for your journey.
entries.translation:
在桔梗市获得的经验，
肯定能用到今后的旅程中！

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_HaveThisSeed
entries.english:
You have some good
#MON there. It must be from
the training you gave them around
VIOLET CITY. The training at
the GYM must have been especially
helpful. As a souvenir of
VIOLET CITY, takethis. It increases the
power of grass-type moves.
entries.translation:
嗯，你的宝可梦很不错啊。
他们都在桔梗市进行过各种训练吧？ 其中最有价值的修行
肯定是宝可梦道馆。 好！既然来了桔梗市，
就收下这个当作纪念吧。 据说让宝可梦携带以后，
草属性招式的威力就会上升哦！

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_UnusedSproutTower
entries.english:
Have you gone to
SPROUT TOWER? If you ever visit
VIOLET CITY,  they'll expect you
to train there. That's basic for
trainers. Go toSPROUT TOWER!
entries.translation:
去过喇叭芽之塔吗？
去了桔梗市，就要去喇叭牙之塔修行！ 这是训练家的常识呀！
赶紧过去吧！

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_VioletGym
entries.english:
Have you gone to
the #MON GYM? You can test your
#MON and your-self there. It's a rite of
passage for alltrainers!
entries.translation:
去过宝可梦道馆吗？
要通过宝可梦道馆来磨练自己以及宝可梦。 这是训练家的常识呀！
赶紧过去吧！

entries.label: Route32CooltrainerMText_WhatsTheHurry
entries.english:
Wait up!
What's the hurry?

entries.label: Route32RuinsSignText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH
EAST ENTRANCE
entries.translation:
阿露福遗迹
东侧入口

entries.label: Route32SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 32 VIOLET CITY -
AZALEA TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是32号道路
桔梗市   ……   桧皮镇

entries.label: Route32UnionCaveSignText
entries.english:
UNION CAVE
AHEAD
entries.translation: 前方是互连洞

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher1AfterText
entries.english:
How come the guy
next to me catchesgood #MON?
entries.translation:
怎么旁边那个垂钓者
就能调上好宝可梦？

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher1BeatenText
entries.english:
Nothing ever goes
right for me now…
entries.translation:
倒霉的时候
干什么都倒霉……

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher1SeenText
entries.english:
I keep catching
the same #MON… Maybe a battle
will turn thingsaround for me.
entries.translation:
只能钓到一种宝可梦……
用对战来转换心情吧……

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher2AfterText
entries.english:
You have to have a
good ROD if you want to catch good
#MON.
entries.translation:
想捉到好的宝可梦，
你得有个好钓竿。

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher2BeatenText
entries.english:
Oof. I wasn't
lucky that time.
entries.translation:
哎呀！
对战就没那么走运了！

entries.label: Route32UnusedFisher2SeenText
entries.english:
Heh, I'm on a roll
today. How about abattle, kid?
entries.translation:
我今天状态极佳！
来战斗吧！

entries.label: Route32UnusedText
entries.english:
The fishermen
yelled at me forbugging them…
entries.translation:
垂钓者生气地批评我，
让我别妨碍他们钓鱼……

entries.label: Text_MillionDollarSlowpokeTail
entries.english:
How would you like
to have this tasty, nutritious
SLOWPOKETAIL? For you right now,
just $1,000,000! You'll want this!
entries.translation:
又香又有营养的
美味尾巴，您需要吗？ 现在购买，只要
100万元，欲购从速！

entries.label: Text_RefusedToBuySlowpokeTail
entries.english:
You don't want it?
Then scram. Shoo!
entries.translation:
不要吗！
滚一边去！滚！

entries.label: Text_RoarIntro
entries.english:
WROOOOAR!
PEOPLE RUN WHEN I ROAR! BUT YOU
CAME LOOKING! THAT PLEASES ME!
NOW TAKE THIS!
entries.translation:
喔哦哦哦！ 我随便一吼大家就跑了，
你却迎面而来哎哎哎！我好感动嗡嗡嗡！这个就拿去吧啊啊啊！

entries.label: Text_RoarOutro
entries.english:
WROOOAR!
IT'S ROAR! EVEN #MON RUN
FROM A GOOD ROAR!
entries.translation:
喔哦哦哦！
里面是“吼叫”！一吼叫就能吓跑宝可梦！

entries.label: Text_ThoughtKidsWereLoaded
entries.english:
Tch! I thought
kids these dayswere loaded…
entries.translation:
你的钱根本不够嘛！ 切！我还以为现在的
小朋友都很有钱呢……

entries.label: YoungsterAlbertAfterText
entries.english:
I'm going to try
to be the bestwith my favorites. I'm not using the
same tough #MONas everyone else.
entries.translation:
我要用我喜欢的宝可梦
来成为最强的训练家！ 不论有多强，我也不想用
大家都在用的宝可梦。

entries.label: YoungsterAlbertBeatenText
entries.english: You're strong!
entries.translation: 太强了吧！

entries.label: YoungsterAlbertSeenText
entries.english:
I haven't seen you
around before. So you think you
are pretty tough?
entries.translation:
之前没见过啊，
你小子很强吗？

entries.label: YoungsterGordonAfterText
entries.english:
The grass is full
of clingy things.
entries.translation:
在草丛里走着走着，
就粘上了好多虫子。

entries.label: YoungsterGordonBeatenText
entries.english:
Darn. I thought I
could win.
entries.translation:
啊啊，
还以为能赢的。

entries.label: YoungsterGordonSeenText
entries.english:
I found some good
#MON in thegrass! I think they'll do
it for me!
entries.translation:
在草丛里发现了好宝可梦！
一定能派上用场吧！

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
What should I make
my #MON hold? Maybe an item that
increases ATTACKpower…
entries.translation:
嗯，我好困扰啊……
该让宝可梦携带什么呢？ 还是携带可以
强化攻击力的道具吧。

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_After
entries.english:
Yo, kid. How are
they biting?
entries.translation:
哟！
垂钓的状态如何？

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_GiveOldRod
entries.english:
Fishing is great! If there's water,
be it the sea or a stream, try out
your ROD.
entries.translation:
垂钓是最好的！ 只要是有水，
管他是大海还是小河，要尽情使用钓竿哦！

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_No
entries.english:
Oh. That's rather
disappointing…
entries.translation:
哎哟哟，
那就很遗憾了……

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Question
entries.english:
This is a great
fishing spot. You saw people
fishing? Howabout you? Would you like one
of my RODS?
entries.translation:
这一带可是垂钓名胜哦。
看着大家都在垂钓，你也跃跃欲试吧？ 要是愿意的话，
我就把我的钓竿给你吧？

entries.label: Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Yes
entries.english:
Heh, that's good
to hear. Now you're an
angler too!
entries.translation:
我很开心！这样一来，
你也能加入垂钓者的行列！

entries.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH A Look-and-Touch
Tourist Site Try the sliding
stone panels!
entries.translation:
欢迎来到能看又能摸的
阿露福遗迹！ 请您务必亲手摸摸
能移动的石板哦！

entries.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGatePokefanMText
entries.english:
You're studying
the RUINS? I see a scientist
in the making.
entries.translation:
哦，你是来遗迹学习的？
将来一定能当博士啊！

entries.label: Route32RuinsOfAlphGateYoungsterText
entries.english:
There are drawings
on stone panels. I tried moving
them. I wonderwhat they are.
entries.translation:
石板上有画，而且还能推！
那到底是什么东西呢？

entries.label: HikerAnthony2AfterText
entries.english:
We HIKERS are at
our best in themountains.
entries.translation:
如果放登山男归山，
精力会比这充沛一百倍！

entries.label: HikerAnthony2BeatenText
entries.english:
Whoa! You've got
more zip than me!
entries.translation:
哦哦！
你更有精力嘛！

entries.label: HikerAnthony2SeenText
entries.english:
I came through the
tunnel, but I still have plenty
of energy left.
entries.translation:
虽然刚脱离洞穴，
不过我还精力充沛！

entries.label: HikerAnthonyDunsparceText
entries.english:
Hey, did you get a
DUNSPARCE? I caught one too. Take a look at it
in the light. It'sgot a funny face!
entries.translation:
捉到土龙弟弟了吗？ 我也捉了一只，
到明亮的地方一看，那张脸也太有趣了吧！

entries.label: Route33LassText
entries.english:
Pant, pant… I finally got
through that cave. It was much bigger
than I'd expected. I got too tired to
explore the whole thing, so I came
outside.
entries.translation:
呼……呼……
终于走出这个洞窟了。 里面比原先想象的
要宽阔得多啊。没有逛完就累了，只好先出来了。

entries.label: Route33SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 33
entries.translation: 这里是33号道路

entries.label: CamperTodd1AfterText
entries.english:
Maybe I should
take one to a DAY- CARE. Or maybe use
some items…
entries.translation:
唔……
我该寄放到培育屋里吗？还是该用道具呢？

entries.label: CamperTodd1BeatenText
entries.english:
Did I screw up my
training?
entries.translation: 是我的培养方式不对吗？

entries.label: CamperTodd1SeenText
entries.english:
I'm confident in
my ability toraise #MON. Want to see?
entries.translation:
我有信心能培养好宝可梦，
来和我对战吧！

entries.label: CamperToddSaleText
entries.english:
Shopping under the
sky! It feels so nice
up on a rooftop.
entries.translation:
在蓝天之下购物！
屋顶真令人心情舒畅～

entries.label: CooltrainerfIreneAfterText1
entries.english:
IRENE: My sister
KATE will get youfor this!
entries.translation:
真理纱：我一定要让
真理亚姐姐为我报仇！

entries.label: CooltrainerfIreneAfterText2
entries.english:
IRENE: Isn't this
beach great? It's our secret
little getaway!
entries.translation:
真理纱：沙滩很美吧？
这里是我们的秘密基地！

entries.label: CooltrainerfIreneBeatenText
entries.english:
IRENE: Ohhh!
Too strong!
entries.translation: 真理纱：讨厌～好强啊！

entries.label: CooltrainerfIreneSeenText
entries.english:
IRENE: Kyaaah!
Someone found us!
entries.translation:
真理纱：呀！
来了个不认识的孩子！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJennAfterText1
entries.english:
JENN: Don't get
cocky! My sisterKATE is tough!
entries.translation:
真理香：千万不要大意！
真理亚姐姐很强的！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJennAfterText2
entries.english:
JENN: Sunlight
makes your bodystronger.
entries.translation:
真理香：太阳的光芒
能让身体变得更结实哦！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJennBeatenText
entries.english:
JENN: So sorry,
IRENE! Sis!
entries.translation:
真理香：对不起！
真理纱！姐姐！

entries.label: CooltrainerfJennSeenText
entries.english:
JENN: You can't
beat IRENE and gounpunished!
entries.translation:
真理香：还真敢过来！
我要给真理纱报仇！

entries.label: CooltrainerfKateAfterText
entries.english:
KATE: I'm sorry we
jumped you. We never expected
anyone to find us here. You sure
startled us.
entries.translation:
真理亚：真是很抱歉，
突然向你发起对战。 我们还以为没人会来这里，
所以有点惊慌失措。

entries.label: CooltrainerfKateBeatenText
entries.english:
KATE: No! I can't
believe I lost.
entries.translation:
真理亚：我居然
会输给你！

entries.label: CooltrainerfKateOfferSoftSandText
entries.english:
KATE: You're too
strong. I didn'tstand a chance. Here. You deserve
this.
entries.translation:
真理亚：你好强啊。
我输了，彻底输了…… 这个就给你了！

entries.label: CooltrainerfKateSeenText
entries.english:
KATE: You sure
were mean to mylittle sisters!
entries.translation:
真理亚：你倒是很关照
我那几个妹妹嘛！

entries.label: DayCareSignText
entries.english:
DAY-CARE LET US RAISE YOUR
#MON FOR YOU!
entries.translation:
这里是培育屋
为你培育宝可梦

entries.label: OfficerKeithAfterText
entries.english:
Yep, I see nothing
wrong today. You be good and stay
out of trouble.
entries.translation:
巡逻没有发现异常！
你也多加小心啊。

entries.label: OfficerKeithDaytimeText
entries.english:
I'm on patrol for
suspicious indi-viduals.
entries.translation:
我在附近巡逻，
看看有没有可疑的人。

entries.label: OfficerKeithSeenText
entries.english:
Who goes there?
What are you upto?
entries.translation:
你，就是说你，
在那里干嘛呢？

entries.label: OfficerKeithWinText
entries.english:
You're a tough
little kid.
entries.translation: 好厉害的小朋友啊！

entries.label: PicnickerGina1AfterText
entries.english:
You're too strong
to be a practicepartner.
entries.translation:
你太强了，
根本没法好好练习！

entries.label: PicnickerGina1BeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, no! I just
can't win…
entries.translation:
不行啊！
完全赢不了！

entries.label: PicnickerGina1SeenText
entries.english:
Are you a trainer? Let's have a
practice battle.
entries.translation:
你是宝可梦训练家吗？
那就来当我的练习搭档吧！

entries.label: PokefanmBrandonAfterText
entries.english:
My #MON knew
moves I didn'tknow it had. That confounded me
to no end!
entries.translation:
宝可梦不知道什么时候
记住了我没见过的招式，所以我才会不知所措。

entries.label: PokefanmBrandonBeatenText
entries.english:
Why does it end
this way?
entries.translation: 为什么会这样！？

entries.label: PokefanmBrandonSeenText
entries.english:
I just got my
#MON back fromDAY-CARE. Let's see how much
stronger it got!
entries.translation:
让你看看我刚从培育屋里
取回来的宝可梦究竟变得有多强！

entries.label: Route34IlexForestSignText
entries.english:
ILEX FOREST
THROUGH THE GATE
entries.translation: 穿过大门就是栎树林

entries.label: Route34SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 34 GOLDENROD CITY -
AZALEA TOWN ILEX FOREST
SOMEWHERE BETWEEN
entries.translation:
这里是34号道路
满金市   ……   桧皮镇途经栎树林

entries.label: Route34TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS BERRY trees grow
new BERRIESevery day. Make a note of
which trees bearwhich BERRIES.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 能结果的树木，
每天都会结出新树果。 先记下哪里有什么树果，
有空再回去看看吧！

entries.label: YoungsterIanAfterText
entries.english:
I'm trying hard so
I can be the starin my class.
entries.translation:
为了在班里能有面子，
我还会不断地努力。

entries.label: YoungsterIanBeatenText
entries.english:
No! There are bet-
ter trainers…
entries.translation:
哦呦呦……
天外有天吗……

entries.label: YoungsterIanSeenText
entries.english:
I'm the best in my
class at #MON.
entries.translation:
我是我们班
宝可梦最强的人哦！

entries.label: YoungsterSamuelAfterText
entries.english:
I'm going to train
even harder. After all, I'm
trying to becomea GYM LEADER.
entries.translation:
如果一般的练习还不够，
那就要进行特训！毕竟我的梦想是道馆馆主！

entries.label: YoungsterSamuelBeatenText
entries.english:
Beaten by a
passing stranger!
entries.translation: 我输给了过路的！

entries.label: YoungsterSamuelMobileText
entries.english:
Have you been to
GOLDENROD CITY? Weren't you amazed
by how they've changed the
#MON CENTER?
entries.translation:
去过满金市了吗？
宝可梦中心焕然一新，没想到吧？

entries.label: YoungsterSamuelSeenText
entries.english:
This is where I do
my training!
entries.translation:
这一带是我的
练习用地！

entries.label: Route34IlexForestGateButterfreeText
entries.english: BUTTERFREE: Freeh!
entries.translation: 巴大蝶：大蝶！

entries.label: Route34IlexForestGateLassText
entries.english:
Did you see the
shrine honoringthe protector? It watches over
the FOREST fromacross time. I think that it
must be a grass-type #MON.
entries.translation:
你参拜过
森林之神的祠堂吗？ 森林之神能超越时间
为我们守护森林哦。它一定是草属性宝可梦吧。

entries.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacherText
entries.english:
Oh, honey. You're
making a #DEX? It must be hard if
#MON won't appear. Try using
this TM.
entries.translation:
嗯，你是要完成
宝可梦图鉴吗？ 遇不到宝可梦很头疼吧？
要不，你用用看这个招式学习器吧？

entries.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_ForestIsRestless
entries.english:
Something's wrong
in ILEX FOREST… You should stay
away right now.
entries.translation:
栎树林的样子
有些奇怪…… 这会儿还是
别进去比较好吧。

entries.label: Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_GotSweetScent
entries.english:
It's SWEET SCENT. Use it wherever
#MON appear. #MON will be
enticed by it.
entries.translation:
里面含有甜甜香气。 在能遇见宝可梦的地方
使用的话…… 就会出现被甜甜香气
吸引而来的宝可梦哦。

entries.label: BirdKeeperBryanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Some #MON flee
right away. Try catching them
with KURT's FASTBALL. Whenever I find a
WHT APRICORN, Itake it to KURT. He turns it into a
custom BALL.
entries.translation:
有些宝可梦逃得很快，
这种时候最好用的就是钢铁先生的速度球！ 每当我找到白球果，
就会把它交给钢铁先生，让他制作特制的球。

entries.label: BirdKeeperBryanBeatenText
entries.english:
Yikes! Not fast
enough!
entries.translation:
呀！
速度还不够吗。

entries.label: BirdKeeperBryanSeenText
entries.english:
What kinds of
BALLS do you use?
entries.translation:
你捕捉宝可梦的时候，
都在用哪种球呢？

entries.label: BugCatcherArnieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
My VENONAT won me
the Bug-Catching Contest at the
NATIONAL PARK.
entries.translation:
我就是靠宝贵的毛球
在公园的捕虫大赛里获得了第一名！

entries.label: BugCatcherArnieBeatenText
entries.english:
Huh? I shouldn't
have lost that…
entries.translation:
什么？
我竟然会输……

entries.label: BugCatcherArnieSeenText
entries.english:
I'll go anywhere
if bug #MONappear there.
entries.translation:
只要有虫宝可梦，
什么地方我都愿意去！

entries.label: BugCatcherArnieYanmaText
entries.english:
Wow… Look at all
those YANMA! I'm so blown away,
I can't move.
entries.translation:
天哪……
这里到处都是蜻蜻蜓呀！ 我感动得不知所措了！

entries.label: CamperElliotAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I was humiliated
in front of mygirlfriend…
entries.translation:
反而在女朋友面前
出丑了……

entries.label: CamperElliotBeatenText
entries.english:
I wish you would
have lost for me…
entries.translation:
求你了……
能不能输给我啊……

entries.label: CamperElliotSeenText
entries.english:
I'm gonna show my
girlfriend I'm hotstuff!
entries.translation:
好吧！就在女朋友面前
好好展示一下吧！

entries.label: CamperIvanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Music on the radio
changes the moodsof wild #MON.
entries.translation:
播放广播节目中的音乐
有时能让野生宝可梦镇静，有时能让它们变得更活跃！

entries.label: CamperIvanBeatenText
entries.english: I give!
entries.translation: 我输了！

entries.label: CamperIvanSeenText
entries.english:
I've been getting
#MON data off my radio. I think
I'm good.
entries.translation:
靠广播收集到了
很多宝可梦情报呢。我现在应该挺强的。

entries.label: FirebreatherWaltAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The #MON March
on the radio lureswild #MON.
entries.translation:
用广播听宝可梦进行曲，
宝可梦会比平时更易扑来！

entries.label: FirebreatherWaltBeatenText
entries.english:
Ow! I scorched the
tip of my nose!
entries.translation:
烫烫烫……
刚才烧到鼻子了。

entries.label: FirebreatherWaltSeenText
entries.english:
I'm practicing my
fire breathing.
entries.translation:
我在这种地方
进行喷火练习！

entries.label: JugglerIrwin1BeatenText
entries.english:
Whew! That was a
jolt!
entries.translation: 噫——发麻了。

entries.label: JugglerIrwin1SeenText
entries.english:
Behold my graceful
BALL dexterity!
entries.translation:
看！
这华丽的丢投球姿势！

entries.label: JugglerIrwinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I was going to
dazzle you with myprize #MON. But your prowess
electrified me!
entries.translation:
本来想用我自豪的宝可梦
让你麻痹的，反而被你的强大迷倒了！

entries.label: OfficerDirkAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You know, night-
time is fun in itsown ways. But don't overdo
it, OK?
entries.translation:
夜晚有夜晚的快乐，
但你也别玩过头了。

entries.label: OfficerDirkBeatenText
entries.english: Whoops!
entries.translation: 哎呀呀。

entries.label: OfficerDirkPrettyToughText
entries.english:
Your #MON look
pretty tough. You could go any-
where safely.
entries.translation:
因为你有强大的宝可梦，
所以去哪都不怕，对吧？

entries.label: OfficerDirkSeenText
entries.english:
Danger lurks in
the night!
entries.translation: 夜晚充满了危险！

entries.label: PicnickerBrookeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I can count on my
#MON more thanmy boyfriend.
entries.translation:
比起男朋友，
还是宝可梦更可靠呢。

entries.label: PicnickerBrookeBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, my! You're so
strong!
entries.translation: 哎，你好强啊！

entries.label: PicnickerBrookeSeenText
entries.english:
My boyfriend's
weak, so I can'trely on him.
entries.translation:
我的男朋友好弱，
真靠不住啊……

entries.label: PicnickerKimAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The GYM BADGES are
pretty. I collectthem.
entries.translation:
道馆给的徽章很漂亮，
所以我在收集它们。

entries.label: PicnickerKimBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh. I couldn't
win…
entries.translation: 嗯，赢不了哇……

entries.label: PicnickerKimSeenText
entries.english:
Are you going to
the GYM? Me too!
entries.translation:
你要去宝可梦道馆？
我也是！

entries.label: Route35SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 35
entries.translation: 这里是35号道路

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateFisherText
entries.english:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MON there are in the
world. Three years ago,
PROF.OAK said that there were 150
different kinds.
entries.translation:
世界上到底有
多少种宝可梦呢。 大木博士
3年前的报告中是说总共有150种……

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGatePlayerReceivedAMonWithMailText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received a
#MON with MAIL.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}收下了
持有邮件的宝可梦！

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText
entries.english:
A strange tree is
blocking the road. It wriggles around
if you talk to it. I heard it became
wild when someone watered it with a
SQUIRTBOTTLE.
entries.translation:
我听说有棵树把路堵住了，
和它搭话，它还会扭起来。 我还听说，用杰尼龟喷壶
给它浇水，它就会发狂。

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText_FoughtSudowoodo
entries.english:
I like the #MON
Lullaby they playon the radio.
entries.translation:
我喜欢收音机播放的
宝可梦摇篮曲。

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyAskTakeThisMonToMyFriendText
entries.english:
Excuse me, kid!
Can you do a guya favor? Can you take this
#MON with MAILto my friend? He's on ROUTE 31.
entries.translation:
喂——说你呢！ 能拜托你把这只
持有邮件的宝可梦交给我的朋友吗？他在31号道路。

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyCantCarryAnotherMonText
entries.english:
You can't carry
another #MON…
entries.translation:
你好像带不下
更多宝可梦了……

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyMyPalWasSnoozingRightText
entries.english:
My pal was snooz-
ing, right? Heh,what'd I say?
entries.translation:
我的朋友当时在睡觉吧？
他这人就知道睡觉！

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyOhNeverMindThenText
entries.english:
Oh… Never mind,
then…
entries.translation:
是吗……
没办法啊……

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandySomethingForYourTroubleText
entries.english:
Thanks, kid! You
made the deliveryfor me! Here's something
for your trouble!
entries.translation:
谢谢！
你顺利地完成了寄送任务！我要给你谢礼！

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyThanksText
entries.english:
You will? Perfect!
Thanks, kid! My pal's a chubby
guy who snoozesall the time. You'll recognize
him right away!
entries.translation:
谢谢！ 我的朋友是个胖胖的男人，
他总是在打瞌睡，应该是很好找的！

entries.label: Route35GoldenrodGateRandyWeirdTreeBlockingRoadText
entries.english:
You can read it,
but don't lose it!ROUTE 31! Oh, yeah. There
was a weird treeblocking the road. I wonder if it's
been cleared?
entries.translation:
邮件可以随便读，
但千万别弄丢了！是31号道路哦！拜托了！ ……哎呀！
我听别人说，有棵奇怪的树堵在路中间。现在已经能通行了吗？

entries.label: BugCatchingContestExplanationText
entries.english:
The Bug-Catching
Contest is held on Tuesday, Thursday
and Saturday. Not only do you
earn a prize just for participating,
you also get to keep the bug
#MON you may have at the end of
the contest.
entries.translation:
捕虫大赛的
举办日是……周二、周四、周六。 参赛者能获得奖品。
而且捉到的虫宝可梦也会在大赛结束之后变成自己的宝可梦。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToParticipateText
entries.english:
Today's {STRBUF}.
That means the Bug-Catching Con-
test is on today. The rules are sim-
ple. Using one of your
#MON, catch a bug #MON to be
judged. Would you like to
give it a try?
entries.translation:
今天是星期{STRBUF}。
将举办捕虫大赛！ 规则很简单！ 就是比一下
谁能只带一只同行宝可梦捕捉到最强的虫宝可梦。 要参加吗？

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToUseFirstMonText
entries.english:
Uh-oh… You have more than
one #MON. You'll have to use
{STRBUF}, the first #MON in
your party. Is that OK with
you?
entries.translation:
哎呀？
你带的宝可梦不止1只！ 那就用排头的宝可梦……
{STRBUF}参加本次比赛？这样可以吗？

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ChooseMonAndComeBackText
entries.english:
Please choose the
#MON to be used in the Contest,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
决定好在大赛
出战的宝可梦之后，再来找我吧。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ContestIsOverText
entries.english:
Today's Contest is
over. We hope you will participate
in the future.
entries.translation:
今天的比赛
已经结束了，请下次再来参加！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1EggAsFirstMonText
entries.english:
Uh-oh…
You have an EGG as the first #MON
in your party. Please switch it
with the #MON you want to use,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
排头的宝可梦好像是颗蛋呢。 请替换宝可梦之后
再来吧。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ExplainsRulesText
entries.english:
The person who
gets the strong-est bug #MONis the winner. You have 20
minutes. If you run out of
PARK BALLS, you'redone. You can keep the
last #MON youcatch as your own. Go out and catch
the strongest bug #MON you can
find!
entries.translation:
谁捉到的宝可梦最强，
谁就是第一名！ 限制时间是20分钟！ 另外，公园球用完时
比赛会强制结束！ 捕捉到的最后一只宝可梦
会归参赛者所有！ 请努力捕捉
强大的宝可梦吧！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1FirstMonCantBattleText
entries.english:
Uh-oh…
The first #MON in your party
can't battle. Please switch it
with the #MON you want to use,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
排头的宝可梦好像无法战斗呢。 请替换宝可梦之后
再来吧。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkBallsText
entries.english:
Here are the PARK
BALLS for theContest.
entries.translation:
这是大赛专用球，
请拿好！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1MakeRoomText
entries.english:
Uh-oh…
Both your party and your PC BOX
are full. You have no room
to put the bug#MON you catch. Please make room
in your party or your PC BOX, then
come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
无论同行还是电脑的盒子好像都已经满了。 现在这个状况，
无法带走捉到的虫宝可梦。 请对同行与电脑的盒子
进行整理，之后再过来吧。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1OkGoFinishText
entries.english:
OK. Please get
back outside andfinish up.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
那就请你好好利用剩下的时间！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1TakePartInFutureText
entries.english:
OK. We hope you'll
take part in thefuture.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
请下次再来参加！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WaitAtNorthGateText
entries.english:
OK. Please wait at
the North Gate for the announcement
of the winners.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
那就请你去上面的大门等待结果公布吧。

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WantToFinishText
entries.translation:
剩余的时间
还有{STRBUF}分钟。已经要结束了吗？

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WeHoldContestsText
entries.english:
We hold Contests
regularly in the PARK. You should
give it a shot.
entries.translation:
有时会在公园里
举行捕虫大赛。到时候你也来参加吧？

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldYourMonText
entries.english:
Fine, we'll hold
your other #MONwhile you compete.
entries.translation:
那么剩下的宝可梦
将会暂时寄放在此处！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGatePlayerReceivedParkBallsText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
20 PARK BALLS.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
20个公园球！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGatePlayersMonLeftWithHelperText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}'s #MON
were left with theCONTEST HELPER.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}将宝可梦
寄放在了工作人员那里！

entries.label: Route35NationalParkGateYoungsterText
entries.english:
When is the next
Bug-Catching Con-test going to be?
entries.translation:
下次捕虫大赛
是在什么时候举行呢？

entries.label: ArthurGaveGiftText
entries.english:
ARTHUR: A #MON
that uses rock- type moves should
hold on to that. It pumps up rock-
type attacks.
entries.translation:
星祺四：让宝可梦携带它
再使出岩石属性招式…… 岩石属性招式的
攻击力就会提升哦！

entries.label: ArthurGivesGiftText
entries.english:
Here. You can have
this.
entries.translation: 好的，收下这个！

entries.label: ArthurNotThursdayText
entries.english:
ARTHUR: Today's
not Thursday. Howdisappointing.
entries.translation:
星祺四：今天
不是星期四吗……好失望啊。

entries.label: ArthurThursdayText
entries.english:
ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR
of Thursday. I'm the second son out
of seven children.
entries.translation:
星祺四：我是
星期四的星祺四！7个孩子里的二儿子！

entries.label: FloriaText1
entries.english:
I'm the FLOWER
SHOP's FLORIA! Listen, listen! When I sprinkled
water on that wiggly tree, it
jumped right up! It just has to be
a #MON. I bet it would be
shocked out of its disguise if you
soaked it! I know! I'll tell
my sis and borrowher water bottle!
entries.translation:
我是花店的绽芳。 听我说，听我说！ 我试着给会动的树浇水，
它居然吓了一跳！ 我猜它肯定是宝可梦！ 再多浇点水吓吓它，
它一定会原形毕露！ 对了！
我要把这件事告诉姐姐，让她把喷壶借给我！

entries.label: FloriaText2
entries.english:
When I told my sis
about the jiggly tree, she said
it's dangerous. If I beat WHITNEY,
I wonder if she'll lend me her water
bottle…
entries.translation:
我跟我姐姐讲了
那棵会动的树的事情，她却说太危险了别管它！ 如果我能打赢小茜，
她就给我喷壶吧……

entries.label: MeetArthurText
entries.english:
ARTHUR: Who are
you? I'm ARTHUR of
Thursday.
entries.translation: 星祺四：你是谁？ 我是星期四的星祺四。

entries.label: PsychicMarkAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'd be strong if
only I could tell what my opponent
was thinking.
entries.translation:
如果进攻时能预测对手，
那就会变得十分强大！

entries.label: PsychicMarkBeatenText
entries.english: I misread you!
entries.translation: 没猜中！

entries.label: PsychicMarkSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to read
your thoughts!
entries.translation: 让我猜猜你的心思！

entries.label: RockSmashGuyText1
entries.english:
Wa-hey! I was going to
snap that tree with my straight-
arm punch. But I couldn't!
I'm a failure!
entries.translation:
你好呀！ 我本来以为，
靠我那厚重的掌力，推倒一两棵树不在话下…… 但是办不到呀！
真是太遗憾了呀！

entries.label: RockSmashGuyText2
entries.english:
Did you clear that
wretched tree? I'm impressed!
I want you tohave this.
entries.translation:
是你帮我搞定了
那棵碍事的树？ 真是令人惭愧呀！
我要送给你这个呀！

entries.label: RockSmashGuyText3
entries.english:
That happens to be
ROCK SMASH. You can shatter
rocks with just a single well-aimed
smack. If any rocks are
in your way, justsmash 'em up!
entries.translation:
里面是必杀碎岩！
只要有了这个招式，随手一击就能打碎岩块！ 请你尽情地
去击碎岩块呀！

entries.label: Route36LassText
entries.english:
An odd tree is
blocking the wayto GOLDENROD CITY. It's preventing
me from shopping. Something should
be done about it.
entries.translation:
路上长了棵奇怪的树，
不能去满金市买东西了！希望能有人解决这个问题。

entries.label: Route36LassText_ClearedSudowoodo
entries.english:
That odd tree dis-
appeared without atrace. Oh! That tree was
really a #MON?
entries.translation:
那棵奇怪的树
消失得无影无踪…… 什么！它是宝可梦？

entries.label: Route36SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 36
entries.translation: 这里是36号道路

entries.label: Route36TrainerTips1Text
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS #MON stats
vary--even withinthe same species. Their stats may be
similar at first. However, differ-
ences will become pronounced as the
#MON grow.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 即使是同一种宝可梦，
强弱也存有差异。 即使刚开始都差不多，
培育后也会产生巨大差异。

entries.label: Route36TrainerTips2Text
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS Use DIG to return
to the entrance ofany place. It is convenient
for exploring caves and other
landmarks.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 如果使用了
“挖洞”这一招式，就可以瞬间返回入口。 在洞穴探险的时候，
如有宝可梦会使用挖洞，旅行也会轻松不少吧。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphNorthSignText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH
NORTH ENTRANCE
entries.translation:
阿露福遗迹
北侧入口

entries.label: SchoolboyAlan1BeatenText
entries.english:
Oops! Computation
error?
entries.translation:
什么……？
计算失误了？

entries.label: SchoolboyAlan1SeenText
entries.english:
Thanks to my stud-
ies, I'm ready forany #MON!
entries.translation:
我已经充分地预习过
如何面对各种宝可梦！

entries.label: SchoolboyAlanBooksText
entries.english:
Darn. I study five
hours a day too. There's more to
learning than justreading books.
entries.translation:
唔唔唔唔唔……
我每天花5小时学习啊…… 这世上有很多事情
光靠教科书是学不会的呢。

entries.label: SudowoodoAttackedText
entries.english:
The weird tree
doesn't like theSQUIRTBOTTLE! The weird tree
attacked!
entries.translation:
奇怪的树好像很反感
杰尼龟喷壶！ 奇怪的树扑过来了！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedTM08
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM08.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
招式学习器08！

entries.label: UnusedOddTreeText
entries.english:
An odd tree is
blocking the wayto GOLDENROD CITY. I wanted to go see
the huge #MON CENTER they just
opened…
entries.translation:
路上长了棵奇怪的树，
没法去满金市了！ 之前有人告诉我，
那里建了超大宝可梦中心，我真的好想去看看啊……

entries.label: UseSquirtbottleText
entries.english:
It's a weird tree.
Use SQUIRTBOTTLE?
entries.translation:
有棵奇怪的树！
要使用杰尼龟喷壶吗？

entries.label: UsedSquirtbottleText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} used the
SQUIRTBOTTLE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}使用了
杰尼龟喷壶！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant10BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
KIPP: I study a
lot, but that's not good enough to
win.
entries.translation:
智行：虽然学了很多……
但光靠学习还是赢不了的。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant10BText
entries.english:
KIPP: Could you
give me some tips? I want to study
your style.
entries.translation:
智行：请你教我秘诀！
我真的很想学！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant1BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
DON: Luck plays a
big part in this. You never know
what #MON willappear.
entries.translation:
干泰：能不能遇见宝可梦，
也是要看运气的。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant1BText
entries.english:
DON: Wow, you beat
me. You're prettygood.
entries.translation:
干泰：居然能赢过我……
你很有本事啊！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant2BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
ED: Maybe you win
with big #MON?
entries.translation:
辉奇：难道说宝可梦越大
越容易获得第一名？

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant2BText
entries.english:
ED: I envy you.
I just couldn'tdo it this time.
entries.translation:
辉奇：哇，羡慕嫉妒恨！
我这次状态不佳！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant3BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
NICK: Maybe you
get a higher score for a #MON of
an unusual color.
entries.translation:
小建：如果是特殊颜色的
宝可梦，得分会更高！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant3BText
entries.english:
NICK: Well done!
I'm going to raisemy #MON better.
entries.translation:
小建：真是精彩！
我要重新培育宝可梦！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant4BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
WILLIAM: Well, I'm
satisfied because I caught a #MON
that I wanted.
entries.translation:
彰宏：只要能找到想要的
宝可梦，我就满足了。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant4BText
entries.english:
WILLIAM: You're
the winner? Whatdid you catch?
entries.translation:
彰宏：第一名是你啊！
你捉的是什么宝可梦啊？

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant5BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
BENNY: I caught a
SCYTHER before,but I didn't win.
entries.translation:
贞夫：之前
连飞天螳螂都捉到了，结果却没成为第一名……

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant5BText
entries.english:
BENNY: Congrats!
You have earned myrespect!
entries.translation:
贞夫：恭喜！
我开始尊敬你了！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant6BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
BARRY: It's easier
to win if you get a high-level bug
#MON. But I think they
also consider someother points.
entries.translation:
雄一：等级越高
越容易被评为第一名……不过得分点也不只这一个。

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant6BText
entries.english:
BARRY: That #-
MON you caught…it's awesome!
entries.translation:
雄一：你捉到的宝可梦
真是太酷了！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant7BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
CINDY: I really
love bug #MON!
entries.translation:
里美：我超级喜欢
虫宝可梦哦！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant7BText
entries.english:
CINDY: You won?
That's great! Do you feel like
looking for bug#MON with me?
entries.translation:
里美：你是第一名！？
太厉害了吧！！ 下次要不要和我一起
去捕捉虫宝可梦？

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant8BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
JOSH: I heard that
somebody won witha CATERPIE!
entries.translation:
友道：我听说曾经有人
靠绿毛虫当上第一名！

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant8BText
entries.english:
JOSH: I… I can't
believe I lost atbug-catching…
entries.translation:
友道：在捉虫宝可梦方面
我居然输给了别人……

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant9BStillCompetingText
entries.english:
SAMUEL: Darn.
I thought I wouldscore higher…
entries.translation:
康太：嗯？我的得分
不应该只有这么点啊……

entries.label: BugCatchingContestant9BText
entries.english:
SAMUEL: Next time,
I'm going to win.
entries.translation: 康太：下次我一定会赢！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToParticipateText
entries.english:
Today's {STRBUF}.
That means the Bug-Catching Con-
test is on today. The rules are sim-
ple. Using one of your
#MON, catch a bug #MON to be
judged. Would you like to
give it a try?
entries.translation:

将举办捕虫大赛！ 规则很简单！ 就是比一下
谁能只带一只同行宝可梦捕捉到最强的虫宝可梦。 要参加吗？

entries.english:
Uh-oh… You have more than
one #MON. You'll have to use
{STRBUF}, the first #MON in
your party. Is that OK with
you?
entries.translation:
哎呀？
你带的宝可梦不止1只！ 那就用排头的宝可梦……
{STRBUF}参加本次比赛？这样可以吗？

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ChooseMonAndComeBackText
entries.english:
Please choose the
#MON to be used in the Contest,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
决定好在大赛
出战的宝可梦之后，再来找我吧。

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ContestIsOverText
entries.english:
Today's Contest is
over. We hope you will participate
in the future.
entries.translation:
今天的比赛
已经结束了，请下次再来参加！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1EggAsFirstMonText
entries.english:
Uh-oh…
You have an EGG as the first #MON
in your party. Please switch it
with the #MON you want to use,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
排头的宝可梦好像是颗蛋呢。 请替换宝可梦之后
再来吧。

entries.english:
The person who
gets the strong-est bug #MONis the winner. You have 20
minutes. If you run out of
PARK BALLS, you'redone. You can keep the

the strongest bug #MON you can

entries.translation:
谁捉到的宝可梦最强，

会归参赛者所有！ 请努力捕捉
