entries.english:
Uh-oh…
The first #MON in your party
can't battle. Please switch it
with the #MON you want to use,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
排头的宝可梦好像无法战斗呢。 请替换宝可梦之后
再来吧。

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkBallsText
entries.english:
Here are the PARK
BALLS for theContest.
entries.translation:
这是大赛专用球，
请拿好！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1HeresThePrizeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}? Here's the prize
we were holdingfor you.
entries.translation:
您是{PLAYER}吧？ 给，
这是帮您保管的奖品。

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1MakeRoomText
entries.english:
Uh-oh…
Both your party and your PC BOX
are full. You have no room
to put the bug#MON you catch. Please make room
in your party or your PC BOX, then
come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
无论同行还是电脑的盒子好像都已经满了。 现在这个状况，
无法带走捉到的虫宝可梦。 请对同行与电脑的盒子
进行整理，之后再过来吧。

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1OkGoFinishText
entries.english:
OK. Please go back
outside and finishup.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
那就请你好好利用剩下的时间！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1SomeMonOnlySeenInParkText
entries.english:
Some #MON can
only be seen inthe PARK.
entries.translation:
有些宝可梦
只能在公园里找到哦！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1TakePartInFutureText
entries.english:
OK. We hope you'll
take part in thefuture.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
请下次再来参加！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WaitHereForAnnouncementText
entries.english:
OK. Please wait
here for the announcement of
the winners.
entries.translation:
这样吗，
那就请你在这里等待结果公布吧。

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WantToFinishText
entries.translation:
剩余的时间
还有{STRBUF}分钟。已经要结束了吗？

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldPrizeText
entries.english:
Uh-oh… Your PACK
is full. We'll hold on to
your prize, butonly for today. Please make room,
then come see me.
entries.translation:
哎呀？
您的行李好像装满了…… 我们可以先帮您保管，
但仅限今天一天。请整理好行李再来！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldYourMonText
entries.english:
Fine, we'll hold
your other #MONwhile you compete.
entries.translation:
那么剩下的宝可梦
将会暂时寄放在此处！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGatePlayerReceivedParkBallsText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
20 PARK BALLS.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
20个公园球！

entries.label: Route36NationalParkGatePlayersMonLeftWithHelperText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}'s #MON
were left with theCONTEST HELPER.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}将宝可梦
寄放在了工作人员那里！

entries.label: UnusedBugCatchingContestExplanationText
entries.english:
The Bug-Catching
Contest is held on Tuesday, Thursday
and Saturday. Not only do you
earn a prize just for participating,
you also get to keep the bug
#MON you may have at the end of
the contest.
entries.translation:
捕虫大赛的
举办日是……周二、周四、周六。 参赛者能获得奖品。
而且捉到的虫宝可梦也会在大赛结束之后变成自己的宝可梦。

entries.label: UnusedSilphScope2Text
entries.english:
I hear there's a
#MON that looksjust like a tree. You can reveal its
identity using aSILPHSCOPE 2.
entries.translation:
据说某处有种宝可梦
长得像一棵大树。 要是有二代西尔佛检视镜，
就能查明它的真身了。

entries.label: Route36RuinsOfAlphGateGrampsText
entries.english:
Did you see that
strange tree inthe road? That may explain
why fewer people are visiting the
RUINS OF ALPH.
entries.translation:
路上有棵奇怪的树对吧？
可能就是因为这东西，来遗迹的游客变少了。

entries.label: Route36RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText
entries.english:
Don't you wonder
who'd make some-thing like this?And why?
entries.translation:
遗迹的建造者是谁？
又是为什么而建造的呢？

entries.label: MeetSunnyText
entries.english:
SUNNY: Hi! I'm SUNNY of Sun-
day, meaning it'sSunday today!
entries.translation:
星祺天：我呢，
就是星期天的星祺天！

entries.label: PsychicGregAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Putting #MON to
sleep or paralyz-ing them are goodbattle techniques.
entries.translation:
让对方陷入麻痹或睡眠，
从而剥夺对方的自由。这是非常重要的技巧。

entries.label: PsychicGregBeatenText
entries.english:
I lost. That's
pretty sad…
entries.translation:
输了……
我好悲伤啊。

entries.label: PsychicGregSeenText
entries.english:
#MON can't do a
thing if they areasleep. I'll show you how
scary that is!
entries.translation:
如果宝可梦陷入睡眠，
就做不了任何事情。我要让你体验这种恐惧！

entries.label: Route37SignText
entries.english: ROUTE 37
entries.translation: 这里是37号道路

entries.label: SunnyGaveGiftText
entries.english:
SUNNY: That thing… Um… … What was it now… … Oh! I remember
now! A #MON that
knows electric moves should hold
it. My sis MONICA said
it powers upelectric moves!
entries.translation:
星祺天：这个就是…… 呃…… ……是什么来着？ …… …… …… 啊！
想起来了！ 让宝可梦携带它，
再使出电属性招式，招式威力就会变强！这是星琪一姐姐说的！

entries.label: SunnyGivesGiftText1
entries.english:
I was told to give
you this if I sawyou!
entries.translation:
既然遇见了大哥哥，
我就要按规矩送出这个！

entries.label: SunnyGivesGiftText2
entries.english:
I was told to give
you this if I sawyou!
entries.translation:
既然遇见了大姐姐，
我就要按规矩送出这个！

entries.label: SunnyNotSundayText
entries.english:
SUNNY: Isn't today
Sunday?Um… I forgot!
entries.translation:
星祺天：今天不是
星期天呀？呃……我忘了！

entries.label: SunnySundayText
entries.english:
SUNNY: My sisters
and brothers areMONICA, TUSCANY,WESLEY, ARTHUR,FRIEDA and SANTOS. They're all older
than me!
entries.translation:
星祺天：大姐星琪一，
二姐星琪二，三哥星祺三，四哥星祺四，五姐星琪五，还有六哥星祺六！ 而我是最小的！

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
ANN: I can tell
what my sister and my #MON are
thinking.
entries.translation:
茉奈：我懂姐姐的想法，
也懂宝可梦的想法。

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne1BeatenText
entries.english:
ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A
little too strong.
entries.translation:
茉奈和佳奈：唔……
你有点强啊。

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne1SeenText
entries.english:
ANN: ANNE and I
are in this to-gether!
entries.translation:
茉奈：我会和佳奈
齐心协力的！

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
ANNE: We share the
same feelings asour #MON.
entries.translation:
佳奈：我们姐妹
和宝可梦异体同心！

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne2BeatenText
entries.english:
ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A
little too strong.
entries.translation:
茉奈和佳奈：唔……
你有点强啊。

entries.label: TwinsAnnandanne2SeenText
entries.english:
ANNE: ANN and I
are in this to-gether!
entries.translation:
佳奈：我会和茉奈
齐心协力的！

entries.label: BeautyOliviaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
MOOMOO MILK is
good for beauty and health, but
inconveniently, they only sell a
bottle at a time.
entries.translation:
哞哞鲜奶
既能养颜又能养生， 最大的缺点是
一次只能买一瓶。

entries.label: BeautyOliviaBeatenText
entries.english:
We drink MOOMOO
MILK every day.
entries.translation:
为了美容养颜，
我们每天都喝哞哞鲜奶哦！

entries.label: BeautyOliviaSeenText
entries.english:
Don't you think my
#MON and I arebeautiful?
entries.translation:
那个，你不觉得
宝可梦和我都很美吗？

entries.label: BeautyValerieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
When I see #-
MON, it seems tosoothe my nerves.
entries.translation:
每次看到宝可梦，
都会让人感到舒心，或者说是让人安心吧。

entries.label: BeautyValerieBeatenText
entries.english:
I'm glad I got to
see your #MON!
entries.translation:
看到了好多宝可梦，
我真是太幸福了——！

entries.label: BeautyValerieSeenText
entries.english:
Hi! Aren't you a
cute trainer! May I see your
#MON?
entries.translation:
嘿！
这位可爱的训练家！ 带着怎样的宝可梦啊，
让我看看嘛？

entries.label: BirdKeeperTobyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I plan to train in
CIANWOOD CITY to teach my #MON
how to FLY.
entries.translation:
为了让宝可梦学会
能在天空飞翔的招式，我打算去湛蓝市修行！

entries.label: BirdKeeperTobyBeatenText
entries.english:
I feel like just
flying away now.
entries.translation:
我现在想直接乘上
鸟宝可梦去旅行呢。

entries.label: BirdKeeperTobySeenText
entries.english:
Fly high into the
sky, my belovedbird #MON!
entries.translation:
展翅翱翔吧，
我的鸟宝可梦！

entries.label: LassDana1BeatenText
entries.english:
I see. So you can
battle that way.
entries.translation:
原来如此……
还有这种战斗方式啊。

entries.label: LassDana1SeenText
entries.english:
You seem to be
good at #MON. If you are, how
about giving mesome advice?
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦貌似很强啊！ 既然你这么强，
教我一些小窍门呗！

entries.label: LassDanaMoomooMilkText
entries.english:
I know something
good! MOOMOO FARM's milk
is famous for itsflavor.
entries.translation:
告诉你一些有用的情报吧： 哞哞牧场的鲜奶，
喝了都说好哦。

entries.label: Route38SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 38 OLIVINE CITY -
ECRUTEAK CITY
entries.translation:
这里是38号道路
浅葱市   ……   缘朱市

entries.label: Route38TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS If a #MON is
trying to evolve,you can stop it. Press the B But-
ton during evolu-tion. That startles the
#MON and stopsits evolution.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 在宝可梦进化时
按下B键，受惊的宝可梦会停止进化。这被称为“取消进化”。

entries.label: SailorHarryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
All kinds of peo-
ple around the world live happily
with #MON.
entries.translation:
在各种各样的国家
生活着各种各样的人，他们都和宝可梦和谐共处。

entries.label: SailorHarryBeatenText
entries.english:
Your skill is
world class!
entries.translation:
你简直就是
世界级水平！

entries.label: SailorHarrySeenText
entries.english:
I've been over-
seas, so I know about all sorts of
#MON!
entries.translation:
我去过各种国家，
认得很多宝可梦哦！

entries.label: SchoolboyChad1BeatenText
entries.english:
I didn't study
enough, I guess.
entries.translation:
哎呀，不对劲啊？
是我的学识太浅薄了吗？

entries.label: SchoolboyChad1SeenText
entries.english:
Let me try some-
thing I learnedtoday.
entries.translation:
那么请让我赶紧试试
今天新学到的知识吧。

entries.label: SchoolboyChadSoManyTestsText
entries.english:
I have to take so
many tests, I don't have much
time for #MON. So when I do get
to play, I reallyconcentrate.
entries.translation:
平时光顾着考试了，
都没怎么研究宝可梦。 所以能用宝可梦的时候，
我都会全神贯注哦！

entries.label: Route38EcruteakGateOfficerText
entries.english:
Where did you say
you're from? NEW BARK TOWN? PROF.ELM lives
over there, right? You've come a long
way to get here.
entries.translation:
你是打哪来的？ 哎，若叶镇！？ 啊，就是空木博士
所在的那个城市嘛，那可真是远道而来呢。

entries.label: MoomooFarmSignText
entries.english:
MOOMOO FARM Enjoy Our Fresh
and Tasty Milk
entries.translation:
哞哞牧场
来杯美味的现榨鲜奶吧！

entries.label: PokefanMDerekPikachuIsItText
entries.english:
PIKACHU is it!
Don't you agree?
entries.translation:
果然还是皮卡丘最棒！
你也是这么想的吧？

entries.label: PokefanMDerekText_NotBragging
entries.english:
I'm not listening
to your bragging! We # FANS have
a policy of not listening to other
people brag!
entries.translation:
不听别人的炫耀！
这可是我们发烧友俱乐部的规定！

entries.label: PokefanfJaimeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I met my MEOWTH at
night, right hereon ROUTE 39. I'm not sure why,
but it seems to like it when I
train here. It seems to become
friendlier by training here than
anywhere else.
entries.translation:
这只小喵喵，是我在
夜间的39号道路遇见的。 虽然不知道对不对……
只要晚上在这里训练它，它就会变得非常开心。 如果在其他地方训练它，
它肯定不会这么亲近我。

entries.label: PokefanfJaimeBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, how disap-
pointing…
entries.translation: 呀，好遗憾啊……

entries.label: PokefanfJaimeHopeItGetsDarkText
entries.english:
Ufufufu… I hope it
gets dark soon.
entries.translation:
呵呵，
夜幕不能快点降临嘛？

entries.label: PokefanfJaimeSeenText
entries.english:
You came at just
the right time. Let's battle.
entries.translation:
来得正好，
来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: PokefanfRuthAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Do you know about
baby #MON? I bet they're just
adorable!
entries.translation:
你有没有听说过
宝可梦有小宝宝呢？一定非常可爱吧？

entries.label: PokefanfRuthBeatenText
entries.english:
I don't mind
losing.
entries.translation: 输了也无所谓了。

entries.label: PokefanfRuthSeenText
entries.english:
Such darling
#MON. Let's show our
#MON togetherat the same time.
entries.translation:
喂，和我同时拿出
可爱的宝可梦吧？

entries.label: PokefanmDerekBeatenText
entries.english:
I had no time to
show off PIKACHU…
entries.translation:
一直都没机会
炫耀我的小皮卡丘……

entries.label: PokefanmDerekSeenText
entries.english:
This is a good
time to brag aboutmy PIKACHU!
entries.translation:
我来跟你炫耀一下
我的小皮卡丘吧！

entries.label: PsychicNormanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You know how #-
MON have differentabilities? People are like
that too. Every-one has differentpotential.
entries.translation:
宝可梦不是
具备各种能力嘛。 与之类似，我们人类
也拥有很多可能性呢。

entries.label: PsychicNormanBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, your #MON
have potential.
entries.translation:
不错啊，
你的宝可梦很有潜力啊。

entries.label: PsychicNormanSeenText
entries.english:
Let me see what
your #MON arecapable of.
entries.translation:
让我见识一下
你的宝可梦有什么能耐！

entries.label: Route39MiltankText
entries.english: MILTANK: Mooo!
entries.translation: 大奶罐：嗯，哞——！

entries.label: Route39SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 39 OLIVINE CITY -
ECRUTEAK CITY
entries.translation:
这里是39号道路
浅葱市   ……   缘朱市

entries.label: Route39TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS Use HEADBUTT on
trees to shake#MON out. Different kinds of
#MON drop outof trees. Use HEADBUTT on
any tree you see!
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 用头锤摇树的时候，
不同的树上会掉落不同的宝可梦。 对各种树使出头锤吧！

entries.label: SailorEugeneAfterBattleText
entries.english:
My #MON were
caught and raisedoverseas. They're my compan-
ions on those longvoyages.
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦是在外国捉的，
也是在外国培育起来的。是我长途航行的好搭档！

entries.label: SailorEugeneBeatenText
entries.english: Awaaargh!

entries.label: SailorEugeneSeenText
entries.english:
I just got back to
OLIVINE. So how about a
#MON battle?
entries.translation:
好久没有回浅葱市了，
那就来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: MoomooHappyMooText
entries.english: MILTANK: Mooo!
entries.translation: 大奶罐：嗯，哞——！

entries.label: MoomooWeakMooText
entries.english: MILTANK: …Moo…
entries.translation: 大奶罐：……嗯哞

entries.label: Route39BarnAskGiveBerryText
entries.english:
Give a BERRY to
MILTANK?
entries.translation: 要给大奶罐树果吗？

entries.label: Route39BarnGaveBerryText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} gave a
BERRY to MILTANK.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
给出了树果！

entries.label: Route39BarnItsCryIsWeakText
entries.english: Its cry is weak…
entries.translation: 叫声有气无力……

entries.label: Route39BarnLittleHealthierText
entries.english:
MILTANK became a
little healthier!
entries.translation:
大奶罐
稍微有点精神了！

entries.label: Route39BarnNoBerriesText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} has no
BERRIES…
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
没有树果了。

entries.label: Route39BarnQuiteHealthyText
entries.english:
MILTANK became
quite healthy!
entries.translation:
大奶罐
变得相当有精神了！

entries.label: Route39BarnRefusedBerryText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} wouldn't
give a BERRY. MILTANK looks sad.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}没拿出树果。
大奶罐的眼神中流露着悲伤……

entries.label: Route39BarnTotallyHealthyText
entries.english:
MILTANK became
totally healthy!
entries.translation:
大奶罐
变得精气十足！

entries.label: Route39BarnTwinMoomooIsSickText
entries.english:
MOOMOO is sick… She needs lots of
BERRIES.
entries.translation:
哞哞没什么精神……
必须让它多吃树果……

entries.label: Route39BarnTwinWereFeedingMoomooText
entries.english:
We're feeding
MOOMOO!
entries.translation: 我们正在给哞哞喂食物！

entries.label: FarmerFText_HealedMiltank
entries.english:
You fixed our
MILTANK, hon. Now it gives MOOMOO
MILK again. Here's somethin'
fer your trouble.
entries.translation:
大奶罐终于又能
产出好喝的鲜奶了！这都是托你的福！ 就把这个送给你了，
拿好了！

entries.label: FarmerFText_InTrouble
entries.english:
Our milk even goes
out to KANTO. So if our own
MILTANK won't give us any milk, we're
in trouble.
entries.translation:
咱家的鲜奶生意
都已经做到关都去了。 但如果大奶罐
产不出好喝的鲜奶，我们会很头疼的！

entries.label: FarmerFText_SnoreSpeech
entries.english:
That there's
SNORE. It's a rare move
that only works while the #MON
is asleep. You best think how
you ought to useit, hon.
entries.translation:
那是叫做“打鼾”的招式。 是只能在睡着的时候
使出的稀有招式。好好想想该怎么用吧。

entries.label: FarmerMText_BuyMilk
entries.english:
How'd you like my
MOOMOO MILK? It's my pride and
joy, there. Give it to #MON
to restore HP! I'll give it to ya
fer just $500.
entries.translation:
要不要我们牧场
引以为傲的哞哞鲜奶？ 给宝可梦喝下去
就可以回复体力哦！ 现在只需500元！

entries.label: FarmerMText_GotMilk
entries.english:
Here ya go!
Drink up'n enjoy!
entries.translation: 喝个痛快吧！

entries.label: FarmerMText_Milking
entries.english:
I best go do my
milkin'.
entries.translation: 那就开始挤奶吧！

entries.label: FarmerMText_NoMoney
entries.english:
Sorry, there.
No cash, no sale!
entries.translation: 哎呀呀，你的钱不够呢！

entries.label: FarmerMText_NoRoom
entries.english:
I reckon yer
PACK's full.
entries.translation: 哎呀呀，你的行李满了！

entries.label: FarmerMText_NoSale
entries.english:
You don't want it?
Come again, hear?
entries.translation:
不需要吗？
那就下次再来吧！

entries.label: FarmerMText_SickCow
entries.english:
My MILTANK ain't
givin' me milkn'more. This here FARM's
got famous milk. Most everyone
wants a drink. It'll give me lots
o' milk if'n I feed it lots o'
BERRIES, I reckon.
entries.translation:
我的大奶罐
最近都不产奶了啊。 咱家的奶可是远近闻名，
大家以前都很爱喝的…… 只要喂它大量树果，
就能让它提起精神。然后就能挤出许多好喝的鲜奶吧……

entries.label: Text_ReceivedTM13
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM13.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}得到了
招式学习器13。

entries.label: BirdKeeperHankAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If you have a
specific #MON that you want to
raise, put it out first, then switch
it right away. That's how to do
it.
entries.translation:
如果想培育某只宝可梦，
可以放在排头，迅速替换。 这是宝可梦小妙招。

entries.label: BirdKeeperHankBeatenText
entries.english:
Ack! I lost that
one…
entries.translation: 嗯，又输了啊……

entries.label: BirdKeeperHankSeenText
entries.english:
I'm raising my
#MON. Want tobattle with me?
entries.translation:
我正在培育宝可梦。
当我的对战对手吧！

entries.label: MtMoonSquareSignText
entries.english:
MT.MOON SQUARE Just go up the
stairs.
entries.translation:
月见山广场
……爬上楼梯近在眼前！

entries.label: PicnickerHopeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I heard CLEFAIRY
appear at MT.MOON. But where could
they be?
entries.translation:
传闻说有人在月见山
目击到了皮皮，是在哪里遇见的呢？

entries.label: PicnickerHopeBeatenText
entries.english:
Aww, you are too
strong.
entries.translation: 果然很强啊……！

entries.label: PicnickerHopeSeenText
entries.english:
I have a feeling
that I can win. Let's see if I'm
right!
entries.translation:
我觉得我能赢！
来和我对决吧！

entries.label: PicnickerSharonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
……I'll go train
some more…
entries.translation:
…… …… …… ……还需要
更多的修行……

entries.label: PicnickerSharonSeenText
entries.english:
Um…
I…
entries.translation:
那个……
我……

entries.label: MeetMonicaText
entries.english:
MONICA: Glad to
meet you. I'm MONICA of Monday.
entries.translation:
星琪一：初次见面！
我是星期一的星琪一。

entries.label: MonicaGaveGiftText
entries.english:
MONICA: It's an
item that raises the power of fly-
ing-type moves. You should equip a
bird #MON withthat item.
entries.translation:
星琪一：这个道具可以
提升飞行属性的攻击力， 让你的鸟宝可梦携带它
真是在合适不过了！

entries.label: MonicaGivesGiftText
entries.english:
As a token of our
friendship, I havea gift for you!
entries.translation: 这是我们友谊的象征，给！

entries.label: MonicaMondayText
entries.english:
MONICA: My broth-
ers and sisters are all over the
place. See if you could
find them all!
entries.translation:
星琪一：我的
弟弟妹妹们在各种地方等你哦。 你去找找看吧！

entries.label: MonicaNotMondayText
entries.english:
MONICA: I don't
think today isMonday. How sad…
entries.translation:
星琪一：今天好像
不是星期一呀……好遗憾哦。

entries.label: Route40Lass1Text
entries.english:
Although you can't
see it from here, CIANWOOD is across
the sea.
entries.translation:
虽然这边还看不到对岸，
但只要越过大海，就能抵达湛蓝市。

entries.label: Route40Lass2Text
entries.english:
I came to OLIVINE
by ship to see the sights and soak up
the atmosphere. Being a port, it
feels so differentfrom a big city.
entries.translation:
我是坐船来浅葱市观光的！ 这种大都市里无法体会的
海港风情真是太棒了。

entries.label: Route40PokefanMText
entries.english:
Hm! There's a big
building up ahead! What is it?
entries.translation:
唔！前方不远处
有栋巨大的建筑物！这是怎么回事啊？

entries.label: Route40PokefanMText_Mobile
entries.english:
Hm! Look at all
those serious-looking trainersstreaming in. What? What?
entries.translation:
唔！有好多看似强大的
训练家进去了！这是怎么回事啊？

entries.label: Route40SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 40 CIANWOOD CITY -
OLIVINE CITY
entries.translation:
这里是40号水道
湛蓝市   ……   浅葱市

entries.label: Route40StandingYoungsterText
entries.english:
Have you gone to
the BATTLE TOWER? I think a lot of
tough trainers have gathered
there already. But since you have
so many BADGES, you shouldn't do
badly at all.
entries.translation:
去过对战塔吗？ 里面好像聚集了一些
实力不俗的训练家…… 我看你的徽章也不少，
应该也有相当的实力吧？

entries.label: SwimmerfElaineAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'd say I'm a bet-
ter swimmer thanyou. Yeah!
entries.translation:
如果是比游泳，
那一定是我更强。

entries.label: SwimmerfElaineBeatenText
entries.english: I lost that one!
entries.translation: 是我输了呢。

entries.label: SwimmerfElaineSeenText
entries.english:
Are you going to
CIANWOOD? How about a quick
battle first?
entries.translation:
你想游到湛蓝市？ 在那之前，
和我来场小对战吧？

entries.label: SwimmerfPaulaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
While I float like
this, the wavescarry me along.
entries.translation:
一直像这样飘荡在水面，
不知不觉就被海浪冲走了。

entries.label: SwimmerfPaulaBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, I'm feeling
dizzy!
entries.translation:
嗯……
头晕目眩。

entries.label: SwimmerfPaulaSeenText
entries.english:
No inner tube for
me. I'm hanging on to
a sea #MON!
entries.translation:
没有游泳圈也没问题，
我抓着海里的宝可梦前进！

entries.label: SwimmermRandallAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Swimming exercises
your entire body.It's healthy.
entries.translation:
游泳需要动用全身，
是一种很好的锻炼！

entries.label: SwimmermRandallBeatenText
entries.english: Uh-oh. I lost…
entries.translation: 我输了……

entries.label: SwimmermRandallSeenText
entries.english:
Hey, you're young
and fit! Don't ride your
#MON! Swim!
entries.translation:
你一个年轻力壮的孩子，
不要骑宝可梦！自己游！

entries.label: SwimmermSimonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
CIANWOOD CITY is
a good distanceaway from here.
entries.translation:
从这里去湛蓝市，
路程相当遥远啊！

entries.label: SwimmermSimonBeatenText
entries.english: OK! Uncle! I give!
entries.translation: 呜，难过！

entries.label: SwimmermSimonSeenText
entries.english:
You have to warm
up before goinginto the water. That's basic.
entries.translation:
入水之前
要做热身运动！ 这是基础知识！

entries.label: Route40BattleTowerGateRockerText
entries.english:
Are you going to
the BATTLE TOWER? This is a secret,
but if you win a whole lot, you can
win special gifts.
entries.translation:
你也要去对战塔吗？ 如果有人赢了很多次，
好像会获得礼物呢。我只告诉你一个人哦！

entries.label: Route40BattleTowerGateTwinText
entries.english:
The levels of the
#MON I want to use are all
different. I have to go train
them now!
entries.translation:
我必用的几只宝可梦
等级参差不齐，所以我要先去训练它们！

entries.label: Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText1
entries.english:
Did you come to
see the BATTLETOWER too? But I guess you
can't go in yet.
entries.translation:
你也是来看对战塔的？
但好像还进不去啊……

entries.label: Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText2
entries.english:
BATTLE TOWER has
opened. I want to go, but
I haven't thought up a cool line for
when I win.
entries.translation:
我听说对战塔已经开放了，
真想马上就过去看看。 可是我想不出来
胜利时该说什么帅气台词，真让人头疼啊。

entries.label: Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText3
entries.english:
I'm going to train
my #MON so I'll be all ready for
the BATTLE TOWER.
entries.translation:
为了将来能
在对战塔里玩得尽兴，我要先去训练宝可梦！

entries.label: SwimmerfDeniseAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A sunburn is the
worst for skin. But I don't use a
sunblock. I won't pollute
the water.
entries.translation:
日照是皮肤的天敌！ 但是我怕会弄脏大海，
所以没涂防晒霜。

entries.label: SwimmerfDeniseBeatenText
entries.english: Ohhh!

entries.label: SwimmerfDeniseSeenText
entries.english:
The weather is so
beautiful, I'm ina daze!
entries.translation:
天气真不错啊……
令人沉醉。

entries.label: SwimmerfKaraAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I heard roars from
deep inside theISLANDS.
entries.translation:
说起来，我听到岛上的
洞窟深处传来叫声。

entries.label: SwimmerfKaraBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh! You have more
energy than I do.
entries.translation:
真是的！
你比我更有精神嘛！

entries.label: SwimmerfKaraSeenText
entries.english:
If you need to
rest, just treadwater. You'll get your
wind back, so you can keep on going
strong.
entries.translation:
如果游累了想休息，
那就站在水中吧。这能缓解疲劳恢复活力！

entries.label: SwimmerfKayleeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
There's supposed
to be a big #-MON deep beneathWHIRL ISLANDS. I wonder what it
could be?
entries.translation:
传说在漩涡岛的地下深处
栖息着一只巨大的宝可梦。那到底是怎样的宝可梦呢？

entries.label: SwimmerfKayleeBeatenText
entries.english:
Is that how you do
it?
entries.translation: 嗯……原来如此。

entries.label: SwimmerfKayleeSeenText
entries.english:
I'm on my way to
WHIRL ISLANDS. I'm going explor-
ing with friends.
entries.translation:
我要和朋友一起
在漩涡岛探险！

entries.label: SwimmerfSusieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Wasn't there a hit
song about a boyriding a LAPRAS?
entries.translation:
你有没有听过一首
《骑拉普拉斯的少年》？

entries.label: SwimmerfSusieBeatenText
entries.english: I'm crushed…
entries.translation: 我很失望呢……

entries.label: SwimmerfSusieSeenText
entries.english:
You look so ele-
gant, riding your#MON.
entries.translation:
哎呀？你骑着宝可梦的
样子很优雅呢。

entries.label: SwimmerfWendyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The clusters of
STARYU light upat the same time. It's so beautiful,
it's scary.
entries.translation:
海星星聚集以后，
会一起发光哦！漂亮得有点诡异！

entries.label: SwimmerfWendyBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, dear…
entries.translation: ……哎呀呀。

entries.label: SwimmerfWendySeenText
entries.english:
At night, STARYU
gather near thewater's surface.
entries.translation:
一到了晚上啊，
海星星就会在接近水面的地方聚集。

entries.label: SwimmermBerkeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It was a dark and
stormy night… I saw this giant
#MON flyingfrom the islands. It was scattering
feathers from itssilver wings.
entries.translation:
据说在一个暴雨之夜…… 有人看见
一只巨大的宝可梦从漩涡岛飞了出来，同时还散落了银色之羽。

entries.label: SwimmermBerkeBeatenText
entries.english:
What's the secret
to your strength?
entries.translation:
你的实力
肯定也有什么秘密吧！

entries.label: SwimmermBerkeSeenText
entries.english:
See those islands
that are blockedby whirlpools? There just has to
be a secret!
entries.translation:
那座被漩涡围绕的岛屿，
肯定有什么秘密吧？

entries.label: SwimmermCharlieAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Isn't it relaxing
just floating likethis?
entries.translation:
一直像这样漂着，
真是太舒服了。

entries.label: SwimmermCharlieBeatenText
entries.english:
Yikes! I've got
prune skin!
entries.translation: 吸、吸水发胀了……

entries.label: SwimmermCharlieSeenText
entries.english:
The water's warm
here. I'm looseand limber. Sure, I'll take
you on!
entries.translation:
这一带的海水很暖，
感觉全身都放松了。来打一场吧！

entries.label: SwimmermGeorgeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's so far to
CIANWOOD. But it's no easy
return trip toOLIVINE either. What should I do?
entries.translation:
离湛蓝市还很远啊。
回浅葱市也不轻松……该怎么办呢？

entries.label: SwimmermGeorgeBeatenText
entries.english: Pant, pant…

entries.label: SwimmermGeorgeSeenText
entries.english:
I'm a bit tired.
If I win, lend meyour #MON.
entries.translation:
我有点累了。
如果我能赢你，你就把宝可梦借我吧？

entries.label: SwimmermKirkAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The currents keep
me from reachingthat island.
entries.translation:
被潮水搅乱了方向，
怎么也到不了那座岛。

entries.label: SwimmermKirkBeatenText
entries.english: I'm beat!
entries.translation: 断、断气了……

entries.label: SwimmermKirkSeenText
entries.english:
The waves are wild
here. They tire you out
while you swim.
entries.translation:
这片海波涛汹涌，
想游过去要花很大力气。

entries.label: SwimmermMathewAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A secret about
WHIRL ISLANDS… It's pitch-black
inside!
entries.translation:
先不说秘密不秘密……
漩涡岛里面真的很黑啊！

entries.label: SwimmermMathewBeatenText
entries.english:
Ooh, you've got
great endurance!
entries.translation: 嗯，不好对付。

entries.label: SwimmermMathewSeenText
entries.english:
Are you seeking
the secrets ofWHIRL ISLANDS?
entries.translation:
你也想要探索
漩涡岛的秘密吗？

entries.label: FisherTullyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I want to become
the trainer CHAMP using the #MON
I caught. That's the best
part of fishing!
entries.translation:
呵呵呵，靠钓上的宝可梦
成为最强训练家，这就是垂钓者的乐趣！

entries.label: FisherTullyBeatenText
entries.english:
What? That's not
right.
entries.translation: 喔哟，不对劲啊？

entries.label: FisherTullySeenText
entries.english:
Let me demonstrate
the power of the#MON I caught!
entries.translation:
看好了，我钓到的
宝可梦就是这么厉害！

entries.label: HikerBenjaminAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Losing feels in-
significant if you look up at the big
sky!
entries.translation:
与天空的辽阔相比，
失败太渺小了！渺小！

entries.label: HikerBenjaminBeatenText
entries.english: Gahahah!
entries.translation: 哇、哈、哈！

entries.label: HikerBenjaminSeenText
entries.english:
Ah, it's good to
be outside!I feel so free!
entries.translation:
还是在蓝天之下更舒服！
心胸也变得更宽广了啊！

entries.label: MtMortarSign1Text
entries.english:
MT.MORTAR WATERFALL CAVE
INSIDE
entries.translation:
擂钵山
含有大瀑布的洞穴

entries.label: MtMortarSign2Text
entries.english:
MT.MORTAR WATERFALL CAVE
INSIDE
entries.translation:
擂钵山
内含大瀑布的洞窟

entries.label: PokemaniacShaneAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You're working on
a #DEX? Wow, you must know
some pretty rare#MON! May I please see
it. Please?
entries.translation:
咦，在收集宝可梦图鉴吗？
那你一定见过很多珍惜的宝可梦吧？ 喂，把图鉴借我看看嘛？

entries.label: PokemaniacShaneBeatenText
entries.english:
I should have used
my MOON STONE…
entries.translation:
唉，要是当初
用了月之石就好了……

entries.label: PokemaniacShaneSeenText
entries.english:
HEY! This is my secret
place! Get lost,you outsider!
entries.translation:
喂！ 这里是我的秘密基地，
外人别来捣乱啊！

entries.label: Route42Sign1Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 42 ECRUTEAK CITY -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是42号道路
缘朱市   ……   卡吉镇

entries.label: Route42Sign2Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 42 ECRUTEAK CITY -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是42号道路
缘朱市   ……   卡吉镇

entries.label: Route42EcruteakGateOfficerText
entries.english:
MT.MORTAR is like
a maze inside. Be careful. Don't
get lost in there.
entries.translation:
在擂钵山的山体之中
形成了一个天然迷宫，小心不要迷路了哦！

entries.label: CamperSpencerAfterBattleText
entries.english:
What is going on
at LAKE OF RAGE? We were planning
to camp there.
entries.translation:
愤怒之湖发生什么了？
我还想去露营来着……

entries.label: CamperSpencerBeatenText
entries.english:
Losing isn't fun
at all…
entries.translation: 输了就不开心了……

entries.label: CamperSpencerSeenText
entries.english:
I can do so much
with my #MON--it's super-fun!
entries.translation:
和宝可梦在一起
能做很多事情，我很开心！

entries.label: FisherMarvinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
KURT's LURE BALL
is the best for catching hooked
#MON. It's much more
effective than aULTRA BALL.
entries.translation:
嗯……如果想捕捉
钓上来的宝可梦，我推荐钢铁先生的诱饵球！ 这绝对比高级球
更容易捕捉成功！

entries.label: FisherMarvinBeatenText
entries.english:
I lost, but I feel
better anyway.
entries.translation:
虽然我输了，
但是心情变好了。

entries.label: FisherMarvinSeenText
entries.english:
I'm in a slump. Maybe it's the
gear I'm using. Let's battle for a
change of pace!
entries.translation:
我最近陷入低谷了。
是因为道具不给力吗？ 算了，我要转换心情。
来场宝可梦对战吧！

entries.label: PicnickerTiffanyBeatenText
entries.english: I played too much!
entries.translation: 玩过头了！

entries.label: PicnickerTiffanyClefairyText
entries.english:
Isn't my CLEFAIRY
just the mostadorable thing?
entries.translation:
那个，我的小皮皮
是不是超级可爱？

entries.label: PicnickerTiffanySeenText
entries.english:
Are you going to
LAKE OF RAGE too? Let's play for a 
little while!
entries.translation:
你也要去愤怒之湖？
那先陪我玩玩吧！

entries.label: PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnicText
entries.english:
I'm having a pic-
nic with #MON. Won't you join us?
entries.translation:
我要和宝可梦一起野餐，
你要加入吗？

entries.label: PokemaniacBenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
What else do I
like besides#MON? MARY on the radio.
I bet she's cute!
entries.translation:
宝可梦之外的爱好？ ……电台的胡桃小姐姐吧。
我猜她长得超级可爱。

entries.label: PokemaniacBenBeatenText
entries.english:
How could you do
this to me?
entries.translation: 这不可能！

entries.label: PokemaniacBenSeenText
entries.english:
I love #MON! That's why I
started--and why I'll keep on col-
lecting #MON!
entries.translation:
我非常喜欢宝可梦！ 所以我会和宝可梦
永远永远在一起！

entries.label: PokemaniacBrentAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'd be happy just
to own a singlerare #MON.
entries.translation:
只要带着稀有的宝可梦，
我就会觉得无比幸福。

entries.label: PokemaniacBrentBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, my poor #-
MON! Darlings!
entries.translation: 我的小宝可梦——！

entries.label: PokemaniacBrentSeenText
entries.english:
Hey! Do you have
any rare #MON?
entries.translation:
你有没有带什么
稀有的宝可梦啊？

entries.label: PokemaniacRonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's okay for
people to like different types
of #MON. #MON isn't just
about having themost powerful one.
entries.translation:
喜欢什么样的宝可梦，
是训练家自己的事情。 并不只有强大的宝可梦
才算是宝可梦啊。

entries.label: PokemaniacRonBeatenText
entries.english:
My NIDOKING did
pretty right on!
entries.translation:
怎么样？
我的尼多王很酷吧？

entries.label: PokemaniacRonSeenText
entries.english:
Would you get
this? Some {RIVAL} guy
made fun of my#MON! Darn it! My #-
MON's great!
entries.translation:
你给我听着！ 有个叫{RIVAL}的人，
居然跑过来戏弄我重要的宝可梦！ 可恶——
我的宝可梦明明很强啊！

entries.label: Route43Sign1Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 43 LAKE OF RAGE -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是43号道路
愤怒之湖  ……   卡吉镇

entries.label: Route43Sign2Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 43 LAKE OF RAGE -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.translation:
这里是43号道路
愤怒之湖  ……   卡吉镇

entries.label: Route43TrainerTipsText
entries.english:
TRAINER TIPS All #MON have
pros and cons depending on their
types. If their types
differ, a higher- level #MON may
lose in battle. Learn which types
are strong and weak against your
#MON's type.
entries.translation:
有用的公告牌！ 宝可梦的属性之间
存在属性相克。 即使有很高的等级，
也不见得一定能赢。 好好研究一下自己的
宝可梦克制什么属性，以及被什么属性克制吧。

entries.label: OfficerText_AvoidGrass
entries.english:
Use this gate to
avoid walking inthe grass.
entries.translation:
这道门口
是为了那些想要躲开草丛的人而设置的。

entries.label: OfficerText_FoundTM
entries.english:
I got chased from
my post by thesethugs in black. They left this
behind. It makes me uncom-
fortable. Couldyou take it away?
entries.translation:
突然就被那些一身黑的人
赶了出来，真受不了。 他们落下了这个。
这玩意儿有点邪门，你要的话就拿去吧。

entries.label: RocketText_AllYouGot
entries.english:
Then pay what you
have, please.
entries.translation: 那你有多少给多少吧。

entries.label: RocketText_MakingABundle
entries.english:
He-he-he. We're
making a bundle. Everyone wants to
see what's going on up at LAKE OF
RAGE.
entries.translation:
最近愤怒之湖
出了些怪事，人们都往那跑，赚大发了！

entries.label: RocketText_ThankYou
entries.english:
Thank you very
much!
entries.translation: 嘿嘿嘿，谢谢惠顾！

entries.label: RocketText_TollFee
entries.english:
Hold it there,
kiddo! The toll is $1000
to go through.
entries.translation:
哎呀！ 这里的过路费
要收1000元。

entries.label: Text_ReceivedTM30
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
TM30.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
得到了招式学习器30！

entries.label: Route43MahoganyGateOfficerRocketsClearedText
entries.english:
Nobody goes up to
LAKE OF RAGE thesedays.
entries.translation:
最近倒是没几个人
去愤怒之湖了。

entries.label: Route43MahoganyGateOfficerText
entries.english:
Only people headed
up to LAKE OF RAGE have been through
here lately.
entries.translation:
最近好像每个人
都要去愤怒之湖。

entries.label: BirdKeeperVance1BeatenText
entries.english:
Whew! You're hot
stuff.
entries.translation: 哟，还挺厉害！

entries.label: BirdKeeperVance1SeenText
entries.english:
Do you know about
the legendary bird#MON?
entries.translation:
关于传说的鸟宝可梦，
你知道多少？

entries.label: BirdKeeperVance2BeatenText
entries.english:
Why can't I ever
beat you? Oh yeah, here you
go. It's that gift I couldn't give
you last time.
entries.translation:
为什么
我就是赢不了你啊…… 啊，对了！
之前一直没给你，拿好！

entries.label: BirdKeeperVanceLegendaryBirdsText
entries.english:
ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS
and MOLTRES are the three legend-
ary bird #MON. I heard there are
other legendarybirds, though.
entries.translation:
传说的鸟宝可梦
总共有三种，分别是： 火焰鸟、闪电鸟、急冻鸟。 但是我听说除了这三种，
还有其他传说的鸟宝可梦。

entries.label: CooltrainerfCybilAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We all get better
by experiencingmany battles. I battled a lot to
become what I amtoday--an elite.
entries.translation:
经历各种战斗之后，
大家都能变得更强。 在成为精英训练家之前，
我还要经历更多的战斗！

entries.label: CooltrainerfCybilBeatenText
entries.english:
Nope! This won't
do at all.
entries.translation: 啊，不行不行。

entries.label: CooltrainerfCybilSeenText
entries.english:
You look strong. Good trainers seek
tough opponentsinstinctively.
entries.translation:
你貌似很强啊…… 寻求强大的对手
是训练家的本能哦！

entries.label: CooltrainermAllenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Wow. You have a
lot of BADGES. No wonder you're
so tough. I wonder if
ECRUTEAK GYM's MORTY is still in
training? He really hammered
me.
entries.translation:
原来你有这么多徽章啊！
难怪这么厉害呢！ 说起来，缘朱道馆的松叶
现在也在继续修行吧。他让我吃了不少苦头哦。

entries.label: CooltrainermAllenBeatenText
entries.english:
Tch! It's a total
loss on my part.
entries.translation:
……！
我彻底输了！

entries.label: CooltrainermAllenSeenText
entries.english:
I can tell you're
a good trainer bylooking at you. I'm good at #-
MON, and I can seethat you are too.
entries.translation:
这相貌，这身姿，
一看就知道水平很高！ 我也拥有强大的宝可梦，
所以我能看出你的实力！

entries.label: FisherEdgarAfterBattleText
entries.english:
That's 100 wins
to 101 losses. I won't battle
again for a while.
entries.translation:
目前100胜，101败。 输多赢少……
暂时不和别人对战了。

entries.label: FisherEdgarBeatenText
entries.english:
Hmmmm… 
This isn't right.
entries.translation: ……嗯，怎么说呢……

entries.label: FisherEdgarSeenText
entries.english:
I fish until I
can't anymore. I also battle
until I drop. That's my
relationshipwith my #MON.
entries.translation:
钓啊，钓啊，拼命钓，
赢啊，赢啊，一直赢，我和宝可梦就是这种关系！

entries.label: FisherWilton1BeatenText
entries.english:
Just forget about
it.
entries.translation: 已经够了。

entries.label: FisherWilton1SeenText
entries.english:
Aack! You made me
lose a POLIWAG! What are you going
to do about it?
entries.translation:
啊啊！都怪你！
蚊香蝌蚪跑掉了啊！你怎么赔我啊！！

entries.label: FisherWiltonHugePoliwagText
entries.english:
That POLIWAG that
got away…It was huge. I swear it must've
been 16 feet long!
entries.translation:
跑掉的那只蚊香蝌蚪……
好家伙，长得可大了，起码有个五米吧！

entries.label: PokemaniacZachAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If a #MON has
different colors from usual, it's
more valuable. What? You mean
that's not true?
entries.translation:
即使是同一种宝可梦，
颜色不同价值就会不同！哎，不是这样嘛？

entries.label: PokemaniacZachBeatenText
entries.english:
Oooh, your #MON
are so appealing.
entries.translation:
啊！
你的宝可梦不错啊！

entries.label: PokemaniacZachSeenText
entries.english:
I'll do anything
to get my hands onrare #MON!
entries.translation:
我说什么也要弄到
稀有的宝可梦啊！

entries.label: PsychicPhilAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's important to
have convictionon your side.
entries.translation:
不管做什么事情，
都要具备强大的意念！

entries.label: PsychicPhilBeatenText
entries.english:
Arrgh… That's a
shocking loss…
entries.translation:
……哐！
备受打击！

entries.label: PsychicPhilSeenText
entries.english:
I'm gonna win,
for sure!
entries.translation:
我要赢！
我一定要赢！

entries.label: Route44Sign1Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 44
ICE PATH AHEAD
entries.translation:
这里是44号道路
前方是冰雪小径

entries.label: Route44Sign2Text
entries.english:
ROUTE 44 MAHOGANY TOWN -
BLACKTHORN CITY
entries.translation:
这里是44号道路
卡吉镇   ……   烟墨市

entries.label: BlackbeltKenji3BeatenText
entries.english: Waaaargh!
entries.translation: 唔哇！

entries.label: BlackbeltKenji3SeenText
entries.english:
I was training
here alone. Behold the fruits
of my labor!
entries.translation:
我正独自在这里
进行修行…… 让你见识一下成果吧！

entries.label: BlackbeltKenjiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
This calls for
extreme measures. I must take to the
hills and train insolitude.
entries.translation:
看来必须剃了眉毛，
去深山老林里修行了……

entries.label: BlackbeltKenjiMorningText
entries.english:
I'm going to train
a bit more beforeI break for lunch.
entries.translation:
趁着午休时间还没到，
再稍微修行一下！

entries.label: BlackbeltKenjiNightText
entries.english:
We had plenty of
rest at lunch, so now we're all
ready to go again! We're going to
train again!
entries.translation:
白天休息够了，
体力完全回复！ 再继续修行吧！

entries.label: CamperQuentinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Have you been to
the BATTLE TOWER? I never, ever lose
there, but…
entries.translation:
去过对战塔吗？
我在那里绝对不会输……

entries.label: CamperQuentinBeatenText
entries.english:
I was tough at the
BATTLE TOWER…
entries.translation:
在对战塔的时候，
我明明超级强的啊……

entries.label: CamperQuentinSeenText
entries.english:
I'm really, really
tough!
entries.translation: 我超级强哦！

entries.label: CooltrainerfKellyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm not in favor
of overly power-ful moves. I want to win, but
I also don't wantto harm #MON.
entries.translation:
没错，我并不偏好
过于强大的招式。 虽然想赢得对战，
但不能因此就去伤害宝可梦。

entries.label: CooltrainerfKellyBeatenText
entries.english: Fine. I lost.
entries.translation: ……是我输了。

entries.label: CooltrainerfKellySeenText
entries.english:
What is your
battle strategy? It is foolish to
use strong movesindiscriminately.
entries.translation:
用宝可梦对战的时候，
你都在想些什么？ 可不能一味地强迫
宝可梦使出强大的招式哦。

entries.label: CooltrainermRyanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I see you're rais-
ing your #MONwith care. The bond you build
will save you intough situations.
entries.translation:
你很重视对宝可梦的培育。 你们之间的这种牵绊，
会在关键时刻起作用的！

entries.label: CooltrainermRyanBeatenText
entries.english:
You've won my
respect.
entries.translation: 不愧是你。

entries.label: CooltrainermRyanSeenText
entries.english:
What are your
thoughts on rais-ing #MON?
entries.translation:
你培育宝可梦的时候，
怀有怎样的信念？

entries.label: HikerErikAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'll head back to
BLACKTHORN's ICE PATH and train
some more.
entries.translation:
我还是回烟墨市的
冰雪小径重新锻炼吧。

entries.label: HikerErikBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, I lost that!
entries.translation: 哦，我输了。

entries.label: HikerErikSeenText
entries.english:
Be prepared for
anything! Let me see if your
#MON have beenraised properly!
entries.translation:
正所谓有备无患！
你有没有好好培育宝可梦？

entries.label: HikerMichaelAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Boy, do I love
HP UP! Mmmm, yum! I keep drinking my
#MON's! I can't help it!
entries.translation:
叔叔的最爱就是
HP增强剂！ 太好喝了。不小心就
把宝可梦那份也喝了。

entries.label: HikerMichaelBeatenText
entries.english:
My #MON weren't
spunky enough!
entries.translation:
虽然叔叔还没输，
但是宝可梦没精神了。

entries.label: HikerMichaelSeenText
entries.english:
Yo! You're spunky!
But you know what? When it comes to
sheer spunkiness,I'm the man!
entries.translation:
好！很有精神！
但是要比精力，叔叔我可不会输哦！

entries.label: HikerParry3BeatenText
entries.english:
Wahahah! I'm the
big loser!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈！
叔叔输了！

entries.label: HikerParry3SeenText
entries.english:
My #MON are
power packed!
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
对自己的力量充满自信！

entries.label: HikerParryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm not much good
at thinking, see? So, I just plow
ahead with power!
entries.translation:
我可不擅长思考，
平时都是一个劲地进攻。

entries.label: HikerParryGivesIronText
entries.english:
I just can't find
a way to win! Keep it up! Oh, and take this
--it's the gift you couldn't take
when we last met.
entries.translation:
哎呀，打不过你啊！
保持势头继续努力吧！ 你上次忘掉的东西，
今天一定要带走啊！

entries.label: HikerTimothyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The best thing to
ever happen to me was discovering
#MON.
entries.translation:
人生最大的喜悦，
就是与宝可梦的邂逅！

entries.label: HikerTimothyBeatenText
entries.english:
Losses…
They're there too!
entries.translation: 失败者也在那里！

entries.label: HikerTimothySeenText
entries.english:
Why do I climb
mountains? Because they're
there. Why do I train
#MON? Because they're
there!
entries.translation:
人为什么要爬山？
……因为山就在那里。 人为什么要培育宝可梦？
然是因为宝可梦就在那里！

entries.label: Route45DummyText
entries.english:
I'm really, really
tough! Is there anywhere
I can prove howtough I really am?
entries.translation:
我超级强哦！ 真希望有地方能
让我大显身手……

entries.label: Route45SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 45
MOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD
entries.translation:
这里是45号道路
再往前走全是山路

entries.label: CamperTedAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I did my best but
came up short. No excuses--I
admit I lost.
entries.translation:
全力以赴还是输了，
那就应该老老实实认了！

entries.label: CamperTedBeatenText
entries.english: Wha…?
entries.translation: 什么？

entries.label: CamperTedSeenText
entries.english:
I'm raising #-
MON too! Will you battle
with me?
entries.translation:
我也在培育宝可梦，
你来陪我较量一下吧！

entries.label: HikerBaileyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's over. I don't
mind. We HIKERSare like that.
entries.translation:
结束了也毫不在意！
这就是登山男的气概！

entries.label: HikerBaileyBeatenText
entries.english:
Mercy! You showed
me your power!
entries.translation:
难过！
我体会到了你的实力！

entries.label: HikerBaileySeenText
entries.english:
Awright! I'll show
you the power ofmountain #MON!
entries.translation:
好嘞！
我就让你好好看看山里的宝可梦有多强！

entries.label: PicnickerErin1BeatenText
entries.english: Oh, rats!
entries.translation: 啊，不甘心！

entries.label: PicnickerErin1SeenText
entries.english:
I raise #MON
too! Will you battle
with me?
entries.translation:
我也在培育宝可梦，
你来陪我较量一下吧！

entries.label: PicnickerErin2BeatenText
entries.english:
Aww… I keep losing
all the time! I'll just have to
try harder! Anyway, thanks for
battling me again and again. Here's
that present fromthe other time.
entries.translation:
啊……一直都在输。
我要更加努力啊！ 但还是要感谢你总是陪我！
这是这段时间的谢礼哦！

entries.label: PicnickerErinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I've been to many
GYMS, but the GYM in GOLDENROD is my
favorite. It's filled with
pretty flowers!
entries.translation:
我也去过很多道馆，
其中最喜的是满金道馆！到处都是鲜花，可漂亮了。

entries.label: Route46SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 46
MOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD
entries.translation:
这里是46号道路
前方是山路

entries.label: HouseForSaleSignText
entries.english:
What's this? House for Sale…
Nobody lives here.
entries.translation:
……贴了张纸！
出售房子……看起来没人住……

entries.label: Route5PokefanMText
entries.english:
The road is closed
until the problem at the POWER PLANT
is solved.
entries.translation:
在发电厂的事故
得到解决之前，这里禁止通行！

entries.label: Route5UndergroundPathSignText
entries.english:
UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY -
VERMILION CITY
entries.translation:
前方是地下通道
华蓝市   ……   枯叶市

entries.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText1
entries.english:
Eeyaaaah! I sense a sinister
shadow hoveringover you. Take this to ward
it off!
entries.translation:
消失——吧！ 有个不吉利的影子
附在施主身上！请你带上这个！

entries.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText2
entries.english:
You were in mortal
danger, but youare protected now.
entries.translation:
真是好险啊！
这下就能放心了！

entries.label: Route5CleanseTagHouseTeacherText
entries.english:
My grandma is into
warding off what she believes to be
evil spirits. I'm sorry that she
startled you.
entries.translation:
我家的奶奶呀，
一直很热衷于驱邪。抱歉啊，让你受惊了。

entries.label: Route5SaffronGateOfficerText
entries.english:
You're from JOHTO,
aren't you? How do you like
KANTO? It's nice,don't you agree?
entries.translation:
你是城都的人吧？
第一次来关都感觉如何？是个好地方吧。

entries.label: Route5UndergroundPathEntranceTeacherText
entries.english:
Many cities in
JOHTO have long histories. I'd
love to visit!
entries.translation:
我听说城都有很多
历史悠久的城市。真想去看一次！

entries.label: PokefanmAllanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Look how adorable
my TEDDIURSA acts! Isn't it cute
enough to makeyour heart melt?
entries.translation:
你一定要看一下！
我家熊宝宝撒娇的样子！ 真是可爱得不得了！
是不是觉得心都融化了？

entries.label: PokefanmAllanBeatenText
entries.english: My TEDDIURSA!
entries.translation: 我的熊宝宝啊——！

entries.label: PokefanmAllanSeenText
entries.english:
My TEDDIURSA is
the cutest in theworld.
entries.translation:
所以说我的熊宝宝
是世界第1可爱！

entries.label: PokefanmRexAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Look how adorable
my PHANPY acts! Isn't it cute
enough to makeyour heart melt?
entries.translation:
你一定要看一下！
我家小小象撒娇的样子！ 真是可爱得不得了！
是不是觉得心都融化了？

entries.label: PokefanmRexBeatenText
entries.english: My PHANPY!
entries.translation: 我的小小象啊——！

entries.label: PokefanmRexSeenText
entries.english:
My PHANPY is the
cutest in theworld.
entries.translation:
所以说我的小小象
是世界第1可爱！

entries.label: Route6PokefanMText
entries.english:
The road is closed
until the problem at the POWER PLANT
is solved.
entries.translation:
在发电厂的事故
得到解决之前，这里禁止通行！

entries.label: Route6UndergroundPathSignText
entries.english:
UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY -
VERMILION CITY
entries.translation:
前方是地下通道
华蓝市   ……   枯叶市

entries.label: Route6SaffronGuardMagnetTrainText
entries.english:
The MAGNET TRAIN
is the most famous thing about SAF-
FRON.
entries.translation:
要说金黄市的特色，
那当然是磁浮列车啦！

entries.label: Route6SaffronGuardWelcomeText
entries.english:
Welcome to SAFFRON
CITY, home of theMAGNET TRAIN! …That's what I'd
normally say, but the MAGNET TRAIN
isn't running now. It's not getting
any electricity because there's
something wrong with the POWER
PLANT.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到
磁浮列车之城——金黄市！ 我是很想这么说……
但是发电厂好像出事了，完全不能输出电力。磁浮列车也跟着停运了。

entries.label: Route7LockedDoorText
entries.english: It's locked…
entries.translation:
锁得紧紧的！
……打不开！

entries.label: Route7UndergroundPathSignText
entries.english:
What's this flyer? … Uncouth trainers
have been holding battles in the
UNDERGROUND PATH. Because of rising
complaints by lo-cal residents, theUNDERGROUND PATHhas been sealedindefinitely. CELADON POLICE
entries.translation:
……这里贴着一张告示！ 最近有些没规矩的训练家
聚集在地下通道进行宝可梦对战。 住在附近的居民
向我们发来了投诉，因此决定关闭地下通道！ ……玉虹市警署留

entries.label: Route7SaffronGuardPowerPlantText
entries.english:
Did you hear about
the accident atthe POWER PLANT? It's located in
the East, close toLAVENDER TOWN.
entries.translation:
发电厂好像
发生了什么事故。 发电厂啊，去对面那侧
往紫苑镇方向走就是了。

entries.label: Route7SaffronGuardSeriousText
entries.english:
I take my GUARD
job seriously. Hey! You have a
#DEX. OK. You can go
through.
entries.translation:
我是有原则的保安。
你带着宝可梦图鉴啊！那你可以通过了！

entries.label: BikerDwayneAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The KANTO #MON
FEDERATION willnever fall!
entries.translation:
“关都宝可梦会”
永远不灭！

entries.label: BikerDwayneBeatenText
entries.english: S-sorry!
entries.translation: 非、非常抱歉——！

entries.label: BikerDwayneSeenText
entries.english:
We're the KANTO
#MON FEDERATIONtrainer group. We'll drive you
under our wheels!
entries.translation:
我们是训练家帮派——
“关都宝可梦会”！我们要干你丫的！

entries.label: BikerHarrisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Wiped out by some
punk from JOHTO…
entries.translation:
居然输给了
从城都来的人……！

entries.label: BikerHarrisBeatenText
entries.english: F-forgive me!
entries.translation: 请、请原谅我——！

entries.label: BikerHarrisSeenText
entries.english:
The cops shut down
our UNDERGROUND PATH! That really
fries me!
entries.translation:
地下通道是我们的地盘！
条子居然说封就封！真是岂有此理！

entries.label: BikerZekeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We'll try not to
disturb anyonefrom now on…
entries.translation:
从今以后……
我们尽量不给别人添麻烦就是了。

entries.label: BikerZekeBeatenText
entries.english: Yikes! Sorry!
entries.translation: 对、对不起——！

entries.label: BikerZekeSeenText
entries.english:
We're the KANTO
#MON FEDERA-TION!Right on!
entries.translation:
我来自“关都宝可梦会”！
还望赐教！

entries.label: Route8LockedDoorText
entries.english: It's locked…
entries.translation:
锁得紧紧的！
……打不开！

entries.label: Route8UndergroundPathSignText

The flyer's torn. It's impossible to
read…
entries.translation:
……告示被撕毁了，
无法阅读……！

entries.english:
The power of mag-
nets is awesome!
entries.translation:
磁铁的力量
真厉害——！

entries.label: SupernerdSamBeatenText
entries.english:
I just want to see
the MAGNET TRAIN…
entries.translation:
我真想看一眼
磁浮列车…… ……

entries.label: SupernerdSamSeenText
entries.english:
How does the MAG-
NET TRAIN work?
entries.translation:
磁浮列车是通过怎样的
原理运作起来的呢？

entries.label: SupernerdTomAfterBattleText

GYM BADGES give
you advantages inbattles.

You're tough!

entries.label: SupernerdTomSeenText
entries.english:
Hm… You've got
many GYM BADGES.
entries.translation:

entries.label: Route8SaffronGateOfficerText

LAVENDER TOWN? There's a tall
RADIO TOWER there.
entries.translation:
你去过
紫苑镇吗？那里有座大型电台哦。

entries.english:
My #MON were
hurt before even entering ROCK
TUNNEL. I'd better take
them to a #MONCENTER right away.
entries.translation:
进入隧道以前
我的宝可梦已经受伤了，要快点去宝可梦中心！

entries.label: CamperDeanBeatenText
entries.english: Whoa! Danger, man.
entries.translation: 糟、糟糕！

entries.label: CamperDeanSeenText
entries.english:
I came to explore
ROCK TUNNEL.
entries.translation:
我是来岩山隧道
进行探险的！

entries.label: CamperSidAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Sorry. You weren't
littering. It wasmy mistake.
entries.translation:
你没有在吸烟呢，
是我看错了。

entries.label: CamperSidBeatenText
entries.english:
I was just point-
ing out…
entries.translation: 我就是想提醒一下……

entries.label: CamperSidSeenText
entries.english:
Hey, you!
Don't litter!
entries.translation:
你怎么这样！
这里禁止乱丢烟头！

entries.label: HikerSidneyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The POWER PLANT is
across a smallriver.
entries.translation:
渡过那条细细长的河流，
就能看到巨大的发电厂。

entries.label: HikerSidneyBeatenText
entries.english:
Oh, dang!
I lost that…
entries.translation:
见鬼！
输了吗！

entries.label: HikerSidneySeenText
entries.english:
I'll tell you a
secret. But first, we
battle!
entries.translation:
告诉你个秘密！
不过要先来场宝可梦对战！

entries.label: HikerTimAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Battles are about
concentration.
entries.translation: 战斗需要集中注意力！

entries.label: HikerTimBeatenText
entries.english:
I was too busy
singing…
entries.translation:
唱得忘乎所以，
疏忽了宝可梦吗……

entries.label: HikerTimSeenText
entries.english:
She'll be coming
'round MT.SILVERwhen she comes… MT.SILVER is in
JOHTO, right?
entries.translation:
山是——白银——山…… 歌词里的“白银山”
好像在城都吧？

entries.label: PicnickerEdnaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Conserving energy
is important, but the environment is
even more vital.
entries.translation:
电力很重要，
自然也很重要呢。

entries.label: PicnickerEdnaBeatenText
entries.english: Ohh… I lost…
entries.translation:
啊啊……
输掉了啊……

entries.label: PicnickerEdnaSeenText
entries.english:
People shouldn't
leave any litterbehind.
entries.translation:
自己的垃圾
应该要自己带走！

entries.label: PicnickerHeidiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
We bake lots of
goodies and share them all around.
They're delicious!
entries.translation:
我做了很多点心，
打算和大家一起享用！超好吃的！

entries.label: PicnickerHeidiBeatenText
entries.english: Ohhhh!
entries.translation: 讨厌——！

entries.label: PicnickerHeidiSeenText
entries.english:
Have you ever been
to a picnic? They're so much
fun!
entries.translation:
你试过出去野餐吗？
非常有趣哦！

entries.label: Route9SignText
entries.english:
ROUTE 9 CERULEAN CITY -
ROCK TUNNEL
entries.translation:
这里是9号道路
华蓝     …… 岩山隧道

This is a big
room, but there'snothing here.
entries.translation:
房间这么宽阔，
里面却什么都没有。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberGrampsText
entries.english:
Ancient buildings
are often tombs ofkings. Like the pyramids,
for instance.
entries.translation:
说起年代久远的建筑，
就会让人想到皇帝陵，比方说金字塔什么的……

It's a replica of

仿照过去的宝可梦
做出来的雕像。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberTeacherText
entries.english:
This place has a
mystical qualityto it. It feels sort of
ethereal even.
entries.translation:
这算是神圣感吗？
这个地方可真神秘。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphStrangePresenceText
entries.english:
There is a strange
presence here…
entries.translation: 感受到了什么动静……

It's a replica of

仿照过去的宝可梦

entries.english:
A #MON that hid
on the sea floor. Eyes on its back
scanned the area.
entries.translation:
该宝可梦藏匿于海底时
会用背上的眼睛观察四周

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome to this
chamber. There are sliding
panels that depict a #MON drawn by
the ancients. Slide the panels
around to form thepicture. To the right is a
description of the#MON. Scientists in the
back are examining some newly found
patterns.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到遗迹小屋！ 这里有古代人
绘制的宝可梦图画！你可以试着移动它们！ 右侧的文字是
该宝可梦的说明。 另外，
最近在前面发现了花纹，研究人员还在做调查！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistCrypticText
entries.english:
Recently, strange,
cryptic patternshave appeared. It's odd. They
weren't here alittle while ago… You should take a
look at the walls.
entries.translation:
前不久在这里
出现了神秘的花纹！ 真是不可思议。
前不久还是一片空白…… 你也来看看墙壁吧！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistHoleText
entries.english:
Ah! Here's another
huge hole! It's big enough to
go through!
entries.translation:
哦哦！又有新发现！
出现了可以通人的洞穴！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistTremorText
entries.english:
That tremor was
pretty scary! But I'm more
concerned aboutthis wall here…
entries.translation:
刚刚的摇晃吓了我一跳！
话说回来……这个墙壁很可疑啊……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberUnownText
entries.english: It's UNOWN text!
entries.translation: 这是未知图腾文字！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberUnusedText
entries.english:
The patterns on
the wall appear tobe words! And those sliding
stone panels seem to be signals of
some kind. I think they make
#MON appear, but it's not clear
yet…
entries.translation:
画在墙壁上的花纹
应该是某种语言！ 那么……那个石板
或许是暗号吧…… 我觉得就是它们……
导致了宝可梦的出现……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberWallHoleText

in the wall!

墙上开着一个
巨大的洞！

drifted in the sea by twisting
its ten tentacles.
entries.translation:
该宝可梦弯曲着十只脚
飘荡在在古代的大海中

仿照过去的宝可梦
做出来的雕像。

entries.label: PsychicNathanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I like thinking
here.
entries.translation:
我最喜欢在遗迹里
思考各种问题。

entries.label: PsychicNathanSeenText
entries.english:
Hmmm… This is a
strange place.
entries.translation:
……嗯，
这可真是个奇妙的地方。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText1
entries.english:
While exploring
the RUINS, we suddenly noticed
an odd presence. We all got scared
and ran away. You should be
careful too.
entries.translation:
看遗迹看得好好的，
突然出现了奇怪的动静！ 大家全都被吓跑了……
你最好也小心点。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText2
entries.english:
The RUINS hide a
huge secret! …I think…
entries.translation:
这个遗迹之中
或许藏有巨大的秘密！纯属个人观点……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideMysteryChamberSignText
entries.english:
MYSTERY STONE
PANEL CHAMBER
entries.translation: 神秘石板房间

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideScientistText
entries.english:
Hm? That's a #-
DEX, isn't it?May I see it? There are so many
kinds of #MON. Hm? What's this? What is this
#MON? It looks like the
strange writing on the walls of the
RUINS. If those drawings
are really #-MON, there shouldbe many more. I know! Let me up-
grade your #-DEX. Follow me.
entries.translation:
嗯？
那个是宝可梦图鉴吧！能给我看一下吗？ 唔……
世上有很多宝可梦呢。 等等！ 这个宝可梦是？ 和画在遗迹墙壁上的
神秘花纹非常相似…… 如果花纹指某种宝可梦，
那应该会有很多种类…… 好吧！
我帮你升级一下图鉴吧！请跟我来！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster1Text
entries.english:
There are many
kinds of UNOWN, so we use them for
our secret codes.
entries.translation:
未知图腾种类繁多，
所以我们就用未知图腾来当作我们的秘密暗号。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster2Text
entries.english:
A… H… E… A… D…
Hmm… What? I'm decoding this
message!
entries.translation:
ZHE… QIAN…
MIAN… SHI…嗯…… 哎？ 暗号解开了！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterSignText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH
RESEARCH CENTER THE AUTHORITY ON
THE RUINS OF ALPH
entries.translation:
阿露福遗迹研究所
帮你解答遗迹的一切谜题！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphSignText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH
VISITORS WELCOME
entries.translation:
阿露福遗迹
对外开放参观

entries.label: SuperNerdStanAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The RUINS are from
about 1500 yearsago. Nobody knows who
built them. It's also not
known if the #-MON statues haveany meaning. It's all one big
mystery…
entries.translation:
这个遗迹，
大约是1500年前建造的。 但建造者是谁、
宝可梦雕像有什么意义，这一切都是未解之谜……

entries.label: SuperNerdStanBeatenText
entries.english:
Sorry…
I'm frustrated by our lack of real
understanding…
entries.translation:
抱歉…… 净是些莫名其妙的东西，
弄得我非常恼火……

entries.label: SuperNerdStanSeenText
entries.english:
What do you want?
I'm studying--don't disturb me!
entries.translation:
怎么回事啊，你？
不要妨碍我的研究！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterAcademicBooksText
entries.english:
There are many
academic books. Ancient Ruins…
Mysteries of theAncients…
entries.translation:
放着好多复杂的书：
《古代遗迹》……《古代文明之谜》……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterComputerText
entries.english:
RUINS OF ALPH Exploration
Year 10
entries.translation:
调查阿露福遗迹……
已经有十年了。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterComputerText_GotAllUnown
entries.english:
Mystery #MON
Name: UNOWN A total of 26
kinds found.
entries.translation:
神秘的宝可梦
名字叫做……未知图腾。总共发现了26个种类。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterDexUpgradedText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}'s #DEX
was upgraded.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}的
宝可梦图鉴升级了！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterModifiedDexText
entries.english:
Done! I modified your
#DEX. I added an
optional #DEX to store UNOWN
data. It records them in
the sequence thatthey were caught.
entries.translation:
好了！ 宝可梦图鉴的
改造工作完成了！ 我在选项中追加了
未知图腾图鉴。 它会按照捕捉的顺序
自动进行记录哦。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterPrinterText_DoesntWork
entries.english:
This doesn't seem
to work yet.
entries.translation: 现在似乎用不了……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterProfSilktreePhotoText
entries.english:
It's a photo of
the RESEARCH CENTER'S founder,
PROF.SILKTREE.
entries.translation:
摆放着阿露福遗迹研究所
初代所长——合欢博士的照片！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text
entries.english:
The RUINS are
about 1500 yearsold. But it's not known
why they werebuilt--or by whom.
entries.translation:
这个遗迹，
大约是1500年前建造的。但是我们还没弄清谁是建造者，以及建造的原因。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_GotAllUnown
entries.english:
Our investigation,
with your help, is giving us insight
into the RUINS. The RUINS appear
to have been built as a habitat for
#MON.
entries.translation:
多亏了你的协助，
我们的调查工作很顺利！我们对遗迹有了更多了解。 这个遗迹似乎是为了
给宝可梦当巢穴而建造的。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_GotUnownDex
entries.english:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MONare in the RUINS?
entries.translation:
遗迹里的宝可梦
总共有多少种类呢？

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_UnownAppeared
entries.english:
#MON appeared
in the RUINS? That's incredible
news! We'll need to
investigate this.
entries.translation:
遗迹里真的
出现宝可梦了吗！？ 这是大新闻啊！
必须要赶紧调查一下！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text
entries.english:
There are odd pat-
terns drawn on the walls of the
RUINS. They must be the
keys for unravel-ing the mysteryof the RUINS.
entries.translation:
画在墙上的花纹就是
解开遗迹之谜的关键！ ……我是这么觉得的。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_GotAllUnown
entries.english:
Why did those
ancient patterns appear on the wall
now? The mystery
deepens…
entries.translation:
为什么这些花纹
直到现在才会出现在这些古老的墙壁上？ 谜题变得
越来越深奥了！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_UnownAppeared
entries.english:
The strange #-
MON you saw in theRUINS? They appear to be
very much like the drawings on the
walls there. Hmm… That must mean
there are manykinds of them…
entries.translation:
你遇到的宝可梦
看起来非常像遗迹墙壁上的花纹呢。 ……唔。 这可能意味着：
遗迹里还有更多种类……

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3Text
entries.english:
The UNOWN you
catch will all berecorded. Check to see how
many kinds exist.
entries.translation:
捕捉到的未知图腾
全都会被记录下来。 你就帮我们确认一下
究竟有多少种类吧！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3_PrinterAvailable
entries.english:
You caught all the
UNOWN variations? That's a great
achievement! I've set up the
printer here forhandling UNOWN. Feel free to use
it anytime.
entries.translation:
你捕捉到了
所有种类的未知图腾吗？那太了不起了！！ 研究所里有台打印机，
可以用它来打印未知图腾的图像。 请你一定要试试看！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnownPrinterText
entries.english:
UNOWN may be
printed out.
entries.translation:
可以打印
未知图腾的图像！

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText1
entries.english:
We think something
caused the cryptic patterns to appear
in the RUINS. We've focused our
studies on that.
entries.translation:
墙上出现了神秘花纹。
之所以回变成这样肯定有什么特别原因。 我们正在调查这一点。

entries.label: RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText2
entries.english:
According to my
research… Those mysterious
patterns appeared when the #COM
CENTER was built. It must mean that
radio waves have some sort of a
link…
entries.translation:
根据我的调查…… 神秘花纹正好是在
宝可梦对话中心建成之时突然出现的！ 这应该是……电波！
一定和电波有某种关联！

entries.label: SafariZonePhotoText
entries.english:
It's a photo of a
huge grassy plain with rare #MON
frolicking in it.
entries.translation:
照片里是一片大草原，
上面有些稀有的宝可梦！

entries.label: WardenPhotoText
entries.english:
It's a photo of a
grinning old man who's surrounded
by #MON.
entries.translation:
照片里有个笑着的老爷爷，
他的身边都是宝可梦！

entries.label: WardensGranddaughterText1
entries.english:
My grandpa is the
SAFARI ZONE WAR-DEN. At least he was… He decided to go
on a vacation and took off overseas
all by himself. He quit running
SAFARI ZONE justlike that.
entries.translation:
我的爷爷是
狩猎地带的园长！ ……话是这么说，
他当初就留下一句：“我要去旅行了！”就一个人跑外国去了！ 那一刻，
他抛弃了狩猎地带！

entries.label: WardensGranddaughterText2
entries.english:
Many people were
disappointed that SAFARI ZONE closed
down, but Grandpais so stubborn…
entries.translation:
狩猎地带关门以后，
很多人都觉得很遗憾。这都怪爷爷太顽固了！

entries.label: FightingDojoSignText
entries.english:
Everyone Welcome!
FIGHTING DOJO
entries.translation:
欢迎各位到场！
这里是格斗道场！

entries.label: MrPsychicsHouseSignText
entries.english:
MR.PSYCHIC'S
HOUSE
entries.translation: 超能力大叔的家

entries.label: SaffronCityCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
This is SILPH CO.,
famous for #MONmerchandise. In the past, TEAM
ROCKET wanted the company because of
that.
entries.translation:
这里是以宝可梦物品
而闻名的西尔佛公司！ 但是这里曾经
被火箭队盯上过。

entries.label: SaffronCityCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
I went to the GYM,
raring for battlesagainst trainers… It turns out, I
stumbled into the unused GYM next
door. Boy, I was pretty
embarrassed.
entries.translation:
当初想挑战道馆训练家，
进门一看…… 发现自己误闯进
隔壁那家歇业的道馆了……有点尴尬啊……

entries.label: SaffronCityFisherText
entries.english:
Chew… Chew… I hear there's big
trouble brewing atthe POWER PLANT. Chew… Chew…
entries.translation:
我嚼，我嚼…… 发电厂好像出大事了啊。
我嚼，我嚼……

entries.label: SaffronCityFisherText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
Chew… Chew… I hear there was
big trouble at thePOWER PLANT. Chew… Chew…
Haaah, I'm full!
entries.translation:
我嚼，我嚼…… 我听说发电厂
之前出什么大事了……我嚼我嚼……吃饱了！

entries.label: SaffronCityLass1Text
entries.english:
A little girl who
is an expert at mimicking people
lives here. She even mimics
the people she's conversing with.
It's confusing.
entries.translation:
这里住着一个女孩子，
她非常擅长模仿哦。 她总是学别人说话，
和她交谈会陷入混乱哦。

entries.label: SaffronCityLass1Text_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
The COPYCAT girl
looked unhappy. She said she lost
her favorite #DOLL--CLEFAIRY.
entries.translation:
擅长模仿的少女
弄丢了她一直以来珍爱的皮皮玩偶。她现在非常难过。

entries.label: SaffronCityLass2Text
entries.english:
Our city was
featured on aradio program. It's nice to hear
praise for your city, but it's a
bit embarrassingtoo.
entries.translation:
我听到广播节目
介绍这个城市了！ 有人夸奖自己住的城市，
让人有点害羞呢！

entries.label: SaffronCityMagnetTrainStationSignText
entries.english:
SAFFRON CITY
MAGNET TRAINSTATION
entries.translation:
这里是金黄市
磁浮列车车站

entries.label: SaffronCityPokefanMText
entries.english:
You came out from
JOHTO? You can zip back
home if the MAGNETTRAIN's running.
entries.translation:
你来自城都吗？ 磁浮列车能发车就好了，
那样你马上就能回城都！

entries.label: SaffronCityPokefanMText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
You came out from
JOHTO? You can zip back
home by hopping onthe MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.translation:
你来自城都吗？ 只要乘上磁浮列车，
一眨眼就能回到城都呢！

entries.label: SaffronCitySignText
entries.english:
SAFFRON CITY Shining, Golden
Land of Commerce
entries.translation:
这里是金黄市。
金黄即是辉煌的黄金之色。

entries.label: SaffronCityYoungster1Text
entries.english:
Going into an
alley for the first time makes
me sorta anxious.
entries.translation:
第一次走进某个小巷，
让人有点兴奋呢！

entries.label: SaffronCityYoungster2Text
entries.english:
There's a place
called TRAINER HOUSE in VIRIDIAN
where trainers gather from all
over the place.
entries.translation:
我听说在常青市
有个叫训练家之屋的建筑，里面聚集了很多训练家！

entries.label: SaffronGymSignText
entries.english:
SAFFRON CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: SABRINA The Master of
Psychic #MON!
entries.translation:
金黄市宝可梦道馆
馆主：娜姿超能力淑女！

entries.label: SilphCoSignText
entries.english:
SILPH CO.
OFFICE BUILDING
entries.translation:
西尔佛公司
总部大楼

entries.label: MediumDorisAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Darn! I forgot
that I predicted Iwould lose to you.
entries.translation:
糟糕！
我之前明明已经预测到我会输给你，结果却忘了！

entries.label: MediumDorisBeatenText
entries.english:
Though I read you,
I still lost…
entries.translation:
虽然看穿了你的心灵，
输了就是输了！

entries.label: MediumDorisSeenText
entries.english:
Fufufufu…
I see it clearly. I can see into
your soul!
entries.translation:
呵呵呵……
我看见了，看见了……！ 你的心灵
我已经完全看透了！

entries.label: MediumRebeccaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
What is the source
of your power?
entries.translation:
你的力量之源
到底是什么啊！

entries.label: MediumRebeccaBeatenText
entries.english:
Strong…
Far too strong…
entries.translation: 好强，强过头了！

entries.label: MediumRebeccaSeenText
entries.english:
The power of all
those you defeatedcomes to me!
entries.translation:
你所战胜的一切
都化作了力量在我体内流淌！

entries.label: PsychicFranklinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
You made your soul
stronger, not justyour abilities.
entries.translation:
你在有意无意之中
锻炼过自己的心灵！

entries.label: PsychicFranklinBeatenText
entries.english:
Your soul has more
power than mine!
entries.translation:
我的心灵力量
不如你！

entries.label: PsychicFranklinSeenText
entries.english:
Psychic power is
the power of yoursoul.
entries.translation:
超能力是
心灵的力量！

entries.label: PsychicJaredAfterBattleText
entries.english:
KARATE KING, the
master of the FIGHTING DOJO, was
just destroyed bySABRINA.
entries.translation:
道场里的师傅——
空手道大王， 曾经被娜姿
打了个落花流水！

entries.label: PsychicJaredBeatenText
entries.english: I was no match…
entries.translation: 打不过啊……

entries.label: PsychicJaredSeenText
entries.english:
The FIGHTING DOJO
next door was oncethis city's GYM.
entries.translation:
隔壁的格斗道场
过去也担任过这个城市的道馆！

entries.label: ReceivedMarshBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
MARSHBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}
得到了金色徽章！

entries.label: SabrinaFightDoneText
entries.english:
SABRINA: Your love
for your #MON overwhelmed my
psychic power… The power of love,
I think, is also a kind of psychic
power…
entries.translation:
娜姿：……
你对宝可梦的那份爱，似乎胜过了我的超能力…… 我觉得，
这份爱的力量也是一种超能力……

entries.label: SabrinaIntroText
entries.english:
SABRINA: I knew
you were coming… Three years ago I
had a vision ofyour arrival. You're after my
BADGE. I don't enjoy bat-
tling, but it's my duty as a LEADER
to confer BADGES on anyone who has
proven him- orherself worthy. Since you wish it,
I will show you mypsychic powers!
entries.translation:
娜姿：……你果然来了！ 其实我三年前就预感
你会来到这里。 你的目标，
想必是我的徽章吧！ 虽然我这个人
不喜欢战斗……但是馆主的任务就是把徽章交给合适的人。 既然你这么希望了，
我便让你见识一下我的超能力！

entries.label: SabrinaMarshBadgeText
entries.english:
SABRINA: MARSH-
BADGE draws out your subliminal
powers… Although I failed
to accurately pre-dict your power,this much I knowto be true. You will become a
celebrated andbeloved CHAMPION!
entries.translation:
娜姿：金色徽章
可以发掘出你的潜力…… 虽然我没能
准确地预测你的实力，但这点我还是很清楚的…… 你的未来一片光明，
大家都会拥戴你这个优秀的冠军！

entries.label: SabrinaWinLossText
entries.english:
SABRINA: Your
power… It far exceeds
what I foresaw… Maybe it isn't
possible to fully predict what the
future holds… OK, you win. You
earned yourselfMARSHBADGE.
entries.translation:
娜姿：你的实力……！
完全超出我的预料……！我或许还不能完美地做到预测未来吧…… 好吧，
我的金色徽章就送给你了。

entries.label: SaffronGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo, CHAMP in
making! A trainer as
skilled as you doesn't need to be
told how to deal with psychic-type
#MON, right? I expect great
things from you! Good luck!
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！ 像你这种水平的训练家，
肯定很清楚该怎么攻略超能力属性吧！ 我很期待哦！
Good luck！

entries.label: SaffronGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
That was another
fantastic battle!
entries.translation: 真是场精彩的战斗！

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText
entries.english:
The MAGNET TRAIN
is a super-modern rail liner that
uses electricity and magnets to
attain incrediblespeed. However, if there
isn't any elec-tricity…
entries.translation:
磁浮列车是
凭借电力与磁力运行，梦幻般的超特快列车！ 但是没有电的话……

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText_ReturnedMachinePart
entries.english:
Whew… How many times
have I gone back and forth between
KANTO and JOHTO?
entries.translation:
呼…… 从关都到城都
来回往返了多少趟了？

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationLassText
entries.english:
Hi. Do you have a
rail PASS? I have one. All the peo-
ple in SAFFRON who ride the MAGNET
TRAIN have PASSES.
entries.translation:
喂喂，你有定期月票吗？
我有哦！ 金黄市的所有人
都会用定期月票来乘磁浮列车的哦！

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYouComingOnBoardText
entries.english:
We'll soon depart
for GOLDENROD. Are you coming on
board?
entries.translation:
开往满金市的列车
马上就要出发了。请问您要乘坐吗？

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrivedInSaffronText
entries.english:
We have arrived in
SAFFRON. We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
路上辛苦了。
列车已经到达金黄市。 衷心期待
您下次乘坐我们的列车！

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeToSeeYouAgainText
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.translation:
衷心期待
您下次乘坐我们的列车！

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightThisWayText
entries.english:
May I see your
rail PASS, please? OK. Right this
way, please.
entries.translation:
请出示一下车票！ 好了！
请走这边！

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerTrainIsntOperatingText
entries.english:
I'm sorry, but the
MAGNET TRAIN isn'toperating now.
entries.translation:
非常抱歉，磁浮列车
现在暂停运营。

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDontHaveAPassText
entries.english:
Sorry, but you
don't have a PASS.
entries.translation:
哎呀，这位乘客
您没有带车票呢。

entries.label: SaffronMagnetTrainStationTeacherText
entries.english:
Before the MAGNET
TRAIN STATION was built, there was a
house there. A little girl
named COPYCAT usedto live there.
entries.translation:
磁浮列车站建成之前，
这块地方本来是模仿少女的家。

entries.label: SaffronMartCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I want to become
stronger, but I'mnot good yet… Could you show me
how sometime?
entries.translation:
我想变得更强，
不过现在还差得远…… 有机会的话，
一定要教我变强的秘诀哦。

entries.label: SaffronMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
There's a big
RADIO TOWER inLAVENDER.
entries.translation:
紫苑镇上
有一座巨大的电台。

entries.label: SaffronPokecenter1FFisherReturnedMachinePartText
entries.english:
Caves collapse
easily. Several caves have
disappeared in the past few years,
like the one out-side CERULEAN. As a pro HIKER,
that's commonknowledge.
entries.translation:
洞窟容易坍塌！ 已经有好几个洞窟
完全坍塌了，就像华蓝洞窟那样！ 作为专业登山人，
这是应有的常识！

entries.label: SaffronPokecenter1FFisherText
entries.english:
I just happened to
come through ROCK TUNNEL. There was
some commotion atthe POWER PLANT.
entries.translation:
我刚刚穿过岩山隧道
来到这里。发电厂那边好像不是很太平啊……

entries.label: SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherMobileText
entries.english:
What are JOHTO's
#MON CENTERSlike? …Oh, I see.
So they let you link with people
far away? Then I'll get my
friend in JOHTO to catch a MARILL and
trade it to me!
entries.translation:
城都的宝可梦中心
是什么感觉？ ……嗯，那边也可以
和远方的人们进行连接交换了吗。 那我要让城都的朋友
去捕捉玛力露，然后让他和我交换！

entries.label: SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherText
entries.english:
What are JOHTO's
#MON CENTERSlike? …Oh, I see. So
they're not much different from the
ones in KANTO. I can go to JOHTO
without worrying,then!
entries.translation:
城都的宝可梦中心
是什么感觉？ ……嗯，和关都地区
没什么区别嘛。 那我就可以
放心地去城都了！

entries.label: SaffronPokecenter1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
SILPH CO.'s HEAD
OFFICE and the MAGNET TRAIN STA-
TION--they're the places to see in
SAFFRON.
entries.translation:
西尔佛公司总部
以及磁浮列车车站！ 这两个地方
是金黄市的名胜！

entries.label: BlaineAfterBattleText
entries.english:
BLAINE: I did lose
this time, but I'm going to win the
next time. When I rebuild my
CINNABAR GYM, we'll have to have
a rematch.
entries.translation:
夏伯：这次是我输了。
等红莲道馆重建完成，我肯定不会再输了！到时候再战一次吧！

entries.label: BlaineFightDoneText
entries.english:
BLAINE: My fire
#MON will be even stronger.
Just you watch!
entries.translation:
夏伯：我的火宝可梦
会变得更强！

entries.label: BlaineIntroText
entries.english:
BLAINE: Waaah! My GYM in CINNABAR
burned down. My fire-breathing
#MON and I are homeless because
of the volcano. Waaah! But I'm back in
business as a GYM LEADER here in
this cave. If you can beat
me, I'll give youa BADGE. Ha! You'd better
have BURN HEAL!
entries.translation:
夏伯：喝～～～！ 我以前的道馆
在红莲镇被烧毁了！ 明明是擅长火属性的
宝可梦道馆，居然被火山烧毁了！ 喝～～～！ 但我会在这个洞窟
继续承担馆主的职责！ 如果你能战胜我，
我会给你徽章！ 嘿～～～！
灼伤药都准备好了吧！

entries.label: BlaineWinLossText
entries.english:
BLAINE: Awesome.
I've burned out… You've earned
VOLCANOBADGE!
entries.translation:
夏伯：灰……灰常精彩！
我燃烧殆尽了……！ 深红徽章就交给你了！

entries.label: ReceivedVolcanoBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
VOLCANOBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从夏伯那里
得到了深红徽章！

entries.label: SeafoamGymGuideWinText2
entries.english:
A #MON GYM can
be anywhere as long as the GYM
LEADER is there. There's no need
for a building.
entries.translation:
有道馆馆主的地方
就是宝可梦道馆！门面是次要的！

entries.label: SeafoamGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Yo! … Huh? It's over
already? Sorry, sorry! CINNABAR GYM was
gone, so I didn't know where to find
you. But, hey, you're
plenty strong even without my advice.
I knew you'd win!
entries.translation:
嗨～！ ……哎呀？
看来已经结束了。 抱歉、抱歉！
因为原本的红莲道馆没了，我找了好久呢！ 算了，就算没有我的建议
你也够强了。我就知道你会赢的！

entries.label: SilphCoOfficerText
entries.english:
Only employees are
permitted to goupstairs. But since you came
such a long way, have this neat
little souvenir.
entries.translation:
2楼以上的楼层
仅限员工入内。 不过
看你从大老远跑到这里，就送你这个吧！

entries.label: SilphCoOfficerText_GotUpGrade
entries.english:
It's SILPH CO.'s
latest product. It's not for sale
anywhere yet.
entries.translation:
这是
西尔佛公司的全新产品！目前任何地方都买不到哦！

entries.label: SilphCoReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome. This is
SILPH CO.'s HEADOFFICE BUILDING.
entries.translation:
欢迎光临！
这里是西尔佛公司总部大楼！

entries.label: MtSilverSignText
entries.english: MT.SILVER
entries.translation: 这里是白银山

entries.label: SilverCavePokecenter1FGrannyText
entries.english:
Trainers who seek
power climb MT. SILVER despite its
many dangers… With their trusted
#MON, they must feel they can go
anywhere…
entries.translation:
据说那些一心想要
变强的训练家们会不顾危险爬上白银山…… 这也说明只要值得信赖的
宝可梦陪伴在身旁，训练家哪都愿意去吧……

entries.label: GruntF1AfterBattleText
entries.english:
SLOWPOKETAILS
grow back fast! What's wrong with
selling them?
entries.translation:
呆呆兽的尾巴
不是马上就能长出来吗，凭什么不能拿去卖？

entries.label: GruntF1BeatenText
entries.english: You rotten brat!
entries.translation: 哎呀，真可恨！

entries.label: GruntF1SeenText
entries.english:
Stop taking TAILS? Yeah, just try to
defeat all of us!
entries.translation:
什么，叫我别割尾巴了？ 那你就试试看
能不能击败我们全员吧！

entries.label: GruntM1BeatenText
entries.english:
You did OK today,
but wait till nexttime!
entries.translation:
切！真有你的。
下次不会这么走运了！

entries.label: GruntM1SeenText
entries.english:
What do you want? If you interrupt
our work, don'texpect any mercy!
entries.translation:
什么？ 你要妨碍我们的工作，
我可不会轻饶你的！

entries.label: GruntM29AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Sure, we've been
hacking the tails off SLOWPOKE and
selling them. Everything we do
is for profit. That's right!
We're TEAM ROCKET, and we'll do any-
thing for money!
entries.translation:
没错，我们确实
把呆呆兽的尾巴割下来拿去卖了。 拼死拼活都是为了赚钱！
只要有钱赚，火箭队啥都干！

entries.label: GruntM29BeatenText
entries.english:
Arrgh! This is NOT
my day!
entries.translation:
啊——可恶——
完全不行嘛！

entries.label: GruntM29SeenText
entries.english:
Darn! I was stand-
ing guard up top when some old coot
yelled at me. He startled me so
much that I felldown here. I think I'll vent
my anger by takingit out on you!
entries.translation:
可恶！本来在上面望风，
不知道从哪来了个老头。 他突然大叫一声，
吓得我掉进井里了。 哼，我就把你揍一顿，
以解心头之恨吧！

entries.label: GruntM2AfterBattleText
entries.english:
We need the money,
but selling SLOW-POKETAILS? It's tough being a
ROCKET GRUNT!
entries.translation:
竟然卖呆呆兽的尾巴……
怎么能这样赚钱啊！ 太为难我们这些手下了……

entries.label: GruntM2BeatenText
entries.english:
Just…
Too strong…
entries.translation: 太、太强了……

entries.label: GruntM2SeenText
entries.english:
Quit taking SLOW-
POKETAILS? If we obeyed you,
TEAM ROCKET's repwould be ruined!
entries.translation:
什么，叫我别割尾巴了？ 让我住手就住手，
火箭队不要面子的吗！

entries.label: KurtLeaveSlowpokeWellText
entries.english:
KURT: Way to go,
{PLAYER}! TEAM ROCKET has
taken off. My back's better
too. Let's get outof here.
entries.translation:
钢铁：{PLAYER}，
干得漂亮！火箭队这帮人全都跑了。 我的腰也没事了，
一起回去吧。

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB1FKurtText
entries.english:
KURT: Hey there,
{PLAYER}! The guard up top
took off when Ishouted at him. But then I took a
tumble down theWELL. I slammed down
hard on my back,so I can't move. Rats! If I were
fit, my #MON would've punished
them… Ah, it can't be
helped. {PLAYER}, show them
how gutsy you arein my place!
entries.translation:
钢铁：哟，{PLAYER}！ 上面本来有人放风，
我大声批评两句居然就把他吓跑了…… 我刚刚从井口掉下来，
折了腰，动不了了。 可恶……要是我没事，
一定能用宝可梦好好教训一下他们…… 算了，{PLAYER}，
你一定要给他们展示一下训练家之魂！

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeMailText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} read the
MAIL. Be good and look
after the house with Grandpa and
SLOWPOKE. Love, Dad

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeWithMailText
entries.english:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off… Huh? It has MAIL.
Read it?
entries.translation:
是呆呆兽……
尾巴被割掉了…… 哎呀，这只带着邮件呢。
要读读看吗？

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB1FTaillessSlowpokeText
entries.english:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off…
entries.translation:
是呆呆兽……
尾巴被割掉了……

entries.label: TrainerGruntM1WhenTalkText
entries.english:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET
was broken upthree years ago. But we continued
our activitiesunderground. Now you can have
fun watching usstir up trouble!
entries.translation:
我们火箭队
的确在三年前解散了。 但还是能像这样
继续进行地下活动。 接下来会发生什么呢，
你就拭目以待吧！

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText
entries.english:
I'm waiting to see
SLOWPOKE's momentof evolution. Through observa-
tion, I made a newdiscovery. A SLOWPOKE with a
KING'S ROCK often gets bitten by a
SHELLDER. Here, I'll share a
KING'S ROCK withyou.
entries.translation:
我一直在这里
想看到呆呆兽进化的那个瞬间。 根据观察，我发现：
携带王者之证的呆呆兽不知为什么，特别容易大舌贝咬上。 对了，我也分给你
一个王者之证吧！

entries.label: SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText_GotKingsRock
entries.english:
I'm going to be
like SLOWPOKE. I'll wait patient-
ly, so I can seeone evolve.
entries.translation:
我像呆呆兽那样，
悠哉地等着进化的瞬间。

entries.label: MrFujiText
entries.english:
MR.FUJI: Welcome. Hmm… You appear to
be raising your #MON in a kind
and loving manner. #MON lovers
come here to pay their respects to
departed #MON. Please offer con-
dolences for the souls of the de-
parted #MON. I'm sure that will
make them happy.
entries.translation:
富士：呀，来得正好。 嗯嗯……你很关爱宝可梦，
一直都在精心培育它们呢。 这里是爱宝可梦人士的
聚集地。 请你也来祈祷吧。
宝可梦们一定会很高兴的。

entries.label: SoulHouseGrannyText
