entries.english:
The #MON that
lived with me… I loved them like
my grandchildren…
entries.translation:
曾今和我
共同生活的宝可梦就像是我的亲孙子……

entries.label: SoulHouseLassText
entries.english:
I came with my mom
to visit #MONgraves…
entries.translation:
我是和妈妈
一起来扫墓的……

entries.label: SoulHouseTeacherText
entries.english:
There are other
graves of #MONhere, I think. There are many
chambers that onlyMR.FUJI may enter.
entries.translation:
宝可梦坟墓的
实际面积应该要大得多。 听说这里有很多房间
只有富士老人能进去。

entries.label: SageChowAfterBattleText
entries.english:
All living beings
coexist throughcooperation. We must always be
thankful for this.
entries.translation:
万事万物
互利共生…… 感激之情
切不能忘！

entries.label: SageChowBeatenText
entries.english: Th-Thank you!
entries.translation: 多、多谢——！

entries.label: SageChowSeenText
entries.english:
We stand guard in
this tower. Here, we express
our gratitude tohonor all #MON.
entries.translation:
我们在担任
这座塔的护卫工作。 因为我们从没忘记
向宝可梦表达谢意！

entries.label: SproutTower1FGrannyText
entries.english:
A BELLSPROUT over
100 feet tall… People say that it
became the centerpillar here.
entries.translation:
过去出现过一只
高达30米的巨大喇叭芽。 据说它的身躯
化作了这座塔中心的那根大柱子。

entries.label: SproutTower1FSage1Text
entries.english:
Only if you reach
the top will youobtain an HM.
entries.translation:
只有爬到最顶层的人，
才会被授予秘传招式。

entries.label: SproutTower1FSage2Text
entries.english:
SPROUT TOWER was
built long ago as a place for
#MON training.
entries.translation:
这座喇叭芽之塔，
当初是为了宝可梦修行而建造起来的。

entries.label: SproutTower1FStatueText
entries.english:
A #MON statue… It looks very
distinguished.
entries.translation:
安放着宝可梦雕像……
有一种神圣的感觉。

entries.label: SproutTower1FTeacherText
entries.english:
See the pillar
shaking? People are train-
ing upstairs.
entries.translation:
柱子摇晃得很微妙吧？
上面有很多和尚在进行修行哦。

entries.label: SageEdmondAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I tried to copy
BELLSPROUT's gentle movements
for battle… But I didn't train
well enough.
entries.translation:
虽然我的战斗方式借鉴了
喇叭芽优雅的身姿。但修为似乎不够啊。

entries.label: SageEdmondBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, I'm weak!
entries.translation: 我真是软弱无力——！

entries.label: SageEdmondSeenText
entries.english:
…Sway like leaves
in the wind…
entries.translation:
如同在风中
飘摇的落叶……

entries.label: SageNicoAfterBattleText
entries.english:
The flexible pil-
lar protects the TOWER, even from
earthquakes.
entries.translation:
即使发生了大地震，
只要有这根柱子在，这座塔就不会塌……！

entries.label: SageNicoBeatenText
entries.english:
I fought hard but
I'm too weak.
entries.translation: 我这人雷声大雨点小……！

entries.label: SageNicoSeenText
entries.english:
However hard we
battle, the TOWERwill stand strong.
entries.translation:
就算我们大闹一场
这座塔也纹丝不动！

entries.label: SproutTower2FStatueText
entries.english:
A #MON statue… It looks very
distinguished.
entries.translation:
安放着宝可梦雕像……
有一种神圣的感觉。

entries.label: SageJinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
As #MON grow
stronger, so doesthe trainer. No, wait. As the
trainer grows stronger, so do
the #MON.
entries.translation:
宝可梦变强的同时，
训练家也会一起变强。 不，应该说训练家变强了，
宝可梦才会变强。

entries.label: SageJinBeatenText
entries.english:
My training is
incomplete…
entries.translation: 我的修为不足吗……

entries.label: SageJinSeenText
entries.english:
I train to find
enlightenment in#MON!
entries.translation:
我的修行能让
宝可梦之道登峰造极！

entries.label: SageLiAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I hope you learn
and grow from yourjourney.
entries.translation:
愿施主在旅途中
能得到诸多收获。

entries.label: SageLiBeatenText
entries.english: Ah, excellent!
entries.translation:
嗯，
善哉善哉。

entries.label: SageLiFlashExplanationText
entries.english:
FLASH illuminates
even the darkestof all places. But to use it out
of battle, you need the BADGE
from VIOLET's GYM.
entries.translation:
学会了闪光之后，
不论多么晦暗的地方，都可以用它照亮！ 不过，战斗之外使用时，
必须先持有桔梗道馆授予的徽章。

entries.label: SageLiSeenText
entries.english:
So good of you to
come here! SPROUT TOWER is a
place of training. People and #MON
test their bonds to build a bright
future together. I am the final
test. Allow me to check
the ties between your #MON and
you!
entries.translation:
施主竟然能来到这里！ 在这座喇叭芽之塔，
通过修行来确认人与宝可梦能否通往光明的未来。 接下来，最后的考验
便是贫僧了。 那么就让贫僧确认一下
施主和宝可梦的牵绊！

entries.label: SageLiTakeThisFlashText
entries.english:
You and your #-
MON should have no problem using
this move. Take this FLASH
HM.
entries.translation:
施主和施主的宝可梦
应该可以妥善运用这个秘传吧。 就请施主带走
秘传学习器——闪光！

entries.label: SageNealAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Let there be light
on your journey.
entries.translation:
愿你的前路
一片光明。

entries.label: SageNealBeatenText
entries.english:
It is my head that
is bright!
entries.translation:
在发光的
是我的脑袋——！

entries.label: SageNealSeenText
entries.english:
The ELDER's HM
lights even pitch-black darkness.
entries.translation:
长老所赐予的秘传学习器
可以照亮一切黑暗。

entries.label: SageTroyAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It is not far to
the ELDER.
entries.translation:
马上就能到长老
的身边了！

entries.label: SageTroyBeatenText
entries.english:
Yes, your trust is
real!
entries.translation:
嗯！
充满信赖！

entries.label: SageTroySeenText
entries.english:
Let me see how
much you trustyour #MON.
entries.translation:
你究竟对宝可梦
有多少信赖呢？就让我来确认一下！

entries.label: SproutTower3FPaintingText
entries.english:
It's a powerful
painting of aBELLSPROUT.
entries.translation:
用强而有力的笔触
画出来的喇叭芽……

entries.label: SproutTower3FStatueText
entries.english:
A #MON statue… It looks very
distinguished.
entries.translation:
安放着宝可梦雕像……
有一种神圣的感觉。

entries.label: SproutTowerElderLecturesRivalText
entries.english:
ELDER: You are in-
deed skilled as atrainer. As promised, here
is your HM. But let me say
this: You should treat your
#MON better. The way you battle
is far too harsh. #MON are not
tools of war…
entries.translation:
长老：这位施主
确有真才实学。 按照约定，这个
秘传学习器就是施主的了。 不过，施主应该
对宝可梦好一点啊。 施主的战斗方式太严苛了，
宝可梦并非是用来对战的道具……

entries.label: SproutTowerRivalOnlyCareAboutStrongText
entries.english:
…
…Humph! He claims to be
the ELDER buthe's weak. It stands to
reason. I'd never lose to
fools who babble about being nice
to #MON. I only care about
strong #MONthat can win. I really couldn't
care less aboutweak #MON.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… ……哼！
虽然被别人叫作长老，但也没多了不起嘛。 ……这也难怪。
我怎么可能输给像他这样天真地说出“善待宝可梦”的人！ 我只看得上
战无不胜的宝可梦。 其他的宝可梦
爱怎么样怎么样！

entries.label: SproutTowerRivalUsedEscapeRopeText
entries.english:
{RIVAL} used an
ESCAPE ROPE!
entries.translation:
{RIVAL}使用了
离洞绳！

entries.label: CameraGrunt1BeatenText
entries.english: Dang… I failed…
entries.translation:
见鬼，
居然被反杀了……

entries.label: CameraGrunt1SeenText
entries.english:
Hey!
Intruder alert!
entries.translation:
哎呀！
发现入侵者！

entries.label: CameraGrunt2BeatenText
entries.english:
Surveillance cams
are in the #MONstatues. We'll keep appear-
ing until you tripa secret switch.
entries.translation:
宝可梦雕像上有监控。 只要隐秘开关没被关掉，
我们就会不断地来找你！

entries.label: CameraGrunt2SeenText
entries.english:
It's my turn!
There's no escape!
entries.translation:
下一个换我！
你逃不掉的！

entries.label: GruntM16AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I don't even know
where the trapsare planted. You'll just have
to collect yourcourage and walk.
entries.translation:
连我都记不住
到底哪里会爆炸。你也只能大胆往前走了。

entries.label: GruntM16BeatenText
entries.english: Kaboom!

entries.label: GruntM16SeenText
entries.english:
Heheh. Feeling
lucky, punk? Go ahead, take
another step. We've got traps
set in the floor!
entries.translation:
哦，还要继续前进吗？
前面埋了“地雷”，一踩到就会爆炸！

entries.label: ScientistJedAfterBattleText
entries.english:
All right. I'll
divulge a secretabout our hideout. That thing on the
floor up ahead isa warp panel. If you step on it,
you'll be warped back to the en-
trance.
entries.translation:
……好吧，我能告诉你
这个基地的秘密之一。 前面那个是传送板！
一不小心碰到的话就会被送回入口！

entries.label: ScientistJedBeatenText
entries.english: I get it…
entries.translation: 原来如此呢……

entries.label: ScientistJedSeenText
entries.english:
This was once a
ninja hideout. There are traps to
confound intruderslike you.
entries.translation:
这里原本是忍者基地。 所以设置了很多机关
来阻碍入侵者！

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB1FSecretSwitchText
entries.english:
A secret switch!
Better press it.
entries.translation:
发现隐秘开关！
按下去吧！……我按！

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB1FSecurityCameraText
entries.english:
It's a PERSIAN
statue… Its eyes are oddly
shiny.
entries.translation:
猫老大的宝可梦雕像……
眼睛好像在发光。

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB1FSwitchOffText
entries.english:
The switch is
turned off.
entries.translation: 电源切断了……

entries.label: GruntM17AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Heh, I'm just a
GRUNT. I don't know the
password. Too badfor you.
entries.translation:
我只是给他们当手下的。
密码也没有告诉过我，真遗憾呐。

entries.label: GruntM17BeatenText
entries.english: What? I lost?
entries.translation: 输、输了？

entries.label: GruntM17SeenText
entries.english:
The door won't
open? Well, duh.
It has to have a password that only
TEAM ROCKET knows.
entries.translation:
门打不开？ 那是当然的。
开门所需要的密码，只有火箭队成员知道。

entries.label: GruntM18AfterBattleText
entries.english:
I got wiped out on
the last missionby a kid too. When we were ab-
ducting #MON, this kid with long
red hair and mean- looking eyes just
creamed me…
entries.translation:
呜，上一次执行
偷宝可梦任务的时候，被一个留了红色长发、目光凶狠的小孩子打得屁滚尿流……

entries.label: GruntM18BeatenText
entries.english: I knew I'd lose…
entries.translation: 呜，还是输了……

entries.label: GruntM18SeenText
entries.english:
Oh, a kid? I don't
really like this, but eliminate you
I must.
entries.translation:
呜，又是小孩子啊……
虽然我不是很想动手，但是必须要扫除障碍！

entries.label: GruntM19AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Heh, only the boss
knows the passwordfor that door. Where's the boss?
Who knows? Go lookfor yourself.
entries.translation:
打开那个门的密码
只有老大才知道。 你问老大在哪里？
谁知道，自己找去吧。

entries.label: GruntM19BeatenText
entries.english: Grrrr…
entries.translation: 咕噜咕噜……

entries.label: GruntM19SeenText
entries.english:
You rotten little
pest!
entries.translation: 跑来跑去的真碍眼！

entries.label: LanceHealsText1
entries.english:
LANCE: Are you all
right? Your #MON are
hurt and tired. Here, give them
some of my medi-cine.
entries.translation:
阿渡：你没事吧？ 你的宝可梦
伤得很重啊。我的药也分你一些。

entries.label: LanceHealsText2
entries.english:
LANCE: {PLAYER},
let's give it ourbest for #MON.
entries.translation:
阿渡：来，{PLAYER}，
为了宝可梦一起加油吧！

entries.label: RockerBaseLanceElectrodeFaintText
entries.english:
It's this machine
that's causing allthe problems. I don't see a
switch on it… We have no choice.
We have to make all the ELECTRODE
faint. That should stop
this machine from transmitting that
strange signal. It's no fault of
the #MON, so it makes me feel
guilty. {PLAYER}, let's
split the job.
entries.translation:
是这个装置吗……
找不到开关啊。 没办法了，
只能打昏顽皮雷弹了。 那样一来，奇怪的电波
也会停止发射吧。 毕竟不是宝可梦的错，
我也于心不忍呢。 {PLAYER}，
兵分两路吧。

entries.label: RocketBaseB2FDeactivateTransmitterText
entries.english:
The radio trans-
mitter has finally stopped its evil
broadcast.
entries.translation:
产生怪异电波的装置
似乎停下来了。

entries.label: RocketBaseB2FTransmitterText
entries.english:
It's the radio
transmitter that's sending the
sinister signal. It's working at
full capacity.
entries.translation:
产生怪异电波的装置
正在嗡嗡地运作着。

entries.label: RocketBaseBossDontMeddleText
entries.english:
What? You had an
accomplice? Where is your
sense of honor? As the interim
boss in place of GIOVANNI, I'll
show you how wrong it is to meddle
with TEAM ROCKET!
entries.translation:
居然还有同伴！
真是让人讨厌呢。 现在由我暂替坂木老大。
你就好好体会一下 杵逆火箭队
会有什么下场吧！

entries.label: RocketBaseBossFThrashText
entries.english:
We can't have a
brat like you onthe loose. It's harmful to
TEAM ROCKET'spride, you see. However strong you
may be, you can't take both of us at
the same time. Sorry, baby. Now
get ready to bethrashed.
entries.translation:
居然被小屁孩小看，
这让我们火箭队颜面何存！ 不管你有多强，
也不能同时对付我们两个人吧？ 不好意思啊，
你还是死心吧！

entries.label: RocketBaseBossRetreatText
entries.english:
…This hideout is
done for… But that's fine.
The broadcast ex-periment was atotal success. It doesn't matter
what happens tothis hideout now. We have much big-
ger plans. You'll come to
appreciate TEAM ROCKET's true
power soon enough. Enjoy yourself
while you can… Fufufufu…
entries.translation:
……这个基地完蛋了。 不过没关系。
毕竟电波实验已经取得了收获。这个基地也无所谓了。 我们的目标
可不是仅此而已哦。 你终有一天会明白
火箭队的可怕之处。 好好等着吧……
哼哼哼……

entries.label: RocketBaseBossWinText
entries.english:
Tch, you really
are strong. It's too bad. If you were to
join TEAM ROCKET, you could become
an EXECUTIVE.
entries.translation:
哎呀，很强呢。 真是可惜，
你要是加入了火箭队起码也能当个干部吧。

entries.label: RocketBaseDoorKnowPasswordText
entries.english:
The door's closed… {PLAYER} entered
the password. The door opened!
entries.translation:
门紧闭着…… {PLAYER}
输入了密码。 门打开了！

entries.label: RocketBaseDoorNoPasswordText
entries.english:
The door's closed… It needs a pass-
word to open.
entries.translation:
门紧闭着…… 输入1组密码
才能把门打开。

entries.label: RocketBaseExecutiveFHoldItText
entries.english:
Hold it right
there!
entries.translation: 到此为止了！

entries.label: RocketBaseLanceElectrodeDoneText
entries.english:
LANCE: That odd
signal has finallystopped. The LAKE should be
back to normal. You're the hero!
Let me thank you on behalf of all
the #MON. Oh, yes. You
should take this. I found it here,
but I don't haveany need for it.
entries.translation:
阿渡：奇怪的电波
总算停下来了。 这下愤怒之湖
也会恢复正常吧。这多亏了你。 我要代替宝可梦
向你道谢！ 对了！
这个给你吧！ 这是刚刚在这里找到的，
我拿着也没什么用。

entries.label: RocketBaseLanceMonMasterText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}… The journey to be-
coming the #MON MASTER is long and
difficult. Knowing that, will
you keep going? … I see. No, you're
right. If you would give
up that easily, you would have
never chased that dream in the first
place. I look forward to
seeing you again!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}！ 通往宝可梦大师的道路
幽深而险峻……你还愿意继续前行吗？ …… …… …… ……
是吗？确实如此。 随随便便就放弃的话，
还谈何梦想？ 那么，下次再会！

entries.label: RocketBaseLancePostBattleText
entries.english:
LANCE: That did
it. We defeated all the ROCKETS
here. But I'm concerned
about the young guy I battled in
the process…
entries.translation:
阿渡：呼，这样一来
我们已经打败了基地里所有的火箭队员。 刚刚和我交战的少年，
让人有些在意啊……

entries.label: RocketBaseLancePowerOffText
entries.english:
Sorry, {PLAYER}.
I saw how well you were doing, so I
just hung back. Now all there is
left to do is to turn off that odd
radio signal.

entries.label: RocketBaseLanceShareFunText
entries.english:
Hey! Don't be so
selfish. Spreadthe fun around.
entries.translation:
别那么说嘛！
总得有人陪我玩两把吧？

entries.label: RocketBaseLanceWhirlpoolText
entries.english:
That's WHIRLPOOL.
Teach it to a #MON to get
across wild water. But keep this in
mind. You can use that
out of battle only with the BADGE
from MAHOGANY GYM.
entries.translation:
里面是潮旋！ 教给宝可梦之后
就能穿越汹涌的漩涡！ 不过你要知道，
持有卡吉道馆的徽章才能使用这个招式。

entries.label: RocketBaseLancesSideText
entries.english:
LANCE: Leave this
side to me.
entries.translation: 阿渡：这边就交给我吧。

entries.label: RocketBaseReceivedHM06Text
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
HM06.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿渡那里
得到了秘传学习器06！

entries.label: ExecutiveM4AfterText
entries.english:
No, I can't let
this affect me. I have to inform
the others…
entries.translation:
不行，
现在不应该哀叹失败，而是要去通知同伴们……

entries.label: ExecutiveM4BeatenText
entries.english:
I… I couldn't do a
thing… GIOVANNI, please
forgive me…
entries.translation:
咕呜呜……
完全抵挡不了。 坂木老大，
请原谅我……

entries.label: ExecutiveM4BeforeText
entries.english:
What? Who are you?
This is the office of our leader,
GIOVANNI. Since disbanding
TEAM ROCKET three years ago, he has
been in training. But we're certain
he will be back some day to assume
command again. That's why we're
standing guard. I won't let any-
one disturb thisplace!
entries.translation:
谁啊，你是？
这里是我们的老大——坂木老大的房间。 坂木老大在3年前
发表了解散宣言之后，一直都在进行修行…… 但是，我们相信
他总有一天会回来的，所以一直守在这里。 不管你是什么人，
都不许在这里撒野！

entries.label: GruntF5AfterBattleText
entries.english:
The password to
the boss's room is SLOWPOKETAIL. But it's useless
unless you havetwo passwords.
entries.translation:
老大门口密码是…… 呆呆兽的尾巴。 但是，密码有2组。
只有1组什么也干不了！

entries.label: GruntF5BeatenText
entries.english:
All right. Stop.
I'll tell you.
entries.translation:
我知道了，
告诉你总行了吧。

entries.label: GruntF5SeenText
entries.english:
Do I know the
password? Maybe. But no weakling's
going to get it!
entries.translation:
问我知不知道密码？
说不定知道呢。 可是呢，我可不会
把它透露给一些弱者！

entries.label: GruntM28AfterBattleText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! The password to
the boss's room… Uh…, I think it is
RATICATE TAIL.
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！ 就告诉你
老大门口的密码吧。应该是“拉达的尾巴”。

entries.label: GruntM28BeatenText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
You're good!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！
干得不错嘛！

entries.label: GruntM28SeenText
entries.english:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You're challenging
me to a battle? Hah! You're nuts,
but you have guts! I like that! If you can beat
me, I'll tell you a password to the
boss's room!
entries.translation:
嘻嘻嘻！ 你以为你能打倒我？
真是好胆量啊。 我喜欢你！
如果你赢了，我就告诉你老大门口的密码！

entries.label: LanceGetPasswordText
entries.english:
LANCE: It takes
two passwords to get into the
boss's quarters. Those passwords
are known only toa few ROCKETS. That ROCKET there
very graciouslytold me so. {PLAYER}, let's go
get the passwords.
entries.translation:
阿渡：进老大的房间之前，
好像需要在门上输入2组密码。 而这2组密码
似乎只有个别火箭队员才知道。 这是边上那个火箭队员
刚刚跟我坦白的。 {PLAYER}！靠你了！
努力去寻找密码吧！

entries.label: RocketBaseMurkrowText
entries.english:
MURKROW: The
password is… HAIL GIOVANNI.
entries.translation: 黑暗鸦：密码是…… 坂木老大万岁。

entries.label: RocketBaseRivalText
entries.english:
… Didn't I tell you
that I was going to destroy TEAM
ROCKET? …Tell me, who was
the guy in the cape who used
dragon #MON? My #MON were no
match at all. I don't care that
I lost. I can beat him by getting
stronger #MON. It's what he said
that bothers me… He told me that
I don't love and trust my #MON
enough. I'm furious that I
lost to a bleedingheart like him. …Humph! I don't
have the time forthe likes of you!
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 我跟你说过的吧？
火箭队应该由我击溃！ ……先不说这个。
那个披斗篷的龙使者到底是什么来头？ 我的宝可梦
根本不是他的对手…… 输了倒也无所谓。
只要我能获得更加强大的宝可梦，那种人也不在话下！ 说起来……
他的言论真是令人作呕！ 说什么“你对宝可梦的
爱与信赖还不够”…… 赢了我的居然是那种
满嘴胡话的人！生气！ ……哼！
谁要当你的对手啊！

entries.label: ScientistMitchAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If we turn up the
power of our radio signal for broad-
cast nationwide… The very thought
excites me!
entries.translation:
将奇怪的电波升级后
再散布到全国…… 光是想象就兴奋不已。

entries.label: ScientistMitchBeatenText
entries.english:
Thinking is my
strong suit, notbattling.
entries.translation:
我擅长的是思考，
而不是战斗。

entries.label: ScientistMitchSeenText
entries.english:
I don't care that
#MON are hurtby our experiment.
entries.translation:
就算在实验中折磨宝可梦，
又关我什么事呢？

entries.label: ScientistRossAfterBattleText
entries.english:
A radio signal
that drives #-MON mad… My experiment is a
complete success. My promotion is
assured. This loss means absolutely
nothing.
entries.translation:
使宝可梦发狂的电波…… 实验已经取得成功，
这下就能出人头地了！输了就输了吧。

entries.label: ScientistRossBeatenText
entries.english:
A mere tactical
error cost me…
entries.translation:
不可能……
作战失败了。

entries.label: ScientistRossSeenText
entries.english:
I used to work for
SILPH, but now I run research for
TEAM ROCKET. A meddlesome child
like you needs tobe punished.
entries.translation:
我以前在西尔佛做实验。
但是现在呢，我在火箭队做实验。 小孩不乖是要打屁股的。

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorNeedsPasswordText
entries.english:
The door's closed… It needs two
passwords to open.
entries.translation:
门紧闭着…… 输入2组密码
才能把门打开。

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorOpenSesameText
entries.english:
The door's closed… {PLAYER} entered
the two passwords. The door opened!
entries.translation:
门紧闭着…… {PLAYER}输入了
2组密码。 门打开了！

entries.label: TeamRocketBaseB3FRocketText
entries.english:
Urrggh… The guy
in the cape isincredibly tough…
entries.translation:
呜呜呜……
那个斗篷男太强了……

entries.label: .FriendReadyText
entries.english:
Your friend is
ready.
entries.translation: 对方完全准备好了！

entries.label: TinTower1FEusineHoOhText
entries.english:
I knew it. I knew you'd get
to see the #MON of rainbow colors,
{PLAYER}. It happened just
as I envisioned. My research isn't
bad, I might say. I'm going to keep
studying #MON to become a famous
#MANIAC!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，你果然
见过虹色宝可梦了。 正如我当初
预想的那样。 看来我的研究
也不是一无是处嘛。 我要学习更多更多
宝可梦的相关知识，成为优秀的狂热迷！

entries.label: TinTower1FEusineSuicuneText
entries.english:
EUSINE: Awesome!
Too awesome, even! I've never seen a
battle that great. That was truly
inspiring to see. SUICUNE was tough,
but you were even more incredible,
{PLAYER}. I heard SUICUNE's
mystic power summons a rainbow-
colored #MON. Maybe, just maybe,
what went on today will cause that
#MON to appear. I'm going to study
the legends more. Thanks for showing
me that fantasticbattle. Later, {PLAYER}!
entries.translation:
水京：厉害！太厉害了！ 第一次看到
如此美妙的战斗，真是非常感动啊！ 水君很了不起，
{PLAYER}也不赖呀！ 我听说拥有神奇力量的
水君好像可以召唤“虹色的宝可梦”。 经过这次的事情，
水君所召唤的宝可梦指不定哪天就会现身。 我也会去调查一下
这方面的传说。 在这里还要感谢你，
让我欣赏到美妙的战斗。 再会，{PLAYER}！

entries.label: TinTower1FSage1Text
entries.english:
According to
legend… When the souls of
#MON and humans commune, from the
heavens descends a #MON of rainbow
colors… Could it mean the
legendary #MON are testing us
humans?
entries.translation:
据传说…… 人与宝可梦的心灵
相通之时，虹色的宝可梦就会降临。 也就是说…… 传说的宝可梦们
正在考验人类！ 或许可以这么理解吧……

entries.label: TinTower1FSage2Text
entries.english:
When the BRASS
TOWER burned down, three nameless
#MON were said to have perished.
It was tragic. However… A rainbow-colored
#MON… In other words… HO-OH descended
from the sky and gave new life to
the three #MON. They are… SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU. That is what they
say.
entries.translation:
铜钟塔烧焦的时候，
有3只无名的宝可梦当场气绝身亡。真是悲惨啊。 就在这时…… 虹色宝可梦现身了， 它就是—— 神圣的凤王。
凤王从天而降，复活了3只宝可梦。 没错…… 这3只宝可梦正是：
水君、炎帝以及雷公。 以上是我所知道的传说。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage3Text
entries.english:
The two TOWERS are
said to have been built to foster
friendship and hope between #-
MON and people. That was 700 years
ago, but the ideal still remains
important today.
entries.translation:
我听说，建造两座塔
是为了祈求人与宝可梦友情长存、充满希望。 虽说已经是
700年前的事情了，但是这点依然很重要。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage4Text1
entries.english:
HO-OH appears to
have descended upon this, the TIN
TOWER!
entries.translation:
神圣的凤王似乎
降临在这座铃铛塔了。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage4Text2
entries.english:
The legendary
#MON are said to embody three
powers… The lightning that
struck the TOWER. The fire that
burned the TOWER. And the rain that
put out the fire…
entries.translation:
据说，
三种传说的宝可梦各自蕴含着神奇的力量： 轰临塔顶的雷电、 烧尽塔身的火焰、 浇灭火焰的大雨……

entries.label: TinTower1FSage5Text1
entries.english:
This will protect
you. Take it.
entries.translation:
为了保护您的安全，
请带上这个。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage5Text2
entries.english: Now, go.
entries.translation: 请您继续前进！

entries.label: TinTower1FSage5Text3
entries.english:
When the legendary
#MON appeared… They struck terror
in those who sawtheir rise. And… Some even took to
futile attacks. The legendary
#MON, knowing their own power,
fled, ignoring thefrightened people.
entries.translation:
就在传说中的宝可梦
诞生后不久， 见证这件事的人们
突然发起了攻击。 甚至…… 有人不惜采取
过分的攻击方式。 传说中的宝可梦明白
自己的力量过于强大， 于是它们不断地奔走，
始终没有向人们发起反击。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage6Text1
entries.english:
I believe you are
being tested. Free your mind
from uncertainty,and advance.
entries.translation:
如果我没有猜错，
这一定是在考验你。迈向前方，无需迷惘。

entries.label: TinTower1FSage6Text2
entries.english:
Of the legendary
#MON, SUICUNE is said to be the
closest to HO-OH. I hear there may
also be a link to #MON known as
UNOWN. The #MON UNOWN
must be sharing a cooperative bond
with SUICUNE.
entries.translation:
虽然都是传说的宝可梦，
但是大家都说水君是其中最接近凤王的宝可梦。 此外，我还听说：
有种叫未知图腾的宝可梦似乎也和它们有些渊源。 这个未知图腾或许
也会发挥自己的力量 与水君保持着
合作关系吧。

entries.label: TinTower9FUnusedHoOhText
entries.english: HO-OH: Shaoooh!

entries.label: TinTower9FUnusedLugiaText
entries.english: LUGIA: Gyaaan!
entries.translation: 洛奇亚：奇——亚！！

entries.label: HoOhText
entries.english: Shaoooh!

entries.label: TradeCenterFriendReadyText
entries.english:
Your friend is
ready.
entries.translation: 对方完全准备好了！

entries.label: TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
They hold practice
battles downstairshere. I would love to
see how well a trainer from JOHTO
battles.
entries.translation:
地下的房间现在
正在进行练习赛。 我希望您能展示一下
城都训练家的实力！

entries.label: TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
VIRIDIAN is the
town closest toINDIGO PLATEAU. They built this
place because so many trainers pass
through on their way up to INDIGO
PLATEAU.
entries.translation:
常青市是距离石英高原
最近的城市。 有很多前往石英高原的
训练家会经过这个城市，所以建立了这个设施。

entries.label: TrainerHouse1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
Whew… I'm taking a
rest from #MONbattles.
entries.translation:
呼……
宝可梦对战可真累啊，我先休息一会儿……

entries.label: TrainerHouse1FReceptionistText
entries.english:
Welcome to TRAINER
HOUSE, the newest and most happening
place in VIRIDIAN. We're open to
trainers only. You can battle
against the best of the best right
downstairs.
entries.translation:
这里是常青市的新景点
——训练家之屋！也是训练家的社交场所！ 在地下的练习场
可以进行对战哦！

entries.label: TrainerHouse1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
I guess you can't
become the CHAMP unless you go all
over the place and battle all kinds
of people. The CHAMPION from
PALLET traveled to all the cities and
towns in KANTO.
entries.translation:
如果想要成为冠军，
就必须去很多地方游历、必须与很多人对战啊。 据说真新镇的那个冠军
曾经就走遍了关都地区，去过所有城市！

entries.label: TrainerHouseIllegibleText
entries.english:
…What's this?
A strategy memo? This writing looks
like ONIX tracks… It's completely
illegible…
entries.translation:
……这是什么？
对战攻略……？ 上面的字难以辨识……
就像大岩蛇爬过的痕迹！

entries.label: TrainerHouseSign1Text
entries.english:
Practice battles
are held in the TRAINING HALL
downstairs. Skilled trainers
are invited toparticipate.
entries.translation:
地下的训练场
正在举行练习赛！希望有自信的训练家可以积极参赛！

entries.label: TrainerHouseSign2Text
entries.english:
There are no rules
or regulations for practice matches.
Just like in field battles, anything
goes!
entries.translation:
没有规则，没有限制！
和道路中的自由对战没什么两样！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FAskWantToBattleText
entries.english:
Would you like to
battle?
entries.translation: 要进行对战吗？

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FCalBeatenText
entries.english:
I lost…
Darn…
entries.translation:
我输了……
好遗憾……！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FCalBeforeText
entries.english:
I traveled out
here just so Icould battle you.
entries.translation:
为了和你对战，
我特地从大老远跑过来！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FGoRightInText
entries.english:
Please go right
through. You may begin
right away.
entries.translation:
那就请进吧！
对战马上开始！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FIntroText
entries.english:
Hi. Welcome to our
TRAINING HALL. You may battle a
trainer once perday.
entries.translation:
这里是练习场！
在这里可以和训练家进行对战！但是每天仅限1次！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FPleaseComeAgainText
entries.english:
Sorry. Only those
trainers who will be battling are
allowed to go in.
entries.translation:
只有正在参加
练习赛的训练家才可以进来！

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FSecondChallengeDeniedText
entries.english:
I'm sorry.
This would be your second time today.
You're permitted to enter just once
a day.
entries.translation:
这位客人，
今天已经参加过一次了！ 1天只能对战1次，
非常抱歉。

entries.label: TrainerHouseB1FYourOpponentIsText
entries.english:
{STRBUF} is your
opponent today.
entries.translation:
这次的对战对手是
{STRBUF}！

entries.label: FirebreatherBillAfterBattleText
entries.english:
On weekends, you
can hear strange roars from deep in
the cave.
entries.translation:
每逢周末，
洞穴的深处就会传来奇异的叫声。

entries.label: FirebreatherBillBeatenText
entries.english: I flamed out!
entries.translation: 燃 烧 殆 尽 ！

entries.label: FirebreatherBillSeenText
entries.english:
ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC
keeps confusingmy #MON. I'm seriously
upset about that!
entries.translation:
超音蝠的超音波
让我变得一片混乱，我现在超级火大！

entries.label: FirebreatherRayAfterBattleText
entries.english:
It's my #MON's
fire that lightsup this cave.
entries.translation:
我的宝可梦
用火焰照亮了四周，所以这个洞穴如此明亮！

entries.label: FirebreatherRayBeatenText
entries.english: FLASH!

entries.label: FirebreatherRaySeenText
entries.english:
If it's light, a
cave isn't scary. If you're strong,
#MON aren'tscary.
entries.translation:
够明亮就不怕无底洞，
够强大就不怕宝可梦。

entries.label: HikerDanielAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I was conned into
buying a SLOWPOKE-TAIL. I feel sorry for
the poor #MON.
entries.translation:
被人忽悠了，一不小心
就买了呆呆兽的尾巴。总觉得呆呆兽很可怜呢。

entries.label: HikerDanielBeatenText
entries.english:
Whoa! I'm beaten
big time!
entries.translation:
天哪！震惊！震撼！
居然能碰到这么强的人！

entries.label: HikerDanielSeenText
entries.english:
Whoa! What a
surprise! I didn't expect to
see anyone here!
entries.translation:
天哪！震惊！震撼！
居然在这种地方碰到人！

entries.label: HikerRussellAfterBattleText
entries.english:
All right, then!
I've decided. I'm not leaving
until my #MONget tougher!
entries.translation:
好——嘞！我决定了！ 在我的宝可梦变强之前，
我要一直待在这里！

entries.label: HikerRussellBeatenText
entries.english: Oh, oh, oh!
entries.translation: 哎呀哎呀……

entries.label: HikerRussellSeenText
entries.english:
You're headed to
AZALEA, are you? Let my #MON see
if you are goodenough to battle.
entries.translation:
你这是要去桧皮镇吗？
让我的宝可梦测试一下你能否离开这个地方吧！

entries.label: PokemaniacLarryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Every Friday, you
can hear #MON roars from deep
inside the cave.
entries.translation:
一到周五，
这个洞窟的深处就会传出宝可梦的叫声。

entries.label: PokemaniacLarryBeatenText
entries.english:
Ugh. My poor #-
MON…
entries.translation: 啊，我的小宝可梦……

entries.label: PokemaniacLarrySeenText
entries.english:
I roam far and
wide in search of#MON. Are you looking
for #MON too? Then you're my
collecting rival!
entries.translation:
我走遍四方寻找宝可梦。
你也是来找宝可梦的吗？ 那你就是我收集之路上的
竞争对手了！

entries.label: UnionCave1FUnusedSignText
entries.english: UNION CAVE
entries.translation: 互连洞

entries.label: HikerLeonardAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I live down here. You can, too, if
you'd like. There's plenty of
room, you see.
entries.translation:
我在这里过日子！
你也能住在这里哦！空地要多少有多少。

entries.label: HikerLeonardBeatenText
entries.english:
Wahahah! You're a
feisty one!
entries.translation:
哇哈哈哈——
充满活力的小朋友！

entries.label: HikerLeonardSeenText
entries.english:
What do you know!
A visitor!
entries.translation: 哦哦，久违的来客！

entries.label: HikerPhillipAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I've been lost for
a long time… I don't mind it
here, but I amsoooo hungry!
entries.translation:
我迷路好久了…… 虽然出不去也无所谓，
但是肚子会饿啊。

entries.label: HikerPhillipBeatenText
entries.english: Uurggh…

entries.label: HikerPhillipSeenText
entries.english:
It's been a while
since I last sawanother person. Don't be shy.
Let's battle!
entries.translation:
啊呀，好久没见过活人了，
那就赶紧派出宝可梦吧！

entries.label: PokemaniacAndrewAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Just me and my
#MON. I'm de-lirious with joy.
entries.translation:
只有我和宝可梦……
啊啊，这是多么幸福啊。

entries.label: PokemaniacAndrewBeatenText
entries.english:
Go…
Go away!
entries.translation:
呜……
你给我滚！

entries.label: PokemaniacAndrewSeenText
entries.english:
Who's there? Leave me and my
#MON alone!
entries.translation:
你哪位？不要来打扰只有
我与宝可梦的世界啊！

entries.label: PokemaniacCalvinAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I should compile
and announce mystudy findings. I might even be-
come famous likePROF.ELM.
entries.translation:
我也该归纳调查结果
并将其发表出来了。 说不定我可以变得和
空木博士一样出名。

entries.label: PokemaniacCalvinBeatenText
entries.english:
You demonstrated
on me!
entries.translation: 反而受到指教了……

entries.label: PokemaniacCalvinSeenText
entries.english:
I came all the way
here to conduct my#MON research. Let me demonstrate
my findings in areal battle!
entries.translation:
为了调查宝可梦，
就连这种地方我也愿意来。 让我用实战来告诉你
我的调查结果吧！

entries.label: CooltrainerfEmmaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Just once a week,
a #MON comes tothe water's edge. I wanted to see
that #MON…
entries.translation:
有种宝可梦，
每周只会来水边一次。 我一直都很想
见它一面呢……

entries.label: CooltrainerfEmmaBeatenText
entries.english:
I'd rather pet my
babies than this!
entries.translation:
比起宝可梦对战，我可能
更喜欢照料宝可梦吧。

entries.label: CooltrainerfEmmaSeenText
entries.english:
If the #MON I
liked were there,I'd go anywhere. That's what a real
trainer does.
entries.translation:
只要有喜欢的宝可梦，
刀山火海在所不辞。这就是所谓的训练家哦。

entries.label: CooltrainerfGwenAfterBattleText
entries.english:
I'm going to train
by myself until Iimprove.
entries.translation:
在变强之前，
我要默默地进行特训！

entries.label: CooltrainerfGwenBeatenText
entries.english:
Aww, no! You're
too good for me.
entries.translation:
啊啊，真是的！
你也太强了吧！

entries.label: CooltrainerfGwenSeenText
entries.english:
I'm in training.
Care for a round?
entries.translation:
我正好在这里特训，
你愿意陪我玩玩吗？

entries.label: CooltrainermNickAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Your #MON style
is stunning andcolorful, I admit. You'll just keep
getting better!
entries.translation:
你的宝可梦品味，
有看点又很养眼呢！你一定能变得更强！

entries.label: CooltrainermNickBeatenText
entries.english:
You've got
dazzling style!
entries.translation: 光彩夺目！

entries.label: CooltrainermNickSeenText
entries.english:
There are two
kinds of people. Those who have
style, and thosewho don't. What kind of
person are you?
entries.translation:
这个世上的人
大致能分成2种：有品位的和没品位的。 你是哪种呢？

entries.label: PokemonFanClubSignText
entries.english:
#MON FAN CLUB All #MON Fans
Welcome!
entries.translation:
这里是宝可梦发烧友俱乐部 热烈欢迎任何
喜欢宝可梦的朋友！

entries.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyAllBadgesText
entries.english:
Congratulations! You got all the
KANTO GYM BADGES. I've got a reward
for your efforts.
entries.translation:
终于集齐关都的徽章了！
恭喜你！ 既然你这么努力，
那我就要送你这个！

entries.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyBattleEdgeText
entries.english:
Having a variety
of #MON types should give you an
edge in battle. I'm sure the KANTO
GYM BADGES willhelp you.
entries.translation:
与朋友对战的时候，
多带不同属性的宝可梦，一定会更有优势。 我觉得关都地区的徽章
也一定能帮到你的！

entries.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyMostBadgesText
entries.english:
I guess you'll be
finished with your conquest of KANTO
GYMS soon. Let me know if
you get all eightBADGES.
entries.translation:
只差一点就能
征服关都的所有道馆了！ 等你收集到8枚徽章
一定要和我说一声啊！

entries.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuySomeBadgesText
entries.english:
You've started to
collect KANTO GYMBADGES? Don't you agree
that the trainershere are tough?
entries.translation:
你已经开始收集
关都的道馆徽章了吗！ 这里有很多
难缠的训练家，对吧！

entries.label: VermilionCityBadgeGuyTrainerText
entries.english:
Skilled trainers
gather in KANTO. GYM LEADERS are
especially strong. They won't be easy
to defeat.
entries.translation:
关都的道馆里聚集了
很多强大的训练家。 其中道馆馆主尤为强大，
别以为可以轻松获胜哦。

entries.label: VermilionCityDiglettsCaveSignText
entries.english: DIGLETT'S CAVE
entries.translation: 地鼠洞穴

entries.label: VermilionCityPortSignText
entries.english:
VERMILION PORT
ENTRANCE
entries.translation: 枯叶港入口

entries.label: VermilionCityRadioNearSnorlaxText
entries.english:
The #GEAR was
placed near thesleeping SNORLAX… … SNORLAX woke up!
entries.translation:
拿起宝可装置，
凑近了卡比兽…… …… …… …… …… ……
…… …… …… …… …… 卡比兽醒来了！

entries.label: VermilionCitySignText
entries.english:
VERMILION CITY The Port of
Exquisite Sunsets
entries.translation:
这里是枯叶市。
枯叶即是日暮的橙黄之色。

entries.label: VermilionCitySnorlaxSleepingText
entries.english:
SNORLAX is snoring
peacefully…
entries.translation:
卡比兽正在打鼾，
似乎睡得很香……

entries.label: VermilionCitySuperNerdText
entries.english:
There are eight
GYMS in KANTO. That big building
is VERMILION's#MON GYM.
entries.translation:
我们关都地区
也有8枚徽章哦。 看，那个大型建筑物
就是枯叶市的道馆了！

entries.label: VermilionCityTeacherText
entries.english:
VERMILION PORT is
KANTO's seasidegateway. Luxury liners from
around the worlddock here.
entries.translation:
这里是枯叶港，
关都通往大海的入口。 甚至会有豪华游轮
从外国开过来哦。

entries.label: VermilionGymSignText
entries.english:
VERMILION CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: LT.SURGE The Lightning
American
entries.translation:
枯叶市宝可梦道馆
馆主：马志士闪电般的美国人！

entries.label: VermilionMachopOwnerText
entries.english:
My #MON is
preparing the landfor construction. But I have no
money to start theproject…
entries.translation:
我让宝可梦先用重踏压路，
不过建楼的钱还没着落……

entries.label: VermilionMachopText1
entries.english:
MACHOP: Guooh
gogogoh!
entries.translation: 腕力：嚎哦～～嚎嚎嚎～～

entries.label: VermilionMachopText2
entries.english:
A MACHOP is growl-
ing while stompingthe ground flat.
entries.translation:
腕力一边吼叫，
一边用重踏来压路！

entries.label: VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouseGentlemanText
entries.english:
Over many years,
DIGLETT dug alarge tunnel. That tunnel goes
to a distant town.
entries.translation:
地鼠花了好几年
才挖出一条直通遥远城镇的地下通路哦。

entries.label: FishingDudeText
entries.english:
I am the FISHING
DUDE, the elder ofthe FISHING BROS. Have you met the
FISHING GURU atLAKE OF RAGE? He dreams about
seeing the world'sgreatest MAGIKARP. If you don't mind,
could you show him any MAGIKARP you
catch? Who knows, you may
catch the MAGIKARPof his dreams.
entries.translation:
我是垂钓大叔！
是爱垂钓兄弟中的哥哥！ 你认不认识
住在愤怒之湖的垂钓名人？ 他的梦想是
看到世上最大的鲤鱼王。 要是你哪天心情好，
你可以把自己捉到的鲤鱼王带给他看看！ 说不定那次就能看到
他梦寐以求的鲤鱼王。

entries.label: FishingDudesHousePhotoText
entries.english:
It's a photo of
people fishing… They're having a
great time…
entries.translation:
照片里
有人正在垂钓……看起来非常开心。

entries.label: GentlemanGregoryAfterBattleText
entries.english:
When I was still
in the army, LT. SURGE saved my
life.
entries.translation:
以前在部队的时候……
我曾经被马志士少校救过一命……！

entries.label: GentlemanGregoryBeatenText
entries.english:
Sorry I failed
you, LT.SURGE,sir!
entries.translation:
非常抱歉！
马志士少校！

entries.label: GentlemanGregorySeenText
entries.english:
You're here to
defeat LT.SURGE? Not if I can help
it!
entries.translation:
你来这里是想要
打败马志士少校吗！别想得逞！

entries.label: GuitaristVincentAfterBattleText
entries.english:
If the GYM's traps
were working, you would have been
toast…
entries.translation:
如果道馆的机关还在，
我肯定能赢你……！

entries.label: GuitaristVincentBeatenText
entries.english: Ooh, how shocking!
entries.translation: 咻——！麻掉了！

entries.label: GuitaristVincentSeenText
entries.english:
LT.SURGE recog-
nized my potential with electric
#MON. Think you can beat
me?
entries.translation:
我使用电属性的技术
可是得到马志士认可的！你赢得了我吗！？

entries.label: JugglerHortonAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Don't get too com-
fortable about beating me…
LT.SURGE is tough.
entries.translation:
你只是赢了我而已，
别掉以轻心啊……马志士少校很强的……

entries.label: JugglerHortonBeatenText
entries.english:
Gwaaah!
I was overpowered…
entries.translation:
呜哇！
好强！

entries.label: JugglerHortonSeenText
entries.english:
I'm going to take
you down! Prepareto be shocked!
entries.translation:
由我来打败你！
做好觉悟吧！

entries.label: LtSurgeFightDoneText
entries.english:
SURGE: Hey, kid!
Still slugging andchugging away? My #MON and I
are still at it!
entries.translation:
马志士：Hey，you！
还在继续努力吧？ Me和宝可梦们
也在继续努力！

entries.label: LtSurgeIntroText
entries.english:
SURGE: Hey, you
little tyke! I have to hand it
to you. It may not be very smart to
challenge me, butit takes guts! When it comes to
electric #MON,I'm number one! I've never lost on
the battlefield. I'll zap you just
like I did myenemies in war!
entries.translation:
马志士：Hey！
Poor little kid！ 居然想向me发起挑战，
You真是不知天高地厚！Me的electric宝可梦，简直Number One！ Me在战场上
从来没输过！！ 我要让You浑身麻麻的，
就像敌方Soldier那样！

entries.label: LtSurgeThunderBadgeText
entries.english:
SURGE: THUNDER-
BADGE increases#MON's speed.  Consider it proof
that you defeated me. You wear it
proudly, hear?
entries.translation:
马志士：有了橙色徽章，
You的宝可梦就会speed up！ 这是战胜me的证明！
You要好好珍惜！

entries.label: LtSurgeWinLossText
entries.english:
SURGE: Arrrgh!
You are strong! OK, kid. You get
THUNDERBADGE!
entries.translation:
马志士：Oh no！
You真是Strong！ Ok！
橙色徽章就给you了！

entries.label: ReceivedThunderBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
THUNDERBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从马志士那里
得到了橙色徽章！

entries.label: VermilionGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! You lucked out
this time. LT.SURGE is very
cautious. He has traps set all over
the GYM. But--he-heh--the
traps aren'tactive right now. You'll have no
problem getting toLT.SURGE.
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！你很走运！ 平时马志士都会
小心翼翼地设置陷阱，但现在正好坏掉了！ 尽管放心，
好好和马志士对战吧！

entries.label: VermilionGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Whew! That was an
electrifying bout! It sure made me
nervous.
entries.translation:
Exciting！
真是令人紧张的比赛！

entries.label: VermilionGymTrashCanText
entries.english:
Nope! Nothing here
but trash.
entries.translation:
我翻我翻……！
垃圾箱里只有垃圾！

entries.label: VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHousePokefanFText
entries.english:
Do you know about
the MAGNET TRAIN? It's a railway
that goes to GOL-DENROD in JOHTO.
entries.translation:
知道磁浮列车吗？ 我说的是可以直达
城都满金市的列车哦。

entries.label: VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouseYoungsterText
entries.english:
I want to go to
SAFFRON to seethe MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.translation:
金黄市——！
我要去金黄市——！好想看磁浮列车——！

entries.label: VermilionMartBeautyText
entries.english:
I'm thinking about
going shopping inSAFFRON.
entries.translation:
我打算去金黄市的商店
买东西。

entries.label: VermilionMartSuperNerdText
entries.english:
TEAM ROCKET is no
longer in KANTO. That alone makes
me happy.
entries.translation:
关都没有火箭队，
只是这样我就觉得很开心！

entries.label: VermilionPokecenter1FBugCatcherText
entries.english:
Oh? You have some
BADGES I've neverseen before. Oh, I get it. You
got them in JOHTO.
entries.translation:
哎呀？你带着一些
我从没见过的徽章啊。 啊，我懂了。
你是城都的居民，对吧！

entries.label: VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText
entries.english:
A sleeping #MON
is lying in frontof DIGLETT'S CAVE. It's a fantastic
opportunity to get it, but how do you
wake it up?
entries.translation:
有只瞌睡的宝可梦
在地鼠洞穴的入口睡觉！ 虽然是捕捉的好机会，
但是要怎么叫醒它？

entries.label: VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText_FoughtSnorlax
entries.english:
There used to be a
sleeping #MON lying in front of
DIGLETT'S CAVE. But it seems to
have disappeared.
entries.translation:
之前有只瞌睡的宝可梦
在地鼠洞穴的入口睡觉，但是突然就不见了！

entries.label: VermilionPokecenter1FSailorText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP is a
great place to meet and battle
trainers.
entries.translation:
能与训练家对战
正是高速船的乐趣所在！

entries.label: VermilionPortAskBoardingText
entries.english:
Welcome to FAST
SHIP S.S.AQUA. Will you be board-
ing today?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到
高速船水流号！要乘船吗？

entries.label: VermilionPortAskTicketText
entries.english:
May I see your
S.S.TICKET?
entries.translation: 那么，请出示一下船票。

entries.label: VermilionPortCantBoardText
entries.english:
Sorry. You can't
board now.
entries.translation: 你无法登船！

entries.label: VermilionPortComeAgainText
entries.english:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.translation:
下次再见，
请多关照。

entries.label: VermilionPortDepartingText
entries.english:
We're departing
soon. Please geton board.
entries.translation:
马上就要启航了，
请上船。

entries.label: VermilionPortNoTicketText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} tried to
show the S.S.TICKET… …But no TICKET! Sorry!
You may board only if you have an
S.S.TICKET.

entries.label: VermilionPortSSTicketText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} flashed
the S.S.TICKET. That's it.
Thank you!
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}向船员
出示了船票！ 好的！可以了！

entries.label: VermilionPortSailSundayText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Sunday.
entries.translation:
高速船预定
在下个周日启航。

entries.label: VermilionPortSailWednesdayText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP will
sail on Wednesday.
entries.translation:
高速船预定
在下个周三启航。

entries.label: VermilionPortSuperNerdText
entries.english:
You came from
JOHTO? I hear many rare
#MON live overthere.
entries.translation:
你是从城都来的吗？
听说那里居住着许多稀有的宝可梦呢。

entries.label: VermilionPortPassageTeacherText
entries.english:
The FAST SHIP
sails on Wednes-days and Sundaysevery week.
entries.translation:
高速船的出航日
是每周的周三与周日！

entries.label: VictoryRoadRivalAfterText
entries.english:
…I haven't given up
on becoming thegreatest trainer… I'm going to find
out why I can't win and become
stronger… When I do, I will
challenge you. And I'll beat you
down with all mypower. …Humph! You keep
at it until then.
entries.translation:
…… …… …… 我并没有放弃
成为最强的训练家。 我要弄清楚失败的原因，
努力变得更强！然后会再来找你挑战的。 到那个时候，我会用尽
浑身解数来打败你！ ……哼！在那之前，
你就努力挣扎吧。

entries.label: VictoryRoadRivalBeforeText
entries.english:
Hold it. …Are you going to
take the #MONLEAGUE challenge? …Don't make me
laugh. You're so much
weaker than I am. I'm not like I was
before. I now have the
best and strongest #MON with me.
I'm invincible! {PLAYER}!
I challenge you!
entries.translation:
慢着！ ……接下来要去挑战
宝可梦联盟吗？ ……开什么玩笑！
你比我弱多了！ 我已经不是从前的我了！ 我现在获得了
最棒、最强的宝可梦！简直就是天下无敌！ {PLAYER}！
来和我对战吧！

entries.label: VictoryRoadRivalDefeatText
entries.english:
…I couldn't win… I gave it every-
thing I had… What you possess,
and what I lack… I'm beginning to
understand what that dragon master
said to me…
entries.translation:
……赢不了啊。 我明明使出全力了…… 你一定具备一些
我所没有的东西…… 我好像开始理解
龙使者的那番话了……

entries.label: VictoryRoadRivalVictoryText
entries.english:
…Humph! When it comes down
to it, nothing canbeat power. I don't need any-
thing else.
entries.translation:
……哼！ 果然要靠实力说话，
其他的都是虚的！

entries.label: VictoryRoadGateEightBadgesText
entries.english:
Oh! The eight
BADGES of JOHTO! Please, go right
on through!
entries.translation:
哦——！
那是城都的8个徽章！请你过去吧！

entries.label: VictoryRoadGateLeftBlackBeltText
entries.english:
This way leads to
MT.SILVER. You'll see scary-
strong #MON outthere.
entries.translation:
前方是 …… 白银山！
里面栖息了很多强到可怕的宝可梦！

entries.label: VictoryRoadGateNotEnoughBadgesText
entries.english:
You don't have all
the GYM BADGES ofJOHTO. I'm sorry, but I
can't let you gothrough.
entries.translation:
你还没有集齐
城都的所有徽章呢！ 规定就是规定，
我不能让你通过！

entries.label: VictoryRoadGateOfficerText
entries.english:
Only trainers who
have proven them-selves may pass.
entries.translation:
前方的道路
只有真正强大的宝可梦训练家才能通行。

entries.label: VictoryRoadGateRightBlackBeltText
entries.english:
Off to the #MON
LEAGUE, are you? The ELITE FOUR are
so strong it's scary, and they're
ready for you!
entries.translation:
要挑战宝可梦联盟吗？
实力骇人的四天王正在等着接受挑战！

entries.label: EarlsPokemonAcademySignText
entries.english:
EARL'S #MON
ACADEMY
entries.translation: 初始老师的宝可梦补习班

entries.label: SproutTowerSignText
entries.english:
SPROUT TOWER Experience the
Way of #MON
entries.translation:
这里是喇叭芽之塔
来进行宝可梦修行吧

entries.label: Text_EarlAsksIfYouBeatFalkner
entries.english:
Hello!
You are trainer? Battle GYM LEADER,
win you did?
entries.translation:
嘿～你是宝可梦训练家吧。
打赢道馆馆～主～了没有？

entries.label: Text_FollowEarl
entries.english:
Is that so? Then
study shall you!Follow me!
entries.translation:
这～样吗～？
那就要好～好～学习了。跟上我哦～

entries.label: Text_HereTeacherIAm
entries.english:
Here, teacher I
am. Good it isyou study here!
entries.translation:
我是这里的老～师！ 你就在这里
好～好～学习吧！

entries.label: Text_VeryNiceIndeed
entries.english:
Ooh, la la!
Very indeed nice!
entries.translation: 那可太～了不起了～！

entries.label: VioletCityGrampsText
entries.english:
FALKNER, from the
VIOLET #MON GYM, is a fine
trainer! He inherited his
father's gym and has done a great
job with it.
entries.translation:
桔梗市宝可梦道馆的阿速
是一位了不起的训练家！ 他继承了父亲的意志，
努力地捍卫着道馆！

entries.label: VioletCityLassText
entries.english:
Ghosts are rumored
to appear inSPROUT TOWER. They said normal-
type #MON moves had no effect on
ghosts.
entries.translation:
有传闻说：到了晚上，
喇叭芽之塔里会闹鬼。 宝可梦与之对战的时候，
使出一般属性的招式居然一点用也没有。

entries.label: VioletCitySignText
entries.english:
VIOLET CITY The City of
Nostalgic Scents
entries.translation:
这里是桔梗市。
散发怀旧气息的城市。

entries.label: VioletCitySuperNerdText
entries.english:
Hey, you're a
#MON trainer? If you beat the
GYM LEADER here, you'll be ready
for prime time!
entries.translation:
哎呀，你是宝可梦训练家？ 如果战胜这里的道馆馆主，
你就算得上是成熟的宝可梦训练家了。

entries.label: VioletCityYoungsterText
entries.english:
I saw a wiggly
tree up ahead! If you touch it,
it squirms anddances! Cool!
entries.translation:
前面有棵会动的树！ 一碰它就会晃悠悠地跳舞，
超级有趣哦！

entries.label: VioletGymSignText
entries.english:
VIOLET CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: FALKNER The Elegant Master
of Flying #MON
entries.translation:
桔梗市宝可梦道馆
馆主：阿速华丽的飞行宝可梦专家！

entries.label: BirdKeeperAbeAfterBattleText
entries.english:
This is pathetic,
losing to somerookie trainer…
entries.translation:
居然输给了菜鸟训练家，
我真是太丢人了……

entries.label: BirdKeeperAbeBeatenText
entries.english:
This can't be
true!
entries.translation: 真的假的——！？

entries.label: BirdKeeperAbeSeenText
entries.english:
Let me see if you
are good enough toface FALKNER!
entries.translation:
让我确认一下你有没有资格
去挑战阿速先生吧。

entries.label: BirdKeeperRodAfterBattleText
entries.english:
FALKNER's skills
are for real! Don't get cocky
just because youbeat me!
entries.translation:
阿速先生
可不是吃素的！ 你也就只能打赢我而已，
不要太得意忘形！

entries.label: BirdKeeperRodBeatenText
entries.english: Gaaah!

entries.label: BirdKeeperRodSeenText
entries.english:
The keyword is
guts! Those here are
training night and day to become bird
#MON masters. Come on!
entries.translation:
我们的口号是永不言败！！ 聚集在这里的人都希望用
鸟宝可梦来成为最强，从早到晚都在特训！ 你尽管来吧——！

entries.label: FalknerFightDoneText
entries.english:
There are #MON
GYMS in cities andtowns ahead. You should test
your skills atthese GYMS. I'm going to train
harder to become the greatest bird
master!
entries.translation:
接下来，
有道馆的城市还有很多，你不妨去试试身手。 而我，为了成为最强的
鸟宝可梦专家，要和宝可梦一起变强！

entries.label: FalknerIntroText
entries.english:
I'm FALKNER, the
VIOLET #MON GYMleader! People say you can
clip flying-type #MON's wings
with a jolt ofelectricity… I won't allow such
insults to bird#MON! I'll show you the
real power of the magnificent bird
#MON!
entries.translation:
我就是桔梗道馆的
道馆馆主阿速！ 世人都说
飞行属性宝可梦没什么，来一发电击就完蛋…… 他们如此小瞧鸟宝可梦，
我无法原谅！ 我一定要让他们明白
能在空中翩翩飞舞的鸟宝可梦到底有多厉害！

entries.label: FalknerTMMudSlapText
entries.english:
By using a TM, a
#MON will instantly learn a
new move. Think before you
act--a TM can beused only once. TM31 contains
MUD-SLAP. It reduces the
enemy's accuracy while it causes
damage. In other words, it
is both defensiveand offensive.
entries.translation:
使用招式学习器，
宝可梦就能立刻学会招式了！ 不过是一次性的，
用之前要好好考虑一下。 顺带一提，招式学习器31
里面含有“掷泥”。 降低对方命中率的同时
会给予对方伤害， 换句话说，
这是一个攻守兼备的招式。

entries.label: FalknerWinLossText
entries.english:
…Darn! My dad's
cherished bird#MON… All right.
Take this. It's the official
#MON LEAGUEZEPHYRBADGE.
entries.translation:
……可恶，
父亲宝贵的宝可梦居然…… 好吧，
这个拿去吧！ 这是宝可梦联盟认可的
飞翼徽章！

entries.label: FalknerZephyrBadgeText
entries.english:
ZEPHYRBADGE
raises the attackpower of #MON. It also enables
#MON to use FLASH, if they
have it, anytime. Here--take this
too.
entries.translation:
有了飞翼徽章，
你的宝可梦的攻击力就会上升！ 另外，如果有宝可梦
记住了叫做闪光的招式，那么它在对战之外也可以使用闪光了。 这个也拿去吧。

entries.label: ReceivedZephyrBadgeText
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
ZEPHYRBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从阿速那里
得到了飞翼徽章！

entries.label: VioletGymGuideText
entries.english:
Hey! I'm no train-
er but I can givesome advice! Believe me!
If you believe, a championship dream
can come true. You believe?
Then listen. The grass-type is
weak against the flying-type. Keep
this in mind.
entries.translation:
嗨～！
虽然我不是训练家，但是建议还是能给几个的！ 相信我吧！
只要信任我说的话，成为冠军也不再是梦！ 是吗，你愿意听我说的！
真的吗！ 草属性面对飞行属性
非常不利，要多加小心！

entries.label: VioletGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Nice battle! Keep
it up, and you'll be the CHAMP in no
time at all!
entries.translation:
真是精彩的对战！
保持这个势头， 一路成为宝可梦冠军！

entries.label: VioletKylesHousePokefanMText
entries.english:
A #MON you get
in a trade growsquickly. But if you don't
have the right GYM BADGE, they may
disobey you.
entries.translation:
和别人交换过来的宝可梦
会获得更快的成长！ ……但是如果没有徽章，
它就会变得不听话。

entries.label: VioletMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
#MON can hold
items like POTIONand ANTIDOTE. But they don't
appear to know how to use manmade
items.
entries.translation:
虽然宝可梦可以携带道具，
但是像伤药或解毒药这种人工制造的道具，它们好像用不来呢。

entries.label: VioletMartGrannyText
entries.english:
When you first
catch a #MON,it may be weak. But it will even-
tually grow to bestrong. It's important to
treat #MON withlove.
entries.translation:
宝可梦刚捉来或许很弱，
但只要好好培养，总有一天会变强的。 我觉得最重要的
还是对宝可梦的爱。

entries.label: VioletNicknameSpeechHouseBirdText
entries.english: STRAWBERRY: Pijji!
entries.translation: 小草莓：波波～！

entries.label: VioletNicknameSpeechHouseLassText
entries.english:
I call my PIDGEY
STRAWBERRY!
entries.translation:
我的波波
名字是小草莓！

entries.label: VioletNicknameSpeechHouseTeacherText
entries.english:
She uses the names
of her favoritethings to eat. For the nicknames
she gives to her#MON, I mean.
entries.translation:
她总是把自己喜欢的食物
拿来取名字。 我是在说我女儿
给宝可梦取的昵称哦。

entries.label: VioletCityElmsAideFullPartyText
entries.english:
Oh, no. You can't
carry any more#MON with you. I'll wait here
while you makeroom for the EGG.
entries.translation:
你身上带了很多宝可梦，
已经带不下了。那么，我就在这里等你。

entries.label: VioletPokecenter1FGameboyKidText
entries.english:
A guy named BILL
made the #MONPC storage system.
entries.translation:
将捕捉到的宝可梦
寄放进电脑的系统好像是叫正辉的人创建的。

entries.label: VioletPokecenter1FGentlemanText
entries.english:
It was around
three years ago. TEAM ROCKET was up
to no good with#MON. But justice pre-
vailed--a youngkid broke 'em up.
entries.translation:
大概是3年前的事情了。 有一帮叫做火箭队的人，
他们捕捉宝可梦，到处为非作歹。 但是，邪不压正！
在一位少年的奋斗之下，他们最后被迫解散了！

entries.label: VioletPokecenter1FYoungsterText
entries.english:
#MON are smart.
They won't obey a trainer they don't
respect. Without the right
GYM BADGES, they will just do as
they please.
entries.translation:
宝可梦相当聪明呢。
如果训练家不值得尊敬，他们就不会听话。 如果没有道馆徽章，
他们会无视命令擅自行动！

entries.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideAskEggText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, will you
take the EGG?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，
你愿意带上这个蛋吗？

entries.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideFavorText
entries.english:
{PLAYER}, long
time, no see. PROF.ELM asked me
to find you. He has another
favor to ask. Would you take the
#MON EGG?
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}，好久不见。
空木博士之前委托我来找你哦。 其实呢…… 他希望你能
带上这个宝可梦蛋！

entries.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideGiveEggText
entries.english:
We discovered that
a #MON will not hatch until it
grows in the EGG. It also has to be
with other active#MON to hatch. {PLAYER}, you're
the only personwe can rely on. Please call PROF.
ELM when that EGGhatches!
entries.translation:
根据空木博士的调查，
宝可梦好像要在蛋中培育一段时间才会孵化出来！ 而且边上还要时常有
健康的宝可梦陪着，否则也不行。 这种事情只有
{PLAYER}能办得到，所以就拜托你了！ 等它孵化出来，
记得联系空木博士哦！

entries.label: VioletPokecenterElmsAideRefuseText
entries.english:
B-but… PROF.ELM
asked for you…
entries.translation:
别、别这样……
这可是空木博士的请求啊！

entries.label: VioletPokecenterFarawayLinkText
entries.english:
I've been thinking
it'd be great to be able to link up
and battle with my friends who live
far away.
entries.translation:
我总是在想，
要是能和身处远方的朋友进行连接对战，那该有多好啊！

entries.label: VioletPokecenterMobileAdapterText
entries.english:
I just battled a
friend in CIANWOODover a link. If you connect a
MOBILE ADAPTER, you can link with
a friend far away.
entries.translation:
刚刚，
我和远在湛蓝市的朋友进行了连接对战！ 只要有接上移动适配器，
就能与远方的朋友们进行连接了！

entries.label: TrainerHouseSignText
entries.english:
TRAINER HOUSE The Club for Top
Trainer Battles
entries.translation:
训练家之屋
强者的聚集地

entries.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsBelievedText
entries.english:
Good, good. Yes, I
was something out of the ordinary,
let me tell you!
entries.translation:
对吧！对吧！
嗯嗯。

entries.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsDoubtedText
entries.english:
What? You little
whelp! If I were just a
bit younger, I'd show you a thing
or two. Humph!
entries.translation:
你这小屁孩！ 我要是再年轻点，
一定会给你露两手！

entries.label: ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsQuestionText
entries.english:
Hey, kid! I just
had a double shot of espresso, and
I am wired! I need to talk to
someone, so you'llhave to do! I might not look
like much now, but I was an expert at
catching #MON. Do you believe me?
entries.translation:
喂！嗝……你等等！
好好听我讲话！ 别看我现在是这样，
以前也算是捕捉宝可梦的高手！ 你信吗？

entries.label: ViridianCityDreamEaterFisherGotDreamEaterText
entries.english:
TM42 contains
DREAM EATER… …Zzzzz…
entries.translation:
招式学习器42就是……
食梦哦…………呼噜噜……

entries.label: ViridianCityDreamEaterFisherText
entries.english:
Yawn! I must have dozed
off in the sun. …I had this dream
about a DROWZEE eating my dream.
Weird, huh? Huh?
What's this? Where did this TM
come from? This is spooky!
Here, you can havethis TM.
entries.translation:
哈啊……！
想要晒会儿太阳，结果居然就这么睡着了…… 我做了个很奇怪的梦……
我梦见催眠貘在吃梦！……咦？我手里怎么会拿着一个招式学习器咧？ 这简直
太邪门了！给你吧，你快拿去！

entries.label: ViridianCityGrampsNearGymBlueReturnedText
entries.english:
Are you going to
battle the LEADER? Good luck to you.
You'll need it.
entries.translation:
你要去挑战馆主吗？
加油啊。

entries.label: ViridianCityGrampsNearGymText
entries.english:
This GYM didn't
have a LEADERuntil recently. A young man from
PALLET became the LEADER, but he's
often away.
entries.translation:
前不久，这家道馆
还是没有道馆馆主的。 最近有个真新镇的年轻人
成了这里的新馆主。……不过现在不在这里。

entries.label: ViridianCitySignText
entries.english:
VIRIDIAN CITY The Eternally
Green Paradise
entries.translation:
这里是常青市
常青即是恒久的翠绿之色。

entries.label: ViridianCityWelcomeSignText
entries.english:
WELCOME TO
VIRIDIAN CITY, THE GATEWAY TO
INDIGO PLATEAU
entries.translation:
欢迎来到石英高原的
关口城市——常青市！

entries.label: ViridianCityYoungsterText
entries.english:
I heard that there
are many items on the ground in
VIRIDIAN FOREST.
entries.translation:
我听别人说
有很多看不见的道具散落在常青森林里！

entries.label: ViridianGymSignText
entries.english:
VIRIDIAN CITY
#MON GYMLEADER: … The rest of the
text is illegible…
entries.translation:
常青市宝可梦道馆
馆主：……后面的字看不清了！

entries.label: LeaderBlueAfterText
entries.english:
BLUE: … All right, I was
wrong. You're the real deal. You are
a good trainer. But I'm going to
beat you someday. Don't you forget
it!
entries.translation:
青绿：…… …… …… 看来我错了，
你确实是实力非凡的强大训练家！这点我要老老实实地承认！ 不过，
别忘了！ 我总有一天
会把你打败的！

entries.label: LeaderBlueBeforeText
entries.english:
BLUE: Yo! Finally
got here, huh? I wasn't in the
mood at CINNABAR, but now I'm ready
to battle you. … You're telling me
you conquered allthe GYMS in JOHTO? Heh! JOHTO's GYMS
must be prettypathetic then. Hey, don't worry
about it. I'll know if you
are good or not by battling you right
now. Ready, JOHTO
CHAMP?
entries.translation:
青绿：唷，你来啦。 我在红莲镇的时候
可能有点小忧伤。但是此时此刻，我充满了对战的欲望！ …… …… …… 我听说你战胜了
城都地区所有道馆？ 城都的水准该不会
低得不像话吧？ 算了，
只要来场对战，我就能知道你的实力是真是假！ 来吧！
城都地区的冠军！

entries.label: LeaderBlueEpilogueText
entries.english:
BLUE: Listen, you. You'd better not
lose until I beatyou. Got it?
entries.translation:
青绿：听好了！ 在被我打败之前，
你可不准输啊！

entries.label: LeaderBlueWinText
entries.english:
BLUE: What? How the heck did I
lose to you? … Tch, all right…
Here, take this--it's EARTHBADGE.
entries.translation:
青绿：不可能！ 我怎么可能
输给你这种人！！ …… …… ……
……切，没办法。这就是绿色徽章，归你了！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedEarthBadge
entries.english:
{PLAYER} received
EARTHBADGE.
entries.translation:
{PLAYER}从青绿那里
得到了绿色徽章！

entries.label: ViridianGymGuideText
entries.english:
Yo, CHAMP in
making! How's it going?
Looks like you'reon a roll. The GYM LEADER is
a guy who battled the CHAMPION three
years ago. He's no pushover. Give it everything
you've got!
entries.translation:
嗨～！
未来的冠军！状态如何？看起来一切顺利呀！ 3年前与冠军
展开殊死对决的男人正是这家道馆的馆主。 这关可不好过啊！
加油吧！

entries.label: ViridianGymGuideWinText
entries.english:
Man, you are truly
tough… That was a heck of
an inspirational battle. It brought
tears to my eyes.
entries.translation:
你果然很强呢！
我都要哭出来了，真是一场令人感动的对战！

entries.label: ViridianMartCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
Have you been to
CINNABAR? It's an island way
south of here.
entries.translation:
去过红莲镇吗？ 从这里一直往南有座岛，
那就是红莲镇！

entries.label: ViridianMartLassText
entries.english:
The GYM LEADER
here is totallycool.
entries.translation:
这个城市的道馆馆主
超级酷、超级帅气哦！

entries.label: RatteyText
entries.english: RATTEY: Kikiii!
entries.translation: 小拉：吱吱——！

entries.label: SpearyText
entries.english: SPEARY: Ch-chun!
entries.translation: 小烈：啾啾！

entries.label: ViridianNicknameSpeechHouseLassText
entries.english:
They're SPEARY--
a SPEAROW--andRATTEY--a RATTATA.
entries.translation:
这只烈雀叫做小烈，
这只小拉达叫做小拉！

entries.label: ViridianNicknameSpeechHousePokefanMText
entries.english:
Do you put a lot
of thought into naming your
#MON? Giving them good
nicknames adds to the fun of trading
with others.
entries.translation:
给宝可梦起昵称之前，
你有没有仔细思考过？ 如果取了昵称，
和别人交换的时候会更有乐趣哦！

entries.label: ViridianPokecenter1FBugCatcherText
entries.english:
My dream is to be-
come a GYM LEADER.
entries.translation:
成为道馆馆主
是我的梦想啊！

entries.label: ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText
entries.english:
I heard that the
GYM in CINNABAR isgone. I wonder what be-
came of BLAINE,the GYM LEADER.
entries.translation:
红莲镇的道馆
好像消失不见了。 那里的道馆馆主夏伯
现在又在哪里干什么呢？

entries.label: ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText
entries.english:
Where in the world
is VIRIDIAN's GYM LEADER? I wanted
to challenge him.
entries.translation:
常青市的道馆馆主
到底去哪了啊？我很想挑战他啊。

entries.label: ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText_BlueReturned
entries.english:
There are no GYM
TRAINERS at theVIRIDIAN GYM. The LEADER claims
his policy is to win without having
any underlings.
entries.translation:
常青市的道馆里面
没有一般的道馆训练家。 不管有没有跟班都能赢，
这好像是馆主的基本原则。

entries.label: LugiaText
entries.english: Gyaaas!
entries.translation: 奇——亚斯！！

entries.label: WillScript_WillBeatenText
entries.english:
I… I can't…
believe it…
entries.translation: ……伤脑筋啊。

entries.label: WillScript_WillBeforeText
entries.english:
Welcome to #MON
LEAGUE, {PLAYER}. Allow me to intro-
duce myself. I amWILL. I have trained all
around the world, making my psychic
#MON powerful. And, at last, I've
been accepted intothe ELITE FOUR. I can only keep
getting better! Losing is not an
option!
entries.translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦联盟，
{PLAYER}！ 我的名字是一树。 以前环游世界的时候，
我日夜不停地锻炼着我的超能力宝可梦。 最后终于成为了
四天王中的一员。 我还要变得更强！
可不会在这里输掉！

entries.label: WillScript_WillDefeatText
entries.english:
Even though I was
defeated, I won'tchange my course. I will continue
battling until I stand above all
trainers! Now, {PLAYER}, move
on and experience the true ferocity
of the ELITE FOUR.
entries.translation:
虽然这次输了，
但我的计划没有改变。为了站上训练家的顶点，我还会不断地战斗。 {PLAYER}，继续前进吧，
好好体会一下四天王的可怕之处！

entries.label: SageGakuAfterBattleText
entries.english:
Ah, so it is you
who claim to have seen SUICUNE,
ENTEI and RAIKOUwhile they slept? Unbelievable! Legend has it that
they can't be seenwhile they sleep…
entries.translation:
你就是那个见到了
沉睡中的水君、炎帝、雷公的人物吗？ 难以置信！ 如果传说是真的，
在它们沉睡的时候，应该是无法被人看见的……

entries.label: SageGakuBeatenText
entries.english:
Stronger than we
thought? Perhaps…
entries.translation:
强得超乎想象……
……难道……

entries.label: SageGakuSeenText
entries.english:
Legend has it that
upon the emergence of a trainer who
has the ability to touch the souls of
#MON, a #MON will come forth to
put that trainer to test at the TIN
TOWER. The legend has
come true! The legendary
#MON SUICUNEhas arrived! We, the WISE TRIO,
shall test your worthiness to go
inside!
entries.translation:
传说里提到：
当与宝可梦心意相通的人出现的时候， 就要在铃铛塔中
对那个人进行考验…… 宝可梦…… 神圣的水君出现了，
就像传说里描述的那样！ 因此我们三人组，
就要在这里测试一下你是否具备那样的资格！

entries.label: SageKojiAfterBattleFinalText
entries.english:
Please, do go on. SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
entries.translation:
请走这边。 神圣的水君将会
对你发起考验。

entries.label: SageKojiAfterBattleQuestionText
entries.english:
You… Are you the
trainer who is awaited by the
legendary #MON?
entries.translation:
你……难不成！？
就是传说的宝可梦一直期盼的那个人！？

entries.label: SageKojiAfterBattleSpeechText
entries.english:
I see… We, the WISE TRIO,
have been given  the responsibility
of protecting the legendary #MON.
We are to allow passage only to
those people who possess the power
and soul of truth. Please, do go on
and enter the TINTOWER ahead. SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
entries.translation:
原来如此…… 我们三人组收到命令：
要在此守护传说的宝可梦， 并且让拥有真实之力、
拥有真实之心的人顺利通过这里。 请走这边。 然后请你进入
前方不远处的铃铛塔。 神圣的水君将会
对你发起考验。

entries.label: SageKojiBeatenText
entries.english:
Too strong!
Why?
entries.translation:
好、好强……强过头了。
这是为什么！？

entries.label: SageKojiSeenText
entries.english:
Let me see your
power!
entries.translation: 让我看看你的实力！

entries.label: SageMasaAfterBattleText
entries.english:
In the past, there
were two nine-tiertowers here. The BRASS TOWER,
which was said to awaken #MON,
and the TIN TOWER, where #MON were
said to rest. The view from the
tops of the TOWERS must have been
magnificent. At the time, an
immense, silver- colored #MON
was said to make its roost atop the
BRASS TOWER. However… About 150 years
ago, a lightning bolt struck one of
the TOWERS. It was engulfed in
flames that ragedfor three days. A sudden downpour
finally put outthe blaze. And that is how
the BURNED TOWERcame to be.
entries.translation:
很久以前
有2座九重塔。 传说能让宝可梦醒来的塔
——铜钟塔， 传说能让宝可梦休息的塔
——铃铛塔。 当时一定是一副
气派的景象。 那段期间，
有只巨大的银色宝可梦会在铜钟塔上顿羽栖息。 然而…… 在距今150多年前，
天雷击中了其中一座塔。 于是这座塔
包裹在熊熊烈火之中，连续烧了三天三夜。 然后…… 天上突然降下暴雨
浇灭了大火。 最后变成了现在的烧焦塔。

entries.label: SageMasaBeatenText
entries.english:
…I will tell you
the truth…
entries.translation:
…………
那我就说出真相吧。

entries.label: SageMasaSeenText
entries.english:
Can you be trusted
with the truth? I must ascertain
your worthiness.
entries.translation:
我还不确定能不能
让你得知真相。 请展示一下你的实力吧。

entries.label: WiseTriosRoomSage1Text
entries.english:
Astounding… SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU have arisenfrom their sleep… Is the legend
coming true?
entries.translation:
竟然有这种事！ 神圣的水君、炎帝、雷公
居然苏醒了…… 难道传说中的故事成真了？

entries.label: WiseTriosRoomSage2Text
entries.english:
We train at the
BURNED TOWER, but we've never heard
of a hole opening up there before.
It must have been deliberately made
by someone.
entries.translation:
我们一直在烧焦塔中
进行修行。从来没听说过塔里会裂开一个洞。 这个洞一定是有人
故意挖出来的……

entries.label: WiseTriosRoomSage3BlocksExitText
entries.english:
TIN TOWER may be
entered by those bearing ECRUTEAK's
GYM BADGE. However, now that
SUICUNE, RAIKOU and ENTEI have
arisen, I ask you to refrain from
entering!
entries.translation:
虽然之前说允许
拥有缘朱道馆徽章的人进入铃铛塔。 可神圣的水君、炎帝、雷公
现在已经苏醒了， 暂时谢绝入内！

entries.label: WiseTriosRoomSage3Text
entries.english:
We, the WISE TRIO,
are the protectors of the legendary
#MON.
entries.translation:
我们是守护传说的宝可梦的
三人组。

entries.label: Text_BattleRoomVisitLimit
entries.english:
One visit per day
per BATTLE ROOM!
entries.translation:
挑战过一次的对战房间，
该天不能再挑战第二次！

entries.label: Text_CancelBattleRoomChallenge
entries.english:
Cancel your BATTLE
ROOM challenge?
entries.translation:
向对战房间发起的挑战，
现在要取消吗？

entries.label: Text_CanceledSendingSaveFile
entries.english:
Canceled sending
SAVE FILE.
entries.translation:
已放弃
发送宝可梦记录！

entries.label: Text_CheckBattleRoomListByMaxLevel
entries.english:
Check BATTLE ROOM
list by max level?
entries.translation:
要观看哪种
等级限制的房间一览？

entries.label: Text_EnterWhichBattleRoom
entries.english:
Enter which
BATTLE ROOM?
entries.translation:
要挑战哪种
对战房间？

entries.label: Text_ExitGymLeaderHonorRoll
entries.english:
Exit GYM LEADER
HONOR ROLL?
entries.translation:
要结束观看
历代关主一览吗？

entries.label: Text_LinkingWithCenter
entries.english:
Linking with the
CENTER…
entries.translation:
接下来将会连接中心，
请耐心等待。

entries.label: Text_PartyMonTopsThisLevel
entries.english:
A party #MON
tops this level.
entries.translation:
你的同行宝可梦之中
有可以承受这个级别的吗？

entries.label: Text_QuitReadingNews
entries.english: Quit reading NEWS?
entries.translation:
要放弃读
新闻吗？

entries.label: Text_ReadingNews
entries.english: Reading NEWS…
entries.translation: 正在读取新闻……

entries.label: Text_ReceivedNews
entries.english: Received NEWS!
entries.translation: 新闻已读取！

entries.label: Text_ReceivedOddEgg
entries.english:
ODD EGG
was received!
entries.translation:
让您久等了！
谜之蛋已接收！

entries.label: Text_RegisteringRecord
entries.english:
Registering your
record…
entries.translation:
正在记录
你的成绩

entries.label: Text_SaveFileWillBeSent
entries.english:
SAVE FILE will be
sent.
entries.translation: 正在发送宝可梦记录……

entries.label: Text_SentSaveFileReadingNews
entries.english:
Sent SAVE FILE.
Reading NEWS…
entries.translation:
宝可梦记录已发送！
正在读取新闻……

entries.label: Text_ThisBattleRoomPleaseWait
entries.english:
{STRBUF}'s ROOM
{STRBUF}?Please wait…
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}房间，
{STRBUF}吗？请稍等一下。

entries.label: Text_UberRestriction
entries.english:
{STRBUF} may go
only to BATTLE ROOMS that are
Lv.70 or higher.
entries.translation:
{STRBUF}达到等级70
以上才能参加对战房间。

entries.label: Text_WhatLevelDoYouWantToChallenge
entries.english:
What level do you
want to challenge?
entries.translation:
要挑战哪种
等级限制的房间？

entries.label: Text_WhichBattleRoom

entries.translation: 哪种对战房间？
